Skibidi Sandbox is the perfect game to have some action. There are also two maps you can explore and have some fun shooting/blowing things up and finding secrets. This is the perfect game for you if you want to have some skibidi fun.

title: Ultima Online: Outlands
description:
Join us in launching the most anticipated Ultima Online server! UO Outlands is a free-to-play shard set in the T2A era with over 3 years of development.

Be among the first to form a guild, place a house, conquer a dungeon, kill one of your fellow adventurers, or master a skill. There is nothing quite like the rush of logging in with hundreds of other players for the first time, all on equal footing.

Outlands features auto-account creation, so simply download our installer, pick your assistant of choice (Razor or Steam) and login! Because Outlands is a highly customized gaming world featuring a brand new map, new monsters, new clothing items, custom hues and more, we have made the installation process as easy as possible.

title: Accolade Sports Collection
description:
Accolade Sports Collection is a retro collection featuring some of the most iconic sports games from the early 90s. This collection includes titles like Summer Challenge, Winter Challenge, Hardball 1&2 and Hoops Shut Up and Jam!.

This collection offers a complete retro gaming experience, where players can easily select from the different titles available, with features like save states, filters options, manuals and more!

title: Blades & Battles
description: Blades & Battles is a fantasy Beat'Em Up game that takes players to the heart of the legendary world of King Arthur in his barbarian youth. A modern version of classic titles such as Golden Axe.

title: Bird Simulator 24
description: Take flight in Bird Simulator 24, an outrageous action game where you reclaim your rightful territory from the humans and assert your genetic dominance! As a fearless bird, your mission is simple: rule the skies, reclaim your homeland, and fight the humans in the most hilarious ways imaginable.

title: Tales of the Uncanny
description: A horror game featuring standalone stories filled with eerie atmospheres and unsettling mysteries. Each chapter reveals a new, chilling narrative where your choices shape the outcomes. Dive into the unknown and embrace the uncanny.

title: Course of Temptation
description:
Course of Temptation is a detailed adult college life simulator. It’s text-based and runs right in your browser.

Featuring a detailed simulation with hundreds of possible events and erotic scenes, you can explore your exhibitionist, voyeuristic, and debauched fantasies through your character.

A detailed life simulator! Manage your character’s day-to-day needs, skills, attitudes, clothes, and so on. A different story every day! Make plans as you like. Go to class. See a movie. Work out at the gym. Make some questionable side bets at the arcade. But expect surprises.

Hundreds of events mean you can never be sure exactly what will happen. An erotic narrative. Long-term plotlines with recurring characters will play out over time, including erotic prose that’s reactive to your character and your decisions.

title: Crater Song
description: Crater Song is a single-player co-op puzzle-adventure game with an authentic 8-bit aesthetic that takes place on the alien world of Orebody. Two twins, born of song, must embark on a mythic journey to lift a curse that makes them the target of eldritch horrors from beyond the stars.

title: Sunset Land
description: Our story takes place on Venture, a planet that has recently been colonized by several corporations to harvest its valuable resources. You play as a psychic named Marco, who is tasked with stealing 3 stellar crystals (artifacts which contain tremendous amounts of energy) for an intergalactic mob boss.

title: Corporeal
description: Amateur ghost hunters seeking a cheap thrill becomes a nightmare. Investigate haunted places, but beware—the more you uncover, the more hostile the spirits become.

title: Jeff The Killer vs. Slendrina
description:
Jeff the Killer vs. Slendrina brings together two evil and dastardly villains in an epic third person shooter battle. You can play as either Jeff the killer or the fearesome and twisted Slendrina.

Move around the map and find the different hidden objects as you play. You must battle it out against the other iconic character but also fight against the various monsters and creatures that you encounter. Who will win the ultimate battle of evil?

title: Realm of Chaos 2
description: On October 31st, 1996, The Macintosh Team released Realm of Chaos, the first Mac-made megawad. Now, in a rare opportunity, 2 of the original mappers, Steve Duff and Rob Berkowitz, and his son, Leo Berahovich, along with a team of veterans and fans of RoC, have combined to create Realm of Chaos 2: The Revenge of '96! The style of this megawad is oldschool with occasional fashion-forward maps. The mix is eclectic, similar to the original RoC, with broadly defined episode themes. Difficulty ranges from mild to challenging, especially in the episode-ending maps.

title: Valkyrie Destruction
description: Explore a classic JRPG world together with a cute battle maiden! Upon being rescued from a monster by a passing battle maiden, the protagonist Batz begins journeying together with her. But taking advantage of her weakness, the scoundrel Batz has other plans for his beautiful savior.

title: Domino Earning World
description:
It is the first platform for this game, based on blockchain that unites millions of domino enthusiasts in a community where they will be able to buy and create their own NFTs such as avatars and accessories.

In addition, they will be able to organize games including tournaments in gaming centers. DEW will combine multi-million dollar video game-based marketplaces and a popularized millennial game, all merged by blockchain and NFT technologies.

There are not many video games that offer players the opportunity to generate real profits. We believe there is a huge opportunity in the video game market with “play to win” features.

This is skill-based gaming with the potential for real-world monetary rewards. The slow digitization and lack of transparency of the NFT gaming market, gave us the ability to see the great niche for the creation of Dominoes as NFT.

Online domino game platforms with modern graphics, extensive gameplay possibilities and, most importantly, blockchain is what the market wants.

title: Holy Undead
description: An undead-loving necromancer is reincarnated as a saint!? By chance, the necromancer Frankel is reborn as Yurishia, a girl with the incredible qualities of a saint. Today, too, she ignores the expectations of those around her and forges ahead on her path to collecting undead.

title: Isekai-ya
description: An adorable cooking game where you hop around many worlds, finding new ingredients to whip up new recipes. Get to meet a variety of customers of all races and background as you immerse yourself in the flow and frenzy of running a restaurant.

title: Mint Fantome's Freak or Treat
description: Join Mint and her friends on a spooky-fun Halloween adventure! Trick or treat through eerie but charming neighbourhoods, discovering candies, coins, and cute characters in every level. Use her Halloween costume powers to overcome obstacles and explore hidden areas. Can you help Mint collect every treat and meet all of her friends?

title: Spirit Driver
description: From the everyday passenger to the horrors of Halloween, Spirit Driver is a short, casual conversation simulator where your choices can affect the fates of people and spirits alike. Remember, your choices have consequences. Good luck!

title: Love Me or Die
description: Yuki, a lonely teenager, embarks on a desperate quest for popularity and fame. But her path soon turns into a dark and tragic journey that will change her life forever. A retro graphic adventure with challenging puzzles, intense tweet battles, and a pixelated world filled with humor and mysteries.

title: While We Sleep: Slendrina Is Here
description: While We Sleep: Slendrina Is Here is the first person horror game in which you must find keys and fight evil beings. While most of are sleeping there are others fighting to keep us all safe. Slendrina is coming and you need to defeat the evil spirit for the safety of the world.

title: Astral Blitz
description: Astral Blitz is a roguelite, twin stick shooter. Control your fighter ship and wreak devastation through the hordes of empire defenses. Create your own play style as you customize your ship to your needs, setting it up for brutal destruction, refined precision, or to become chaos incarnate!

title: Gamit: The Skyward Voyage
description:
An incredible voyage about the disheveled old man, Gamit, and his crusade to annihilate a sky-born nation.

Plucked from the crust of the earth, the elite of the world decided to break free from the surface. Leaving the surface drought with pollution and disarray. However, there is one, misguided-idiotic-unwashed man, ready to take them down.

Gamit plays as a top-down shooter, pick from 12 varied weapons before you pick a mission to take down. Fight varied enemies in different levels through-out 4 worlds. Tackle goals with a variety of options, fight bosses with varied patterns and counters, and help Gamit destroy the new sky nation.

title: JellyBall
description:
Jellyball is a physics platformer where you control a squishy slime!

JellyBall takes after the game Gish, where you play as a simulated blob that can change forms.

title: ChronoVenture
description:
ChronoVenture is a momentum-based Gameboy-style platformer shooter where the player controls a cat named Lizzy as she runs, jumps, claws and shoots her way to the end of the level where she'll encounter against a boss to unlock a new weapon or ability before she finds herself warping into the future.

Taking inspiration from Sonic CD, you start off in Act 1 during the present or past of a stage where you can either focus on completing an objective that changes the future in Act 2 for the better or reach to the end as fast as you can for a tougher challenge.

title: Let's Fly Away
description: Let's Fly Away is a shoot em' up (shmup) which aims to make the game accessible to anyone with its easy, flowing gameplay, with layers of depth for advanced players to toy around with the massive amount of customization for a different experience each play through. The game is also built around a story unlike most shmups, telling a different tale with each of it's main characters.

title: Lady Killers
description: You play as a futuristic ninja girl named Ashe who joins a female mercenary group called Lady Killers. In this game you'll be fighting robots, monsters, and other PMC groups as you progress through missions and fight powerful enemies.

title: Horror High
description:
HORROR HIGH is a '90s horror/comedy 4v1, competitive survival, open-map RPG.
Up to four high school stereotypes face iconic monsters as they attempt to survive and escape.

Journey around the expansive town of Creepertin as you gave weapons, health, flashlights, and key items you'll need to rebuild long-abandoned vehicles and flee to safety. Or, team up and try to take down your pursuer!

title: Linja vs. the Maneclowns
description: Linja vs. the Maneclowns is wacky 2D action platformer focused on speed and mobility.

title: Marble Launcher
description: Journey through the world of Marble Launcher. Explore interesting worlds and overcome challenges in a 2D platforming adventure.

title: The Headmaster
description: The headmaster is a dark comedy combining a nonlinear story, stats management and a unique punishment system.

title: Baldi's Basics The Ancient Save
description: This game offers a rich storyline, building on the classic Baldi's Basics experience. Players are drawn into a deeper mystery, facing new challenges and unexpected twists. With added characters, puzzles, and secrets, it expands the universe with a thrilling and engaging plot.

title: Meander Forth
description: Meander Forth is a platform game about an otter named Garret Rapids, who discovers that a curse has caused all of his friends to disappear! To find them, Garret must learn to master a magic known as Dark Cadence, which gives him the power to shoot bubbles, skate on ice, climb walls, and more! Not everything is as it seems, however, as Garret's search uncovers the web of secrets that cursed his friends in the first place.

title: Meander Forth: Teak's Tall Tale
description: When aspiring punk-rock drummer Oscar Teak is kicked out of his favorite band, he mopes his way home. He doesn't get far before he learns some chilling news, however: His childhood friend Tamree Willow is missing! The bearer of this news, a child in a wooden mask, demands that Teak follow her into the woods. Does she really know the whereabouts of the misplaced Ms. Willow? That's for you to find out.

title: Meander Forth: Teak's Tall Tale Plus
description: Two Tales Begin Anew!

title: Meander Forth: Teak's Tall Tale Plus Plus
description:
One year after the original Teak's Tall Tale was released, an "enhanced version" with nicer backgrounds, new dialog, and a short demo of the actual Meander Forth was released. to coincide with the Sonic Amateur Games Expo 2020. This version was called "Teak's Tall Tale Plus."

Unfortunately, the Plus version had some HUGE technical oversights during development that caused it to barely run on machines running Windows 10, on top of being a technical mess regardless.

The 2021 version, Teak's Tall Tale Plus Plus, was compiled in GameMaker Studio 2, mitigating some of the technical issues. On top of that, certain visual effects have been redone for optimization. Certain art assets have been replaced, as well. I hope this version's release is a lot more smooth than it was last time!

title: Diamond Sword, Wooden Sword
description: The game is set in the fantasy universe of Nick Perumov's literary saga of the same name. Humans, after defeating the dwarves, elves and orcs, founded the Empire, which is ruled by seven Magical Orders. However, the future of the state is in jeopardy. Deep in the Drung Forest, the sacred wooden sword Immelstorn has awakened, and in the caves of the Foothill Tribe, the diamond Dragnir - artifacts with destructive power. At the center of the battle for the iconic blades is the protagonist Fess, a mercenary of the Grey League. He will have to demonstrate his strength, agility, and magical abilities to find the swords and save the world, thus disproving the ancient prophecy about the end of time.

title: Slenderclown: Be Afraid of It!
description:
Slender Clown: Be Afraid of It! sees a return of the weird and mystical Slenderman character. In this episode, Slenderman has disguised himself as a creepy clown. He is also accompanied by an army of evil clowns that he has summoned from the depths of darkness.

You must complete two different missions and try to defeat Slender Clown and his minions. Each mission takes place in a spooky location – either an abandoned carnival or abandoned building. You must try and collect the different colored balloons and then use different weapons at your disposal to eliminate the clown creatures!

title: Corpse Carnival
description: A top-down action-adventure game where you will play as Li Xiaomeng, a first-year student at the "Linge" Military Academy, and escape from a city filled with zombies and monsters alongside "Asami Yuki."

title: Softie
description: Softie is a short creepy (but cute!) point-and-click adventure game. Take on the role of a cuddly teddy bear trying to find their lost owner in a peculiar house.

title: The Uzujigoku Massacre
description:
Takiyo Mochizuki is accepted into Heaven’s Bridge Boarding School, Japan’s most elite academy. Renowned for molding talented individuals into Ultimates - skilled professionals in their desired fields - Heaven’s Bridge accepts students between 10-20 in its pursuit of notable alumni destined to make their mark on Japanese history.

After an unfortunate tragedy forced the school into a temporary shutdown some years ago, it has now reopened, and intends to restart its prestigious legacy with its 21st class.

Unbeknownst to them, another tragedy is quickly approaching.

title: DROD: Smitemaster's Selection Expansions 1+2
description:
Smitemaster's Selections are level expansion packs for DROD. These Caravel-produced level collections add to the official story of DROD with quality writing and voice acting. You will have about a hundred new and unique puzzles to solve in each Smitemaster's Selection bundle.

Expansions 1+2 contain these episodes:

Perfection
The Choice

title: DROD: Smitemaster's Selection Expansions 3+4
description:
Smitemaster's Selections are level expansion packs for DROD. These Caravel-produced level collections add to the official story of DROD with quality writing and voice acting. You will have about a hundred new and unique puzzles to solve in each Smitemaster's Selection bundle.

Expansions 3+4 contain these episodes:

Halph has a Bad Day
Beethro and the Secret Society

title: DROD: Smitemaster's Selection Expansions 5+6
description:
Smitemaster's Selections are level expansion packs for DROD. These Caravel-produced level collections add to the official story of DROD with quality writing and voice acting. You will have about a hundred new and unique puzzles to solve in each Smitemaster's Selection bundle.

Expansions 5+6 contain these episodes:

Beethro's Teacher
Master Locks + Master Locks Expert

title: DROD: Smitemaster's Selection Expansions 7+8
description:
Smitemaster's Selections are level expansion packs for DROD. These Caravel-produced level collections add to the official story of DROD with quality writing and voice acting. You will have about a hundred new and unique puzzles to solve in each Smitemaster's Selection bundle.

Expansions 7+8 contain these episodes:

Devilishly Dangerous Dungeons of Doom
Smitemastery 101

title: Blood West: Dead Man’s Promise
description: Blood West: Dead Man’s Promise offers you a new story chapter of immersive stealth FPS action. The course of which will take you to a familiar place at an unfamiliar time. As Twen’s father, you will have to pay your debt to the God of Death and wrangle lost souls for his herald. Be prepared for another Weird West adventure with new eldritch horrors and new weapons to send them back to where they came from.

title: Alisa: The Parting
description: Alisa: The Parting is an unforgettable action packed adventure, that looks and plays exactly like a late 90's and early 2000's 32bit game. With crispy pixely polygons and pre-rendered backgrounds and cinematics, Alisa: The Parting is enjoyable in both solo and co-op play.

title: DROD: Smitemaster's Selection Expansions 9+10
description:
Smitemaster's Selections are level expansion packs for DROD. These Caravel-produced level collections add to the official story of DROD with quality writing and voice acting. You will have about a hundred new and unique puzzles to solve in each Smitemaster's Selection bundle.

Expansions 9+10 contain these episodes:
Complex Complex
Suit Pursuit

title: Abducted Toad: 10th Anniversary Edition!
DROD: Smitemaster's Selection Expansions 11+12
description:
Smitemaster's Selections are level expansion packs for DROD. These Caravel-produced level collections add to the official story of DROD with quality writing and voice acting. You will have about a hundred new and unique puzzles to solve in each Smitemaster's Selection bundle.

Expansions 11+12 contain these episodes:

Finding the First Truth
Flood Warning

title: DROD: Smitemaster's Selection Expansion 13 - Treacle Stew
description:
Smitemaster's Selections are level expansion packs for DROD. These Caravel-produced level collections add to the official story of DROD with quality writing and voice acting. You will have about a hundred new and unique puzzles to solve in each Smitemaster's Selection bundle.

Expansion 13 contains the episode Treacle Stew.

title: Ritual Tides
description: Ritual Tides is an first-person horror game set on a fictional British island, drenched with Lovecraftian terrors.

title: Hotel Owner Simulator
description: Hotel Owner Simulator is a hotel management game where you start from a small hotel and grow your business by creating beautifully designed rooms, adjusting room sizes and layouts by placing each individual wall, negotiating high prices, and expanding your empire. Lets build, and manage the resort.

title: Folletti
description: In Folletti, step into the shoes of Yezac Folletti, who awakens to the horror of his wife being kidnapped by the sinister Degenite Church in the eerie land of Krycek. Embark on a quest across this bizarre realm, uncovering clues, forging alliances with quirky friends and peculiar creatures, and taking on odd quests. Unearth hidden conspiracies, brave terrifying territories, and perhaps find camaraderie in unexpected places.

title: Slender Man: Downpour
description: A classic style Slender Man game that you can play straight from your web-browser! Keep in mind that the downloadable version runs much better.

title: Slender: The Gaze Of Horror
description:
Slender: The Gaze Of Horror is a Slender game created by Italian game developer Luca Bersiga a.k.a. lukeberfiga and inspired by Slender: The Eight Pages.

It was originally released in October 2014, then remastered in May 2021 with a patch which added improvements such as new features, visual effects and stalkers to the game (the 2021 Ultimate Hardcore Patch).

title: Slender: The Haunted Metro
description: Slender: The Haunted Metro is a Slenderman-based video game, set in the abandoned metro in a city called Sanville.

title: Bitorpito Deluxe
description: Bitorpito Deluxe is the sequel to Bitorpito. A game about repeating back patterns but this time in a deluxe form! Meet new game modes, graphics and more within the biggest project yet.

title: Slender: Adrift
description:
Yes! This is just another Slender Man rip off.

But my friend challenged me to make a slender game. In 4 days. This forest was what I came up with (yes I used Models from my previous games).

What I am planning on Doing is for this game to be inspired by the game Slender man : Shadows.

title: Flora Learns to Sing!
description:
The wind blowed all of the petals of Flora, a wandering flower, and they ended up in Meatos's Swamp!

Meatos is a music instructor plant, and seems very nice! He says he will teach her to sing well so the petals can return... What could go wrong?

WARNING: This game contains disturbing images and is not meant to be played by children.

title: Fast Food On The Beach!
description: Renovate with your friends a fast food restaurant on the French beaches of Arcachon, and turn it into a renowned establishment. Cooperate, cook, and serve to achieve success!

title: Dead Abyss
description: A short first-person horror experience that places you in the rusted out hull of a mysteriously abandoned shipwreck. Search for clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery of the wreckage, but beware of the evil that lurks within.

title: Petit Royaume
description: A relaxing, free-building game set in a pixelated 3D environment.

title: Tim 7: Et l'Ordinateur Fou
description:
Tim 7: Et l'Ordinateur Fou is an edutainment game focusing on CM1 level French.

The contents of the subject are:
Know words better: Word families, homonyms, noun groups, difficult plurals.

Know the sentences better: Match the verb, match the past participle, split the sentence, master the active and passive.

Handling verbs: The present indicative and the present imperative, the past perfect and the past perfect, the imperfect and the past simple, the future indicative and the present conditional.

Read, write and describe: Distinguish the different types of text, cut out a story, make a description, write a story.

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Gooing Up!
description: A brutally difficult rocket-jumping precision platformer with a charming aesthetic and a non-linear map.

title: Tim 7: Et Le Cadeau Volant
description:
Tim 7: Et Le Cadeau Volant is an edutainment game focusing on CM1 level of mathematics.

The contents in the subject are:
Figures, numbers and orders of magnitude: large numbers and decimals, comparison of integers and decimals, and sexagesimal numbers.

Operations: addition, subtraction of decimals, multiplication of integers and decimals, division, and fractions.

Geometry: geometric figures, instruments and units of measurement, calculation of areas and perimeters, and symmetry.

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Rivalhearts
description: Join Noah in his first year of university as he decides to overcome his heartache, pursuing either a tomboy classmate, gorgeous doctor, or junior-year goth!

title: Spell Spiral
description: A fast-paced action shooter game where you fight while managing spells, decks, and mana just like in a card game.

title: Tim 7: Et Le Milliardaire
description:
Tim 7: Et Le Milliardaire is an edutainment game focusing on CM2 level of French.

Contens of the subject:
The components of the sentence: the noun and its determiner, the qualifying adjective and the verb.

Invariable words: adverbs, prepositions, coordinating conjunctions.

Sentence construction: distinction between sentence forms and types; independent, juxtaposed, coordinated propositions; identification of the subject group; verb complements.

Verb groups: the stem of the verb; the difficulties of the present; of the future and the imperfect; simple past and compound past; imperative present.

Spelling: accents; grammatical homophonies; the masculine of adjectives.

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Escape Simulator: Mayan DLC
description: Venture deep into the mysterious Mayan jungle and unlock the secrets of four brand-new escape rooms! Inspired by iconic adventures, this DLC will test your wits and puzzle-solving skills as you explore ancient temples and face legendary challenges.

title: Escape Simulator: The Talos Principle DLC
description: In this DLC, players will face a series of intricate puzzles and challenges inspired by The Talos Principle universe. Whether you are a veteran of Escape Simulator or a fan of The Talos Principle, we believe this room will offer a unique, engaging experience that bridges the gap between these two beloved puzzle game worlds.

title: Grooveyard
description: A cryptic puzzle game where you embody a skeletal sorcerer. Use tile-creation powers to free minions from their predestined paths. Groove to the beat, solve puzzles efficiently for better ratings, and uncover mysteries.

title: Tim 7: Au Secours De Clara
description:
Tim 7: Au Secours De Clara is an edutainment game focusing on CM2 level of Mathematics.

The contents of the subject are:
Numbers: reading, writing and comparing large numbers; decimals and fractions; the different writings of a number.

Functions: digital functions; proportionality, proportional sequences; percentages and scales.

Operations: addition, subtraction and multiplication of whole numbers and decimals; multiples and divisors; division.

Measurements: units of length and area, units of volume and mass, measuring time, solving problems.

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Tim 7: Et Le Monstre Marin
description:
Tim 7: Et Le Monstre Marin is an edutainment game focusing on 4e level of French.

The contents of the subject are:
Analyze sentence structure: The expansion of nominal and verbal groups; Functional groups; The complex sentence (juxtaposition, coordination, subordination); The different subordinate clauses (conjunctives, relative, indirect interrogatives, infinitives, participles).

Conjugations:
the present and its traps; future, imperfect and simple past; the past perfect and the past perfect; the main irregular verbs

Master verb forms: The conditional and the subjunctive (the tenses of the subjunctive and the conditional, use of these 2 modes); The pitfalls of the indicator; The concordance of tenses (link between the tense of the main clause and that of its subordinate, indicative and subjunctive); Active voice, passive voice, pronominal turn.

Enrich your vocabulary: Root, prefix and suffix (place and role); Polysemy (definition and semantic field, homonyms); The lexical field (definition and extent, concrete and abstract); The use of the exact word.

Manipulate the language: The poem (lines, rhymes, emphasis, sounds, stanzas); The dialogue (directions, scenes, sequences of lines, monologue, aside); The story (definition, narrator, time and stages of the story, characters); The description; Figures of speech (comparison, metaphor, hyperbole, antithesis).

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Tim 7: Et L'eclipse Totale
description:
Tim 7: Et L'eclipse Totale is an edutainment game focusing on 4e level of Mathematics.

The contents of the subject are:
Master the calculation: Relative numbers and decimal relative numbers (rule of signs and parentheses); Fractions and inverse; Powers and scientific notation; Statistics (count table, frequencies, percentage of a value).

Calculate with an unknown: Development (formulas, factorization); Order and operations; Equation (equate and solve); Proportionality, speed and linear application.

Manipulate the figures: Projections (theorem of the midpoints of the sides of a triangle); Orthogonal and cosine projections (orthogonal projection, coordinates of the midpoint of a segment, cosine of an angle); Translations and rotations (image of a figure and a segment, tracing method); Spheres and balls (area and volume).

Know how to demonstrate: Lines, circles and distances (tangent, axis of symmetry, bisector); Remarkable triangles and lines (orthocenter, median, bisector, height, bisector, center of gravity, inscribed circle); Pythagorean theorem and its converse; Right triangle.

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Carved In Stone
description: A mysterious regular at your potion shop comes to relieve you of your recent turmoil.

title: The Traded Groom
description: A short adult otome about an arranged marriage and the many forms your new relationship can take.

title: The Dawn Of Slenderman
description:
The Dawn of Slenderman is a first-person horror survival game to find the required pages and to either avoid or kill Slenderman.

- Collect 8 pages to win
- 2 levels with day and night mode
- 4 levels to play
- Original realistic sounds
- Stunning 3D graphics
- Original Eight Pages made by JD Thunder

title: Tim 7: Et La Correspondante
description:
Tim 7: Et La Correspondante is an edutainment game focusing on 5e level of French.

The contents of the subject are:
The pitfalls of verb/subject agreement: identify the subject: proper noun, infinitive, pronoun, simple or extended noun group; know what the indefinite pronoun represents; master the subject relative pronoun; impersonal forms, “this+being”, collective subject: identify the real subject.

Study of the word: etymology; radical, prefix, suffix; homonyms and paronyms; compound nouns.

Conjugations: verbs of the third group: present indicative and simple past; compound tenses: past anterior and future anterior; present subjunctive, present imperative and present conditional.

Qualifying adjective and past participle: agreement of the qualifying adjective; masculine plural and feminine of qualifying adjectives; agreement of the past participle with the auxiliaries être and avoir.

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Tim 7: Mene Le Jeu
description:
Tim 7: Mene Le Jeu is an edutainment game focusing on 5e level of Mathematics.

The contents of the subject are:
Calculation on integers and positive decimals: use of parentheses; distributiveness and calculation priorities; write expressions.

Operations on fractions: comparison, addition, subtraction and multiplication of fractions; solving equations using fractions.

Relative decimal numbers: comparison, addition and subtraction of relative numbers; solving equations using relative numbers.

Data interpretation and management: proportionality coefficient and graphic representation; calculation of percentages; graphic representations: bar, semi-circular, circular diagrams; meaning of scales; calculation of average speeds.

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Game Of Thrall'an
description: Game of Thrall'an is an action RPG where players take on the role of a character named Thrall'an, embarking on a journey to the icy land of Alterrac, filled with enemies, to destroy the Ice Lord, Lookholar.

title: Tim 7: The Memories From Nowhere
description:
Tim 7: The Memories From Nowhere is an edutainment game focusing on 5e level of English.

The contents of the subject are:
Description: Express possession (to have, whose, possessive adjectives and pronouns, genitive); Express quantity (some and any, quantifiers); Locate intimate (prepositions and adverbs of time); Locate in space (there + be, prepositions, plural of nouns, articles).

Tell a story: Talk about one's activities (present simple and progressive); Talk about one can or must do (modal verbs); Talk about what one did (simple and continuous past), Talk about what one is going to do (future with will, be going to, present with future value).

Perfect one's expression: Tell one's experiences, Compare (comparatives and superlatives), Give details (conjunctions and adverbs), Report a speech (direct and indirect speech).

Master conversation: Suggest (suggest, propose, order); Give one's opinion; Talk (tag questions); Give and ask for information.

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Pina Colada 2
description: Pina Colada 2 is a set of 27 MBF21 maps for Doom 2. These maps use the same gimmicks from the first set: a 75 monster limit in maps that are short, dense, and interconnected.

title: Yangshuo Invasion
description: Doom 1 episode replacement with familiar guns and demons modified for more lightweight, fast-paced gameplay, plus a bunch of unique additional features. Built around Bite-Sized Threats, a vanilla-compatible gameplay mod that speeds up the pace of Doom by drastically reducing both monster health and ammo available.

title: Tim 7: Lance Un S.O.S
description:
Tim 7: Lance Un S.O.S is an edutainment game focusing on 6e level of French.

The contents of the subject are:
Agreements: the plural of nouns; agreement of adjectives, verb and past participle.

Conjugations: the present and its pitfalls; future, imperfect and simple past; the past perfect and the past perfect; the main irregular verbs.

Frequent confusions: conjugated verb or common noun; infinitive in “er” or past participle in “é”; or/where; and/is ; his/are; a/to; upper or lower case.

Write the key sounds: the sounds [o], [f], [k] and the sounds written with the letters x, y and z.

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Tim 7: Et L'envoye Special
description:
Tim 7: Et L'envoye Special is an edutainment game focusing on 6e level of French.

The contents of the subject are:
Story structure: Linking words, Use of the past simple and the imperfect, Use of relative and possessive pronouns.

Oral expression: The interrogative sentence, Circumstantial complements, Language registers.

Construction of a presentation: text comprehension, image playback, values ​​of the present, active/passive voice.

Written expression: expression of order, advice and wish, lexical fields of will and feelings, the expression of the condition, punctuation.

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Tim 7: Concours Pour New York
description:
Tim 7: Concours Pour New York is an edutainment game focusing on 6e level of Mathematics.

The contents of the subject are:
Decimal writing - fractional writing: decimal fractions; multiplication and division by multiples of 10; arrangement of decimal numbers.

Operations on decimals: addition, subtraction and multiplication of decimals and decimal fractions; orders of magnitude and approximations; solving problems with decimals.

Division: dividing whole numbers and decimal numbers; solve division problems; divide with fractions.

Numerical calculation: calculate with and without parentheses; calculate with fractions; solve simple equations; learn to calculate quickly.

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Tim 7: Et Les Fouilles Interdites
description:
Tim 7: Et Les Fouilles Interdites is an edutainment game focusing on 6e level of history and geography.

The contents of the subject are:
Ancient Egypt: the Nile valley in Ancient Egypt; chronological benchmarks; the powers of the pharaoh; the religion of the Egyptians during Antiquity.

Ancient Greece: Greek cities and colonies; Athenian democracy; the domination of Athens; the epic of Alexander the Great.

Ancient Rome: the Roman Republic; the Roman Empire and the Roman Peace; the Romanization of Gaul; religion and the Roman state.

The Mediterranean basin today: people around the Mediterranean; a natural environment: the Mediterranean environment; a metropolis of a poor country: Cairo; a tourist coastline: the Côte d’Azur.

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Tim 7: The Lost Traveller
description:
Tim 7: The Lost Traveller is an edutainment game focusing on 6e level of English.

The contents of the subject are:
Introduce oneself: Give one's name, age and address (say hello and goodbye, To be, introduce yourself, figures and numbers); Talk about one's activities (use and formation of simple and progressive present tenses); Say what one has or not (to have, genitive, possessive articles, whose); Introduce and describe someone.

Locate oneself: Locate in space; Indicate directions (prepositions); Know how to say the date and the hour (time, date, year, seasons); Locate in time (preposition of time, adverbs of frequency, yesterday/today, before/after)

Say: Describe one's environment (colors, demonstrative adjectives, some and any);Say what one can and must do; Say what one did (past tense, regular and irregular verbs); Say what one is going to do (be going to).

Talk: Express one's opinion (comparatives, agreeing/disagreeing); Ask an information (questions); Say what one likes or would like to do (like, love, hate, want, would like); Give information and ask for it (common expressions, imperative, question tags).

You play as Tim 7, named as such due to being kidnapped by Dr. Gaaf and being the 7th guinea pig of his experiments. Tim 7 has lost his memories and you need to help him escape the island.

title: Wuthering Waves: When the Night Knocks
description:
Version 1.4 of Wuthering Waves, which included:
• New characters: Camellya and Lumi
• New main event: Somnium Labyrinth
• New companion story for Camellya: Forking Path Among the Stars
• New echoes, events and more!

title: C-Smash VRS: New Dimension
description: C-Smash VRS New Dimension offers a whole new kind of Hybrid Multiplayer, allowing PS5 players to play with other PS5 players, but also across dimensions with PS VR2 players. Fully immersed and physical or in third person, complete with a multitude of accessibility options - a world first for a sports title.

title: Mobs 'N Monsters
description: Manage a spooky castle of monsters & fend off angry mobs with Slingshot action in this Physics-based Tower-Defense RTS. Fling vampires, mummies, & more to make the local villages crumble. Upgrade your units & castle between battles for impenetrable defenses & cause monstrous destruction!

title: Killpaku!
description: A 3D action game where you control Bebe, a gluttonous monster. Aim at the weak points of the fighting "onis" and deal the final blow! Literally, enjoy picking the best parts!

title: Slendrina Must Die: The House
description:
Slendrina Must Die: The House is yet another fantastic episode in the creepy Slendrina Must Die series. In this title, you get to find out more about this strange and sinister creature and her origins.

Game is based on House of Slendrina.

title: Chosen of God
description: "Chosen of God" thrusts you into the heart of an ancient world, brutal and fraught with danger. You are David, a young shepherd destined to become king. Wield your weapons to face giants, ruthless warriors, and ferocious beasts.

title: Slendrina Must Die: The Asylum
description:
Slendrina Must Die is back in a new scary adventure! The Asylum! Now with new level added (currently Android only), The Asylum Backyard. More Action.

Game is based on Slendrina: Asylum

title: Fortnite: Chapter 2 Remix
description: The Island you knew is back, remixed and reimagined, with weekly location and loot drops inspired by the best of early Chapter 2 OG gameplay and some of the greatest music icons in history. In this time rewind, Snoop D-O-double-G heads up the Agency, the rap god Eminem sets up shop in the Grotto, hip hop princess Ice Spice lays claim to Shark Island, and the remix hits the finale with a celebration and tribute to the legend and icon, Juice WRLD. Push play, turn up the volume, and open up the vault in Fortnite Battle Royale Chapter 2 Remix!

title: Further Skies
description:
Further Skies takes place in 2008, following a pair of childhood friends adjusting to the ever-shifting world of online communication and relationships, which allows their world to become ever larger - for better and for worse.

This is a story about being a young person in an online age that doesn't quite exist in the form it once did anymore. About communication, paranoia, grief, the joy of finding your people and your place, and the road to equanimity and internal harmony.

title: The Spire of Mech Zero
description: A lite roguelike card deck building game inspired by Slay the Spire. You can experience battles of robots with cards and components! Try to conquer the spire with one perfect run, every choice matters!

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 2: Gear Shift
description: Save Tails from the clutches of Dr. Robotnik in this complete re-imagining of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 for the Master System and Game Gear!

title: Hotel Mario ReBooked
description: A fan-made port of Hotel Mario for PC.

title: Tails' Picross
description: Tails' Picross is a fangame inspired by the Picross game series and other Mega Drive puzzle games. In this game, you will need to clear puzzles using the clues on each row and each collumn of the grid.

title: La Chose De Grotemburg
description:
La Chose de Grotemburg is a text adventure with graphics in French. The protagonist returns to his town after travelling to find his young wife dead. The search for the one responsible bring the character to different locations such a forest, an underground environment and a mansion where the one responsible resides.

Most of the screen provides a view of the environment with detailed graphics. At the bottom of the screen text descriptions appear and commands are entered. On the right possible movement options based on the four wind directions are displayed.

title: Miko Miko Nurse
description: The story takes place in the Paradise Hospital, the forefront of elderly treatment. As a result of the founder's retirement, the two heirs cannot agree on which uniform the nurses should wear — one having a miko style, the other having a nun style. Amidst the fierce debate is Tatsuya Makishima, a doctor-in-training....

title: Slendrina Must Die: The Forest
description:
Slendrina Must Die: The Forest is a fantastic first-person shooter with horror elements. You must uncover the sinister and strange Slendrina who lives within a dark and mysterious forest with her mother and children.

You must explore the forest and locate seven keys that will help you complete the mission and unlock the dark secrets surrounding this woman.

Game is based on Slendrina: The Forest

title: Chuushaki: Hirasawa Nurse School
description: A young girl named Mana is determine to become a good nurse. She plans to attend the Hirasawa Nurse School, which was also the place where her late mother studied. However, upon arrival Mana finds out that strange things are happening in the school. Not only some of the teachers are acting weird, but the fellow aspiring nurses seem to be more interested in sex than in actually learning their profession...

title: Liminal Shroud
description: A psychological exploration experience that takes you deep into the heart of uncanny, in-between spaces where reality unravels. There are no monsters here—only the shadows of your own mind. Navigate strangely layered rooms, interact with the environment and unlock secrets to escape.

title: Chu x Chu Idol
description: Kensuke is an ordinary uni student, living alone. One day, he happens to know Chiyu's secret. Chiyu transforms into a popular idol by kissing Chuchu, a vampire girl. Chuchu finds Kensuke knows their secret, and curses him not to stay away from them. As a result, they start to live together... Will he be able to get rid of the curse?

title: Ace of Wands
description: A doujin fighting game released at Comiket 81 following a story of nanomachines spread throughout the city

title: Slendrina Must Die: The School
description:
Slendrina Must Die - The School - is an intense and exciting horror game in which you must further explore the character of Slendrina. This evil entity is truly haunting and stops at nothing to hurt you.

Game is based on Slendrina: The School

title: Borderline
description: Borderline is a free running first person adventure heavily inspired by the momentum-based gameplay from Mirror’s Edge. You are tasked with working against the city of Greyhawke’s most notorious mega corporations, uncovering their secrets while navigating through their state-of-the-art security.

title: Fracas
description: Fracas is a dungeon crawler that evokes a retro RPG experience and a complex story. In its short duration, it seeks to keep you intrigued as you solve the mystery behind this enigmatic character that has society on the brink of collapse.

title: Royalty Free-For-All
description: Royalty Free-For-All is a hand-drawn cartoon Party Brawler featuring an original cast of characters inspired by the public domain! Join Dorothy, Sweeney Todd, Mother Goose, and more as they duke it out in hand-drawn platform fighting mayhem!

title: Royal Montgomery Raceways
description:
Royal Montgomery Raceways is a vintage racing game set between the years 1913 and 1939; covering the golden age of racing across the world.
RMR is still in development.

title: Yandere Tensei: I Can't Beat The Programming!
description:
Mei (name changeable) is an overworked office worker at a black company, who suddenly collapses on the office floor just as she's about to head home after a late night. As she laments her fate and thinks about the bright side of dying at work (enjoy the stigma of working an employee to death, company!), her only regret is that she couldn't read her favourite character's ending in an otome game she loved one last time. But after her vision fades to black, she comes to... right in front of said favourite character in the flesh?! It turns out she was reincarnated as the villainess her bias, Albert, is in love with, just as he's confining her to his manor in his obsession ending!

But unfortunately, despite the miraculous circumstances, things aren't all roses for our heroine. Just as she's about to jump headfirst into a lovey-dovey life with her best boy, the villainess Meirina's original personality yanks control of the body away from her to express her disgust, just as she did in the original ending. It turns out that the original Meirina's mind takes priority when it comes to dealing with Albert. But a strange sound as the villainess's heart flutters opens up a method to get our heroine's desired ending: raise Meirina's affection levels for Albert until she accepts his mad love, so that they can fall into the darkness together!

title: Lando: Me? A Hero?
description: Thrown into a strange world by an angel, you’ll fight, adapt, and evolve in this action-packed roguelike. Combine insane powers, conquer new worlds with each run, and face relentless enemies. Will you rise as the hero—or fall trying?

title: Cardfight Area
description: Cardfight Area is a third-party software used to play Cardfight!! Vanguard online for free, receiving updates regularly as new cards release. The game provides an alternative method for people to playtest new units, connect with other players, and play Cardfight!! Vanguard when in-person cardfights are not available.

title: A Boring Place: The Road 2 Head
description: Don't move, it's around here somewhere

title: Top Heroes
description:
On this distant and mysterious continent, countless unknown miracles and challenges are hidden. Here live magical creatures of various forms, each with their unique culture and profound secrets. Their legends and stories, filled with magic and myth, ignite the curiosity of every adventurer.

However, a powerful and terrifying dark force is spreading and threatening the peace and tranquility of this continent. Facing this dark tide, brave warriors from different races and cultures have stepped forward. They vow to unite and resist this evil force together.

In this passionate and adventurous game, you will play as a brave leader, leading these warriors through mysterious forests, ancient ruins, and dark caves to explore every corner of this continent. On the journey, you will encounter various wonderful creatures, uncover forgotten ancient secrets, discover hidden treasures, and fight against various powerful enemies.

Your wisdom, courage, and strategy will be the key to defeating the dark forces and protecting the peace of the continent. Rally your team, select appropriate equipment and spells, and fight for the future of this continent! In this grand adventure, every choice and battle is of great significance. Now, it's time to embark on this journey to save the world!

title: Ratshaker
description: RATSHAKER is the fun and quirky solution to all your rat problems! Hold on to the RAT, shake your arm, and watch life’s problems disappear! How far can you go?

title: Slender: New Hope
description: Slender - New Hope is based on Slender: The Eight Pages, but with modern graphic, better AI, bigger environment & discoverable deep woods!

title: Slender: Dark Woods
description:
Slender - Dark Woods is based on Slender: The Eight Pages, but with a completely different environment, dynamic jumpscares & environment, modern graphics, new mechanics and a Co-op mode.

You can choose to play singleplayer or local co-op on 3 different difficulty levels.

title: Waddle Knight
description: Waddle Knight is a Kirby fangame with gameplay similar to Hollow Knight that stars Bandana Waddle Dee! Kirby gets kidnapped by a dark creature, and it's up to Bandana Waddle Dee to save him!

title: The Overnight Watch
description:
Welcome Subject/Employee to 'The Overnight Watch'. This experiment/exam will take a total of 5 business days to complete.

Your objective during this experiment/exam is to watch the cameras and report anything that you find out of the ordinary.

Each day you will be pushed even further by watching more rooms and having to keep an eye on the Power Containment Drive. Failure is NOT an option.

Do you 'IRIS SUBJECT NUMBER' wish to apply to 'The Overnight Watch'?

Please note:

IRIS will not take responsibility for a subject's death during this test.

title: G-Switch 4: Creator
description: High-speed gravity switching platformer with precise single-button gameplay. Includes single player story mode and local multiplayer mode for up to 8 players. Easily create and publish your own levels.

title: Kamalatale
description: Kamala is tasked with fighting for a New Way Forward that protects our fundamental freedoms and strengthens our democracy! Debate your way through a divided nation, secure endorsements and future voters, and finish what your mentor, Joe Biden, started!

title: Monoyellow Madness
description: Backrooms game with procedurally generated rooms and corridors.

title: Sumrak
description: A short visual novel about fear, choice, miracle, adventure, friendship, love. A game for one warm, dreamy evening with a cup of tea and cookies. At the beginning of the story, a small surprise awaits in the form of a mini-platformer to find out what happens next.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Horn of Balance
description: A fangame inspired by A Link to the Past, which ultimately became an original IP, Horn of Balance.

title: Super Mario in Marooned on Mars!
description:
Super Mario in Marooned on Mars is a hybrid tribute to both one of gaming's all-time favorite heroes and PC's platforming pioneer, Commander Keen!

Play as Mario as he finds the missing parts of his spaceship so he and his passengers can travel back to the Mushroom Kingdom safe and sound. There are over fifteen levels here on Mars, but you only need the four ship parts to get out of there! That's not to say there's no reason to explore anywhere once you have them. Oh, of course not!

You can talk to your passengers for tips or casual interactions, and you can discover tons of secrets and goodies as you romp around the monster-infested environment. Just be sure to keep on your toes! You're going to need all the ammo and power-ups you can get!

title: Swing Swing Swing
description:
Swing Swing Swing is a short-and-sweet adventure through a mysterious wireframe world, BUT with one important twist: you can't move!

Well, not directly at least. Attach your grapple hook to surfaces and let gravity SWING you forward!

title: 13th House on Halloween
description:
You finally bought a house, but it's the 13th house on the street and it's Halloween... so who knows what you actually bought...

Are you ready to experience why is it a bad idea to go against superstition on Halloween? In this game you will get to and see the consequences, and maybe even live trough it... but who knows, anything can happen on Halloween...

title: Good Night Mr. Snoozleberg
description: Expert diplomat Mr. Snoozleberg has a busy schedule: bullet-train inaugurations, movie awards, alien invasions, theme park visits. He can handle everything, though, as long as he gets a good night rest... and his sleepwalking makes that difficult. It'll be up to you to prevent international incidents by point and clicking objects at the right time to form a safe platforming path!

title: VHS Collection: Goodnight Me
description: VHS Collection: Goodnight Me is a short horror game where reality blurs with nightmares over five eerie days. Experience strange events, unsettling dreams, and unravel a chilling mystery in a remote house. Can you survive the madness, or will the nightmare consume you?

title: Symphony of the Stars
description: A retro RPG that features puzzles, exploration, and turn-based combat.

title: Cherish Pizza ha Ikaga Desu ka
description: The story of a college student who was decides to work part-time at a pizzeria "Cherish Pizza". What kind of life will he have at this part-time job?

title: SAGE 5: Event the Game
description: In 2002, that year's second SAGE was itself a fan game, which contained all of the usual information and booths. The player could choose from a number of characters to explore a virtual SAGE show floor, visiting booths and trying out games. Some special mini games could be unlocked.

title: You're Gonna Die 1000 Times (Or So)
description:
You have been accused of endangering the lives of 1000 people. As punishment, you will be cloned and killed 1000 times.

Can one version of you escape prison, using nothing but a match and whatever items you find around?

title: Late Night Sausage
description:
In the sparse, remote reaches of northern Sweden, Late Night Sausage plunges you into a horror experience inspired by chilling true events that may feel disturbingly familiar.

Complete your nightly chores: take out the garbage, do the laundry and most importantly, grab a sausage at the local gas station. As night falls, mundane routines twist into chilling encounters. Each event reveals more about the townsfolk and every night brings new dark discoveries. Can you maintain your sanity in this horror walking simulation?

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Kuradashi-hen
description: “Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Kuradashi-hen” is a collection of "what if?" stories derived from scrapped concepts in the writing and development of the original story, showing the way Ryukishi07 went on writing the stories and his thought development process for the Higurashi series. This is a fan visual novel adaptation of the original.

title: Cryptic Crawlz
description:
Cryptic Crawlz: Dive into the depths of an enigmatic dungeon where mystery and danger lurk at every turn. Combining the thrilling action of a Hack-and-Slash RPG with the cerebral challenges of a point-and-click adventure,

Cryptic Crawlz offers a unique gaming experience. Embark on a journey filled with dark secrets, treacherous puzzles, and formidable foes as you navigate the labyrinthine corridors. Unravel the cryptic lore and conquer sinister adversaries in this spellbinding fusion of Hack-and-Slash combat and intricate puzzle-solving. Are you prepared to uncover the secrets that lie beneath?

title: Klondike's Hike
description: A solitaire-based game with roguelike and deck-building elements.

title: Eufloria Classic
description: Eufloria Classic brings back the original charms of the long-unavailable indie classic, updated for a new age with a plethora of new content and features, including extreme moddability.

title: Gensou Rouman Kikou: Phantasmagoria Trues
description:
Gensou Rouman Kikou―Phantasmagoria Trues― ("Fantasy Romance Travel Log") is a Touhou fan game made by Len in Danmakufu. It is a remake of his earlier game Phantasm Romance, containing an overhauled game system, three game modes, and an extra stage.

The game spans six regular areas as well as three "unseen" areas which the player must unlock via special means. In addition to this, the game also contains a Terminus area which serves as a counterpart to the Extra stage in the main Touhou series.

The game's system revolves around a combination of factors, including a multiplier that is increased by items, bonuses caused by grazing, and a hyper system that duplicates point items and allows the player to cancel bullets into items. There is also a "simple" mode that works like Phantasm Romance, with the multiplier, graze and hyper system removed.

title: Math Genius: Multiplication
description: Math Genius: Multiplication is a fun and educational game that challenges players with randomly generated multiplication problems. Players fill in the missing number in the equation by choosing one of three possible answers. Keep track of your progress with on-screen counters displaying your correct and incorrect answers. Perfect for sharpening math skills in a quick, engaging format!

title: Mechanic Supermarket 2024
description: Master the art of running a supermarket and tuning cars!

title: McBelle Manor
description: McBelle Manor is a Survival Horror game that takes you to an old, abandoned house that has been turned into the latest Halloween attraction.

title: Gummy Jump 2
description: You just emerged from the depths of the colossal machine, only to find that its vastness far exceeds your wildest imagination. The metallic walls tower over you, casting long shadows that shift ominously as you explore your surroundings. As you take in the intricate machinery around you

title: Arcade Archives: Riot
description: " RIOT " is an action game released by TECMO in 1992. Conquer the stages while defeating the "THE MAGIC TIGERS", warriors armed with special weapons and magic that stand in your way one after another. Enemies appear in the front and back of the screen, so you need to shoot them separately. The key to success is to make good use of various weapons and shields along the way.

title: Finding America: The Great Lakes - Collector's Edition
description: Explore the beautiful areas surrounding the Great Lakes of America!

title: Sleeping: Counting Sheep
description: A relaxing, Twitch-integrated sheep simulation where viewers can spawn and chat as sheep. Perfect for streamers looking to entertain their audience while resting or away from their keyboard.

title: Snaky Snakes
description: Snaky Snakes is an exhilarating game where player control a snake through randomly generated obstacles while collecting cherries. Each cherry increases the snake's length and score. Additionally, player can use cherries to purchase new environments such as Desert, Asia, and Ballroom from the in-game shop. The objective is to achieve the highest score possible and unlock all environments.

title: Jigsaw Chronicles: Haunting Tales
description: Piece together haunting tales from around the world.

title: I'm in Love With Your Dead Grandmother Presents: Noah SmallJohnson's Puzzle Game
description: In memory of a woman he never met, Noah SmallJohnson creates the most epic puzzle game ever. Featuring high-score gameplay, catchy tunes, multiple arcade modes, and a Game Show where players can win cheat codes. It’s weird, it’s wild, and it’s unapologetically heartfelt.

title: The Adventure of Ninomae Ina'nis
description: The Adventure of Ninomae Ina'nis is a vertical shoot 'em up game where you control Ninomae Ina'nis from Hololive Myth and her companion AO-chan.

title: Halo 2 Digsite: E3 2003 Demo
description:
Revisit the debut prototype of Halo 2 in this restoration of the notorious "Earth City" demonstration, initially unveiled at the Xbox press conference during E3 2003.

For the first time ever, take it to the streets, your way, with support for cooperative action, optional navigation points to rehearse the exact demo path and an included 'Playground' version of the level, allowing free roam of the city.

This release represents an effort to rebuild content originally designed for a different functioning game engine, the first campaign collaboration between Digsite and Halo Studios.

title: Furries & Scalies & Scarecrows Oh My!
description: The island of Roanoake is a small, quaint farming community that has recently been swept up in the king's war effort. Crops and weaponry are needed to provide the troops with food and a way to fight the enemy. Many on the island feel that this is an impairment on their way of life, and many feel that it is not. Can you navigate this sea of discomfort in order to make the island of Roanoake prosperous once more?

title: Astronomicon
description: In this atmospheric puzzle game with cute original art and music, you're playing as a navigator of a small caravel. Study the constellations and test your visual perception skills to find your way in the endless ocean.

title: Escaping Diddler
description: Escaping Diddler is a stealth survival game where you escaped the Diddler party, while navigating Diddler's Backyard, Steal bottles of baby oil to escape, but beware—getting caught means game over. Stay hidden, outsmart the Diddler, and escape.

title: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League - Season 3: Season of Lawless
description: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League – Season of Lawless launched on October 1, 2024, adding Zoe Lawton (Lawless) as a playable character, a Gotham-themed Elseworld location, new missions, Infamy gear sets, and a Battle Pass. The update is available for all platforms as a free expansion.

title: Shadow's Descent
description: "Shadows' Descent" is a psychological horror game where you investigate a very special hospital, full of mysteries and dangers. Solve puzzles, discover terrifying secrets, and survive an oppressive atmosphere where every shadow can be a threat.

title: Bad Time Trio
description: This is the original bad time trio. by mcatr

title: Airborne Justice
description: Airborne Justice is a shoot 'em up that pays homage to classics from the golden age of video games. Take control of a helicopter, fight enemies, and restore peace to the skies!

title: OttGiu
description:
An otter on the way to save your friends.

Follow Giuseppe on this adventure!

title: Hockey Super Squad
description: Hockey Super Squad is a thrilling free to play 3v3 multiplayer online hockey game featuring character creation and lite-RPG mechanics. Jump in alone or with friends!

title: Mushroom Pancakes
description: The last fan game created by supertoad2k. You play as Mario/Beardman as he goes on a quest to collect the 3 missing handle pieces of Star 'Buck' Sampson in order to get more red ink for Mario's pen.

title: Moekasu
description: Among other goodies there are two stories based on the extended world of Moekan's Kirishima route and Tsui no Sora.

title: Waifu Impact 2
description:
Waifu Impact 2 is a third person shooter, adventure game with role-playing elements where you explore the Waifu Islands to unlock new characters and abilities.

Discover the secrets of the paradisiac Waifu Islands. Shoot and level up your characters in this sequel of the acclaimed Waifu Impact.

title: Artemis Blue
description:
In 2040, a mysterious natural disaster causes all planes to stop functioning above 500 feet (150 meters) of the Earth’s surface, resulting in over 20 million deaths. The year is 2060 and it is forbidden to fly above this limit. Pilots call this stretch from 500 feet to outer space ‘Artemis’s hymen’. Now a group of people operate a transport agency from the abandoned building that was to be the New Third Tokyo International Airport (nicknamed Edowanzu). They wish to fly higher than what is permitted by aviation laws.

Haru is a cheerful, honest, polite and hardworking girl who always wanted to become a pilot. Following her dream, she went overseas after graduating from high school and earned her pilot license after two years in an aviation school in San Diego. She applied to become a co-pilot and got an interview with the Kubo Air Transport Agency. There she met Katsura Keima, the test pilot who had broken the impenetrable barrier in Project Ikaros five years ago.

title: 100 Hidden Capybaras
description: It is a hidden object game with hand-drawn graphics. Find one by one 100 unique capybaras in different, colorful settings while listening to calm music. Find, click, find another one, and enjoy the painted picture.

title: Good-Bye to Youtopia
description: A work of metafiction with a simplistic pixel style. Travel to the depths of the world, battling fears along the way. Say goodbye to utopia, to become human once more, even if you're the only one.

title: Aquatic Store Simulator
description: Dive into the vibrant world of aquatic retail with Aquatic Store Simulator! Take on the challenge of managing your very own underwater-themed supermarket, blending business management with the beauty of aquatic life. Stock shelves with exotic fish, decorations, set prices, take payments and maintain aquariums.

title: Spellchanted 2D Hidden Object Puzzle Adveture Tile-Matching
description: Enter a magical world filled with legendary Fairy Tale characters. Become the greatest wizard. Help a young witch break an evil curse and save the Fairy Tale kingdoms!

title: Paradise XRPL
description:
PARADISE XRPL is built with advanced AI-driven technologies. The game features a living, breathing world where traffic patterns, pedestrian behavior, and daily activities mimic real-life.

Infrastructure & Nature: From ocean to city bustling with unique locations such as police station, banks, airport and stores, each offering a variety of activities.

AI Trafic: Realistic driving behaviors, where vehicles adhere to traffic laws, get into accidents and respond dynamically to player interactions.

Dynamic activities: Dive into activities from racing to shooting. Work jobs, complete missions, and buy cars, clothes, and property to enrich your game life.

title: SiliCorp Systems
description: It's your job to check up on an "edutainment" game that was reported to be having some issues. Collect items, catch and battle monsters, and work through puzzles. Just be careful, though, because you never know what may be lurking around the corner.

title: Jupiter Hell Classic
description: Jupiter Hell Classic is the demake of a remake of a roguelike unmake of a famous 1993 FPS shooter. Rip and Tear!

title: Life is Feudal: Arden
description: Life is Feudal: Arden is a new, free-to-play MMO set in a brutal medieval world. Challenge fellow feudal lords and ladies, and embark on a journey to conquer uncharted lands. Explore a meticulously hand-crafted map designed to cater to PvP enthusiasts, PvE adventurers, and even those who enjoy the thrill of PvPvE. Fight epic battles, forge alliances, master various professions, trade goods, craft unique items, and build thriving cities or impregnable fortresses. You are the sole driving force for your success!

title: You Have My Support
description: Brought to you by the Lost Ether Crew, You Have My Support is a small collection of 3 unique maps based around slight texture limitations except for anything with a "SUP" prefix. ﻿

title: Elements and Build
description: Form your own genre with skills in different elements, use building rewards to build your own unique maze in randomly generated levels, and fight to survive waves of monsters to win

title: Gator Brigade
description: A game by Oddfellows Software that was formerly know as "Broken Hearts Club - Blue Bird Blues". Not much is public about it and the developers are currently on hiatus so its development is currently up in the air.

title: Red Flood
description: Red Flood is a mod for Hearts of Iron IV set in an alternate timeline where the Great War ended in stalemate. The year is now 1936 and Europe once more is on the brink of war.

title: Leapo Faith
description: Play as LEAPO FAITH, and climb the tower by running, jumping, sliding, and swinging to find out what lies above.

title: The King of Fighters XIV: Oswald
description: This additional character ‘OSWALD’ is available in 'THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV' with this purchase

title: The King of Fighters XIV: Heidern
description: Heidern commands the mercenary unit where Ralf and Clark belong. He fights using a combination of martial arts and self-taught assassination techniques. As a military officer, Heidern remains calm and silent, but can be over protective to his adopted daughter Leona.

title: The King of Fighters XIV: Blue Mary
description: This additional character ‘BLUE MARY' is available in 'THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV' with this purchase.

title: The King of Fighters XIV: Najd
description: Najd wears the Abaya (traditional Saudi garment) which has extraordinary powers, but remains humble. She lives a double life, a college student during the day, but at night, she turns into a vigilante to protect her fellow citizens from evil.

title: Call of Elyndra
description:
CALL OF ELYNDRA, where farming meets adventure! Grow crops, battle monsters in real-time combat, upgrade your village and solve ancient quests across five epic realms.

Play as you want--cozy or action-driven. In Elyndra, farming meets fantasy!

title: Fart Game
description: In this hilarious and challenging game, it's all about holding in your fart until the perfect moment! Time and manage your farts wisely, because the more you let slip, the more aware your colleagues become.

title: Dreadway
description: A co-op horror about surviving a nuclear apocalypse as a small group of people on a train, scavenging for various scrap to upgrade the train.

title: Danchi Days
description:
Help Hoshino bring her hometown back together in a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in 2000s Japan! She'll face malevolent forces, uncover truths about her town, all while reconnecting with neighbors and her grandma living with dementia.

By gingham games - that's sandy powder, mogumu, and Melos Han-Tani (of Analgesic Productions)!

title: Nightmare House: The Original Mod
description:
Enter the haunting world of Nightmare House. This is the definitive edition of the highly acclaimed horror classic "Nightmare House 2".
Initially released in 2010 as a Source mod for Half-Life 2, the Nightmare House series captivated players with its intense atmosphere and gripping gameplay.

Wake up, it’s time for the real nightmare to begin. Make your way through a terrorizing house, uncover the secrets of a haunted hospital, fight through hordes of the undead, and try to escape Nightmare House.

title: Paperhead Ep. 0
description: In this cute cardboard world, something went horribly wrong... You wake up in a prison cell. A strange voice calls to you from the depths of dark corridors covered in runic symbols and blood. Reload your trusty shotgun and find out... WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED?

title: Ark's Wonder Dungeon
description: Explore looping halls, chat around the campfire with dungeoneering misfits, and learn to make the most of each turn in this JRPG dungeon crawler!

title: Plastic Trick
description: “Plastic Trick” is a choice-driven, visual novel where you play as a shopaholic named Serena - who's having a delulu romance with plastic mannequins that have come to life and are fighting for your kiss.

title: 100 Waiting Cats: Extra Content
description:
By purchasing DLC, you will get extra content in the game 100 Waiting Cats.
Get an extra level with 100 more adorable cats!

title: My Raising Diary
description:
At a particular research establishment, a study has been taking place in order to create a synthetic life form that will have more superior abilities than a human. The study had finally yielded results, but...

The protagonist who is working there ends up being forced by the other researchers on the same team as her to raise the synthetic life form.

Since she was young, she has been called a genius, and has no memories of being treated like a child, so even though it's a study, the protagonist, who hasn't really known a parent's love, feels uneasy about raising a child...

title: In Search of the Golden Crops
description: In Search of The Golden Crops is a short game about plant and harvest, use cards, sell your crops, complete tasks on board, upgrade your farm and collect all Golden Crops

title: Genshin Impact: Tapestry of Spirit and Flame
description:
Version 5.2 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New characters: Chasca and Ororon
• New areas: Tezcatepetonco Range, Quahuacan Cliff, and Ochkanatlan
• New main story quest: Archon Quest, Chapter V - Interlude
• New Tribal Chronicles quests for the Flower-Feather Clan and the Masters of the Night-Wind
• New main event: Itkomi Spiritseeking Scrolls
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

title: The Memory Thieves
description: Immerse yourself in a unique cooperative multiplayer game for 1 to 4 players. Explore the graveyard of Ravenwood, pass through mysterious portals, and steal as much treasure as possible while avoiding the dangers.

title: Warp Cinema
description: Warp Cinema is a bite-size text-parser adventure game made for Adventure Jam 2023 and takes about 10-15 minutes to play through.

title: Under Defeat
description:
Set in an alternative history where all-out war has erupted, development of this new release falls into the capable hands of City Connection, under supervision by Takehiro Eda and Zerodiv Fukushima Factory, well known in the shooter community for their high-quality ports of classic games.

A popular arcade shooter from G.rev, Under Defeat originally released in 2005 and attracted a legion of fans thanks to its high-octane gameplay, as one or two players assume control of a heavily armed helicopter, taking on a non-stop assault of fighters, played across a semi-isometric playfield, with the unique ability to tilt shots left or right when attacking your enemy. Renowned for its explosive 3D graphics and high intensity gameplay, Under Defeat features no less than three game modes offering high levels of replayability, all of which have been integrated under supervision of G.rev.

Arcade Mode faithfully replicates the original arcade experience, with a 4:3 ratio and a pseudo vertical screen. New Order Mode adapts the game for modern displays, transforming the adrenaline packed shooting action to widescreen 16:9 ratio, and New Order Mode+ brings a host of additional elements to the game, not least being a “WARNING GAUGE,” which adds a risk/reward mechanic to assist the player as they shoot, bomb and swerve through the hordes of enemy invaders.

In addition, Under Defeat comes complete with an incredible soundtrack, newly boosted by video game music veteran, Shinji Hosoe (Ridge Racer series, Tekken series, etc.) and his company, Super Sweep.

title: Mayo Mayo
description: Discover Mayo Mayo, a Match-4 game where strategy and agility are key. Chain clever combos, solve captivating puzzles, and break records. Challenge your friends or improve your skills solo in this competitive adventure full of surprises.

title: Going Down Turbo
description: Going Down Turbo was created for the 10th anniversary and is not intended to replace the original megawad. Every map has some tweaking, adjusting and in some cases completely overhauling the gameplay to improve the flow and generally make it faster and more fun. Difficulty has been rebalanced to make it more forgiving for new players, while old players can go a bit more rambo if they feel like it.

title: I'd Kiss That Fish
description: This is a fish dress up game in which you select clothes/ accessories to dress up your fish! It is a casual single player 2D sandbox experience with cute stylized graphics.

title: Giant Rush
