description: Happy Hotel is a mildly horror-themed game where you descend through creepy, handcrafted floors filled with traps, puzzles, and eerie surprises. With randomized challenges and Happy, the sinister mascot, your goal is to escape the hotel. Playtime: 15 mins to 2 hours.

title: The Kharzov Effect
description: Welcome to The Kharzov Effect, an immersive first-person puzzle horror game. Explore Dr. Kharzov’s eerie estate as you unravel the mystery behind a series of abductions. Face terrifying creatures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the truth of Kharzov's dark history!

title: These Darker Tides
description: Welcome [EMPLOYEE] to your new job protecting Deep Sea Cables from creatures of the deep. We're not liable for loss of limbs, sanity, or life while on the job. Don't forget to keep your desk clean and your eyes on those cameras!

title: AquaDark
description: AquaDark is a first-person horror game with management elements set in the ‘80s. As an aquapark owner, players have to serve customers, sell wares, record everything, and solve the mystery behind strange events in the aquapark.

title: Dreamcore95 Idle
description: Dreamcore inspired incremental game with vaporwave aesthetics

title: X-Blades: HD Upgrade
description: The all new X-Blades HD Upgrade features updated graphics and wide-screen compatibility, as well as newly rendered and post processed cutscenes in Full HD.

title: Pocket Legend
description: In Pocket Legend, a roguelike deck-builder, you control a hero transported to a world of legendary weapons. Strategically arrange items in your inventory to defeat enemies with unique attack patterns. Customize your setup, unlock powerful cards, and uncover the fate of the dark forces.

title: Warcraft III: Reforged - Version 2.0
description: In celebration of the 30th anniversary of the release of Warcraft: Orcs & Humans, Warcraft III: Reforged has been updated to version 2.0, which includes many fixes, improvements, and nods to Warcraft’s history.

title: Warcraft Remastered Battle Chest
description: Celebrate 30 years of Warcraft history and travel back to the beginning with remastered versions of Warcraft I and II and a newly updated Warcraft III Reforged.

title: Hearthstone: The Great Dark Beyond
description: Long ago, the distant planet Argus was attacked by the demonic Burning Legion. While most of Argus gave in to unholy promises of power, some brave souls escaped to the stars. These “exiled ones” now call themselves Draenei, and they need you to help them find a new home. Pilot your own Starship and explore the vastness between worlds in The Great Dark Beyond!

title: Hearthstone: Into the Emerald Dream
description: Into the Emerald Dream is Hearthstone's 29th expansion, set to release as the first expansion of 2025. This expansion explores the Emerald Dream, as the battle between the Old Gods and the Druids of the Emerald Dream decides the fate of the World Tree.

title: Hearthstone: The Lost City of Un'Goro
description: The Lost City of Un'Goro is Hearthstone's 30th expansion, set to release as the second expansion of 2025. This expansion is stylized as the first-ever sequel expansion, following the events of Journey to Un'Goro. Players join Elise on a hunt for a mythical, lost Tortollan city.

title: Hearthstone: Across the Timeways
description:
Across the Timeways is Hearthstone's 31st expansion, featuring 145 new collectible cards released on November 4, 2025. In this expansion, players travel with Chromie through alternate realities to recruit Legendary Warcraft heroes.

Across the Timeways introduces two new keywords: Rewind and Fabled. Cards with Rewind can be replayed an additional time for a potentially different outcome. Legendary Fabled cards include 2 additional cards with them in players' decks during deckbuilding.

title: World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria Classic
description:
World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria Classic (sometimes shortened to MoP Classic) is a Classic server option that launched in July 2025 which allows playing content and game mechanics of the 2012 Mists of Pandaria expansion. It will be available during the latter half of the modern The War Within period and the beginning of Midnight.

Like prior Classic releases, MoP Classic is similar to its original version, but includes some changes, including significant changes to endgame instance difficulty progression. A Mythic+-like dungeon mode was added, continuing the trend started in Wrath of the Lich King Classic, while Raid Finder mode has been omitted, with its loot shifted to the upgraded dungeons. Minor changes include alts having easier access to flying mount skills and tweaks to Arena healing.

title: World of Warcraft: The War Within - Undermine(d)
description: Undermine(d), takes players to an underground city built by the creativity of the goblins.

title: Interstate 35
description: A visual novel exploring a near-apocalyptic vision of North Texas, told through the poetic words of a young woman going home.

title: Grimgig Railway
description: Grimgig Railway is a horror game with train simulation elements where you’ll need to keep calm and face your fears. You’ll drive the train across an old railway in Sakura valley, deep in the Japanese countryside. Drive the train and find soon enough why not everyone can keep this job.

title: Active Matter
description:
You’re an operative stuck in a time loop, always brought back from the dead to the same point.

Choose your loadout and enter quantum unstable zones rich with active matter — a substance capable of warping and ripping the very fabric of space and time.

Fight against rivals from other timelines, survive physics-breaking anomalies and try to stay alive. Harvest active matter, gather loot and extract to a safe place before the whole zone ceases to exist with everything inside it.

title: Jail Escape
description:
Jail Escape is a Half-Life 2 mod based off the television show "Prison Break". It somewhat follows the environments of the show. The developer made this mod to learn how to use different programs, such as Valve Hammer Editor and Maya.

Features:
- 1 new weapon
- 9 new maps
- Some new props and textures
- 30-60 min. playing time (depending on you skill level)

title: HoloReality
description:
This mod started from a chat session about learning to map and ways of improving.

The idea is to allow maps that are not normally released to be part of something bigger and that keeps growing.

It was original conceived for Half-Life 2 / Orange Box but could easily be extended to other single player games.

In retrospect it is clear that HoloReality was influenced by a Half-Life mod called Project Quantum Leap and Portal, although at the time of concept it didn’t seem that way.

title: Hearts of Iron IV: Götterdämmerung
description: Build the industrial and research foundation to survive the world’s greatest conflict In Hearts of Iron IV: Götterdämmerung. In this expansion, players can write new histories of Germany, Austria, Hungary, Belgium, and Congo. Pursue exciting new research and military options, opening new paths for devastating new weapons and dramatic raids on strategic targets.

title: Yard Resistance
description: Don't let the UFOs disturb your Yard. Eat their shield. Shoot them down.

title: Need for speed: Mobile
description: At sunset in Hot Bay World, Ajie and Vera stood at the highest point of Hot Bay, looking at this endless racing paradise.

title: Portal: Alive & Kicking
description: Portal: Alive & Kicking is a full remake and re-imagining of Valve's award-winning title, Portal.

title: Portal: Ambition
description: Portal: Ambition is a semi-story-driven campaign that offers hours of gameplay through puzzles and out-of-bounds tasks. Complete requests by an unknown scientist from a different section of the facility, help retrieve important information and data.

title: Culinarium
description: Culinarium is a card management cooking game where you stack ingredients to create recipes and cook dishes. For example, if you cut some Salmon slices on a cutting board and stack them with rice, soy sauce, and wasabi, you'll make a Salmon Nigiri.

title: Portal: System Failure
description: Portal: System Failure is a community made standalone modification for Portal 2 built on the Source Engine, set within the Portal universe.

title: Dungeon Vending Machines
description: Dungeon Vending Machines is a relaxing, casual idle game. Where you run vending machines in a dungeon! As adventurers brave dangerous depths, you’ll be their lifeline. Expand your machine lineup, grow your profits, and become the ultimate dungeon supplier!

title: Portal: Lost in Aperture
description: This is a mod for Portal 1. Includes new maps, storyline, a whole new Portal experience. This game take place in an Aperture laboratory in Eastern-Europe.

title: Portal: Singularity Collapse
description: Explore a new wing of Aperture Science focused on the creation of Portal Guns. Play as a scientist working at this research centre, and traverse it's remains after an unforeseen accident sends you forward in time. Go through never before seen areas with new technology in order to return.

title: The Broken Vow
description: Unravel the mystery by finding notes, objects and memories hidden around the house. Find out what happened to Clark, escape Emma and escape — even if it takes strength.

title: Aftercare Sessions
description: Aftercare Sessions is a short episode dedicated to provide very easy maps. It features light combat, very easy exploration and snack-sized pace, with each map taking no more than 2 minutes. Just jump in and unwind a little.

title: HertenHeld
description:
An exploration platformer where you play as a young huntress, that has to search for her lost deer pet, and save it from the hostile wolves that threatens the forest.

As you progress, you'll find items and weapons that helps you to open paths to other areas. Untill you'll meet the wolf boss, which will mark the end if defeated.

title: Dead Dock Protocol
description:
A neon-bloody action cyberpunk zombie shooter from Game Studio 1979.

Introducing Dead Dock Protocol, a thrilling cyberpunk zombie shooter packed with intense, neon-blood-soaked action! Embark on a crucial mission to rescue six besieged city zones from the clutches of Zombots and their formidable bosses. Whether you fight alongside your team or venture alone, your objective is to stay alive and eradicate the hordes of Zombots.

title: Oh My Wrench
description:
How long can you survive the road?

In Oh My Wrench, you’ll take the wheel in an endless car-driving adventure where the main goal is to survive as long as possible while dodging unpredictable obstacles. As you progress, the speed increases, pushing your reflexes to the limit. Compete for the highest score on a global leaderboard that now features both all-time and weekly rankings, giving you fresh opportunities to shine every week!

To spice up the challenge, pick up bonuses along the way: grab an extra life to keep going, a time-slowing hourglass to catch your breath, or special coins to boost your score. Combined with a fast-paced day-night cycle and dynamic weather shifts, every moment feels fresh, thrilling, and filled with new surprises.

Can you navigate the chaos, collect the bonuses, and claim the top spot? Find out in Oh My Wrench!

title: Sainte-Vibrisse
description: A father and daughter set out for a peaceful camping holiday in the deep woods of rural Quebec. But when their car dies on a deserted road, their dream trip turns into a nightmare! No cell signal. No sign of life. Just an empty village, overrun with cats, strange happenings, and a supermarket that somehow… remains open despite no one inside. Are they truly alone? Or have they wandered into the heart of a dark and twisted cult? Sainte-Vibrisse awaits you… if you dare!

title: Masquerade: Hell Academy
description:
The quiet Numata Hiroshi is being blackmailed by his classmate, Himehara Yoritake, into performing sexual acts for him. One day, Himehara orders Numata to steal the exam answers off the teacher's desk, which sets off a chain of events culminating in the two men being among the captives taken by a criminal impersonating a police officer.

Their captor demands increasingly depraved acts from his hostages, and if they're going to survive, they have no choice but to comply...

title: Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos
description: Purrrifiers is a hilarious 4-player co-op game about cleaning while causing chaos. Solve puzzles, drive quirky vehicles, use an array of cleaning tools and team up with adorable cats. Experience absurd humor, diverse locations, and non-stop fun as you collaborate or troll your way to cleaning glory!

title: Wildaria
description: Wildaria is an Action-Adventure RPG Pet Collector set in an Infinite Fantasy World. Explore diverse open-world biomes as you collect and train unique pets to aid in your quest to conquer dungeons, slay gods, or defend the natural world from the kingdom.

title: RetroBlazer
description: Take on the mantle of the Pyramid Guard, go up against the cybernetic Ark Legion, and rid the kingdom of a spectral blight. Combining the charm of Saturday Morning Cartoons and the bombastic action of late 90s shooters, RetroBlazer recaptures a golden era of frantic, fast-paced, first-person action.

title: LittleBigPlanet 3: Fix Me Hook Hat T-shirt
Moonsigil Atlas
description: The deckbuilding roguelike with no energy – play cards using physical space! Slot cards together, manipulate the shape of your cards, and create overpowered combos to break the game!

title: You Know The Drill
description: You Know The Drill is a relaxing incremental mining game about digging underground to harvest ores. Collect resources, sell them, and upgrade your drill to go even deeper!

title: Drums Rock: Powerwolf - 'Army of the Night'
description: Get the track 'Army of the Night' from Powerwolf! This track is part of the 'Smash Fest Music Pack'.

title: Random Quest
description:
Random Quest is a slightly experimental mod with an unusual story. It is not set inside the Half Life universe and there are some game mechanics which have been subtley altered. The pace starts out slow, and builds up gradually.

This mod is intended to be more of an adventure rather than a shooter. If you approach this mod as a pure shooter, then you will probably not enjoy it.

There are some intense action scenes, but most of these come later on, much of the earlier parts of the mod are focused on adventure and storytelling.

title: Tsuki no Hikari
description: A short yuri visual novel with several optional voice options for the protagonist.

title: Iron Trails: Outlaw Pursuit
description: Step into a semi-open world where your mission is to deliver supplies to stations while fending off bandits. Explore a vast, relaxing environment while engaging in shootouts or simply enjoying the scenery. Each delivery strengthens your country’s war effort. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Mister Antonio
description: A puzzle adventure game about a quirky cat with rather curious demands.

title: Multimind
description: Multimind is a relaxing game that tests the player's ability to multitask. Players need to maintain the stability of multiple game items at the same time and try to persist as long as possible as the game difficulty increases.

title: Void Lands
description: A fast-paced 2D action RPG where you play as a skilled archer battling through intense monster hordes, epic boss fights, and loot-rich arenas. Customize your abilities, find powerful gear, and master dynamic combat in a world filled with endless challenges and upgrades.

title: Meow Mission
description: Play Meow Mission and solve a variety of puzzles to rescue cats trapped in an outer dimension! The rescued cats will be brought to the Tomcat House, where you can make memories with their unique personalities. Let's go rescue these adorable kitties!

title: The Super Pie Throwing
description:
Princess Rosa is mad…. And her maids are gonna pay!!! After a tragic dessert mishap, everything falls apart.

The Super Pie Throwing is a slapstick action mini game where you throw pies, avoid weights, play red light green light, and all other sorts of things to earn HUGE POINTS!!! Try challenge mode for a variety of challenges and obstacles that change the core gameplay and push your skills! Or, if you want to just jump in for a quick match, try Time Attack and Score Attack!

30 unique challenges, various unlockables, funny faces, and more!!!

title: Unterholz
description: Explore the murky corners and abandoned ruins of an isolated enclave in 15th century Europe. Prevail in chivalrous battle and unveil the mysteries of a dark world. Embark on a non-linear psychological journey through the underbrush of this sinister setting as well as your own soul.

title: LEGO Horizon Adventures: Digital Deluxe Edition Content
description: An addon for LEGO Horizon Adventures, adding the content of the Digital Deluxe Edition to the game.

title: Maple Colors
description: Saku Yoshijirou has just transferred to Kouka Academy, which is famous for its theatrical activities. On his first day at school, he started a fight with Aoi Mirai. To make the matter worse, the fight was seen by Aizen Yukihito, the head of the Drama Club. All of Yoshijirou's classmates are problem students, and he thought he could use the fight to rid himself of them. Then, Yoshijirou is assigned to direct his class in a drama competition against the Drama Club. If they lose the competition, they will be suspended. However, because they are problem students, he has difficulties directing them.

title: Legam
description: Legam is an RPG, which was published by U-Office

title: Go-Go! Grapplestaff
description:
Go! Go! Grapple Staff is a fast paced, momentum based, 2.5d platformer set in a magical cartoony realm.

The Meddling "Grapple Wizard", once a meagre wizard, now blessed with the knowledge of the deathly-efficient and recently outlawed Grapple Staff, geared up with their pointy hat is able to tear through anyone (or anything) that stands in their way. Mischief, chaos and high speeds are the aims of the game in the Grapple Wizards mission to ascend the peak of the Wizard Council - who banished the Grapple Wizard for their use of the Grapple Staff.

title: Recursed: The Ice Palace
description: Recursed: The Ice Palace is a free community DLC for the puzzle game Recursed, filled with carefully crafted and extremely challenging puzzles.

title: Beanrise
description: First-person Action, Puzzle-Solving game. Unfold the Mysteries of two interconnected timelines. Discover the truth of the present within the past!

title: Escape The Garage
description: Wake up at an abandoned train station and find yourself in a dark garage. Solve puzzles, find clues, and uncover secrets to escape. With a suspenseful atmosphere and three different endings, this game will captivate you. Can you escape the nightmare?

title: Vircoban
description: A Sokoban engine / game for the Vircon32 fantasy console

title: Retrojam 4
description: Map-Center’s Quake Retrojam 4 contains 25 maps and their biggest hub yet.

title: Get to Work
description: You are poor and bald. Get to Work.

title: Put the Sausage in the Bun
description:
Guide a wobbly sausage into its bun using balloons and bees in this chaotic physics puzzle. Can you master the fine art of getting the sausage in just the right place?

Put the Sausage in the Bun is a physics-based puzzle game where your goal is straightforward— get the sausage into the bun. Use balloons and bees to move the sausage through various obstacles, with realistic sausage'y physics making everything a greater challenge than it needs to be. As you progress, new levels introduce new challenges, requiring more precision, fast and creative thinking to complete.

title: The Thaumaturge: Deluxe Edition
description:
Step onto the culturally flourishing streets of Warsaw with an even more fashionable style in The Thaumaturge Digital Deluxe Edition.

To refine your look just as a gentleman should, you receive in-game content: an elegantly stylized hairstyle and facial hair, luxury clothes, and a HUD reskin.

But that's not all; the Deluxe Edition also includes downloadable content:
• Notes from the Grimoire to help you delve into the arcana of thaumaturgy
• A map of Warsaw in 1905 to familiarize yourself with the city
• The Thaumaturge digital soundtrack for your auditory pleasure
• A 3D printable model of the Golem salutor to guard your desk
• A set of wallpapers for an overall aesthetic boost

title: Half-Life 2: 20th Anniversary Update
description: To celebrate the 20th anniversary, Valve has released a massive update to the game itself. Added new features, fixed old bugs, improved some visuals, added more options, and integrated the Steam Workshop into the classic game.

title: Mega Man 42
description: A Mega Man fan game by Servadac. The game is made in the style of the original Mega Man for NES. Because of this many of the newer features are not to be found in the game, such as Mega Man's slide and charge-up buster. There are no E-tanks either. This to preserve the challenge of the game instead of watering it out with features that do not add to the gameplay, and instead detract from it by making it too easy.

title: Hero's Last Words
description: A short visual novel about lovers before a final battle

title: Election Tycoon: Trump vs. Harris
description: Step into the intense world of U.S. politics with Election Tycoon! In this real-time strategy game, you'll take on the role of a presidential candidate in the 2024 elections. Whether you choose to be Donald Trump, Kamala Harris, or create your own independent candidate, your goal is to sway the nation and secure your place in the White House.

title: Clutchtime: Basketball Deckbuilder
description:
A basketball-themed Roguelike Deckbuilder. Each player in a basketball team is represented by 3 skill cards like 2 and 3 point shots, rebounds, steals, blocks, assists, crossover moves. There are also coaching cards like timeouts, challenge or substitution.

The cards are played during a match with a goal of outscoring your opponent. You can play an elimination tournament, or a season where you need to qualify into playoffs.

You can trade cards with other teams, duplicate, remove and upgrade them. You can draft new cards at the end of each quarter and keep one of those permanently at the end of each match.

There's a multiplayer mode as well, where you can play PvP matches when you meat during the competition.

title: Supra Smash Bross For the Commodore 64 and ZX Spectrum
Undertale: Bits and Pieces Together
description: Undertale: Bits and Pieces Together is a mod that allows you to play the entire original Undertale Bits and pieces mod but with two players!

title: Hero King Quest: Peacemaker Prologue
description: A short "classic" JRPG. Play the role of the Dark Lord's sister, slay the Hero King, and take the first step in conquering humankind.

title: Super Mario Bros: Attack of the Bloopers
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 2D
Tangomon 2
description: Educational monster battling memorization game.

title: Millas
description: A modpack for NeoLemmix which adds aesthetics and levels inspired by Freedom Planet.

title: Manhattan's Left-Overs
description: A late entry for Func Map Jam 6, following the theme "Fire and Brimstone": a ruined cityscape with lots of lava and jumping.

title: Digital Soul Data
description: Digital Soul Data is a top-down bullet hell shooter. Play as a hacker, Mia, who uses avatar NB4 to blast her way through cyberspace and retrieve her sister's Digital Soul from eternal virtual slavery.

title: Treasure Atlas
description: This is a roguelike card game with RPG elements. An open world with a procedurally generated map where you decide where to go and who to fight. Along the way, you will encounter events that complicate or simplify the adventure. you will have to create your character and choose a class for him.

title: The Forgotten Nightmare
description: Huge map featuring a cave system with a crypt beneath, a dungeon and some ruins; very high enemy count. It is based on the Progs_dump mod (included) and comes with a custom skybox as well as a few new sounds.

title: Zombie Jam 1
description: Results of an impromptu speedmapping/jam session following a "medieval E1M2 style brickwork and about 20 monsters" theme.

title: Zombie Jam 2
description: Results of an impromptu speedmapping/jam session following a "lifts and zombies and 20ish monsters" theme.

title: A Punk with Wheels
description: A punk with a wheels is a point and click game. It's a parody of the 80's punk culture. The protagonist is Cody and he will lead you in a funny story in a drama universe. Help him to investigate to know what he did last night. You will meet a lot of weird original characters in a black humour story. Enjoy!

title: Shei Toule Wo de Nu Pengyou
description: This game tells the story of the player through the clues on the slips of paper to find the stolen girlfriend！

title: Erk: Adventures in Stone Age Real Estate
description: In this comedic point-and-click adventure game Stone Age estate agent Erk must sell a cave or lose his job

title: Destino Indomable
description: In Destino Indomable, you're the new actress tasked with playing the main character in a telenovela! This is a wild visual novel inspired by the craziest Latin soup operas, filled with humor, drama, romance, horses, handsome men, Spanglish and slaps!

title: Adventures of a Cat in Space
description: Adventures of a Cat in Space is a family-friendly point & click adventure. After being accidentally launched into space, a cat is on a mission to find their way back home. Along the way you will need to solve puzzles and explore distant planets across the galaxy to unlock original music and songs to power up your navigation system and get back to Earth in this cosy adventure purrrfect for all ages.

title: AlienXcape
description: AlienXcape is a 3D first-person shooter set in a science fiction world where you were captured during your last raid on the Wymacet horde. Now you must find a way out of your cell and fight your way through three levels.

title: Portile
description: A 2d, tile-based take on narbacular drop

title: Blade of Dawn
description: This is a third-person hack-and-slash roguelike game. You will play as a Knight of Light defending against the invasion of the Shadow Empire. Using the power of holy light, you can convert shadow-infected enemies into allies. Try to survive until dawn!

title: Barry Bonds enter the world of Myst
description:
Barry Bonds, surreal adventures, and the becoming his world thereof

An adventure game set in the world of MYST starring Barry Bonds, made by Jon Bois for the website Progressive Boink, back in 2005.

title: The Question's Quest of Sin
description: TheQuestion's Quest of Sin is a game made in RPG Maker VX Ace, in which you follow Steam lover, TheQuestion619, on his mission to cop some Steam currency in order to purchase additional crate keys, as he is lacking.

title: Creepy Claus
description: It’s your first day on the job in Santa’s workshop, but it’s already off to a bad start. Santa isn’t impressed with your work, and now he’s chasing you down. The only way out? WRAP THE PRESENTS the job is simple :)

title: Friday Night Funkin' Red Version: vs. Red
description: You meet Red at Mt. Silver, he wants to battle, but you force him into a rap battle.

title: Danger, Bob-omb! Danger!: Handle with Care
Fire Emblem: Immortal Sword
description: A fan-made prequel to the popular Fire Emblem: Blazing Sword (FE7), Fire Emblem: Immortal Sword (FE7x) is the tale of a vast conspiracy to throw the world of Elibe into chaos, and of three young leaders caught in its wake. A tale of questionable alliances, political intrigue, and the confusion of conflict. Follow a cast of your favorite characters in a brand new adventure, as their mettle is tested in both battlefields and moral dilemmas. Explore a world of new classes, skills, and features that bring the classic land of Elibe into a modern standard of tactical depth.

title: Five Nights at Jaygi's: Into Dreams...
description: After the events of the mishaps at Jaygi's Pizzeria, Ashley decides to relax and falls asleep after reading her newspaper. Upon waking up, she finds herself in a place that isn't like the real world and gets trapped

title: Luigi and the Quest for Nothing: Enhanced
Aldoria
description: Explore your way through the dangerous fantasy land of Aldoria where a single hit will kill you! Slay monsters and collect magical abilities in this small skill-testing metroidvania.

title: Touhou Spell Carnival: Limited Edition
description:
The Limited Edition includes:
- Reimu and Marisa Figures
- Official Hardcover Art Book (56 Pages)
- Official Soundtrack (52 Tracks)
- Reversible Cover Sleeve
- Collector's Box
- Exclusive Trading Card

title: Data Doesn't Lie
description: You study samples under your microscraper. You extract the data. Then -- and only then -- you sleep.

title: Dawn of the Tiberium Age
description: Dawn of the Tiberium Age (DTA) is a stand-alone mod that combines and enhances Tiberian Dawn and Red Alert using a heavily customized Tiberian Sun engine. Featuring all 4 factions (GDI, Nod, Allies and Soviets) with extremely polished gameplay, DTA allows you to mix and match the factions as you'd like in tons of new multiplayer maps and challenge yourself in dozens of original missions.

title: Of Ash and Steel
description: Of Ash and Steel is an immersive third-person open-world RPG created by a passionate team that values the essence of classic old-school RPGs and modern designs. Explore the lands of a once-prosperous island, hone your combat skills, and survive in the unforgiving realm of the Kingdom of the Seven.

title: Octopus 21
description: Octopus 21 is a Homebrew version of the classic Game & Watch game "Octopus" for the Amstrad GX4000 and Amstrad CPC.

title: The Gorge
description: Large base themed map surrounded by cliffs and caves, an adaptation / conversion of the level "Mountain Gorge" from the game SiN (1998). Originally presented at the 20th anniversary QEXPO 2016

title: Quadrant 7
description: Medium sized Rubicon base themed map remix based on rd1m1 from Runner's Delight, built on Alkaline 1.2

title: Third Iteration
description: Medium sized blue runic / metal themed map remix based on rd1m2 from Runner's Delight, built on Progs Dump 3

title: Cumma Celeritate
description: Small / medium sized temple map with a lot of monsters, built on Progs Dump v3 (already included). A remix of rd1m3 from Runner's Delight.

title: Azure Be Gone
description: Medium sized runic / metal themed level in a classic style, a remix of the author's 2004 release "Azure Influx" (flecksp1).

title: Azure Influx
description: Around medium sized linear b/w Metal map

title: Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles
description:
"Fake Ducks: Spooky Chronicles" is a turn-based RPG inspired by the great classics set in the present day.
It tells of the misadventures of a group of bizarre friends who, thanks to the powers gained from an ancient pendant, must prevent a mysterious individual from getting his hands on a dark talisman that could compromise the future of the world. There's just one problem... Let's just say that our friends are not the classic heroes expected to save the planet.
Form your ideal team and explore a total of seven levels filled with puzzles, riddles, obstacles, hidden rewards, and face hordes of strange enemies and monsters in turn-based combat with simple but strategic and often challenging mechanics.

title: Yakuza Shadows of New York
description: Step into the shadows of New York City in YAKUZA: Shadows of New York, a gripping action-adventure where the old codes of honor clash against the forces of modern corruption.

title: World War II City Rebirth Tycoon
description: Lead a war-torn city to prosperity in a post-WWII rebuilding adventure.

title: VoidCraft Island Chronicles: Sky Survival
description:
In "VoidCraft Island Chronicles: Sky Survival," you find yourself as a nomadic explorer cast into the mysterious Void, a world with its own secrets and surprises. This enigmatic realm invites you to uncover its hidden mysteries and navigate its unique landscapes, each filled with challenges and unexpected encounters.
Construct and enhance your sailing vessel to better equip yourself for the journey ahead. Starting with a simple raft, you'll develop it into a formidable vessel complete with a ship's hold, mast, and captain's cabin. Customize your vessel with various objects, from storages and workbenches to decorations, making it truly your own.
As you traverse the surreal terrains of the Void, you'll confront numerous foes and navigate through ever-changing environments. Whether you journey solo or uncover unexpected twists along the way, the Void promises an unparalleled adventure waiting to be experienced, testing your survival skills and resilience.

title: The Legend of Cyber Cowboy
description: Liberate a town from gangs of cybernetic bandits! The Legend of Cyber Cowboy is a top-down twin-stick shooter presented in slick pixel art style.

title: The Fine Art of Murder
description:
Unravel the mystery, where every choice shapes your fate.
A supernatural gamebook brought to life, with multiple endings to discover. Fully accessible – with or without the screen.

title: Outbreak: Shades of Horror Chromatic Split
description: Experience the beginning of the end of Cypress Ridge in this '90s survival horror nightmare at the dawn of the zombie outbreak.

title: Reflector
description: You control a UFO. Score points by reflecting bullets back at your enemies. You can change direction by pressing a button or hitting the sides of the screen. Hold a button to enhance your power.

title: Sky Aces: WWII Air Combat
description: Rule the skies in epic aerial combat and change the course of history!

title: Racing Champions
description: Hone your racing skills, sharpen your strategy, and aim for the podium in the ultimate racing challenge!

title: Pretty Girls Pop Match
description:
When the Demon Lord takes your fellow adventurers captive, it’s up to you to rescue them, recruit them to your team and utilize their unique abilities to turn the tide against the forces of evil! Pretty Girls Pop Match is a match-3 game that gives you the power to raise legendary adventurers to overcome puzzle challenges created just for you!

Align colorful jewels in sets of three to earn the points needed to win! Collect enough points to unlock "magical items" that can clear all jewels from the map. Adventurer skills can enhance the effect of magical items even further! Level up your adventurers' skills with gems earned in each stage to grow the ultimate adventuring party.

title: Jumping Boy
description: Jump higher and try not to fall!

title: Learn to Play vol. 8: Penalty Shootout
description: Aim, shoot, score!

title: Monkey Kong in New York
description: Get ready to explore the Big Apple like never before in Monkey Kong in New York!

title: Monster Truck Arena: Battle Royale
description: Crush the competition in epic arena battles!

title: Jet Combat: Cats vs. Dogs Military Simulator
description: Choose your side and rule the skies!

title: Euro Truck Sim Driver Simulator 24: Garbage
D.U.M.B. Ducks
description: D.U.M.B. Ducks is an action-filled, retro platform game. Slaughter giant snails. Battle gigantic beasts. Buy better guns. Blow up walls. Collect fat stacks of cash.

title: Draw li
description: Draw, connect, and master the art of physics in 40 thrilling levels!

title: Cubic Run
description: Switch the sides

title: GGmuks Casino: Slots
description: Step into the fun and thrill of GGmuks Casino: Slots, where every spin is a chance to win big! Start with a small balance and place bets to chase exciting payouts with vibrant icons and a playful casino atmosphere. Enjoy classic slot machine excitement with a lighthearted, casual twist!

title: Chained Towards Heaven
description: Climb from hell to paradise, bound by chains and teamwork!

title: Chained Heroes
description: Can you reach the top, or will the water pull you down?

title: Bamboo Retro Run
description: Run, jump, and slash your way through endless retro action!

title: Arcade Archives: Konami's Table Tennis
description:
Show your brilliance at table tennis!

"KONAMI’s TABLE TENNIS" is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1985.
This title captures the fun and thrills of actual table tennis, where matches hang on split-second decisions that keep your reflexes sharp.
Don't miss your openings, and return the ball with a smash!

title: Eye Sore
description: Small purple-bricked castle level

title: FourFeather
description: Large mixed theme map set in a partly technological, party runic and partly medieval complex. Features plenty of new custom content, including a large variety of new monsters.

title: Gabang: Ultimate
description: GABANG: ULTIMATE is a roguelike deck-building game that builds your own deck with various classes and items. Defeat your enemies with a cute backpack and randomly placed items that help you!

title: Stand: Survive, Team-up, And Never Die
description: STAND is a tower defence in a post-apocalyptic environment. Other survivors can join you, but also lots of upgrades. Combine weapons with items. Make a spinning flamethrower or install barbed wire to face the hordes ! Survive, Team-up, And Never Die !

title: Stunt Bike Extreme
description: Stunt Bike Extreme is a motocross racing game. Compete around the world through adrenaline-pumping tracks.

title: Conquest Tactics: Realm of Sin
description: Conquest Tactics: Realm of Sin is a dark fantasy roguelite with hex-based, turn-based tactical combat. Command your forces, make impactful choices, and navigate a realm consumed by sin—will you restore order or surrender to darkness?

title: Liegecraft
description: You are the King. Lead your vassals, build your feudal realm and conquer foreign kingdoms in this blend of turn based 4X and realtime rpg. Attend feasts, host tourneys and fight duels. Every character has their own mind so promote the loyal, scheme against rivals and imprison the disobedient.

title: Just Skateboard
description: JUST SKATEBOARD is simply a skateboard simulator. Just skate and enjoy the ride.

title: A Night Duty
description: It is an upcoming horror game developed in South Korea. The player can simulate a night duty as an officer in Korean army base. It is a game that inspired by the game The Exit 8.

title: Deathmatch Classics Vol. 1
description:
Episode consisting of seven classic deathmatch maps converted for single player (with speedrunning in mind):

dmc1m1 : basewalk (basewalk) by Preacher
dmc1m2 : Acrophobia (dm7) by (maybe) American McGee
dmc1m3 : Bloodrun (ztndm3) by ZTN
dmc1m4 : DeutschMaschine (cmt3) by Gandhi
dmc1m5 : Domination (p3a) by Pingu
dmc1m6 : #endif (endif) by Yataze
dmc1m7 : Lost Entrance to the Dismal Oubliette (e2m10) by John Romero

title: Deathmatch Classics Vol. 2
description:
Episode consisting of five classic deathmatch maps converted for single player (with speedrunning in mind):

dmc2m1 : Deadalus Revisited (imp1dm6) by Biff Debris
dmc2m2 : Slipstream (slip) by Inertia
dmc2m3 : Black Rain (evdm1) by Evan Wagner
dmc2m4 : The Killing Jar (kdmj) by Kell
dmc2m5 : Void Runner (kdmv) by Kell

title: Deathmatch Classics Vol. 3
description:
Eight small deathmatch levels by various authors converted into an action-packed single player episode. Comes with a start map and a secret level.

dmc3 : Deathmatch Classics Vol.3 by negke
dmc3m1 : Orange Whip (lundm1) by Lunaran
dmc3m2 : Zeal & Fury (spirit1dm3) by spirit
dmc3m3 : Deep Scars (q1shw2) by ShadoW
dmc3m4 : Aghast (aghast) by Vondur
dmc3m5 : Devastation (q1shw1) by ShadoW
dmc3m6 : Dark Ritual (ritual) by Tyrann
dmc3m7 : /me Votes Vondur For World Domination (rpgdm1) by R.P.G.
dmc3m8 : Base Of Two Deaths (negdm1) by negke

title: Deathmatch Remix
description: Eight deathmatch levels remixed for single player, most of them based on the stock DM maps. They run on the SMP mod (included) and come with two skyboxes plus a music track.

title: The Hidden Ones
description: The new 3D ARPG GAME based on the famous chinese anime IP: Hitori No Shita: The Outcast. The game will be alpha test soon and it plans to launch on PC, console and mobile platform.

title: Mad Metal
description: Mad Metal is a vehicle combat roguelite set in a dying America. Customize your vehicle, master precision car-to-car combat, and fight through dynamic arenas as a broken cop races to rescue his daughter and stop an AI-driven apocalypse.

title: Sagas of Lumin
description: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Your choices will shape the fate of this world.

title: The Home Into The Woods
description: Trapped in the woods you have no idea who or what is there?

title: Journey to the Void
description: Prepare to fend off attacks from all directions in this hybrid strategy roguelite deck builder. On your journey through varied grid-based biomes, battle unique foes and make tough moral choices to restore a corrupted land and decide the fate of your world.

title: Wyrd Waters
description: Wyrd Waters is a fast-paced, tactical multiplayer naval game set in a world inspired by Anglo-Saxon mythology. Join forces or face off with up to 8 friends as you command your fleet, outwit rivals, and navigate perilous, kraken-infested seas!

title: Vigilant
description:
A Dark story for Vigilants of Stendarr. This mod includes a lot of unique armor sets, weapons, jewelry, creatures and more.

Episode 1: The Summoner (Tutorial)
The Player becomes a Vigilant of Stendarr, and chases down a Summoner of Molag Bal.
To start the quest, speak with Altano, who is located in the Windpeak Inn in Dawnstar.

Episode 2: Bloody Matron (Small Dungeon)
The Player investigates the disappearance of multiple prisoners from the Windhelm dungeons.
It automatically start after Act1. When you update from older version, You need to activate "Water Snakes"of debug room.

Episode 3: Child of Oblivion (Horror, Hide and Seek)
The Player must rescue the owners of a noble mansion.
It automatically start after Act2. When you update from older version, You need to activate "Water Spirits" of debug room.

Episode 4: Oblivion (New World, Non-Journal)
The Player is trapped in Oblivion, and must wander the wasteland in order to find a way out.
The quest begins immediately after Episode 3.

title: Pic-Me!
description: Test how well you know your fellow players and how creative you can be! In this turn-based card game, the goal is to find the perfect word to describe one of the images on your cards—not too easy, but not too difficult either. If your description isn't good enough, your opponents will have a chance to steal points with a better-fitting card. But if your description is too obvious, everyone scores points—except you! Only those who strike the perfect balance have a chance to win!

title: Crystalfall
description:
Loot-Driven Action RPG in a Steampunk World

Take on the role of a convict who has been thrown into the dungeons by a powerful ruling organization. Embark on a journey through a world devastated by a mysterious asteroid, scattering powerful crystal shards across distinct world zones brimming with mutated creatures and steampunk enemies.

Delve into post-apocalyptic dungeons that randomize upon each visit and ascend to new heights of power with epic loot, extensive talent tree progression, theorycrafting and lootable skills.

title: Explorers
description:
Explore an archipelago, encounter fellow explorers, and seduce and haggle with them to help you complete your map!
There is no time constraint, no danger, there's no gameover. Instead, this game proposes a calming experience of exploration and encounters. You can just stop playing when you feel satisfied. A play session will usually last 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Mubosama
description: We were spending our usual summer—catching beetles, chasing dogs, finding good spots. And then, we learned about her existence. MUBOSAMA is an adventure game based on urban legends.

title: Undying: The Beast
description: Your town calls you a witch, but you're a simple, widowed herbalist. Tonight is your first brush with the supernatural. A man is hunted and finds refuge in your home, and you can tell he's something other than human.

title: Undying: Reject
description: A short visual novel in which a vampire offers his help

title: Hellgate Senigallia Remake
description: An RPG-infused boomer-shooter with dark and mysterious tones, offering innovative gameplay with a nostalgic nod to the '90s. Get ready to blow everything up and turn enemies into cannon fodder before facing the massive end-level bosses!

title: Women's Dresses
description: A short kinetic novel about an intimidating knight and his love for women's dresses

title: The Yandere CEO
description:
William, the CEO of the company you just joined, had always been a man of ambition and success. From a young age, he was driven to achieve greatness, and he had a singular focus on his goals. He rose to the top of his field, building a successful company from the ground up.

However, his relentless drive also came at a cost. He pushed away friends and family, sacrificing personal relationships for the sake of his ambition. He had no time for romance, believing it to be a distraction.

Until he met you...

but you will find out for yourself what happens next..

title: Flat Fat Fartfest
description: Our friend Chuggy just devoured a hearty plate of extra spicy noodles and is on the brink of an epic bout of diarrhea. The nearest toilet is several kilometers up… several. I wish you good luck on your journey, but be warned—the diapers were left at home.

title: Clicker Clicker Clicker
description: Click on the cursor to receive clicker gold. Upgrade your clicks with your clicker gold. Click on the falling cursors to receive more clicker gold! Purchase projectiles in the shop that will clean out the falling cursors for you.

title: Acidophilus
description: Medium-sized copper/metal level; a singleplayer remix of stock DM2 - Claustrophobopolis, based on the original map source.

title: The Containment Centre
description: Small base level; a remake of the first map of the game Viscerafest.

title: Symphony of Steel
description: Small industrial base map; the layout is a tribute to ztn's Bloodrun. It comes with a custom skybox.

title: Flocking Hell
description: Flocking Hell is a turn-based strategy roguelite where you defend your pasture from demon legions. It blends calm exploration with auto-battler combat, offering a mix of easy-to-learn mechanics and deep strategy. It also has a lot of sheep.

title: Hyperchannel
description: This is a free shooting game. The game has very simple operations and beautiful graphics. Great for killing time.

title: Blob
description: Embark on a chemistry-packed adventure! Collect elemental blobs, combine them into powerful compounds, and build the ultimate periodic table collection. One element drop per hour, with more drops influenced by your blobventory!

title: Papa's Pizzeria Deluxe
description: Top, bake, and serve delicious pizzas in Papa's Pizzeria Deluxe! Craft pizzas for Papa Louie's loyal customers while earning tips, points, and Special Recipes. Unlock holiday ingredients for seasonal pies, and take a trip in the Food Truck to serve your own unique creations!

title: Frontline Inferno
description: Step into the boots of a soldier from the Axis, Soviet, or Allied forces and engage in thrilling, rapid-fire battles across colorful, stylized battlegrounds. Frontline Inferno is an action-packed FPS arena shooter that combines the historical setting of World War II with an arcade twist, delivering frantic gunfights, instant respawns, and total freedom in how you gear up.

title: Sports Supermarket
description: From Small Shop to Sports Empire – Are You Ready to Rise?

title: Trading Card Shop Simulator
description: Turn your card collecting dream into a real business!

title: TCG Card Shop Master
description: What’s your strategy for becoming a top card retailer?

title: TCG Empire: Card Shop Simulator
description: Unleash your entrepreneurial spirit in a world of trading cards!

title: Black Pine: Incident Response
description: Black Pine is a 4-player online co-op horror survival game where you and your crew are hired contractors, sent into the Appalachian Mountains to restore critical infrastructure after unknown events devastated the area. Take on important repairs and stay alert—nothing is quite as it seems.

title: Ultra Cop
description: A challenging retro arcade FPS/TPS straight from the late '90s. The Crime Wars have started and it's up to the Ultra Cops to bring back ultimate justice. Use Mechs, Riot Cars and serious firepower to bring the pain to the criminal underworld in this 6th Generation Y2K inspired game.

title: Former Dawn
description: An upcoming port of Former Dawn for the PC

title: Avowed: Premium Edition
description:
Premium Edition includes:
- Avowed base game
- Up to 5 days early access
- Two Premium Skin Packs
- Access to Avowed Digital Artbook & Original Soundtrack

title: Sklime: A Difficult Climbing Adventure
description: Sklime is a difficult single level twin-stick climbing game taking inspiration from Bennett Foddy's Getting Over It. The player must climb over a thousand meters out of The Depths, visiting 7 different colorful zones while playing some minigames along the way.

title: Zero to Dance Hero
description: Become a Dance Hero from Zero! Grab your Joy-Con controllers, and get your body moving to the beat! Learn popular hip-hop dance moves from basic to complex. But you won't be alone on your dancing journey. Four instructors help along the way!

title: Unpacking Universe Dreams
description: Unpack, Arrange, Create - Shape your world

title: Symmetrical Logic Puzzles 1000
description: A luxurious puzzle game where you separate scattered gems into different rooms. However, the rooms must be point-symmetric with the gems at the center.

title: Sweet Survivors
description: The purr-fect storm is coming! Can you protect your café from fluffy chaos?

title: Survive Undead Rush
description: Outrun, upgrade, and survive the relentless zombie onslaught!

title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Grim Protocols
description:
This update will include:
New Game Mode - Havoc: Think you’ve mastered the threat over Tertium? Think again. Havoc is a new end-game experience that will test the resolve of the most seasoned operative. Be ready to face daunting challenges and earn new cosmetic rewards. We’ve posted an initial dev blog about this, and we’re working on finishing the Q&A post to follow.
New Mission - Dark Communion: Return to the Carnival and explore its darkest corners. Steel yourself as you face hordes of cultists who will stop at nothing to achieve their Dark Communion. We are working on a dev blog for this.
Three New Weapon Families: Tear through waves of enemies by wielding the destructive might of the Two-Handed Force and Power Swords, and the Ogryn Heavy Stubber.

title: Final Memories
description: Point & Click Psychological Thriller about losing memories and gaining life

title: Goombario's Quest
description: Goombario's Quest is a Mario fangame where you embark on a great adventure as Goombario to save the Mushroom World from Goomboss's evil plans. Join Goombario and Goombella on this epic quest to stop Goomboss from getting the Cosmic Star!

title: Bob-Ball
description:
A Bob-Ball (which is type of Bob-Omb) found a paddle that can move on its own, and decided to have fun with the paddle. However, he didn't realize that somehow a timer is set on the Bob-Ball.

It's a Breakout-clone, but with a timer. Once you run out of time, the Bob-Ball explodes and the game ends. There is six powerups and high scores. High scores are the only thing that is for replay value however, so you probably won't play this a whole lot if high scores aren't your thing.

title: Fregocles y la Desinfección del Olimpo
Riki 8Bit Game Collection
description: Riki 8bit Game Collection is not just one experience, but many. To be precise, it includes five unique games and music albums. Kira Kira Star Night lets you collect stars while running through a pixelated, surreal cityscape. In Astro Ninja Man DX, you defend against threats from above by shooting upwards—just like in the classic arcade games of the 70s and 80s. And the trilogy of albums—8bit Music Power, 8bit Music Power Final, and 8bit Music Power Encore—will stay with you long after you turn off the power.

title: Gallery: Coloring book & decor
description: Gallery combines a coloring book and house design game with a rich story. Become a painting master, express yourself through a range of artworks!

title: Pippa and Your Phantasmal Problem
description:
Ms Ester's beautiful and neat house has been mysteriously wrecked in the past few weeks and nobody knows why. Patches of dirt on the carpet, things gone missing, and all sorts of mess keeps happening around the house. The police was called to investigate, a priest was invited to bless the house, and a group of ghostbusters was hired (they were so expensive!) and none of them found anything. How useless!

If this problem isn't solved by the time Ms Ester returns from her short trip, she'll kick you out. You have to find someone who can help: anyone will do, even this unreliable looking, self-proclaimed witch you just randomly met.

title: Shadowhand Solitaire
description: Ride with Lady Cornelia Darkmoor - aristocrat by day, highwaywoman by night. Play your cards right to untangle a web of corruption, smuggling and blackmail in this swashbuckling solitaire adventure. Your fortune and freedom are at stake!

title: Pranksters: Treasure of the Indians
description:
In Pranksters a city is plagued by rowdies which play pranks on innocent people. Now the player takes the role of a male or female kid to set things right. There are basically two goals per level: Drive away all rowdies and gather enough money for the bus. This is done by playing either nice tricks, e.g. washing off graffiti, or bad tricks, e.g. using a banana peel so someone slips.
The usage of tricks influences the village's morale either positive or negative, when it gets too low the game is lost. To do tricks the player has to use and combine items he finds on the streets. These depend on the character's gender and are randomly distributed. When pranksters get a hand on the player they pummel him and he loses life energy.

title: Maze: Path of Light
description: Play classic stress-relieving mazes or discover many original ones with square, circular and triangular maze shaped games. Enjoy more than 100 combinations of maze sizes, types, shapes and games modes. Special maze forms are also available: with bunny, guitar or tree shaped mazes.

title: Gakuin Makyo: High School Crisis
description: A group of boys and girls is thrown out of their world by a sudden earthquake... finding themselves in a new realm—a demon realm filled with strange monsters. Their fight to return begins now.

title: Memoirs of Murder: Welcome to Hidden Pines
description: It's time to relocate to the town of Hidden Pines! Your excitement over escaping the big city and enjoying your new home quickly turns tragic when your neighbor is murdered! To make matters worse, your spouse is the prime suspect! It's up to you to piece together the evidence and clear their name. This small-town is hiding some big secrets. Can you crack the case in time? Find out in this gripping Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

title: Memoirs of Murder: Resorting to Revenge
description: You and your spouse have won an all-inclusive vacation to Pinecone Hill! Your excitement on the train is short-lived when you and your new friends are stalked by a mysterious and dangerous man! Can you uncover his motives and stop his sinister plot before it's too late?! Find out in this thrilling Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

title: Memoirs of Murder: Behind the Scenes
description: What starts out as a fun vacation to a true crime film set turns disastrous when Aaron's cousin Kevin is accused of murdering the lead actress. Everybody in this small town is certain he's the killer, but Aaron and Mary suspect someone is framing Kevin to take the fall. Can they prove Kevin's innocence, or will he be punished for a crime he didn't commit? Find out in this thrilling hidden-object puzzle adventure game!

title: Phoenix Contract
description: Phoenix Contract is an exhilarating idle RPG that immerses you in a world teeming with adventure, mystery, and relentless battles. In this dynamic universe, you'll forge your legend by customizing your character, mastering unique skills, and embarking on epic quests. Engage in fierce PvP combat to prove your supremacy, challenge towering bosses for legendary rewards, and unlock the secrets of powerful heirlooms. Join forces with allies to conquer realms and shape the fate of the world. Your destiny awaits in Phoenix Contract—a realm where heroes rise, legends are born, and the adventure never ends.

title: Histoire de Lune
description: Histoire de Lune is an indie adventure game by Suits & Sandals. Explore the kingdom of Lunaire, finding weapons, upgrades and other collectables on your way. Fight against monsters deep underground and uncover the mysteries surrounding the disaster that struck the kingdom centuries ago.

title: SokoCode
description: Sokocode is a programming sokoban "Zach-Like" where you take on the role of an intern at the newest box-centered enterprise, BoxTopic.

title: Zonic 4 My New Life Turbo HD Remastered Edition
Heavy As Stone
description: Investigate a series of deaths on behalf of the Atsmith Life Insurance Co., uncovering the relationship between these cases and the cause of your mysterious illness. Adapt to your disease and survive Terminal's seedy underbelly as you face the consequences of your search for answers.

description: FPS where you are tasked by God to give souls to the wealthiest people on Earth, helping them get normal jobs and be productive members of society.

title: Glass Horizon
description: Experience the freedom of parkour in "Glass Horizon." Leap across rooftops, overcome obstacles, and explore a futuristic city. With fluid movements and thrilling challenges, your skills will be put to the test. Are you ready to conquer the horizon?

title: Werner Waffenwerke: Arms Tycoon
description: Take on the role of a weapons manufacturer and lead your company to fame and fortune. Develop weapons and sell what you can!

description: Play as a giant and build your ideal medieval city in this tiny city builder. Pick up villagers and command them to do your bidding while defending them from hoards of pillaging gnomes.

title: Sunchaser
description: Bring light back to the darkening town of Mallard by exploring its monster-infested outskirts, hearing its residents' stories, and defeating the dangerous pets of a mastermind light-stealer in this simple top-down adventure inspired by a love of exploring one's own neighborhood.

title: Mars Lives!!
description: This game is specially designed for parents and children to enjoy a shared gaming experience. It contains several mini-games that will captivate the whole family.

title: Wildermyth: Omenroad
description: Wildermyth's second DLC introduces a new game mode that includes roguelike ​​tactical challenges with progression across runs, as well as a rich new story campaign that takes your heroes into the mysterious Netherflare.

title: Benny the Blob
description: This is a tricky puzzle game with cute little blobs, sparkly gems, 50 levels, and the ability to load and create custom levels. Benny The Blob features some difficult and headache-inducing levels that will challenge even the most experienced puzzle fans.

title: Synthetic Soul: Onyx
description: Synthetic Soul: Onyx is an immersive futuristic life sim with an in-depth robot companion. Discover the future and restore the past.

title: Bot Beats
description: Unleash your inner coder, build epic robots, and conquer the arena. For beginners and computer scientists alike! Join Bot Beats today and embark on an educational adventure that transforms coding from a daunting task into an enjoyable, empowering skill.

title: Hero's Adventure: The Great Conquest
description: DLC "The Great Conquest" is based on Hero's Adventure: Road to Passion, focusing on sect management gameplay which is quite different from while not affecting the original game. If you are interested in a strategic game mode and are willing to treat our team a cup of coffee, please give it a try.

title: Biological Incident
description: Cases of disappearances have become more frequent in the small town. The tracks lead to an empty house on the outskirts of the city...

title: Kairos'Light: Vanilla
description: Yo! relive Kairos'Light Vanilla, our first project, only uglier and less fun! Chat with poorly-dialogued inhabitants, then return to the current version. New successes have been added, even if they're not guaranteed to work. Have a great adventure!

title: Lords & Villeins: The Great Houses
description: Expand Lords and Villeins beyond your settlement and live out the fantasy of building a Great House: purchase land titles, deploy families, engage in trade with your neighbors, and grow your wealth and influence through diplomacy or war. A new era of prosperity is here!

title: Pixel Gun 3D: Deadly Toys Set
description: The Deadly Toys Set DLC brings you a trio of playful yet potent plastic-themed weapons. Features: Plastic Overseer, Plastic Instigator, Plastic Storm.

title: Manipulus
description:
Manipulus is a thrilling deck-building, choose-your-own-adventure game with rogue-like mechanics and perma-death. Trapped by mysterious forces, you are made to relive your past, guiding a band of survivors through perilous times.

As a Manipuli general, form strategic defensive lines and manoeuvre your followers to activate wild abilities to defeat the oncoming monsters and lead your band to safety. Re-play your cards, re-live your actions, and fight to keep your refugees alive in this dark and captivating adventure.

It's time to FORM THE MANIPULUS!

title: Pixel Gun 3D: Wastelands Set
description: Prepare for the ultimate survival experience with the Wastelands Set DLC! In this set, you'll find: Wastelands Dual Anger, Wastelands Brutal Thinner, Wastelands Fatal Melter.

title: PAWG Runner: A NSFW Platformer
description: Race against the clock with epic anime babes, unlocking bold outfits and NSFW options. Take on tough levels and dive into hilarious mini-games. Think you can conquer the challenges and uncover all the secrets?

title: The Mobius: Apartment
description: In a eerie apartment, explore and discover anomalies, find the rules,seeking the correct Floor and Exit of The Mobius Apartment.

title: Memocratie
description: You are the leader of the Memocratic Party. Crowds of people have gathered under your office to protest. Give them money or drive them out, the choice is yours. Each choice will determine how long you stay in power.

title: Homeless Dog Motel
description: As the Homeless Dog slumbers, a nightmare creeps up to take over her night. Explore the depths of the loop her mind has trapped her in. The images that are conjured up are potentially tied to her past, allowing the player to learn more about the protagonist as they go on.

title: Forbidden Fantasy
description: Forbidden Fantasy is a choice-driven adult visual novel where you're the chosen one. Become the hero of prophecy, romance elven women, and save the world from the Demon Queen. Your quest will be filled with adventure, drama, and lots of sex.

title: TCG Multiplayer Card Shop Simulator
description: Multiplayer TCG Card Shop Simulator game. Dive into the world of multiplayer gaming by opening your own local game store! Stock your shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them open to collect the cards yourself.

title: Tri Breaker: A Sacred Symbols Odyssey
description: If Twin Breaker was a brick breaker about space, Tri Breaker is a brick breaker on steroids, and this go-around, it's all about time. Explore 40 stages spread across periods of galactic history, and obliterate the brick-breaking formula.

title: The Legend of Zelda: King of Thieves
Crimes Against Slimes
description:
Crimes Against Slimes is a game where you fight against the never-ending slime hordes, gain upgrades as you level up, and do whatever you can to survive as long as you can.

It is a survival game where all you can do is run away and shoot the enemies that constantly hunt you down. At first, the slime horde might seem unbeatable but the stronger you get the more you formidable an opponent you become!

title: Hentai Girls: Winky Witch
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Arida: Backland's Awakening - Definitive Edition
description: ARIDA: Backland's Awakening. A story of survival and adventure in the brazilian backlands. Face the drought to explore the more arid regions, gather resources and discover clues about the fate of the young Cícera.

title: Ball Rush 2
description: Smash a path to the finish!

title: Banana Clicker
description: Click. Upgrade. Conquer. Build a banana empire, unlock powerful upgrades, and uncover a wild banana-fueled conspiracy. Meet silly NPCs, test your luck in gacha, and unleash Banana Storms! With skills, achievements, and endless growth, the bananas never stop!

title: ATV Stunt Racing: Extreme Offroad Simulator
description: Extreme racing on dangerous tracks on powerful ATVs - set new records and take the top spot in the tournament table!

title: Axe Champ Shoot Out
description: Can you be the Axe Champ?

title: Car Mechanic Shop Simulator
description: Car Mechanic Shop Simulator is a simulation game that offers a comprehensive, in-depth experience combining strategic business management with the technical nuances of car maintenance, making it a must download for enthusiasts and novices alike.

title: Car Parking Legends: Drive & Park Adventure
description: The art of parking.

title: Caveheart: Legacy of The Depths
description: Embark on an Epic Quest Beneath the Surface!

title: Crimson Asylum
description: As a paranormal investigator fueled by curiosity and a thirst for the unknown, you've been dared to enter the abandoned halls of Crimson Asylum.

title: Dizzy Hero
description: Transform into a hero with your wobbly moves in this unique action game!

title: Drone World Tour: Flight Simulator
description: Take part in extreme drone racing and fly around the world in a new realistic drone simulator!

title: Catch Beshi!! Scooping Game
description: Beshi the frog, a famous character by Fujio Akatsuka, the king of Japanese gag manga of the Showa era, has been made into a game.

title: Arcane Rush
description: Arcane Rush is a digital card game developed by Gear Games. Immerse yourself in epic auto chess card battles, featuring a diverse array of heroes and creatures to collect, upgrade, and lead into battle. Build the ultimate team, summon powerful allies, and engage in strategic duels against players from all corners of the realm. With a unique blend of strategy, creativity, and dynamic gameplay, Arcane Rush delivers a novel experience for auto chess and CCG enjoyers.

title: Blue Night Laundromat
description: A short 2D exploration adventure in a retro style! Explore a laundromat in the middle of the night and try to clear it!

title: R.E.C
description: A Survival horror shooter blending first- and third-person combat. Engage in tactical firefights, manage scarce resources, and survive intense hybrid encounters as shifting perspectives and unique environments heighten tension and immersion.

title: Gordon Freakman
description: Gordon Freakman is a comedy-themed mod for Half-Life 2. It features abstract level design, custom sound effects and character models and a full story campaign.

title: Gordon Freakman 2: Kleiner-Life
description: Gordon Freakman 2: Kleiner-Life is the sequel to the 2016 Half-Life 2 mod Gordon Freakman, featuring the same comedic themes and meme culture influence.

title: Operatives: Revolve
description: A cinematic roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are physically activated "Machines". Enemies can strike, pierce, or bomb them to pieces. Install multiple components to modify your cards, and set off cascading chain reactions to destroy your enemies.

title: There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder
description:
In this single-player spy thriller interactive novel, secret agents Franklin Benjamin and Virginia West take on a madman named Zeus who threatens the world with a weather machine.

You may find yourself needing to de-escalate a hostage situation, investigating a crime scene, or even defusing a ticking time bomb - good thing you always bring the thunder, agent!

title: Kaamos
description: Kaamos is a bite-sized turn-based puzzle roguelike where battles are fought by matching tiles on a grid with looping rows and columns. Build your character and deck of tiles by looting equipment from your foes. Traverse a dark medieval world where the Sun went down and never rose again.

title: Survius
description:
Survius is an open world, multiplayer, zombie survival game.
Roam the deserted island and claim whatever you desire. Land, loot, friends or bodies, it's all yours for the taking.

Find and choose a playstyle that fits your preferences. Be a humble farmer, a ruthless bounty hunter, or anything in between.

Roam the open world map, exploring towns, hovels, mountains, and lakes.

Claim whatever land and loot you find.

Whether you find a place to call home, or call the whole island your home. The choice is yours.

You are not alone on this island, and it will be up to you to decide whether you help or hinder your fellow man.

Form clans and alliances. Or go another route, and spark conflict to come out on top.

Who will you trust? Who will to trust you? Many or few, it's your decision to make.

Zombies aren't the only threat here.

While some animals may be gentle or fear you, other are a far bigger threat than the undead.

Will you bring home a meal, or be the meal yourself?

title: The Righteous Scar
description: When blades fall silent, and blood tells its tale, a scar remains—a mark not of rage, but of absolution. In The Righteous Scar, violence becomes virtue, and what’s buried beneath the skin reveals a truth only the damned can see.

title: The Mirror's Curse
description:
The Mirror's Curse is a first-person puzzle solving mysterious action game. You’re trapped in a limbo — a twisted version of your own home.

To escape, you must solve intricate puzzles and evade spirits.

The mirrors are your greatest mystery and danger: while they reveal hidden clues, staring too long raises your curse level, triggering supernatural attacks.

title: 1000 Words
description: 1000 Words tells the story of a little girl whose family is falling apart. One day she meets an artist, and asks him to teach her how to draw better. He answers that she just has to train everyday, and a few years later she'll get better. But that's too slow to her; there's no time.

title: Don't Wake the Beast
description: In Don't Wake the Beast, a roguelite stealth game, you’ll sneak through ever-changing dungeons to steal precious treasures guarded by deadly beasts. Use your trusty grappling hook to evade traps, outsmart enemies, and solve puzzles. But beware—each treasure you claim makes escaping more dangerous!

title: Kathy Rain 2: Soothsayer
description: In this point-and-click urban thriller, down-and-out private eye Kathy Rain will embark on her most dangerous case yet — the pursuit of the notorious serial killer known as the Soothsayer. Find clues, gather evidence, connect the dots, and confront the murderer before the hunter becomes the hunted…

title: Outworld Station
description: Take the helm as a new Station Commander and exploit an alien star system in this stunning space-station factory automation game. Amass resources and construct starships using increasingly advanced manufacturing and expand your station in a hostile universe!

title: Hobnobbers
description: Pillage the mall with your friends, fight murderous Pixys, and worship a divorcée Lady Goddess.

title: Void Dungeon
description: Void Dungeon brings you a 2D Action RPG with intense hack & slash combat, deep character options, and unyielding enemies, which you can face solo or with up to 4 friends. Oh, and quirky costumes. Because it’s better to look good when the void consumes you.

title: Doors of Insanity: ReOpened
description: Gear up, sling cards, and power through the endless doors of Purgatory in this demo for Doors of Insanity: ReOpened!

title: Neon Inferno
description: NYC 2055: a city beyond salvation. Blast your way through this dense cyberpunk jungle in NEON INFERNO, an explosive fusion of 2D run-and-gun and gallery-shooter, and help the Family dominate its streets!

title: Spray Paint Simulator
description: Sit back, relax and express your creative side in the colorful world of Spray Paint Simulator. Enter the town of Spatterville, meet the locals while you restore, repair, mask and spray paint everything from a kitchen to local landmarks. Buy new equipment, unlock Free Spray and transform the town.

title: Into the Fire
description: Race an exploding volcano in this high-risk extraction survival. Rescue survivors, manage scarce resources, survive fire anomalies, and carve escape routes through ash and lava. Bring them back alive, before the island buries you.

title: Furry Woof
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Furry Sex
description: Furry Sex - is a classic 2D game in the memory genre which is about you find the same pictures and enjoy different images of furry beautiful ladies.

title: Empire Builder: Europe
description: Empire Builder train board games brought to the digital world. Starting with Empire Builder - Europe as the base game, we will release each of the games in this series for all to enjoy.

title: Furry Sex 2
description: Furry Sex 2 - is a classic 2D game in the memory genre which is about you find the same pictures and enjoy different images of furry beautiful ladies.

title: Soul Armors Recollect
description: Soul Armors Recollect is a single player RPG about a journey of recollection. Smash up your enemies with various weapons and skills. Explore and collect equipment and items as you try to remember why you're left with only your armor.

title: Sex Education
description: Sex Education Embark on an exciting journey by matching positions using the handles. Unlock satisfying results through quick time events, and progress to unlock unique skins and styles. Enjoy diverse adventures in various locations!

title: The Ark Adult Game
description: The Ark Adult Game is an immersive action-adventure title set in a futuristic universe. Explore, collect, and preserve various races and species as you navigate through perilous encounters.

title: Hentai World Sexy
description: Hentai World Sexy is a soothing puzzle game featuring several unique and alluring girls. The gameplay involves solving jigsaw puzzles by moving pieces to recreate the original picture.

title: Cellyon: Boss Maker
description: Cellyon: Boss Maker gives you the possibility to invent from A to Z the class which the players will use for your fight.

title: Gambit Shifter: Surrealm
description: Surrealm is a DLC for Gambit Shifter, providing a whole new set of levels that will challenge both your skill and creativity.

title: Sker Ritual: Skerville Slasher
description: Run and Hide! It's the Skerville Slasher, featuring a new mask alongside a Premium menu background and more!

title: Where is the Tutorial
description: Where is the Tutorial is a game where the biggest challenge is simply figuring out how to play. Dropped into a whimsical world with no instructions, no hints, and no mercy, you're left to navigate a series of increasingly bizarre levels using only your wits and a growing sense of frustration.

title: Creepy Waves FM: Bugs Fixer
description: A young and promising boy applies for a job at a AAA game development company. As he starts working night shifts on probation, he experiences a series of events that could lead to no good. As the story unfolds, you will be able to choose what you would do in his place.

title: AI Solitaire: 4th of July
description: AI Solitaire - 4th of July provides 3 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around beautiful girls in a patriotic style.

title: Melancholic Dreamtower
description:
"You're the new hero."

Ichiya Shinozaki opened his eyes in a strange darkness
to the words of a stranger.

"There's a princess trapped in the highest room of this tower. I need you to get her out of this place."

It felt like the premise of some RPG.
Ichiya was full of questions, but the stranger's way seemed the only way.
If he wanted to get out of here, he would have to save the princess.

Ichiya wasn't alone in his upward journey.
On the first floor was a man rendered deaf and mute.
On the second floor, a blinded man.
On the third floor, a man who coveted color.
On the fourth floor, a young girl who was terrified of men.

He undertook his so-called quest.
For the sake of the princess, for his own sake, in defiance of destiny,
steeped in the interests of five cohabitants.

5 potential suicides. 5 candidates for death.

In the overwhelming gloom of a dark pagoda.

title: Killer Klowns From Outer Space: Infernal Tracker - Slappy
description: As a Dark Jester, more than just laughter is needed to satisfy this Klown. Nothing is more funny to Slappy than the sounds of humans fleeing in terror. Slappy is a special character skin for the Tracker Klown Type and is only cosmetic.

title: Killer Klowns From Outer Space: Infernal Hunter - Zombo
description: Bearing scars and "leftovers" from a previous invasion attempt long ago, Zombo returns with a vengeance to consume any human that crosses his path! Zombo is a special character skin for the Hunter Klown Type and is only cosmetic.

title: Killer Klowns From Outer Space: Infernal Tank - Gutso
description: Never satiated, Gutso has been hunting and consuming humans for many many ages. Driven by this hunger, genetic evolutions have taken this Klown to new levels of Konsumption. Gutso is a special character skin for the Tank Klown Type and is only cosmetic.

title: Killer Klowns From Outer Space: Infernal Brawler - Impy
description: A devilish little imp with a knack for killing. Don't let the tail fool you, Impy is light on his feet and ready to strike fear into the hearts of those frightful human snacks. Impy is a special character skin for the Brawler Klown Type and is only cosmetic.

title: Killer Klowns From Outer Space: Fatso
description: The beloved, rotund brother of Chubby, Fatso makes short work of invasions so he can get back to feasting on human delicacies. Fatso is a special character skin for the Tank Klown Type and is only cosmetic.

title: HenPri
