description: Traverse a brand new chapter like never before. New weapons to master, mystical energy to control, powerful demons to slay. Become a Ronin in Chapter 6!

title: Kirby's Dreamland Collision
description: Worlds Collide! Dark Matter is back and stronger than ever! This time he is packing a new skill that lets him merge realities to gather new support for his anti-Kirby cause! Meet crazy foes, get wild copy abilities, and save dreamland in this unconventional platformer!

title: Kirby's Air Raid
description: Retro Kirby style with all new gameplay. Prepare for an all new, full legnth Kirby adventure like no other! Don't like the cute look fool you, this game will test your speed & reaction to their limit!

title: World of Jade Dynasty
description: "World of Jade Dynasty" (Zhu Xian World) is a fairy-themed online game developed by Perfect World Games. It was launched for public beta on December 19, 2024. The game is developed using the UE5 engine, using various technologies such as physical rasterization and ray tracing rendering, dynamic shadow options, screen space and true 3D reflection.

title: KWRPGIII
description: It's the third entry in the KWRPG series, and your evil doppelgänger is up to no good! He's built a whole army of doppelgängers out of all your friends, and schemes against you in a faraway land where wishes are granted.

title: Winterfest
description: Winterfest is a German educational game aimed to help adults improve their reading, writing and mathematical skills.

title: BubbleBeast DigiDungeon
description: Pop bubbles, fight monsters, and keep rocking to the beat. Get into the flow with unique puzzle-rhythm mechanics across 5 vibrant levels. Match colored bubbles, defuse the Beasts’ attacks, and don't let that combo meter break.

title: Scaling Up
description: Become the owner of a snake ranch! As a small dragon, raise your ranch from the ground up. Gather and manage resources, build various facilities to house your snakes, make sure they are cared for to keep them happy, and collect their beautiful scales, to forge stronger equipment and scale up!

title: Paranormal Snap Shot
description: A psychological horror game set in a Japanese school. Trapped in an endless looping building, can you find your way out by photographing all of the anomalies?

title: Cerulean Tears
description: A vanilla style map map made by FifthElephant and will take 5-10 minutes to complete.

title: Hidden Cursed Crypt
description: The slip gate takes Ranger to what looks to be a guarded crypt in the side of a mountain. He's not keen to find out what is going on and would rather get out of there. Unfortunately, the exit is locked behind a gold key out of reach.

title: Castle Evalon
description: The thought to be abandoned mysterious Castle Evalon has recently been emitting strange lights and sounds. The most concerning being rumbles from deep underground. Ranger steps through the front doors, only to have them shut tight behind him. Donning his trusty boomstick, he has no choice but to push through.

title: Lucas y el Caso del Cuadro Robado
Ogora
description: Ogora is a fantasy roguelike deck-builder where you will craft powerful decks, cast unwieldy spells, and blow up your own path through a procedurally generated dungeon. Adorn yourself with hidden trinkets and try to survive!

title: Deserter
description: In this stealth RPG, you play as a deserter who is forced to become a thief in a grim, war-torn town. You'll have access to a rich arsenal of tools and devices: from lock picks and crowbars to grappling hooks and dynamite. Additionally, take advantage of your surroundings: find or create alternate routes, stick to the shadows, stay quiet, or use loud noises to cause distraction.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed - Deluxe Edition
description:
Embark on an pizza-fueled journey with Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello and Michelangelo to battle an all-new wave of havoc-wreaking mutants as you join forces with familiar faces in thrilling missions across the streets of NYC!
The Deluxe Edition features exclusive TMNT themed collectibles that pay homage to your favourite heroes in a half shell, including an awesome Steelbook and a radical artbook which tells the story behind Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed! Beyond the physical game, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed – Deluxe Edition includes the following exclusive items: · Steelbook
· 4 Pin Badges resembling the belt buckles of each of the 4 Turtles.
· 4 Keychains resembling the weapons of each of the 4 Turtles.
· Softcover Artbook.
· All contents packaged inside a collectible tuck-in box.

title: Little Nightmares II: Enhanced Edition
description:
Little Nightmares II: Enhanced Edition is a puzzle-platformer horror adventure where you play as Mono, navigating the distorted Pale City with Six to uncover the secrets of the Signal Tower. Solve environmental puzzles, evade terrifying creatures, and escape the dark world that has been warped by an ominous signal.
The Enhanced Edition features ray-traced graphics, improved shadows, immersive 3D audio, and 4K resolution with options for 30 FPS or 60 FPS performance.

title: The Protocol Directive
description:
Dive into the dark world of The Protocol Directive, a unique text-based adventure that blends retro charm with modern suspense. As a nameless protagonist, you begin in an ordinary office, but what seems like a normal day quickly turns into a nightmare full of decisions, secrets, and deadly challenges.

After leaving the office, you suddenly find yourself in a dark room. A light flickers on, illuminating a table with an old keyboard. Shortly after, a PC screen comes to life, and a strange force the possessed Protocol begins testing you. Every decision you make can mean the difference between life and death. Find useful (or deceptive) items, solve tricky dilemmas, and try to escape the game alive.

But nothing is as it seems. The deeper you venture into the world of the Protocol, the more reality and dream begin to blur. Is this just a cruel experiment, or are you trapped in a nightmare? Can you unravel the truth before it’s too late?

Are you ready to face the ultimate test? Choose wisely your fate is in your hands.

title: Super Monkey Ball: Banana Mania - Launch Edition
The War of the Worlds: Siberia
description:
The year is 1896. The Martian invasion wipes cities and entire civilizations out of existence. Separated from his loved ones, a young student escapes the capital city already conquered by the aliens.
Along with the player, he will have to survive in the distinctive and dangerous Siberia, stand against the forces of the old world, and inevitably confront its new masters.

title: N-Ice Cover
description: N-Ice Cover is a 3D platformer/puzzle game that lets you play as Icy, a cute little ice cube whose goal is to cool down drinks they find there and there. To reach their objective, they'll have to overtake obstacles by placing their unpossessed body as a platform. Will you get your cocktail on this hot summer day?

title: Electro Air Hockey: Under the Mallet
Scorched Warfare
description: This is a strategy action game set in a fictional fantasy world. You play as a warmaster, commanding troops in battles. Use the roguelike system to customize your gameplay style: will you be a one-man army, standing against thousands, or a mastermind tactician controlling the battlefield?

title: Kanji de Go!
description: Kanji de GO! is a free game developed by Micelle, on PC in 2023. Type the reading of the displayed kanji(Chinese character) within the time limit. There are several other modes of entering calculation results and English spelling.

title: DCS World: Normandy 2.0
description: DCS: Normandy 2.0 includes large parts of the territory of France and Great Britain, including the capitals of these countries - Paris and London. The map also reproduces in detail the largest cities in this region - English Eastbourne, Brighton, Worthing, Portsmouth and French Caen, Le Havre, Rouen, Amiens and Calais. The coast on both sides of the English Channel, including sea and river ports, has been recreated in detail. The size of the map is 400/600 kilometers.

title: KWRPG
description: Kirby Warrior's Role Playing Game was the first fan-made RPG in the online Kirby fandom.

title: KWRPGII
description: Kirby Warrior’s RPG II was the much-anticipated sequel to the original, released on KRR to much fanfare in the early aughts, featuring over 12 playable characters. It was made in RPG Maker 2000.

title: Ambroise Niflette & the Gleaned Bell
description: In this stop-motion inspired adventure, play as detective Ambroise Niflette in the thrilling investigation of the search for the stolen bell in a mysterious village.

title: Tiffy's Magical Tales: Pinocchio
description: Children can learn decision making skills as they help Pinocchio in this animated storybook which can be viewed in English, French, German or Russian. It includes 17 scenes, each displayed in full screen animation. Children can interact with the storyline, helping Pinocchio find money to buy Geppeto a vest, communicating with characters and even choosing how the action will develop. Pinocchio improves observation, listening, comprehension and problem solving skills.

title: Limb Chopper
description: Limb Chopper is a third-person PS1 style survival slasher horror/shooter set in the underbelly of Los Angeles in the 1980s. You are Detective Palmer, a loose cannon who doesn't play by the rules. You're on a mission to hunt down and apprehend a hulking masked killer before he butchers more innocent citizens.

title: Final Response
description:
Final Response is an ultra brutal shooter dedicated to players who enjoy gore and visceral combat.

This game is build on Leaden Sky Update 4 engine - the goriest version of LS Demo before it began to focus on other aspects.

Final Response is a game with extremely advanced gore system and basic gameplay elements, but it does include some interessting things like stealth, dynamic lighting, day and night cycle and rain effects.

The game is very brutal, it features many gory mechanics such as surface based wound system, many amputation points for dismemberment, detailed blood spilling, permanent mess, prolonged death animations affected by physics and many more.

The game is made to be dark and edgy, but that's a part of it's charm.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Shadow Mirror
The Legend of Zelda: The Hylian Frontier
The Legend of Zelda: Guardians of Hyrule
Super Mario the Nightshift
description: Super Mario the Nightshift is a fangame made in Game Maker that has a halloween feel to it. Fight Goombas and Koopas and massive bosses to save the princess yet again from the evil forces of Bowser. This game was inspired by Super Mario Blue Twilight DX.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening Coop
Akupara Collection
description: The Akupara Collection by Super Rare Games is a limited edition, fully assembled physical release for the Nintendo Switch, featuring three acclaimed indie titles: Relic Hunters Zero, Whispering Willows, and Kardboard Kings. This collectible package includes a cartridge with all three games, vibrant interior artwork, a full-color manual, an exclusive sticker, and a 3-card trading card pack.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Hylian Phoenix
Ero Mission
description: Adult visual novel about trans woman Samus retiring from bounty hunting. She takes time off to focus on her mental health and adjust her bird hormones, and she has a few sexy rendezvous with familiar space pirates along the way.

title: Poradora vs. Monsters of the World
description: Poradora vs. Monsters of the World is a 2.5D action-adventure platformer where you travel across the coolest places on earth to defeat all the monsters and find all the mythological secret there! Now let's jump, shoot, slide, and defeat all the monsters! LET'S GO!

title: Blue Revolver: Double Action
description:
After a long time in development and a fruitful public beta, Blue Revolver: Double Action is now available for all players. Go forth and flourish!

Double Action is a large, free update to our game. We wanted to give players the best possible version of the game. There's rebalancing, new weapons, new content, a ton of new features and options -- including a super-smooth 120Hz mode!

title: That's My Exploit Keeper!
description:
Exploit Keeper is a puzzle game, where you have to change the version of the game between the well developed one and the poorly developed one, to find the game bugs and exploit them to be able to continue the plot.
Badly programmed mechanics might be useful if used in the right place...

Between features that work poorly, repeating events and unindexed values, you will find every kind of nightmarish bug for beta testers!

title: Snow Way Home
description: A collection of 9 maps by the Waffle House Team that capture the essence of this magical time of year that feature falling snow and slippery ice. ﻿

title: Chilling Reign
description: A wintery episode for heretic and narratively is a direct sequel to Lost and Forgotten.

title: Justine et la Pierre de Feu
description:
Justine et la Pierre de Feu is a point-and-click adventure game for 7-10 year-olds.

In the middle of the ocean there was once a small island where Justine and many other mice lived. This rocky islet was their only treasure. It sheltered them, fed them and protected them every day and every night. In winter, the mice stayed warm in the depths of their shelter.

One morning, hungry Justine went out in search of food. From a distance, she spotted a shiny spot at the bottom of a crevice, a small stone shimmering with a thousand lights. Justine immediately picked it up. When she returned to the village with her stone, all the mice ran to her and bombarded Justine with questions, because they all wanted nothing more than to possess such a treasure!

Your mission in this adventure is to help Justine and her friends find other shiny stones, or ‘fire stones’. Each mouse needs one!

title: Ghoulie's Garden
description: Welcome to Ghoulie’s Garden, where Halloween magic awaits!

title: Jumping Ninja
description: Awaken the true warrior within!

title: Learn Basic Kanji!!
description: A Kanji learning game which teaches you 80 basic Kanji.

title: Wolf Sim: Animal Battle Survival RPG
Rivenaar's Grove
description: Harvest ingredients for potions to prove your worth as the apprentice of a skilled magician!

title: Match 'Em
description:
Match 'Em is an action/puzzle game all about the beauty of geometric shape-shifting. Transform your avatar in one of 4 shapes, and color it in one of 4 tints to match the symbols and colors of the obstacles coming towards you and reach the end of the level!

And guess what? You'll get 4 different game modes that each offer a unique take on the concept, a level editor to make and share your very own creations with the rest of the community, and a bunch of granular options to customise the gameplay to your liking :)

title: Shokudo Underworld
description: Run your own sushi shokudo in a mysterious underworld. Satisfy the appetite of your customers, collect suspicious ingredients from bizarre fantastical creatures, and realize your dream of creating ... the legendary Chawanmushi!

title: No Robots Allowed
description:
You’re at the doors of PARADISE…
…but it seems that the security protocol doesn’t trust you.

Can you prove you’re not a robot?

title: Harpy's Ascent
description: Soar and struggle to the top in Harpy's Ascent. A simple, brutally challenging platformer testing your precision.

title: Bardia
description:
Bardia is a story of gallantry, courage and historical facts based on Alexander of Macedon’s attack on Iran, the circumstances around the Achaemenid Persian Empire and the sacrifice and resistance of Aryobarzan and the brave soldiers of Iran. Through action-adventure gameplay, the story unfolds itself.

Bardia, an adventurous puzzle game, appeals to both domestic and international audiences. Bardia, familiarizes Iranians with historical figures and segments from their history. For the international audience, it shows the battle that really took place between Alexander of Macedon and Aryobarzan, contrary to what the film 300 depicted.

Bardia is based on historical documents and readings of sections of the Achaemenid period; and for the first time, all of Persepolis, Iran’s most historic site, has been built and put to display in a computer game.

A 3D graphic game, Bardia pays special attention to the architecture and clothing during the time of the Achaemenids: Particular attention has been given to the type of clothing military personal wore during this time.

title: The Pocket Master
description:
As the Pocket Master, you job is to help people in need.

Use your magical pocket to change objects size and please everyone!

Pocket everything! Objects, people, entire rooms... The pocket world has no limit.

title: Grow to Perfection
description: The perfect scale

title: Smoots Summer Games II
description: Compete with up to 4 players in Smoots Summer Games II, the cartoon-styled arcade sequel. Enjoy classic and new events like the 100m dash, swimming, cycling, archery, and more. Master game modes including Practice, Championship, Special Challenge, and Battle Royale.

title: Just Grill the Steak!
description: This is a game for anyone who just wants to grill a steak. That’s it. You grill steaks. We’ve really focused on getting that jiggly meat texture just right.

title: Super Waifu Ball
description: Get ready for a gravity-defying, action-packed adventure in Super Waifu Ball, an arcade-style game where you roll through vibrant, obstacle-filled worlds as you control a cast of lovable waifus. Master each level, collect stars, and navigate through increasingly tricky courses to unlock exciting rewards and surprises!

title: I Crave The Wind's Bite
description: A television tries to break the language barrier.

title: Candivity
description:
Don't let the sweets get outside the dome. Merge them together, and make the biggest candy!
You're about to dive into a sugary adventure! Combine sweets, and prepare yourself for a sugar overload!

Gather extraordinary powers that can save you from any sticky situation. Mix them up, and you might create something even more powerful!

Journey through worlds full of surprises. Each has its own set of challenges. Can you master them all and merge the largest sweet?

title: Urbex Murder
description: Urbex Murder is a cooperative horror game where you explore abandoned places alone or with friends. Solve puzzles, confront events, and uncover hidden secrets. Each map offers unique scenarios for an immersive and terrifying experience.

title: Dark Trip
description:
Dark Trip is a psychedelic VR escape room where the hero is forced to use drugs investigating a sadomasochistic lab.

The game of Escape Room genre features Lavcraftian setting, Psychedelic Trips gameplay mechanics and the goals to collect and investigate evidences. Some event in the game are inspired by David Lynch's and Terry Gilliam's movies.

- Experiences Psychedelic Trips. Use VR to immerse yourself into psychedelic experiences not possible on any other gaming platform.

- Investigate the Sadomasochistic Laboratory. Solve twisted riddles in surrealistic setting of physical and mental torture.

title: UOGamers
description:
UOGamers is a unique flavor of Ultima Online brought to you by UOGamers and the developers of RunUO. It is a mix of classical and modern Ultima Online, based on the game in its PvP glory days. The shard features only the Felucca facet, where combat is unrestricted in most parts of Britannia. Additionally, factions, guild wars, the dueling system and regular tournaments held by staff.

Custom dungeons and special monsters throughout the world provide a challenging PvE experience. Customized housing is also available to provide for creative players who wish to build their own place in the world. If crafting is more your thing, then you will enjoy the all-custom, balanced, bulk order reward system, offering power scrolls to further enhance your skills.

UOGamers is backed up by a massive community ready to help and make your game experience better.

Features of Hybrid:

Skill cap of 700
Stats cap of 225
Fast skill gain
Felucca only
Factions, Hero/Evil system, Order/Chaos
Dueling system
Poker
New guild system
Customizable houses
Greater dungeon monsters
Paragons (Mobs of the Month)
Extensive rare item economy
Active in-game staff
Rift System
Regular PvP-themed events

We hope you enjoy your stay here, and thanks for considering UOGamers for your best in class gaming experience.

The game is remade from the ground up, ensuring compatibility + smooth peformance with modern machines and allowing for additional features such as tweaks to the game's style [visually and gameplay wise] as well as extra saving features that can make it more acessible to players.

Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver Remastered is a remastered version of the 1999 action-adventure game. Set 1,500 years after Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain, it follows Raziel, a vampire lieutenant executed by his master Kain and resurrected by the Elder God as a wraith. Raziel travels across Nosgoth seeking revenge against Kain and his former vampire brethren.

Gameplay combines combat, exploration, platforming, and environmental puzzles, with Raziel able to shift between the Material and Spectral Realms, devour souls, and wield the spectral Wraith Blade. The remaster adds updated graphics, camera and control options, navigation features, and the ability to switch to the original visuals.

title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2 Remastered
description:
Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2 Remastered is a remastered version of the 2001 sequel to Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver. Raziel continues his pursuit of Kain through different periods of Nosgoth's history, gradually uncovering information about his own past and destiny, the corruption of the Pillars, and the history of the conflict between humans and vampires.

Gameplay combines combat, exploration, environmental puzzles, and shifting between the Material and Spectral Realms. Raziel can acquire new abilities and enhancements for the Soul Reaver to access previously unreachable areas. The remaster adds updated graphics, camera and control options, navigation features, and the ability to switch to the original visuals.

LaserReimu is a vertically scrolling shooter developed by voidProc, where the player controls Reimu Hakurei in her journey to restore Marisa's magic tool.

Reimu has two primary weapons: a three-way ofuda shot that spreads all over the screen, and secondary laser, where both can be executed at once or separately in two different formations: focused or unfocused.

The game also provides 55 achievements which can be unlocked when the player fulfills certain conditions.

title: Ember's Verge
description: Bushcraft and survive on a deserted island where nature is both your greatest ally and fiercest adversary. As the weather turns colder toward winter, preparation becomes key to survival. Build shelters, hunt, fish, farm, and craft items from natural resources—all without any modern tools.

title: Galactic Loader
description: Galactic Loader is an action-platformer about a space loader who is forgotten on a hostile alien planet which is abandoned by people. The game has various power-ups, big bosses and many monsters that the player needs to defeat. On his journey, the hero finds leftover equipment that provides new abilities for the player. Fight through hordes of alien, giant monsters and escape the planet!

title: Expedition to the Backrooms
description: You are the exploration team from company Async, you arrive to reported anomaly place and searching for anomalies, but what would you find? Prepare yourself for a gripping and heart-pounding adventure in EXPEDITION TO THE BACKROOMS, where every step could be your last.

title: Hell Dive
description: A first-person horror game where you play as Daniel, a Maritime Operative trapped alone aboard a submarine. Sent to investigate an abandoned deep-sea colony, you uncover dark secrets as terrifying horrors await in its depths.

title: Chicken Hill
description: Find 250 Genjouin of various species and hundreds of items for brother KUN. Rescue your frustrated and devastated brother KUN in the KUN space. We are the most devout believers.

title: RX10-40
description: 『RX10-40』(RX ten forty) is a third-person shooter. Ricocheting Bullets, Shields, and Baton stun guns. An antithesis to an ever-accelerating world.

title: Panzer Strike
description: Authentic RTS gameplay straight out of the 2000s. Command your troops, develop strategies, and win World War II battles. Huge maps, thousands of units, long-range firepower, and no building mechanics!

title: Chi Project
description: Sci-fi fantasy visual novel that combines a turn-based combat system with murder investigation elements.

title: Furball Farm
description: Welcome to Furball Farm. The current version only has the orchard map and a small amount of white noise, the remaining white noise will be fixed in the next update. The garden map and food map will be presented in the big update next year, all the updates are free, no purchase, stay tuned.

title: Red Spider Anecdote: The Longest Nite
description: The latest in the “Red Spider” series of Hong Kong noir visual novel with full japanese voice acting, “Red Spider Anecdote: The Longest Nite” is now available with all-new graphics. The hard-boiled story of two female protagonists is set in Thailand in 2009. Play time: 2-4 hours

title: Farm Invaders
description: Top down stealth based puzzle game about an alien stealing cows from a farm. Use futuristic gadgets and stay in the shadows to avoid detection. Get all golds in every level to appease the queen and bring honor to your colony!

title: Septic
description: Septic is a gripping precision platformer where you navigate an underground sewer, mastering challenging jumps and dealing with significant setbacks. Test your skills and perseverance in this intense escape adventure.

title: Biohazard: Siberia
description: Trapped in a secret research facility, you discover a terrifying truth- everything was a simulation… until now. Escape mutated horrors, uncover dark experiments, and decide your fate in this mind-bending, atmospheric survival horror.

title: ShapeScale
description: Scale shapes to match the target size

title: Carl's Alien Shooting
description: A skirmish with bizarre alien races in space! A massive tide of enemies will surge towards you! You need to choose your own build from various equipment and weapons! 20 Stages! When rogue game meets 2D vertical bullet hell shooting, experience the clash of classic and modern!

title: Comix Zero
description: Become a wise-cracking immortal fighting an evil regime in world’s first “COMIXVANIA”. Every page could be your last. Every death wipes a piece of your memory. A unique mix of genres: beat ‘em up/metroidvania/roguelike based on comics which we call “COMIXVANIA”. Welcome to Comix Zero.

title: Wolf Souls: Arena
description: Fight monsters in the colloseum. After each round upgrade your ablilities or wepon and prepare for other vawe of enemies. This DLC is new game mode into Wolf Souls game.

title: Ninja Numpties
description: Boobytrap a mini Chess board in this turn-based party game for 2 - 4 players!Works on Steam Deck!Only ~40Mb!

title: Ringer
description: The marble roguelike. Ringer reinvents the classic game of marbles with a deckbuilding twist. Discover game breaking synergies, defeat menacing bosses, and accumulate an ever increasing score in this thrilling roguelike

title: Pebbles Quest
description: The Princess has been kidnapped by evildoers! It is now Pebbles Quest to breach the Castle, face a gauntlet of traps and trials, all to rescue his one true love.

title: Blast-a-Bug!
description: Giant Bugs have invaded our planet and as a soldier it is your duty to help Corporal get rid of them ! Hop into your specially designed ball engine and crush them while trying to preserve citizens integrity !

title: Vagnerun
description: Vagnerun: Race, fight, and upgrade your ship to win thrilling races filled with obstacles and danger!

title: Super Ricko’s Islands
description: A FREE 3D platformer-collectathon with dynamic movement controls. Explore different worlds as you master the controls to perform different movement combos and collect all the cores and coins!

title: The Duchess Curse
description: As a security guard tasked with a simple job in a long-abandoned mansion, you quickly find yourself trapped within its haunted walls. Dark secrets unravel as you uncover the tragic tale of the Duchess, who, in a desperate attempt to resurrect her daughter, summoned something far more sinister.

title: Only a Billion?!
description: Congratulations, you won a billion dollars! Now it's time to find a way to spend it. It might prove more difficult than it sounds.

title: Stick Tongue
description: Hello, I'm Frogus! Humans have ruined the Earth and depleted its resources. My plan? Climb to heaven with my tongue and ask God to make it rain!

Sneak, climb or distract guards to move further unnoticed. Solve light puzzles alongside your path to rescue your loved one.

description:

Unveil the deepest secrets with the Blasphemous 2 Mea Culpa Edition, combining the base game and Mea Culpa Expansion.

This exciting expansion allows you to delve into deeper romantic stories with four beloved characters: Logan, Fang, Nia and Mi-an. Immerse yourself in captivating new storylines and romantic chronicles, all brought to life with emotionally rich voice interactions. Discover these unique quests, making your romantic journey even more vibrant and colorful!

title: WorldNeverland: Elnea Kingdom - Fluffy Brown-Rabbit Suit
Land of Mushrooms: Co-Op mode - Play with Friends
Atari Recharged: Volume Two
description: Atari Recharged: Volume Two is a digital arcade compilation game published by Atari for the Nintendo Switch. The series completely modernizes old-school gaming loops by introducing neon-infused vector-style visuals, smooth twin-stick controls, power-ups, global online leaderboards, and structured challenge modes.

title: My First Gran Turismo
description:
My First Gran Turismo is a free-to-play, beginner-friendly introduction to the world of racing, crafted to bring the excitement of Gran Turismo to new players. Whether you’re a parent introducing your family to racing or a longtime fan revisiting the series, My First GT captures the essence of those unforgettable first laps in a streamlined, approachable experience.

In My First Gran Turismo, players can unlock achievements by completing a variety of fun and engaging challenges that introduce essential racing techniques, such as cornering, braking, and acceleration. As you progress at each level, you will encounter increasingly intricate tracks and vehicles, each designed to build confidence and refine your driving skills, from basic to more advanced techniques, all in pursuit of mastering the craft of racing.

-Find your Line as you unlock various achievements and set record times across an array of challenges, including three Race Events, Time Trials and License Tests.

-Feel the exhilaration of driving 18 unique cars through a variety of scenarios that sharpen your racing craft on three iconic Gran Turismo circuits: Kyoto Driving Park, Deep Forest Raceway, and Trial Mountain Circuit.

title: Penguin Hotel
description: Game in a series of horror, action, story, and mystery-solving elements set in the Penguin Hotel, celebrating its 18th anniversary.

title: Streamer Mini Games Collection
description: This game allows the streamer's chat members to participate and interact with the game using chat commands. Mini games can be used as community games, during the streamer's breaks or used to participate in the streamer's raffles.

title: Minecraft: The Garden Awakens
description: This eerie new update to Minecraft: Java Edition adds the Pale Garden, the Creaking, and the new Resin block.

title: Tetris Dotbas
description: Another Tetris version made with Locomotive Basic for the Amstrad CPC computers. One or two players supported.

title: 3D Morpion
description:
A Connect 4 in 3 dimensions but without the effect of gravity.
In a four-story cube, "align yourself" against the malice of your machine.
In a four-level cube, try to align four pawns along the diagonals, vertical and horizontal.

title: Newsun
description:
Newsun is a short Disco Elysium inspired project for a Programming Languages college course Final Project.

The nameless amnesiac Protagonist experiences a day Newsun Hotel, a weirdly familiar 5-story establishment.

title: Nedy's Adventure: The Curse of Vera Deluxe
description: The Carbon captain has kidnapped you to have someone to resolve the cursed island mistery, she makes you jump from the airplane with your parachute, and then you must guide Nedy to escape from the island. You'll get into trouble and it won't be easy to escape...

title: Poké Floats: Melee
description: Stage mod for Super Smash Bros. Ultimate.

title: Pokemon Find The Alphabets
description: Use your mouse to interact and find all the hidden letters of the alphabet. Be careful, you have to help Pikachu and his friends before the time runs out, so have to work fast, and you have to be precise, each wrong click costs you points.

title: Tic Tactic
description: Long ago, the feathered nations lived in harmony. But, nothing lasts forever. Avenge the ducks in this deckbuilding roguelike take on tic-tac-toe. Collect tiles, engage in strategic battles, meet quirky characters, and explore diverse environments as you push ever closer to the chicken stronghold.

title: Restaurant Owner: A Restaurant Simulator
description: Step into the world of a Restaurateur in Restaurant Owner: Prologue, where you create unique recipes, manage your restaurant, and satisfy customers. Unlock ingredients, design your menu, and start your journey toward becoming a top Restaurant Manager. Your culinary adventure begins here!

title: Aris Arcanum
description: Clyde Colergrave is a Librarian, laboring away in the Aris Archives. Bound by his Knowledge, he is trapped with the festering Ink among the occult stacks of Aris. A unique Victorian roguelite awaits, where a desperate scholar uses Atramancy, the Magic of Ink, to spellcraft his way to salvation...

title: Halo: Combat Evolved VR
description: A virtual reality conversion mod for the original PC version of Halo: Combat Evolved.

title: Sparta Anthology
description: The Sparta Anthology is a collection that includes the games Ancient Wars: Sparta and Age of Alexander.

title: PowerWash Simulator: Ice Rink - Winter 2024
description: Put all your plans on ice, this is no rinky-dink clean up. With the grand reopening of the Ice Rink just around the corner, and the place nothing short of a glacial grime-fest, you’re the power washer wielding hero Muckingham needs this holiday season.

title: Nighthold
description: Build shelters, interact with rescuees, battle against the Rot and raiders to survive another night in this Sandbox RPG. Play Solo or team up with friends in Online Сo-op.

title: Craftlings
description: Inspired by legendary classics from the ’90s, Craftlings will take you on a journey full of strategic decisions and test your skills in optimizing automated production chains and Craftlings’ paths. Gather, deliver, build, and fight for wealth and glory in the unique, nostalgic world of Craftlings.

title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
description: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown
description: Splinter and Shredder are dead. Help the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles tackle deadly new threats and the approach of adulthood in this fast-paced turn-based beat-em-up.

title: Sol Mates
description:
As a Solar God, your immortal task is to cleanse the souls of the departed, combine them into a purified entity, and send them off to reincarnate on native planets.

"Sol Mates" is the first official entry into the "Legends of Saviors" series, a collection of different games centered around the same lore, locations, characters, and life systems of an entire gaming universe.

title: Starlight Re:Volver
description: Dive into vibrant dream worlds, where every adventure brings you closer to Nishi stardom. Team up to unleash explosive combos and defeat powerful foes. Then, unwind in the lively city of NIM, where you can hang-out, craft and relax with friends.

title: Tombwater
description: Explore the accursed Wild West town of Tombwater and lay bare the eldritch horrors that lie beneath. Survive blood-spilling combat in this gruesome 2D action-RPG that might just drive you to madness.

title: Prologue: Go Wayback!
description: Prologue: Go Wayback! is a single-player open-world emergent survival roguelike where every journey is unique. Traverse a new wilderness that is generated for you every time you play. Chart your path, overcome the elements, and write your own story of exploration.

title: Preface: Undiscovered World
description: Preface is an immersive tech demo showcasing Melba, PLAYERUNKNOWN Productions' groundbreaking technology generating an Earth-scale world. In this project still in development, experience our machine learning agents creating a planet in real-time, directly on your GPU.

title: Deepest Fear
description: DEEPEST FEAR is a sci-fi horror FPS with a retro-future aesthetic. Deep beneath the ocean, a long dormant secret has been unearthed which throws mankind’s future into jeopardy.

title: Ready or Not: Dark Waters
description: At approx. 0800 hours this morning a critical situation occurred on offshore oil rig “HeavyWell A-101" and was responded to via tactical response by LSPD SWAT. The “United Peoples Front,” designated by the US Government as a terror group, claimed responsibility for this hostage incident. The situation is still ongoing, further investigation and situation reports are under the jurisdiction of FISA.

title: Chains of Freedom
description: Embark on a thrilling journey in a high-stakes, turn-based tactics game. Lead an elite squad in a fictional, dystopian Eastern Europe as you unravel a sinister conspiracy threatening the nation. Navigate intense strategic battles and adapt to ever-evolving challenges to prevail.

title: Geometry Blaster
description: Geometry Blaster is a Blaster game that teaches high school geometry.

title: City Tales: Medieval Era
description: City Tales is a medieval city builder, allowing you to unleash your creativity and shape vast cities that break outside a traditional grid. Plan each district for your citizens needs and aid your companions in their tales, creating a city to be proud of!

title: Drivers of the Apocalypse
description: Drivers of the Apocalypse is a high-octane action-driving combat game set in a vast, treacherous wasteland. You step into the shoes of Artemis, a junior mercenary working for Thunder Strike Force. Your mission? Stop deadly convoys, defeat powerful bosses, and survive.

title: The Finals: Season 5 - Next Stage
description:
Season 5 is the current and the fifth season of THE FINALS. It launched on December 12, 2024, and is expected to end on March 20, 2025.

This season is sponsored by VAIIYA, DISSUN and the returning sponsor ISEUL-T, who introduced the all-new arena Bernal.

New content introduced in Season 5 includes:
- Arena: Bernal
- New cosmetics
- New Battle Pass
- Weapons: Cerberus 12GA, ShAK-50
- Gadgets: Gravity Vortex, Lockbolt Launcher
- New weapon sights
- Clubs
- Progression: new sponsorships, new career levels

title: Empyreal
description: Empyreal is a complex, challenging, feature-rich action RPG. In a far-flung corner of the galaxy an Expedition arrives on a hitherto unexplored planet to find a colossal Monolith built by a lost civilisation.

title: Legends of Awen: Rise of The Fianna
description: Legends of Awen: Rise of the Fianna is a story-driven cRPG set in a Celtic-inspired medieval-fantasy world. Gather your party of legendary Fianna champions and embark on a journey to save the kingdom of Tara from internal strife and the return of an ancient dark force!

title: Containment Corp, Inc.
description: A co-op horror game where you team up with friends to hunt anomalies and collect rare loot. Customize your loadouts, your looks, much more!

title: Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster: Special Edition
description:
Say cheese! Everyone’s favorite zombie-hunting photojournalist, Frank West, is back in action with the beautifully remastered Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster. Reanimated from the ground up with Capcom’s RE ENGINE, Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster is the definitive remaster of the 2006 classic Dead Rising, which delivered a fresh take on the zombie genre with incredible action, over-the-top combat, hordes of weapon choices, wacky costumes (trust us, they’re even wackier this time around), and a comedic yet compelling storyline

Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster introduces freelance photojournalist Frank West as he ventures to Willamette, Colorado after overhearing there is something going on in town. Frank soon finds out he is in the middle of a zombie takeover and has 72 hours to uncover the truth about this outbreak!

title: Detective Beebo: Night at the Mansion
description:
Detective Oliver Beebo has been invited to a party by an ex-rich man in the middle of nowhere. Snacks included.

Unravel the mystery of the party, the guests, the house and the strange phenomena causing you to forget... something important? Surely it won't affect your love life.

title: Evil Nun: The Broken Mask - Unholy Edition
description: Evil Nun: The Broken Mask – Unholy Edition is a first-person horror game where players try to escape a haunted school while avoiding Sister Madeline, an AI-driven enemy who reacts to the player’s actions. The gameplay involves solving puzzles, crafting items, and exploring different escape paths. It’s based on the original mobile game series and includes updated graphics, new areas, and an expanded story. The Unholy Edition includes a slipcover, digital soundtrack, camp admission letter, art book, and the game disc.

title: MyRobot
description:
Adventure Character Simulator with optional AI features featuring your own robot that you can build and explore with.

Developed by sgthale, StillKill, and algernonvanpeel

title: Lex Venture: A Crossword Caper
description: Bullies have stolen and hidden parts of Eugene`s amazing Letter Machine--right before the science fair! Can you connect enough words crossword-style to build a path and collect the missing parts in time? With dozens of colorful levels to explore and obstacles to avoid, Lex Venture provides hours of fun for one person or the whole family. Outsmart the bullies and save the science fair!

title: Papetura: Craft Edition
description:
One day Pape escapes from a flowery prison and finds little Tura, a magical being that he’ll take care of. Together they will have to face dark and flaming monsters which will try to burn down their beloved paper world.

Papetura is a handcrafted puzzle adventure game made entirely out of paper.

Along with atmospheric music made by Floex, Tomas Dvorak, it creates a mysterious and unique paper world shrouded in shadow and light.

Everything is made out of paper, from tiny insects, strange creatures and monsters to truly magical locations.

Includes Exclusive Case, Downloadable Soundtrack, Art book and Base Game.

title: Runner Heroes: The Curse of Night and Day - Enhanced Edition
description: Runner Heroes is a unique adventure in which you control two characters at the same time. Sprint your way through the mystical lands of Celuria, a war-torn land of magic, to break a wicked curse and reunite with your childhood sweetheart. Do you accept the challenge? Follow Colwyn and Lyssa, heirs of their respective kingdoms, as an evil Red Witch prevents their love from flourishing. Harness the magic of Celuria to fight her curse as she chases you across 5 challenging worlds! Escape her clutches by running, jumping, diving and riding mine cars across 47 levels.

title: Goldenheart
description: Goldenheart is a retro first person fantasy adventure game created by two people in our home studio. It has a look and feel inspired by our favorite classic console games.

title: Sociable Soccer 25
description: Embrace the excitement of the world's favorite sport in Sociable Soccer 25. Created by legendary game designer Jon Hare, Sociable Soccer 25 features his signature fast-paced, arcade-style and intuitive gameplay, enriched with multiplayer head-to-head matches and collectible player cards.

title: Tomb Raider I•II•III Remastered: Deluxe Edition
description:
Tomb Raider I•II•III Remastered is a collection of the first three Tomb Raider games, originally released between 1996 and 1998, updated with enhanced visuals and modern controls.

Players follow Lara Croft across global locations, solving puzzles, exploring tombs, and engaging in combat. The remasters allow switching between original and updated graphics during gameplay.

The Deluxe edition includes:
• Physical copy of Tomb Raider I-III Remastered Starring Lara Croft
• SteelBook
• Exploration map book (featuring over 80 pages full of secrets, including all maps from all three games and their expansions)
• Collectible tuck-in box
• The collection's original soundtrack

description: The 14th free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley brings 'Sally from Disney Tim Burton’s The Nightmare Before Christmas as a new character, new Floating Islands to decorate and the Frost & Fairies Star Path.

title: Rivals Hover League
description: 'Rivals Hover League' is a vehicular combat PvP game where players battle in arenas across the galaxy using hover vehicles with various abilities. Join your teammates and show off your skills - hover, boost, shoot your way to become the MVP!

title: Juufuutei Raden's Guide for Pixel Museum
description: A VTuber from hololive DEV_IS, "Juufuutei Raden" from ReGLOSS, will guide you through a museum as the curator. The entire game world, including Curator Raden and the museum, is depicted in "pixel art". The illustrations are completed by solving logic nonogram puzzles.

title: TrickShot Simulator
description:
This Game is a simulator game.
A player experiences realistic trickshot challenges.

title: Santa Slides to Town
description: Santa Claus slides on his sleigh. Jump or double-jump or even triple-jump over obstacles. Gather stars to unlock new levels and upgrades. Reach the town as quickly as possible to set a new record. Use your collected stars to personalize the game's appearance.

title: Mystical Maritime Adventure
description: Here, you can freely sail your ship, explore the endless ocean, and find hidden islands and treasures!

title: Rugby League Team Manager 4
description: The fourth instalment of “The Number 1 Rugby League Management Game”. The biggest leagues and competitions. Take full control of managing your own Rugby League club. Training schedules, coaches, physios, scouting, finances, sponsors and more. MUCH MORE!

title: Purrfect Frenzy
description: A fast-paced top-down survival shooter where a cat fights off waves of rats in a brutal gladiatorial arena. Survive dynamic stages with evolving challenges and uncover hidden secrets behind the rat hordes.

title: Druta-Cinta
description: Druta-Cinta is a relaxing and replayable game to play in your free time that doesn't require your full attention. Time is controlled by the player, and the speed of obstacles matches the player, so take your time in here.

title: The Bewildering Basilica of the Bishop of Bobtown
description: A deckbuilding, tactical roguelike focusing on controlling the battlefield and getting your units close enough to the enemy commander to kill them while defending your own leaders. Summon units and wield skills to protect them to defeat your foes!

title: Scauage
description: A short horror experience where you play as a scavenger looting an abandoned house, uncovering its dark secrets and collecting hidden treasures while facing what lurks within.

title: Chosen Card Chronicles
description: Chosen Card Chronicles is a fast-paced card-battling visual novel with over 900 cards to collect. Meet new friends, build the ultimate deck, and aim for the top of the world.

title: Party Spirits
description: An online party game for 2-6 players. Play with friends or by matchmaking. Experience unique physics-based minigames. Use your spirit form after death to sabotage others and turn the tide in your favor.

title: Fisher-Price: Time To Play - Dollhouse
description: This software designed for younger girls provides a virtual dollhouse full of activities to encourage role-playing, exploration, and imagination. Players search eight different areas for hidden surprises and play with four interactive dolls at special tea parties.

title: NLC 7: Hard Edition
description: Explore a meticulously crafted world where your decisions have consequences, and quests offer multiple completion paths. Success requires strategic planning and adaptability. Attention to detail is critical. Observe dialogues, environments, and ever-present dangers closely.

title: Menticide
description: Menticide is an endless runner where you protect a man running from himself. You draw lines to bounce the man around, block off enemies and cut through obstacles. Through strong symbolism and procedural rhetoric we are using the game as an analogue for mental health.

title: Night Store Simulator
description: A PSX-style simulation game where you work in a night store. Sell goods and enjoy the process.

title: Superball Mario: Neutral Special
description: This mod replaces Mario's fireball with the superball from Super Mario Land. The new projectile is capable of bouncing off of floors, walls, and ceilings in order to reach places and fighters that Mario would otherwise be unable to reach.

title: Dungeons 4: Not Another Multiverse
description: Tristan and Thalya are thrown into yet another multiverse and Thalya makes an astounding discovery: The demonic and hordic inhabitants hate them BOTH. There is only one way out of this – and it’s by joining the forces of Evil and Good to find a way back into your own world.

title: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl: Voice Acting and Items
Dating Killmulator
description: Step into a world where dating goes beyond your typical choices. In this game, you’ll find yourself navigating a twisted, darkly humorous universe filled with popular guys, nice guys, and serial killers. This isn't your standard dating game; it’s a wild parody that plays with every dating sim trope, flipping it on its head.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 1.4 - A Storm of Falling Stars
description:
Version 1.4 of Zenless Zone Zero, which includes:

• New Characters: Miyabi and Harumasa
• New Main Story Quest: A Storm of Falling Stars
• New Events
• ...and more!

title: Prisoner of the Mist
description: A fantasy yuri visual novel about two trans women meeting before the eve of Saunheim. It was created for the 2024 edition of the Yuri Game Jam.

title: JR East Train Simulator: Nambu Line (Kawasaki to Tachikawa) E233-8000 series Nambu Branchi Line (Hamakawasaki to Shitte) 205-1000 series Tsurumi Line (Tsurumi to Ogimachi,Okawa,Umi-Shibaura) 205-1100 series
description:
The Nambu Line is a 35.5 km long line connecting Kawasaki Station in Kawasaki City, Kanagawa Prefecture and Tachikawa Station in Tachikawa City, Tokyo.
The Nambu Branch Line is a 4.1 km long line connecting Shitte Station in Kawasaki City, Kanagawa Prefecture and Hama-Kawasaki Station in Kawasaki City, Kanagawa Prefecture.
The Tsurumi Line is a 9.7 km long line connecting Tsurumi Station in Yokohama City, Kanagawa Prefecture and Ogimachi Station in Kawasaki City, Kanagawa Prefecture.
In addition to the main line connecting Tsurumi Station and Ogimachi, the line has two branch lines: the Umi-Shibaura branch line, which branches off from Asano Station and connects to Umi-Shibaura Station, and the Okawa branch line, which branches off from Musashi-Shiraishi Station and connects to Okawa Station.

title: JR East Train Simulator: Yamanote Line (Osaki to Osaki) E235-0 series
description: The Yamanote Line runs in a circle around the center of Tokyo for 34.5 km, taking 59 minutes, and is one of the major lines in the Tokyo metropolitan area, connecting huge terminal stations with world-class passengers.

title: JR East Train Simulator: Utsunomiya Line (Kuroiso to Tokyo) E233-3000 series
description:
Utsunomiya Line is the nickname for trains operating on the 163.3 km long section of the Tohoku Line (between Tokyo Station and Morioka Station) between Tokyo Station and Kuroiso Station. The Utsunomiya Line has been in use since March 10, 1990, at the suggestion of the local governments along the line. In the past, many express and sleeper trains headed for Tohoku and Hokkaido used to run on the line, but now regular and rapid trains make up the majority of the schedule.
Please enjoy the Utsunomiya Line DLC as you travel through the Kanto Plain, experiencing the changing landscape from Tochigi Prefecture to Tokyo, with its sprawling countryside, suburban residential areas, and buildings in the heart of the city.

title: JR East Train Simulator: Yokosuka Line (Kurihama to Tokyo) Series E217
description:
The Yokosuka Line is a 23.9 km long line connecting Kurihama Station in Yokosuka City, Kanagawa Prefecture and Ōfuna Station in Kamakura City, Kanagawa Prefecture. Although the official name of Ōfuna Station to Tōkyō Station is Tōkaido main line, trains run directly from Kurihama Station to Tōkyō Station, so the line between Kurihama and Tōkyō Stations is known as the Yokosuka Line.
The train leaves Kurihama Station for Yokohama Station via Yokosuka Station, a military port town; Kamakura Station,famous for the Daibutsu statue and Tsurugaoka Hachiman Shrine; and Ōfuna Station, where the train joins the Tōkaidō Main Line. After Yokohama Station, the line separates from the Tōkaidō Main Line near Tsurumi Station and heads for Shinagawa Station while running alongside the Tōkaidō Shinkansen via Shin-Kawasaki Station where the Shin-Tsurumi Engine Works, and Musashi-kosugi Station is spead. After Shinagawa Station, the line goes underground to Tōkyō Station, its final destination. We hope you enjoy the various landscapes from the suburbs to the city and the many parallel trains.

title: JR East Train Simulator: Ome Line - Tachikawa to Okutama: E233-0 Series
description:
The Ōme Line is a 37.2 km long line connecting Tachikawa Station in Tachikawa City, Tōkyō, and Okutama Station in Okutama-town, Nishitama-county, Tōkyō. The line runs through residential areas from Tachikawa Station to Ōme Station, but from Ōme Station onward it runs along the Tama River through the mountains. The area between Ōme Station and Okutama Station is known as the Adventure Line, and although it is in Tōkyō, it is an area where visitors can enjoy abundant nature and activities right after getting off the station.
We hope you will enjoy the Ōme Line, which has two distinctive features a double track running through a residential area and a single track running through the mountains.

title: Chop Shop
description: Feel the flow as you hunt, butcher, and cook at a blisteringly fast pace in this action shop-keeping game. Hunt adorable monsters, chop colossal carcasses, and power-slice through huge chunks of flesh to serve your customers even faster. Move fast and stay sharp if you want your shop to survive.

title: DCS World: Black Shark 3
description: DCS: Black Shark 3 is a further development of the well-known Black Shark and Black Shark 2 projects, which are dedicated to the Russian Ka-50 attack helicopter.

title: American Conquest: Anthology
description: American Conquest: Anthology is a PC collection developed by GSC Game World in 2008 and distributed in Italy and Spain by FX Interactive. The FX edition includes the original game and the Fight Back expansion. The game features five stories (the Discovery, Pre-Columbian Civilizations, European Powers, the Conquest of the West, and the War of Independence), and numerous historical figures such as Christopher Columbus, Cortès, Montezuma, George Washington, and many others.

title: DCS World: CH-47F
description: The Boeing CH-47F Chinook fondly referred to as 'The Hook' by US military personnel, stands today as the premier multi-mission rotary wing aircraft in use with the US Army, US Army Reserve, National Guard and 20 other nations including Canada, the United Kingdom, Netherlands, Japan, Italy, Greece, Spain, South Korea, Australia, Türkiye, India and the United Arab Emirates. Embodying a unique tandem rotor design this massive helicopter excels in all its roles, including cargo and troop transportation, sling load operations, search and rescue, casualty evacuation, special operations, and humanitarian assistance in disaster scenarios.

title: SokoNature
description: SokoNature is a Sokoban-inspired game with a unique twist. The character and blocks come in three sizes, each interacting differently. Small characters can't push medium or large blocks, while large characters can push all sizes, with larger blocks moving fewer spaces. The game centers on saving the forest from fires, adding a thematic layer to the puzzle-solving mechanics.

title: Couple-Cultivation Saves the World
description: This is a live-action interactive game. As the hero, you find out you become the best cultivation power bank in Jiuqiu by chance. Are you willing to Couple-Cultivate with the girls from another world, save the Earth, and maintain peace in Jiuqiu?

title: The Permanent Residence: Souls Kept
description:
The Permanent Residence pulls you into the unsettling world of an isolated bungalow shrouded in mystery and dread. You step into the shoes of a traveling musician, stranded after your shows are suddenly canceled. Desperate and tempted by a 50% discount, you take up an offer to stay in this strange house, blissfully unaware of the horrors that await.

The once-quiet halls now hum with whispers, and the walls seem to hide secrets aching to be uncovered. As you piece together strange clues, the bungalow’s chilling history unfolds—a past filled with rituals, vanishings, and a dark presence that refuses to let go. Soon, you realize that walking out the door might not be as simple as walking in.

title: DCS World: F-16C Arctic Thunder Campaign by Reflected Simulations
description: February 2024. Finland is on the verge of joining NATO, when the unthinkable happens: Russian armed forces push through the border while cruise missiles rain down on the country. Several western allies join the conflict at once to fight alongside their Finnish brothers in arms. Among them is the 112th Fighter Squadron of the Air National Guard, who had just arrived from a training exercise in the UK.

title: Im Bann Der Dunklen Jagd
description: Dive into an immersive co-op horror experience with a friend. As detectives, you’ll search for clues in a sinister area and must survive the horrors lurking within. Work together to find all the objects and escape before doom catches up with you.

title: Kono Aozora ni Yakusoku wo: Refine
description: Kono Aozora ni Yakusoku wo: Refine is a remake of the original visual novel Kono Aozora ni Yakusoku wo, updated for modern consoles with improved visuals, UI, and all-ages presentation. It tells a character-driven story set on a remote island where a group of students living in a dormitory experience everyday school life, friendships, and emotional routes that branch based on player choices, focusing on romance, personal growth, and long-standing secrets tied to their shared past.

title: Electro-Dynamic Mayhem
description: Join the not-so-goody two-shoes robot 'EDM' in a Wario Land 4-inspired speedy‎ platformer where your goal is to cause as much destruction to public property as you can while doing field research.‎

title: Sexdivers
description: SEXDIVERS is an intense survival shooter where you play as a fighter escorting a scientific expedition on a mysterious uninhabited planet.

title: I Didn't Cheat
description: This game places players in the role of a student attempting to cheat during school exams at Redstone Middle School while avoiding detection by vigilant teachers. Players must use their phone to find answers to exam questions across four days, each featuring different supervising guards with varying levels of awareness. The gameplay focuses on stealth mechanics and timing as players balance between checking their device and maintaining the appearance of legitimate test-taking. The experience is designed to be enhanced with headphones for immersive audio cues that signal teacher proximity and detection risk.

title: Outlaw City: Dark Past
description: A mini-episode, lasting 1 hour.

title: Outlaw City
description: Previously known as Generation City, a city outside of the reach of foreign policy and law.

title: Pretend it's not There
description:
You are a young student returning home from school, burdened by an unsettling presence of something following you. You convince yourself that if you ignore it, it will leave you alone. But as you close your front door, a horrible realization sets in—it followed you inside.

Left alone with the monster in the house, you must carry out your nightly routine, pretending not to notice it's presence.

title: 100 in 1 Game Collection
description: Meet Magrat the witch, Harvey the weird fish, Stephanie the green cow and all their beloved friends, and embark on an epic journey through 100 arcade games that blend classic gameplay from your favorite retro titles with new concepts that are reinventing the arcade genre! Score as much as you can, then improve and challenge yourself to get all stars in solo or with your friends!

title: Super Sunny World
description: Super Sunny World is the ultimate love letter to the platformer greats of the 8-bit era. Jump, bump, and kick your way through 8 worlds of pixel-perfect platforming, cute characters, and exciting power-ups.

title: 9 R.I.P. Aroma Edition
description: Aroma Edition Includes: 9 R.I.P for Nintendo Switch, Reversible Cover Sleeve, Collector’s Boxes, Acrylic Standee (reveals an image when lit up!), set of 9 Character Cards, Cloth Poster, Dark Sweet Dreams Aroma Diffuser

title: Emerald Ties
description: Emerald Ties is an upcoming Sonic the Hedgehog fan game that features classic gameplay with a modern aesthetic.

title: Himei Dam
description: "Himei Dam" is a horror game where you patrol the dam at night with your senior, who has an afro. Recommended for: People who want to be scared People who want to be surprised People who want to try working at a dam Streamers known for their great reactions

title: Persona 5: Dancing in starlight - Dance! (OP ver.)
Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Groovy
description: Additional playable track 'GROOVY'.

title: Persona 5 Dancing in Starlight: Picaresque Mouse Set
description: A set of 9 'Picaresque Mouse' accessories for all characters.

title: Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Tanaka's Amazing Commodities (Atlus Kozuka Remix)
description: Additional playable track 'Tanaka's Amazing Commodities (ATLUS Kozuka Remix)'.

title: Persona 5: Dancing In Starlight - Wake Up, Get Up, Get Out There (OP ver.)
description: Additional playable track 'Wake Up, Get Up, Get Out There (OP ver.)'.

title: Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Race Queen Set
description: Race Queen costume set for Ann, Makoto, Haru and Futaba.

title: Minecraft: Heat Wave Survival
description: Each summer, the heat Dragon descends upon your village. Travel the World in search of new ways to defeat this formidable foe. Keep yourself Cool with new items like cold compresses and solar-powered fans. After completing the story, play Survival mode with the added Challenge of the heat meter, and a new friend who will Fight by your side.

title: Defensurvivor
description: DEFENSURVIVOR is a strategy game where you build obstacles and place and move units to block zombies. There are various units with unique characteristics and powerful high-level units that can be obtained through combination. Use randomly given units to survive until the end!

title: CyberSeas
description: Race around sunken streets in your jet ship, swing between collapsed skyscrapers with your trusty harpoon and build your reputation amongst the colourful inhabitants of the CyberSeas!

title: Facing the Rain
description: Story-driven RPG adventure, where you take the role of a hotel maid in her first job. Soon you notice the gloom surrounding the hotel and its owner. But doing the right things, you can make a difference.

title: Laundry Store Simulator
description: Start small and work your way up, upgrading your equipment, designing a stylish store, and expanding your services! Are you ready to own the best Laundry Store in the world?

title: Bakso Simulator 2
description: The Sequel to Bakso Simulator with new gameplay, areas, characters, and more!

title: Unexpected Pigeon Race
description: A pigeon racing game (Checkpoint system) the race passes through ancient Egyptian historical sites (Abu Simbel, Philae, Edfu, Luxor, Karnak, Hatshepsut, Dendera, Abydos and Pyramids).

title: Lost Room: Escape
description: As twilight descends and the world plunges into darkness, you, a seasoned police officer, find yourself answering a harrowing call that shatters the peace of a quiet, unassuming neighborhood. The distressed voice on the other end speaks of Lost Apartment, a place steeped in sinister legends.

title: Gorf the Frog
description: Become a lost frog searching for its destiny in a brutal world filled with dangers. GORF combines classic road-crossing gameplay with soulslike punishing difficulty. Uncover the dark truth behind your seemingly simple mission.

title: Tetrominer
description: Cosmic Puzzle Adventure Embark on a cosmic journey where strategic thinking meets colorful puzzle-solving in Tetrominer! Inspired by the iconic Rubik’s cube,Tetrominer challenges players to match and destroy Tetris blocks using a variety of Tetriminos distinct shapes that dictate your moves.

title: Nightfall House
description: Nightfall House is a first-person walking simulator game that allows you to feel as if someone is always around.

title: Weapons of War
description: Weapons of War is a free 3D fantasy MMORPG set in an ancient mythical world, featuring five classes, quests, PvP and PvE environments, and ongoing in-game events

title: The Shattered Veil
description: The Wraith Army rises again, and it falls to Kael to wear the Crown and lead his people to victory once more. After spending the last decade preparing for Coronation Day with the help of his sister, Elara, they will soon discover that the Wraith Army is much closer than they had anticipated.

title: DCS World: F/A-18C Arctic Thunder Campaign
description: February 2024. Finland is on the verge of joining NATO, when the unthinkable happens: Russian armed forces push through the border while cruise missiles rain down on the country. Several western allies join the conflict at once to fight alongside their Finnish brothers in arms. Among them is the 112th Fighter Squadron of the Air National Guard, who had just arrived from a training exercise in the UK.

title: DCS World: F-16C Last Out: Weasels over Syria II Campaign
description:
Strap back into the legendary F-16C Viper and re-enter the world of the Wild Weasels!
Rejoin Captain Dan 'Forrest' Wilson as he returns to the air to fight for supremacy over the Syrian skies in Last Out - Weasels Over Syria II. Picking up two weeks after the events of First In - Weasels over Syria, LOWOS will see the pilots of the 79th Fighter Squadron once again thrown into unforgiving combat as they battle for survival against the Syrian air defense network. YGBSM!

title: Championship Manager 2010 Special Edition
description:
Championship Manager 2010 Special Edition is an updated version of the popular football management simulation game, Championship Manager 2010. It includes the full game along with additional content.

The Special Edition features extras such as
- Manager's Notepad
- Championship Manager pencil
- Large Poster showcasing the structures of over thirty national leagues.
- Additionally, it offers a subscription-based CM Live service that provides six updates during the football season, allowing players to manage their teams in real-time as the season progresses.

title: Prolegomena to a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges
description: This is a fully voiced multi-ending adventure game that progresses by repeating a limited 3-minute dialogue time. Interactions primarily occur through an interface called "choices".

title: Monster Palace
description: Monster Palace is a video game for Windows 95 developed by Clementoni, an Italian toy company. This game falls under the horror genre aimed primarily at children and features a limited release in Italy. However, it was never translated into other languages, making it predominantly available in Italian. The game involves navigating a haunted mansion filled with puzzles and a mysterious atmosphere, where players use tools like tarot cards, crystal balls, and pendulums to solve puzzles.

title: Escape From Sandhill
description: A horror puzzle adventure begins in the spooky tunnels of Sandhill, which can be played as FPS and TPS. Navigate dark corridors, solve complex puzzles, and survive encounters with vengeful shadows born of sinister experiments. Escape the tunnel and survive the mysteries of the neighborhood.

title: Battaglia Navale & Forza 4
description: The game "Battaglia navale & Forza 4", developed by Evviva! Software, combines two classic board games into a single digital package. Released on Windows platforms, this game includes the strategic naval combat of Battaglia navale and the logic-based challenges of Forza 4.

title: Retribution: 25th Anniversary Edition
description:
Anniversary Edition of Half-Life: Retribution mod includes Half-Life 25th Anniversary Update's new features:

- Removed non-working multiplayer and everything connected with it.
- All types of debris have been completely removed.
- New menu background up to Quad HD resolution as "WON" version
- Animated Logo
- New loading screen
- UI items click sound as "WON" version
- Added 4 options in game configuratons "Advanced"
- Removed unsupported menu items
- Added new menu item for demo campain
- New icons for Steam library
- include russian translation.

title: Disney Game Shots: Sparamu
description: Disney Game Shots: Sparamu is part of the Disney Game Shots series developed by Disney Interactive. This specific game draws its theme from the animated movie Mulan and features arcade-style shooting gallery mechanics where players engage in challenges inspired by the film's setting.

title: Unpunished
description: UNPUNISHED game is a horror story game that is endowed with good, realistic graphics and plot

title: I'm a Gensokyo Observer
description: You worked in a company known for getting rid of anomalies and any paranormal activities. One day, you received a letter from Yukari, asking for your assistance in Gensokyo about paranormal activities which this time, it's from a different source. You have to take care of the anomalies in Gensokyo and make Gensokyo safe again. Good luck.

title: Zombie Pandemia 2D
description: top-down 2d zombie shooter

title: As Dusk Falls: Special Edition
description:
As Dusk Falls is an original interactive drama from INTERIOR/NIGHT that explores the entangled lives of two families across thirty years.
Special Edition includes: Game, Cinematic Poster, Collector's Box, Dante's Black Book, Postcards, Pins and Desert Dream Motel Replica Key.

title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic
description: Dive into a world of fun and adventure with the Care Bears in "Care Bears: Unlock the Magic" Play as Cheer Bear and her friends in a variety of arcade games!

title: Myths of the World: Love Beyond
description: Your husband has been kidnapped by a vengeful witch. To save him, you'll need to uncover the secrets of a nearby town before she can destroy it. Can you find the true story of the witch's betrayal? How is the town's Master tied in to all of this? Find the clues to save your love before you become another victim of the witch's wrath!

title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero - Collector's Edition
description:
Shake the earth. Break the heavens. Make yours the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in DRAGON BALL!
Box contents:
Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero
Metallic Bookmark
Dragon Ball:Sparking! Zero Exclusive Diorama 264 x 174 mm
Digital Content

title: Dragon's Dogma II: Lenticular Edition
description: Dragon's Dogma is a single player, narrative driven action-RPG that challenges players to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more.

title: Eldrador Creatures: Shadowfall
description: The adventure-filled worlds of Eldrador are in danger! Lead battle-ready creatures in turn-based strategic combat to defeat a mysterious shadowy menace.

title: Enotria: The Last Song - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition of Enotria: The Last Song includes:

ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK EXTRACT

DIGITAL ARTBOOK EXTRACT

EXCLUSIVE WEAPON SKINS SET

UPGRADE WEAPON MATERIALS

UPGRADE MASK MATERIALS

UPGRADE LINES MATERIALS

EXTRA MIRACLE PESTO

EXTRA HYMN OF VIGOR

EXTRA ARMONIA SAP

title: Fisher-Price: Big Action Construction
description: Fisher-Price Big Action Construction is an activity center game released on September 17, 1998. It is Funnybone's take on Tonka Construction. In the game, the player can visit different work areas of the Big Action Construction Site. Collector Cards are rewarded for playing the actives. Obtaining all the collector cards in an activity will reward the player a certificate. One all six are completed, the player is declared a "number-one construction worker".

title: Kena: Bridge of Spirits - Premium Edition
description:
Kena: Bridge of Spirits is a story-driven, action adventure combining exploration with fast-paced combat. The story follows Kena, a young spirit guide who uses her magical abilities to help deceased people move from the physical to the spirit world.
Premium Edition contains:
• Base Game
• Official Digital Soundtrack
• Unique Kena Staff
• Golden Rot Skin
• Retail Exclusive Sticker Sheet
• Xbox Exclusive Pirate-Themed Hats

title: Morkull: Ragast's Rage - Collector's Edition
description:
A 2D video game that combines platforming and action with a touch of exploration in which we control Morkull, God of death and darkness and lord of the Ragast, whose main mechanics lies in the breaking of the fourth wall, which will allow Morkull to communicate with the player in various ways.
The Collector's Edition contains:
• The Base Game (Standard Edition)
• Special Box with exclusive illustration
• An Artbook
• 4 stickers
• Postcards Set
• Original soundtrack on CD-ROM

title: The Worries of Santa Clauses
description: They are somehow arrested when the police find them.

title: The Inheritance of Crimson Manor: Victorian Edition
description:
Victorian Edition – The Inheritance of Crimson Manor
Delve deeper into the eerie and enigmatic world of The Inheritance of Crimson Manor with the Victorian Edition Bundle, an essential collection for fans of gothic mystery and suspense.

This bundle includes:

️ Penny Dreadful DLC – Discover a new chapter in the Crimson Manor universe with an official illustrated story, inspired by the Penny Dreadfuls of the 1890s. This visual tale unveils events that preceded the main story, revealing secrets of the mansion’s past and enhancing your understanding of its sinister legacy. (Installed as a PDF in the game directory: DLC/PennyDreadful/)

Original Soundtrack – Immerse yourself in the haunting ambiance of Crimson Manor with a meticulously crafted soundtrack by Daniel Alvarez Veroy. Each track captures the dark, unsettling, and mysterious essence of the mansion, drawing you further into its foreboding world.

Expand your journey into the mystery of Crimson Manor—if you dare.

title: The Plucky Squire: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Plucky Squire - Deluxe Edition contains:
- The Plucky Squire
- The Plucky Squire - Soundtrack
- The Plucky Squire - Digital Art Book

title: Two Point Museum: Explorer Edition
description:
Two Point Museum - Explorer Edition contains:
Two Point Museum base game
Explorer Upgrade Pack
DIGITAL ONLY: 5 days advanced access

title: Castle Doombad Classic
description: Become the villain and slay any hero who dares enter your evil domain! Deploy traps and minions as the ultimate diabolical dungeon keeper in this Tower Defense puzzler. Includes the 2014 Castle Doombad game plus new improvements and content.

title: Attack Hole
description:
Can you move the black hole to swallow the arms down the hole? Can you bite the bullet and rule the black hole games solo or on multiplayer?

Your quest is easy in Attack Hole io game. The clock is ticking, tik tok, tik tok, will you succeed to swallow the bullet in this circle game, and eat it all like a wormhole in your favorite black hole games?

This eating simulator can be played solo, or multiplayer, you can use the wormhole, eat the bullet and upgrade your black holes!

Choose among your favorite black holes skins and go into the eating games in the hall full of weapons and bullet stacks and try to clear them like in those eating games! If you swallow the whole io weapon, you will have more bullet power to fight and destroy bosses who dare your black holes! Become the black hole hero attacker in this corn hole io game!

title: The Legend of Shiande
description: An old-school, extremely challenging game that combines RPG, adventure, and puzzle elements. Designed to test the skills and determination of players who thrive on tough challenges.

title: And Roger
description: It was a morning like all others, until she realized her dad wasn't home. In his place, a stranger who speaks nonsense and insists she "takes her medicine". Who is he? Where is dad?

title: Girls Made Pudding
description:
"When there's nobody there to see you, you disappear."

In Girls Made Pudding, two girls tour a series of towns that people have disappeared from. Follow them on the road as they find out the mysteries of this world.

title: Castle Doombad 2: Muahaha!
description: The sinister sequel to Castle Doombad with all-new content, features, and story! YOU are the villain, and it's up to you to destroy the heroes! Defend your evil lair Solo or in 2-Player Co-Op with terrible traps, monstrous minions, and wicked weapons. "Action Tower Defense" meets dungeon keeping.

title: Sofia in Exchange for Lies
description: Peek into the sins and memories of five personalities through surveillance cameras. This is an immersive, mystery adventure game that unravels the thoughts of the dark past that lie dormant inside Sofia, a suspect in the murder of a presidential candidate, and uncovers the truth behind the crime.

title: Re:Choice
description:
