"I told you, with you, we can start over!"
Choices that weren't available in the first playthrough become unlocked in the second. A time-loop adventure RPG where the story branches from the very beginning, depending on your decisions.

title: Magical Girl Witch Trials
description: Thirteen girls awaken, only to find themselves in a prison. What awaits them: a Witch Trial. Help them prepare for the trial by exploring the prison in order to find the witch hidden amongst them. Find the witch, learn what kind of magic she holds, dispel the lies, and prepare for the execution.

title: Chonkers
description: Chonkers is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Adopt the cutest fur balls and watch them ramp up the chonk scale as you play with them. Find them a new family. They’ll pay A LOT for your hefty chonker! Complete your collection by finding all the breeds and the rarest space cats!

title: Slime Nomi
description: Slime Nomi is a platformer with creative ideas. Help Nomi collect potion ingredients and concoct witch Millie's extraordinary potion.

title: Alone A Long
description: In a world where you are alone, you repeat your daily routine in a nonchalant and somewhat joyful manner. A simulation game to maintain civilization where the objective is to maintain civilization until the day when you can no longer move.

title: IF: Imaginary Friends
description: The main character, a young boy named Croqui, is reunited with the imaginary friends he created in his infancy due to a mental regression caused by the birth of his younger sister. Fearing that he will be forgotten again, the friends try to trap him in their imaginary world by playing games with him! You are Croqui and you will win the game with your friends. An adventure game with an atmosphere like a picture book or a painting, featuring unique imaginary friends.

title: Weirdo
description: Weirdo is a Japanese manga-style visual novel set in DYL High School. It follows Wang Zhe, an ordinary and frail boy, who tries to win the hearts of girls and complete his experiments. He gets entangled in bizarre events, plunging into darkness. Each choice you make determines his fate.

title: Mini Golf Simulator
description: Mini Golf Simulator is a calm, cozy mini golf experience made to help you slow down and unwind. Enjoy peaceful courses, the sound of birds on a fresh Saturday morning, and the simple satisfaction of mastering each hole and landing the perfect hole-in-one.

title: Dalafri
description: This title is a physics-based 3D sword fighting game. Players take on the role of a slightly flexible warrior and aim to become a champion in the arena.

title: Sheeeroom
description: You wish to bring "She" back to life to reclaim something precious you’ve lost. Solve the various puzzles set before you and gather what "She" needs. Even you don’t know what "She" truly is. "sheeeroom" is a mysterious adventure game.

title: The Headliners
description: Co-op horror game where you play in teams of 1 to 4 reckless journalists, ready to explore a city overrun by deadly creatures to snap spectacular footage. Your only goal: make the headlines without becoming one.

title: Unlight: Revive
description:
This is a story-centered competitive training card game. Players explore and conquer quest mode (single player) with character cards to obtain treasure chests, train and customize their character cards, and explore deck construction that suits their strategy, such as focusing on preemptive action, attack, defense, or overall balance. Not only do trained character cards increase their HP and attack/defense stats, but they also learn special moves unique to each character, which, when conditions are right, can deal significant damage and battle effects to enemies.

Deck construction is also a crucial factor when battling other players in Duel Mode (PvP), so build your deck carefully yet boldly.

title: GrindFest
description: GrindFest is a free-to-play idle programming action fantasy RPG where players utilize C# programming to create bots that engage in combat, loot, and cooperate with one another.

title: Karting of Banban
description: Grip your steering wheel and join your favorite Banban characters in the race of a lifetime! Drift around tight corners and zoom through locations both old and new. Use power-ups and boosts to dodge your opponents and claim first place!

title: April Freebee
description: April Freebee is an April Fools game which was disguised as an instrument for the Kontakt Player.

title: Caretaker: The Bureau
description:
You are the caretaker.
Today is your first day on the job in organization called The Bureau. Your task is to carefully observe and report all anomalies or deviations.

If you do well - a promotion awaits you.
If you don't - The Bureau breaks the contract.

Can you handle this task?

title: Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled: Nitro Tour Grand Prix
Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled: Back N. Time Grand Prix
Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled: Spyro N. Friends Grand Prix
Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled: Spooky Grand Prix
Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled: Neon Circus Grand Prix
Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled: Winter Festival Grand Prix
Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled: Rustland Grand Prix
description: Themed on a post-apocalyptic desert world.

title: Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled: Gasmoxia Grand Prix
description: Themed on science-fiction and a fast-food war above Gasmoxia.

title: Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled: Post-Grand Prix
description: Update themed around Beenox's brand colors

title: Raisond'etre
description:
Will you be able to uncover your raison d'être and solve the mysteries that await in this suspenseful thriller?

In this 2D adventure title, players can explore as they please, examine objects, solve a series of riddles, and complete a variety of minigames.

title: Need for Speed Unbound: Ultimate Collection
description:
Unleash the ultimate Need for Speed Unbound experience in one package with the Ultimate Collection. Enjoy instant access to all post-launch premium content, and the Vol. 9 Premium Speed Pass. Get access to 9 fully customizable cars, over 45 Customs, and 100+ additional cosmetics.

INCLUDES:
- Keys to the Map
- Vol. 9 Premium Speed Pass** (upon release)
- Vol. 8 Premium Speed Pass
- Vol. 8 Dynamic Catch-Up Pack** (Including Premium Speed Pass Content, upon release)
- Vol. 7 Dynamic Catch-Up Pack (Including Premium Speed Pass Content)
- Vol. 6 Dynamic Catch-Up Pack (Including Premium Speed Pass Content)
- Vol. 5 Catch-Up Pack
- Vol. 5 Customs Pack
- Trick or Street Swag Pack
- Vol. 4 Catch-Up Pack
- Hip Hop Origin Swag Pack
- Vol. 4 Customs Pack
- Vol. 3 Catch-Up Pack
- Robojets Swag Pack
- Vol. 3 Customs Pack

title: Crusty Proto
description:
Unknown incomplete and glitchy game, with build date roughly around 1997, found in a pack of CD bought in a garage lot.
It tries to mimic Resident Evil very hard, as it was big hit at the time.

Though in this state, i think i know who to blame, why it didn't make it to release...

title: Onibito Kiki
description: Experience ONIBITO KIKI’s first game adaptation in 90s-style 2D action! Play as KIKI, leader of the ONIBITO clan, using special abilities to conquer tough missions. Enjoy retro pixel art combined with modern gameplay—join KIKI on an epic adventure!

title: Grabbed by the Ghoulies
description: When Grabbed By The Ghoulies was featured in Rare Replay, it was the only one of the games in the collection that got itself remastered to run natively on the Xbox One.

title: CrimeBot 2: Unsolved Cold Case
description: Become a detective in CrimeBot 2 and travel the world solving criminal cases. You'll have only your logic and intuition to analyze dossiers filled with clues, suspect profiles, and photographs. Can you catch the culprit?

title: Jelly Troops
description: An online action RTS where the tide can turn in a flash! Fight exciting battles where you recruit golems to battle your opponent’s slimes, cleverly redirect their slimes with walls, or sneakily steal their flag to make a dramatic comeback.

title: Overwatch 2: Season 14 - Hazard
description: Introducing Hazard, the new Tank hero, embodying the spirit of anarchy for the greater good. Then test your skills with a unique blend of past and present in the 6v6 Role Queue event, using the 2-2-2 setup. Plus, master the elements with an Overwatch 2 x Avatar: The Last Airbender collab event, celebrating unity, resilience, and the power within. And don’t miss out on Mythic Thor Reinhardt.

title: Todesangst
description:
Todesangst is a single player Half-Life modification, which follows an alternate timeline where the nuclear destruction of Black Mesa and the Seven Hour War never happened.

Gordon is back from Xen, and it's all business as usual. That is, until a sinister scientist named Jack Newell, motivated by morbid curiosity and seething hatred of Gordon, decides to start another bloodbath, forcing Gordon and his friend Joe to put a stop to his experiments with Xen creatures.

Todesangst (pronounced TOH-dess-ahngst) is a German word that literaly means fear of death, but is usually translated as meaning terror or dread.

title: Todesangst 2: Der Echte Feind
description: Sequel to the original Todesangst, Todesangst 2 is a single player Half-Life modification, made by a team of 10 people taken for 15 months to develop and released in December 2002.

title: Three Kingdoms Heroes
description: Swallowing the Heaven and Earth Version of Zhao Yun's Biography, in which multiple girls fall in love with you, also known as: Zhao Yun's Harem Biography

title: Skate City: New York
description: Navigate the iconic streets of New York City as you master hundreds of tricks in famous, real-world skate spots. Jump over taxis, dodge pedestrians and string together impressive combos to land your highest scores.

title: DCS World: F-5E Remastered
description: The F-5E was developed in the early 1970s as a light tactical fighter. It is an upgraded version of the earlier F-5A. Combat roles of the F-5E include both air-to-air and unguided ground attack. In the United States, it has excelled as an aggressor. Given its mission flexibility, ease of operation, and low cost, the F-5E continues to serve air forces including Iran, Switzerland, and others.

title: Do No Harm
description: A Doctor Simulator with a Lovecraftian twist. Diagnose patients by analyzing unsettling symptoms and treat them using your Book of Medicine. Make moral choices — decide who to save or kill, discover whom to trust, and unlock multiple endings! Can you endure 30 days of perilous decisions?

title: My Plushy Shift
description: In My Plushy Shift, your Task is to collect around the Office. Sounds simple enough, though things get difficult as you start hallucinating about toys and - walking Plushies. Collect around all Rooms while struggling through the Plushy Hallucinations.

title: Morrigan's Isle
description: Stave off waves of enemies that grow in strength and number as each night passes and defend the Tree of Life. Survive, harvest resources, craft armor and weapons, outfit helper NPCs, and build a base protected by auto-firing towers. Explore the island to find gear with the power of the Celtic Gods.

title: Comet Force
description: Comet Force is a Space Arena Shooter Action Roguelite. Build your camp, recruit to compose and grow your troop, collect upgrades and unique effects, fight enemies and bosses, and choose how the threat evolves. Keep your troop strong enough to survive all waves and close off the anomaly.

title: Eyes That Hypnotise
description: A cozy, hand-drawn puzzle where you arrange fluffy friends to fit the grid. With their funny big eyes and a calming mood, this game offers a relaxing escape.

title: Dimensional Illusion
description: Dimensional illusion is a real-time strategy game that combines role-playing with friendly placement. Each map scene is a new experience, and by combining friendly formations and skill combinations, lead your character to defeat powerful bosses.

title: Love Angel Syndrome
description:
"Ah… the binary… it's beautiful. You're beautiful."

Yuuna, our protagonist and mentally ill NEET, spends most of her days browsing forums about her favorite anime, Ai no Uta ★ Tenshi Senshi 𝄞. One day she stumbles across an ad claiming to have a desktop assistant modeled after Ai, the main character of Ai no Uta.

Unable to resist the allure of talking with her favorite character, Yuuna downloads the program. Ai-chan turns out to be the girlfriend Yuuna’s always dreamed of– but can a relationship with no boundaries really flourish? Can an AI program actually feel real human love?

title: Knight-Blade: Howling of Kerberos
description: In 2077, after World War IV, Cain Graywood, betrayed by the Elite and having his friends killed, enters their headquarters for revenge. What awaited him was the strongest armored forces, with the forbidden super weapon "EX-ARMS".

title: A Tiny Wander
description: Buu must deliver a package through a deep forest. Despite many attempts to challenge the forest, he has not succeeded. Chat with passersby, explore, and take breaks at campsites, while searching for a way to get through the forest. Let's go on a small nighttime adventure with Buu!

title: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer
description: "Create the games you want, at the time you want, and live doing only what you love." In this realistic life simulation game, an independent game developer dreams of such a life, struggling with money and time while paying taxes until death. Whether this life is happy or truly lonely, you decide.

title: Draconic Date
description: By invoking the old Dragon Law, you managed to get your dragon girlfriend out for a date. What will you discover in that old abandoned castle, and what bounds will you forge with Iryl?

title: Abyss Seeker: What Do You See Deep in The Abyss
description: A dungeon known as the Abyss has suddenly appeared. To open the "Door of Darkness" at its deepest point, the Seeker plunges into the dungeon gate... in search of the truth. Survive the onslaught of dark forces in this twin-stick survival shooter! — Do you have the will?

title: Metal Slug SB Fanthology
description:
Metal Slug SB Fanthology is a fan game developed by SuperBlinky, which has been in development since 2020. The latest version of the project is 0.7.2.

The main goal of the project is to create 8 new Metal Slug experiences based on the 8 mainline games, while also providing a 4-Player Co-op and a new VS. mode.

title: DCS World: AH-64D Outpost Campaign by Stone Sky
description: Explore the chronicles of the Syrian War in the OUTPOST campaign series. In the second installment, you'll dive into the events of 2012-2017, piloting the AH-64 Apache helicopter. Take on the role of U.S. pilots navigating through some of the most challenging phases of this conflict.

title: DCS World: F-16C Dragon's Fury Campaign by SorelRo
description: Dragon's Fury: DCS F-16 Viper is a fictional story-based campaign that will test your skills using the DCS F-16 Viper in a variety of missions while you operate with the 23rd Fighter Squadron, The Fighting Hawks.

title: The Short Bread Game
description: A cozy platformer where you help a piece of bread get to the bakery for breakfast. Though your path there may not be the most direct, you'll get to explore charming places. Jump high, run from enemies, and engage in witty dialogue with your odd new friend.

title: Cast Dice Away
description: A board game-style survival adventure on a deserted island! In Cast Dice Away, roll dice to explore the island, gather resources, and survive. Each roll triggers unpredictable events, challenging you to strategically navigate diverse environments as you seek escape.

title: Industrial Annihilation
description: The next major game in the Planetary Annihilation universe, Industrial Annihilation combines the iconic real-time strategy of the beloved Annihilation games with deep factory-building to deliver a blend of genres unlike any you’ve experienced before.

title: Short Trip
description: An interactive illustration five years in the making where you drive a cat tram through picturesque mountain villages. A relaxed, casual, delightful experience. Ding ding!

title: Dirtbag Mahjong
description:
Lie, cheat, and steal your way to victory in Dirtbag Mahjong!

Choose your character and join five other dirtbags for a night of riichi mahjong - with a twist. Nobody here plays fair, and they've all got some dirty tricks up their sleeves.

Dirtbag Mahjong is a complete and beginner-friendly mahjong experience that also offers some party game surprises to keep experienced players guessing.

title: DCS World: UH-1H Peacekeeper Lebanon Campaign by Flying Cyking
description:
Lebanon, September 2006.
It has been four weeks since the end of the second Lebanon war (July War). UN Forces have been deployed to ensure the ceasefire agreement and stabilize the southern regions of Lebanon.

title: Silent Hill: The Arcade
description:
Silent Hill: The Arcade is an arcade game based on Silent Hill survival horror series by Konami. The Arcade has currently never been officially ported to consoles or on PC, thus the game is rare.

However, in February 2014, it was unofficially ported to PC (Windows XP & 7) by a group of talented fans known as Insert More Coins, although setting up the game may be difficult as it can only run on monitors that support 640x480 resolution and is apparently not Windows 10-compatible.

On Sept 2015, another fan known as Biffman 101 re-published the port on their blog and following a conversation with an anonymous commenter, in 2019, a Windows 10 compatible version was emerged and published, on their blog post (The Collection Chamber - SILENT HILL: THE ARCADE).

title: Covenant
description: Covenant is a first-person dark fantasy combat game in which you play as a messenger sent from above. Wield martial arts, secret magic, and ancient weapons to explore a vast interconnected world.

title: Spatial Ops
description:
Turn Your Home Into a Battlefield in Spatial Ops – The Ultimate Mixed Reality Multiplayer Experience!
Step into fast-paced, competitive and cooperative battles with friends in Spatial Ops. Compete in co-located matches with up to 8 players in real-world environments, transforming your space into an action-packed arena.

title: Breath of Death VII: The Beginning - Reanimated
description: The fast-paced supernatural RPG, Breath of Death VII, has been resurrected and remastered! Embark with our undead heroes on a bone-rattling post-apocalyptic adventure through an undead world, now more vibrant than ever, to exhume the mysteries of the past.

title: Fortnite OG
description:
FORTNITE OG is BACK and here to stay. Drop into Chapter 1 and explore the OG map, collect OG loot, and relive OG gameplay.

THE OG OG RETURNS Solos or Squads, drop into battle with Fortnite OG: Chapter 1. Build your way to pure victory in Battle Royale or dominate the Island in a new way with Zero Build. Each Fortnite OG season runs approximately two months, bringing back the legendary loot and features from back in the day.

CLASSIC COOL IN THE OG PASS The Fortnite OG Pass features 45 tiers of retro rewards with a modern twist on items and Outfits. A new OG Pass will be available every OG season for 950 V-Bucks or in Fortnite Crew including the OG Pass, new Battle Royale, Music and LEGO Passes in Fortnite Crew for 1,400 V-Bucks. Getting this add-on is not necessary to access this content.

title: River Towns
description: Solve puzzles by placing buildings and creating vibrant cities in River Towns. Each district has its own style and shapes, making every level a new challenge. Help to restore and rebuild our River Towns.

title: Midnight Snack
description: Midnight Snack is a short and surreal first-person horror game where you wander through an eerie forest using the dials of a microwave.

title: Fortnite Reload
description: Fortnite Reload is a 40-player fast-paced Battle Royale game that is all about carrying the squad to Victory. Reboot as long as one teammate is still in the action! Loot up after rebooting to get back into fighting shape! Eliminate opponents to reboot teammates faster! Near the end of the match, reboots will stop. Lock in with your squad to secure the Victory Royale!

title: Are You Kidding Me?
description: A slice of life adventure with a collection of narrative driven micro games all about the inhabitants of Nowhere Space - where all lost and forgotten things end up.

title: The Queen of Battlers 2
description:
The Queen of Battlers 2 is a 2016 crossover fighting game by doujin circle Capricorn. It parodies the "King of Fighters" series and features a cast made up of female characters from various visual novels. It is the sequel to the 2012 game The Queen of Battlers.
Characters are organized into teams, representing the following games: ONE (Tactics), Kanon (Key), AIR (Key), Clannad (Key), Little Busters! (Key), Tayutama (Lump of Sugar), SHUFFLE! (Navel), Really? Really! (Navel), and Tick! Tack! (Navel). The characters Kanna (from AIR), and Saber (from Fate/stay night) are also featured as individual characters who are not part of any team. Secret characters include Saber Alter and an alternative version of Sakura Yae.

title: Rusty Road Racing
description: A fun rally simulator focusing on car physics modeling, tire skidding, and suspension functionality! Full camera customization, recording, and sharing features! Incredible turns and jumps await drivers who are crazy enough!

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 - Season 1
description: Ready to wreak havoc? The Black Ops 6 era is here. Prepare for a vast new season of content with five Multiplayer maps plus a festive Nuketown variant, seven new weapons, a brand-new Zombies map, and full Call of Duty: Warzone integration along with a new Resurgence map.

title: Headquarters: World War II - Ardennes
description: Headquarters: World War II - Ardennes is the second DLC for Headquarters: World War II, a fast-paced turn-based strategy game where your battlefield tactics are as important as your army management skills.

title: The Talos Principle: Reawakened
description: Step back into a world of thought-provoking puzzles, philosophical intrigue, and breathtaking visuals with The Talos Principle: Reawakened - a first-person puzzle masterpiece for both new players and long-time fans alike.

title: Rule the Waves 3: Expanded Battles
description: Prepare to return to the definitive naval warfare simulation game, Rule the Waves 3, with the new Expanded Battles expansion! Take your love and knowledge of 20th century naval warfare from the exciting campaigns of the base game and get ready to craft and fight the naval battles of your dreams.

title: Commander: Europe at War
description: Commander: Europe at War is a turn-based strategy game and a remake of the 2007 classic. Spanning six epic WWII campaigns, command air, land, and sea forces, research advanced technologies, manage resources, and strategically assign commanders to shift the course of battle.

title: Distant Worlds 2: Return of the Shakturi
description: An ancient evil is returning to the vast universe of Distant Worlds 2. The Return of the Shakturi is the third expansion and first feature expansion for the acclaimed 4X space strategy game, Distant Worlds 2. It adds a full endgame crisis and story, along with numerous new gameplay features and improvements that elevate the experience to new heights.

title: Annoy Squidward
description: Total conversion mod that transforms Springfield into Bikini Bottom.

title: Headquarters: World War II - Market Garden
description: Headquarters: World War II - Market Garden introduces a new British campaign with 8 meticulously crafted battles covering the events of Operation Market Garden. Your force has to reach the paratroopers holding the key bridges as soon as possible. However, nothing goes according to plan - and your troops have to deal with the ensuing chaos.

title: Chained Echoes: Ashes of Elrant
description: Eldrea is calling once again. Eldrea needs you. One. More. Time. Ashes of Elrant is the official DLC for the highly acclaimed Chained Echoes, offering you more of what you enjoyed so much. Meet all your beloved characters and answer the call as the Crimson Wings are needed once again.

title: On My Way Home
description: You're standing at the bus stop, eager to get home, when suddenly, the unexpected happens. Desperation pushes you to knock on the door of a nearby house, hoping for help, but stepping inside turns out to be a mistake you’ll regret.

title: Nice Day for Fishing
description: The world needs you Adventurer! Embark on an RPG pixel adventure where you’ll play as Baelin the humble fisherman, who must rise-up to become the hero of Honeywood. Battle fish with precision timing and magic spells, upgrade your abilities, defeat evil and rebuild Honeywood.

title: Atmosfear: The Third Dimension
description: Atmosfear: The Third Dimension is a 1995 PC game based on the Atmosfear video board game series. It combines strategy, horror, and time-sensitive challenges as players race against the clock to escape a supernatural realm.

title: Yellow Trouble
description: 8-way water gun blasting horizontal 2D arcade co-op shoot ‘em up, with ducks?!

title: Virtual Cottage 2
description: Study alone - or together in your own customizable cottage! Virtual Cottage 2 motivates and supports you in tackling your daily tasks. Use its built-in productivity tool to accomplish your goals faster. Create your ultimate cozy space with hundreds of items.

title: Sheol Inferno
description:
Sheol is a roguelike card game based on Dante's Divine Comedy.

You will accompany Dante on his journey through the 9 circles of Hell and fight alongside him to defeat the guardians of the circles.

Use the cards from the Spanish deck or Poker deck to complete the missions that will be assigned to you in each circle and thus be able to access the next one.

During the game you will earn gold that will allow you to obtain Blessings to help you on your adventure and, at the end of the game, you will be able to improve your skills on your character sheet.

FEATURES:
- Card roguelike.
- Spanish deck of cards or Poker deck.
- Character progression.
- Deck Management.
- Based on the lore of the Divine Comedy.
- Highly replayable.
- NO micro transactions.

title: TankHead
description:
Embark on a thrilling journey as Whitaker, piloting a drone-controlled tank through the desolate ECA. Battle fierce enemies, scavenge valuable parts, and fight to survive in this fast-paced sci-fi world, as you strive to reach the mysterious Highpoint.

As Whitaker, your goal is to fight to reach Highpoint. To do that, you must traverse the Event Containment Area – an area where humans cannot survive. Whitaker must project his mind into a Needle, a robust drone capable of surviving in the harsh conditions of the ECA, and also of piloting your Tank. Use your Needle and Tank to combat the vehicles and creatures of the ECA to reach Highpoint.

Explore the ECA, a world torn apart by war and a mysterious cataclysmic event that left it uninhabitable by humans. Explore the Deadzone, where humans must “tele-project” their minds into drones in order to survive and pillage the remains of a once great society.

Your vehicle of choice is a Light Tank, capable of moving quickly and delivering devastating damage to your enemies and the reactive world around you. Your tank can be equipped with various weapons, armors, wheels, motors and abilities to customize your gameplay.

Use a variety of weaponry to dismantle your enemies, blow off their parts, and take a clear shot at their exposed weak points to deliver decisive blows. Defeated enemies will leave behind their remaining parts for you to salvage or steal. Take what you need, scrap the rest. Use everything to survive.

title: Steampunk Shinobi
description: Steampunk Shinobi is a roguelite action game set in a Steampunk/Medieval Japan-inspired world. Play as a lineage of Shinobi, where each death passes the quest to the next generation. Procedurally generated maps evolve with your actions, making every playthrough unique!

title: Daycare Dungeon
description: Dungeon Crawler is an upcoming roguelite, hack n' slash, platformer puzzle game. Makhoba discusses how Dungeon Crawler's imagination mechanic works, the inspiration behind the game's creation, and more.

title: GameMaker 25th Anniversary
description: Join us in celebrating twenty five years of GameMaker with GameMaker 25th Anniversary! A fun look at the process behind creating the world's greatest 2D Game Engine! Manage your development house, keep your employees happy, and squash bugs as they come up!

title: Muri: Wildwoods
description: Explore the mysterious creature-filled Wildwoods as a Muri. Find secrets, solve puzzles, befriend creatures, and clean away the corruption. Restore the world's beauty in this cozy adventure!

title: The Irony
description: You are a nameless mercenary, dispatched to the research facility 'UNDERDOG CORP.' Survive the horrors of this dangerous facility, twisted by human experimentation, and uncover the hidden secrets within before they consume you.

title: Whiskara
description: Whiskara is an action role-playing game where you play as a cat named Lyra. Whiskara also features choice-driven storytelling

title: Atomic
description: Atomic is a faithful freeware remake of Thalion's classic Atomix. The gameplay and levels are identical - just cosmetically upgraded with SVGA graphics and a Windows interface. Move different atoms around the screen to create the required molecule.

title: Classic Sonic 3D Adventure
description:
Sonic and Tails take on a new adventure and experience from the norm. In objective to stop Eggman to take control over all the flickies is this unusual world.
Dr. Robotnik latest evil device suck Sonic and Tails to some other dimension taking everything they know with them. As the best option, they have to stop Dr. Robotnik and save all the flickies to bring them back to their original world!

title: A Happy New Year
description:
A Happy New Year is a short text-based game where you spend New Year's Eve alone by the river. It's about getting messages from drunk people, about the need to justify what you're doing and maybe just about ordinary teenage-kitsch, too.

The game mixes personal experiences with fiction and would best be described as a mood-game. It's not necessarily about the story itself, but about a specific feeling at a specific time. It takes about 10 - 15 minutes to complete.

title: Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Sonic Suit
description: Costume 'Sonic Suit' for Morgana.

title: Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Protagonist's Life in the Attic Set
description: Costumes 'Casual Training Outfit' and 'Loungewear' for P5 Protagonist.

title: Zenpu-kun
description: A Shogi application developed by Hiroshi Yamashita utilizing his award winning YSS (Yamashita Shogi System) program. The AI system developed in this game would be implemented by Yamashita in collaboration with I4 in their AI Shogi series.

title: Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Heeho's School Uniform
description: Costume 'Heeho Costume' for Morgana.

title: Undercook
description: A single-battle Undertale fan game, featuring Archo the dino chef.

title: Golf Up
description: Enjoy Golf Up with friends and family!

title: Arcade Archives: City Bomber
description: It's a frantic chase scene to escape!

title: A Maze Against Time
description: A Maze Against Time is a dynamic game where you race in one labyrinth after another against a timer that gets smaller every time you win. To top that, if you rack high enough of a highscore the labyrinth gets more complex! Find the exit, accelerate and blow the maze walls up in this puzzler action game!

title: Agent Fall
description: Infiltrate and destroy in side-scrolling shooter style!

title: Airport Police Contraband Simulator: Border Patrol
description: Protect the airport, stop the smugglers.

title: Chained Through Hell
description: Escape the underworld, but don’t break the chain—or each other.

title: Cazzarion: UFO Kidnapping
description: Fly over a city with an alien UFO and kidnap the residents

title: Backrooms: Inside the Escape
description: Venture through a labyrinth of seemingly endless, creepily familiar corridors based on popular Creepypasta lore.

title: Bunny Mazes
description: Bunny Mazes is a 2D maze game where you need to make your way through 50 levels, consisting of 500 mazes, within time limit. Collect time bonuses, avoid dangers and decide what path to go to complete all the mazes.

title: Chess Infinity
description: Whether you're new to chess or a seasoned master, welcome to Chess Infinity—the art of timeless strategy. Immerse yourself in serene environments, sharpen your skills with an adaptive AI mentor, and connect with players worldwide. Embrace endless challenges that transcend eras and borders.

title: Collectible Card Shop Master
description:
Who cares about the ordinary cards? And only the chosen few know that they can be a real treasure! Your collecting dreams can come true.

Open a trading card shop in your town and expand across the world. Let the passionate come to you and find something special. Create an iconic place for your friends to gather!

Expand and upgrade your store. Become a true perfectionist and turn this boring space into a stylish home for collectors.

Organize the space - add new features so everyone can find what they are looking for. Open new zones for customers to buy, trade or play in.

Search for rare collections and sell them in your store. Find the diamonds for you and your special collections!

Make your store and card collection the best in the world!

title: Decoration Rush
description: Run and decorate! What could be stranger and more fun?

title: Strong Buy Strong Sell
description: Strong Buy Strong Sell is a fast-paced financial strategy game where you step into the shoes of a stock trader. Your main objective is to buy stocks at a low price and sell them for maximum profit. But beware: the market can crash at any moment, causing the value of your investments to plummet. Your goal is to make as much money as possible while avoiding bankruptcy! Success hinges on your ability to take calculated risks and act swiftly.

title: Trade Em Up: TCG Empire Shop
description: From booster packs to business stacks—build the ultimate card shop empire!

title: Rooftop Rascal: The Glitch Cat
description: In "Rooftop Rascal: The Glitch Cat," take control of a nimble cat scaling fire escapes and rooftops in a Vaporwave-themed adventure. Test your quick thinking and jumping skills as you climb higher and higher to reach the rooftop.

title: Malu the Princess
description: Help Malu Reclaim Her Stolen Crown!

title: Jump Race
description: Jump high. Run fast. Win the race!

title: Internet Cafe Simulator 2025
description: Run your own internet café! Manage, upgrade, and customise every detail to create the ultimate hangout in this immersive first-person simulation.

title: Gun Shop Dealer Simulator
description: Master the art of gunsmithing and business!

title: Gun Bro
description: GunBro is an action-packed side-scrolling run ‘n’ gun game

title: BeatBlast: Rhythm Rampage
description: Ride the Rhythm, Blast the Beats, Save the Universe!

title: Meow Moments: Celebrating Renewal & Romance
description: Join cute cats in festive scenes! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore New Year's on Copacabana beach and share sweet moments for Valentine’s Day.

title: Anime Dance-Off: Around the World
description: Step into a universe where music and movement collide in a spectacular party experience for seasoned rhythm gamers and newcomers.

title: Save Christmas With Santa
description: SAVE CHRISTMAS WITH SANTA!

title: Archer Maclean's DropZone: 40th Anniversary Edition
description: Celebrating a Retro Classic: The Return of DropZone in "ARCHER MACLEAN'S DROPZONE - 40th ANNIVERSARY EDITION"

title: High Cars 2
description: Sky-high racing

title: Cookulo
description: Cookulo: An experimental cooking game where your mission is to complete your Recipe Book!

title: Hentai Girls: College Romance
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: 2 in 1: Trash Punk & Food Truck Tycoon
description:
Jump into your food truck and business will bump up!
Rock the apocalypse in punk style!

title: Pararecords
description: As a counselor in a mysterious facility, you are to examine children with strange powers and fill in their "Paranormal Records". In this story-based, choice-driven game, you will have to pry open your subjects' minds... but what you find inside them could prove dangerous.

title: Arena Warrior
description: Jump, Slide and Wallride your way across a multitude of arenas fighting off waves of enemies using different weapons and movement equipment to survive. Fight epic bosses and gain new abilities to strengthen your run in this fast past rouge-like arena fighter.

title: Deepy
description: Deepy is an underwater complex built to house a maximum-security prison, where the most dangerous inmates on earth are forced to work extracting gold from the seabed.Your task? Fight, help survivors, search for objects and solve puzzles all to survive, escape and reach the surface.

title: There's No Dragon!
description: Alone on a plot of land with a few resources and a single building, your civilization will begin here. Exploit resources, explore and conquer other regions, develop technologies, and fend off relentless barbarian attacks. Everything is manageable: they don't have a dragon!

title: Trainz 2019: BR Class 24 - Blue & Green
description: The British Rail Class 24, also known as the Sulzer Type 2, was a class of diesel locomotives that operated on the British Rail network. A total of 151 units were produced. They had a maximum speed of 75mph, and a power output of 1160 hp, and were nicknamed 'rats' due to their abundance.

title: Trainz 2019: B08 Baggage Car
description: Build by INKA (An Indonesian Train Industries Company) on 2008. This car is running on the Java island of Indonesia. Some of this "Cargo" cars are coupled with the Passenger train service. This content has Animated doors and custom product.

title: Trainz 2019: RCH 14T Class A/B Tankers
description: RCH 14T Class A/B Tankers were built between 1939 and 1944, and lasted up till the early 1970s. This pack includes 8 variants of the class A and B tankers in the BR era, each with 3 levels of weathering, and animated couplings, handbrakes and brake gear.

title: Trainz 2019: Pro Train - Altoona Works
description: This route features ‘Altoona Works' and it (also known as Altoona Terminal) is a large railroad industrial complex in Altoona, Pennsylvania. 10 new locomotives are included.

title: Trainz 2019: Model Trainz - Germany
description: Model Trainz: Germany is a German themed model railway route with several inspirations from different parts of Germany and a few from the classical routes from UTC. The route takes place in the valley of the mountains and in the mountains.

title: Trainz 2019: SA AN Class - Australian National
description: The AN Class entered service on Australian National's standard gauge network from Broken Hill to Adelaide, Alice Springs and Perth. In 1995, all were leased to National Rail, and later were transferred to Pacific National where they were used on a wide variety of trains.

title: High Sidin': Hyphy Edition
description: HighSidin’: Hyphy Edition is a game about Bay Area dance battles. Navigate through the ranks of the National Sideshow League (NSL), traversing well known cities in the Bay Area. Make your way through the campaign by dancing in 4 unique sideshow tournaments, each with their own look, and aesthetic. Battle with friends in the couch multiplayer mode. Refine your skills against opponents in practice mode. Go from local to well known star and become the best dancer in the bay area.

title: Care
description: Care is an atmospheric first person horror game where your choices have consequences. Be observant with your surroundings and unravel the horrific secrets that hide within these walls.

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 0 - Dooms' Rise
description:
From what we can tell… it began out of curiosity.

Inspired by Doctor Doom and his never-ending quest to unravel the mysteries of time, Season 0 isn't just the beginning, it's the explosive start to innumerable conflicts beyond imagination. Between Doctor Doom and his counterpart from 2099, no one knows who will be the final victor, but everyone knows that the time has come to ignite the battle.

title: Anzu
description: Solve match-4 puzzles with Anzu to gather treasure, hatch eggs, and discover all the secrets of the prehistoric hub!

title: Lythe The Forgetful Witch: A Visual Novel
description: Guide Lythe, a naïve witch on a journey through the spooky world of Samhain, as she seeks the High Witch and rediscovers her magic. This visual novel features spell crafting, rune seeking, and memory game mechanics, all while unraveling the desires of her monstrous friends!

title: Duck Eggs
description: Welcome to Duck Eggs, an innovative game that mixes desktop pet, collection, trading, clicking and surprise elements together. In this world, you'll collect all kinds of rare and fantastic duck eggs . Eventually, you can exchange them for money to help the duck go back to her original world.

title: Echoes of Formosa: Agent Reborn
description: Embark on a journey through Taiwan’s rich history in 'Echoes of Formosa: Agent Reborn.' Play as Li Bin, a secret agent awakening in the prison of Stad Zeelandia, on the brink of war. Unravel mysteries, explore ancient streets, and reclaim lost memories in this immersive adventure.

title: Akuro & Bahaku: Jungle Adventure
description: Akuro and Bahaku were happily living in the jungle when the forces of darkness suddenly attacked, shrouding the entire jungle in darkness. Akuro and Bahaku had no choice but to set out on a journey to find a way to combat the darkness...

title: Your Study Mate
description: If we both get into North University, we can achieve happiness! Of course, if we both pass the lawyer exam, that's not a bad option either (laughs). What's in front of you is such a companion-oriented focus game.

title: Xióng Chuǎng Tiānxià
description: Xiong Chuang Tian Xia is a realistic puzzle game set in the Middle Ages. Players will play as a brave warrior, crossing various dangerous levels, challenging powerful bosses, clearing all monsters, and saving people from danger.

title: Overview: Rain Echoes
description: Overview: Rain Echoes is a music adventure game where players explore the City of Rain, divided between day and night. Using a music box as a guide, players will collect scattered melodies, restore them, and perform the music to awaken forgotten memories and hear long-lost stories.

title: Snow Ash
description: "Snow Ash" is a stand-alone independent game about running a business in the snowy wasteland developed by 3 people! The player plays the role of a courier who delivers goods on the snow. The delivery process will be presented in a light Rogue+DBG way, with some survival elements.

title: Wind's Poem
description: In this visual novel, you will meet a group of distinct characters with different pasts from the perspective of an ordinary college student - the protagonist Luo Yu, and experience a profound love story, feeling youth and illusion in the university where you are studying.

title: Hit A Plane
description: This is a simple casual flying game where players control their fighter jets to eliminate enemies, and their scores accumulate points as the enemies are eliminated!

title: The Journey to Life
description: The dead are imprisoned in a cage, while the living are confined to the past. A mysterious small town, where the cycle of cause and effect is hard to find its end In the end, how should we make a decision and who can survive

title: Anomalies Detective
description: A psychological horror game with a chapter-based plot, thriller and unusual elements! You are a novice paranormal detective, exploring secrets and finding ways to escape in an infinite loop of scenes. Many unusual things happen during this process, as if some strange force wants to devour you...

title: Blackjack Tavern
description: Set in a magical tavern, choose your class and build your deck from over 300 cards to defeat your tavern opponents.

title: The Anchorite
description: A short point & click mystery/horror.

title: Legends BMX
description: Pure Flow and Adrenaline! LEGENDS BMX is an energetic and exhilarating game made for extreme sports enthusiasts! Ride your BMX through a variety of parks and scenarios designed to let you pull off incredible tricks.

title: DCS World: UH-1H Worlds Apart Stormfront Campaign by Low-Level-Heaven Mission Development
description: STORMFRONT is a story-driven campaign that follows the story of SPRING 2025. As in the first part of the WORLDS APART series, you find yourself in the role of a German Bell UH-1 helicopter pilot serving in the squadron "WOLF PACK," a German Army unit (Heeres Flieger).

title: The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search for a Dead Body
description: "Is there a dead body who'd like to be buried in me?" This is a coming-of-age adventure of a young boy who believes he's an ancient tomb! As Kofun, interact with all sorts of characters and objects. Gain points and spend them on new skills and hints to show Kofun a world of new experiences!

title: Atomic Heart: Enchantment Under the Sea
description: Enchantment Under the Sea goes back to the spectacular combat gameplay that made Atomic Heart one of the highlights of 2023, as players continue the main storyline with the Twins’ consciousness at their side and new weapons in their arsenal. Meet new and returning characters while diving into the mysteries of the underwater Neptune Research Center to find a way to save humanity from a dismal future. Players will also revisit familiar locations from Facility 3826 that have changed beyond recognition, like the flying city of Chelomey, now under the robots’ total control.

title: Chicken Run: Special Edition - Escape from the Pot-Pie Machine
DCS World: AH-64D The Four Horsemen Campaign by Fight's On Simulations
description: In 2014, the militant group Islamic State made vast territorial gains in Iraq and Syria following several offensives. It is claimed its territory was captured by a caliphate, within which it enforced a strict interpretation of Sharia. The group, which was designated a terrorist organisation by the United Nations, received universal condemnation for its human rights abuses and crimes against humanity. The Iraqi government formally requested of the United States and wider international community, they begin airstrikes against ISIL in support of their fight on the ground.

title: Cards and Dungeons
description: Cards and Dungeons is a roguelike dungeon crawler that blends strategic card play with fast-paced action. Choose your hero, equip your deck, and descend through ever-changing dungeons filled with monsters, traps, and brutal bosses. Every run is a test of survival, strategy, and risk management.

title: Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled: Xfinity Flash Kart
Imprimatura
description:
Imagine that you are an artist. Imagine that you are in mourning. A painter – your relative, and your former mentor – has died. In their will, they have left you seven paintings of your choosing from their collection. But which seven? What matters to you as both an artist and an inheritor of your mentor’s legacy? And what memories will these paintings stir up?
Imprimatura is a nonlinear work of interactive fiction that makes light use of procedural generation and heavy use of a multilayered painting that changes based on your choices.

title: Do Not Press The Button (Or You'll Delete The Multiverse)
description: A first-person, narrative-driven game featuring The Developer, who questions, taunts, and tests you at every turn. You shouldn’t press the button, but you’ll want to. You will have control, and you will have none. Power is in your hands... or is it?

title: Sly 2: Band of Thieves
description: A port of Sly 2: Band of Thieves enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Cryptogamous Flowers
description:
An immortality experiment gone horribly wrong at a plant factory. A husband and a wife that could never be separated.
Cryptogamous organisms -- the black spore disease -- and the female researcher that never thought she'd be pregnant.
Maria, the purity in a world devoid of it. An aberration.

Those three stories will intersect.

title: Needy Streamer Overload: Typing of The Net
description: "Needy Streamer Overload: Typing of The Net" is a typing game in which you enter internet lingo in a call-and-response format with a girl (OMGkawaiiAngel) who has a strong need for approval.

title: Akanemachi Kitan
description: In modern-day Tokyo, there is a town called "Akanegai" where humans and demons coexist. Will this alliance last?

title: The Passive Voice
description: The Passive Voice is a short, interactive visual poem and a video game that explores the struggle of my own lived experience with dyslexia and dyspraxia. The main player character is a bouncing eyeball. It acts as a clumsy and voiceless avatar that progresses through and around an ancient woodland representing a dark night of the soul, reminiscing, though stylised cutscenes, about difficult past traumas and the often-overlooked difficulties that neurodivergent people face daily.

title: The Mystery Mist
description: In this world, deadly toxic mist is everywhere. The protagonist, Yaqing, becomes an apprentice to a physician skilled in using insects to save his sister, who has been poisoned by the mist. As the story progresses, he finds himself entangled in a tense racial conflict…

title: Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves
description: A port of Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Ultima Founding
description: The Primaris are ready to step in the battle for the God Emperor and the Holy Throne. Eight new units and unique gameplay mechanics will give you more options for the fight for Gladius Prime.

title: RuneQuest: Warlords
description: RuneQuest: Warlords is a battle-scale turn-based strategy game set in the Runequest universe. Immerse yourself in the rich lore of Glorantha. Become a warlord, master the use of runes and defend your tribe against the incursions of Chaos. Field an army drawing from heroes and creatures.

title: DCS World: F/A-18C Flaming Sunrise Campaign by Sandman Simulations
description: It is June 2005. Situation at Persian Gulf has been stable for some years. For the last month there has been rising tension from new direction while Iran has launched multiple naval and air force exercises at southern coast of the country. Iran has made political and diplomatic provocations against other Gulf States, mostly United Arab Emirates, accusing them about production of nuclear and chemical weapons and repeated attacks against Iran commercial shipping. Maybe most worrying was statement of Iran defense minister speaking in Iran television last week telling United Arab Emirates being governed by national socialist leaders threatening security of Iran citizens living in Emirates.

title: Prescription: Love
description:
"You wake up in a hospital with no memory of how you got there. A kind and attentive doctor assures you that you will be under his care, patiently nursing you back to health. No one seems to know what caused your condition. "

Will you recover your lost memories...? Or has he made sure you never will?

title: Lost Footage: Sound In The Silence
description: Sound in the Silence is a horror game where you must find and destroy 10 Totems in a quiet, ominous environment. With each Totem destroyed, more monsters appear and eerie sounds increase, raising the tension. Survive the growing fear and complete your mission before it's too late.

title: The Burton Equation
description: Time is an equation, and you're here to solve it. 1920s Chicago detective Zachary Burton must defeat the Combine's attempts to influence humanity's past in the 20s, 40s, and 80s, and then achieve victory in the present - all the while pursued by a dark mirror of himself.

title: Devil Slayer: Raksasi 2
description: "Devil Slayer - Raksasi 2" is a top-down, action, role-playing game. The game offers four major professions with over a dozen growth directions, more than one hundred weapons, and a rich array of special abilities. Countless powerful enemies lie ahead, and the shattered world needs you to repair it.

title: Capy Castaway
description: Embark on a whimsical adventure with a capybara pup and a clever crow as they set off to find their way home! Sniff, dig, and fly as you explore a vibrant world brimming with wonder, challenges, and heartwarming friendships at every turn.

title: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping
description: When spookiness strikes a luxury campsite, the one and only Duck Detective is summoned to quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!

title: Little Rocket Lab
description: Transform your childhood home as you build brilliant factories and forge lifelong friendships, then reach for the skies and finally finish your family's dream - your mother's precious rocket ship. Roll up your sleeves, it turns out that saving this town really IS rocket science!

title: Locomoto
description: Locomoto is a cozy, life-sim adventure game set on a train, where you are the conductor! Customise and manage your train, while tending to your colourful passengers. Get onboard and embark on a journey through beautiful landscapes, accompanied by a soft, lofi original soundtrack.

title: A Waddleful Life
description: A sweet little game where you play as a duck and raise ducklings.

title: Pinbleton Park
description: Pinbleton Park is a small open world cosy adventure game where the whole world can transform into a giant pinball table. Help the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!

title: DLC Quest: Live Freemium or Die
Wylde Society
description: Step into the elegant heels of Vivian Wylde, witch, socialite and host, in period drama sim Wylde Society! Build, run and customise your magical boarding house in turn of the century Fairhaven. Host splendid events, expand your witchcraft, and influence the town. Who will you invite for tea?

title: Toem 2
description: Step back into the shoes of a curious photographer and set off on a brand new adventure all about uncovering hidden details, helping friends along the way, and documenting the world’s little wonders in TOEM 2, the sequel to the acclaimed TOEM.

title: Rocket League: Season 17
description:
High-score chasing and racing await as we press play on Rocket League Season 17. Prepare to level up your Soccar skills as this neo-arcade-inspired season kicks off on December 4!
⁠
In Season 17, try out the Online Free Play feature, battle for supremacy in the Neo Tokyo (Arcade) Arena, master the new Split Shot game mode, and look forward to leveling up a new Rocket Pass!

title: Sonic Game Land
description: «Sonic Game Land» is an unofficial fan-game featuring racing concept gameplay influenced by the titles like Sonic Rivals and Sonic Riders. Race with your opponents across four circuit-based zones to see who is faster.

title: The Magical Advenenture of Soggy Hoggy
Omega 6 The Triangle Stars
description: OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars is an adventure game with 16-bit styling, based on the manga by former Nintendo art director, Takaya Imamura.

title: The Dark Queen of Mortholme
description:
You are the Dark Queen—the most powerful being of your entire universe. Your lair is breached by an aspiring hero—a pitiful thing, easily crushed.

Except they keep coming back.

A 20 minute anti-game about an unconventional relationship and the capacity for change.

title: Shippin
description: Embark on a journey across cozy islands, where you’ll fish and experience magical moments. Uncover the stories of an ocean, where each harbor is a welcoming place, with friendly characters waiting to help guide you back home!

title: MineGeon: Renegades
description: Descend into Planet Paimo in MineGeon: Renegades, a chaotic multiplayer roguelite where you choose your renegade, delve into the minegeons, and battle unique enemies across diverse biomes. Fight, gather, improve, and die to uncover the secrets of Paimo and New Olympia.

title: Sin Squad: Stealth Assassins
description: Master 7 deadly assassins with unique abilities in the twisted world of Sin Squad: Stealth Assassins, a 3rd Person Stealth Assassination game. Use the environment and dozens of stealth tools to infiltrate a doomed city and set it free from the inside.

title: BrokenLore: Dark Dawn
description: BrokenLore: DARK DAWN is a first-person psychological horror where you face the horrors of abduction and fight to escape a warped reality. Do you have what it takes?

title: AM Archaic Memories
description: It's a 3D platform about the dreams and nightmares of a 90-year-old being.

title: Kraino Rebirth
description:
Sharpen thy scythe & lock n’ load! for you are about to enter a vast world of monsters, magic & mayhem!

Kraino is once again called into action! with his deadly scythe & hand-cannon

Cut & blast your way through a meticulously hand-crafted non-linear world filled with hazards, Ghoulies & ghosts! Gain powerful abilities to reach the unknown.

The world is vast & filled with more than just enemies, Along your journey you’ll encounter some friendly faces some of which might aid you (for a price)

title: L.I.A.C.F.F Tale of the Cursed Chain
Cosmorons
description: A mix of gravity-defying gameplay, slapstick-tinged parody, and a classic low-poly-inspired aesthetic all wrapped up in an addictive arcade shooter for 1-4 players!

title: Knock Off: The Battle for Imagination
description: Fight for the fate of imagination in this fast-paced 2D fighter inspired by classic arcade games and 80s/90s action figures. Master air combos, EX moves, assists, and super attacks with a roster of wild off-brand toy legends.

title: Kentum
description: Stranded in the year 10,000, Kent—an average Joe turned clone—must survive, explore, and rebuild civilization with the help of a snarky AI. Craft, farm, and automate in this 2D craftervania adventure as you uncover Earth’s secrets and kickstart humanity, one machine at a time.

title: Take Us North
description:
Take Us North is a narrative adventure survival game that follows the journeys of migrants and asylum seekers on their way to cross the US-Mexico border.

Inspired by real-world stories, Take Us North aims to foster greater awareness and empathy about some of the most crucial global issues of our time.

title: Space Hunters
description: Join space bounty hunters in a brutal 2D handmade beat 'em up, where every punch and kick is fueled by action and greed. Battle your way through a gritty, money-driven universe in this intense, fast-paced adventure.

title: Go Slimey Go!
description: Go Slimey Go! is an easy-to-pick-up game for players of all ages! Help Slimey, our tiny slippery protagonist, visit his friends for some well deserved teatime after some thrilling platforming challenges! Just make sure not to get caught in the middle of the ultimate showdown between good and evil!

title: Curse of the Dragonbeast
description: A team-turn-based MOBA centralized around slaying monsters, gathering items, gaining levels, and competing in teams of five to slay an enemy teams dragon. CotDb takes place in a grimdark alternative future where dragons have returned to Earth, use their blood to grant magical powers to humans, and uses the same dragons blood to control their minds. Humans are used as soldiers in their war against other dragons, as they seek to collect magical artifacts to grow their Draconic magic. The player takes on the role of a dragons thrall, venturing into the wilds to fight enemy thralls and retrieve treasure for their master.

title: Kenneth Rice: Vampire Detective
description: You play as Kenneth Rice; a 130-year-old hard-boiled detective with sensibilities firmly in the 1920s era from when he was bitten by a vampire. When he gets a call from a mysterious stranger with a missing necklace, Kenneth steps up to the challenge; using his detective skills and vampiric transformation powers to solve the case. (And maybe fall in love?)

title: Remnants of Calandria
description: Remnants of Calandria is a short one-hour-long RPG Maker MV game submission to the 2022 Indie Game Maker Contest: Rebirth. It is a short top-down action-exploration game with a real-time battle system, about prowling through the remains of a destroyed land and the small civilization that's managed to recover from it.

title: 8-Bit Blocks
description: Discover a world of blocky action in 8-Bit Blocks for the Commander X16!

title: Bonk The Goblins!
description: Bonk the Goblins! is Whackamole meets microgames! It's full of hectic and funny score attack arcade action.

title: Anomaly Patroller
description: Story: You are being hired to become an anomaly patroller. Your job is to investigate the area that is being haunted by anomalous activity through the special protocol. If there's an anomaly, press the button then proceed. If there's no anomaly, proceed without pressing the button. You must make it to area 20 to finish the protocol. Good luck.

title: Gemwielders
description: In this competitive deckbuilding game you are a Gemwielder, capable of controlling an ancient artifact weapon. Socket mystical gems to acquire powerful abilities and prevail in a duel against another Gemwielder.

title: DCS World: F/A-18C Inherent Resolve Campaign by Looking Glass
description: Welcome to Inherent Resolve - an exciting and immersive player friendly campaign for the F/A-18C Hornet in Syria.

title: DCS World: AV-8B Kerman Campaign by Ground Pounder Sims
description: Join ‘Detachment B’ of US Marine Corps Harrier squadron VMA-311 as they embark on ‘The Kerman Campaign’. The 2011 Arab Spring has driven civil unrest across the middle east and in Iran has resulted in the violent repression of it’s citizens, this chain of events has led to the formation of a US led coalition and the launch of Operation Persian Freedom. The Kerman Campaign puts you in the shoes of USMC Captain Mitch ‘Mike-Mike’ Mickleson as the Harrier pilots of ‘Det B’ fight to protect their fellow marines on the ground.

title: Tile Tales: Pirate
description: Solve logic puzzles while following the journey of a mischievous pirate as he plunders his way across a mysterious secluded island in search of the ultimate treasure!

title: DCS World: Mosquito FB VI - V for Victory Campaign by Reflected Simulations
description: Some of the thrilling sorties flown by Mosquito units in World War II belong to movie screens rather than history books. The ’wooden wonder’ flew in an astonishing variety of roles, and some of them were truly stranger than fiction. ’V for Victory’ will take you through most of these different sorties: Night intruder, ranger, oboe pathfinder, noball, photo recce, Joan Eleanor - just to mention a few.

title: Sunset Irreligion
description: A spiritual successor to their previous WAD Fallen Leaves

title: DCS World: F-14 Speed & Angels Campaign by Reflected Simulations
description: Some dreams are worth fighting for. “Speed and Angels, the Campaign” is a joint production between Reflected Simulations, and Commander Paco Chierici. Paco is a former Tomcat fighter pilot and F-5 bandit. He is the creator and producer of the film Speed and Angels and the novel Lions of the Sky. Together Paco and Reflected have joined forces to bring you a truly epic DCS campaign combining next level realism and immersion. You will live the campaign. Strap in.

title: Wooly Rockbottom and the Quest for the Golden Beard of Thor!
Fool's Pub
description:
Welcome to Fool’s Pub - The Online Multiplayer Card Game.

This isn’t just a card game – it’s an online multiplayer battle where up to four players compete in a high-stakes game of skill, luck, and survival. Outplay your friends or strangers from around the world and prove you’ve got what it takes to be the last one standing.

- First-Person Fun: Experience the game through the eyes of your character, bringing you closer to the action with every draw, bluff, and shot fired.
- Play Your Way: Jump online to challenge others or enjoy offline mode with clever AI opponents when you’re flying solo.
- Cute and Dangerous: Meet adorable characters packing serious heat – their charm hides a fierce determination to win at any cost.
- Rough Rules, Wild Rounds: With Russian roulette-style mechanics, every turn could spell glory or disaster. Will you take the risk or play it safe?
- Only One Wins: In this pub, there’s no second place. Outwit, outplay, and outlast everyone else to claim the ultimate victory.

Get ready for the perfect mix of strategy, adrenaline, and chaos.
Fool’s Pub is calling – are you brave enough to answer?

title: Christmas Bazaar: Manager Simulator
description: Christmas Bazaar - Manager Simulator is a relaxed first-person simulation game where every aspect of running a Christmas Bazaar comes to life.

title: Housekeeping to Room 501
description: A work simulator set in an old hotel that is definitely not haunted. Clean the rooms and make sure our guests feel at home!

title: Twelve Sky2 World
description: "Twelve Sky2 World" is a classic version of a large-scale 3D MMORPG online game developed based on "Twelve Sky 2" and exclusively operated by BacN Network Technology (Hong Kong) Co., Limited. In addition to continuing the complete game structure of the previous game, it also has more Rich game content, exquisite art expression and fast-paced battle scenes allow players to truly experience the world's grudges and never-ending hearty feelings.

title: Untravelled Planet
description: Outer space 3D-platformer action.

title: Holy Shot
description: Holy Shot is a fast-paced, physics-based top-down shooter. Face nasty hordes of monsters in a chaotic environmental destruction, combining powerful weapons and strategic abilities to survive intense battles against challenging bosses.

title: The Cabin Factory
description: Your job at the Cabin Factory is simple: inspect the cabins and decide on whether they’re haunted or not. If you do find any anomalies, get out…immediately.

title: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon
description: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build the course together. Add obstacles and dangerous traps, take the lead with power-ups, and race to the finish!

title: Recur
description: A time-bending journey to the end of the world and back. Run, jump, and manipulate time to solve puzzles as the apocalypse unfolds. Can you stop the clock on disaster?

title: Neon Abyss 2
description: Plunge into the chaotic cybermyth roguelike world of Neon Abyss 2! With diverse combat styles and unlimited item synergies, every run delivers a dramatic and action-packed experience you won't forget.

title: Fortnite Ballistic
description:
FORTNITE BALLISTIC is a first-person, 5v5 tactical FPS. Prove your talents, precision and teamwork to overcome your opponents.

Each round, use your skills and gadgets to Attack and Defend your side. Avoid elimination and outplay your opponents to secure victory for your team.

TACTICAL CHOICES MATTER.
Choose your gadget and lock in! Fortnite Ballistic provides unique, Flex gadgets that can alter the outcome of a round. Once you’ve locked in your gadget, add it to your arsenal during the Buy phase of each round and go ballistic.

FIRST PERSON, FULL IMPACT
Fortnite Ballistic is the first Fortnite mode built using the First Person Camera Mode Device in UEFN. Experience Fortnite in an all new way, challenging your skills and testing your tactics.

Getting this experience is not necessary to access this content. When you launch Fortnite using this through your Library, the experience will be pre-selected for your convenience.

title: Feltopia
description: In this hand-felted, stop-motion "cute-em-up," the realms of Feltopia have been infected by a mysterious Smog Spirit. Skyrider flies on their pegasus through wondrous landscapes to save their magical sheep, transform creatures, and battle bosses on their quest to uncover Feltopia’s secrets.

title: Blippo+
description: Blippo+ is a live-action, off-cable TV simulator. Channel-surf the stars and discover the staticky, radical world of Planet Blip through its soaps, sitcoms, news, weather, and talk shows. But don't touch that remote—everything's about to get bent.

title: Flaregate Network
description: Flaregate Network is a roguelike deckbuilder with RTS-inspired spaceship combat. Build a unique deck, then pilot it—and your fleet—to victory!

title: The Old Barn
description: The Old Barn is a short, 10-minute narrative experience in the walking simulator genre. Explore a cosy, messy, and warm old barn and listen to the musings of the narrator as she recalls growing up in this environment. Relax while you navigate this highly detailed environment, listening to the soothing voice inviting to calm reflection and pondering of life's learnings and mysteries. Take your time and see if you can spot any secret objects hiding in the clutter -- examining them from up close might reward you with a display of light. Can you spot all seven of them?

title: Dreaming Seal Simulator
description: Dreaming Seal Simulator is a retro-style arcade game where you play as a seal of dreams and you have to calm down each kid that has a bad dream until the in-game time of 6AM - every 500 points can advance you towards that time.

title: Chumini: Tiny Army
description: In this vampire survivor-like, summon an army of tiny Chuminis to battle waves of forest demons. Each Chumini has its own movement patterns: it's up to you to manage this merry mess to create an unstoppable force!

title: Mtion studio
description: Create, play, and remix immersive 3D experiences with mtion—where you can bring immersive stories to life without coding. Build interactive worlds, publish with ease, and connect with a vibrant community across platforms like Twitch and YouTube.

title: Murder Gods Play Pachinko
description:
A group of friends gathers in a remote house for the first time in two years.

This is the place where Kaya took his life. Tensions are high, to say the least.

The snowstorm isn't letting up. It appears they're trapped. The only company they have is each other.

Little do they know -- time isn't on their side.

He's on his way.

title: Kaiju Control Force
description: Lead a team of survivors into the abandoned Kaiju Control Force facilities, where bioengineered rats escaped and research went awry long ago, in this one-screen arcade platformer. Jump, climb and buy items from vending machines to reach the Mecha Kaiju Maintenance Bay and reclaim our city!

title: A Bone To Pick
description: Ribsy is a skeleton, brought to life by the capricious Skeleton God. The Skeleton God is bored, and so he's set Ribsy a task- figure out who killed the pirate Captain who once owned Ribsy's bones.

title: A Single Fallen Feather
description:
"The Shadow Over the Sky, Cielvide, had been utterly defeated. But the shadows have started to grow ever deeper of late..."

A Single Fallen Feather is a turn-based RPG where the player creates a party of four out of 12 selectable classes.

title: Evoscape
description: Action Roguelike where you build your organism by dividing and placing cells. Pick from random mutations and specialize your cells in one of 11 genes. Test your organism in a fast paced melee- and ranged combat with timing-based parry system against enemies and bosses.

title: Fraction Munchers
description: Fraction Munchers is the second math based game in the Munchers series of educational games. Aside from the subject matter, the basic concept is the same as other games in the series. It is played on a grid where the player controls a creature called the Fraction Muncher who has to eat the numbers or fractional expressions that correspond to the statement that is written above the grid. Other creatures known as troggles roam the grid and try to get to the muncher. There are five different ones and they all have their own behaviour and movement patterns. Eating wrong answers or getting caught by a troggle leads to a life being lost. There are four different game modes which decide what kind of statements should appear: fraction types, equivalents, comparing and expression. Additionally there is a combined mode that mixes all.

title: Class of Heroes 3: Remaster
description: The classic, school-based 3D dungeon-crawling RPG is back! After a 15-year wait, the third installment in the series comes to the West, with new features, more characters, classes, and bigger dungeons.

title: Moldbreaker: Rise of the Loaf
description: Embark on a moldy adventure in a land of bread. Play as Bradley the Breadapus, a waffle-tailed bread platypus, in this quirky action platformer and battle to cleanse a world infected by mold. Break the mold, save the world!

title: Spirit of the Obelisk
description: Switch between four unique heroes, each with their own special ability in this charming puzzle platformer. Play alone or with a friend to complete interesting puzzles in vibrant themed worlds.

title: Crony Corp
description: Build your empire in a competitive world shaped by supply, demand, & shady deals. In Crony Corp, you’ll buy & manufacture goods in a live market that responds to every player’s actions. Trade smart, undercut rivals, bend the rules, and climb the corporate ladder. Just don’t expect fair play.

title: Version -1: Where Love Lies
description:
A prequel side story to Pokémon Rejuvenation, Where Love Lies tells the story of Keta and Taelia, presented in a short package of four chapters with two endings. It contains most of Rejuvenation's mechanics, based on Generation VII.

Where Love Lies eschews the traditional Pokémon formula, with no Pokédex, Gym battles or Pokémon catching. Instead, adding Pokémon to your party must be done through story progression or by finding them in secret locations.

title: Dawn of Kagura: Keika's Story
description: Vanquish and recruit youkai in randomized dungeons in Dawn of Kagura: Keika's Story, a replayable roguelike RPG! Strict big sis Keika wants to set a good example by exorcising evil with her priestess powers...

title: Dawn of Kagura: Hatsuka's Story
description: Vanquish and recruit youkai in randomized dungeons in Dawn of Kagura: Hatsuka's Story, a replayable roguelike RPG! It's one quest after another for Hatsuka, who's off to investigate a case of seriously unseasonable snowfall...

title: Zombie Tower Survivor
description: Survive the zombie apocalypse in this top-down, tower-defense game with survivor-like elements. Customize your magic tower with talents and upgrades to defend it against zombie waves. Can you keep your tower alive?

title: Die for the Economy!
description: Blast evil robots in a retro psychedelic maze of an office, as you bring down the security servers and make your way home. Die for the Economy! is a retro arcade survival game featuring beautiful, chunky pixel art graphics with a psychedelic slant harking back to the old 8-bit game systems.

title: Space Menace 2
description: Start small, expand your fleet, rise to power, and eventually command entire factions in this seamless blend of sci-fi space RTS and battle game. With strategic gameplay and evolving challenges, every decision shapes your legacy in the stars.

title: Digseum
description: Digseum is a short, unique incremental journey about digging up ancient relics and building the greatest museum ever! Excavate for ancient relics across the world, manage your resources and upgrade your abilities, and build the biggest and greatest museum the world has ever seen!

title: Pastopia
description: Become a Memory Walker in Pastopia and restore the mystical lands of Talmanu. In this open-world adventure, team up with your Golem A.I companion to explore vast environments, solve puzzles, and unleash your creativity. Discover the lost memories of Pastopia and shape your own adventure!

title: Stolen Realm Survivors
description: Stolen Realm Survivors is an online co-op survivor-like auto-shooter. Battle hordes of fierce enemies, discover ancient artifacts, merge unique skill trees, and unlock powerful upgrades to survive. Wield the full power of the Stolen Realm. Play solo or with friends against relentless minions!

title: Supply Chained
description: An Open World Capitalism RPG where you manage a supply chain and keep anyone from touching it with all means necessary.

title: Longjuice Squeeze
description: Shoot, parry, and slash your way to self-awareness in Longjuice Squeeze, a roguelite fighting game where you get to steal gear from your opponent when you win. Featuring wild art, sick music, rollback netcode, and highly customizable fighters.

title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Shared History
description: Shared History is a free update for Assassin's Creed: Valhalla. It follows Eivor Varinsdottir's meeting with Basim Ibn Ishaq's former mentor Roshan to combat common enemies who had joined forces against the two women.

title: Assassin's Creed Odyssey: Those Who Are Treasured
description: This is part 1 of the Assassin's Creed Crossover Stories that had Kassandra travel to the island of Korfu to explore the aftermath of obtaining the immortality-granting Staff of Hermes Trismegistus

title: End's Reach
description: End's Reach is a 3D Exploration Action Adventure Game that focuses on a character lost in the depths of space. Players will solve puzzles, collect upgrades, items, weapons and even magical abilities as they uncover the mysteries of this strange new world. A classic tale of technology taken too far.

title: Flexible Frosty
description: A short and icy GameBoy-style puzzle platformer featuring Frosty, a cute little penguin who can not jump like other penguins.

title: Darkbound
description: Darkbound is a survival horror game where you play as a cat. Avoid the darkness, solve puzzles and help other survivors to escape the hospital.

title: Adventurers Guild Inc.
description: Adventurers Guild Inc. is a turn-based management game where you run the business behind the heroics! Hire staff, post quests, and fulfill adventurers' needs (while taking a cut). Manage your budget, grow your reputation, watch adventurers scramble and build the greatest guild of all!

title: Sudden Soul
description: A sudden blackout within the city of Oasys causes havoc as people and creatures wake up with new powers. Control your party in this turn-based RPG with a mix of CCG. Combo different elements together. Light up an enemy who just got oil bombed, shock a ruffian after they get drenched in water.

title: RPG Chess
description: A turn-based RPG, except it's also chess! Every capture becomes a 1v1 battle decided by stats, elements and abilities. Build your team, climb the roguelite campaign, or duel friends and CPUs.

title: Wave Defense: Trappist
