description: Gear up and get going! Defend your outposts from waves of alien enemies with your mech. Build and upgrade your base, protecting the extraction of the mysterious planetary system’s rich resources!

title: Skatehouse
description: Skatehouse is a small idle game where you manage a skate shop. Manufacture pieces, combine parts, and sell boards.

title: An Abyss of Dreams
description: Two worlds, one nightmare. Explore a gruesome orphanage, solve puzzles related to an inexplicable phenomenon, and dive into the depths of dreams to uncover otherworldly horrors. An Abyss of Dreams is a cosmic horror point-and-click game set during the Great Darkness.

title: Love In Tiny Spaces
description: A bite sized quickie of a game, find your girlfriend and avoid her parents [and neighbours!] in this humorous tongue-in-cheek top-down stealth game! Navigate the corridors of the big city - then change it up using the powers of the Love Transport Authority(LTA), with love as your guide.

title: Bashful Adoration
description: Fight for your love with 2-4 friends locally or online in easy-to-learn, hard-to-master combat. Soar the skies on your broom, and dash and smash props and opponents until they're a twinkling dot on the horizon! Secure powerups, land devastating blows, and win the adoration of your crush!

title: Proud Dad Simulator
description: Have you ever wondered what it feels like to have a proud and supportive dad? Proud Dad Simulator gives you the loving father you wish you had growing up! Simply click dad to receive an affirmation, or delve deeper to explore all 10 minigames and collect all achievements.

title: Bambas!
description: Relive your childhood and turn every crosswalk, curb, and puddle into an epic adventure with this innovative urban walking simulator.

title: The Case of the Worst Day Ever
description:
A family is gathered for a cozy celebration, but everyone looks miserable! What happened here? Who are these people (and pets)?! And why are they so unhappy?!?

Revisit each family member's worst moment, deduce what happened, and cheer everyone up in this cozy fill-in-the-blank mystery!

title: Robo Ride & Glide
description: Ride, Glide, and collect powerups to upgrade your hover car, and gain an advantage against your friends in a random mini game

title: Qualia
description:
A Psychological-horror RPG. Eileen, a troubled human girl stumbles into an infinite-everchanging abandoned building. She gets lost and meets a new friend: a human-like doll. They search for an exit.

It's a story about friendship, humans and a naive girl separated from all of humanity.

title: Upstream
description: A physics-based upstream paddling challenge where every move matters. Navigate treacherous waters, dodge deadly obstacles, and fight against the current—but one wrong touch shatters your fragile glass boat, sending you back downstream. A brutally hilarious test of patience and skill.

title: Excavation Alliance: Cadoramo
description: A tough side-scrolling action roguelike game. In underground caves where various "animal" factions vie for resources, danger, treasures, and intrigue abound! To be a cave explorer, confronting numerous enemies with daggers, guns, great swords, or attack with magic wands!

title: A Case of Fraud
description: A non-linear detective adventure. Investigate a case of fraud by analysing documents from an abandoned office. Examine evidence, connect clues, and make your own deductions to solve the case.

title: Steel Century Groove
description: Pilot mecha in rhythm-RPG dance battles. Assemble a squad of colossal dancers, challenge every rival you lock eyes with, compete for the championship trophy, and uncover the secrets of a world where everything moves to the drumbeat of steel feet.

title: 1cm Time
description: Explore, adventure, collect, and experience anecdotes and various interesting characters in a city-based 3D RPG, discovering some beautiful little worlds. Or perhaps wander aimlessly on the streets, relaxing in the shade of trees. Such a wonderful time is not far away.

title: StarSim: BattleZone
description: StarSim: BattleZone is a real-time strategy (RTS) game set in the StarSim universe. Take command of an army and lead your faction to victory. Gameplay includes classic RTS mechanics such as: building a base, gathering resources, researching new technologies, building defences, training units, etc.

title: Gladiators of Citadelum
description: The ultimate gladiator management sim. Hire and train fighters in different disciplines, defeat your rivals in the arena, climb through the ranks and, remember, give the best spectacle Rome has ever seen to survive. Blood and glory await!

title: Sonic Frontiers: Sonic Adventure 2 Shoes
description:
Take it back to the early 2000s and railgrind in style with your own pair of iconic shoes from Sonic Adventure 2!

This offer is available to our newsletter subscribers in select countries who signed up prior to January 31, 2023.

title: Fogpiercer
description: Build your train to build your deck. Fight off bandits in a post apocalyptic world. Progress and unlock new train combinations with synergies. Get drivers to their final destinations.

title: Hyperwired
description: Pilot a ship with a charger hanging. Explore an ever-changing space an plug to recharge your energy while surviving the enemy breach in this cable-like space shooter with roguelike elements and plugged resource management.

title: Oni Magatsu Toki
description: A girl wakes up to find the world has been overtaken by God. Being the only human left, Okappa has no choice but to survive in this strange world. Her only companion is a mysterious white fox who strums a guitar.

title: Snakeloop
description: Snakeloop is a challenging puzzle game based on a simple idea: What if you took classic Snake but inverted the goal and made it so you have to form a loop by eating your own tail.

title: Ghostslayers
description: A top-down cooperative shooter where you play as mages with various unusual guns and spells, which you can use to create chaotic combinations that completely destroy everything in their path. Want an army of clones of yourself armed with miniguns whose bullets ricochet and explode? Sure thing. A leafblower that shoots leaves that automatically target enemies? No problem there either.

title: A Byte War
description: A Byte War is a real time strategy game where you lead a race of block-based machines against a machine threat from another dimension. Construct buildings from blocks arranged in various patterns and leverage your machines to convert the world around you.

title: Super Platform Tag
description: Tag, chase, and outsmart your friends in this chaotic platformer party game featuring your favorite variations of tag. Snag crazy power-ups, place obstacles to gain a winning edge, and unlock a colorful cast of characters and stages. Enjoy the ignorant bliss of childhood.

title: My Dark Eden
description: Dark Eden is a short visual novel, where, after accepting a job to investigate the remote mountains, you will meet two peculiar semi-humans along with a big old secret.

title: Scourge of the Reptiles
description: Scourge of the Reptiles is a party-based tactical RPG set in a prehistoric fantasy world. When a meteor strikes the Earth, humans, elves and dinosaurs alike are gifted with magical abilities—abilities that result in war, devastation and forces that stretch far beyond the hero’s quiet home village.

title: Yorumorukimiri: Hajimari no Shoujo
description: A cat, adorned with a guitar and a sword. The calls who calls himself a "demon", gazes at the universe. The demon observes a girl swiftly passing through the twinkling stars. The girl, racing through the cosmos, is known as the "Girl of The Beginning". This marks the concluding tale surrounding the mysterious dog and Yorumorukimiri.

title: Blast-A-Finn
description: A 2D physics-based platformer. play as a fish who can only move by blasting arm cannons in a direction and getting launched the opposite way.

title: Towelket One More Time: Kemono
description: The world has already ended. The protagonist, Okappa, wakes up to find her home overrun by killer beasts. She meets Shinshi, a white rabbit who will guide her through this ruined world. Meanwhile the other protagonist, a young Tanuki named Tantanuki begins his new life at PonPon school, a cheerful school that specializes in teaching machinery to beasts.

title: Iron Village
description: With the help of your railway, build houses, farms, warehouses, and more to create your village. Trade what your people make for other resources and gold to grow your village into a prospering town, and grow the railway into a powerhouse.

title: Incrate
description: Incrate is a mind-warping 2D/3D puzzle game within a crate! Bend reality and manipulate your perspective to solve the puzzles and escape!

title: Elemental Showdown
description: Unleash elemental chaos in this thrilling top-down arena party game! Fight using Fire, Water, and Plant elements, strategically switching between them to gain the upper hand. Navigate elemental shifting zones to outsmart your friends and emerge victorious!

title: Snake in the Dark
description: Sure, you've played Snake. But could you play it blind? Snake in the Dark is a total re-imagination of the timeless arcade and puzzle game classics like Snake and Sokoban. Fun gameplay you know delivered with more puzzling twisssts than you expect!

title: Hopeful Day Inside Room
description: Right after moving to a big city and getting a new apartment, you were fired from your job! And now you don't want to go outside again! Improve your skills, manage your time and find a way to make money without having to leave the room! Watch as your plans go down the drain and you sleep through the whole week!

title: Wanwan Datte Uchuu No Shinpi
description: The great adventures of Space Investigator Pon-kun. While on his mission to search for Area51 on Earth, he comes across a stray dog named Pucchi and turns her into a human girl. Unable to reverse his mistake, he takes her along on his journey.

title: I Come In Peace
description: Don't panic! survive the bullet hell action. As a goofy pacifist alien that crashed on Earth, use your tech abilities to evade paranoid humans whose deadly attacks on you cause destruction and mayhem. Navigate the chaos, collect your spaceship parts, and run the hell out of this crazy planet!

title: About a Boy
description: “About a Boy” immerses players in a narrative-driven journey set in a future city devoid of humanity as we know it. Through the eyes of Miro, a boy with the unique ability to perceive people based on their animal temperaments, players embark on a puzzle point-and-click adventure.

title: Pika Game 64
description: An interactive dreamy diary built using the Celeste 64 engine!

title: Finding America: New England - Collector's Edition
description: Explore scenic landscapes and rich history of this iconic region.

title: Mia and Me: Magic Friends
description: Take your unicorn for a ride through enchanting tracks. Discover the Rainbow Island, Crystal Cave, Heart Valley, Blackwood Forest, and many more magical locations. Help Mia, Yuko and Mo protect Centopia - take on exciting quests, search for magical items, and then, with the help of Phuddle, banish Gargona and the other villains! And then there's the cute little ponycorns you're sure to fall in love with too!

title: My Life: Zoo Vet
description: Take care of sick zoo animals!

title: CatCat
description: "CatCat" is a relaxing cat simulation game. Raise different breeds, feed them, and pet them. You can freely change the layout, arrange furniture, and alter wall colors to create a cozy space for you and your cats. There are no goals or pressure; just enjoy a peaceful time together with your cats.

title: The Spirit Guide
description: Play as the titular Spiritguide Ale in this beautiful top down 2D pixel art RPG. It's the night of the day of the dead festival, and families both celebrate and mourn their loved ones. You must take their gifts, and good memories and deliver it to the Spirits, so they may never forget who they are.

title: Slum Guide
description: Explore a mysterious slum town and recruit women seeking fortune. Use them as fighters in a coliseum or to defend yourself against local threats. As a cunning guide, gather intel, use tools, and manipulate secrets to immerse them into the town's hidden desires.

title: Iseikan Renai Guide: Interplanetary Love Guide
description: This PC game is a love simulation game set in the distant future where interstellar travel has become commonplace. Slavery, crime, violence... Interact with unique aliens and form close relationships with them in a world where anything is possible, where high technology and low technology coexist.

title: The Underworld of Brain Damage
description: Players can't attack. Players need to avoid attacks in the game and lead monsters' attacks to other monsters. Let the monster kill himself! ! ! The game map is random, the elements in the map are random, and there are many strange props, so that players have different game experiences every time.

description: A device that generates a blade of energy.

title: Earth Defense Force 6: Ranger Weapons: Broken MR98 Fang
description: A high-caliber sniper rifle with a damaged scope.

description: Special exoskeleton tuned for gunfire.

title: Earth Defense Force 6: Ranger Boarding Weapons - Free Bike No. 6
description: Custom military motorcycle.

title: Earth Defense Force 6: Fencer Weapons - Power Blade Zero
description: A blade for close combat. It produces a jet of light to slash the enemy.

title: Earth Defense Force 6: Fencer Weapons - 'OneeChanbara Origin' illustrated 'Disguised Body Pillow'.
description: A hammer disguised as a body pillow with the same specs as the Vibro Hammer.

description: Specially painted carrier equipped with multipurpose missiles.

title: Earth Defense Force 6: Air Raider Boarding Weapons - Eros No. 6

title: Earth Defense Force 6: Fencer Weapons - Proto Reflector

description: Adds the character "The Professor."

description: Adds the character "The Lieutenant."

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 - Don't Bring Civilians Into This: Special Appearance by The Captain from EDF6
description: Adds the character "The Captain."

title: Chirashiiru
description: A puzzle game where you have to follow the arranged themes.

title: Energy Crush
description: This is a 2D online shooting game. Up to four players can play against each other. It is still in development, so there is only one mode and few types of players. I would like to hear the opinions of users, so I would appreciate it if you could review it even if it is a small thing.

title: Ask Gear Re:Boost
description: A new, straightforward RPG! Hot scenarios and battles that go right to the heart of JRPGs. For those of you who still feel your youth in the RPGs of the PS1 and PS2 generations, this is the game for you.

title: Eden Tactics
description: Eden Tactics is a competitive digital card game. Simple rules and deep reading, casual digital cards for a new era. Read your opponent's hand and make the best move!

title: Project Solaris
description: A rogue-lite RPG about the 100-day challenge of Solaris, a Less magic power witch, and her sidekick Homu, with beautifully animated combat, quick-time events, and charming characters to interact with!

title: Totonoi Simulator
description: The Totoi simulator is a simulator to feel “Totoi” by slowly soaking in a hot spring, taking a sauna, or bathing in a water bath, The Totoi Simulator is a simulator that allows you to feel “Totoi” by slowly soaking in a hot spring, taking a sauna, or taking a water bath.

title: Sakura-iro Tetra Prism
description: Sakurairo Tetra Prism is a visual novel set in the summer of 2000, following a photography club from Kirigamine High School during their six-month study abroad in Akita. After a disappointing contest, they seek new creative opportunities while navigating new encounters and themes of distorted love. With fully voiced characters and an emotional soundtrack, the game immerses players in a richly woven story that evolves based on their choices.

title: Laby to Panel de Shiritori
description: Play picture word chain with Laby, the knowledgeable robot! Fun for one player or two!

title: 0101: Classic Bonus Levels 3
description: This DLC includes another 10 bonus Classic levels, extremely cool, which will make you love the game even more.

title: 0101: Counter Bonus Levels 3
description: This DLC includes another 10 bonus Counter levels, extremely cool, which will make you love the game even more.

title: 0101: Pusher Bonus Levels 3
description: This DLC includes another 10 bonus Pusher levels, extremely cool, which will make you love the game even more.

title: Murder Mystery J: Satsujinhan ha Soba ni iru
description: Everyone is a suspect!? Up to 12 players can compete online! Using the communication function of your device, you can compete online with up to 12 players anytime, anywhere, with anyone, and as many times as you want!

description: You can use new faces for the "impersonation characters" that you use during battles. Only a set of 30 characters will be sold.

description: You can add "stamps" to use during battles. You can purchase each character individually. During a battle, you can use your favorite character's impersonation stamp no matter which character you select. *The design may change even after purchase. Please note.

description: Tiny Devils is a fast-paced multiplayer party game for 1-4 players. Race, jump, and climb through crazy obstacle courses, using wild power-ups like bees and magnets to mess with your rivals. Grab the crown and race to the finish line—the first one there wins, but chaos is guaranteed!

title: 07Gorillas
description: 07Gorillas is a top-down roguelike arena shooter game, you control one gorilla from a squad of seven break into "Foggy Zone" on a cleanup mission. Missions lasts less than 20 minutes, fight your way with powerful kung fu and tactical consumables, don't forget internal force enhancement.

title: Battle Spirits: Character Play Sheet Set 1
Hardcore Circus
description: Hardcore Circus is a difficult precision-platformer where you play as Dik, a skilled acrobat on a daring quest to rescue his brother from the grasp of the Devil.

title: Full Metal Sergeant 2
description: The Sergeant is back. Ready to turn unqualified recruits into fearless war machines. Manage your camp and prepare your squad with tougher training and new challenges, will they be ready for a real battlefield? New skill tree, more abilities and a reworked battle system. Start you deployment now.

title: Just Platformer 100
description: "Just Platformer 100" is a platformer game that focuses on the pure enjoyment of the genre itself. The game starts with simple levels and gradually introduces new rules. As these simple rules accumulate, the game continuously takes on new aspects.

title: 100 Screamers
description: 100 Screamers is a horror about a policewoman who came to a call, but turned out to be a toy in the hands of a maniac. Will she commit terrible things to survive or will she find a way out of a hopeless situation?

title: Project Rebirth
description: Fight for your life in a high-security prison where dangerous experiments have unleashed a deadly mutation. Solve puzzles, hide from a crazy doctor, and survive intense encounters as you attempt to escape this nightmare.

title: 1000 Waves
description: 1000 Waves is a bullet hell arcade game that becomes progressively difficult as you approach the 1000th wave. Strengthen your ship by leveling up and conquer the final boss!

title: 100 Animals on an Island
description: Embark on an incredible adventure on an island where 100 adorable animals await you! Explore the mysterious island and try to find all the creatures hidden in the game.

title: 100 Cats New York: Extra Content
description: Play a brand new level enriched with intricate details. 100 Cats have once again decided to hide themselves in New York.

title: 100 Hiddensaurs: Egypt
description: This is DLC for 100 Hiddensaurs. Find all the dinosaurs of Ancient Egypt.

title: 100 Dogs in India
description: Find 100 dogs in India! A simple hidden object game made with Kivy. Do you recognize the real-life buildings in the background?

title: 100 Korea Cats: Extra Content
description: By purchasing DLC, you will get extra content in the game 100 Korea Cats. Get an extra level with 100 more adorable cats!

title: 100 New Year Cats: Extra Content
description: By purchasing DLC, you will get extra content in the game 100 New Year Cats. Get an extra level with 100 more adorable cats!

title: Gridhack
description: Gridhack is a sci-fi puzzle RPG where you fight nonogram battles to hack your way on an intergalactic quest as you try to find out what happened to a planet called.. Earth?

title: Maximum Chaser: 1001 Squad
description: It is a universe similar to ours, where humans are technologically advanced but also full of evil. You will play as 2 member of the street organization "Maximum Chaser" and confront an evil security company A.A.S.S., making them scream under your gunfire.

title: 100% Wedding Mission: Love Love Christmas
description: 100% Wedding Mission! is a real time strategy game playable only for a streamer with 45~ viewers. Gather gold and upgrade chat viewer's Unit! Collaborate with chat and streamers to capture the Love

title: The Vast White
description: Explore an old mountain at your pace in this openworld snowboarding adventure. Uncover hidden paths, experience dynamic weather, and explore stunning landscapes as you ride. Every path holds new secrets.

title: Nekomancer of Nowhere
description: Draw spells on your screen as the Nekomancer! Swap between the realms of life and death, revive ghosts, and uncover Tombstone Tower's haunting truth!

title: Freeky Faucets Arcade
description: In Freeky Faucets, you play as these round beetle bugs called Boogas. The Faucets have invaded ally grounds! Eeeyikes! Don't worry hero, Faucet Friend will assist! (for a price). Discover his comrades too!

title: Elder Lich
description: Elder Lich is set in a world almost identical to 19th century Earth, except there's magic, undead, Germany is split between a South German Federation, a North German Federation and, between them, a country barely bigger than a city-state, Schadel.

title: Mr. Wolf
description: Little red riding hood and wolf are rival

title: Intrusive Thoughts
description: A short story that turns everyday tasks into journeys. Can you be the voice that doesn’t let her down?

title: Autogun Heroes: Supercharged
description: Blast through alien-infested planets and help Gus assemble a team of powerful heroes to save the galaxy. This challenging shoot 'em up 2D action platformer combines brutal chaos with smooth, responsive controls. Dodge. Roll. Dominate!

title: Rogue Monster Rush
description: Rogue Monster Rush is a blend of roguelike and tower defense. Collect and command an array of monster defenders, unleash strategic player abilities, unlock tons of upgrades, to defend your town from the invading robots.

title: Diamond Word
description: Diamond Word is a word action game where you need to make quick decisions, making the needed words from the letters flying up. Direct the letter to the place where you plan to make a word. Erase unnecessary words, making room on the field for the necessary (Diamond) word.

title: Total War: Warhammer III - Omens of Destruction: Gorbad
description: Introduces one of the most infamous of all Orc Warbosses, Gorbad Ironclaw, as a playable Legendary Lord alongside a deadly host of new battle units, gameplay features and objectives to be experienced in the immense Immortal Empires campaign or Custom Battles.

title: Kemotaku
description: "Kemotaku" is a brand new roguelike card game mixed with puzzle, deck-building and tower-defence. Beat away attacking enemies and defend your town with a variety of animals!

title: Pinball FX: Williams Pinball Volume 8
description: This dlc contains 3 classic tables: Banzai Run, Black Knight 2000, and Earthshaker.

title: The Ouroboros Express
description: Play as Vivienne Sanssouci, a daring journalist who has been tasked to review the Ouroboros Express. She quickly notices that this is not your regular train—and a devastating secret changes her life forever, and that of the other passengers…

title: Sintopia
description: Manage Hell. Manipulate the Overworld. Build the resurrection business of your dreams! In Sintopia, you’re tasked with managing the bureaucratic administration of Hell: “re-educate” the sinful, generate profit, play god and expand your hellish empire. All part of a day’s work at Hell Incorporated.

title: The Accuser and the Abyss
description: You are a detective. You have been assigned a partner to investigate a horrid case. But things are not what it seems. Navigate the paths as you attempt to unravel the truth behind your lost memories and your new disturbing detective partner.

title: DCS World: MAD AH-64D Campaign by Stone Sky
description: And the battle rages on! This time you are an officer of the UAE Air Force, with Bedouin ancestry; a pilot of the Special Operations Squadron - Captain Khalid Al-Mansouri. You will take part in a series of interesting campaigns; MAD - Mutual Assured Destruction. Detailed and high-quality work from Stone Sky will once again surprise you.

title: Battleship War Multiplayer
description:
Battleship War is the classic strategy/skill game.

Hit all the ships of your enemy and lead your fleet to the victory!

Two games mode:
Classic: Guess the position of your enemy’s ships and destroy them!
Advanced: Collect points and buy 2 special power-up.

Also challenge your friends with online multiplayer!

title: DCS World: F/A-18C Rise of the Persian Lion II Campaign by Badger 633
description: As staccato shafts of burning light flashed by the canopy, Lieutenant Scott Rivers, call sign 'Ford', squeezed the release button. He felt the expected "kick in the pants" as the Hornet surged when a ton of self-guiding ordinance dropped away intent on finding its mark. Below, seconds later, there was a massive shock wave as the area where the I.R.G.C. meeting was being held, exploded into ‘Hell on earth’ lighting up the entire City.

title: Kingdom Flipper
description: Grab a broom and hammer, it’s time to flip castles! Take drab strongholds and transform them into palaces fit for royalty. Take jobs, buy land, and build your dream castle all for profit, of course!

title: DCS World: MAD JF-17 Thunder Campaign by Stone Sky
description: This campaign guides the player through a gripping storyline about a PMC pilot named Vitalii Gerasimov. You will take part in a series of campaigns called MAD Mutually assured Destruction.

title: DCS World: Spitfire Beware! Beware! Campaign by Reflected Simulations
description: During the winter of 1942-43, the air battle raging in the skies over Europe was at its fiercest. The Focke Wulfs and Messerschmitts flown by the Luftwaffe’s ’experten’ proved to be more than a worthy foe for the RAF’s new Spitfire Mk.IX-s. The air supremacy of the Allies was still just a distant dream. In the thickest of this battle stood the Biggin Hill Wing with 611 (West Lancashire) and 340 (Ile de France) Squadrons.

title: Shadows of Progakko
description:
Adam Samishi went to live at Progakko, a huge school with the purpose of protecting teenagers from a threat that occurs in the country, however, nobody knows what exactly this threat is.

Note:
This game was originally released on Gamejolt, then re-released on Itch.io a few months later.
At the time the developer was known as SlothOgami/ShinOgami, only later it became Kuraishimi.

title: LEGO Fortnite: Brick Life
description:
Build your new life in an ever-evolving LEGO city.

Experience a highly social destination for up to 32 players where you can explore all the city has to offer!

Be the ultimate socialite and hang out in restaurants, house parties or rooftop clubs. Chat with friends or make new ones, activities in LEGO Fortnite Brick Life are better together. Host a band practice down the beach, grab a bite to eat with others or race through the streets on hover boards.

Take on a job, complete tasks to earn some spending money and start living the life in Brick Bay with vehicles, housing and more. Customize your home with furnishings from the local store or invite your friends over to hang out.

Getting this experience is not necessary to access this content. When you launch Fortnite using this through your Library, the experience will be pre-selected for your convenience.

title: Once Upon a Time in the 70s
Extinction Day
description: Extinction Day is a strategy simulation game in which players orchestrate the end of humanity using a variety of catastrophic events including disasters, diseases, and wars. Players combine different catastrophes to overwhelm human survival efforts and spread destruction across the globe.

title: A Game About Digging A Hole
description: A minimalist game about digging a hole in the garden of a newly purchased house. Collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and discover a mysterious secret. Costs you only one coffee!

title: Helldivers 2: TR-117 Alpha Commander Armor Set
description:
TR-117 ALPHA COMMANDER
For warriors who are so strong and confident that they don't need any reassurance whatsoever.

title: Bridge Constructor Studio
description:
Test your construction expertise with dozens of distinct bridge-building puzzles across varied biomes. Seven different vehicles and multiple construction materials (wood, steel, cables, concrete pillars, and roadways) ensure each puzzle is a fresh and varied challenge.

With no budget restrictions or material limits, you are free to experiment and design without constraints. For an extra challenge, earn a special award by keeping costs within a set budget while ensuring your bridge holds up under pressure!

Design and play your very own bridge-building scenarios! Choose from five biomes, seven vehicles, and a variety of obstacles and checkpoints to design your own challenges. Up to 40 custom levels can be saved per player profile.

Mixed Reality (Quest 3 Exclusive): View your creations in the real world with Mixed Reality! Seamlessly switch between VR and Passthrough modes to experience the game in a whole new way.

title: No Man's Sky: Starborn Phoenix Ship
description:
An exclusive reforged starship, commemorating a time when Travellers old and new joined together to voyage across the stars.

This unusual ship is optimised for effortless gliding during flight, while a localised vector field allows the craft to hover above solid planes.

To add this ship to your collection, visit the Quicksilver Synthesis Companion aboard the Space Anomaly and choose "Collect Special Rewards".

title: DCS World: Iraq Map
description: Experience the full scope of Iraq's diverse and historically rich environment with DCS: Iraq. Fly over the entire country, from the deserts of the south to the mountains of the north, and immerse yourself in a landscape that has been the backdrop for some of the most significant air campaigns in history.

title: DCS World: Iraq North Map
description: Dive into the rugged terrains and historically significant regions of Northern Iraq. This module offers a richly detailed environment featuring the mountainous landscapes, rivers, and urban centres that have been central to numerous military operations. From the ancient city of Mosul to the oil-rich fields of Kirkuk, Northern Iraq presents a challenging and varied theatre.

title: Football Life 2025
description: Football Life 2025 game is an attempt to continue the offline modes of the retired PES series, football life is a standalone football game based on PES 21, built for offline career modes only. SP Football Life is how we like to play a football game.

title: Warframe: Nyx Warframe
description:
Warframe is pulling up to The Game Awards 2024 with plenty of goodies and great news to share!

Claim now to receive a free Nyx Warframe with a free Warframe Slot, for a limited time only.

title: Ninja Gaiden: Ragebound
description: A brand-new side-scrolling entry to the NINJA GAIDEN series from the team behind Blasphemous, NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound redefines the classic platformer saga in a spectacular, thrilling and challenging ninja adventure.

title: One Move Away
description: One Move Away is a cozy, first-person puzzle game where you pack your belongings for another move and embark on a new chapter in life. With each move, you step into the lives of three unique characters, uncovering their personal stories through the items they take with them—or leave behind.

title: Dave the Diver: In the Jungle
description: Dave the Diver: In the Jungle is a DLC expansion for Dave the Diver. It introduces a new jungle-themed environment where players can explore for exotic resources and face additional challenges, all while continuing to balance underwater exploration with restaurant management.

title: Shadow Labyrinth
description: Shadow Labyrinth is a 2D action platformer and a genre-twisting alternate take on the iconic PAC-MAN. As The Swordsman, you wake on a mysterious planet amidst relics of wars past. To survive you will discover secrets, consume your enemies, and grow from prey to apex predator.

title: Kyora
description: Delve into KYORA, a mystical multiplayer sandbox adventure, where every pixel is yours to shape, mine, build or explode.

title: Solasta II
description: In a Mana-infused land, a dark force led by the enigmatic Shadwyn threatens Neokos. Bring your party of adventurers together across perilous realms in this Turn-Based Tactical RPG based on the SRD 5e ruleset. You make the choices, dice decide your destiny.

title: Elden Ring Nightreign
description: Elden Ring: Nightreign is a standalone adventure within the ELDEN RING universe, crafted to offer players a new gaming experience by reimagining the game’s core design.

title: Catly
description: An open-world adventure filled with surprises and joy, side by side with Cats! Build your dream island, meet various characters, and enjoy caring for your cats, dressing up, building, farming, racing, skiing, and much more! Explore freely and have endless fun with your furry companions!

title: Gen Atlas
description:
This planet… is still alive.
Without knowing why, you awaken on an abandoned planet.

Before you lies a vast, silent world. Colossal structures stretch over endless plains, deserted facilities, and an ever-changing sea. The remnants of some grand design litter the planet’s surface.

title: Split Fiction
description: Split Fiction is a 2025 cooperative multiplayer game. It follows two writers, Mio Hudson and Zoe Foster, as they become trapped in their imaginations.

title: Blackfrost: The Long Dark 2
description: A year after the Aurora’s appearance & the world went dark, the people of Harmont & its vast wild environs struggle to survive the Quiet Apocalypse. Survive alone or with others against a host of new hazards & a fresh new survival sandbox from a pioneer of the genre. Live together. Die alone.

title: Tekken 8: Clive Rosfield
description:
Clive Rosfield, the first prince of the Grand Duchy of Rosaria, from FINAL FANTASY XVI joins the tournament!

Experience thrilling swordplay and precision coordinated attacks with Clive's loyal hound, Torgal. Wield powerful and dynamic Eikonic abilities and temporarily transform into the mighty Ifrit. Use your power as the Dominant of Fire to emerge victorious.

Content:
- Clive Rosfield as a playable character

title: Virtua Fighter Crossroads
description: The newest installment in the Virtua Fighter series, releasing in 2027.

title: Stranger Than Heaven
description: Stranger Than Heaven is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. The game follows a multi-decade story across five eras and five cities, centered on men searching for a place to belong. It combines close-quarters action with narrative elements, historical urban settings, and activities connected to music and performance.

title: Turok: Origins
description: Play as the legendary Turok warriors to face off against ferocious dinosaurs and a terrifying alien threat that seeks to destroy all human life across the galaxy.

title: Helldivers 2: Omens of Tyranny
description: The sightings, rumors, conspiracy theories. They were all true. The ancient Illuminate civilization are back from extinction!

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
description:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.
With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

title: Game of Thrones: Kingsroad
description:
Enter the world of the HBO hit series, Game of Thrones.
Experience an open-world action RPG with an original story found only in Game of Thrones: Kingsroad!

title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
description: Race across land, sea, air, space, and time in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.

title: Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet
description: Set thousands of years in the future, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet puts players into the role of Jordan A. Mun, a dangerous bounty hunter who ends up stranded on Sempiria – a distant planet whose communication with the outside universe went dark hundreds of years ago. Jordan will have to use all her skills and wits if she hopes to be the first person in over 600 years to leave its orbit.

title: Dungeonfell
description:
Enter the World of Dungeonfell,

A tactical team-based Roguelite where you lead a group of heroes into ever-changing dungeons. Battle against hordes of Monsters and uncover the corruption lurking deep within the dungeon’s heart.

Learn the unique abilities of each Hero and unlock new spells and skills as you progress. Combine your heroes strategically to create powerful synergies and overcome the increasingly difficult enemies you face.

title: Meat Girl
description:
Your roommate went missing several months ago.

You finally gain a conscience and go look for her.

You find a strange girl in the woods.

title: Lost in Anomaly
description: You wake up on the 9th floor of an unknown building. The only way out of here is to detect and mark anomalies. One wrong move and you could be trapped forever.

title: Cartas de Coisas
description:
A game within a game, Cartas de Coisas (Cards of Things) invites players to wager on a gacha simulator to win cards representing animals, games, cultural icons, and literary figures. These cards contribute to your Fighting Power, a resource essential for facing and hunting down hordes of aliens within the Liturgy. Each opened Gate reveals a new epistle—fragmented stories that unveil the creation of every layer of the game's universe.

On its official page, Cards of Things (Cartas de Coisas) describes itself this way:

"There is a game called Cards of Things, which some people believe can replace the weariness of life with a terrible feeling known as Agony.
Of course, you don't want to live in Agony: just stay away from these cards.
After all, you should be working.
You like your job.
Staring at the wall.
You don't need the torment of Agony."

title: Prey of the Night
description: Become a night owl, soaring through an infinite forest under the moonlit sky. Skillfully avoid obstacles, hunt for prey to gain strength, and perch to regain stamina. But beware—every moment in the shadows tests your survival. How long can you conquer the night?

title: Watermelon Simulator
description: Watermelon Simulator is a game in which you can become a watermelon.

title: Bit-Cremental: Fishistry
description: Grow fish with a gashapon twist in this bite-sized idler. Feed, nurture, and watch as fisher people reel in mature catches, earning money to upgrade things like feeding, growth, and fishing speeds for even faster profits.

title: Tile Cities 2
description: City-building experience reimagined as a simple relaxing puzzle game bringing the original Tile Cities to a new level

title: Tiny Divide
description: Endlessly split tiles into smaller fragments and compete on the leaderboard to reach the tiniest divide.

title: Cargo 19
description: Play as a brave pilot navigating a spaceship through the wastelands. Explore diverse locations, gathering resources to fulfill contracts while carefully planning your routes and avoiding damage to your ship.

title: Project Search
description: Project Search is a visual novel of Chinese immortality cultivation. Scholar Qian Jiangmin investigates collapsed pagodas in Linhai's old town while searching for his missing brother. With the help of Daoist cultivators, he explores grotto-heavens and uncovers the truth behind his double vision.

title: Saltwater Bodies
description:
Operate a tourist attraction by day, and conduct eldritch experiments by night to build yourself a new vessel.

Explore cave systems in a fully physics-based caving/swimming system, where you'll have to twist your head and breathe out precious air to fit through openings.

The narrative has a few branching points, depending on events that happen during dives or out on dry land.

title: Escape Simulator 2
description: Sequel to the best-selling escape room game, brings a fresh take on first-person puzzles with a variety of new rooms to explore solo or with friends. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, or craft your own escape rooms with Room Editor 2.0.

title: Void Sails
description: Void Sails is a single-player adventure where you captain a flying ship across uncharted space. Sail through mysterious worlds, battle powerful foes, and make story-defining choices. Uncover dark secrets in a game where every discovery could bring you closer to the truth—or to madness.

title: Brok: Natal Tail, A New Christmas
description: A Christmas tale set in the world of BROK the InvestiGator, presented as a visual novel.

title: DCS World: F-14B Operation Sandworm Campaign by Sandman Simulations
description: It is the year 1998. Tension is building up in the Persian Gulf region. Violations of human rights, demonstrations terminated by the military and executions of political prisoners in Iran have led to financial sanctions set by United States and European Union. Iran has responded with airspace violations and disruptions of commercial shipping. Diplomats are doing their best but the Gulf states and the World are afraid of war.

title: Kraken City
description: She is the dark magician, an apostle of the great Kraken, Nialato. Show the foolish mortals the terrifying power of the Kraken through brute strength and magical prowess Experience the thrill of hack-and-slash action alongside the fearsome Kraken

title: Die in the Dungeon: Classic
description: Fight your way through a mysterious dungeon in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike where you don't use cards, but dice! Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board and risk it all hoping for a good roll on unexpected encounters.

title: Error Codes
description: You Go in Pursuit of you Best Friend who has recently gone missing. but your spaceship gets shot down by a rogue group of Robots. With no communication with earth, you must survive, Fight, and discover the secrets of this Ice Planet. (2024)

title: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions - Cozy Kitchen
description: Step into a fresh new corner of Spirit City's room with the Cozy Kitchen DLC! This feast of a DLC expands your Spirit City experience with a brand-new kitchen area. New items, spirits and activities await!

title: Undisputed: Deluxe WBC Edition
description: Become Undisputed and rule the ring in the most authentic boxing game to date! Featuring true to life visuals, bone-jarring action, and more licensed boxers than ever before, Undisputed gives you unprecedented control to master every inch of the ring.

title: Way of the Hunter: Wild Expeditions
description:
Way of the Hunter: Wild Expeditions is the ultimate compilation of hunting grounds all over the world. In this authentic hunting simulation, you can explore the vast the in-game wilderness and fulfil all your hunting fantasies. The wide world of Way of the Hunter allows you to follow the many storylines in hunting grounds all over the world, master the challenges of ethical hunting and solve intriguing cases of unethical behaviour. Or venture out in free hunt, and explore the breath-taking landscapes of North America, Europe, New Zealand and Africa to learn about habitats, animal behaviour and ultimately how to manage animal fitness in order to harvest the rarest and most impressive trophies.

This latest edition bundles 6 enormous hunting areas and includes agile UTVs for off-roading. All of this has been enriched with the cosmetics of the Hunter's Pack and the Outfits Pack: 5 alternative outfits for your playable hunters, a beautifully engraved antique shotgun, a cameo paintjob for the car and an impressive wooden carved statue for your Transylvania hunting lodge.

Wild Expeditions includes 6 amazing DLCs:

• Tikamoon Plains is a huge new hunting ground in Africa. Explore diverse landscapes, from windy mountains to deadly deserts and vast savannahs teeming with life. Join Malachi, a professional hunting guide, as he leads a group of adventurers through the thrilling world of Tikamoon Plains, inspired by the African wilderness. Includes bowhunting and 2 top-of-the-line hunting bows.

• Aurora Shores is a breath-taking hunting area in the northernmost part of the USA, the Alaskan wilderness. As a fresh graduate of the Wildlife Trooper School, your job is to protect the natural resources of Aurora Shores. Explore untouched nature with rich populations of wild animals, such as Kodiak bears, Roosevelt elk, Wood bison, and many more. Includes crossbows.

• Matariki Park in New Zealand offers a remarkable blend of biomes. Traverse hilly or mountainous terrain, home to the unique Himalayan tahr and the mighty Sambar deer, and venture into the lowland forest areas, the domain of the majestic Red deer. Immerse yourself in nature's beauty and lifelike wildlife that will keep you engaged for hours, all while offering insights into unique local habits and traditions.

• Lintukoto Reserve is an amazing hunting ground in Scandinavia and the newest addition to Way of the Hunter. Experience the adventures of game warden Mikael and discover the nature and animals of the European North.

• The Outfits Pack contains one original costume for each character - River, April, Wallace, Jackie and Malachi, usable in Free Hunt and Multiplayer mode.

• Hunter's Pack: a shotgun with engravings, a paintjob for the Car, and a wooden carved mouflon statue for the lodge

title: Home_0
description:
Home_0 is a phycological horror where you play as 9-year-old boy relieving his memories on the most horrifying week.

Help yourself to get rid of the anomalies in your memories by choosing the right choice.

title: Cats Visiting Christmas Town
description: Embark on a Christmas quest to uncover hidden cats in charming holiday scenes filled with snowmen, festive shops, and a grand tree adorned with gifts.

title: Kimi ga Nozomu Muv-Luv
description:
Fandisc released for free to members of the age Fan Club, Kimi ga Nozomu Muv-Luv contains two stories:

-Ore ga Hetare de Hetare ga Ore de:
A crossover for Kimi ga Nozomu Eien and Muv-Luv where the protagonists for each game swap bodies, and wacky hijinks ensue!

-Melvina Maniax
A short story about daily life of the JFK Curry Restaurant crew.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Wednesday's Infidelity
description: Wednesday's Infidelity is a fan-made modification (mod) of the rhythm game Friday Night Funkin'. The mod falls under the horror-themed rhythm game genre, blending music-based gameplay with a dark, psychological narrative. The mod follows a tormented version of Mickey Mouse, inspired by creepypasta and lost-media myths, as he faces despair and inner struggles. it features a vintage cartoon aesthetic, a haunting original soundtrack, and progressively intense stages that reflect Mickey's deteriorating mental state. Known for its engaging music, dynamic visuals, and emotional depth, the mod offers a chilling twist on the traditional FNF experience. This mod is the creation of some very iconic songs such as: "Unknown Suffering" and "Last Straw".

title: Nick Brawl Community Edition
description: It's time to get back into the Brawl! Introducing Nick Brawl Community Edition, a community-made patch for the Steam version of Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl full of bug-fixes, balance changes, and more!

title: Hashire Hebereke: EX
description: Hashire Hebereke: EX is a modern remake of the 1994-released Super Famicom racing action game Hashire Hebereke by SUNSOFT. Players can choose from comical and cute characters like series protagonist Hebe and partake in extreme races across unique stages. While carrying over elements from the original game, it will add a new Time Attack mode, new characters, and new stages, as well as four-person online multiplayer support.

title: Pyromania
description: Pyromania is an action-packed horde survival game. Strategy and movement are key to surviving the ever-growing hordes of zombies, wild animals and other monsters. It can be played either solo or in online-coop with up to 4 players.

title: Nine-Ball Roulette
description: This will be the most exciting pool game you have ever played. Join up to 3 of your friends in this exciting pool roulette game! Eliminate each other with pool until only one person is left.

title: Soulblaze
description: Soulblaze is a creature-collecting roguelite in which you catch and train creatures called animons to fight your way through several regions and defeat their bosses in tactical turn-based battles with dice rolling mechanics. Build your team, upgrade and customize techniques, collect stickers, and hopefully survive until the end!

title: Nils Holgerssons wunderbare Reise
description:
Selma Lagerlöf's classic children's book comes with the software Nils Holgersson's Wonderful Journey. Off to Lapland comes in a double pack: once as an active adventure game on CD-ROM, and once as an audio play for the CD player.

The young players slip into the role of the enchanted Nils Holgersson, a little thumbelina, and get to know life from an even smaller perspective. The journey, in which Akka, the leader of the wild geese, has to be freed, leads through eight different locations, from the farm to the forest and river to Kullaberg, before finally ending up at the treasure chest. Naughty Nils always annoys all the animals and he certainly doesn't listen to his parents. One day, however, he has a bad time when an elf enchants the boy into his own kind. As such, Nils flees into the straw pile and from there continues on the back of the pet goose Martin.

Now begins an exciting and, due to the adversities of nature, dangerous journey. Again and again, the players have to defend themselves against foxes, sometimes with cunning, sometimes with force, by asking the ram to drive the fox away with his horns. But there is still more to do: berries need to be collected, fish caught, a sleeping chamber built for the new friend Martin and the crows distracted. Many more clicks enable enjoyable little gimmicks, games and tasks.

title: The Scouring
description: The Scouring is an RTS with fast pace, high attention to detail and next generation experience. Lead humans or orcs to fight for victory! Play alone or with friends. Use modding tools to create custom game modes! Join The battle!

title: Senpai and the Mysterious Island
description: An RPG where you get to uncover the secrets of a mysterious island inhabited by succubi that was rumored to contain a lost ancient technology. Play as either the warrior Hula Elstia, or Sonia Lanternlily to a variety of combat styles, and dress them up with various outfits.

title: Randotura
description: Randotura is a top-down action roguelike with inventory management. Dive into bullet hell action and collect unique modifiers, all in a selfmade dungeon.

title: Bopimo!
description: A Free to play, online 3D platformer where players can create their own levels.

title: Smiley Dusty
description: After a long day, Emily trudges through the pouring rain on the night of March 10th, 2000. Arriving home late from school and volunteer hours, she's met with an unsettling emptiness. Her family is nowhere to be found, having left abruptly for an important event. Alone in the house, a familiar warmth seems strangely absent. Emily is left to deal with whatever entities are trying to hunt her down...

title: Astro Bot: Winter Wonder
description: The Christmas-themed DLC level for Astro Bot

title: Part of the Flock
description:
Lamby is a little poultry farmer who takes his job seriously.

But when things start going awry, Lamby is certain the well in the woods near his property holds the key to his agony. But the sleepless nights cost a hefty toll.

title: Penumbris Doña
description: A pixelated, possibly horror, occasionally live-action point-and-click graphic adventure about visiting your ex

title: Desktop Survivors 98
description: Desktop Survivors 98 is a chaotic roguelite dungeon crawler that unfolds right on your Desktop. Take control of your cursor as you explore new rooms, battle relentless waves of enemies, and collect powerful new weapons.

title: Deprision
description: Deprision is a psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying AAA experience. Survive human madness, amnesia's power, and navigate parallel worlds via a deadly virus. Solve your world's problem, survive, prevent more deaths, and escape before it's too late.

title: Survive: Frost Bite
description: Trapped in an isolated Antarctic research base, you’re hunted by bloodthirsty werewolves after a brutal attack. With every passing second, survival becomes a desperate struggle—will you outsmart the creatures stalking you, or will the relentless terror tear you apart before help arrives?

title: Feed The Pit
description: JOIN THE SOCIETY. Avoid unpredictable horrors that will pursue you relentlessly. Perform rituals in a haunted forest to find dead bodies. Feed these bodies to THE PIT, lest you be fed to it yourself.

title: Amberspire
description: A science fantasy dice city builder. Construct buildings, manage resources, and build in harmony with an alien ecology. Beneath the glow of a gas giant, Amberspire will grow and prosper into a flourishing city atop the ruins of an abandoned moon.

title: Birchwood
description:
Birchwood is a narrative driven psychological horror game which delves into the dark-side of 1980’s Britain.
After an ecological and personal tragedy befell your household a decade earlier, you must now return home and uncover the morbid secrets which lay at the heart of the once idyllic farmhouse, while confronting the evil which destroyed your family.
Armed with nothing but a VHS camcorder, it’s up to you to solve the mystery of what really happened on that fateful night ten years ago.

title: Captain Midnight
description: The tide always wins

title: Christmas Drift: Delivery Simulator
description: Christmas Drift - Delivery Simulator Experience the ultimate holiday challenge! Drift through snowy roads, deliver gifts on time, and conquer festive obstacles in this fun, fast-paced driving simulator. Customize your vehicle, master tricky routes, and spread Christmas cheer like never before!

title: DCS World: A-10C Operation Agile Spear Campaign by Combat King Simulations
description: In a surprise move, Russia has, again, invaded Georgia and the United Nations is unable or unwilling to provide even the most basic military response to this attack. Initially, only the United States commits a small but highly effective force of A-10C Warthogs to help defend its Black Sea ally.

title: DCS World: MiG-21bis Constant Peg Campaign by Bunyap Campaigns
description: The Constant Peg Campaign is based on operations carried out by the USAF's 4477th Test and Evaluation Squadron, the 'Red Eagles'. These 10 missions are set in 1988 and replicate the unit's typical operations from Tonopah Test Range Airfield, Nevada. You will take flight in a MiG-21 to expose pilots from operational units to Soviet aircraft, and to replicate adversary tactics during realistic combat training scenarios.

title: Farmine Land
description: Dive into Farmine Land, a captivating 2D retro-style MMORPG where mining, crafting, and battling monsters come to life! Own lands as NFTs, earn Landcoin, and explore a world full of challenges and rewards.

title: A Better World
description: A Better World Company is hiring! We’re looking for a skilled new recruit to alter the past and reshape the future! Use our Computer to travel back in time, and make game-changing choices to make the world a better place! You decide what to do… as long as you follow our internal policies.

title: Come on,Fantasy baby!
description: Watch out for a heart-throbbing adventure! Let us take you into an ideal world for men, where you can control and save various Korean beauties from different dimensions, each with their own unique style. Every day unfolds an irresistible and exhilarating fantasy life.

title: Boku to Iu Mono
description: The protagonist character has 'lived' alone and unfeeling as a conscience inhabiting random objects and animals for random times for as long as he can remember — but one day, he turns into the shape of a human boy. His life changes utterly when the human girl Sae decides to try to befriend him, naming him "Ao" for his deep blue eyes as he cannot speak. Every day, they have fun playing hide and seek — but one day, Sae stops coming...

title: The Loveland Frog
description:
A Myth, or A Legend?

Once a media cycle, the Loveland Frog cryptid makes their appearance to a select few. Though they may be three feet tall, an unusual size for a frog, they are truly a friendly character. However, people find the Frog menacing, and do not understand them. They run away from the Frog, and occasionally attempt to attack them in misguided fear...

It has been three years since the Loveland Frog was last seen, and tonight they have decided to shake things up. They wish to go for a stroll across a busy highway, where many people will be able to see that they really exist. However, due to their isolation from human culture, they do not understand "vehicles", and so do not know the danger they represent...

title: Office 29
description: In Office 29, a seemingly normal workday turns into a nightmarish journey through a haunted office. You wake up at night, alone, and must gather your belongings while navigating terrifying anomalies that distort reality. As you explore, strange events unfold—lights flicker, shadows move, and eerie figures lurk outside the window. Each anomaly hides secrets, pushing you deeper into the unknown.

title: Super-Spatial
description: Explore, build, and master the art of automation. Build your base, discover colorful new worlds, and develop new technologies as you tame the far reaches of space and search for a way to return to Earth.

title: Payuta and the Ice God
description: Payuta and the Ice God is an educational interactive game for children set in the Arctic. Players take on the role of Payuta, a young Inuit boy who must challenge Kiagnyk, the ice god, to rescue his kidnapped sister Opiak. Throughout the adventure, children engage with puzzles, memory challenges, and skill-based minigames that teach them about Inuit culture, traditions, and daily life in the Arctic. The game blends entertainment with learning, offering insights into Inuit lore and lifestyle while guiding players through Payuta's quest to save his sister from the threatening ice god.

title: Enscroll
description: Fresh out of Magic Academy with a hefty student loan, you must craft and sell magic scrolls to pay off your debt. Create spells for demanding customers and manage your growing loan payments. Will your magical skills be enough to free you from student debt?

title: Bone to Gather
description: "Bone To Gather" is a synergy-building action roguelike. Embark on an epic journey with a team of puny skeletons determined to revenge the Demon King. Recruit skeletons with unique synergies to create a powerful team and battle through monsters on your way to the final showdown.

title: Dr. Cog
description: Dr. Cog is a deck-building roguelike game using gears. Operate the memory restoration machine, turn gears, discover and enhance them, and build synergies. Complete the memory restoration within the time limit, recover the client's lost memories, and reach the final chapter.

title: Balantica
description: Safely guide the twins to the altar. The path to the altar branches into multiple routes, each filled with trials and unexpected events awaiting the twins. As their companion, you will choose their path, build a deck of cards to give hope and overcome increasingly challenging trials.

title: Killistar
description: Killistar: A 2D/3D sci-fi shoot-em-up remake of the classic arcade game Sinistar.

title: InKing
description: Inking is a fast-paced 2D top-down action game. Players take on the role of an ink bottle warrior on a journey to become the king of tools. Use your fast attacks, moves, and powerful skills to defeat the tools that stand in your way, prove that ink and pen are the best tools, and become the King of Tools.

title: The Mysterious Thief: Forget Me Not
description: A story-rich, girl's love visual novel about phantom thieves.

title: Dicey Tales
description: Roll the dice in your hand! Dicey Tales, a TRPG-inspired game, combines deckbuilding with strategy in a unique SRPG experience. Assemble the ultimate expedition team with a variety of heroes. Defeat powerful bosses through strategic decisions and a bit of luck!

title: Opus Cortex
description: Opus Cortex is a nonogram puzzle game with captivating story and a cast of wonderful characters. You are an AI who wakes up in an unknown location, your memory chip damaged and unreadable. In the meantime, the world faces great dangers. Will you find out what happened?

title: Darby is Here Forever
description: Help our little vampire Darby getting out from his eternal prison. Log on into a difficult 2D pixel platformer, find out secret rooms, defeat great bosses and end up discovering why Darby has been imprisoned in his own castle!

title: Masks of the Void: Origins
description: Masks of the Void is a Rogue-lite action-RPG where you use powerful masks that grant you unique powers. Player's can level up their skills and swap them out for better ones as their journey continues.

title: The Wide Open Sky Is Running Out of Catfish
description: A story-driven photography game... on the back of a giant, flying catfish. Transform clouds into sea creatures and bring abundance back to an empty sky.

title: Vaultframe
description: A sci-fi, zero-gravity side-scroller. Navigate a labyrinth of parasite-spore-infected energy cells on a space station, fighting parasites and evading deadly traps. Complete your mission and reach the only escape before the station’s purge wipes out everything alive.

title: Aggrolotls
description: A top-down arena roguelike where you play as tiny axolotls and must evolve into a swarm that can take on powerful creatures from the sea. Level up and choose from upgrades that make each round feel unique.

title: Pachinko TD
description: Pachinko TD is a physics-based, minimalist tower defense game. Inspired by Thronefall.

title: DCS World: F/A-18C Raven One Сampaign by Baltic Dragon
description: The Raven One campaign for the F/A-18C Hornet is based on the bestselling novel of the same title. This campaign was developed with the active participation of author Kevin Miller and Vincent "Jell-O" Aiello, host of the Fighter Pilot Podcast. Both are retired U.S. Navy Hornet pilots, each with over 3,000 career flight hours and numerous overseas deployments.

title: Sokomonster
description: Unleash chaos, strategize destruction, and conquer the city - monster style!

title: Zigzag Car
description: Zigzag Car is an endless journey through nature where players collect coins to unlock new cars. The more coin they collect, the faster they go, making it even more challenging. Along the way, players can get special items such as multiplier coins. The goal? Collect as many coins as possible!

title: Toy Titan: Protector of Childhood Dreams
description: In a faraway realm, the benevolent Eldritch Crafters have entrusted you with a powerful artifact: the Dreamcore. This enchanted relic safeguards the vibrant fantasies and imaginations of children across the globe. However, the world is threatened by the malevolent sorcerer, Nythros, who desires to shatter the Dreamcore and plunge everything into a bleak, dreamless void.

title: Dead By Daylight: Doomed Course
description:
CHAPTER 34: Doomed Course is the thirty-fourth Chapter DLC for Dead by Daylight.
This DLC features the following content: 1 Original Survivor: Taurie Cain, 1 Original Killer: The Houndmaster. The Chapter will release without an accompanying new Map.

title: DCS World: F/A-18C Raven One: Dominant Fury Campaign by Baltic Dragon
description: Raven One: Dominant Fury campaign for the F/A-18C Hornet is a prequel for the highly acclaimed Raven One campaign, based on the bestselling novel of the same title. Developed by Baltic Dragon, all the missions were constructed with the active participation of author of the book, Kevin Miller, and Vincent "Jell-O" Aiello, host of the Fighter Pilot Podcast - both retired U.S. Navy Hornet pilots, each with over 3,000 career flight hours and numerous overseas deployments.

title: Made In MFGG
description: A WarioWare fangame focusing on the use of the mouse and keyboard.

title: Save The Doge 2
description: New puppy rescue mission from the evil bees!

title: Vaulting Champions
description: Try this incredible mix of track and field and running. Pole vaulting through the course is something very unusual and unrealistically fun!

title: RAF Survival: Ocean Shark Survivor
description: Set sail into the unknown in RAF Survival - Ocean Shark Survivor, where every wave could spell adventure or doom! Stranded on a precarious makeshift raft, your journey begins in the vast, shimmering expanse of the ocean. With nothing but your wits and determination, transform your humble vessel into a floating sanctuary of survival!

title: OFC: Ultimate Fighting Club
description: OFC - ULTIMATE FIGHTING CLUB invites you to dive into the brutal world of no-holds-barred fighting, where the only rule is to win. Join a fighting club inspired by the intense atmosphere of real OFC tournaments, and level up your fighter to become a true champion.

title: Learn to Play Vol. 9: Santa's Sleigh Ride
description:
You are Santa Clause and it's your task to deliver all the Christmas presents, just in time for the holidays.
Hop on your sleigh, fly over a bustling town, decide who's been good or bad and deliver lots of wonderful presents to all the happy townsfolk.
Watch out for obstacles in the sky! Can you make it in time for Christmas?

title: Infernitos
description: In Infernitos, take on the role of a little imp chef serving up devilishly delightful dishes to hungry demon patrons. Move the dishes across the fiery kitchen, carefully pushing and delivering them on the table to serve your hellish clients. Every level demands sharp thinking and a strategic approach, as each dish must be assembled with precision to satisfy your picky infernal clientele!

title: Learn to Play Vol. 10: Gravity Space Walk
description: Repair your spaceship and return home!

title: Color Swiper 2
description: From the makers of The Jumping Food Games comes the sequel to the popular puzzle game "Color Swiper". In this expansion you can expect new, hand-crafted, tricky levels in which the aim is to fill all the squares with skillful swiping movements!

title: Christmas Gift Catcher
description: From the makers of The Jumping Food Games comes the perfect game for the holidays: "Christmas Gift Catcher"! After decorating the Christmas tree in our previous game, "Christmas Tree Decorating Simulator", now it's time to collect the presents.

title: Truck Simulator 25: American Driver
description: Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver invites you to an exciting adventure on the roads of America, progressing through levels set in diverse locations — from industrial zones to quiet suburbs and the bustling city center. From hauling cargo across diverse landscapes to managing your trucking business, this game brings the thrill of the road to life. Your task is to deliver goods on time, improving your driving skills and upgrading your trucks as you go.

title: Mac & Jack: Candy Bashers
description:
Mac & Jack: Candy Bashers is a hi-score chasing roguelite following the adventures of a Pumpkin and their loyal friend.

Brave the Halloween night and work to survive against waves of monsters while collecting as much candy as you can! Discover new items by Trick-or-Treating between waves, purchase them from the shopkeeper for permanent use, and build a loadout that customizes the difficulty of every run!

title: Killing Floor: Horzine Outbreak
description: Horzine Outbreak is based on original Killing Floor mod (KFMod) v1.0 for Unreal Tournament 2004 by Alex Quick and tell a story about incident in Horzine Biotech, currently in progress and being made by the last version of Xash3D + XashXT.

title: PowerPoint Osu!
description: Osu, but its made and runs inside PowerPoint.

title: The Succession of Changing Kings
description: A turn-based kingdom management simulator, with an emphasis on decision making. Will you survive and lead the kingdom to prosperity or die in obscurity? The throne awaits you.

title: Darso Roads
description: A racing game shrouded in mystery was developed for Playstation in 1996, remained unreleased and unfinished, with speculation suggesting its cancellation was due to its eerie basis on a real-life event, marked by the chilling disappearance of one of the competitors.

title: Red Haze: Bruises Glimmer in Starlight
description: Gretta finds something alluringly beautiful, yet horrendously terrible​ hidden deep within her apartment. It grows beneath the floorboards. Will it bring her happiness, or sink her into despair?

title: Storage Anomaly
description: Storage Anomaly is a memory and puzzle game in which you have to identify anomalies in a dark and spooky storage room using your phone, while overcoming unexpected challenges.

title: Seedbo And That Time The Sun Exploded
description: Re-assemble the sun in this bite-sized adventure platformer!

title: Bricksbumpbump
description: bricksbumpbump is a local multiplayer party game (supporting up to 4 players). In the game, you need to control your character to move and stack blocks like building with toy bricks to achieve the game objectives. The first one to meet the objective wins the game.

title: Cursed Baby
description: The once #1 horror game on the Horror list of Itch is back! Join now and use a variety of repair tools to experience life as a handyman in a haunted house, uncover the terrifying past of this old house and face the terrifying demon baby head-on!

title: The Patient: Can You Escape?
description: The Patient is a tense first-person escape game set in an atmospheric 1930s German sanatorium with subtle horror Elements. Explore the mysterious location, solve cunning puzzles, and hide from the doctor using a refined stealth system, while uncovering the disturbing truth about yourself and this eerie place.

title: Little Adventure Tale
description: Little Adventure tale is a Roguelike Deckbuilder set in a cute fantasy world where you can enlist the help of the Guild to Hire companions and manage several Card Decks & Accept Quests to earn more rewards! All this in order to banish the Evil Lord Obradin!

title: Trials of Yarbil
description: In this top-down roguelike you must think creatively to take advantage of your resources and best your enemies. You are a samurai wizard and to prove your worth you must complete the Trials of Yarbil.

title: TailScape: The corgi’s Advendture
description: Tailscape is a Metroidvania game starring a cute puppy. Solve hidden puzzles and sometimes face large enemies to fill in the story of the bond between humans and animals.

title: Black Fairy
description: A new wintery map: Black Fairy on its black red wings! Contains lots of enemies, explosions, boom-booms, and there's also one snowman. In addition, it contains a calmer variation of the map called "White Noiz" which is meant to be played after Black Fairy

title: Age of Wonders 4: Ways of War
description: Achieve perfection in battle with Age of Wonders 4: Ways of War. Embrace the Oathsworn culture and devote yourself to their warrior's code. Deploy disciplined monks and shadowy assassins. Investigate mysterious happenings that see your fellow Godir replaced by demons and dragons. Lead two new forms for your factions: the hulking Ogrekin or the strong Simians. This content pack contains a new culture, new tomes, new wildlife units and a new type of narrative event chain.

title: Age of Wonders 4: Giant Kings
description: Restore the Elder Giants to their rightful place as masters of the Astral Sea, in the Age of Wonders 4: Giant Kings Expansion. Explore the ruins of their fallen empire, seek out forgotten crystal magic to empower your armies, and delve for forgotten treasures deep beneath the earth. Contains a new giant ruler type, dwelling and hand crafted regions to explore.

title: Age of Wonders 4: Archon Prophecy
description: Take command of the forces of light, in the Age of Wonders 4: Archon Prophecy Expansion. Join the celestial Archons as they strike back against Urrath’s corrupt forces. Consult the oracles and glimpse the hidden prophecies that shape the fates of the realms, and become the master of your own destiny. Contains a new culture, story content and prophecy events.

title: Magical Girls vs. Cat Aliens
description: Magical Girls vs Cat Aliens is a casual run and shoot game where you control a highschool girl fighting against the cat alien invasion. By charging her magical brooch she can transform into a powerful magical girl! Use your wand to shoot magical blasts on the enemies and dash to avoid being hit, because once attack can undo the transformation and you will have to survive on your own, without powers, until you can transform again! Can the magical girl bring the city's public safety to the maximum? Defeat alien cats and collect crystals to increase the public safety and the crystals can also be used to unlock new powerful wands!

title: Golf With Your Friends 2
description: Tee off in Golf With Your Friends 2! Dive into 12-player chaos, wild new course mechanics, a revamped level editor, and nonstop fun—play together no matter how and where your friends play!

title: Solitomb
description: Use your solitaire skills to assemble powerful combos and defeat the dungeon's monsters. Grab treasure and spend it to build a set of powerful, synergistic abilities to help you. Manage both your own resources and the demon's patience to hopefully survive the ordeal.

title: Seal of Solitomb
description: Use your solitaire skills to assemble sweet combos and defeat the dungeon's monsters. Grab treasure and spend it on powerful, synergistic abilities. Manage both your own resources and the demon's patience to hopefully survive the ordeal.

title: Pinball FX3: Carnivals and Legends Demo
description: The Pinball FX3: Carnivals and Legends Demo is a free trial download for the pinball simulation game Pinball FX3 by Zen Studios. It lets players try tables from the Carnivals and Legends pack, which features the theme park-themed Adventure Land table and the mythological Son of Zeus table.

title: Inn Hand
description: Inn Hand is an atmospheric god game and casual management sim that places you in the role of a magical deity operating a cozy isometric inn. Replace your mouse cursor with a spectral hand to tend to your patrons' needs in exchange for gold and reviews, ensuring your inn thrives!

title: LepozhdianVibe
description:
Lepozhdian Vibe is an immersive simulator inspired by the synthwave aesthetic and the 1980s. It's a game where creativity and freedom take center stage. We offer a variety of modes: sandbox, classic shooters, arcade racing, social dynamic modes like Mafia, and even an editor where you can create your own maps, stories, and worlds.

Lepozhdian presents a unique game that knows it’s a game. In this experience, reality and the game world intertwine, breaking the fourth wall. Characters discuss their roles, the game’s rules, and even address the player directly, creating an unforgettable experience. It’s more than a game — it’s a reflection on what a game truly is.

There are no strict boundaries in the game. Want to build a city? Go ahead. Prefer competition? Host races or battles with friends. It's all up to you.

Our game supports multiplayer, style customization, and VR. Want to play in your own atmosphere, with personalized interface settings and weapons? No problem. Most importantly, we've added modding capabilities through a built-in programming language. Everything you need for creativity is already in the game.

Lepozhdian Vibe is a free game with no microtransactions. However, the project's support relies entirely on you. Subscribe to our Patreon if you'd like to help us make the game even better.

This format allows us to continually develop and improve the game, respond promptly to your feedback, add new content, fix bugs, and implement innovative ideas. This gives us the flexibility to keep the game fresh and engaging for you over a long period of time.

We are confident that this approach will allow us to create something truly special and captivating. Together with you, we can develop a game that will bring joy for years to come.

description: Cat's Dream is a pixel-style puzzle game in which players take on the role of Cat Meow that turns into a human, on a fantasy one-day adventure. The reason for all this seems to have something to do with her owner Song...

description: Get ready to splat, splash, and spill as you mess it up with friends in this family-friendly shooter! Customize your character, chat it up with iconic Atari characters, and blast your way to claim the cone in this reimagined classic!

description: Permuter is a synthwave-style autobattler inspired by Geometry Wars 3's Pacifism mode. Control an agile ship, weave through enemies, buy and stack game-changing upgrades, choose your build carefully to gain synergy bonuses, and defeat the challenging elite bosses.

Experience the thrill of the road as you explore diverse maps, from icy fjords and dense forests to bustling cities and serene countryside. Choose from a wide array of vehicles.
