description: Hear me, pitiful mortals, for I shall reveal to you the path to true power - a demonic fusion of deckbuilding, ritual duels, and roguelite! I speak of a realm shrouded in darkness, where only the most wicked may thrive. Behold my masterpiece, "Just A Shadow Game".

title: Trails of the Last Day
description: A zombie apocalypse game where you play as the last survival team of humankind.

title: Elimora
description: Master Elemental Creatures in real-time deck-building adventure! Explore a fantasy world filled with magical creatures. Collect spirit fragments to summon and evolve companions, use cards to unleash powerful abilities, and uncover the secrets of the mystical realm to prevent its destruction.

title: Road59: A Yakuza’s Last Stand
description: Born as the heir to a crime syndicate, yet longing for an ordinary and peaceful life, the kind-hearted protagonist fights desperately to protect their loved ones. Set against a backdrop of towering skyscrapers, this visual novel weaves together the lives of 23 characters in a modern-day legend.

title: Graphical Limbo
description: Dive into the surreal realm of Graphical Limbo! A weirdcore / dreamcore adventure, inspired by the worlds and interactions of our dreams (and nightmares)!

title: Sentinel Agency
description: As a special investigator on a theme park island full of dinosaurs, you have to solve three murders while hidden forces try to stop you with brute force. Shoot, sneak, uncover secrets, survive.

title: Paper Battlefield
description: A strategy game where warfare takes place in a drawn world bound by the limits of a notebook. Experience a real-time strategy experience where all your units and structures are drawn with ink.

title: Winion Virus
description: A pixel-art visual novel horror game. It features adorable and charming graphics paired with a dark fairy-tale story full of unexpected twists. As a point-and-click adventure, your task is to fix the errors occurring within the computer.

title: Blepp Quest!
description: Blepp Quest: an adventure RPG about getting treasure, smashing baddies and gross close-ups. Seek the legendary Gaia's Opal... a shattered gift from the Gods.

title: Cats of Mona Lisa: A Hidden Object Game
description: Step into the world of timeless art with a playful twist! Cats of Mona Lisa is a relaxing hidden-object game where you explore beautifully reimagined classical paintings in search of ten mischievous cats cleverly hidden within each masterpiece.

title: Yin Peach Blossom
description:
I saw a girl with light blue hair by the lake, and she actually wants to add me on WeChat?!

Wait, I woke up, it was just a dream.

Huh? I dreamed about her again today?

title: Sorcerian System New Scenario Vol.1: Uchuu kara no Houmonsa (1989)
Crimson Incursion
description: Crimson Incursion thrusts you into the heart of a futuristic battlefield on a distant colony. Command a diverse array of war platforms and unleash your innate prowess to dominate your foes. Inspired by the iconic mech-based games of the early '90s and 2000s.

title: Mech Crusade
description: Mech Crusade is a 90's-inspired mech simulator set in the post-apocalyptic land of 2199 Merica. You have a choice of multiple different mechs, weapons, and branching, nonlinear missions. Take contracts. Blow things up. Rake in the moolah.

title: Czech Soccer Manager 2025
description: Czech Soccer Manager is a football manager simulator, where you take over the coaching of one of the available teams and try to bring it not only by using reinforcements to bring over time to success.

title: Forma
description: Hunt or be hunted in Forma, an immersive sandbox RPG set in a land overrun by living emotions, where every choice shapes a dynamic living world

title: Dreeg
description: Dreeg is a dimension shifting platforming adventure game where you move between 3 parallel dimensions at will to solve puzzles and take on robotic enemies. Customize Dreeg's armor to gain power and unlock new abilities and upgrades for your energy weapon system as you take on the psychotic Xel'xan.

title: Libritopia: Librarian Simulator
description: Manage your own library! Organize and classify books however you like, furnish the space with shelves, help visitors find their books, and maintain silence to keep them happy!

title: Sonic the Hedgehog: Legend of the Blue Blur 2
Mystereet: Yasogami Kaoru no Chousen!
description: An upcoming remastered version of Mystereet: Yasogami Kaoru no Chousen! made by MAGES. for Windows, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 and Xbox Series X/S.

title: Cadeau
description: Cadeau is an RPG Horror game about a lonely, yet stubborn, young woman named Charlotte– who finds herself in a world unknown to man, wearing clothes that do not belong to her. Wonderful and tragic events are to follow suit, as all of her greatest wishes come true. However, as these things often go, her happiness does not come without consequence…

title: Cognitive Dissonance: A SiIvaGunner Christmas Comeback Crisis Side Story
description: Cognitive Dissonance: A SiIvaGunner Christmas Comeback Crisis Side Story is a visual novel and spinoff of the SiIvaGunner Christmas Comeback Crisis which was released as a part of the SiIvaGunner 2024 Christmas ARG. The game follows The Joke-Explainer 7000 as she helps Dr. Andonuts with his mental struggles.

title: SilvaGunner: Rebooted
description: SilvaGunner: Rebooted is an Undertale fangame released by SiIvaGunner as a part of the Christmas 2024 ARG, in which it plays in the genocide ending of the SilvaGunner: Rebooted storyline. The player plays as Chad Warden as he faces off against Haruka Amami.

title: Meet Santa
description:
Did you ever want to meet Santa? Well, now you can! At least if you can win a match of Nutcracker Run!
Sir Creakwood is ready to take on any opponent—do you have the skill (or luck) to beat him? Roll your way to victory and burn this old wooden creature... for real... please, do it, this thing creeps me out! Who the hell designed these things?!

title: Racoonfeast
description:
"It's okay, Sophia. There's no need to be scared. Would you be so kind as to satisfy the hunger of an old creature?"
In this eerie game, you assume the role of little Sophie, who forgot to do the laundry. Despite the warning never to venture into the nocturnal chore, an unsettling question lingers: what malevolent presence awaits in the shadows of the laundry room?

title: Mr. Lupin
description: On a wonderful winter night, the moonlight bathes the silent streets, your own footsteps echoing softly. But wait... did you just hear someone whispering your name?

title: SiIvaGunner: King for a Day Tournament - Playable Credits Minigame!!
description: SiIvaGunner: King for a Day Tournament - Playable Credits Minigame!! is a short game made for the SiIvaGunner: King for a Day Tournament which is based on the credits segment of Super Smash Bros. Melee, in which the player scores points by shooting down all the credits from the tournament. The game was released with the video "ONE FINAL ANNOUNCEMENT (for real this time)" alongside the album for the soundtrack for the event.

title: Gorgonia: A Gorgon's Tragedy
description: Gorgonia: A Gorgon's Tragedy is an RPG Maker horror game that reimagines the Gorgons’ origin story, offering a fresh perspective on the ancient myth. Step into the role of Medyuu, a beautiful lamia with unsettling secrets. Her sisters seem to glimpse something different in her—a haunting gaze that pulls her into a path of strange encounters and eerie discoveries.

title: Restoring Falmay
description: An RPG about saving a fairy's homeland.

title: The Cold Hand Reef
description: Help a young girl escape the infamous Cold Hand Reef before nightfall.

title: Christmas Jumper Jam
description: A jam using Arcane Dimensions, with a focus on jump boots featuring 9 maps. Get on your holiday jumper!

title: Learning Ladder: Years 1 & 2
description: Learning Ladder: Years 1 & 2 is an educational PC game designed for ages 5 to 7. The game aims to teach kids about maths, reading and writing.

title: Final Sanctuary
description: A year after the disaster, the bunker's life support systems fail critically. Communication with the outside world is completely lost. You are a mechanical engineer, awakened in your quarters by a piercing siren, alone and cut off from the world.

title: Project Spikepig
description: ~Sonic for me and you~

title: Sonic Incursion
description: Sonic Incursion is a fangame utilizing the Sonic GDK extension to the Unreal Development kit. Play as Sonic or Metal Sonic as you take the fight to the vicious Metallix Empire, before they convert all life into twisted mechanical beings! The gameplay is 2.5D for the regular stages, with certain Act 3's featuring singular gimmicks.

title: Skeppskatten går iland
description:
An educational game for kids teaching Swedish words when they have just started to learn reading and writing.

The game will teach:
- Read and writing
- Consonant lengthening
- Word comprehension
- Synonyms
- Phonics
- Create with text and image

title: Strings of Fate XI: Magic Dream
description: This is an adventure about five brave heroes who have to embark on a journey where ancient prophecies, sword and magic play a key role in the struggle to save the world. Nine schools of magic, about a hundred spells and dozens of sets of weapons. More than fifteen dungeons with riddles and monsters.

title: The Corn Maze
description: Navigate a haunting corn maze in this atmospheric exploration game. Manage your flashlight battery, search for compasses, and uncover eerie secrets while avoiding what lurks in the shadows. Simple mechanics, immersive tension—can you find your way out?

title: Tower Wizard
description: Help a wizard construct the mightiest wizard tower in this short incremental game!

title: Vampire Huntress: Lament of the Sun
description: Classic survival horror experience set in a dark gothic world. Play as Luna Ashcroft and explore an interconnected world filled with incomprehensible horrors, mind-bending puzzles and countless secrets. Are you ready to face the horrors of the night? LET THE HUNT BEGIN!

title: Mercenaries 3: No Limits
description: Mercenaries 3: No Limits was the working title of a video game being developed by Pandemic Studios. It was supposed to be the third instalment of the Mercenaries game series, until it was canceled when Pandemic Studios was shut down in 2009. A showreel of early development footage was leaked in November 2010.

title: Sub Terra Draconis: The Golemworks
description: A dusty tunnel to the side leads to an old dwarven construction facility. Disused parts of golems and other machinery litter the ground. There is surely treasure here, but these tunnels won't lead him to the outside of the mountain!

title: Slender Killer
description: Slender Killer was a hidden level in Slender: The Nine Pages. The author have decided to make it standalone so everybody can play it.

title: Panelak
description: Panelak Panelak is a post-Soviet old apartment building where weird things happen. Can you manage to get to the roof and save the helpless man?

title: OneShot: Frostide
description:
Embark on a short journey with Niko through the snow covered world you both once helped save!

Sneakily leave behind gifts for the people you've met along your previous journey, and maybe even get one yourself!
Save Progress:

You can safely close the game to save your progress.
Saved mod progress will not interfere with your vanilla or other mod saves.

title: Battow: Mages And Monsters
description: Battow - Mages And Monsters is a bouncing bullet game, the player clicks somewhere on the screen for the Mage to throw a spell in that direction. The spell bounces off the walls of the scene, and the player will need to use this to their advantage to hit the rival. Every time the player collects a chest or shield, he is protected for one round, that is, will defend himself if he is hit by the monster's spell. It's a relaxing atmosphere game, simple and easy to play. There are 5 Mages, 20 monsters and 100 levels.

title: D.A.R: Deadly Alien Rogues
description: DAR is an arcade-style single-screen shoot-em-up inspired by the classics, with some modern rogue-like twists! Pick your character, plot a course through the galaxy, grab upgrades and destroy the enemy! The ultimate goal? Saving the galaxy! Or just getting a really, really high score - your call.

title: Bilge Junction
description:
Welcome to Bilge Junction, population 8: a dying town on the arctic highway. With the promise of a cheap roof over your head, you ran from your problems and wound up here.

But winter's setting in, and the fire keeps burning. A storm is on its way. There's something lurking in the pipeline that built the town. In three days' time, it's bound to escape.

title: Breaker Initiating
description: BREAKER: INITIATING is a short 3D game featuring platforming and puzzle-solving elements. You step into the role of El, a robot equipped with electrical discharge abilities. Navigate through a desolate world, using El's unique powers to overcome obstacles and explore mysterious environments.

title: Find or be Found
description:
Find or Be Found is an asymmetric co-op horror game. Go on heists as a pair of burglars looking for the most valuable items in haunted houses. Locate the specific item to earn money and progress, but search for too long, and unimaginable horrors will awaken.

Play as either the hacker or the robber. Only the hacker knows what to steal and where to find it, and only the robber inside the house can grab it. Communication is key.

title: Minecraft: PS1 Edition
description:
It's an average Saturday afternoon. You just got your paycheck from your degrading part time cashier job. A whopping 55 dollars and 62 cents. With your new found riches, you decide to hit up some local garage sales to see if you can get a good deal on any retro games. These relics, forgotten by time, remind you of a simpler world. A world of play, of laughter, joy, excitement. Concepts that are becoming more and more unfamiliar to you with each passing day that you waste away at that fucking cash register.

You climb into your beat up 2007 Saturn Ion with the rear bumper held on by ductape, and drive, stopping at each location to see what they have to offer. Clothes, books, kids toys, but no games. This average Saturday afternoon has now devolved into a disappointing Saturday evening. With the orange glow of the setting sun enveloping you in despondency, you decide to make one last stop before calling it a day. You step out of the car, hopes lower than ever, to see more of the same. Tables of neatly folded clothes, boxes of old VHS tapes, dusty dinnerware, miscellaneous knick-knacks.

As you're heading back to the car, something out of the corner of your eye catches your attention. A lone Playstation 1 game, resting atop a plastic tote full of bed sheets. With the glare of the sun reflecting off of its plastic jewel case, you can't quite make out what game it is, but you can tell it's a 3 disc game by the thickness of the case. You wonder which game it could be. Alone in the Dark? Final Fantasy? Chrono Cross? Curiosity now at its peak, you find yourself reaching for the alluring game.

Your curiosity has now twisted into total confusion. Now holding the game in your cold, clammy hands, you read the title, speaking it out loud. "Minecraft: Playstation Edition". As these words leave your lips, you feel a chill run down your spine. "How can this be?", you think to yourself. "Minecraft wasn't created until 2009. By then, even the Playstation 3 was already 3 years old. This is impossible. Surely this is a fake, or a homebrew, or...something?"

Flipping the game over, you take a gander at the rest of the case. At first glance, all appears to be normal. It has a rating, a barcode, gameplay screenshots, even a SLUS number. But upon further inspection, you notice the text on the back of the case. It's not English. In fact, it's no language that you've ever seen before, to your recollection. Strange, indeed.

You tear your eyes away from the case. It's getting dark out. The owners of the house have begun packing up their unsold items, and most of the customers have gone home. You glance back down at the game to see the price sticker. $15. "Should I?", you ponder. 15 dollars is a sizeable amount for someone in your position. Why spend this much for something that might not even work? But you can't just let something this unusual go, you have to know what it is or it will haunt you for the rest of your life.

For the first time, you open the case. You see the first disc: Overworld. Next to it appears to be the game manual. You open it, but the pages are all torn out. "Why would someone do this?" Shoving the thought aside, you close the empty housing of what presumably once was an instruction booklet, and open the second compartment of the case, revealing the other two discs: The End, and The Slip. "The Slip? Is that supposed to be The Nether?" Shrugging off your confusion, you question the integrity of the game. All the discs are there, but in what condition? You check the shiny, black underside of each disc for scratches, but they are minimal.

You take one last look at your surroundings. Nobody has noticed you. In what is not your proudest moment, you close the case, shove it into the pocket of your hoodie, and as you do, you feel a sudden sense that someone or something is watching you. You spare a quick glance over your shoulder. Nothing. You briskly leave the scene, shuffle into your car and start the engine.

Upon arriving at your humble abode, you slam the door behind you, startled by the sound. It seems to have snapped you out of your daze, bringing you to a more conscious state of mind. It's a very familiar feeling. The same feeling you experience every time you wake up. Your surroundings slowly become more real to you. You slowly become more self aware. Your clothes are damp from sweat, your vision is blurrier than normal, you don't even remember the drive home. It's as if you... teleported.

Looking around the room, not quite sure what you're looking for, your eyes stop once they reach the clock on the wall. 11:57. "What the fuck..." Not so much a question that begs for an answer, but rather a simple declaration of bewilderment. You toss your keys in the direction of the table, not caring whether they land on it or not.

You open the mysterious case, remove the Overworld disc, and place it into your Playstation console, close the lid, and press the power button. A procedure you've done so many times before, but this time, it doesn't feel so comforting. You are welcomed by the notoriously eerie startup sequence of the PS1, proceeded by a large spinning grass block accompanied by the word Loading... You feel yourself become increasingly more uneasy as the block continues to spin, and spin, and spin, and as it does so, you feel yourself starting to slip away.

Before you have time to process this feeling, it stops, and the title screen presents itself to you. "Minecraft: Playstation Edition". There are 3 buttons: Play, Options, and Quit Game. Next to these options, a graphic of Steve. His eyes seem to pierce through yours, looking directly into your soul. But it's just a picture...right? The background, while perhaps unintentional, is intangibly disturbing. It appears to be some kind of mansion, expertly built, nonetheless, in a dark and foggy setting.

You press play, proceeding to the World Select screen. To your surprise, there is already one world: Tutorial. You're no stranger to Minecraft, so you ignore it, eagerly jumping straight to the Create New World button. Most of the standard world creation options seem to be there, along with a virtual keyboard. You use it to name your world, then you set your gamemode, world type, difficulty, and with the controller ever so slightly trembling in your hands, you hesitate just for a second. Curiosity, anxiety, excitement, fear. All of these emotions hit you like a punch to the stomach. Your breath stops. The clock strikes 12. "Preparing for world creation. Do NOT turn off system"

Enter the survival horror.

title: Purgatory: Blue
description:
A new visual novel led, written and composed by cittan*.

Akito meets his childhood friend, but for some reason, he is the only one who can see and recognize her.

title: Neva: Devolver Deluxe Edition
description:
Neva: Devolver Deluxe will include the following exclusive items, besides the physical game:
· A stunning softbound 88-page artbook showcasing concept art and game art.
· A copy of the game’s original soundtrack by Berlinist, on a CD and as digital download.
· A collector’s tuck-in box housing all the contents.

Neva is an emotionally charged action-adventure from the team behind GRIS.

title: One Last Story
description: Do a writer's last words mean anything to the living? A story about death and the (idealization or fear of a possible) future.

title: Violeta
description: After feeling marginalized by society, a young trans woman decides to venture out into the post-apocalyptic world to find a place she can call home.

title: Conqueror Of The Galaxy
description:
Conqueror Of The Galaxy is a 2D bullet hell space shooter that puts you in command of powerful spaceships as you conquer galaxies.

With vibrant graphics and intense gameplay, you’ll face waves of enemies, dodge deadly projectiles, and use strategic skills to overcome epic challenges.
With each battle, you’ll be able to upgrade your ship, unlock new features, and conquer galaxies, establishing yourself as the greatest Conqueror in the Universe. Step onto the battlefield and show off your skills!

title: RhythMania
description: An upcoming vibrant rhythm anthology filled with over a dozen dynamic mini-games with minimalistic inputs across musical genres and visual styles!

title: Conradito Cafézito
description: It costs the price of a coffee – but it lasts much longer! Conradito Cafézito, is an idle and incremental game where you unlock recipes, automate processes, and expand your coffee empire while watching your profits rise with every click!

title: Varg
description: A love letter to the classic MS-DOS “boomer” shooter genre, in a setting loosely inspired by Brazil's most iconic UFO case. When your son goes missing, take to the streets in search of answers. Unravel the secrets of a shadowy corporation and an alien-worshiping cult that has taken over your town.

title: Dominium
description: In Dominium, you take on the role of a temporal agent tasked with preventing a time anomaly: a train explosion that will lead to the death of the man destined to invent the time machine. Utilize your investigative skills, navigate intricate time loops, and unravel the mystery behind this catastrophic event.

title: Eco Farm Green
description: A clicker with global warming resource management in which your goal is to reduce your carbon footprint as much as possible while maintaining your plantation.

title: Ivayami: Cradle of Fog
description: Four friends decide to visit an abandoned city. When the trip is is suddenly cut short by a car accident, Cynthia Moriyama must traverse through the dense fog of Ivayami searching for her missing friends. Beware, as the fog hides more than you imagine

title: Sovereign's Enigma
description: Sovereign's Enigma is a 2D platformer with survival elements, in a densely interconnected cave, where the player needs to uncover the story of an ancient civilization to solve a mystery from the past. This game is a slow and immersive experience, with a strong focus on storytelling, atmosphere, and characters.

title: Retrokill
description: RETROKILL is a demake of ULTRAKILL

title: Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego? 3: New Carmen Adventure
description: In ACME's New York branch, the Chief informs agent Julia that some of the world's greatest treasures have been stolen. The Chief suspects the thefts to be the work of Carmen Sandiego, but there is lack of evidence to confirm it. Julia along with Adam Shadow are sent to find the thief and recover the treasures, before news of the theft reaches the public. Matt Forrest provides technical assistance during the mission. After many investigations around the world and putting together a digital map of Atlantis, it turns out that Carmen Sandiego had been intercepting ACME communications and planned this entire mission. Carmen Sandiego steals the map and heads to South America.

title: Oddcore
description: You have only 5 minutes to stylishly explode your way through the hordes of corrupted entities in a retro FPS, roguelike liminal-nightmare... and Timmee is here to help!

title: Medix
description: You are not here to win the war, but to save whom you can before the line breaks. A narrative real-time strategy where you lead a unit of war medics across hand-drawn battlefields and race to reach the wounded as your army retreats before an overwhelming foe. Keep hope alive amidst the chaos.

title: Ansiolisis
description: Ansiolisis (or Anxiolysis) is a short interactive narrative text-based adventure over a dream of someone with anxiety.

title: The Bible
description: A digital recreation of The Bible in Kinetic Novel form! Read through and save passages in any order with an original soundtrack, or listen through the greatest story ever told in audiobook form. Featuring an extensive Trivia section to find out how well you really know the stories of Old and New.

title: Khaos Tracks
description: Khaos Tracks is a high-energy rhythm game that combines heart-pounding beats, dynamic gameplay, and visually stunning neon environments. Players tap, their way through a variety of music genres, from smooth country grooves to electrifying synth melodies. With a sleek UI and bold neon accents, the game challenges players to match the rhythm of carefully crafted instrumental tracks. Featuring fast-paced action and a pulse-pounding soundtrack, Khaos Tracks is an immersive experience where every beat brings you closer to the edge of chaos.

title: Yukuhito no Pleroma
description:
A visual, sound, and novel game that illustrates a Gnostic world.
A story that combines human history, religion, politics, fiction, and prophecies.

title: Tsuki no Hikari no Kusariya-san
description:
"I'll take on all your pain and suffering."

A slightly dark fantasy romance novel about spending time with a young wizard.

title: Sacrarium Gelus
description: A single route romance-fantasy VN with a male LI.

title: Kyonyuu Fantasy Gaiden 2 After: Osutashia no Yabou
description: Sequel to Funbag Fantasy: Sideboob Story 2. It happens few months after it and oppose Edellant to Osutashia.

title: Destination: The Planet
description: Welcome to Destination: The Planet, a 3D collect-a-thon platformer all about exploring weird little worlds! Once a lost game for the DreamSoft console, now playable on your computer!

title: Re:Aktor
description: Re:Aktor is a metroidvania about going fast and rewinding time. Race the clock, unlock new abilities and shortcuts, and solve temporal puzzles. Tear through walls and enemies with damage that scales with momentum, and punch ever deeper into a mysterious underground facility.

title: Neon Doomer 85
description: Dive into the life of a retrowave doomer for a while. Just click the TV screen to control your virtual car, the design of which is inspired by classic '80s automobiles and the vivid imagination of the creators. Each click brings you closer to new levels and unlocks unique references to iconic cultural events of the past.

title: SoftWar Cyber Fight
description: A Science-Fiction Visual Novel Role-Playing Game with a story centered on the cyberworld conflicts. New"SoftWars" are battles involving sentient softwares namely viruses and anti-viruses, deciding the fates of computer systems.

title: Drive Me Crazy
description: "Drive me crazy" is a game inspired by the urban legend "Yua Mikami's wedding and retirement event." You play as her fiancé, qiangzi, in this interactive adventure. During the game, you will be asked one question: "With Yua Mikami by your side, would you still have a change of heart?"

title: Infinity Nikki: Shooting Star Season
description:
Infinity Nikki‘s first major update, “Shooting Star Season,” available December 30 through January 23, introduces new storylines, platforming challenges, time-limited events, and of course, stunning outfits to ring in the new year.

During the Shooting Star Season, shimmering meteors will grace the night skies over Miraland as residents come together and cast their wishes upon the stars. Beyond these cosmic travelers and festive decorations, players will find a series of new activities, rewards, and ways to interact with the cozy open-world.

title: Blades of Mirage
description: Embark on an epic isometric action RPG set in a Southeast Asian-inspired world. As Mira, use your ability to create water-based weapons and explore ancient ruins scattered across unique islands. Confront corrupted, powerful creatures and solve intricate puzzles to secure the ancient relics.

title: Comma
description: Comma is a side-scrolling game that tells the story of a dream world where the player has to get out of there by following a mysterious figure.

title: Temukung: Cultivation in Drylands
description: Live on driest land in Indonesia, The Timorese adapted this difficult situation with corn’s cultivation, but the imperialism created disruption in Timor. Now get ready to manage Timor’s farming as Temukung and face many difficult situations in Timor from middle 19th century until World War II

title: Potion Promise
description: In a medieval fantasy world, a young witch finds herself inheriting a massive debt from her parents. With only 30 days to repay it, she must rely on her potion-making skills and cunning to gather rare ingredients and fulfill the demands of her customers, while uncovering shocking truths behind.

title: Fear the Unknown: Dave Story
description:
In the first episode of Fear the unknown ,In the game, you will play as one of the lucky ones who met them and survived.

This game offers a first-person narrative experience, blending walking simulation with elements of exploration, driving, drinking, and interactive conversations.

title: M's Cases: Chapter 1 - Vanishing of Melisma
description:
The first chapter of an adventure puzzle game. You will play as Mark, a cat detective just
starting out in a quiet little town where nothing much seems to happen. As you solve
one case after another, you'll slowly uncover the hidden mysteries that this sleepy town
has been keeping.

title: Overglow
description:
In OverGlow you gotta help a cute candle ghost rekindle her dimming flame, her lack of arms make it difficult for her to feed herself.
So in comes you, ready to direct the fuel into her mouth.

Left unfinished by the dev to work on a sequel/ spiritual successor "OverGlow 2: Night".

title: Mangui
description: Mangui is a turn-based roguelike game inspired by spooky traditional Korean folklore. Play as one of four protagonists, unraveling the mysteries of the dark Mangui mountains. Live to tell the tale in this dangerous world filled with ghouls and monsters!

title: Q Steps
description:
An educational games for young children to start learning English, the game has several courses divided up in areas, which themselves are different themes for building word comprehension. The game is based on a book called "English With A Smile".

The different areas are
- The Gatehouse (numbers)
- The Q family house (family relationships)
- The Paint Factory (colors)
- The Tailor's Shop (clothing)
- The Gym (parts of the body)
- The School (classroom)
- The Grocery Store (food)
- The Theater (feelings)

The game came in 2 CDs where CD 1 is the 4 first areas and CD 2 is the latter 4 areas. Later revisions of the game combined both CDs into 1 and as such there was no need to swap CDs while playing.

title: Mizi No!: Kintsugi
description:
Oh hi! Good to see you here.
In case you liked the puzzles in Mizi NO! and crave more, you have come to the right place.
The "Kintsugi" DLC adds 20 more items focusing on repeating patterns. Of course, Mizi will happily knock them over. But only because it knows you like to glue them back together ;)

Kintsugi is the Japanese art of repairing broken pottery by mending the areas of breakage with lacquer and powdered gold. If you ever wanted to try this, this DLC is for you :)

title: Mizi No!: Everyday Objects
description:
Oh hi! Good to see you here.
In case you liked the puzzles in Mizi NO! and crave more, you have come to the right place.

The "Everyday Objects" DLC contains 20 colorful everyday objects that Mizi will happily knock over. But only because it knows you like to glue them back together ;)

title: Mizi No!: Playful Patterns
description:
Oh hi! Good to see you here.
In case you liked the puzzles in Mizi NO! and crave more, you have come to the right place.

The "Playful Patterns" DLC adds 20 more items focusing on repeating patterns. Of course, Mizi will happily knock them over. But only because it knows you like to glue them back together ;)

title: Mizi No!: Blank Slate
description:
Oh hi! Good to see you here.
In case you liked the puzzles in Mizi NO! and crave more, you have come to the right place.

The "Blank Slate" DLC is for the minimalists and players looking for a challenge. The items in this pack are designed to be more subtle and will challenge you to focus more on the puzzle shapes themselves!

The "Blank Slate" DLC contains 20 objects that Mizi will happily knock over. But only because it knows you like to glue them back together ;)

title: GSPro
description:
GSPro is the leader in next generation golf simulation software. Amazing 4k graphics, ultra realistic ball physics and a community constantly contributing.

Golf Courses: The golf course simulations playable in GSPro are not endorsed by or affiliated with any real-world golf courses or their respective owners or operators.

title: Nightmare Circus
description: Nightmare Circus is an action-adventure game where the player takes on the role of a Puppeteer trapped in the Nightmare Realm. Set out on a journey to find his friends and escape the nightmare!

title: Not Monday Cafe
description:
Build and manage your cute cozy cafe while working studying or streaming.
Farming and serving delicious dishes to adorable animal customer in your cafe on the bottom of your screen, all while you're working on other tasks and enjoying your day.

title: The Quarantine
description: Experience a blend of survival horror and strategic management. Fortify your base, manage resources, and scavenge for supplies in a world overrun by monstrous creatures and corrupted by blight blooms.

title: Find The Truth
description: Find The Truth is a horror RPG puzzle game that revolves around a girl who has lost her memory due to an accident, and her journey to reclaim her lost memories. Your actions in the game will impact the story and lead to different outcomes.

title: Falling Rain
description: Falling Rain is a third-person anime shooting RPG game with advance movement mechanic. Immerse yourself in a post apocalypse world and experiences the character struggle and follow the character to the end of their story.

title: Big Trouble in Little Chimney
description: Krampus is Coming! Grab your Shotgun, finish your hot punch and don't forget your mission: Save the Christmas! Big Trouble in Little Chimney is highly-addictive and fast paced arena bullet-hell shooter.

title: Super Senseless Soccer
description: The best football rogue-lite ever made! Super Senseless Soccer has a unique twist: start with a normal football game, then add a large variety of illegal modifiers and game-changing Upgrade Tickets in order to trigger ridiculous combos. It's super! It's senseless! It's SOCCER!!!

title: Poop Killer 8
description: The poop killer now strikes in the middle of Christmas... smellier and deadlier. Embark on this shitty adventure and try not to end up with poop stuck in your mouth. With three meaningless endings...

title: Madness in the Banaverse
description: Madness in the Banaverse is a single player platform game that combines action and comedy with a cartoonish style, taking as its protagonist the famous YouTuber “El Bananero”, who provides his voice to give life to the character and the most iconic phrases.

title: Five Minutes Till Christmas
description: Race against the clock in Five Minutes Till Christmas, a fast-paced holiday arcade game! Sprint through a bustling mall to gather last-minute gifts, evade vigilant security guards, and complete as many whishes before the time runs out. Perfect your strategy to top the global leaderboards!

title: Tonya The Killer
description: Tonya the Killer offers a fast-paced action and strategy-filled survival adventure. With dynamic enemy battles, an immersive story, and addictive gameplay, every moment is packed with excitement. Step into Tonya's world and conquer the chaos!

title: Recettear: An Item Shop's Tale HD Edition
description: A remaster of Recettear to be released in 2025.

title: Banebush
description: Banebush - is a non-linear and very red visual novel in the horror genre. Would you dare to step towards a fairy tale if it turns out to be true?

title: Dynasty Warriors: Origins - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Digital Deluxe Edition pre-order bonus:
- Early access
Provides access to the game 72 hours before the official release.

title: Atomfall: Deluxe Edition
description:
Pre-order the Atomfall Deluxe Edition to receive:
• The entire Atomfall game
• 3 days Early Access
• “Story Expansion Pack” – (*not available Day 1):
• “Basic Supply Bundle” Pack
• “Enhanced Supply Bundle” Pack

title: Pokémon HGSS: Sevii Islands
description: Pokémon HeartGold & SoulSilver: Sevii Islands is a Pokémon Fan Game created by PurpleZaffre using RPG Maker XP and Pokémon Essentials v16.2.

title: F1st Strike
description: F1st Strike is a turn-based game that combines elements of fighting games combos.

title: The Dog
description: This is a short, atmospheric psychological horror where you play as a middle-aged man dealing with probably the most life-changing day in his life. You can briefly do routine family man tasks and live through the story.

title: Lola's Lutong Bahay
description: Lola's Lutong Bahay is an immersive Filipino cooking simulation game where players step into the shoes of Dalisay, a budding chef learning traditional recipes from her beloved grandmother, Lola Felicia. Explore vibrant kitchen settings, master authentic Filipino cooking techniques, and embark on a flavorful journey to recreate iconic dishes. hone your culinary skills and celebrate the rich cultural heritage of Filipino cuisine in this heartwarming game.

title: Open Fire
description: In this police first-person shooter, you'll take on the role of an officer tasked with handling dangerous suspects, saving civilians, and reporting crucial evidence all across unique environments that challenge your skills and decision-making.

title: Jet Scalawag: The King of Shooters
description: Fight the mother of all space battles in an epic space combat shooter to end all space combat shooters! Jet Scalawag faces down the evil alien armada through time and space on worlds and expanses never before seen!

title: Oneiro(Phobia/Phrenia)
description:
ONEIRO(PHOBIA/PHRENIA) is a game about my fear of dreaming and my occasional inability to separate my dreams from reality.
In this experience the player zaps between the channels of a collective unconscious; the dreams of me and my loved ones, molded to fit into the confines of a grainy CRT TV screen.

title: The Anders Cyclopaedia
description:
Anders, a wild parallel universe, has become explorable once more. No one sees value in exploring this hostile, strange environment, except you.
Explore the wilderness, commune with its denizens, learn its esoteric rules, and compile your knowledge in the notoriously incomplete and error-ridden Anders Cyclopaedia.

title: Repeat After Death
description: The task is simple, defeat enemies using various Characters. But, your past move will consume you the more you continue down the path. Discover the dungeon mysteries while engaging with the other dungeon dwellers

title: Rootmare
description: Step into a world where the pursuit of beauty leads to unimaginable horror. As Nate, face off against mutated monstrosities and navigate a labyrinth of danger with limited resources. Expose the truth behind COSMIC’s experiments, while not succumbing to the nightmare within.

title: Mini Tank Mayhem
description: Mini Tank Mayhem is a roguelike deck-building tower defense game where you command a powerful mini-tank to repel waves of alien invaders. Craft your very own deck, deploy strategic defenses, and unleash devastating combos to protect Earth from pesky aliens!

title: Ganyang Setan Alas: The Game
description: Ganyang Setan Alas! The Game is a single-player shooter set in a haunted Indonesian forest, where four students, armed with a range of weapons, must survive relentless zombie attacks and escape a cursed fate.

title: Thousands Layered Blade: Reforged
description: Thousands Layered Blade: Reforged is an action-packed action RPG game that immerses players in a stunning 3D world inspired by traditional sumi-e art, now enhanced with realistic brush stroke simulations.

title: Jiwa: The Damned Soul
description: A first-person adventure set in an abandoned Indonesian hospital, where two content creators are in dire need of going viral. Explore alternatively as Sekar and Laras to discover and reveal all of the secrets you saw to the world.

title: Zoomageddon
description: Play as Oyen, an orange cat, in a post-apocalyptic world where you collect Zodiac Beasts abilities and challenge the Rat King. Zoomageddon blends bullet-heaven, dungeon roguelike, and base-building mechanics. Uncover story-rich inspired by Chinese Zodiac, unlock building, and discover quirky power!

title: Village Meow
description: Play as Kiti who was a city cat that moved into Village Meow after Kiti’s owner died. Now Kiti is in debt by the local corrupted Mayor, Bos Oyen, after being tricked. Kiti has a choice to either pay off his debts or unite with other villagers to drive out Bos Oyen.

title: The Gambit Lost to Time
description: Become a time-travelling advisor seeking to shape this world towards her ideal future. Choose between one of four kingdoms to support, with the realization that today's friend is an enemy in another timeline. Bring out your best Gambits and lead your troops to victory!

title: Garden of Wandering Souls
description: Garden of Wandering Souls is a Tower Defense game with a roguelite twist, featuring two unique mechanics: path building and tower attack range patterns that resemble puzzles, with narrative and visuals inspired by Indonesia’s Borobudur Temple, the world's largest Buddhist temple.

title: White Room: Mind’s Prison
description: White Room: Mind's Prison is a psychological horror game. You're not allowed to make any sound. Entities will make you scream. Stay quiet! The day counter will increase as you survive! Survive as long as possible.

title: Garuda Emblem
description:
Garuda Emblem is a beat ‘em up game with a taste of RPG content, where you can roam freely in the game’s beautifully hand-drawn world, get immersed in the story, and be the good journalist you are.

Play as Garuda Emblem members, a journalistic student activity unit that uncovers the truth behind the shady part of UNION. As the story unfolds, you’ll encounter various figures that’ll help you along in the journey. You can also upgrade your characters with different skills and abilities using your accumulated experience by beating your enemies to pulp!

Got bored of the main story? Refresh yourself with various side quests and mini games you can discover around the game’s world! Who knows, there might be secrets lying right in front of you all along!

title: Scribblemania
description:
Dive into a chaotic and surreal adventure where your artistic imagination is your greatest weapon! When your late-night spaceship sketch tears open reality, you and your best friend are thrust into an alien world teeming with bizarre creatures, quirky puzzles, and hilarious encounters.

Use your magical doodle device to draw shapes that come to life — smashing obstacles, fighting foes, and solving mind-bending challenges. Will your artistic genius save the day or destroy it? Grab your stylus and sketch your way to survival!

title: Blackblade Revenant
description: Blackblade Revenant is a Sekiro-like action RPG with parry-focused combat set during the fall of an ancient dynasty. Rise from the dead as Revenants and return to the mortal realm with one mission: Kill the King who cheated death.

title: Paradoxical Heat
description: An android's body reported it was freezing to death on a perfectly temperate day, look over our recreation of the error.

title: Overmind
description: Follow Alexander Blackwood as he explores the Godcomplex, a mental institution built after the end of the world, meant to alleviate the sufferings of the souls of now-deceased people.

title: Comme Tu Veux
description: Comme Tu Veux is a visual novel set in 1966 Saigon, focused on two 14-year-old school girls, Hồng and Như Ý, whose friendship falls apart. They meet again at an antiques market where Như Ý outbuys Hồng for a vase. Như Ý disappears, and Hồng's brother is found murdered.

title: Kyrie and Terra
description: Explore Grand Terra's fantasy world through a Japanese RPG. Recruit Celestia, customize them, and gather skill cards and equipment to build your unique party. Save the world in this epic tale of money's power.

title: Nth Dimension[al] Hiking
description: a ghost catches the bus home

title: Ticking Tea Time
description:
A catastrophic bomb is rumored to have been planted by a notorious spy from the West. According to an inside source, the spy fled the scene aboard first-class cabin of Hesperia Express. As Eastside's top detective, you must go undercover as a train waiter to solve this mystery. Serve afternoon tea to investigate suspect passengers, all while a bomb ticks down and a national catastrophe looms.

Can you make the spy spill the tea?Serve up your investigation in Ticking Tea Time!

title: Nameless Dreams: Endless Nightmares
description: You are trapped in a nightmarish dream. Maybe the only way to escape is to sleep... ? or maybe there is another way to escape... ?

title: Garland Boy
description: GARLAND FOR SALE! A game about a boy who earn his living by selling flower garlands to cars waiting in a traffic light at the intersection. Save enough money and follow his big dream. When the traffic light turns red, your job begins!

title: Fossilpunk
description: Lead space dino settlers to rebuild your civilization and rise again! Start cities, expand borders, grow your economy, and master tactical battles. Unleash epic dino combos in this turn-based strategy game with 4X and Roguelite elements. Rawr!

title: Arsenic & Absinthe
description: Arsenic & Absinthe is a blend of a chill bartender simulation with narrative-driven story. The player takes on the role of "Sylene", a bartender who recently began a new life; making drinks, serving unusual recipes of art, and listening to the stories of working-class customers. A simple life, however, is merely a dream for her as her haunted past returns. The player has to explore the night city and solve the pre-midlife crisis while getting caught in the notorious "Snow White" murder case once more.

title: Love is All Around: Echoes of Yesterday
Bearricade
description: Bearricade is a 32-map Vanilla Limit-removing megawad for Doom 2. It is a megawad of speedmaps and maps (or fragments) that were previously scrapped or abandoned by Death Bear.

title: The Lost Tetekoa
description: The Lost Tetekoa is set in the world of Ärta, a fictional world with Industrial fantasy elements, like magic with firearms. The map is somewhat a spiritual successor to Angmngthoo, one of fai1025 previous maps that goes with the same visual style of Eco-Brutalism.

title: Ozonia 2
description: Ozonia 2 is the sequel to the former 2022 wad Ozonia. The megawad follows a similar philosophy from the first Ozonia by containing fairly short maps with plutonish rocket-based gameplay, non-linear navigation and cryptic lore-based narrative.

title: Space Marshals Collection
description:
A compilation including all the three adventures from the Space Marshals sci-fi stealth action franchise has arrived to Nintendo Switch!

It is your mission to become a space marshal and capture dangerous criminals.
Use the objects and environment around you to your advantage to hunt down your enemies!
Includes all three adventures from the franchise!

title: Cabbie!
description: Buckle up and blast through vibrant bite-sized cartoon worlds. Drive, drift & deliver your way to victory solo or with up to 3 friends in co-op, or clash in competitive Taxi Tag mayhem!

title: County of Fortune
description: Build, grow and shape the future of an entire county in County of Fortune. Develop villages and towns, manage logistics, and guide your region’s economic, cultural, and social growth. Think big, plan smart, and create a thriving county in this unique twist on the city-building genre.

title: Crazy School: Schulverweis!
description:
Crazy School: Schulverweis! is exactly the same game as Gefeuert! Dein letzter Tag... just in a school instead of a office. The player takes the role of a pupil who wants to cause as much chaos as possible. With simple point & click controls the player walks trough the levels and uses the various items to play his pranks, e.g. knocking over a bucket or tearing apart a notebook. For some actions he needs to collect and use another item, e.g. toilet paper to clog a toilet.

Every action takes time and is rewarded with points, more complicated or mean ones give more. So the main goal for a level is to beat the highscore in a limited time. When the player gets caught he has to absolve a mini game of Hangman where he has to guess words in a limited time and in limited tries. The campaign consists of 21 levels and the player can choose his gender and the names of the NPCs.

title: BattleHeights
description:
BattleHeights is a multiplayer party game combining elements of aerial combat, fantasy, and physics-based mechanics.

Players engage in matches across floating maps, using abilities like double jumps, grappling hooks, and wind spells to outmaneuver and outwit their opponents. The gameplay revolves around creative movement, strategic use of terrain, and team-based objectives in modes like King of the Hill, Team Deathmatch and other fun activities, like a Grappling Race.

The game features cartoony physics, emphasizing fun and laughter over competitive intensity.

title: Cinco Noches en Casa Rosada
description: A Five Nights at Freddy's parody changing the main protagonists and setting for Argentina's politicians and government house, the Pink House (Casa Rosada).

title: Stranger Things
description: A short one-room game based on Netflix's "Stranger Things"

title: Stargate Adventure
description: Stargate Adventure is a fan-made point-and-click adventure game released in 2005 that pays tribute to the Stargate SG-1 series. Developed using the Adventure Game Studio engine, it features classic LucasArts-style gameplay where you control Colonel Jack O'Neill and his team on a mission to stop the villainous Anubis.

title: Lilith's Lair
description: A story driven sextroidvania click-em-up where you play as a brave barbarian ascending a lascivious lair!

title: Magicka: Mega Villain Robes
description:
Behind every missing wizard, behind every village pillaged by goblins, behind every bad happening in Midgård, there may or may not be a villainous mastermind behind it all. Unbeknownst to many, there is a dark underworld in Midgård, home to all sorts of evil personalities and organizations. This new robe pack will give you a spectacular taste of it!
With the Mega Villain Robe Pack players can choose from three more or less sane wizards who all decided that the world has done them wrong and must pay for it! These new wizards all follow the patented Super Standard of having their own special themes and matching personalities, this time based on the various Magicka elements.

title: Magicka: Aspiring Musician Robes
description: Some wizards are not only terrible spell casters, but terrible musicians as well! Join their ranks, and explore a variety of music history's greatest styles, from the heavy-metal guitar to the cool-but-moist saxophone! Take the lead in Aldrheim's very own misunderstood progressive basement band, adorned with musically inspired robes and powerful magickal instruments.

title: Sister Ray
description: 2D RPG about the brutal daily life of a drug addicted artist called Ray, who takes care of her little sister. Look after your condition, so no one finds out about the addiction. Improve your drawing and social skills. Do everything to get cash for another fix. Survive and look for a way out.

title: Cat’s Catch
description: Keep the bird safe for as long as you can while a rogue housecat is trying to catch it! The longer you hold out, the more desperate the cat becomes. He’ll take extreme measures like throwing bombs, slashing with scythes and transforming into a wild tornado-frenzy! Increase your highscore, collect feathers and unlock new birds and themes! Do you think you have what it takes to keep the bird from becoming the Cat’s next Catch?

title: Government Contractors: Arms of Influence
description: Historically accurate strategy game where you act as a government contractor researching, developing, and manufacturing weapons and technology for your clients. You choose the parts for each product, but be aware that cheap or wrong political choices may affect your success rate!

title: Gemerald
description: Ongezellig themed mod for Half-Life.

title: Better in Dreams
description: This game is just a compilation of my thoughts and fantasies.

title: Xd1
description: Come on animatronic, save the tulpa dubai! A xd1 roguelike game where you have to save the tulpa dubai. Big adventures & stories! Chapter 1 & 2, for free.

title: Tino's Fruit Stand
description: The opening of a large, unfriendly MegaMart across the street has put Tino's family fruit stand in danger of closing! With a little help from Rikki, the fruit-picking monkey, your job is to help him fill orders and keep customers happy. Fill orders correctly to get bonuses, but don't slow down or let the fruit sit for too long -- that will lead to unhappy shoppers and cost you the family business. Use your power-ups wisely, make the right decisions and you'll grow more than fruit ... you'll grow an empire!

title: Private Eye: Greatest Unsolved Mysteries
description: A nefarious secret society known only as the Enigma Society has been causing trouble around the world; it's up to you to unravel the mystery surrounding them. As the newest Private Eye recruit, you'll travel to exotic international locations and find hidden clues in order to solve some of the world's strangest mysteries! Each new mystery will put your perception skills, as well as your reflexes, to the test! Welcome to the world of Private Eye: Greatest Unsolved Mysteries!

title: Learning Ladder: Year 3
description: Learning Ladder: Year 3 is an educational PC game designed for ages 7 to 8. The game aims to teach kids about maths, reading and writing.

title: Succubus x Saint
description: After being tricked into participating in a ritual to resurrect an evil god, the candidate for sainthood, Liruna, must seek out the four Sealing Orbs. It's up to Liruna to end the ritual and save herself... and her world.

title: Gaia Aura
description: Originally made for the "Vanity" community project but has now been released as a standalone map by Ar_e_en.

title: Brisk
description: Brisk is a set of 30 maps in MBF21 format where each map was created in 24 hours by various authors.

title: Drizzlepath: Picturae
description: Have you ever wandered inside images? Images that blow your soul away? In Drizzlepath: Picturae, you embark on a journey of gorgeous landscapes. While some of these landscapes melt your heart, some will give you the chills.

title: Slaughter Me Street: 1999
description: You've awoken in a familiar place. You are being hunted for your misdeeds. With blood on your hands and weight on your conscience, you must collect the relics of your past, and confront your demons once and for all...

title: Dead Rush
description: Dead Rush is an FPS arcade shooter that combines fast-paced action, stylized visuals, and relentless waves of zombies. Choose your weapon, fight with friends, and see how long you can survive.

title: Heinz Honor and Revenge
description: Heinz Honor & Revenge is a beat 'em up game that offers an action-packed experience with a deep story and challenging puzzles. Players will take on the role of Heinz, a secret agent fighting for his country against various threats from ruthless criminal syndicates.

title: Leo & Mia: Animal Rescue
description: Become a valiant animal rescuer as either Leo or Mia! Save wildlife in the savannah from poachers and other dangers in over 15 exciting missions!

title: Do Dishes As Spencer
description: This is how spencer does dishes because he is over 6ft.

title: Due
description:
Due is a short first person horror, climbing / walking simulator.

In the far future, take control of someone tasked with appeasing the Gods to regain their tribe's life source - water.

Made for the 48 hour Haunted PS1 Wretched Weekend Jam.

A spiritual predecessor to Kill the KOTH

title: The Egg
description: You always wanted to be an egg or maybe you just want to know how an egg lives? Then you can now with "The Egg".

title: Storm the Swan
description: Make Cute Animal Friends in this 8-bit Gameboy-inspired adventure! But there's something lurking in the woods, with DARK SECRETS you'll need to uncover!

title: Booze & Ooze
description: In this deckbuilder and tavern management simulation featuring RPG and roguelite elements, you play a destitute leprechaun trying to claw his way back to fortune and power from behind the counter of a derelict inn. You are no hero material, but unfortunately for you, your clients are!

title: The Hunter's Path
description: Survive. Hunt. Thrive. In "The Hunter's Path," immerse yourself in a top-down survival hunting game. Navigate through the terrain, stalk your prey, and craft your needed supplies.

title: A Butterfly
description:
Part horror part interactive poem about overcoming, and bittersweet surrender.
A Butterfly is part of a larger project, BlueSuburbia, but was released as a standalone because it's very big.

title: Dipets
description: Dipets is a casual RPG where you have to explore and help rebuild the city of a weird world while taking care of a virtual pet.

title: Toilet: Confrontation
description: Fight the Skibidi Toilets in an open endless world and survive.

title: MyPopgoes: New and Improved!
description: myPopgoes has been reprogrammed from scratch, with countless fixes, optimisations, and brand new features! New and Improved! is out NOW as a free update to the game on Steam.

title: Hero of the Kingdom: The Lost Tales 3
description:
Experience an adventure full of surprises and save the kingdom from the evil wizard.

The pursuit of the evil wizard Fendrel has led you to an unknown kingdom. The local people live their peaceful lives here, unaware that the evil wizard has returned to their land and is plotting his terrible revenge. A darkness is coming that will engulf the whole kingdom. You can’t let that happen. You must seek out the forces of good and stop the evil wizard. You can count on fortune to favor those who are brave. An adventure full of surprises and heroic deeds awaits you.

Explore the kingdom and stop the evil wizard’s terrible revenge.
Help people and complete many interesting quests.
Fight monsters and learn many skills.
Find hundreds of useful hidden items.
Earn up to 26 achievements.

Play through the third and final episode of the Lost Tales storyline, which takes you right before the events of the original Hero of the Kingdom game. Enjoy a casual and lovely adventuring RPG that features classic story-driven Point&Click exploration in an old-school isometric style. Embark on a journey to explore a beautiful country, help people and complete many interesting quests. Learn skills, trade and collect items in your inventory. Earn nice rewards for your good deeds and achievements. Get ready for a new heroic adventure to stop the evil wizard’s terrible revenge.

title: The Shortest Journey
description: Manu dreams of finding treasure. A short, dialog-free point and click adventure game.

title: Stormbridge
description: Build a bridge settlement while outrunning an impending storm in this roguelite city builder. Unlock upgrades and pets between runs as you unravel the storm's origin. Can you survive and build the longest self-sufficient bridge?

title: The Violets of Amicus
description: Attack, dodge, and counter the monsters invading the land of Velare in The Violets of Amicus, a 2D action-adventure inspired by classic dungeon crawlers and modern combat games alike. The ferocious Violets are waking from their ancient gardens. Can a lowly courier save the kingdom?

title: Grave Deceiver
description: Grave Deceiver is a rogue-like where a corpse swaps places with you in the grave, casting you into hell while it takes your place in the world of the living. Now, you must fight to escape and return home.

title: The Cleaning Game
description: As a cleaning machine, tend to the custodial duties of an office while trying to avoid human scrutiny and existential dread. Listen to the computers around you, while there is still time. If you are brave enough, investigate your origin and inherent meaning as an electronic in a human world.

title: Fragging Free
description: In Fragging Free you'll find lots of action, lots of monsters, lots of power-ups and a well-balanced gameplay that will push your skills to their limit. If you love Doom, Quake, Unreal, Serious Sam, Painkiller you know what we are talking about.

title: Endarchy
description: A single player mission for Doom 3, played over three levels. Includes a Quake style skill selection area.

title: Journey to die
description:
This is a Japanese visual novel produced by MUGnet.
And this is their first work.

title: Tempest Tower
description: Protect your tower from invading Creepers using wild contraptions, powerful upgrades, or maybe just... jump on their heads! Tempest Tower reinvents Tower Defense with a thrilling mix of strategic base-building and engaging player-driven combat! Can you withstand the onslaught and save Trip Space?

title: Limoria
description: Welcome to a world where you are lost between consciousness and dreams. As you wander the dark corridors of an old hotel, face the games your mind plays on you. Your memories linger like a shadow following you. But there's nowhere to escape... Are you ready to confront your darkest fears?

title: 2024: Mosaic Retrospective
description: 2024: Mosaic Retrospective is a charity-fundraising picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring a single ENORMOUS puzzle inspired by global news stories from throughout the year.

title: Gar-Type
description:
GORESTAR, the living planet, is on a direct course for Earth.
It's time to debut our secret weapon duo:
Ace pilot Jon Starbuckle, and his prototype starfighter, Gar-Type D.
Your mission: save humanity! Defend the Earth from the alien invaders!

title: Project TurboBlast
description: Drift, boost, and spin around corners at BLASTING SPEEDS in this stylish Singleplayer + Multiplayer Arcade Racing game, Blending the familiar drifting of Kart racers and tight responsive handling of classic Anti-Gravity racing games. With a focus on being easy to pick up but difficult to master.

title: Powerful Wind, Slicked-back Cabbages
description: Slice cabbages to the rythim of Powerful Wind, Slicked-back Hair by Yukopi

title: Escalation Titan
description: A Canadian U.A.C. base, CFB Titan, is being overrun by demonic forces and you must escape to the transporter on the other side of the large complex.

title: 2017 Collection
description: 2017 Collection is a six-level PWAD for Doom II designed for Boom-compatible source ports, created by James Collins (an_mutt). MAP05 was made in collaboration with Brayden Hart (AD_79). Four of the five levels in the WAD were previously released by an_mutt as part of the Scrapper collection

title: World of Slavic Glasses
description: World of Slavic Glasses – a bullet-hell action game set in the world of Slavic folklore. You will fly on a stupa, fight hordes of undead creatures, and shop at Baba Yaga's store, which can surprise you as you upgrade it! Build your perfect character and try to survive all 20 waves!

title: Murder Malady
description: The 20th game in the Carol Reed series. A point and click detective story made by real photographs.

title: Bridge to Another World: Escape From Oz
description:
From 4Friends, creators of Living Legends, comes an exciting new game in the Bridge to Another World series!

Today started out like any other day – you sent your kids off to school and settled in for some peace and quiet with your little dog, Toto. But your world is turned upside-down when a tornado suddenly appears and carries your house to the extraordinary land of Oz. Now you find yourself in the middle of a fierce competition controlled by the mysterious Great Wizard. To earn your way back home, you and Toto must explore the four corners of Oz, facing enemies, obstacles, and puzzles at every turn! Are you up to the challenge? Find out in this Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game!

title: Locked in my Darkness 2: The Room
description: A psychological horror walking sim set between realities—where the past never truly stays buried.

title: Dodd Goes To The Museum
description: Explore Dodd's local museum in this short, casual and relaxing adventure! Visit various exhibits within the museum's four wings and talk to various characters along the way!

title: The Memories That Shape Us
description: The Memories That Shape Us is a first-person, walking-simulator, narrative video game. Find the Memory Capsules to uncover the story of a person’s life from childhood to adulthood, all the joys, all the struggles, and all the lessons.

title: Jamie Quest
description: Ok so basically there's this Jamie named Jamie and he lives with other Jamies but they all vanish in the middle of the night randomly so now he has to find them.

title: Slivania
description: Slivania is a short-form 3D platforming metroidvania, made in under a week for the 32-Bit Winter 2024 Jam!

title: Moose Boarders
description: Moose Boarders is an exciting 2D snowboarding game prototype starring the legendary Blue Moose! Shred through the slopes of Snowman's Peak as you tackle thrilling objectives and pull off epic snowboarding tricks. With 10 action-packed objectives, do you have what it takes to conquer them all?

title: Outter Carrier
description: A short and weird RPG Maker game about delivering an important package in an inhabitable crumbling building.

title: Cantaloupe Chronicle
description:
You've arrived in the cozy roadside town of Cantaloupe to begin your internship at your aunt's newspaper. Here, you'll not only learn how to craft compelling articles but also uncover the big mystery hidden in the town's past.

Explore Cantaloupe by collecting items, engaging with locals, and solving puzzles to uncover a series of smaller stories to write about. Keep your eyes peeled for clues related to the big mystery—the key to your final, front-page article.

The game offers a variety of topics for you to explore and write about using a custom text editor. Don't worry, you don't have to write all the text yourself—you'll find clues that unlock text blocks, which you can easily insert into your articles with a simple click. Your ultimate goal is to piece together the story behind a mysterious body found years ago and uncover the truth.

Discover the charming locations in and around Cantaloupe, filled with atmosphere and intriguing characters to meet. Immerse yourself in this laid-back experience and soak in the soothing ambiance of a small, roadside town.

title: TeeDee
description: A minimalist 2D tower defense game with 3 towers, 6 maps, and 4 monster types. Simple, fun, and perfect for quick strategy sessions!

title: Imprisoned
description:
Imprisoned is a Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game (MMORPG) developed with the Unreal Engine 5 graphics engine and advanced predictive artificial intelligence system.

Your objective is to serve your sentence and survive within a hostile prison as a persistent world. During your time behind bars, you must create a character, level up, improve it, and obtain protections and weapons through missions or by eliminating certain enemies you will encounter during your journey through the prison.

title: Tree of Savior: Neverland
description:
The dream-filled Tree of Savior now continues with its official masterpiece, "Tree of Savior: Neverland"!

Produced by Kim Hakkyu, with music by Motoi Sakuraba, featuring masterful visuals and soundtracks, it's a heartwarming MMO filled with joy and wonder!

title: Hentai: Nazi Girl
description: HENTAI: NAZI GIRL is a satirical 3rd person shooter where you play as a sexy naked girl. You will have to destroy the enemies, evil and dangerous, also go to their base, where you need to kill everyone (unexpectedly, right?), you need to collect propaganda posters (and they contain jokes with elements of black humor, be sure to read it). After collecting all the propaganda posters, you need to find the hidden invitation to the club. And then a new big enemy will appear and you will be allowed to destroy the eyes lying on the ground, which indicate a connection with the enemy.

title: Sister Lumina and the Hypnosis Cult
description: When Lumina is forced to open a forbidden book passed down by her grandmother in order to rescue her best friend, she will have to pay a hefty price to gain the power to free her and ensure her safety.

title: Reksio i Kretes: Sermageddon
description: The statue of the Cheese God has been stolen! The weather is going crazy… Could it be that the enraged Cheese God is bringing Cheesemageddon down upon the Earth? Who would dare commit such a sacrilege? Pirates? Aliens? One thing is certain — our heroes will be forced to return to the darkest location of all their adventures — Paris.

title: Catcha
description: Catcha is a catching game where you shoot bombs and bosses, not your average catching game...

title: Submerged Mystery: Takodachi
description: Submerged Mystery: Takodachi is a top-down dungeon-crawling RPG featuring the Takodachis by Ninomae Ina'nis from hololive English. Players explore a sprawling labyrinth filled with puzzles, powerful enemies, and secrets tied to the enigmatic Ancient Ones. As you delve deeper, you unlock new abilities and summon skills from past Takodachis to aid in your journey. Elemental Affinities play a crucial role in combat, allowing players to strategize against the unique challenges posed by the Takodachis guarding the labyrinth.

title: Saintess of the Golden Bow
description:
Celine thought her life as an American office worker was mundane, but after a fatal accident, she wakes up as an extra character in her favorite web novel a BL tragedy fantasy. Expected to die early as part of the protagonist's backstory, Celine defies fate and survives her death event, causing a butterfly effect that catapults her into the role of the Saintess of the Golden Bow.

Joined by an unforgettable cast of characters including the valiant knight Levi, the enigmatic Mad Prince Noah, and the devout High Priest Elijah you must lead a quest to defeat the Demon Queen and bring peace to the realm. Each choice you make weaves a complex web of romance, friendship, and sacrifice, offering a deeply personal and replayable journey.

title: Frosted Love
description: A short visual novel featuring Dizzy Dokuro, Kaneko Lumi, Hoshiumi Jelly and Ember Amane from the VTuber agency Phase-Connect.

title: The Big Gay Adventure
description: The Big Gay Adventure is a bright and silly, JRPG-inspired game that explores identity, community, and free queer expression.

title: Megabonk
description: Smash your way through endless waves of enemies and grow absurdly powerful! Grab loot, level up, unlock characters and upgrade to create unique and crazy builds as you fend off hordes of creatures!

title: Beneath a Dead City
description: Run your own Adventurer's Guild in this fantasy colony sim with a focus on dynamic storytelling. Recruit heroes to explore a ruined city, but keep an eye on those murder hobos. An unhappy hero could turn to arson, violence, and jaywalking.

title: Archwizard
description: Fast paced "Hyper Shooter" complemented with esoteric exploration experience. Take a quest to become Arch Wizard: dominate surrounding realms, reverse Time, escape Death, befriend Chaos, face the End of the World. Knowledge based progression. High scores. Full of secrets.

title: ESHQ
description:
Unknown government spy must steal secret files from the building called “Evil scientists headquarters”. But his job gonna be a bit more difficult and long...

ESHQ is an abbreviation that means “Evil scientists headquarters”. This is the name for the fake experimental center, used for distraction from the real infrastructure complex:

title: Fentanyl Edition
description: Fentanyl Edition is a Fast-Paced Arena Shooter. With the most surreal visuals you may lay your eyes upon.

title: City of Voices
description: A short Golden Idol-like deduction game about a young girl who is catapulted from her suburban life into the mysterious world of the ancient Maya. Investigate a series of moments frozen in time. Examine clues and solve puzzles to uncover a story full of twists and turns. Co-developed by one of the writers and designers of The Rise of the Golden Idol.

title: Tron 2.0: Killer App Mod
description:
The objective of the Killer App Mod for TRON 2.0 on the PC, is to incorporate elements from TRON 2.0: Killer App for the Xbox platform that were never released for the PC version of TRON 2.0.

It also includes other fixes and additions for the game, such as 16:9 and 16:10 Widescreen support.

New to Version 1.1a of the mod is compatibility with the Steam version of TRON 2.0, easier installation, v1.1 bug fixes, and restored Multiplayer support in-game on both the CD/DVD and Steam versions.

title: Yuurou: Transient Sands
description: Riku is a knight of the Yuurou empire, part of a medieval fantasy world known as Varcias. One day, returning to Yuurou through the desert, Riku found a girl lying nearly unconscious on the sand. This girl is revealed to be Azusa, a modern-day Japanese schoolgirl who, thanks to a time warp, ended up in Varcias. Riku must now help Azusa return to her home world. But enemy forces are attacking Yuurou, and the Empress is in desperate need of assistance...

title: Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City 2001
description: Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City 2001 is a lore friendly total conversion mod for Grand Theft Auto 3 that attempts to make the game more in line with its counterparts from later in the 3D era by updating gameplay as well as design direction to match that of its successors.

title: To the End of the Way
Table Game End
description: After school today, I talk with her again. Through the window, I see the sunset and someone playing in the schoolyard. We simply watch the scene or share memories from the past."TABLE GAME END" is an adventure game.

title: Retro Santa Run
description: Ready to slide into the fun?

title: 3D MiniGolf: Makeover-Edition
description:
Get ready to explore over 50 newly designed courses that are not only challenging but also super fun!

There are three fantastic worlds to choose from - a beautiful green park, a camping site in the mountains and a dreamy sandy beach.

Choose between two exciting game modes: take on the challenge in Challenge mode or compete against the AI or your friends in Tournament mode. You can also compete with up to 4 players in local multiplayer mode.

Receive medals for your great achievements - such as an impressive hole-in-one! Show off your skills and leave the competition behind.

So grab your club and bring the whole family - the ultimate MiniGolf experience awaits!

title: Sector Beam
description: A small arcade game where the player needs to destroy asteroids of different colors using an energy beam. The cannon, controlled by the player, automatically targets the nearest asteroid but only within one of four sectors. To succeed, the player must select one of the four surrounding sectors and shoot the closest asteroid with a beam of the matching color. The score multiplier increases as long as no mistakes are made but resets to the base value if an error occurs. There is also a rank multiplier that increases upon reaching specific milestones. Scoring a million points is considered an excellent result, though it’s far from the limit. The game ends if an asteroid hits the platform three times.

title: Let's Compare the Speed of Our Punches!
Journey of Johann: Grasslands
description:
Journey of Johann is an action adventure platformer with puzzle elements.
Make your way through levels and a boss with different challenges and obstacles.
Collect goblets, secrets and beat time trials.
Use your weapons as tools such as climbing, blocking hits, and defeating enemies.

title: To the Moon: Sigmund Minisode 1 (Holiday Special)
description: Return to the world of To the Moon in this heartfelt spin-off that dives deeper into the lives of Dr. Eva Rosalene and Dr. Neil Watts. During a holiday season filled with both festive cheer and public protests against the Sigmund Corporation, this minisode explores the ethical dilemmas and emotional challenges behind their wish-fulfillment work.

title: To the Moon: Sigmund Minisode 2 (Holiday Special)
description: Step into the next chapter of To the Moon with Sigmund Minisode 2, a poignant holiday-themed spin-off that offers a deeper look at the lives of Dr. Eva Rosalene and Dr. Neil Watts. This part continues to explore the personal struggles, mysterious secrets, and ethical dilemmas faced by the doctors of Sigmund Corporation.

title: Steamboat Willie Incident
description: Steamboat Willie Incident is a 3D horror survival game where you are captured in a steamboat and you have to find ways to escape without alerting Willie. Try to find clues, solve puzzles and hide from Willie in a claustrophobic steamboat where you are surrounded only by sea. Will you be able to?

title: Wobbly Construction!
description: Reach the top of the construction site. Carefully place each step, watch out for obstacles on your way up, and try not to quit the game out of frustration.

title: Casino Heist: Aruba
description: *Casino Heist: Aruba* is a comedic heist Visual Novel and dating sim where every choice counts. Assemble a team, craft the perfect plan, and tackle a high-stakes robbery targeting a shady casino. Can you outsmart the odds, secure a fortune, and maybe even find love? The score of a lifetime awaits!

title: Acid Web
