description: You are trapped in a Hotel by accident Find out all the signs of abnormality in the hallway Escape by going down to the first floor while carefully observing your surroundings

title: Jailbreak Assault
description: In Jailbreak Assault, you're a prisoner on a daring mission to break free. Start with a key and a baton, outwit guards, destroy documents, and disable security systems. Arm yourself for the ultimate challenge: escaping the heavily fortified perimeter.

title: Call The Abyss
description: 2D Survival Arcade Game packed with Action and Dark Magic. You cannot survive the relentless Forces of Good alone. Better call allies from the Abyss!! Gather Resources and Summon them from your Cauldron. Conquer the worldwide Leaderboard. Completely FREE TO PLAY!! For now...

title: Prison Notes
description: Prison Notes is a RPG with text-based ADV and cultivation elements. You act as a young migrant worker, wrongly imprisoned in the prison known as "The Coral Reef".What challenges and adventures are awaiting? Will you finally find a way out? Your choices and actions will decide the end of your story.

title: YieldTrillions
description: Hello, I'm a corn alien, I need to start the ship and go home, please V I have 10000000000 pounds of corn for spaceship fuel and I'll give you half a pound of popcorn as a reward when I get home.

title: Terminal One
description: Airport building and light business tycoon game. Build up an airport providing cargo, maintenance, and passenger service. Choose which upgrades to invest in, manage policies, organize finances, optimize layouts, and balance carbon emissions.

title: A Pizza Delivery
description: A Pizza Delivery is a narrative exploration game with puzzle elements focused on connecting with people. Share pizza with charming characters to uncover their stories—and your own. Drive and explore a strange, meditative world filled with secrets.

title: Enerdusk
description: "Enerdusk" is a roguelike deck-building game where you develop strategies centered on units while utilizing cards. Decks and items empower your units, and in turn, your units enhance your deck and shift the battle in your favor. Master this synergy to dominate all your enemies.

title: Aisera's Ladder
description: Come and experience the fast and exciting cold weapon battles! Understand the vast world of Azeroth in battle; By using exquisite combat skills to defeat the weak, managing a farm to produce food, and running a tavern to accumulate gold coins and upgrade equipment.

title: Whispers in the Wood
description: Whispers in the Forest is a single-player base defense strategy game where you must build, upgrade, and defend your base against demonic creatures in a cursed forest. Manage your resources, lead your troops, and survive the darkness of the night as you fight to protect your only hope for salvation.

title: Whack Mole
description: The player gets ready to face moles popping up from various holes. As the game advances, the speed and frequency of the moles' appearances increase, challenging the player's reflexes and hand-eye coordination.

title: Bear Jump
description: Step into the bouncy world of Bear Jump! Help a determined bear jump endlessly upward, dodging obstacles, collecting power-ups, and reaching new heights. With intuitive controls and addictive gameplay, Bear Jump is easy to pick up but challenging to master.

title: Slice Adventure
description: Grab the blade and slice through hordes of enemies in this new "bullet hell" game - Slice Adventure! Control a powerful cursor-sword with simple mouse-only controls. Survive endless waves, check your reflexes, and create unique playstyles using various weapons and items combinations.

title: Threat Vector
description: Battle across the solar system as annihilation looms over mankind in this action sci-fi horror FPS. Powered by id Tech, THREAT VECTOR delivers classic FPS combat throughout a suite of concise, potent levels infested with deadly horrors… and loaded with enough firepower to destroy them all.

title: Undertale: Repent to Jesus
description: Christian mod with bible verses. Tells the true meaning of Christmas. Converts the game into a God-honoring adventure with the gospel. Revamps some of the story. Changes some sprites. Has two main endings - requires a second playthrough for the second ending (has sort of secret...? requirements to unlock). Most graphical changes are in the second playthrough. Interaction with objects and NPCS instead of rushing through the game is recommended.

title: To Aru Otoko to Onna no Naresome
description: Curses, love and hate. A story of a man and a woman set in a dark, Asian-style setting.

title: Monmusu Girls: Autobattler
description: This is a strategic and adventurous idle auto-battler where you'll collect a variety of monmusu girls, form your adventuring team, and challenge the Demon King! Each girl comes with unique skills and bonds, and mastering the right combinations is the key to victory. Embark on a magical journey!

title: Adhvan Chakra
description: Command divine aerial forces in a real-time tactical combat experience set in a dharmic fantasy world. Strategize, adapt, and upgrade to defend vast territories from devastating invasions. Uncover ancient artifacts, perform sacred rituals, and unravel the mystery of the Adhvan Chakra.

title: Kamisama no Hitsugi
description:
One day, a disaster occurs and the normal life of Chibana Michiru comes to an end.

He wakes up to a strange voice calling him, in front of him stands a classmate he has never spoken to before. He knows that they are inside the ”mysterious room”.

title: Ojou-sama no Hanbun wa Renai de Dekiteimasu!
description: The pretty boy Hajime is an agent of a large secret organization, who was asked by the boss one day to do the impossible. His mission was to infiltrate Houshou Girl’s Academy, where only pure maidens are allowed, and to claim the title of the greatest lady: ‘Highness’. Thus, he traded in his weapon for lipstick to become an agent of matchless beauty. What is the purpose of this strange mission?

title: Alice Mesmerizing Episodes of Neurosis: AMEN
description: Alice Mesmerizing Episodes of Neurosis (AMEN) is a hidden object game. The player's task is to find things hidden on the map. Help Alice cross this path, destroy the ego-structure, get out of the abyss, find the key.

title: Aegis Force: The Scorian War
description: Aegis Force is a single player, story-driven, strategy RPG (SRPG) that has an engaging grid-based tactical combat system. It is designed in a breathtaking 2.5d pixel art style. Players can recruit for and customize their party, using gameplay that includes full world and town exploration.

title: Scary Shadow Spot: Bitter Glass
description: Scary Shadow Spot: Bitter Glass. Without memory, John Doe wanders the desert until he finds refuge in a haunted saloon. The ghosts of the past demand justice, and every clue brings him closer to an unsettling truth. Are you ready to uncover the secret of the Bitter Glass?

title: Sincere Deceit
description:
Sincere Deceit is a fangame based on the indie title OFF by Mortis Ghost. You play as The Batter once more, dropped into a world slowly falling apart from a mysterious force corrupting it. It is your job to decide whether to fight against this force, or let it consume the world around you. Follow either of the two voices guiding you, or choose to cut your own path to find out the truth of what happened.

Sincere Deceit is a horror game at heart, and thus deals with many heavy topics, such as violence/cruelty, gore/body horror, suicide, cult indoctrination, jumpscares (both visual and audio based) and some flashing on the screen. This is not a game for the faint of heart.

title: Friday Night Funkin vs. junim Cururu
description: A mod made by a brazilian that loves Friday Night Funkin' :3 where he presents Junim Cururu and his Funk do Cururu

title: Ignisia
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting journey, explore the vast expanses of Ignisia, where magic, adventure, and powerful enemies await you. Discover an amazing world, uncover ancient secrets, and unite with friends to protect it from the looming threat. Perhaps in the future, you’ll find discoveries you never even imagined…

title: It’s on the Mouse
description: Become the best tiny maid on the block! Help Holly and her friends in this little café manager where jumping and running are key to make up for your lack of size! Scuttle around the tables, serve your customers and be careful as dangerous obstacles and bosses will show up to try to stop you!

title: Frozen Inferno
description: Nana has come to face her sins, but it seems things would not go her way... Frozen Inferno is an Ice Climber fan-game that takes horror elements and mix them with platforming gameplay to give you a short but fun experience.

title: Moo & Move: Extra Grazing Grounds
description: Guide the hungry cow to its goal. Place directional tiles on the ground and to solve the puzzles. Watch as the cow follows the path to reach its tasty hay.

title: Night Shift: Laundry
description: Debut indie horror game by Bite X Studios.

title: Big Buck Hunter Pro Adventure
description: Big Buck Hunter Pro Adventure features Adventure Mode where players embark on their own custom hunting vacation across 18 different locations across North America.

title: Disney The Little Mermaid: Undersea Treasures!
description: Discover lost items from the mysterious human world above the waves and reveal unique hidden treasures. From the site of an old shipwreck to Ariel's secret grotto, King Triton's throne room to the incredible coral canyons. Find items quickly in each scene to earn bonus points and claim your place on the leaderboard.

title: Magic Book Auto Battler
description: Magicbook AutoBattler is a non-traditional strategy game that combines Roguelite moves. This game has unique binding combinations, rich weapons and equipment, cool magical effects, and thrilling combat scenes. In the world of magic books, you will face endless challenges and rewards……

title: PicoMix By NuSan
description:
PicoMix by NuSan features games made by creator NuSan over a 8 years period of time. It’s a compilation of works in multiple genres, like platform, puzzle, crafting, or base building for a total of about 20 fun games and experiments, some will provide hours of interesting challenges while others can be completed in a few minutes.

All of the games were made using “fantasy console” Pico 8 with its recognizable 16-color palette, crunchy sweet 128x128 resolution pixel art and 4-channel chiptune

Thanks to the use of Zepto 8 emulator, an optional wide mode is included in some of the games to go beyond Pico 8’s usual square screen, as well as visual filters to tweak your experience (scanlines, CRT, toon, minit...)

title: Cube Crawler
description: Take on the challenge and discover a completely new 3D sci-fi dungeon crawler. The sophisticated room card mechanics and endless generated dungeons with the form of a cube, this game is unique in this genre. What will you discover while exploring?

title: For Sale
description: For Sale is a PSX-esque first-person horror adventure game with a strong emphasis on atmosphere and exploration. Interact with objects, take pictures using your digital camera, and discover unnerving secrets all while exploring a seemingly ordinary house.

title: Cedric & Odious
description: Battle through a dark fantasy world as a resurrected warrior king. Once loyal friends, you now serve at the mercy of Odious, a brilliant but corrupt sorcerer. Master tactical combat and magical artifacts in this challenging action RPG.

title: All Will Fall
description: Build massive ocean cities and lead your people to prosperity in this post-apocalyptic survival colony sim. Featuring a physics-based 3D construction system, complex resource management, exploration, difficult political decisions, supply chains, and a robust sandbox mode.

title: Monitoring All Night
description: "Monitoring All Night" is a horror-style game in which you report anomalies while performing monitoring duties. Report anomalies appropriately and survive until the end of your shift. And watch out for the aliens.

title: Code Violet
description:
Developed by TeamKill Media, Code Violet is a third-person action horror game, where you take on the role of Violet Sinclair, a girl plucked from the past who must unravel the mysteries of the Aion Bioengineering Complex as she avoids, hides or fights against the creatures who have overrun it.

With the evacuation protocol in effect, Violet’s main goal is to escape the complex and save those she cares for, but with the creatures and a mysterious Director doing all in their power to stop you, will you get out alive?

title: Dragon Ruins II
description: An indie dungeon crawler inspired by late 80s and early 90s CRPGs.

title: Azumanga Fighter: Come Back!
description: The game features the six main girls as playable characters, each having an unlockable EX character variant. Starring alongside them are their teachers- Yukari and Nyamo, both unlockable.

title: The Curse of Mount Madre
description: The Curse of Mount Madre is a traditional turn-based JRPG with a wild west twist.

title: Transcontinental
description: Play as a survivor of the aftermath of a train wreck during the Western Expansion era. Traverse the haunting railway tracks of a rural settlement cursed by supernatural forces unleashed after displacing Native inhabitants.

title: Slay the Alice
description: A short visual novel presented with pixel art and cute animations. Chasing after a rabbit, Alice found herself in a land of talking plants. Now, it's time to go on a tiny little adventure.

title: Super Star Shooter Classic
description: "Super Star Shooter" is a classic vertical-scrolling shooter game that combines nostalgic pixel art and high-speed combat. Control your spaceship and save the galaxy by defeating enemies one after another!

title: Kubitori Dolls: Retriever - Shimazu Kaidan 01
description:
A mysterious job: steal the heads from the anomalous entity "Kubitori Dolls," which takes the heads of young girls.
Whether alone or with others, enjoy deduction, stealth, exploration, and head-stealing.
The three girls and one boy are about to curse all the ghost stories that are about to unfold…

title: Tummy Bonbons: The Sweet Monster
description: Eat candy. Get spookier. Scare children into giving you their candy. Eat it. Choose new bellies. Then eat more candy, as much as you can!

title: Libertad o Muerte!
description: Libertad o Muerte!, the wars of independence of the Spanish Colonies is a turn-based game in 19th century America. Players are the Patriots, fighting for freedom, or the Royalists, trying to keep the empire under Spanish control. Who will prevail?

title: Desmond's Castle
description:
The vampire Desmond woke up from his long sleep and attacked the villagers of Burnsley.

A knight sent by the realm, will go to the vampire's dwelling to settle this matter.

From room to room, he will have to face the enemies and take the different secret passages of the castle to be able to face the terrible Desmond!

title: The strange case of the serpent
description:
A short narrative experiment, a digital collage.
I took the souce code of the game "The serpent" by Stephen Lavelle and some Alfred Hitchcock's movie clips.

title: Hunting Grounds: Whispers Of The Woods
description:
Hunting Grounds - Whispers Of The Woods is a free game aiming at letting people know about our transmedia IP named Hunting Grounds Of The Great Spirit (which will include video games, but also board games).

In this game, you have 20 minutes to find magical artifacts to give to the shaman Crazy Owl before the end of the night, so that he can perform a ceremony to get rid of the creature that haunts this dreamlike Native American universe at night.

title: Heart Electric
description: Stay one step ahead of the shifting balance of power in this 4-team Hero FPS. Heart Electric challenges you to outwit, outplay, and ultimately eliminate three other teams. Tactics, team play, and unpredictability are as important as sharp aim in this innovative hero shooter.

title: Oath of the Necromancer
description:
Oath of the Necromancer is a rogue-like & bullet-heaven mix; survive by raising hordes of skeletons to fight alongside you against the many foes of ancient Egypt and Greece.

In the name of Serapis, the ancient Graeco-Egyptian God of life and death, you rebuild a lost religion, raise legendary heroes, find mighty relics, and raise powerful armies of the dead.

title: Kaodi
description: Kaodi is a brief, narrative-driven 2D platformer experience where you control Barren on his journey back home after playing a key role in the victory over the Republic of Shan. Explore a kingdom fractured by war and discover the scars it has left on its people.

title: Smile Thief
description: Join Eva, a young apprentice minstrel, on her mission to save her village’s joy in Trimeria - The Thief of Smiles. This graphic adventure invites you to explore a magical world, face unique challenges, and unravel the mystery of the demon threatening to steal all smiles.

title: The Sinking Forest
description: A Japanese survival horror game full of tension, drama, and violence. If you like psychological horror games with exploration, puzzles, and limited resources, you'll enjoy an intense experience where every decision can mean the difference between finding Sayuri or getting lost in the forest forever.

title: Sonic Scene Creator 5
description: Featuring 100s more sprites, backgrounds and many different kinds of elements to use to build your own scenes in this sonic scene creator flash game with this being the 5th instalment by Zhuburz.

title: Super Mario Scene Creator
description: Choose a background and create your own scene based on Super Mario World

title: Death Howl
description: Journey through the sorrowful spirit world in a soulslike deck builder. Craft cards and claim powerful totems to defeat the woeful spirits lurking in the mystical lands. Unravel the tale of a grieving mother in her desperate attempt to defy death and bring back her son.

title: Divorce Chatroom
description: A chatsim where you divorce a beautiful man!

title: Great Journey
description:
Do you like adventures? Would you like to travel the world?

Then don't waste any more time and join Tony and Annie on their mission to save Antarctica, home of their dear friends!

Immerse in a thrilling adventure and visit lots of vibrant sceneries - from small port towns, through hot, sandy deserts and damp, colorful jungle, all the way to the land of snow and ice.

Based on a mainstream technology from our previous game - Grom, making use of enchanting, prerendered backgrounds and smoothly animated, real-time 3D characters, the game looks and feels different than other titles from this genre available on the market today.

title: Click to Twelve
description: In this game all you do is click until the center number becomes twelve, play this incredibly engaging experience for about 20 seconds then immediately forget about it’s existence

title: Shop Empire 2
description: The popular Shop Empire game sequel. With more booths, new facilities, a fun new parking system for cars and trains. But sadly also more clever thiefs that want to rob your shops! Build a bigger and better shopping mall, hire staff members to run the place smoothly. Shop Empire 2 is a detailed and free resource management game.

title: GeckoShop
description: Collect and sell geckos. Decorate and upgrade your shop. Chase Thieves. Explore the small open-world city, full of charm and life. Sell your lizards, or keep 'em as your Pets!

title: Ultimate Sonic Quiz V.2
description: A trivia quiz based on the Sonic the Hedgehog series. This one features many changes from the first, including new backgrounds, fixed questions, improved quality, and more.

title: Legend of Wulin Heroes
description: Legend of Wulin Heroes is a vastly popular Chinese PC game made by Heluo Studio in 2001 who’s also created the cult classic Heroes of Jing Yong and Heroes of Three Kingdom.

title: From The Other Side
description: "From the Other Side" immerses you in a chilling first-person psychological horror game. You are Steve, a security guard on his first night at work, tasked with monitoring security cameras and fixing unsettling anomalies that will make you question reality.

title: Conjurers
description:
Defeat the Conjurers. Take their constellations. Conquer the Zodiac.
A classic turn-based tactics game where deckbuilding lets players summon Zodiac creatures and hybrids, then steal new constellations by defeating rival Conjurers. Will you become powerful enough to face the Immortal Aquarius?

title: SantaCorps 4
description:
Armed with their merry mysticism, magical machines, and maybe a little bit of luck, it's up to YOU to make a miracle this holiday season...and beyond!

Don the fabled white and red solo or with up to 3 friends as you dash your way through this fast-paced holiday frenzy!

title: End of the Line
description:
A grieving bear is taking a short stay at an old fishing cabin, hoping to reel in one final trout during a winter holiday. In his despondent isolation, however, he meets someone new who may rekindle that spark he's been looking for.

Will he get his colors back, or will his world stay faded and gray?

This project was made for the novemBear 2024 Furry Visual Novel Jam.

title: Ballistic.exe
description: Ballistic.exe is an advanced weapon simulator, with challenging true-to-life aiming mechanics, full weapon manipulation and customization, and highly accurate ballistic calculations.

title: Herbals Tycoon
description: "Herbals tycoon" is a game that combines ancient style with deep management strategy, bringing players into a mysterious and fantastic world of traditional Chinese medicine. Here, you are not only a healer but also an explorer, manager, and inheritor, writing your own herbal legend every moment.

title: Crescent Overload
description: An Action 3D Platformer set inside a virtual cyberscape. Control AL.exe and mend a corrupted program as you traverse drives with her unique Gear Scythe.

title: Sweyet Dreaming Emulator the Familiar Discomfort of the Unpredictable
description: Learn to live without control while solving dynamic dream scape that change through real-life blinks.

title: Schedule I
description: Schedule I is a first-person open-world crime simulation game where players build and manage a drug trafficking operation in the fictional city of Hyland Point. Gameplay combines business management with tactical strategy, as players grow and manufacture various substances, sell to residents while avoiding police, and expand through hiring employees and purchasing properties. Drugs can be mixed with various ingredients to alter their effects and increase sell value. Players must contend with law enforcement mechanics including random searches, roadblocks, and a wanted system. The game also features an active modding community and cooperative multiplayer.

title: Call of Ponchy: Mahjong Warfare
description: Mahjong TPS. It's a mahjong game with unusual rules, using guns and bats.

title: Road Island Adventure
description: Embark on an epic journey in Road Island Adventure, an open-world RPG set in a vibrant world of living cars! Compete in high-stakes races, uncover the mysteries of a strange signal, and build your dream community while exploring a diverse island full of charm and discovery.

title: Cake Shop 2
description: Cake Shop 2 is a time management game and the successor of Cake Shop. Open a street café and serve your customers cakes and pastries. With satisfied customers you earn money, which can then be reinvested in better equipment.

title: Delta Force: Season 1 - Genesis
description:
Delta Force: Season 1 – Genesis is the thrilling first chapter in the revival of the legendary tactical shooter series. Released in December 2024, this season sets the tone for a gripping episodic experience that combines cutting-edge technology with the strategic gameplay that made the franchise iconic.

In Season 1: Genesis, players step into the boots of an elite Delta Force operator tasked with counter-terrorism and high-stakes covert operations across the globe. From desert encampments to urban strongholds and icy tundras, every mission presents unique challenges that test your tactical prowess, decision-making, and combat skills.

title: The Fool's Apprentice
description: A wizard academy management sim where you—an obviously benevolent professor—must manage & cast spells on your many apprentices so that they might study the right spells… and perhaps even survive the researching process. Some may die, but oh well, can’t save them all!

title: WinterBunny444
description: A surreal adventure game about a trans girl named Sue and her newfound love Esther.

title: Rooftop Rascal: The Claus Cat
description: In "Rooftop Rascal: The Claus Cat," take control of a nimble cat scaling fire escapes and rooftops in a Christimas-themed adventure. Test your quick thinking and jumping skills as you climb higher and higher to reach the rooftop.

title: AmidaDaMida
description: AmidaDaMida is a game where you will need to place connecting horizontal lines between vertical ones at a certain moment. You are given one green cube that moves along a line. Your goal is to make all the squares at the end of each line red. Depending on the number of active moving cubes, experience points will be awarded for each new cube activation. If an active cube touches red, it disappears. The game ends if you run out of moving cubes.

title: Bright Escape
description: Embark on a magical journey in Bright Escape!

title: Zombie Dash
description: Zombie Dash is a pixelated 2D platformer where you play as a cheerful zombie whose goal is to infect all the humans on the level!

title: Jewel Fever 3
description: "Jewel Fever 3" is the much improved successor to the highly succesful "Jewel Fever 2" which is played by millions of people. It adds new gamemodes, better graphics and finally local and online multiplayer!

title: Skeleseller
description: Skeleseller is a laid-back idle game set in a vibrant fantasy world. You're a skeleton shopkeep who hires adventurers to collect loot for you after your untimely demise. Send adventurers into battle, sell what they find, and build up your town!

title: Pizza Tower: Chef's Kiss
description: Pizza Tower: Chef's Kiss is a modification to Pizza Tower aiming to bring several additions to the game, including new characters and levels. The goal is to bring an authentic DLC feeling to the mod.

title: Triptych Book I: Blockhead
description: Triptych Book I: Blockhead is a graphical adventure set in an alternate version of World War One with simple point and click interface, easy to use controls & rip-roaring adventure in the skies!

title: Dice With Death
description: Dice With Death is a Dicebuilding Roguelike – Unfortunately you have already died. Fortunately, Death is up for some friendly competition. Collect new dice and their paired relics, create damage stacking combos, and even cheat Death himself to emerge victorious.

title: NSMB Mario Vs Luigi: KKT's Gooffy little Mod
description:
A Mod Of The Somewhat Popular Mario VS Luigi Online!

This Mod Aims To Be Serious & Silly, With A Little Somthin' For Casual, & Competitive Players. Hazards, Which Are Random Objects That Randomly Spawn In The Maps.This Mod Features New Maps, Unused VS Maps From The Original Game, & More Unique Maps! New Characters Like Toad, & New Powerups Like The Bubble Flower & Bombro, & Several "Joke" Powerups. And Some Features To Customise Matches Further.

A bunch of other smaller features to find out yourself :)

title: Who Am I?
description: Who am I is an immersive hidden object adventure of an epic scale. Take the role of an undercover agent investigating strange sci-fi incidents in the city as the threat of a weapon of mass destruction looms. Solve puzzles and seek out clues in over 70 detailed scenes. Find out who you really are to save the world!

title: Greed & Darkness
description: Greed & Darkness is an atmospheric puzzle game where you must venture into a foreboding fortress to gather riches. Use sight, sound and the tools at hand to navigate the dark tunnels and unlock the Gorged One's chamber.

title: Moorhuhn Kart 4
description: The world's craziest chicken is heading back to the racetrack! Wacky characters, cool tracks and karts, and zany items await in a worldwide online battle for first place!

title: Dokapon! Sword of Fury
description:
Spin the wheel and set off on an exciting adventure with your friends!

Defeat monsters, purchase weapons, and level up, just like in an RPG. Once you've gathered enough strength, face off against powerful bosses in epic fashion! Your journey will take you across a wide, diverse world... Just don't forget that your true goal is to get filthy rich!

Money is everything! Anything goes, as long as it lines your pockets...and as long as you're cool with it! Will you walk the path of thievery and plunder, or will you hold firm to your morals? Will you join hands with your friends, or plot to betray them? It's dealer's choice around these parts!

Play even with faraway friends in Online Mode, and feel free to pause your adventure anytime with the Autosave function; it'll be ready and waiting for you whenever you're available again!

There's also a full range of display settings on offer, including HD and widescreen support, allowing full immersion like never before! Game too slow for you? No problem! Speed options up to 5x ensure you can always keep things moving along at your own pace. A virtually endless array of options allows you to play the game your way: you can substitute in battle BGM from earlier titles, set the number of weeks to play, adjust game balance, and more! You can even give yourself an advantage if you're new to the Dokapon experience; come one, come all, as this game's for everybody!

The Sword of Fury returns to cut through all the nonsense of the 2020s in style. Come grab its hilt and give it a swing for yourself!

title: Dino Ramen Express
description: From RAMEN to RIFLES! This is an immersive first-person simulation game where players can run their own restaurant empire. The game allows players to devise their own business strategies, from hands-on "guns & blazing" food delivery in the open world to staff management at stores.

title: Cats and Seek: Toge Land
description: Celebrating the 16th anniversary of Toge Productions, we will explore Toge Land and greet the cats there.

title: Floria
description: A beautiful Match-3 game with some strategy.

title: Compensation Not Guaranteed
description: Peek into Southeast Asian politics through a lens darkly. Check ownership for authenticity, listen to stories, decide who should give up their land in the name of PROGRESS!

title: Constantine Scores
description: Constantine Scores is a single-player heisting Sci-fi First Person Shooter. Upgrade your arsenal to gain more abilities, weapons, and perks to keep the playing field equal. Fight against three separate factions, spanning multiple contracts, and randomized multi-day campaigns.https://

title: I Wanna Be The Guy Remastered
description: This is a faithful remaster of the original I Wanna Be The Guy, aiming to balance the spirit of the original game with the desire for consistent physics like the fangames that came after while fixing some of the jank.

title: Turning the Page
description:
For Felix and Sophie Page, two professors at Riverside College, things are going very well. They have jobs they love, they are well respected and most importantly: they have each other. In fact, their recent marriage has made it official. Nothing could get between them... except maybe one of their students...

Turning the Page is a Visual Novel focused on Netorare and Corruption.

In particular, it is part of the “mystery NTR” subgenre, meaning that the player can choose to experience the story through either the hero’s point of view, with an obscured and limited view of what is happening, or from the heroine’s perspective which shows her being stolen away from the hero in complete detail.

title: Yuri Lowell Prints a Gun
description:
A short reflection on luigi mangione through the lens of media specifically Tales of Vesperia

Made for boshi's place Year of Luigi show

title: Raincouver
description: Welcome to Raincouver, a sprawling cyberpunk metropolis on the brink of oblivion. With the city falling into chaos, the government races to eliminate the threat, setting the stage for a desperate mission to rescue your loved one before Raincouver is reduced to ashes at ground zero.

title: Moe Waifu H: Fantasy
description:
Meet 5 lovely maidens and impress them with your rhythm and sharp reflexes! Moe Waifu H Fantasy is a simple and addictive action puzzler where your goal is to match your target icon at the right side of the screen to the incoming icons that fly in from the left side of the screen. Match them before they touch the target, and your score will climb, earning up to 3 stars for your performance. Fail to match them and you’ll lose hearts!

Each girl’s expressions will change in reaction to your gameplay, so don’t let them down! Can you unlock all their cute outfits, fill your gallery and complete the jukebox to win them over?

title: Penguin Flight
description: Soar Beyond Your Dreams

title: Toon Breakout 3D
description: Break Bricks, Smash Characters, and Conquer the Toon World!

title: Rookie Table Tennis
description: 3D local multiplayer ping pong game

title: Jujump
description:
Ju-ju-ju-jump! Jump and climb through the falling platforms with chill music... and get rich in the process!

JUJUMP is a fast paced one-button arcade game where you jump with any button. Hold the button to make the jump longer, and press it again mid air to jump again and change the direction. Each jump will change the direction and you can jump mid air as many times as you want, but you will quickly lose impulse, so be careful.

You'll score points by climbing, and you'll get a big score bonus with each coin you catch, but as soon as you fall, it's game over.

title: Arcade Archives: Escape Kids

title: Chrono Gear: Warden of Time
description: Turn back the clock and fight to repair Time itself in this cinematic action platformer with fast sword combat and time-based powers. You are the Warden of Time, Ouro Kronii - be proud and fight hard!

description: In this exciting two-dimensional puzzle game, you need to place your prehistoric friends on the grid so that they fit perfectly. Dinosaurs in Place offers 100 unique levels and 40 diverse dinosaurs that will not leave you indifferent.

title: Grandma, No!
description: Step into Grandma's slippers in this hilarious, chaotic adventure where chores become challenges, and things always go... a little off-track. Can you keep things under control, or will the house turn into a whirlwind of chaos?

title: DisplaceMen
description: Survive as a broke painter in a magic-realist coastal town. To redeem the vanished “mermaid” within a 7-day mystery story with multiple endings, you will gradually reveal the truth of people by making paintings…with weird-ass found objects.

title: Matchmaking Inc.
description: A young single man returns to his hometown and takes over the family's matchmaking business. Matchmaking Inc. is a modern-themed RPG designed for men that combines gameplay elements of simulation management and text adventure.

title: Rust of Steel
description: "Rust of Steel" is a post-apocalyptic ruins exploration RPG with a high degree of freedom. Take on the world in your own style with multiple scenarios, free stat distribution, and the option to play as the good guy or the bad guy!

title: Call of Clans
description: Call of Clans is an online turn-based strategy card game set in a magical world. Build a versatile deck with minion and skill cards to challenge equally matched opponents in a world of swords and magic. Team up with others to conquer challenging co-op dungeons

title: Genshin Impact: Moonlight Amidst Dreams
description:
Version 5.4 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New character: Yumemizuki Mizuki
• New story quest for Yumemizuki Mizuki
• New main event: Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

title: Return to Campus
description: An open world school game, you can bully your classmates, collect protection fees, go to the supermarket to make zero-dollar purchases, or even blow up the school. Of course, you can also study hard and exchange ideas with your classmates.

title: Dictionary Glory!
description:
Try to enter in as many words that fit the prompt as you can correctly!

Choose between Time Trials mode, Lives Mode and the new Zen Mode!

With a simple premise, addicting gameplay loop and over 30 prompts to tackle, Dictionary Glory will keep you coming back for more!

Made with Processing and Java, originally for a class project, it has been expanded on since.

Do you have what it takes to achieve true Dictionary Glory?

title: Dimensions of Mind
description: Enter to the characters mind and make decisions. The game is played like interactive movie/adventure game with morality choices which influence the outcome which can be: a manipulative, balanced or violent. The game is based on psychology/philosophy and teaches about thoughts and their consequences.

title: Hunter in the Court of Beasts
description: Standalone Action-Adventure Dungeoncrawl Module

title: A Thief's Quest
description:
TLDR: Players take on the role of a professional thief on the run from police who, while trying to find a place to lie low, ends up getting pulled into one of the biggest heists of their career.

LENGTH: A THIEF’S QUEST takes roughly one hour to finish in a normal playthrough and about an hour and a half for 100% completion. Players who achieve a score of 100/100 (score is given after the game is beaten and the credits roll) gain access to a special gauntlet challenge.

GAMEPLAY: Players will solve simple puzzles, engage in classic RPG turn-based combat, and explore/loot multiple areas, with an emphasis on story and pacing.

title: The Paddy Field
description: I was walking along the rice paddy path with my dog ​​Bonta. That was all I wanted to do. My ordinary daily life was suddenly shattered.

title: Ventisette Voci
description: I dadi non mentono mai / The dice never lie

title: Vanguard Exiles
description: Vanguard Exiles is a new style of auto-battler designed by legendary game designer, Richard Garfield. Each player pits their Squad against their opponent in an ever-changing environment. Each Squad has its own unique identity and is comprised of Units and Actions, each with traits and abilities that can shape your battle strategy. You are the general, guide your troops to victory!

title: Diablo IV: Season of Witchcraft
description:
The Witches Need Your Help

You’ve been called upon, Wanderer. Harness wondrous and uncanny Witchcraft Powers as you unravel the mystery of who stole the Heads from the Tree of Whispers, earning Favor with the Witches of Hawezar to learn the secrets of their power. Hunt the Tree’s rogue Heads before they further spread madness to the creatures of Sanctuary resulting in new grotesque abominations - the Headrotten. Make use of the new Armory feature to quickly save and swap your builds. Earn Dorian, the new Raven Pet, by completing the Season Journey, discover new Uniques and Legendary Aspects, equip new Runes in Vessel of Hatred, and more.

title: Ginger
description: Kevin wants to know what home is, so he writes a novel within a dictionary. Welcome to the unbeatable home.

title: GuGu Pizza: Delivering Pizza to the Space Station? Boss, This is Just Not Right!
description: GuGu Pizza’s motto is to deliver anywhere! So couldn't refuse the pineapple pizza order that came from the space station. Eventually, the pigeon deliveryman begins a high-altitude jump to deliver pizza to space, passing through the city, forest, and sky...

title: Raid Auctus
description: Grow your perfect raid team while the game runs! Build and train your squad from 20 unique classes, enhance their power through permanent upgrades, and watch them conquer challenging raids in Raid Auctus.

title: Little Bartmares
description: On a dark night in Springfield, Bart Simpson sleeps quietly in his bedroom. However inside his mind, he's experiencing a little nightmare...

title: Ocean of Eyes
description:
They're watching you.
Find them.
Look them in the eye.

A short first-person psychological horror game with retro visuals and surreal atmosphere. Players explore a mysterious environment, searching for hidden figures that observe them, creating a minimalist and unsettling experience.

title: Cats With Guns
description:
Cats with Guns is a 2D casual game with rogue-lite elements, where you can make strategic decisions on the middle of the battle and go from a small kitten to a powerful and intimidating feline. Evolve your cat and overwhelm the enemy forces with powerful abilities. Fight sheer enemy numbers with a huge firepower and defeat the generals until you reach Meowstopia.

The game is set in the outskirts of Meowstopia, where cats once lived happily until it was invaded by rats, forcing them to flee. Now, a determined group of cats, known as The Nine Lives Brigade, is fighting to reclaim their city from the rat hordes. The game's premise revolves around the cats battling through waves of enemies to eventually face the leader of the rat invasion.

title: Redshift
description: A short solo developed psychological narrative horror game where you close your eyes to reveal a hidden layer of reality, the REDSHIFT. Uncover the secrets of the facility, Tower 7, and survive what hunts you within the REDSHIFT.

title: Boo! Are you scared? The Chests Game
description: Boo! Are you scared? Don't be afraid, I'm a friend. Play the «Chests» card game for souvenirs with your new friend.

title: Bleeding Code
description: Bleeding Code is a psychological horror game set in a decaying fantasy world long abandoned by its creator. As an unnamed traveler, you must collect the pieces of the shattered kingdom and uncover the truth behind its downfall while trying to keep your sanity and evading a sinister group who want to complete a mysterious ritual tied to the creator’s disappearance

title: Unplayable
description: UNPLAYABLE is a funny/artsy compilation of absurd video games, each in a specific genre: beat'em up, puzzle game and platformer. An art project with meaning.

title: Chuck Nolemland: The Starving Kid
description: Maybe the hardest RAGE horror game ever..

title: The Short Trip
description: The Short Trip is a game about driving and surviving in an endless desert along a somewhat-long almost-short road.

title: Blimpy
description: Gather your friends to assemble your racing vehicle and together, drive it across the track. Select from a wide array of parts and adapt your vehicle to the challenges ahead. Can you put everything together in 90 seconds and then make the best time on the track?

title: Ma vie en rogue
description: Ma vie en rogue is a roguelike spanning multiple themed dungeons and worlds bringing advancements such as a mini-map, first-person view, and paperdoll customization to the genre.

title: Windborn: Journey to the South
description: Guide your bird south, staying with your flock. Soar through speed boosts, embrace the skies, and don’t fall behind. Can you keep up?

title: Clue/Cluedo: Halloween Records
description:
Creep along the candlelit corridors of Tudor Mansion and seek out cryptic clues amongst grinning pumpkins and dust-speckled cobwebs…

Oh, the bats might be fake and the skeletons plastic, but the murder is horrifyingly real!

Use the spooky new Dice Set, Avatar, Card Back and Clue Sheet as you investigate the most frightful Halloween Party this year.

title: Blueman
description:
After King Bedrieger commands his loyal warrior, Blueman, to find an ancient artifact, Blueman finds himself in a treacherous temple full of traps, monsters, and hidden treasures.

Blueman is a platformer game with bite sized levels, a strict time limit, and collectables to increase your score. Points are important beyond just getting a high score- earning points grants you more health! The order of the stages is randomized, and you only have to finish 5 levels to get to the next world. For experienced explorers, an optional "Gauntlet mode" has you play every single last level.

title: The Dispatcher
description: Step into the role of Dominic, a dispatcher in Heavenbrook, where your choices shape a gripping visual novel and adventure game filled with suspense, mystery, and dark secrets. Unravel the chilling mysteries as the shocking events in the city unfold before you.

title: Just Move On!
description: Just Move On! Is a platformer game currently in EARLY ACCESS. Master the challenge! Jump, dodge, and dash your way to the finish.

title: Pico Pico Dungeon!
description: A turn-based roguelike RPG that's easy to pick up and play! Casual yet challenging! Strategic depth is preserved! In addition to roguelike stages, there are over 20 diverse stages, including puzzles and tower defense!

title: Star Beads
description: Learn your basic colors and shapes in Star Beads, an educational PC game for three-five-year-olds from Cellec Games! Select your shape, then click and drag beads of various colors to the correct location on the bracelet. Practice sketching the shapes and colors in the Free-play Drawing Mode.

title: Trash Heart
description: Explore Trash Heart, a planet in the iron grip of the Trash Lord. Find artefacts that grant powerful abilities, fight hordes of deadly foes, and save a planet of outcast robots. Or just scrounge up all the trash your grubby little raccoon hands can hold.

title: Rota's Nautical Chronicles of Trade: Aname Momo - Collaboration Commemorative Residentization DLC
description: A collaboration DLC project between "Rota's Nautical Chronicles of Trade" and Vtuber "Amane Momo" ! Vtuber "Amane Momo" appears in the world of "Rota's Nautical Chronicles of Trade" as a cute pixel art character!

title: Grouls
description: Uncover the chilling secrets of an abandoned house as Denis. Collect body parts, solve puzzles, and escape terrifying entities. Your choices shape your fate. Can you survive the nightmare?

title: Sobreviva Ziggy!
description: Survive with Ziggy through the challenges of a carioca marine life in search of its ideal mate. Take the opportunity to learn more about the life of a seahorse and its daily challenges, as well as predators and prey!

title: Speed Climb
description: A momentum-based 3D platformer carefully designed to torture you.

title: Manny's 2
description: August, 1945. A small Imperial Naval platoon guarding a deserted island. With starvation looming on the horizon, the men begin to see and hear strange calls from the bowels of the island. What mysteries await below the surface and will the soldiers survive long enough to discover them?

title: Big Hunt
description:
This is Big Hunt, a pretty-hardcore roguelite-to-be action game, inpired by The Binding of Isaac & Noita.
Study your foes to spot and exploit their weaknesses.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Backlogged
description: Five Nights at Freddy's: Backlogged is an arcade-style bullet heaven game set in the Five Nights at Freddy's universe. Destroy waves of enemies, upgrade your stats, and ultimately conquer each round in this high-action new take on the Five Nights at Freddy's series! But be warned - it seems that something isn't quite right...

title: Fideos
description: Just shoot another eel's brain.

title: Indiana Jones and the Staff of Kings
description: The plot centers around Indy's search for the Staff of Moses. The game is mostly about a quest which takes you around the world on various quests, fighting Nazis, Panamanian hunters, and Tong thugs, and trying to find artifacts which will unlock other possible things for you to get and do.

title: New Meat
description: New Meat is a fast-paced horror-comedy roguelite about burgers, monsters and dead-end jobs.

title: The Wayward Tower
description: Follow a man cursed to roam the world without ever finding a home, as the road once more leads him to a mysterious tower where a wolf-like wizard lives in peaceful solitude.

title: Unbothered
description:
Drink beer
Smoke cigarettes
Spit on the ground

title: AI Asylum
description: Immerse yourself in a realm of madness and bone-chilling terror as you step into our gripping horror adventure, meticulously crafted to send shivers down your spine. Explore a nightmarish world where each step unveils sinister secrets and heart-pounding encounters.

title: Partygoer!
description: PARTYGOER is an rpgmaker puzzle horror game about your birthday going.. not as you expected. Inspired by a little bit of House of Leaves and heavily inspired by Petscop.

title: Portrait
description: DRAW THE HARPY

title: Batter Up!
description: Bounce your baseball off the faces of zombies in this arena twin-stick shooter! Build synergies with passive upgrades and create chaos on the battlefield.

title: Mazzle Christmas
description: Mazzle Christmas is a straightforward yet surprisingly challenging celebration of the simple beauty of mazes and jigsaw puzzles in a Christmas style.

title: The Legend of Thabor: Rise of the Mages
description: It is a 2D action adventure in pixel graphics. Combines the Metroidvania, platformer and puzzle platformer genres. Experience great fantasy worlds, challenging boss fights and exciting puzzles. Gradually learn new skills and become a master of magic.

title: Civil Warfare
description: After an alien invasion of Earth, the main character gets trapped in a network of alien portals and needs to navigate back home, destroying all kinds of monsters along the way.

title: Nexus Protocol
description: Nexus Protocol: Step into the future and immerse yourself in the high-octane world of Nexus Protocol, a sci-fi first-person shooter that will test your skills, strategy, and survival instincts within an advanced VR training program for future soldiers.

title: Drumguy
description: Become a drummer on your quest for glory in this thrilling rhythm action game ! Explore BOP CITY and make your way to ROCKSTAR Studios. Fight back against mobs of unhinged fans and fearsome enemies, while synchronizing every hits to the beat !

title: Cleanbot 9000
description: 3D Platformer, MetroidVania style Collect-a-thon, this game will have you hop and bop, whack and vac with your outlet plug tail flail. Defeat bosses to clear boundaries. Unlock extra abilities and play as multiple characters!

title: Slice of Ages
description: A top down action rpg with rougelike elements. You'll encounter plenty of opposition trying to make your way to the Slice of Ages. Slice your way through hordes of enemies with unique relics in order to stop Dastardly Duck.

title: HachikanShogi Matta Ari
description: “HakkanShogi-Matta-Ari!” is a simple game in which the player only has to look for anomalies in the playing field while playing Shogi. Scores will be added according to the number of turns, the number of abnormalities you found, and the number of victories or defeats in Shogi.

title: Let's Boogie
description: Use your power to swap places to complete stages as fast as you can in this speedrun platformer!

title: I Hit You
description: Two players take on the roles of Hammer and Gopher. Gopher player: can summon a real or fake gopher by pressing the button corresponding to the cave. Hammer player: Attack by moving and clicking the left mouse button.

title: Ocon
description: In the distant future, long after humans have left Earth, a sprawling underground factory remains operational, hidden beneath the surface. The only signs of life are the occasional flickers of electricity and the soft hum of a lone robot named Ocon.Ocon wakeup in the underground factory, try to escape from underground to surface.

title: Titans Clinic
description: Welcome to Titans Clinic, the ultimate playground for fun with Titans! Get ready to tackle dental challenges and explore the exciting world of nail art for Titan characters like gorillas, vampires, princesses, Santa Claus, aliens, and zombies. Can you create a Million-Dollar Smile for Titans?

title: The Mystic Fortune
description: A narrative-focused game set in an enchanting magical forest! Immerse yourself in a world of mystery and wonder as you interact with four unique characters. Embark on side quests that enrich your journey and unveil the hidden depths of the forest

title: Timebound Vampire
description: Timebound Vampire - an exhilarating 3D action game where you take on the role of a werewolf fending off humans. Your goal is to survive as long as possible in this magical forest. Prepare for a challenging and dynamic gameplay experience where every decision counts and every second matters.

title: Turbo Dash
description: Turbo Dash - an exhilarating 3D racing cartoonish arena where speed and adrenaline become your best friends! Take on thrilling tracks, immerse yourself in a world of speed and dangerous turns, where every second can determine your fate. Are you ready to become the king of the road?

title: The End
description: Survive and lead the score. Swarmed by ghosts, you have to do whatever it takes to survive and it is not going to be an easy task. Lead your way as Bit, earn experience, spend points on upgrades and survive!

title: WarOfGods 2
description: Action RPG to rule the city with goddesses and pets. Protect and rule your city using a variety of creations including cars, bikes, horses, dragons, bosses, and more. You can summon bosses, summon the three goddesses, hire gun-shooting soldiers or workers.

title: Banana Extreme
description: A banana clicking game that is extreme, collect bananas and achieve a higher and higher rank! Can you collect enough bananas to get to the boss at the end?

title: Best Mayor
description: As the new mayor of the island, you need to manage the island's regional planning reasonably to help the island get rid of difficulties and repay the huge bank loan. A variety of rich cards, terrains, and blessings will give you different challenges in every game!

title: Heirs
description: Inheritance can be different, and it is not always pleasant, right?

title: Mortuar
description: Mortuar is a 1-4 player Online co-op psychological horror game. Delve deep into Hoia Baciu Forest where eerie sightings and paranormal activity have transpired. Make use of various ghost hunting equipment to first identify the ghost's type, then attempt to banish it back to the afterlife.

title: Don't Take Me Away
description: This is a tower defense building game. The game controls the movement of the protagonist through the arrow keys on the keyboard or the left mouse button, and interacts with characters and objects in the scene through the space bar.

title: Bad Dream
description: You're stuck in school. What has trapped you is a non-human creature. Run away from him (her?). Find the key and escape from the school to survive. Use w,a,s,d, ESC, left shift, mouse

title: In a Barrel
description: In a Barrel is a hellish game about desperately trying to survive as a fish in an unfair world that only wants you dead. As you play and die, you will be able to upgrade your fish for a better chance of survival. If you're fast and lucky enough, you may just reach freedom.

title: Catch the Dustling
description: Due to an experiment gone wrong, dust creatures from a parallel world have appeared in the laboratory. They pose a threat because of their bad temper and their habit of ignoring certain laws of physics

title: SpaceFire Fury
description: Take control of a powerful spaceship, face relentless waves of cosmic enemies, and battle colossal bosses in this intense, action shoot-'em-up. Use unique powerups, and save the galaxy in SpaceFire Fury.

title: Bugboy
description: Catch, train and battle creepy crawlies and uncover the secrets of Spider Town in this retro Gameboy-style RPG.

title: Palingenesis
description: PALINGENESIS is an interactive music video. Each level is sound tracked with a different song from the album PALINGENESIS, by GRIGS.

title: Time Re:Quest
description: A survival game with a classic style of the graphic adventures of the 80s. Current graphics, updated to the new generations and with a simple way to play. Two game modes. Discover your way and one great game. Procedural game, it is generated as you progress. Every game is different. Survive!

title: Black Light Wave
description: This is a casual and relaxing game based on the classic fable of a turtle and rabbit race

title: Gear of Time
description: It is an Isometric Dungeon Crawler with a few RPG elements in which the character must escape from a great tower after stealing the hourglass.

title: Last Victim: House of Fear
description: This is an indie horror game in which you have to face your fear and escape from house by solving puzzles and escaping from a ghost. Find out the story of a serial killer...

title: TaekwonGirl
description: A cute and sexy Taekwondo girl defeats enemies with Taekwondo power. Defeat enemies with only a mouse.

title: Fuse The Bomb
description: A reverse arcade where you have to make bombs and prevent the special forces from defusing it. Make life difficult for the special forces by making them play mini-games.

title: Cake Platformer
description: Be a Ninja character in this 3rd person platformer. Avoid traps, enemies, solve puzzles and finish maps

title: Skibidi
description: SKIBIDI is a clicker game where you click on toilets! Click more on the toilet and get even more toilets!

title: Normal Days
description: Sometimes you encounter anomalies. Find them or none and react correctly to go back to normal days.

title: Spell Boy
description: Wizard/Mage RPG - combat centric - dungeon crawler where you have to master your spells to conquer the dungeons. It comes with handpicked spells and enemies to make enjoyable gameplay. Master the spells and conquer the dungeons!! Its a game of timing, coordination and strategy!!

title: Safety Corp. VR
description: "Safety Corp." is a VR action game with realistic weapon mechanics, physics, and puzzle elements.

title: Single-handedly Challenge Ultimate World
description: It is a idle cultivation game set in a mythical ultimate world by Chinese mythology, historical biographies, folk tales, and artistic creations.

title: Box Dog
description: Do you love difficult hidden object games? Then this is definitely the game for you! Box Dog is a classic hidden object game at heart. Each level is hand drawn so they are full of surprising details to discover while you are looking for that last object.

title: Latest Issue
description: LATEST ISSUE is a psychological horror in which the protagonist has to descend into underground tunnels to disprove or confirm sinister rumors about the place.

title: Samurai Elemental
description: Samurai Elemental is an action-adventure game in which the player must explore the map to defeat giant insects, collect the elemental soul from them to restore the forest, complete levels, defeat bosses, and save the forest.

title: Furry Farm
description: Furry Farm is a farming simulator RPG!Start your adventure in Tail Town and bring Furry Farm back to its paws! Roll up your sleeves, grab your tools, and get ready for hard work. Can you give this abandoned farm a new breath of life?

title: Keziah's Realm
description: Forage, craft, fight, form clans, and expand your settlements in a dynamic, ever-changing ecosystem. Keziah’s Realm offers a unique gaming experience where you must survive in a rich, procedurally generated world, alongside intelligent NPCs who possess abilities equal to those of the player.

title: Rod Roll
description: Keep rolling! Gift drops every hour!

title: American FKN Election
description: American FKN Election is a clicker game in which you click on your favorite politician and get handsomely rewarded! Between 2 and 12 hours, you get a dollar bill of multiple rarities. The dollar bill drops will change once every 7 days. Join our community and collect them all!

title: KingdomScape
description: KingdomScape is turn based roguelike card game with medieval fantasy settings. Each turn you advance your kingdom by strategically picking a card representing various aspects of your realm.

title: Spider Caro
description: "Spider Caro" is a 2D platform strategy game. In this captivating world, you become a mysterious experimental spider abandoned in a laboratory. Using your exceptional silk-spinning and web-weaving abilities, you must skillfully avoid various traps and obstacles, successfully escape the lab, and embark on a thrilling journey to explore a human world filled with danger and adventure. Endless challenges await your wisdom and courage; use your agility and strategic mind to unravel puzzles and write the legendary story of Spider Caro.

title: Railink
description: Railink takes you on a colorful puzzle/strategy adventure across deserts, icescapes and everything in between. Your job is to link up the remote Railink inhabitants to the rail network, one house at a time. Along the way you will face steep cliffs, vast waterways and tall mountains.

title: Order 13
description: Pack orders and ship them out. But the warehouse holds more than just inventory.

title: Night Hazard
description: A Dark Fantasy Action Hack N' Slash RPG Discover powerful weapons and tear demons and monsters apart in a stylish frenzy as you explore a mythical dystopian world.

title: Torchless
description: Torchless is a dark and gothic dungeon crawler RPG played through a text-based retro console. Forge your party and take up arms against the horrors lurking within the dungeon halls in strategic, turn-based combat, clinging on to survival using everything at your disposal.

title: Bonnie Fell
description: Behind this cute potion-making game lies a choice-driven RPG. Will you solve problems or swindle customers with devious tricks?

title: Over the Hill
description: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

title: The Unexpected (But Not Entirely Surprising) Demise of Jacques du Schnozzle
description: Jacques Du Schnozzle is the worst person in the world. Thankfully though, he’s just been murdered. Do you have what it takes to catch his killer, or will the forces of evil stop you in your tracks?

title: Boo! Are you scared?
description: "Boo! Are you scared?" – game with realistic physics of collisions and destruction, where every step can be the last. Gloomy levels full of dangerous obstacles and bottomless abysses await you.

title: Hero World 2
description: Join Tom and Lisa in Hero World 2, a thrilling new adventure! Unlike the story-driven first installment, this sequel focuses on helping the duo collect fruits while introducing numerous upgrades and fresh features.

title: Ninja Gaiden 4
description: The definitive ninja action-adventure franchise returns with Ninja Gaiden 4! Embark on a cutting-edge adventure where legacy meets innovation in a high-octane blend of style and no-holds-barred combat.

title: Star Crafter
description:
A space survival crafting mining base building and star system building game.
Craft rockets to create planets and Dyson Rings, mine and craft advanced materials, terraform the terrain, manage electricity, farm food, and more as you watch the star system evolve into stunning, everchanging views.

title: Ninja Gaiden II Black
description: Using Unreal Engine 5 to significantly enhance graphic expression, this is the definitive version of "NINJA GAIDEN 2," featuring additional playable characters and enhanced battle support functions.

title: Thyranya
description:
Thyranya is a free-to-play old-style MMORPG with a vast open world to be explored, dangerous creatures, rewarding quests and a lot of social content!

Dive into a world that pays homage to the classics like Diablo, Tibia, and League of Legends, yet stands out with its unique vibe. Thyranya is more than just a game; it's a blend of nostalgia and innovation, crafted from our passion for those unforgettable late-night gaming marathons. Here, you'll find everything from pixel art magic and epic boss battles to smooth animations, crisp graphics, and a fluid combat system designed for today's gamers. Join us on this journey and experience the essence of gaming, right from our hearts to your screen. Subscribe for a front-row seat to all things Thyranya—where every play feels like coming home, yet embarking on an adventure anew.

title: South of Midnight: Weaver's Edition
description: Weaver's Edition: Immerse yourself in the macabre and fantastical world of South of Midnight.

title: Benign Land
description: A short, dreamlike experience where you drift through haunting scenes set in Ireland, from pagan times to recent historical events, revolving around the Troubles of Northern Ireland.

title: Endless Legend 2
description: With a mysterious, ever-changing world, unique factions, and epic storytelling, the much-awaited sequel to the strategy game classic ENDLESS Legend is here, opening a new chapter of the award-winning ENDLESS universe. Write your legend and unveil the secrets of a dreamlike ocean-planet on the verge of extinction.

title: The Black Vault
description: You play as a software engineer who just came back from his job and got a message from his friend that a hacking group called "The Black Vault" is recruiting new members. Throughout the night you'll be given different tasks you'll have to complete in order to get into the group. As the night continues, you gather the attention of some shady people that will try to stop you from getting into The Black Vault. You must crack into servers and devices in order to obtain valuable information while avoiding getting murdered by a bunch of Deep Web killers.

title: Golden Sails
description:
Golden Sails is a naval crew life-sim with ship battles and trading.
Customize your crew (or use a randomized one) and manage their different traits, needs, and desires so they can have high morale for when it's time for battle.

title: EA Sports College Football 26
description: In EA SPORTS College Football 26, the playbook is yours. Rise from high school recruit to Heisman legend, or cement your legacy as a coach by leading your program to glory.

title: Drone Sector
description: Drone Sector is a futuristic gunship game. Provide close air support by firing variety of weapons at the enemies and guide your allied troops via commands. Keep your troops alive, complete objectives, collect resources and recruit engineers. Research better weaponry for the gunship and the troops.

title: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Zardy
description:
You find yourself lost in a cornfield maze, and what do you find. It's Zardy! Though he's not here to scare you in the traditional way you would think.

Can you fight him off? Or will he reign victorious?

This mod is based on Zardy's Maze a game by SwankyBox.

title: The Slowpoke Shack
description:
Archer and his partner Growls the Growlithe have recently moved to Silverspring Town and opened The Slowpoke Shack.

Running a successful restaurant was never going to be easy, but Archer never expected so many difficult challenges to come his way...

title: Friday Night Funkin': The X Event
description:
The X Event mod is a mod bringing your favorite characters from the Undertale AUs Underverse and XTale into the Friday Night Funkin' universe!

The full week contains everything from previews weeks (Overwrite with X Chara and Inking Mistake with Ink!Sans), and now includes a custom RPG overworld, better charting tools, and a new character: X Gaster, with his theme Relight.

title: Woods of War
description: Woods of War is tower defense meets deck builder. Build your tree's defenses from cards you are dealt. As you defeat the orcs, earn new cards, customize your deck and unlock new levels of power. It is your elvish duty to fend off the deadly horde for in this forest, sap runs thicker than blood.

title: Varyznex
description: A horizontal scrolling 2D shmup

title: Xontainer Meta Space
description: Xontainer Meta Space is a logistics simulation game with advanced AI NPCs you can interact with via voice or text. Manage trucks, customize vehicles, complete warehouse missions, operate forklifts, generate energy, and use an in-game smartphone for tasks, calls, and money transfers.

title: Hullbreaker
description: A fusion of arena PvP combat on the high seas and roguelite mechanics. Outfit your ship with powerful weapons, clash with rival captains on the high seas, and create your own flag to hoist over the shipwrecks!

title: Emergency Exit
description: Communicate. Cooperate. Escape. aEmergency Exit is an online cooperative escape/puzzle game with asymmetric gameplay. Separated and unable to see each other’s actions, players must cooperate to reach the exit before time runs out, solving puzzles and uncovering hidden secrets.

title: T1wre3: Noname
description: Hi, I am Noname! Can you solve my puzzle? Dive into a world of riddles and uncover the hidden six-digit keys to advance. With challenging puzzles, hints to guide you, and secrets to discover, this game tests your logic and wit. Solve every enigma and claim for the victory.

title: Snarewaves' Shooting Challenge
description: A short, free high-score chasing 2D shooter set to a punk rock soundtrack.

title: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Valentine
description: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Valentine is a fun and rewarding puzzle game. Assemble charming St.Valentine Day-themed pictures, sharpen your attention, and immerse yourself in a festive holiday world.

title: More Panda: Slot Creator
description: More Panda Slot Creator, Bigger, Better, Brighter, and easier to create and play. Ever wanted to create a slot game but did know how to program. Here is the next best thing. More Panda Slot Creator is a great app to create a slot game for the gaming community now includes save game option.

title: Do or Die: Frontal Warfare
description: Do or Die Frontal Warfare is a FPS game with online team-based game play that takes place in a variety of fictional locations interpreted around the world. It brings a grounded, wide variety combat experience to the players.

title: Dating Sim
description: You play as a guy who is conflicted between fantasy and reality, and tries to get a girlfriend. There are three girls and three endings. Who will you end up with?

title: Billgard
description: Smash your friends in Billgard, a chaotic physics-based party brawler for couch and online multiplayer with up to 8 players. Kick your opponents off the table across different game modes!

title: Dating Sim! Re:Mastered
description:
After a particularly rough night, the protagonist of Dating Sim crawls into bed to forget his loneliness as yet another day of him being single passes by. When he awakens, the protagonist discovers that it’s actually May 30, 2020, twelve years after his nap!

What’s more, the protagonist finds that he’s still in college and still hasn’t found a girlfriend. While usually a successful student, the protagonist is now struggling to maintain his grades and his luck with the ladies hasn’t improved one bit.

Polishing up his grades may be hard but with your help, finding a girlfriend may not be! Can the protagonist win over his dream girl with this new chance he’s been given?

title: Dating Sim! Luna's Lovely Summer
description:
Despite getting friend-zoned by Luna in Dating Sim! Re:Mastered, the protagonist decides that he should be “just friends” with her at first. It’s still a win for him, as Luna is among the top students in college and is willing to tutor him for his summer classes. His grades are already terrible and they could really use a boost from her. Not only that, but since Luna’s such a sex freak he feels that she could eventually become his girlfriend. The protagonist thinks it’s all gonna work out – he’ll graduate, AND he’ll finally have a girlfriend!

…Not so fast, though!

The protagonist finds himself having to put up with Luna’s unpredictable antics. She tends to postpone study sessions with him because if she’s not completely drunk, then she’s busy with her cybersex sessions! It’s summer, and Luna just wants to have fun before the next semester starts. Even though he’s tempted to join in with her craziness and lose his virginity to her, the protagonist’s studies come first. He begins to doubt if Luna really is at the top of her class…

With your help, can the protagonist improve his grades over the summer…and finally earn himself a girlfriend?

title: Seafarer's Gambit
description: Play as a captain who ventures into new lands with his crewmates until a storm passing by mysteriously parts him away from his ship and crew. Help the captain find his missing crew and overcome the challenges on the path by fighting unwanted guests using his trusty old sword.

title: Galactic Striker
description: Galactic Striker is an action-packed top-down space shooter where you battle enemy fleets, upgrade your spaceship, and save the galaxy. Experience thrilling combat, epic boss fights, and retro-style graphics in this exciting space adventure.

title: Yes Comrade
description: Yes Comrade is a 1 - 4 player cooperative survival sandbox where you and your fellow Comrades are re-assigned to a remote sea outpost. Guard the great Belegovskain coastline, process the ships, keep the Supreme Leader happy, and try not to think too hard about what happens on the island…

title: Pogo Epoch: Impossible 99%
description: It’s a game where you bounce on a Pogo Stick and try to climb a massive tower full of tricky obstacles. Take on the impossible challenge—one unlucky slip, and you’re back at the bottom. Pure focus solo or chaotic fun with friends

title: Danger Horizon
description: Danger Horizon is a multiplayer, first-person shooter game made using Unreal Engine 5. The game features realistic gunplay, and advanced blood and gore features that everyone can enjoy.

title: Angry Video Game Nerd 8-bit
description: The Angry Video Game Nerd is back in 8-bits! Battle through frantic platforming levels, defeat classic AVGN bosses, and save all of gaming from a corrupted monstrosity.

title: Screaming in the Basement
description: The main character is mike, an experienced journalist who always strives to uncover the truth, According to locals, restless souls inhabit this place, but this needs to be confirmed., the game takes place in 1991.

title: I Wanna Lap Around
description: A gloomy and minimal take on the needle style pioneered by Fly the Far Away, but with a higher focus on precision and density.

title: Ultimate Ragdoll Game
description: Ultimate Ragdoll Game is a sandbox game without any limitations. The game has no specific way to play or end, your goal is to have a good time!

title: Rance VI Sonogo
description: Collection of short stories related to Rance VI. Included in Alice no Yakata 7.

title: Jumpng Disable
description:
"Casual 3D JUMPNG game"

A game that feels familiar yet refreshingly new—and occasionally downright crazy. No further explanation needed.
Let's JUMPNG!

title: Fragile Sun
description: Autumn is coming

title: MediEvil II
description:
A port of MediEvil 2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

MediEvil 2, or MediEvil II in its NA release, is an action-adventure game originally developed by SCE Cambridge Studio and published by Sony Computer Entertainment. Released in 2000 for the PlayStation, it is a sequel to the original MediEvil and continues the story of Sir Daniel Fortesque.

Set in Victorian-era London, the game follows Sir Dan as he is resurrected once again to stop a sorcerer named Lord Palethorn, who has unleashed chaos by reanimating the dead using pages from Zarok's spellbook. The gameplay combines hack-and-slash combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving, with new weapons, levels, and enemies. The game introduces unique features such as a ghostly ally, Kiya, and new mechanics like controlling Dan’s detached head for specific puzzles.

title: Merge Numbers
description: Merge the numbers and smash the blocks!

title: Red Solstice 2: Survivors - Ultimate Edition
description:
Plan your strategy and undertake real-time combat missions, in this sequel to the best-selling tactical game, Red Solstice!

The Red Solstice 2: Survivors Ultimate Edition contains the base game, as well as all previously released DLCs, including new story lines, classes, maps and much more!

title: The Reward of Cherishment and Eternity.
description:
Death, nature's remedy for all things, offers you a deal: Help him, and he shall grant peace for a lost loved one.

-Explore a visually stunning world filled with hidden secrets and unravel its mysteries at your own pace.
-Chart your own path by playing the levels in any order, enhancing replayability.
-Master a deep and complex combat system, with fully integrated DualSense wireless controller features, including haptic feedback and adaptive triggers for unparalleled tactile engagement.

The Reward of Cherishment and Eternity is a third-person, action-adventure shooter that combines exploration, emotionally charged storytelling, and intense, rewarding combat.

title: Mandragora Seeker in the Creep Zone
description: A timid gravedigger’s strange adventure to claim the Mandragora Gold Prize! Grow Mandragoras affected by weather, moon phases, and time, while fending off ghosts and fireballs to win the ultimate prize!

title: Southside Racing
description: Race and battle using weapons and karts themed after Vtubers and content creators! All characters in game can be found livestreaming on Twitch. Race through different Vtuber themed levels like TomaKey's Liminal Spaces or Meat's Silly Safari and slow each other down with weapons!

title: A Few Days With: Bianca
description: Embark on a sensual butterfly-hunting adventure with Bianca, a charming young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Bianca's enticing layers.

title: The 8ight
description: Max, who suffers from schizophrenia due to childhood trauma, decides to break free from the endless torment of hallucinations and delusions.

title: Parkour Assassin: Sprint Run
description: A 3D parkour game in a cyberpunk style, where you can experience breathtaking speeds, dodge various traps, and continuously break through to achieve the furthest distance. Terrifying bombs and robotic enemies will stand in your way, but you can use the quick blade in your hand to slash through them!

title: Rome: Nightmares of Empire
description: Rome: Nightmares of Empire is an Action game with RPG elements, charming pixel graphics and interesting mechanics. Defeat your opponents, acquire and create equipment, improve your skills to face the great threat, rise up, hero and save Rome !

title: Hack and Slash Fury
description: Heavy Metal! Deep Combo System! Lot of Cinematics! Discover Legendary Warriors Forged in War! Destroy the dark empire! and save the world of his tiranity!!! Dark or Light?! Only one will Survive!!! Prepare your sword! And Anihilate all your enemies!

title: Little Robot
