title: Dreamy Syrup
description: "Sato Ama," whom you met by chance at university, is an ardent fan of the virtual idol "Amaha Shiroppu" just like you! The two hit it off and go out together, talk about their favorite idols, and gradually become closer. However... "I almost got found out." A certain comment made by Amaha Shiroppu during a stream raises a question: "Could it be that Amaha Shiroppu is... Sato Ama?" Will you witness the virtual idol "Amaha Shiroppu" being found out? A thrilling love comedy where "dreams" and "reality" intersect!

title: Akai Majo
description: Dark fairy tale...

title: Kiloton
description: Invade your neighbors, conduct bombing campaigns, research and develop nuclear arsenals, and grapple for diplomatic power in Kiloton, a dark and abstract new RTS that puts you in the room where potentially world-ending decisions are made.

title: Of the Devil: Episode 1
description: Unlock the first of five episodic murder mysteries with the Episode 1 DLC for "of the Devil" and dive headfirst into the dark and thrilling corporate conspiracy that unfolds when the father of modern android programming is found dead of apparent suicide.

title: Occultus Vitae: Hidden Life
description: A psychological horror adventure where you explore abandoned locations and unravel dark legends. Set in a remote castle hiding a Nazi black magic experiment gone wrong, you'll face haunting environments, challenging puzzles, and a fight to survive the horrors lurking within.

title: Dead Daylight
description: "DEADDAYLIGHT" is a side-scrolling platform action-adventure game.Developed independently by a single person. It tells the dark story of a protagonist who wakes up from a nightmare about the plague during a plague after the gods abandoned the earth, and then return to the Cathedral of Holy Light.

title: Caught by a Spider
description:
You've fallen into the spider's web.

Caught by a Spider is a short yandere Visual Novel where you talk to a Spider!

title: Beta Hospital
description:
Beta Hospital is a horror game with a lot of Internet memes, with some funny content, but the main tone is horror.
You will play Zeng Zhaofeng, to Beluta hospital to find his missing wife Zhai Yina, on the way will meet a strange woman Hu Yilian, she is an enemy or a friend?

title: Gravity's Apple
description: An action adventure game in which you guide a rolling apple. As you roll through various stages accompanied by soothing music, your goal is to reach the top of Newton's head.

title: Unblinking
description: Trapped on death row, unravel the dark mystery of an ancient horror to escape alive. Outsmart the abyss, cheat death - if you dare.

title: The Silent Suite
description: You live in a hotel room. Everything seems normal—until a strange rumbling wakes you. Panic sets in as you realize you’re not alone. A killer is somewhere in the hotel… Trapped inside, you must navigate the eerie hallways, and find a way to escape… before it's too late.

title: Pokémon/Grand Order
description: "Pokémon/Grand Order" is a fangame that adapts the story of Fate/Grand Order, using resources from the original game and adjusting them to Pokémon mechanics, based on the Fate system.

title: Laundromat Manager Simulator
description: Step into the world of Laundromat Manager Simulator—where your entrepreneurial skills and creative flair combine to transform a modest laundromat into a bustling business empire! Manage every detail, from upgrading state-of-the-art equipment to designing a standout interior, as you attract loyal customers and outshine the competition. Whether you’re a savvy strategist or a creative decorator, this is your chance to build the ultimate neighborhood laundry hub. Success is just a spin cycle away, are you ready to take it?

title: Give an imp a chance!
description:
Give an imp a chance is a new visual novel about John Johnson, a frustrated salaryman. After weeks of preparation, he is finally ready to summon a succubus. However, he botches the ritual and summons an imp. Despite his initial disappointment, the imp begs him to give her a chance.

GAIAC has multiple hentai scenes and several startling transformations, along with a light hearted story about demon summoning and how dramatically life can change when you meet the right person.

title: Anna vs. Sentimental Fighter
description: A Doujin fighting game developed by 'unikurage' using characters from the "Hyper Anna" manga and "Sentimental Graffiti" game series.

title: Tryhard
description: Turn-based sports RPG about managing an underdog rugby club in New Zealand. Outsmart opponents and upgrade your squad, but also feed your dog and go on dates, in this epic saga of love, betrayal, and community sports.

title: Monster Blast Infinity
description: Shoot waves of monsters

title: Bee Flowers
description: Relax and Puzzle with Buzzing Bees!

title: Golfslinger
description:
An explosive mix of golf and shooting! Use a varied arsenal to launch your ball into a frantic multiplayer chaos!

Be the world best in the racing solo races or face off against up to 12 players in stylized Westernpunk environments and prove you're the best of the Golfslingers!

A game made for tryharder and having fun with your friends !

title: Musestruck
description:
A 2D Platformer RPG about art and magic. You play as JOURNEY and QUINN, two young artist friends who explore a mysterious magical world called NEGATIVE SPACE, to try and make it back home.

Journey must use his powers of illustration, and Quinn must use her powers of music to defeat comical and strange enemies, while slowly uncovering Negative Space's secrets, as it tests and strengthens the two's friendship along the way.

title: Andalas: Realms of Eternal Lights
description: Join Rei, a brave boy battling brain cancer, on a quest to save the enchanting land of Andalas. Customize your adventure by using tools and items to defeat monsters, transform into powerful ancient figures, and summon Companion pets. Collect relics to uncover secrets and rescue Andalas!

title: Mind 720
description: Survive for 100 seconds in each of the 10 unique levels. Enjoy the wrath of ten enemies , as they bring a plague of bullets.

title: Ghostwriter Workshop
description: Become a ghostwriter and write on the behalf of others--everything from love letters to apologies! There's just one catch in this crazy adventure game: the most important words in your writings are decided by roulette.

title: Mayéutica
description:
Only one can get the job. Review their resumes, ask them questions and find out what they hide under their skin. Every second counts.
Mayéutica is a narrative experience about four job candidates. Through their answers, they will discover truths hidden from themselves until they explode. Designed and programmed in 48 hours to participate in the Global Game Jam 2025, with the theme “Bubble”. Recognition for best narrative by the Francisco de Vitoria University.

title: Euphionia: The Tree Spirit's Curse
description: An old school grid-based dungeon crawler with combo oriented non-turn-based combat.

title: Remember Valentine
description: Celebrate the holiday with Remember Valentine, a festive card-matching memory game perfect for all ages! Flip cards to reveal delightful Valentine-themed icons like hearts, candies, and Cupid himself, while testing your memory across increasing levels of fun and challenge. With cheerful visuals, cozy music, and endless holiday spirit, it’s the perfect way to make your gaming season merry and bright!

title: There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin
description:
Secret agent Franklin Benjamin's former-mentor-turned-rogue-agent Dustin MacGuffin has resurfaced to kidnap the one you care about most.

In this single-player interactive spy novel, play as secret agent Franklin Benjamin and use your particular set of skills to save Virginia from the clutches of the madman Dustin MacGuffin.

Which means - you’d better get the MacGuffin!

title: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
description:
Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world.

In the single-player interactive novel villain team-up game "There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.," you play as his greatest adversaries. Can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. (short for a "Very Important Collective of Terrorists, Operatives, and Rogues") defeat the only man standing between them and world domination?

To the V.I.C.T.O.R. go the spoils!

title: Benny Bash
description: Survive this horror/puzzle adventure. Uncover the secrets of a cursed video game from the '80s while a malevolent entity hunts you. Solve escape room-style puzzles, navigate eerie labyrinths, and see how your actions in the game shape the real world. Stay sharp... and stay alive.

title: Fruit Stand Fortune
description: Start with nothing and spin your way to the top! Gather fruit from slot machines and sell them to buy upgrades, new fruit types, and more! Unlock cute customers! Meet a Bear Wizard! Build your fruit empire with Fruit Stand Fortune!

title: Touhou Puppet Dance Performance: Shard of Dreams - Genso Network Connection
description:
The mod, Genso Network Connection, adds a new story apart from the original storyline, which is available from the start of the game. It features new maps, bosses, etc, all inspired by the fangame Shanghai.EXE Genso Network, which itself is based on the GBA game Series, Megaman Battle Network.

You been transported to an unknown world of cyber beings by a mysterious individual who requests your aid to help her. Do you accept her request and go off on a brand new adventure?

Author of Mod: Chabono

title: Touhou Puppet Dance Performance: Shard of Dreams - Extended: Fanchara
description:
The mod, Shard of Dreams - Extended - Fanchara, is a project that populates the Realm of Dreams area from the Shard of Dreams - Extended - mod with characters originated from Touhou project fanworks, some of which were originally planned for the base mod but got cut during development in order to make it feel more authentic.

Adds characters from the Touhou fandom and various Touhou Project fanworks, complete with costumes and fully usable online (provided both players have the fanchara patch installed) Currently featured fanworks: Fantasy Maiden Wars, Subterranean Hatred, Book of Star Mythology, Touhou Puppet Play, Combinations With You.

Author of Mod: Wower/VeePI

title: Orbital Cascade
description: A puzzle game inspired by classics like Zuma, where you pop colorful bullets, unleash dazzling combos, and rise to conquer the skies. Strategize your moves, master the challenge, and claim victory!

title: Mechanized Corps: Rebirth
description: Mechanized Corps: Rebirth drops you into the war-torn year of 2361, where Mechanized Corps fight for control of the Sol system's resources. Choose from four customizable classes, arm yourself with devastating weapons, and fight in intense squad-based combat. Battle offline or online with friends!

title: Eldritch Escape
description:
In this roguelike bullet-heaven, Earth has been consumed by an ancient eldritch god. Form a customizable squad of survivors and explore decaying, metroidvania-inspired worlds trapped within the god’s belly. Battle endless waves of nightmarish creatures, extract resources, rescue survivors, uncover forbidden knowledge, and search for a way out.

Portals powered by ancient eldritch forces link worlds and realities, forming a tangled web. With a limited oxygen supply, your squad has just 20 minutes to navigate the portal network, jumping from world to world in search of the one escape route. Can you escape the void in time?

title: Sangra
description: Classic survival horror with a modern feel. Solve puzzles, search for items, manage your inventory, and pray you'll return to the safe room alive in this decaying twisted facility consumed by a mysterious metallic corruption.

title: Hotel Blue Rose no 99 no Heya
First Steps in the NICU: Discovery Edition
description:
Welcome to “First NICU Experience”! Experience neonatal care in this serious game. As a nursing student, work with medical staff and families to care for infants and tackle post-discharge challenges. With interactive choices and story-driven gameplay, learn key skills in 1 hour.

Players take on the role of a nursing student participating in clinical training at a NICU. By collaborating with medical staff and families, you will learn the basics of neonatal intensive care, communication with patient families, and the challenges of transitioning from hospital to home care.

title: There's No Cake
description:
The cake is a lie! We looked very hard but still couldn't find any!

There's No Cake is a hidden object game with a selection of 9 locations and random sweet treats to find for each of them.

title: The Pub Life Simulator
description: Open your own pub with The Pub Life Simulator, serve food and drinks to keep your customers happy. Enjoy this exciting simulation experience solo or with friends. Unlock higher-quality products, expand your pub, and build the best business in town!

title: Vox Populi: Germany 2025
description: Play as an existing or fully customisable political figure, and campaign for many alternative German elections! In "Vox Populi: Germany 2025", you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

title: Dancing Pandas: Ranger's Path
description: Calling all animal lovers! Become the ranger for Summery Islands! Find courage by helping other Pandas. Dancing Pandas: a cozy adventure where bravery blooms beyond your comfort zone.

title: Bloody Hell 2
description: Pulverize demons as a small Angel wielding a GIANT DEMONIC HAMMER! Explore Hell's deepest layers, and uncover the truth of how Heaven fell in this Bullet-Hell Metroidvania. Will you succeed, or die in the chaotic depths of BLOODY HELL 2?

title: Prolonged Winter
description: Prolonged Winter is an MBF21 mapset of 6 maps (5 beatable maps + 1 stopper map) which are wintery and surreal, using @OverflowingMocha's lovely DreamPal palette. The maps have a heavy focus on creating a sort of dream-like atmosphere, often containing experimental gameplay and visuals, while some maps have no enemies at all. Most of them are relatively short, with the exception of MAP05.

title: Biofactory
description: Build your living factory using organs and fleshy biomachines. Combine your pulsating machines to automate and scale up production. Mine, harvest, produce and assemble weird materials in a grimdark biopunk setting. No enemies or pressure, the hive mind has only one instinct: The factory must grow.

title: Stones Keeper II: Chaos Lord
description:
In Stones Keeper II: Chaos Lord, you'll immerse yourself in a fantasy world as a leader of a squad of the Circle of Unquenchable Thirst. Along with recruiting, leveling, arming, and providing for your army, you'll be in charge of your very own flying fortress. Growing it and improving its system will prove invaluable to challenges ahead.

You'll be able to create a unique squad, by recruiting new warriors with a multitude of skills and weapon preferences. The tasks that will be assigned to you will require not only the strength of your warriors, but also cunning. The search for valuable artifacts, raiding cities, subduing enemy commanders, desecrating lands, and capturing altars are only a few of the challenges you will face.

Every choice opens up opportunities. Change tactics and try new powers. In "Stones Keeper II: Chaos Lord" all means are good to leave your mark on history, be it force, diplomacy, or magic! Your decisions will determine the fate of the kingdom.

title: Pure Pure Pero Pero Princess
description: After a sudden and chance meeting with an otherworldly beauty, Toshio Kaname is whisked away to a magical world, the Kingdom of Perahim. There, he learns of a prophecy to decide Perahim's next king and must embark on a quest to recover two magic relics.

title: Destiny 2: Heresy
description: The Dreadnaught has returned. Gather your allies and bring order to chaos as shadows gather in the galaxy. Descend into the ship and stem the Taken tide before it overwhelms Earth in the new three-player activity. the Nether.

title: 2004Scape
description: Lost City is a unofficial non-profit project focused on preservation through open-source emulation accessibility.

title: Edict
description: Welcome to Edict! Take up the role of a fortunate judgement agent sent to destroy the word of Nowherehoods soul engine!

title: Broke Alchemist Emma's Debt Repayment Plan
description: Emma, a young alchemist living in Echichi Town, suddenly has to repay a debt of 1,000,000 gold after her mother, Beth, goes missing. As it turns out, Beth had a debt with the Baron, but was unable to repay it due to unknown circumstances. Will Emma be able to repay this immense amount of money?

title: Mournight
description: Mournight is a horror game where 1-4 players collaborate to survive and solve the mystery. Explore locked rooms, collect cursed objects, and stay alert against a terrifying creature that hunts you in the dark.

title: Tales of Ancients: Hollow Apartments
description: Reality unravels.Every floor reflects your mind.Tales of Ancients: Hollow Apartments a dark, atmospheric journey through psychological horror and inner collapse.

title: Cafemart Simulator
description: Create and decorate your cozy cafe, where guests can enjoy delicious food and drinks. Expand your service with a supermarket offering a wide selection of fresh products, so visitors can not only have a tasty meal but also do some shopping. Play solo or with friends in cooperative mode!

title: The Immemorial Order II Sisters of Darkness
description: The Immemorial Order II Sisters of Darkness is primarily a spooky, atmospheric, first-person walking simulator that doesn't take itself too seriously.

title: Whale Flesh
description: A short horror game where you dig through the flesh of a giant whale to find out what happened to your team.

title: Coffin Delivery
description: Trapped in a haunted mansion on your first day delivering coffins, you must uncover its dark secrets to survive. Explore eerie halls and evade a stalking demonic presence as you race to gather the ghost's remains and find a way out alive.

title: Nightmare Journey
description: You're on a bus, trying to reach the next station.

title: The Darkness 2
description: The second game starring Blaze the Hedgehog (BlazeHedgehog's Sonic fan character).

title: Sally's House
description: A single player Horror Game made with Unity, consisting of 4 short levels with different environments and entities.

title: Behind The Backrooms: Lost Levels
description: Behind The Backrooms: Lost Levels is Co-op 1-6 survival horror game where you explore eerie, hidden levels filled with terrifying entities, cryptic puzzles, and relentless dangers. survive deadly encounters, and find your way out—before you become another lost soul trapped forever.

title: Webstore Mogul
description: Rise to become a webstore mogul by managing your own online shop. Set prices for your products, manage inventory, hire employees, and design your online store. With strategic decisions and effective management, you will build a successful online business.

title: Shadow Adventure
description: The game is Shadow's own Adventure, with the resurrection of Professor Gerald Robotnik, learning about a counter part to Chaos from Sonic Adventure 1, Destructo. Learning this, Shadow must take Gerald out.

title: Battle Of Witches
description: Bouncing bullet game, the player clicks somewhere on the screen for the fairy to throw a spell in that direction. The spell bounces off the walls of the scene, and the player will need to use this to their advantage to hit the rival.

title: Zanda Bakumatsu Shinsengumi
description: A typing game like Typing of the Dead but set during the Bakumatsu period of Japan.

title: Replicube
description: Replicube is an open-ended programming puzzle game/toy about writing code to replicate 3D voxel-based objects. Solve puzzles, pursue leaderboard glory, or just make art to share with the in-game community.

title: Door Game Deluxe
description: Door Game Deluxe is a (very) short, satirical RPG. An expansion of the original and the pinnacle of human artistic expression, this version offers original art and music on top of new endings.

title: Hentai: Ultimate Puzzle
description: Enjoy this puzzle game with beautiful girls and stunning animations.

title: Condo Desires
description: An adult visual novel where you navigate the lives and fantasies of alluring women in a community condominium. As the new trustee, create relationships, uncover secrets, and trigger in intimate encounters. Will you master the art of seduction, or will you crave more? Your choices, your desires.

title: Model Casting
description: You are in the role of the owner of an exclusive adult modeling agency. Your mission is to discover and mentor aspiring models, each with distinct personalities and backgrounds. Engage in immersive dialogues where your choices influence relationships and unlock intimate moments.

title: Eros Raiders
description: Welcome to Eros Raiders, the ultimate fusion of waifus, sci-fi, mechas and hentai!

title: Bonds of Ecstasy
description: Train your submissive maid-girlfriend. Short erotic H-game involving a Sub/Dom relationship. Visual Novel with interactive point-and-click elements.

title: Waifu Closet
description: Experience the captivating world of "Waifu Closet"! Immerse yourself in a stunning clicker game. Help your companion become a star! Tap to earn hearts! Collect and customize outfits! Each item is unique and tradable! Earn exclusive items and spend hearts on special lots.

title: Private Garden
description: Japan has the highest rate of kaiju attacks in the world, therefore in order to combat them it establishes the Anti-Kaiju Defense Force.

title: Fap&Click
description: Welcome to the Fap&Click world. Fap&Click is a new, breathtaking clicker with elements of a collection game. Here your main task will be to click on a gorgeous Anime girl, gather coins and collect cards. Click, enlarge your collection and remember to put your hands on the table. See you in the game.

title: Sonic Madness
description:
Sonic Madness is a 2D side-scrolling platformer fan game that features a unique character-swapping loop across a multi-act campaign structure. Instead of controlling traditional heroes, players directly command Dr. Robotnik and Metal Sonic, with gameplay split into distinct character-specific acts that require completely different navigation mechanics.

When controlling Metal Sonic, gameplay focuses on momentum-based speed, utilizing precise jumps, traditional spin-dashes, and sudden high-speed horizontal dashes to eliminate environmental hazards and enemies. Conversely, acts featuring Dr. Robotnik transition the gameplay into a methodical, physics-based aerial platformer. Players use a limited-use jetpack mechanic to hover, bypass vertical obstacles, and position themselves during complex boss encounters against rival robotic units.

The game includes custom 2D pixel-art menus, traditional checkpoint systems, classic ring-collection loops, specialized underwater sections, and distinctly themed levels including "Star Brain Zone" and "Funk Surgery Zone."

title: Calyx
description: A strategy game with a new kind of enemy, Calyx puts you in charge of a space mining outpost, locked in battle with an overwhelming alien organism. Build your base, gather resources, assemble your forces, and take on the Calyx. With only an out-of-date AI for company, can you survive?

title: Sil and the Fading World
description: Battle against fearsome Raidbosses alone! Uncover your past in Aritas, a sinister world ravaged by ancient Gods of the Realm Below. This ARPG features 9 class specializations, hundreds of unique items, a vast array of skills, complex character progression, and intense Raidboss encounters.

title: Sol-Rui: After Mini
description: Rui can't catch a break... She had only just returned to her world after saving Roots, thanks to the power of Sol, but now monsters are attacking her town and kidnapping people! However, the challenge awaiting her is very different this time. It's all smoke, mirrors and illusions...

title: The Seven Realms: Realm - Pythonium
description:
After the events in Terran, it's time to discover Pythonium, the Realm of Demons and Witches.

On a journey to save one of your oldest friends and find the perpetrator of her suffering, you seek the Witch Queen's help.

What should have been a simple request becomes more complicated as she refuses to fulfil half of your demand for unknown reasons. All is not what it seems as you uncover Pythonium's dark secrets.

title: Rapture Island
description: Rapture Island is a wandering simulator with no goal & intentionally low-quality, retro graphics. It is something that could have been an early 3D game, with graphics reminiscent of the Super FX Chip. Also heavily inspired by poking around Lego Island as a kid, not engaging with any of the main quest.

title: Retro Game Store Simulator
description: Build your own Video Game Store in 1984. Everyday until the end of 1989 gives you the opportunity to stock shelves, cycle your inventory, manage your prices, analyze historical trends to make your game store profitable. Use era-relevant technology and systems to prove that gaming has a future!

title: Crank
description: An incremental game about being locked in a room, forced to move a crank until you're allowed to leave.

title: Monochrome Echoes: White
description: This is an otherworldly summoning RPG set in a fantasy world, with an adapted and enhanced system from the popular hack-and-slash RPG "QUESTER."

title: Radiant Princess: Poni Ceres
description:
Yui Morisaki is just a regular girl, busy with her regular everyday life like the Karate Club and an unrequited love... until one day she meets a little robot named Polka! Suddenly, she's granted the ability to transform into Radiant Princess Poni Ceres, just in time to fight against the evil forces of Zydarg, an alien organization hellbent on invading and enslaving all of humankind.

Fast forward a few months and Yui is coming to grips with her new life, though her heroic activities are starting to affect her grades. But just as she's getting used to dealing with the enemy's regular troops, it seems like Zydarg is escalating the conflict and attacking with monsters. It's time for Poni Ceres to up her game too!

title: The Soldier and the Golden Princess
description: Princess Knight Lucrezia is known for her exceptional swordsmanship and striking beauty, but when whispers about a secret relationship with the much-maligned General Abol start sweeping through the ranks, it falls to you, a lone soldier, to uncover the truth!

title: The Great Yokai of the Haunted Halls
description: After venturing into the old campus building, you and your friend Yua encounter a mysterious fox spirit that turns your lives upside down! Navigate through a labyrinthine, an uncanny version of the old campus building, evading malevolent spirits and dealing with curses. Form an alliance with the benevolent yokai Izuna to gain unique abilities. Your choices may lead you branching toward multiple endings.

title: Welcome to Paradise Island
description: While on vacation with your friends, you are suddenly washed away to a mysterious island in another world. Now you must befriend the locals, gather resources, and build Paradisiem Island into a bustling tourist destination so that you may go home!

title: Natsu no Sagashimono: What We Found That Summer
description: Summer vacation is finally here, and the next few weeks promise to be anything but uneventful! Natsu has just 30 days to acclimate to life in the countryside, help the locals face their demons, find that special someone, and gain the self-confidence to return home with his head held high!

title: El Chavo
description: It is a game made in the original Game Boy resolution of 160 x 144 pixels. It has 10 levels and 2 types of enemies. Collect diamonds in each level to open the exit and escape.

title: Hypnosis of Corruption
description: Hinata Yuzuzaka is highly respected and admired among her peers. When strange things start to occur at her school and the surrounding town, it will be up to her to get to the bottom of it all.

title: Touhou Makuka Sai: Fantastic Danmaku Festival Part III
description: "Touhou Makuka Sai ~ Fantastic Danmaku Festival Part III" is a bullet hell shooting game with an arcade golden age style. It is the third game in the Touhou Makuka Sai series. The strange moon seems to hide a new conspiracy. Charge into the deep world on the eternal night!

title: To the Mountain
description: A simple game about going through a Mountain.

title: Hopshot
description:
Hopshot is a difficult precision platformer about a lonely gay frog with a gun. Plan your routes, discover the secrets, and destroy anything in your way to make your Wish come true! Or fail and join the lost souls at the bottom of The Wishing Well for eternity.

Tired of other similar games being too easy? HOPSHOT's purposefully simplistic movement system allows for a brand new way to play a rage platformer: strategy & planning ahead are key!

title: Memory Data Memory
description: A short, simple game about transporting data.

title: Cleaner Boy
description:
A platform action game about a boy cleaning his house...with some brute force.

Sweep, clean and combo your way through your house, until every piece of junk is taken care of.

A small game made in 1 week for the GBJam 8.

title: It's Raining Acorn!
description: It’s Raining Acorn! is an idle pachinko drafting game where strategy meets nature in a beautifully crafted, vertically scrolling forest. It sits on the side of your desktop and you can leave it running while you work, but good luck focusing when you see those acorns bounce, roll, and trigger satisfying combos across your custom-built forest.

title: The Second Sight: Dead Reckoning
description:
You’re an urban legend in a county full of them. When you were thirteen, you were found passed out in the road by one of the local cops. No missing persons report. No fingerprints on file. No memories. Just a name.

Oh, and some bizarre psychic powers.

You're content with simplicity. You like your isolated cabin and helping Carter track down missing persons. You know that in theory there are more people like you out there, but you've never wanted to look behind the curtain to find out.

However, with the disappearance of a local teen named Casey Powell and a recent attempt on your foster father's life, your serene, isolated life comes abruptly to its end and a new chapter begins.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD Randomizer
description: Randomizer mod for the Nintendo Switch remaster of Skyward Sword.

title: Project Landsword
description:
The once peaceful surface of Mars has decayed into a violent battleground between arms corporations and Earthly governments.
To join the fight would be crazy. To survive would be downright psychotic.

Landsword is a top-down mecha shooter with a heavy emphasis on destruction and gameplay that combines elements from classic shoot em' ups with contemporary action-stealth games.

Featuring fully destructible environments, players must use their wits and surroundings to outsmart and defeat enemies in combat, while still retaining an arcade feeling to its gameplay.

title: Il Fiore di Moretti
description: You are a renowned chef who accepts a job at "Il Fiore di Moretti," an Italian restaurant preparing for its grand reopening. Your task is to cook and ensure that customers return for your delicious food. However, you start to notice that strange things are happening in the restaurant. They are subtle, almost imperceptible, but enough to make you realize that something is very wrong...

title: A Tale of Body Limbs
description:
This is an historical experience based on the real life and death of Mary and Percy Shelley.

Through fragments and scattered remains, the player pieces together a story of love, death, and creation.

title: Be Brave, Barb
description: Barb the cactus has lost her positive affirmations! How will she get through the day? How will she face her fears? How will she defeat King Cloudy and his evil henchmen? I have no idea. Maybe you should play this gravity-bending platforming adventure right now and find out?

title: Project Hailstorm
description: A short story where you enter the shoes of a researcher sent to uncover the mysteries of a project abandoned deep within the Antarctic circle.

title: B.B. Rider
description: 1200 years ago, a man named Siegfried single-handedly annihilated the entire demon race. What was the reason this man, hailed as a hero, continued to fight…?

title: Storebound
description: A 1-3 co-op horror game. Play as ordinary shoppers trapped in an accursed megastore. Find the exit together at all costs before the employees catch you.

title: The Lost Sanatorium
description: You are a famous researcher, and you found out that in a very popular sanatorium that thousands of people visit, an accident happened where nobody knows what really happened. Many people say that it was a fire or something. The sanatorium has been abandoned for almost a year, but you want to find out what actually happened. So you go to the mountains and try to find out. Finally, you reach the sanatorium, which is very far from any communication/internet. You experience a lot in your visit, but then suddenly...

title: Pickle Theory
description: The proverb of the pickle - If you put a fresh cucumber in a jar of pickles, it will soon become salty too.

title: ViCrew
description: A tactical RPG with turn-based combat in which you build a crew of Vikings to go on glorious raids.

title: Elden Ring Nightreign: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition Includes:
• ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN
• Additional DLC
- Additional playable characters and bosses
• Digital Artbook & Mini Soundtrack

title: Elden Ring Nightreign: Collector's Edition
description:
Collector's Edition Includes:

ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN Base Game (Physical disc for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, physical STEAM voucher for STEAM) - ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN is a standalone adventure within the ELDEN RING universe, crafted to offer players a new gaming experience by reimagining the game’s core design.
Additional DLC* – Additional DLC that will be available after the release of the main game
Statue of Wylder - A perfect replica of the nomadic warrior, Wylder, a lone swordman in pursuit of the Night Lord. Crafted by Pure Arts. Size : 25cm
SteelBook - Premium metal case with a full-color illustration of Wylder. The perfect protection and display for your game disc
Nightfarer Cards - A set of eight high-quality tarot cards featuring detailed illustrations of the Nightfarers. These glossy, full color cards are the perfect way to predict your future in Limveld
Exclusive Hardcover Artbook - An exclusive 40-page artbook tracing the development of ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN through previously unseen concept art, sketches, and full color illustrations. Size: 24 x 21 cm Language: English
Digital Soundtrack Download Code - The unforgettable original soundtrack is included in this Collector’s Edition. Return to Limveld again and again with fully orchestrated tracks from ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN.
Collector’s Box - A beautiful case to store or display your statue and artbook.

title: Siegecaster
description: An active skill-based siege defense game. Prepare your aim and quickly assess the coming onslaught. Survive a large-scale assault on your home as you build outward to strengthen your arsenal. Engage epic hordes. Encircle powerful upgrade runes. Enhance your weapons. Siege the day.

title: Whispers of the Dead
description: A psychological horror game that blurs the lines between love, fear, and reality. The story begins with Eve Levine, a college student caught in a nightmare after being abducted on a rainy evening in the shadowy St. Peters Park. Her fiancé, Adam Hale, a poet haunted by his own creations, must confront the darkness that emerges from his mysterious writings.

title: TurboSquad
description: TurboSquad is a racing party game where you don't drive but sabotage the race! Use traps, weapons and sneaky tactics to outsmart your rivals. Play solo, online or locally in colorful tracks full of loops, jumps and surprises.

title: Zexion
description: Seek out new weapons and equipment to delve deeper into the dangerous world of Cypher-X72! Be warned, you aren't the only one seeking the forbidden technology known as Zexion! It will take cunning and valor to succeed in this action-packed sci-fi adventure!

title: Gas Station Simulator: Drive-In Cinema
description: Gas Station Simulator expands, as Route 66 calls for a drive-in cinema. You wouldn’t let such an opportunity slip through your fingers, would you? So, roll up your sleeves and get to work because time is the most valuable thing. Acquire some additional space, purchase much needed projector and screen, and invite your old as well as new clients to witness some of the best movies in the history of cinematography.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Blood & Gears
description:
"The past has a voice and its calling you home."

"You hoped you'd never have to return to this place of sorrow, but after 20 years, something has called you back."

Five Nights at Freddy's: Blood & Gears is a complete reimagining of Scott Cawthon's original *Five Nights at Freddy's* game. The game is directed by JDBRYANT and is created by Bloody Fungi, a passionate team of over 30 people.

title: UnControlled Shooter
description:
A Short Shoot 'em up about defeating the aliens with your uncontrollable space ship.

A Small game made in 72 hours for the Mini Jam 74: Chaos, with the limitation of only using the A, X, B, P, 8 button and the Space bar.

title: The Seabed's Shining Star
description: Under the hazy moon, a shrine maiden meets a star. A short visual novel of a two person conversation. Cup ramen recommended.

title: Disaster Arms: Impact Project B.A.H.N.
description: Disaster Arms is a 2D run-and-gun boss rush game. Shoot and punch your way through a ceaseless gauntlet of giant alien and robotic lifeforms.

title: Flesh Made Fear
description: Tank controls. Fixed cameras. Pure Terror. Set in a haunting world of twisted experiments and occult nightmares, this game brings back the survival horror mechanics you know and love while pushing the genre into terrifying new depths.

title: Trainatic
description: Trainatic is an explosive incremental train-building game! Upgrade your cars, gather resources, and unlock powerful synergies to chug further down the track.

title: Digimon Story: Time Stranger
description: The latest in the Digimon Story series is finally here! In this RPG, unravel a mystery that spans across the human world and the Digital World, collecting and raising a wide variety of Digimon to save the world.

title: Animahjong X
description:
The sequel to Animahjong V3. When the events of this game occur the playable protagonist in the first game is now close friends with the three mahjong playing sisters and has even begun dating the eldest, Yumika.

In this story, Rumi is kidnapped while walking home from school one day and the player must search for the clues that will reunite the family. Playing the role of the male protagonist or either of Rumi's older sisters, Yumika and Miyabi, you compete against several female mahjong players who have information on Rumi's whereabouts. As they get closer to finding Rumi, Yumika grows increasingly suspicious...

title: Zoominoes
description: Build the ultimate Zoo in this number-go-up roguelike deckbuilder. Find powerful mythical animals, boost them with snacks, and even manipulate the board itself. Break the game by scoring millions (and more) with insane combos.

title: Self Layout Shooter
description: Self Layout Shooter plays like your average Shoot'em Up...but there's a catch: Each round you have to place your own enemies.

title: Fudêncio e Seus Amigos: Jogo do Miolo-Mole!
description: Jogo do Miolo-Mole is a memory game with the main characters of Fudêncio e Seus Amigos which released exclusively through the first season DVD set. It can be played on a computer if you insert the DVD into the disk drive.

title: Undertale: Papyrus' Belief
description: A take on the Disbelief project owned by FlamesAtGames where the roles of Sans and Papyrus are reversed in the no mercy route!

title: Train Valley Origins
description: The cutest management game about trains. Choo-choo! Manage increasingly complex railroad. The rich history of railway transport awaits! From steam engines to futuristic marvels. Explore different eras and countries and witness the evolution of train technology.

title: Berry Berry Festival
description: A wholesome and heart-warming story game about a young girl who wants to become the Berry Berry Champion. Explore a small town and help the residents with odd jobs to prepare for the Berry Berry Festival!

title: Festered
description: Brave the terrors of a contaminated research facility, where every step could be your last. PSX style survival horror game.

title: Dave the Diver: Ichiban's Holiday
description: Dave the Diver: Ichiban's Holiday is a DLC that adds content themed around the Like a Dragon franchise.

title: Darwin's Paradox!
description: Dive into the adventure with Darwin, an octopus as endearing as he is ingenious, torn from the ocean and trapped in a vast and mysterious industrial complex. Harness his unique talents and abilities to help him overcome the many dangers and traps in this captivating platformer and adventure game.

title: Warriors: Abyss
description:
Take command of historic and masterful warriors by challenging countless swarms of enemies. Through victory and defeat, traverse the merciless trials of hell.

A new type of battles fought alongside combinations of 100 and more heroes.
There are 100 and more heroes for players to ally with, allowing them to combine the unique traits of multiple heroes and create their own powerful parties who will help them fight their way through the dead souls of Hell.

A new form of "Warriors" where heroes can be summoned to help eliminate enemies.
By summoning heroes, the player can engage in impressive battles where they daringly rout endless hordes of enemies. This feature will offer players a new form of exhilaration never before experienced in the "Warriors" series.

title: Lies of P: Overture
description: Lies of P: Overture is a story expansion for Lies of P that introduces new narrative developments, environments, enemies, and weapons. It builds on the core game's mechanics while expanding the dark reimagining of the Pinocchio tale with additional challenges and lore.

title: Dreams of Another
description: Dreams of Another is a third-person exploration-action game built around the philosophical theme, “No Creation Without Destruction.” Rather than destroying objects by shooting—as in traditional shooting games—here, your shots materialize and create the world. This unconventional mechanic offers a gameplay experience that challenges the norms of the genre and invites players into a whole new dimension.

title: Days Gone Remastered
description:
Ride into a desperate, dog-eat-dog world in the definitive Days Gone experience, remastered for the PlayStation5 console.

Fight to survive an environment ravaged by a deadly pandemic as former outlaw biker, Deacon St. John. Risk the threats of the Broken Road on the back of your trusty Drifter bike as you face terrifying hordes of relentless feral Freakers – as well as dangerous gangs of humans.

title: Stellar Blade x Goddess of Victory: Nikke
description: Worlds collide in an epic cross-over of heroic proportions in this add-on expansion for Stellar Blade featuring mini games, a new Boss showdown and unlockable cosmetics from mobile app GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE.

title: Armored Core
description: A port of Armored Core, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Armored Core: Project Phantasma
description: A port of Armored Core: Project Phantasma, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Armored Core: Master of Arena
description: A port of Armored Core: Master of Arena, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Patapon 3
description: Patapon 3 is a rhythm game for the PlayStation Portable now back on modern consoles.

title: Tides of Annihilation
description: Tides of Annihilation is a fantasy action-adventure inspired by Arthurian legend. Uncover the mystery of an otherworldly invasion in a shattered modern London, unleashing hordes of enemies. As Gwendolyn, fight alongside spectral knights to save your family and piece a broken world back together.

title: Borgo the Cat
description:
Play as Borgo, a rather *ROUND* cat! You can roll, jump, and turn your trusty camera to change your perspective of the world around you.

With five levels *plus a bonus one* this will only take around 5-10 minutes to complete, so if you don't have a lot of time this is perfect! Please, if there are any problems you are having, feel free to tell me.

title: Metal Eden
description:
An adrenaline-rush sci-fi FPS.
A HYPER UNIT ASKA is sent on a suicide mission to rescue citizens' COREs from MOEBIUS, an orbital city turned into a deadly trap. Dive into cybernetic warfare, face the ENGINEERS, and uncover the secrets of METAL EDEN.

title: Saros
description: Saros is an action game developed by Housemarque and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. Players control Arjun Devraj, a Soltari Enforcer investigating a lost off-world colony on Carcosa. The game features fast-paced third-person combat, boss encounters, and progression across repeated attempts.

title: Days Gone: Broken Road
description: Days Gone – Broken Road DLC is an expansion to Days Gone, an open-world action-adventure game set in a harsh wilderness two years after a devastating global pandemic. Days Gone – Broken Road DLC features all new content and features that will enhance your Days Gone experience as you fight for tomorrow in this brutal relentless world.

title: Vending Dokan!: Kozy Kiosk
description: Build a vending machine empire in this cozy idle sim! Manage staff, decorate locations, and watch your business thrive. Play actively or let it run passively in the background with relaxing music to enjoy while you work or unwind.

title: Luna's Cathouse
description: a nice fun cat clicker game with maps and more but right now in beta

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Enchanted Edition
description: Explore a magical world in Disney Dreamlight Valley alongside Disney and Pixar friends, and expand your journey to Eternity Isle and the Storybook Vale where more adventures await!

title: The Northern Path
description: Embark on an adventure through the vast northern wilderness, where survival depends on your skills and instincts. Experience story-rich exploration as you dredge through untamed lands, face below zero temperatures, and uncover mysteries hidden in the snow. A journey into the long dark awaits!

title: Phantomancer
description: Phantomancer is a deck-building roguelike where you summon phantoms to fight. Defeat the monsters threatening humanity and uncover the story of two sisters.

title: Haunted Streamer
description: Live-stream Japan’s most haunted ruins. Capture ghosts, grow your channel… and survive.

title: Aurora Flight
description: Aurora Flight is an air combat simulation on the uncharted planet Zenoa. Realistic altitude and speed physics provide strategic depth, while flexible fighter customization shapes your approach. Experience diverse aerial battles.

title: Rogue Gladius Survivors
description: Aim to be the fastest conqueror in the world with special moves and the strongest build! Rogue Gladius Survivors is an Isekai Musou SpeedRun survivors-like game.

title: Core Trials
description: Core Trials is a motion-based, pixel-art bullet hell you play using just your webcam. Move your body to control the core, protect it, and survive intense trials. Immerse yourself in high-octane action and uncover the true power of your core!

title: Red Panda is Hungry
description: Follow the journey of a gluttonous red panda that is willing to risk everything if it means more food. Walk, jump and slide through a bamboo forest full of traps and dangers until your reach the legendary all you can eat bamboo buffet.Re d

title: Frozen Gauntlet
description: Frozen Gauntlet is a unique platformer game where you play as Zen, an adventurer with a magical gauntlet that can freeze creatures, helping him find his way back home.

title: 3xtinction: Deluxe Edition
description: 3xtinction is an Online Co-op Top Down Shooter with tactical and strategic elements. After a series of experiments on spiders gone wrong, the world is devasted by an outbreak. You and your friend will have to cooperate in order to complete missions. Prepare yourself before every wave, buy weapons, ammos and set up turrets to stay alive. Each wave, the Infecteds are more and more numerous.

title: Age of Mythology: Retold - Premium Edition
description: Embark on a gaming journey of first-class offerings with the Age of Mythology: Retold Premium Edition. Curated to offer an elevated gaming experience at launch and beyond.

title: Ambulance Life: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
- Bay Side Expansion: A major expansion that adds many hours of content and new emergency situations.
- Fire Department Cosmetic Pack: Proudly display the colours of San Pelícano's fire department with exclusive cosmetic items for your ambulance, paramedic and medical equipment.
- Paramedic Handbook Dev’s Cut: Get a new version of the paramedic handbook enhanced with medical stories and development secrets.
- Additional Siren Pack: Drive around the streets of San Pelícano like never before with this pack of 5 additional sirens for your ambulance.

title: Astroneer: Glitchwalkers - Deluxe Edition
description: This bundle includes the ASTRONEER base game, Glitchwalkers DLC and Glitchwalkers Deluxe Cosmetic Pack.

title: Astroneer: Glitchwalkers Edition
description: This bundle includes the ASTRONEER base game and the Glitchwalkers DLC.

title: Boti: Byteland Overclocked - Deluxe Edition
description: The Boti: Byteland Overclocked experience + 4 add-on DLCs, soundtrack & artbook

title: Bright Side: Quiz - Complete Edition
description: Compete with family and friends to uncover the ultimate quiz champion!

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 - Vault Edition
description: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 is signature Black Ops across a cinematic single-player Campaign, a best-in-class Multiplayer experience and with the epic return of Round-Based Zombies.

title: City Transport Simulator: Tram - Collector's Edition
description: Become a tram driver, so hop into the cab for the ultimate tram driving experience! In addition to the five real-world trams included in the Standard and Deluxe editions (ULF B1, R2.2b, ULF A1, StadtRegioTram, and Type D Vienna), the Collector's edition also includes the E1 Vienna and the GT8N Mannheim

title: The King of Fighters XV: Ultimate Edition
description:
This is a special product that includes the main “THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV” game and each content.

[Product Contents]
- "THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV" Base game
- KOF XV Team Pass 1
- KOF XV Team Pass 2
- KOF XV Fighter Pass
- KOF XV DLC Character "MATURE" and "VICE"
- KOF XV DLC Costume "GAROU: MotW TERRY"
- KOF XV DLC Costume "CLASSIC LEONA"

title: The Riftbreaker: Complete Edition
description: The Riftbreaker Complete Edition contains the core game and all available addons.

title: The Stone of Madness: Special Edition
description:
Take a deep dive into the amazing art and music of The Stone of Madness with the Special Edition!

The Stone of Madness Special Edition includes:
- Digital Artbook

Both the Spooky Outfit Pack and Decades Outfit Pack will be available at launch of the base game.

SPOOKY OUTFIT PACK
Dial up the shivers and indulge your ghost-hunting, monster-wrangling passions with these outfits perfect for Halloween - or for witching hours all year round! This pack contains the Just Haunt It! coat and four indoor outfits: Maxidermy, Ragdoll Max, Max Ghoulfield, and Max O'Lantern.

DECADES OUTFIT PACK

Max Caulfield, photographer-in-residence at the prestigious Caledon University, discovers her closest new friend, Safi, dead in the snow.

Murdered.

To save her, Max tries to Rewind time - a power she's not used in years… instead, Max opens the way to a parallel timeline where Safi is still alive, and still in danger!

Max realizes the killer will soon strike again - in both versions of reality.

With her new power to Shift between two timelines - can Max solve and prevent the same murder?

Compete against other pilots in the iconic Reno and Red Bull Air Races. Enhanced physics and aircraft systems and a groundbreaking flight planner create an unparalleled simulation experience. Explore the most detailed digital twin of the world to date with real-time air and ship traffic and a vast array of animals. Set out on your global adventure with our largest fleet of aircraft as Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 takes simulation to new heights of authenticity and realism.

description: Pursue your aviation career throughout the world with dynamically-generated missions ranging from Medevac and Search & Rescue to Aerial Firefighting and Passenger Transport. description: Emotional, 3rd-person, story-driven, adventure game focused on solving puzzles and using stealth mechanics. Use your bow to interact with environmental elements. Sneak, climb or distract guards to move further unnoticed. Solve light puzzles alongside your path to rescue your loved one.

description: Emotional, 3rd-person, story-driven, adventure game focused on solving puzzles and using stealth mechanics. Use your bow to interact with environmental elements. description: Become a tram driver, so hop into the cab for the ultimate tram driving experience! In addition to the three real-world trams included in the Standard edition (ULF B1, R2.2b, or ULF A1), the Deluxe edition also includes the StadtRegioTram and the Type D Vienna! Get ready to hit the streets of Tramau.

title: Stick Frame
description: Stick Frame is a mini platformer/metroidvania game, where you navigate the world using weirds abilities you find along the way.

title: Wet
description: Play Wet, a calm puzzle game. Move land to guide water through 32 fun puzzles. Think smart and solve each task in a world of peace and ease. Simple to play, hard to master, and made to soothe your mind.

title: Bathhouse Creatures
description: Ready, set, bath! Build and manage your bathhouse for animals in this casual and cozy management game. Keep your bathtubs clean and filled, serve a cast of whimsical creatures, decorate your bathhouse with your hard-earned cash, and be the best bathhouse there can be!

title: Veloria: The Knot of Candles
description: Veloria: The Knot of Candle is a new type of role-playing game that integrates puzzles, level design, visual effects, and music. A girl wakes up from a nightmare to find herself in an orphanage that had long been burned down. Pushing open the charred door, the childhood nightmare strikes again.

title: The Daruma Challenge
description: A brutal bouncing challenge. No shortcuts, no mercy—just you vs. gravity. How far will you climb before it all comes crashing down?

title: Cow Chess
description: Cow Chess is a real-time artillery party game — think Super Smash Bros meets Worms. It features fluid, wall-sticking movement, punchy weapons, and fully destructible terrain. As the game progresses, you unlock upgrades that transform your abilities, pushing you to adjust your strategies on the fly.

title: Escape the Tower
description: Escape the Tower is a horror game where you must escape from a 600-meter-high radio tower within 10 minutes.

title: Trolls vs. Vikings: Reborn
description: Strategy meets mischief! Explore an amazing and lush fantasy world, where an epic battle between Trolls, Vikings and the Nordic Gods rages on. Get ready to don your tactical horns and dive into Trolls vs Vikings: Reborn where strategy is king, trolls reign supreme,and your sanity is the final boss!

title: Overwatch 2: Season 15 - Honor & Glory
description: Season 15 introduces Perks, Overwatch 2’s groundbreaking new gameplay feature that lets players unlock mid-match hero upgrades, transforming strategy and playstyle. With the launch of the 2025 Competitive Year, fresh rewards like Galactic Weapon Skins and exclusive charms await those who climb the ranks fighting for honor and glory. Plus, weekly challenges in the Perked Up event offer exciting treasures, including Rainy Day Mercy and Legendary Loot Boxes. Don’t miss out on Mythic Pixiu Zenyatta and more as Overwatch 2 takes bold steps into its most exciting season yet!

title: Trouble in Pacifica
description: Explore the Pacifica archipelago, different islands, secrets and villages await you...Earn money by fishing in a fishing mini-game. Hunt down the sea monster with your upgraded boat and save your home!

title: There's Nothing Underground
description: There's Nothing Underground is a roguelike puzzle adventure where you use random tools to solve levels in endless ways. Unlock and combine tools to tackle 100+ levels, each with unique challenges. Find creative solutions, uncover the asteroid's secrets, and survive!

title: A Night With: Succubus
description: An adult visual novel where your choices shape a night of temptation with a seductive succubus. Engage in dynamic dialogue, explore multiple paths, and immerse yourself in a captivating story of supernatural romance and desire.

title: Astro Bot: Vicious Void
description:
This free update features harder levels to test your jumping skills. Each level comes with a brand-new Special Bot to rescue and, once that’s done, can be replayed in Time Attack mode with online rankings. It has weekly release schedule:

- Feb 13: Tick-Tock Shock
- Feb 20: Thrust or Bust
- Feb 27: Cock-A-Doodle-Doom
- Mar 6: Hard to Bear
- Mar 13: Armored Hardcore

title: A Night With: Emily
description: After your college friend send you a intimate photo, she would do everything she can so you delete the image.

title: Piss Off
description: Control creatures with gross abilities and compete in absurd frantic battles in this action platformer game. Piss, spit, shit and make your friends taste every fluid you can get on them before they do the same to you. Try not to lose your hair and skin to the corrosive fluids of the other creatures and watch out for the aliens!

title: Cowgirl Trainer
description: Cowgirl Trainer is a JRPG dating sim. Fight bandits and monsters, collect bounties, and romance a sexy cowgirl as you explore the town of Tombwood and its surrounding areas. Level up, spec your characters, pass persuasion checks, and more as you strive to take down the Black Cactus Gang.

title: Seeker of the Ruins
description: As a fearless dwarf delver, navigate interesting underground labyrinths & ruins, uncover hidden treasures, solve riddles and hide from monsters. Use various items and potions to survive and outsmart environmental hazards in this immersive non-combat adventure. Delve into the unknown and reclaim lost treasures!

title: Assassin's Shadows
description: Assassin's Shadows is a game where you play as legendary shinobi taking on an apprentice, a young samurai woman, Aira, from a fallen clan that wishes to learn from you and avenge her clan through becoming a legendary shinobi herself.

title: Lezdom CEO Fantasy
description: After an accident, a dissatisfied CEO is reincarnated in another world. Summoned by a fairy of a dying company, she is asked to use her skills to save the company. Will her skills translate in this strange fantasy world? And more importantly, can she sate her lezdom desires?​

title: Hell is Us: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition of Hell is Us includes:
- The Hollow Walker Pack, featuring an exclusive skin for Remi and his drone KAPI
- The Military Pack, featuring an exclusive skin for Remi and his drone KAPI

title: Warm Monkey
description: Warm Monkey is an Action/Platformer video game in isometric 3D landscape. In a modern architectural and exotic city, a monkey multiplies and its need for water increases. He must reach the seashore.

title: Castle of Shikigami 3
description: ・A culmination of character shooting games set in a unique worldview! ・A wide variety of newly added playable characters and attack methods, as well as a 2P scenario that is different from 1P play. ・Features a high-tension MAX system that will satisfy your insatiable passion for shooting games!

title: Ridiculous Shipping
description: Ridiculous Shipping is a strategy simulation game about running a chaotic sea port. Take charge of unique ports around the world, unload ships, and get every container to its destination using cranes, drones, trucks, and ridiculous buildings like shark-filled aquariums.

title: Trolling Bowling
description: A wild & fun multiplayer party game bowling simulator to compete with your friends, where it’s troll or be trolled. Sabotage your friends with trolling powers like concrete pins, oil spills, windmills, and more! Upgrade your bowling ball. Bowl to score points, collect rings, and send pins flying!

title: Chaos Machina
description: A fast-paced action RPG dungeon crawler with roguelike elements. Shoot, run, dodge, and upgrade your abilities to defeat enemies before Chaos consumes the level.

title: Holo8
description: Escape from the looping office. Observe the office carefully and look for any anomaly to reach the main entrance.

title: Night at Grandma's
description: A single-player experience where your grandma got possessed by a demon. Search her house to find torn pages from an ancient book and items needed to free your grandmother’s soul from a sinister force. P.S. Remember, demons don’t like salt.

title: Hyakki Yako Survivor
description: Follow the wind and destroy all the cursed torii gates. Deploy your fellows and form a formation to fight off the onslaught of enemies. Control many fierce warriors and challenge the "Hyakki Yako".

title: Midnight Transmission
description: Midnight Transmission is a collaborative Yume Nikki fangame. In this game you take control of Toby as he explores the weird and surreal worlds inside his dreams.

title: Bazar Simulator: The Wan Story
description: Bazaar Simulator takes you to Boqueron City, where you will help Wan manage his uncle Wang Long's bazaar while uncovering dark secrets. Customize your store, drive scooters, work with mafias and unravel a plot full of humor, mystery and action in this unique simulator.

title: Outlawed
description: Outlawed is a crime-themed PvPvE first-person extraction shooter, set in a modern city overrun by gangs. Enter solo or with a squad to challenge powerful enemies and search for riches, and use everything at your disposal to make it out alive.

title: Snail
description:
Snail is a Kafkian story, where you find an absurd and fun world, full of color, objects without any logic and characters who, without a single word, will show you true feelings.

You will find a city full of surprises, details and references. You will feel like you are inside the city thanks to its careful setting, both visually and aurally.

This new reality is full of long things, rather, excessively long... Useless in some cases, in others curious, but always appealing to humor.

title: Street Gang Football
description: A streetwise football simulator where the teams are tough and the rules don't apply

title: Undercraft
description: Undercraft is a turn-based, roguelike auto-battle card game where you'll have the option to choose between game levels, participate in single-player free-for-all or one-on-one multiplayer battles, unlock characters, explore classes, explore history, view new seasons, and more.

title: Mowzie's Mobs
description: Mowzie's Mobs adds a variety of fictional creatures to Minecraft, priding itself in unique AI, rich atmosphere, and fluid animations. Prove your might against new bosses and enemies and claim their magical abilities as your own.

title: Abyss Unchained
description: Upcoming indie 3D Metroidvania/Platformer game where you wield a heavy weight to traverse a labyrinthine mansion.

title: Victorian Deathbed Simulator
description:
Three beloved (though distant) relatives will visit, intending to pay their final respects. Choose wisely! One of them will be the beneficiary of your Enormous Fortune...

This conversation based point and click game has 12 possible endings, and playthroughs are randomized for your continued amusement. The game was influenced and inspired by works such as Lemony Snicket's "Series of Unfortunate Events," Terry Pratchett's "Discworld," and the Humongous Entertainment games.

title: Fear Me: The Silent
description:
A small adventure of horror, mystery, hope and quirkiness.

Will you be able to save your family?

Will you be able to control your visions?

Who will you be at the end of it all?

title: Bachelairs
description: Race through a set of short dungeons, trying to collect the most treasures. The player that has the most coins at the end wins the game! Will you horde your coins? Invest in stronger gear? Or perhaps try to win extra gold with one of the awards? Face off against friends or play against the computer!

title: Doggos in Dungeon
description: Reclaim your dungeon through tactical combat in this dungeon crawling adventure to become the best Doggo.

title: Ink Reverie
description: Ink Reverie is a casual city-building game set in a fictional historical era with art inspired by the Tang and Song dynasties. As a diligent manager, you'll guide hardworking villagers to transform a remote village into a prosperous home through exploration, construction, production, and trade.

title: Grex
description: Play as a Swarm in GREX, a fast-paced incremental auto-shooter. Our body is our weapon. We die to evolve. We evolve to become The Monolith. WE ARE ONE. WE INVADE. THEY DIE.

title: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
description: Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a retro action-adventure game where you fight, collect new items, and upgrade your character as you make your way through bustling nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts.

title: TDS Legacy
description:
TDS Legacy is a classic 2D MMORPG developed in Argentina. It is an open-source game inspired by Ultima Online, featuring a medieval fantasy world where players can explore, fight monsters, complete quests, and engage in PvP combat. The game allows players to choose from different races (such as humans, elves, and dwarves) and professions (warrior, mage, thief, among others).

One of its most distinctive features is its hardcore PvP system, where players can attack and loot others freely, making survival a challenge. The game also includes guild wars, magic spells, and crafting mechanics. Over the years, various community-driven servers have emerged, each with unique modifications and custom content. Despite its simple graphics and retro gameplay, Argentum Online has maintained a dedicated player base for decades.

title: Neon Hearts City
description: A private investigator, tracking a missing person, uncovers a conspiracy between humans and androids and a secret that could change everything. Neon Hearts City is a retro point-and-click adventure that thrusts you into a grungy cyberpunk city of the future.

title: Wild Growth
description: A short, action-packed incremental healer game set in a grim norse world.

title: A la Card
description: Buckle up for a roguelike deckbuilder boiling over with card mutation mischief and limitless synergies. It's a food-truck-themed deckbuilding roguelike all about bending the rules and letting the player get weird with absurd synergies.

title: The Grappler
description: Grapple or Fall. Inspired by brutally challenging platformers like Jump King and Getting Over It, this 2D adventure will push you to your limits, one frustratingly rewarding grapple at a time.

title: Patient 001
description: An FPS psychological survival horror game where you must escape from an asylum. Manage your inventory wisely, find procedurally placed items and clues, solve puzzles, and defeat the boss who trapped you inside the asylum.
