title: UFL: Foundation
description: Do you want to enter the game fully prepared? Pre-order the UFL Foundation pack now and be the first on the pitch!

title: UFL: Ultimate UFL club
description: Do you want to enter the game fully prepared? Pre-order the Ultimate UFL club pack now and be the first on the pitch!

title: UFL: Club
description: Do you want to enter the game fully prepared? Pre-order the UFL club pack now and be the first on the pitch!

title: Train Sim World 5: Avanti West Coast BR Class 390 Pendolino EMU
description: Tilt your way in and out of the capital on the busiest services in the UK. The Class 390 Pendolino swings into action with Train Sim World 5, sporting the teal and tango tones of Avanti West Coast, and racing along the thrilling West Coast Main Line!

title: Train Sim World 5: Bahnstrecke Salzburg - Rosenheim
description: Go cross-border and shuttle along the rural, hilly backdrops of Europe in Train Sim World 4. Take a trip back to the early 2010s and climb aboard the classic electric BR 111 - tap into Deutsche Bahn regional services between Germany and Austria with Bahnstrecke Salzburg - Rosenheim!

title: Train Sim World 5: Great Western Express
description: Train Sim World 2: Great Western Express brings to life the experience of driving high speed and commuter passenger trains on one of Britain's busiest railways. Take control of the iconic Great Western Railways HST and command it to 125mph along the Great Western Main Line out of London's Paddington Main Line Station.

title: Train Sim World 5: Brighton Main Line: London Victoria - Brighton
description: Experience one of Britain's busiest main lines, from the nation's Capital to England's oldest coastal destination, via the international hub of Gatwick Airport. Whether Southern commuter or Gatwick Express, a flurry of passengers await in Train Sim World 2: London Commuter.

title: Train Sim World 5: London Overground Suffragette line - Gospel Oak - Barking Riverside
description: An Aventra Adventure awaits in Train Sim World 4! Discover North & East London boroughs aboard modern traction, traversing a newly electrified and extended line fit for future service. Become something of a driver yourself on the Suffragette line: Gospel Oak - Barking Riverside!

title: Train Sim World 5: MBTA Commuter - Boston - Worcester
description: Take charge of passenger traffic in dashing MBTA Purple and run through the commuter suburbs of Central Massachusetts. Operate the sleek HSP46 on the bustling rails out of Boston South and out onto the busy Framingham/Worcester Line in Train Sim World 5!

title: Train Sim World 5: Sherman Hill - Cheyenne - Laramie
description: All the grandeur of big-time, modern American freight railroading comes together on Union Pacific's legendary Sherman Hill for Train Sim World 3! Climb aboard the and potent SD70ACe and veteran SD40-2 diesel locomotives to forward tonnage between Cheyenne and Laramie, now with volumetric skies!

title: Train Sim World 5: Semmeringbahn - Wiener Neustadt - Mürzzuschlag
description: Explore the World's first true mountain railway in Train Sim World 4! Drive trains at altitude through the rocky, forested peaks of the Austrian Alps. Climb the Semmering Pass before hastening downgrade towards historic Wiener Neustadt. Control iconic ÖBB traction on your Semmeringbahn adventure!

title: Train Sim World 5: Schnellfahrstrecke Köln-Aachen
description: Experience the thrill of high-speed inter-city German rail as you push the throttle through bustling German Metropolis and the rolling open countryside in the exquisite Train Sim World 2: Schnellfahrstrecke Köln - Aachen.

title: Train Sim World 5: NEC - New York - Trenton
description: Experience the City that never sleeps. From the Big Apple to New Jersey suburbs, non-stop action awaits aboard premier electric traction. Serve the East Coast well with NJ TRANSIT and Amtrak passenger equipment, brought to life in Train Sim World 3: Northeast Corridor: New York - Trenton.

title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Hands
description: A distant cousin to the Slaughter Family, "Hands" pushes 7 feet tall and weighs nearly 350 pounds. He's massive, extremely powerful, and can kill you with his bare hands in a matter of minutes. He also has the ability to place electro traps on key objectives, electrocuting any Victims that try to bypass the area. He's a lethal combination of strength and strategy!

title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Maria
description: Maria's disappearance sent shockwaves across central Texas. With little evidence to prove otherwise, many in the surrounding communities started to fear the worst. But deep within the bowels of the Slaughter family's property, Maria was alive, struggling and fighting like hell for survival. However, she soon realized there was something strange occurring. For reasons unknown to her, she was actually being kept alive. It seemed that Grandpa had an affinity towards her, perhaps some type of past connection? Maria wasn't sure why, but she planned to use this vulnerability against the family and escape the nightmare once and for all!

title: The Finals: Metro Drifter Set
description: The Metro Drifter Set bundle includes: - 1 Legendary Outfit - 1 Legendary Weapon Skins - 1 Legendary Sticker - 1 Epic Emote - 1 Epic Charm - 2 400 Multibucks

title: Outbreak: Sinister Investigations Collection
description: A terrible night to be trapped in Cypress Ridge…

title: Train Sim World 4: Cathcart Circle Line - Glasgow - Newton & Neilston
description: Experience the hustle and bustle of a modern suburban network using classic electric traction, link Glasgow's suburbs along the Cathcart Circle Line. Now fully remastered as part of a free update, take in the all-new detail in Train Sim World 4!

title: Train Sim World 4: Clinchfield Railroad - Elkhorn - Dante
description: Experience classic railroading moving heavy coal and manifest freight through the heart of Virginia's coalfields with Train Sim World 2: Clinchfield Railroad. It's your job to take charge of freight services through the rugged Appalachians, utilising the EMD F7 and SD40 diesel locomotives.

title: Train Sim World 4: Peninsula Corridor - San Francisco - San Jose
description: California Dreamin' with the Peninsula Corridor. In serving San Francisco and California's 'Silicon Valley', commuter railroad Caltrain calls at 26 stations and, equipped with Caltrain's F40PH-2CAT diesels and Gallery equipment, it will be your job to keep thousands of daily commuters on time!

title: Train Sim World 4: Spirit of Steam - Liverpool Lime Street - Crewe
description: Step back in time and discover the soot and sounds of the romantic steam era; climb aboard iconic living locomotives hungry for coal and water, and work hard on busy passenger and freight services through historic Merseyside and Cheshire with Train Sim World 3: Spirit of Steam: Liverpool - Crewe!

title: MechWarrior 5: Clans - Digital Collectors Content
description: MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS Digital Collectors Content Includes a Digital Art Book, the full Soundtrack, an Omnimech Technical Readout. Plus exclusive in-game content Platinum Mech Patterns and Timber Wolf WAR Omnimech with unique weapon loadout and skin.

title: MechWarrior 5: Clans - Invasion Mech Patterns
description: MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS Invasion Mech patterns. Unlock the Invasion Mech Patterns for 16 Clan Omnimechs. Customize your mechs with these unique designs and stand out on the battlefield.

title: MasterChef: Learn to Cook! - Christmas Special
description: Christmas is here! Roll up your sleeves and cook up a holiday feast worthy of a number one chef!

title: One Girl's Trash
description: Maggie is a simple girl. She doesn't want any trouble, nor does she start any trouble. But sometimes trouble finds you despite your best attempts to avoid it. When Maggie's trash goes missing, she does whatever she can to ensure she gets it back.

title: The SaGa of a Lone Man
description: A tale of adventure centered around a lone man who has lost his memories, unfolding alongside the companions he meets on his journey. An HD-2D-style fantasy RPG featuring a 3D world and 2D characters. The game employs a simple command-based battle system.

title: Star Breaker
description: Star Breaker is a fairly traditional Japanese RPG, with top-down view, world map navigation, random turn-based battles, and all the other usual ingredients. Battles can be set on Auto for quicker pacing. Since the setting of the game is a mixture of sci-fi and medieval fantasy, character use a variety of weapons from swords to guns, as well as special psychic attacks. There are also some space ship combat in the game, and it is possible to upgrade the player's ship later on.

title: The Willowmist Emporium of Antiques & Curiosities
description: A cozy narrative shop sim where you move to the sleepy town of Willowmist to run your aunt’s antique store. Meet 5 charming love interests and quirky locals—each with secrets to uncover—in a town where nothing is quite as it seems. Buy, sell, and haggle to keep the store afloat!

title: Sixtar Gate: Stargazer
description: Sixtar Gate: STARGAZER is the exciting spinoff to the beloved rhythm game Sixtar Gate: Startrail. Play reimagined band-style versions of original tracks, explore a new story in Adventure Mode, and enjoy intuitive 4-lane rhythm gameplay perfect for beginners and veterans alike.

title: Deus Ex: Lay D Denton Project
Defense of Fort Burton
description:
Defense of Fort Burton is a top-down action RPG that fuses intense hero combat with strategic tower defense. Rebuild a besieged fortress, master legendary heroes, and face waves of corrupted creatures in heroic battles for survival.

This is a single player gameplay with blend of action and strategy. Defeat the series of various enemies, each enemies bring different character and ways to defeat them. Fight against unique bosses through at the climax situation.

title: Better Mart Simulator
description: Create and expand your dream supermarket. Manage your aisles, inventory, machines, cleaning, deliveries, and staff. Welcome your customers and decorate every corner. Play solo or with up to 6 players and transform a small shop into a retail empire!

title: Margaret's Sin
description: Margaret is a pious, humble woman who’s been left alone after a brief marriage. She’s had rules hammered into her for too long to easily discard her inhibitions and preconceptions, but deep inside, she’s very curious about a world she’s never explored before — the world of orgasms and good sex.

title: Tavern Owner Simulator
description: Design. Serve. Expand. Become the ultimate tavern owner.

title: ZigZag Ball
description: ZigZag Ball is an endless casual game, switch sides to move forward in the world and do your best to stay on the right track and not fall, and collect diamonds.

title: Into Death and Beyond
description: Into Death and Beyond is a gripping first-person survival horror game set on the hostile planet XB32-ENT. As bounty hunter Mark Helkins, scavenge for resources, solve puzzles, and confront terrifying mutants. Unravel dark secrets and capture a rogue alien before it hunts you down. Will you survive?

title: Spot The Difference: Sports
description: Introducing Spot The Difference Sports, brought to you by the original creators of the globally renowned Spot The Difference amusement machine game.

title: Dropship: United Peace Force
description:
Dropship is an action game set in the year 2050. Terrorist attacks have increased severely, which is why big nations of the world decided to form the UPF, "United Peace Force", replacing the UN and NATO. It is an anti-terror army, operating world-wide.

But there is another globally operating group: A massively militarised drug syndicate. When an attack on a peace convoy in Columbia is linked to this cartel, the UPF starts investigation. A central base and training camp of the drug cartel is believed to be located somewhere in Libya. The UPF opens up a base in this country and starts looking for the criminals.

The player is a recently recruited soldier and pilot of the UPF. During the campaign, which lasts for 20 rather long missions, he can travel and fight on foot, in tanks and various other ground vehicles, but most of the time he will be piloting a dropship, either of the attack, defender or transport class. Dropships can operate in hover and flight mode, and carry a large amount of weapons and cargo.

title: Rabbit Raid
description: Save your family by going on an adventure as a cute bunny.

title: Memory Holder: The Colors
description: A peaceful memory game depicting specific and abstract color patterns.

title: Spin Around
description: Spin around and bring on the chaos!

title: Galagi Shooter Ultimate Blast
description: A fast-paced arcade space shooter with epic battles, stunning visuals, and intense boss fights!

title: Dating Stories
description: Dating Stories combines the fun of solving jigsaw puzzles with the spicy excitement of romantic interactions with the sexiest women you can imagine. Piece together well-drawn images of your accidental dates to unlock seductive conversations and deepen your connections. Every choice you make in dialogues shapes your relationships, leading to a tempting ending. With gorgeous artwork and steamy, suggestive content, Dating Stories gives an experience for those seeking both charm and challenge.

title: There's a Gun in the Office
description: You've been kidnapped and have to get out but luckily, there's a gun in the office. Unluckily, your captor comes back home every day, so you have to cover your tracks when you go out of your cell.

title: Fight Ascension
description: Survive the onslaught of endless waves of humanoid monsters in melee combat with manual mechanics. Defend, dodge, and counterattack as a warrior named Sentinel Ignis, who can manipulate fire to face his adversaries.

title: Wheel of Words: Crossword
description: "Wheel of Words: Crossword" is a delightful word puzzle game designed to test your vocabulary and problem-solving skills. Connect letters to form words that fit into crossword puzzles, uncover hidden bonus words, and enjoy the rewarding feeling of completing each grid.

title: Re:Mobilize Jam 2: Re:Visions
description: A set of 6 maps, plus a start map, created for a map jam event held from January 1, 2025 to February 8, 2025, using the Re:Mobilize mod. The objective of this jam was to re:imagine multiplayer maps from different games as single player experiences, all while making use of the three Re:Mobilize mechanics (trampolines, wiremeshes, and lighthooks/lightpanels).

title: ReSpaced
description: A fast-paced first-person shooter where you master gun recoil to leap across platforms, battle various enemies, and upgrade your weapon to escape an overrun space station.

title: Sacrilege
description: Sacrilege evokes the feels of Quake: Mission Packs 1 and 2 and is a new fork of the Re:Mobilize and Progs Dump 3 mods. It comes with additional monsters, weapons and powerups. This is a set of 3 episodes of 5 maps each - plus one secret map per episode - as well as a start map and an end map. This makes use of Re:Mobilize mechanics such as wiremeshes and lighthooks/lightpanels.

title: Hillbilly Hellfire
description: Defend a holy relic in this third-person tower defense repelling waves of hellspawn using divine intervention and a bit of hillbilly ingenuity. Charge headfirst into fierce battles, outsmarting twisted foes with quick decisions, explosive turrets, and precision gunplay as you claim victory!

title: Holiday Eye Spy
description: Get ready for a magical journey filled with festive cheer in Holiday Eye Spy, the ultimate spot-the-difference game designed to bring joy, challenge, and holiday spirit to players of all ages! Step into a cozy winter wonderland, where each pair of beautiful, hand-drawn images hides subtle differences waiting to be discovered. Can you find them all before time runs out?

title: Architekt
description: Architekt is a compilation of 8 limit-removing maps for Doom II made by the French Doom Community during a special speedmapping event led by Astelan and Gromat! This event, which took place on the Discord of a Doomer called “Panzy”, brought together 8 mappers of vastly different skills with the main goals being castle themed and a cyberdemon must be your best friend.

title: Forgotten Psychedelics
description: Doomer Boards Project #70 is a set of 12 brand new Doom 2 levels for limit removing source ports. The host of the project was @JadingTsunami. The theme was 'the groovy vibes of 70s: brutalism, trippy art, wood paneling, shag carpets, and soft glowing computer lights'.

title: eFootball: Leo Messi Edition 2025 - Deluxe
description:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

The Leo Messi Edition 2025 - Deluxe comes with the free-to-play eFootball core game, an Epic "Lionel Messi (2005–06 FC Barcelona)" player card, 10 Highlight player cards, 22 Training Program experience tokens, a custom Messi uniform, and 450 eFootball Coins as a purchase bonus

title: eFootball: Leo Messi Edition 2025
description:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

The Leo Messi Edition 2025 comes with the free-to-play eFootball core game, an Epic "Lionel Messi (2005–06 FC Barcelona)" player card, 7 Highlight player cards, 11 Training Program experience tokens, and 250 eFootball Coins as a purchase bonus.

title: eFootball: Neymar Jr Edition 2025 - Deluxe
description:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

The Neymar Jr Edition 2025 - Deluxe comes with the free-to-play eFootball core game, an Epic "Lionel Messi (2005–06 FC Barcelona)" player card, 10 Highlight player cards, 22 Training Program experience tokens, a Neymar Jr Edition 2025 uniform, and 450 eFootball Coins as a purchase bonus.

title: eFootball: Neymar Jr Edition 2025
description:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

The Neymar Jr Edition 2025 comes with the free-to-play eFootball core game, an Epic "Neymar Jr (2014 Brazil)" player card, 7 Highlight player cards, 11 Training Program experience tokens, and 250 eFootball Coins as a purchase bonus.

title: Tower Deckfense
description: Tower Deckfense is an exciting blend of tower defense and deck building. Build your deck strategically, upgrade your towers, and equip them with powerful modifiers to discover the best combinations and devastate your enemies.

title: Spring Tales
description: Spring Tales is a cozy 2D puzzle adventure game. Help the charming residents of Blossomdale prepare for their spring festival by solving puzzles, overcoming challenges, and rebuilding after a storm. Experience a heartwarming story filled with friendship, hope, and community spirit.

title: Nightborn
description:
Nightborn is an Action RPG with narrative-focused gameplay set in a dark gothic version of our own world.
Players assume the role of the Bloodhound, a Vampire detective trained in tracking supernatural threats to the Nightborn, using arcane rituals forbidden to others of your kind.
Investigate a series of disappearances of your fellow Vampires, including your Maker, a politically influential member of the Nightborn, the Vampire elite of New Orleans.

Create your own Bloodhound character, choosing from 10 iconic Vampire lineages with a set of signature lineage power skill trees.

Lineage powers include physical prowess enhancements, shapeshifting, controlling the minds of mortals, and acts of eldritch sorcery.

Fuel Vampire powers by preying upon mortals via stealth, seduction, or brute force.

Elude Mortal Law Enforcement and Monster Hunters, masking your dark nature.

Solve the mysteries of gothic New Orleans by taking quests, discovering clues, and exploring the supernatural underworld.

Battle, evade, or outwit, natural and supernatural foes, using your powers, weapons, and tactics.

Side with a Nightborn faction, the ruling Establishment, the reckless Libertines, or the fanatical Orthodoxy; or eschew them all to forge your own path.

title: Fortnite: Chapter 6 - Season 2: Lawless
description: Ransack Fletcher Kane’s banks, pull off a train heist and make an explosive getaway in Battle Royale Chapter 6 Season 2: LAWLESS.

title: Honey Dress Up
description: 'Honey Dress Up' is a simple dress up game, but with a cute boy!

title: The Fairly OddParents: Breakin' da Rules
description:
PC Version of "The Fairly OddParents: Breakin' da Rules"

The PC version features a different plot. In this version, Juandissimo Magnifico tricks Timmy into wishing the book destroyed so that Cosmo and Wanda will get in trouble for it. It also notably features an appearance by Vicky and Tootie's mother (at Timmy's age, as the level featuring her is set in the past), named Nicky. She is shown behaving a lot like Tootie, and Timmy initially mistakes her for Tootie when he first sees her, although the in-game graphics depict her as resembling a young Vicky.

title: Drop 4
description: A Classic Game with a twist, where you must get 4 in a row by removing chips and using special chips like bombs and ice tokens to beat your opponent.

title: Dying Sun
description: Dying Sun is a cozy surfing game in which you play as Hurabi, a young nomad on a solar-powered sailboard, searching for the mysterious causes of the extinction of an ancient, highly advanced civilization. On her journey, she travels through grandiose landscapes where nature and technology meet.

title: Poltergeist Prodigy
description:
Poltergeist Prodigy is a single-player, story-focused, puzzle action-adventure game, a first person haunter where you delight in being a mischievous ghost.

You are a new ghost, and to continue existing and uncover how you died you must haunt the living. With guidance from a comedic, more experienced ghost, you will learn to haunt people and animals with a variety of techniques in a range of places. By throwing objects around, conjuring scary aspects, possessing people, and ultilising many more haunting abilities, you will scare your way to becoming a more powerful spirit and trigger memories of how you died and the mysterious circumstances behind it.

title: Project Float
description: Join Buddy on his adventure to take down BluCo Science and save his town from the robot attack. Project Float is a puzzle based platformer with several RPG elements. You play as the child hero who stumbles upon an abandoned sphere who encourages him to help him defeat the robot overlord secretly in charge of this island. On your adventure you find several other robotic spheres who each give you, the player, a unique ability that will help you pass through obstacles.

title: Sonic GML
description: A fan‑made 2D Sonic the Hedgehog game created in GameMaker: Studio using GameMaker Language (GML). Released in 2015 by independent developer ZykovEddy, it recreates the look and feel of the classic Mega Drive/Genesis Sonic titles while introducing original level layouts, custom sprites, and unique gimmicks. Distributed freely online for Windows PC, it is not affiliated with or endorsed by SEGA.

title: Citizen Kane 64
description: The Citizen Kane of Gaming

title: Hyper Mega 256-in-1
description: Solve the mystery of this bootleg multicart adventure!

title: 60 Second History
description: 60 Second History is a game where you play a series of minigames to create your own messed up timeline. History changes depending on how you play the game, from little cosmetic details to entire separate branches of history with their own unique minigames. After six ten-second minigames, you'll be shown an ending that tells you what your version of the future is like.

title: Necros no Yousai
description: Coming from a promotional Candy Toy Made by Lotte Group, Necros no Yōsai is a JRPG set in an anime / manga, fantasy, turn-based with licensed title themes.

title: John Elway in Space
description: A short football platformer that's OUT OF THIS WORLD!

title: Darkest Days
description: Action, Adventure, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play

title: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Donald J. Trump
description: Donald Trump signs the executive order to change the Gulf of Mexico to Gulf of America. Boyfriend is not happy about this, so he breaks into the oval office and demands that Trump change back the name. However, to change the name back, Boyfriend has to beat Trump in a rap battle.

title: Super Monkey Ball: Banana Rumble - Dole Logo Sticker Ball
Monster Jam Showdown: Yeti
description:
If you suddenly feel a chill, don't blame the window or a new ice age. It could simply be Yeti, ready to get back on track on Monster Jam Showdown. But don't worry skiers and hikers, the only ones this abominable snow truck will take on, are its opponents.

This DLC includes:

Yeti with 2 liveries

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Additional Character: Versusia
description:
Set Contents:
• Playable Character: Versusia
• Premium Avatar: Versusia
• Badge: Versusia
• Figure Studio poses 1–6 and expressions 1–6 for Versusia
• Bonus item for Granblue Fantasy (original mobile game)

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Additional Character: Vikala
description:

• Badge: Vikala

• Figure Studio poses 1–3 for Dormouse
• Bonus item for Granblue Fantasy (original mobile game)

title: CanvasCraft
description:
Fun and addictive puzzle game! Mix and Match Colors! Infinite Gameplay!

ARCADE MODE:
Race against the time to match your canvas with an automatically generated one. Complete the canvas as fast as you can to earn more points!

PRACTICE MODE:
Play casually and take all the time you need when mixing and matching your colors on your canvas.

title: Immortum
description: Immortum is a Psychological Sci-Fi horror inspired by classic horror. Trapped aboard a decaying spaceship, you must escape mind-bending traps and uncover an impossible truth - as Romi, a mother desperate to find her dying child. Can you discover the answers before your existence is erased?

title: Castillon
description:
Defend your Kingdom

As a renoun wizard you lay claim to a new land and build your castle! But beware, for demon invaders roam the wilds. Grow your kingdom during the day then fight off waves of enemies at night!

Castillon is a bite sized strategy game about building and defending your growing castle realm.

title: Detective Frizbee
description: Welcome to "Detective Frizbee". It’s an open-world RPG with a detective twist. In this game, you play as Frizbee, a cuddly, silly yet clever puppy. You’ll follow the storyline and help Frizbee solve puzzles to deduce who the culprit could be.

title: Breeze of Ashes
description: Command airships in a tactical RTS where choices shape your story. Manage resources, upgrade your fleet, and battle rival factions in a non-linear campaign. With rogue-lite replayability, multiplayer co-op, and skirmish modes, your journey evolves with every playthrough.

title: Lobotrypo
description:
Rumors of a serial killer stalking your local town are all over the news, and you have a meeting with your counselor in an hour. The problem is, the walk there is long and dark.

Endeavor through carefully crafted and atmospheric levels that branch out from your apartment. Solve the mystery of what is truly going on in your head in this psychedelic and surreal horror game set in Norway.

title: Kapih
description: Kapih is a classic run-'n'-gun shooter platformer, with action packed levels and boss battles. The visuals and music are inspired by the many lost in time art-styles of India. We follow the adventure of the protagonist Vaanar who is a common kid in a colorfully imagined ancient India.

title: Office Rivals
description: Office Rivals is a slice-of-life visual novel and a love story between two office-rivals-turned-lovers, inspired by wholesome doujinshi and webtoons!

title: Counter-Strike Techno: Zombies
description:
Counter-Strike T:Z is primarily a mod/game using some original content from games such as "Counter-Strike", "Counter-Strike: Nexon",
"Counter-Strike 2"

The purpose of the development: In the future, use Ray Tracing and PhysX technologies to make the game more realistic.

The game includes such game modes as: PVP/PVE, DeathMatch, GunDeathMatch, Classic, Zombie Mode

title: Vesperia Bononia
description: Fight the nightmares of the city! Master a blend of third-person shooting, magic, and bullet hell to survive the fast-paced, ever-changing chaos that grips the streets. Change classes during combat, enter Bononia, and face your destiny.

title: Machick 2
description: The anti-magic toads are back, stronger than ever, and the magical chickens are unleashing ancient powers to fight them! With even more wands and powers to master, vanquish enemies, collect XP, and upgrade like never before in Machick 2! Get ready to out-magic the menace!

title: Broventure: The Wild Co-op
description: Broventure = Vampire Survival + Base building + Co-op. Band together with friends and obliterate hordes of grueling enemies, gather crucial resources, and transform your camp into a sanctuary of liberation.

title: Cruzcredo: Become a Legend!
description: Rise from the grave and stumble though the streets of Casca Dura, a city buzzing with mysteries, wacky gossip and some good ol' chaos thanks to the "Cruzcredo Curse". Flying rats, a vengeful ghost bride and, oh boy, the skinwalkers... Save Casca Dura from it's doom and become a legend!

title: Monster Train 2
description: It's time to raise Hell in Heaven! Monster Train returns with all new clans, new enemy factions, new challenges, new modes and more! Defend your Pyre in the classic three-tiered, vertical gameplay that made the original roguelike deckbuilder a hit.

title: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
description: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

title: Quantum Entanglement
description:
Marine Dorner (that's what she signs her checks at least) has been working at the Odessa underground hyper-science facility for three years.

As a janitor.

She couldn't tell you more than that, having just woken up from one of the facility's regularly mandated memory treatments. She has friends here (even if she can't remember all of them yet.) She has an aptly-named roommate, Gabby, who it turns out has been "more than a roommate" at times in-between these treatments.

And yet, despite all the closed doors and lockdowns, the facility seems safe. Comfortable, even. Until Marine wakes up to find everything's gone...very wrong.

What happened to everyone? What was the facility researching?

There are some doors only a janitor can open.

...And some that no one should...

title: Green Bakery
description:
You play as the main character, who, going to work, goes to the bakery on the way. There fate confronts you with a baker who loves melodramas and Frank Sinatra. And you, of course.
There are five endings in the game.

title: The Stepfather Remake
description:
Welcome to the 1920s, an era of jazz, speakeasies, and gangsters with more ambition than brains. In this classic point-and-click adventure, you’ll step into the shoes of Aurelliot, a down-on-his-luck private detective who, drowning in debt and short on clients, takes on a case that seems simple… until it isn’t.

What starts with a mysterious woman and a suspicious job spirals into a tangled web of blackmail, secrets, and absurd situations, where every conversation could hold the key and every object might (or might not) be useful. Inept gangsters, nosy bartenders, and a slew of puzzles await you in this remastered version of the 2003 classic—now with enhanced graphics, a remastered soundtrack, and brand-new voice acting for an even more immersive experience.

title: Cats 'n Blocks
description: Cats 'n Blocks is a chaotic action game where you control a cat that attacks enemies by picking up pieces of the ground. Raise your paws and prepare yourself to fight, mess around, explore and unlock hidden items in this fast-paced adventure.

title: Dice People
description: Dice People is an incremental game about rolling dice, creating a mass of units, smashing enemies, and gathering resources to get upgrades in a big skilltree.

title: Cauldron's Rift
description: A chaotic platform arena brawler where you can use rifts to gain new weapons or unlock quirky abilities, all while using the environment to your advantage.

title: Hack and Climb
description:
"Hack And Climb" is a physics-based 2D Foddian platformer where every swing matters!
Play as a cursed axe on a grueling ascent in search of revenge
Hard, fair, and addictively fun!

title: Pagliaccionautas
description: This mechanism now in your hands is not exactly a game. I'm not going to say it isn't a game; who am I to deny you the right to play? What I call a "cursed tool" is a synthetic studio. You take on the role of The Clown, an inquisitive and scathing fellow, determined to fulfill his mission: to form the perfect team of Paglaccionautas.

title: Chat Ragdoll Racing
description: Chat Ragdoll Racing is fully physics-based ragdoll animated simulation game where Twitch Streamers can host games for their communities and have people race against each other in a wild physics-based world.

title: Infinite Onslaught
description: Infinite Onslaught is a fast-paced, on-rails arcade shooter that immerses players in a relentless battle against overwhelming odds, delivering non-stop action from start to finish. Pixel art, retro, cartoonish military style. It uses Keyboard Basher technology to provide light-gun-style gameplay.

title: Panic Delivery
description: A horror/comedy co-op game for 4 players: deliver packages in a dystopian world ruled by a ruthless and grotesque society of monsters! Failure is not an option: if the customers don’t kill you, the company will… and another expendable human will take your place.

title: Swords & Souls Legacy Collection
description: All 5 classic games from SoulGame Studio in one epic collection. Slash through enemies and apples in Swords & Souls. Grab the wheel and outrun trouble in The Soul Driver. Outsmart and outmaneuver foes in the runners Rogue Soul & Rogue Soul 2 and solve clever puzzles with a flourish in The Gentleman.

title: Parallel Rift
description: Parallel Rift is a four-dimensional puzzle game where you navigate through interconnected spaces along the W-axis to reach the goal. Experience an unseen direction in this casual first-person puzzle adventure.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Drumming in New Resolutions
description:
Version 8.1 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes
• New Part 2 Story Chapter VII-EX: To None May God Pray
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star (Kiana)
• New AstralOp: Theresa Apocalypse
• New Divine Key: Flawless Benediction
• New Featured Events: Make-A-Wish Fest! & Celebration Lobby 2025
• ...and more!

title: Cheaters Cheetah
description: Everyone will be given ACTUAL CHEATS in this multiplayer shooter. Use wallhacks and aimbots to your advantage and dominate the other cheetahs. The winner will get to BAN all losers!

title: Moves Of The Diamond Hand
description: Immerse yourself in a first-person urban RPG, powered by dice and intrigue. This demo is the start of a journey where you might even shape the fate of a city. Whatever it takes to get the gig, right?

title: Cunning Gauntlet 2D
description: * CHALLENGE THE GAUNTLET

title: Replicat
description: A roguelike memory deckbuilder where you bend the rules of card matching with wild combos, strategy-defining curios and cards featuring some personality-packed cats.

title: Art of Evil
description: Art Of Evil is a roguelike horde survival game set in the medieval Dark Ages. Use magic to burn, smash, electrocute, freeze, explode or turn your enemies to stone in tense single player or exhilarating on-line coop with your friends.

title: The Courage of Cordelia
description: As Cordelia, battle through dynamic dungeons with blasters and magic. Face escalating enemies, dodge traps, and collect powerful loot in fast-paced, randomized arcade shooter runs, each offering fresh challenges.

title: Stunt Flyer
description:
Stunt Flyer is an open-world flying adventure,
led by the brother and sister team of Jimmy and
Sophie.

title: Baptiste
description:
Submerge yourself in a first-hand experience that will make you feel each chill as if it were real. The line between the game and reality blurs further with each step you take.

Explore a mansion where horror awaits in every shadow. The masterful dubbing and sound track will drag you to the depths of a nightmare. Darkness will become your most feared enemy, putting your bravery to the test in each corner.

Play as Tom, a young man still suffering from the tragedy. After the loss of his father, he accompanies his mother Sara on what ought to be a new beginning. However, the ghosts of the past threaten to consume him. Can you keep control against the siege of his inner demons?

Disentangle the gruesome secrets that impregnate each floorboard and each crack on the walls. Each discovery will reveal a story of pain and horror that beggars belief.

Submerge yourself into a world where beauty and terror coexist in a macabre dance. The visual design will transport you to a kingdom where the grotesque is fascinating.

Each objective, each note and each whisper contribute towards weaving the plot. Your perseverance in the face of fear will be rewarded with chilling revelations that will keep you on edge until the very end.

title: Halo: New Covenant
description: A campaign mod for Halo 3 ODST, Halo: New Covenant takes you on a journey after the events of Halo 3 in a new direction. The campaign includes custom missions designed from scratch, Custom cinematics, Custom voice acting and up to 4 player coop support.

title: The Fat Cat Fest
description: Fat Cat Fest is a party game full of minigames and challenges, where funny cats will compete to see who is the fastest and most skillful eater.

title: Lumi Trek
description: Lumi Trek is a unique rhythm platformer where you have to combine the three primary colors of light to overcome obstacles. Change the color of the moving star at the right time, and stay calm when deadly traps appear. It may sound simple, but this challenge will make your hands sweat!

title: Dough or Die
description: Manage the shop by day, serving customers and keeping everything afloat, by night fend off hordes of crazed lunatics and handle unexpected challenges that come with being a small business owner. Enjoy a mix of cooking simulations, tower defense, and multiplayer co-op in this unique pizza adventure.

title: The Curse of the Howling Woods
description:
You signed up for a simple job - pull some weeds, make a little cash. Instead, you got bitten by a werewolf, tricked by an old woman, and thrown into a maze of crypts, curses, and questionable life choices.

Now you have two hours to undo your fate before you sprout fur and start howling at the moon.

The Curse of the Howling Woods is a 2D adventure game that blends classic horror tropes, witty dialogue, and cozy but chaotic gameplay. Navigate haunted woods, solve puzzles, dodge traps, and try not to get mugged by a pumpkin.

Features

Cozy Combat – Enemies? One hit and they’re gone. You? Well… hopefully, you’re lucky.

A Maze of Mayhem – Crypts, quicksand, rolling boulders—this forest wants you to fail.

A Cast of Oddballs – Befriend (or avoid) scam-artist Eudora, overly dramatic ghosts, and Tim the werewolf, who insists it was just business.

Survive the night, break the curse, and maybe - just maybe - get paid for your trouble.

title: Anime Dance-Off: Space Party
description: Step into a universe where music and movement collide in a spectacular party experience for seasoned rhythm gamers and newcomers.

title: Anime Girls: Awesome Adventurer
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Around the World 2: Travel to Canada - Collector's Edition
description: An unforgettable vacation in Canada.

title: Art of Glide 3
description: Spread your wings and discover the beauty of a boundless world, one landmark at a time.

title: Bing in Wonderland: Power Up Edition
description: Fight, loot and upgrade your adventurer Bing!

title: Blackbeard's Treasure
description:
Toss coins and rule the high seas!
Golden riches slumber on the treasure islands that await you!

title: Crosswords: World Tour
description: Are you a fan of crosswords? Do you like travelling? Heck! Who doesn't?! Crosswords: World Tour is the game for you!

title: Eggconsole Arctic PC-8801mkIISR
description: Guide the colorful, roaming planets to the goal. A new type of puzzle game where you skillfully switch points on the rails for fun.

title: Eggconsole Burai: Jokan PC-8801mkIISR
description: An RPG set in the world of Kypros, comprising the continent of Zaius and the seven islands. The story features eight heroes, including pirates, fortune tellers.

title: Distant Woods
description: Start your journey!

title: Escape Room Ultimate Trilogy
description:
Three escape rooms developed by mc2games are included!
Pyramids and Aliens, Mystic Academy, Between Time.

title: Rebus Rush
description: Rebus Rush is an exciting educational puzzle game where players solve word based puzzles by interpreting images. Levels presents a series of visual clues that represent an English word.

title: Puzzle Adventures: Farm Animals
description: Easy to use puzzles for toddlers and kids. Featuring funny and cute animal motifs with 30 unique puzzles. 100% frustration free and child-safe.

title: Pro Wrestler Story
description: Pro Wrestling Team Management Sim, Face off with fearsome foes!

title: Robot Boxing: Real Fighting Steel Battle
description:
Clash of Titans, Built for Battle!
Unleash Steel Fury, Rule the Arena.
Robot Boxing: Where Legends are Forged!

title: Speedway Legends: Overdrive Racing
description: Burn rubber, break limits, become a Legend!

title: Sherlock Purr Adventures
description: Be a cat detective and uncover hidden objects in this purrfect two-game bundle!

title: Santa's Christmas Gift Quest
description: Embark on a magical quest to collect Christmas gifts!

title: Shadowforge Chronicles
description: Magic meets firepower in a battle for survival.

title: Summer Love
description: Experience a summer love story where your choices shape the outcome. Will it be a forever love or just a memory? Your unforgettable journey begins!

title: Spot the Odd Pictogram!
description:
Which Pictogram Doesn’t Belong?
A Fast-Paced Brain-Training Spot-the-Difference Game

title: The Brave Little Pigs
description: This visual novel follows a group of young pigs who participate in their town's annual race for the first time.

title: The Exit: Liminal Anomaly Horror
description: Escape the unknown, survive the unseen.

title: Tiny Lands: Deluxe Edition
description: Relax and find the differences in beautiful 3D dioramas. With the Deluxe Edition, you can play all the new expansions for Tiny Lands.

title: Flames of Damnation
description: The Flames of Damnation burn on your path – are you ready to face them?

title: Jump, You!+
description: As a lost stray cat, you tirelessly jump toward the top to return to your owner!

title: Jigsaw City Princess
description: Solve 45 beautiful puzzles of city princesses drinking coffee, at school or other activities you love!

title: Ice Sisters: Princesses of the Frozen Age
description: In the magical kingdom of Lunalia, where the seasons are controlled by an ancestral legacy, two sisters inherit the duty of maintaining natural balance.

title: Legend of the Kitties: Return of Echoes
description: In a forest full of life, a shining river connects all the creatures that inhabit it. Three young adventurers discover that this river is not just running water.

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Sogeumgang
description: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour East River
description: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!

title: Jurassic Island: Little Dinosaur Park
description: This graphic novel follows the adventures of a group of dinosaurs who find an island full of challenges and ancient secrets.

title: Minions Survivors
description: Survive the hordes of minions and defeat the bosses!

title: Make it! Donut
description:
Get ready for a delicious donut-making challenge!
Make as many as you can and watch your food cart prosper!

title: West Escape
description: Outrun the law, blast aliens, and fight for love in the wildest ride through the Wild West!

title: Wet Whispers: Anime Shift Puzzles
description: Solve captivating anime puzzles with Wet Whispers – Anime Shift Puzzles, where every piece unlocks beautiful, moody art!

title: Wonderful Monsters: The Flower Crossing
description: In a meadow full of colourful flowers, lives a community of small and colourful monsters that maintain a harmonious relationship with nature.

title: Caball: Sunset Hour
description: Veronica has made a deal with a strange being, and now every shadow seems to follow her with its gaze. Or is it all merely an illusion?

title: Scarlet City of Devils
description: A demon punk hack and slash adventure game! Explore the city of Elovelle at your own discretion and take down the toughest thugs this game has to offer.

title: The Unholy Priest
description: Manage a haunted funeral service as a priest in a cursed forest. Bury or cremate the dead, perform exorcisms, fend off demonic possessions, and quiet restless souls. Survive terrifying encounters, maintain sanity, and experience the pinnacle of horror simulation in The Unholy Priest!

title: The Shattered
description: A fantasy roguelite dungeon crawler, where you decide the powers of your opponents. Overcome randomly generated challenges, create a unique set of skills, and uncover the mystery of your true identity.

title: Super Debt
description: Fight against time in Super Debt, the intense and challenging twin-stick bullet-hell dungeon-crawler where everything is tied into one resource... money.

title: Old Timer Transport
description: Hop on your turbocharged mobility scooter as a grumpy old driver! Race through Bompidorm with friends, commit vehicular manslaughter, and deliver your victims to the hospital to dodge lawsuits!

title: One Minute
description: Dive into the frantic universe of One Minute, a roguelite game like no other where every second counts! Designed to be fast, accessible, and addictive, this game offers an intense experience entirely controlled with your mouse.

title: 5th Dimension
description: 5th Dimension is a cyberpunk world builder and RPG MMO that empowers players to create, and then control a limitless virtual world. Build game worlds, design high-tech robotic humanoids and compete in an array of adrenaline fuelled competitions to exert your influence on the world you’ve built.

title: Wallace & Gromit: Cracking Animator
description:
Have a cracking time creating your own animations, adding sound effects and dialogue, and finally saving them as screensavers.

Choose some dialogue then try to synchronise the expressions of Wallace and Gromit. You use the mouse to move their eyes, mouths, ears - well everything really while the sound is running.

You can choose your set, props, music and characters. Make the characters walk on and say their piece, well not in Gromit's case, of course, and then walk off again.

Decide whether you want to make one of your own animations into your current screensaver, or choose one of the three pre-made screensaver games.

title: FarmTD
description: FarmTD combines the charm of farming with the strategy of tower defense. Utilize and upgrade your animals to fend off invading insects while managing your crops to prevent them from dying of dehydration (or being eaten by hungry goats...)

title: The Little Pixel That Could
description: The Little Pixel That Could is puzzle-platformer about a daring pixel on a mission to delete the browser history of its enigmatic owner. Traverse hard drives and firewalls to piece together the fragmented memories of the owner's life.

title: You Die Today
description: Combine deck-building and dice-rolling in this tabletop-inspired roguelike dungeon crawler! Roll D4s, D6s, D20s, and more to activate powerful card abilities and conquer dynamic encounters.

title: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii - Deluxe Edition
description:
■PIRATE YAKUZA ADVENTURE AHOY!
Goro Majima, a notorious ex-yakuza suddenly finds himself shipwrecked on a remote island in the Pacific. Unable to remember even his own name, he sets sail in search of clues to his lost memories, accompanied by a boy named Noah who saved his life. Before long, they’re caught up in a conflict between cutthroat criminals, modern-day pirates, and other scoundrels over a legendary treasure.

■GET YOUR SHIP TOGETHER
Assemble a one-of-a-kind crew while upgrading your ship as you explore the open sea and forge your legend in the cannon fire of foes, unexpected friendships, and immense riches made along the way.

When an enemy pirate ship catches you in their sights, an exhilarating real-time cannon battle breaks out. Quickly maneuver into position while avoiding fire, then deliver devastating damage to board the enemy ship and take down the captain in all-out crew vs. crew brawls. Conquer the seas, discover hidden islands and acquire loads of loot like a true yakuza pirate!

■KICK ARRRSS WITH CREATIVE COMBAT
Dynamically switch between the “Mad Dog” and “Pirate” fighting styles to mix-up attacks and deliver explosive combos, juggles, and aerial takedowns that reward your creativity with over-the-top action.

With “Mad Dog” style, utilize speed, agility, and flair to deliver precise yet powerful blows that stun your enemies into submission.

Or make enemies walk the plank with the “Pirate” style that has you dual-wielding short swords and deploying tricky pirate tools to kick some serious booty.

*This product contains the base game and add-on content. Please be aware that the additional content is also sold separately.
*The “Legendary Pirate Crew Pack” will be available after the main character's pirate ship upgrade event in Chapter 2 of the main game.
*The “Legendary Outfit Pack” will be available after the ability to change outfits is unlocked in Chapter 2 of the main game.
*The “Ship Customization Pack” will be available after the main character's pirate ship upgrade event in Chapter 2 of the main game.
*The “Extra Karaoke & CD Pack” will be available after gaining access to a smartphone in Chapter 1 of the main game.
*The contents of the "Legendary Pirate Crew Pack", "Legendary Outfit Pack", "Ship Special Customization Pack" & "Additional Karaoke & BGM Pack" will not be counted toward in-game achievements.

title: Laundering Simulator
description: Laundering Simulator puts you in charge of a two-faced enterprise – a laundromat as a front and a counterfeiting workshop hidden in its back. As the shady launderer, Eddie Wiser, you run this unconventional enterprise and deal with small-business management, counterfeiting, a criminal underground, nosy authorities, and a rage-inducing grandmother!

title: The Stare
description: Step into a nightmare where every level hides a deadly secret. Trapped in a twisted maze of endless corridors and eerie rooms, every door you open could be your last, and every step could lead you deeper into danger. Can you stay calm, solve the mysteries, and find a way out?

title: Organarium
description:
You have touched down on a mysterious desert planet. The sun of this world has been hidden by an unending eclipse.

The secret to the stars lies in an ancient device known as the Organarium, and you may be the planet's last hope.

title: Doomed Hell 64
description: Doomed Hell 64 is a retro FPS where you battle through hellish levels filled with monsters and chaos. Battle through endless waves, discover the hidden secrets of hell, and obliterate all living forms!

title: Noobs Are Coming
description: You are the final boss in this brutal synergy arena roguelike. Select a character, equip boss patterns and combine tons of attacks to create unique builds. Play solo or in co-op!

title: Heartfire
description:
You are Saffi a hyperspace dragon, and also a lesbian. Your partner, Eleza, had been taken by the venture.

If you want her back, you'll need to fly to the far side of space and burn anything that gets in your way.

Are you up to the challenge?

title: Quartermain and the Cult of Cthulhu
description: Take up arms against Cultists, Nazis, Robots, and Lovecraftian monsters in this fast-paced action adventure. It’s down to you, Aloysius Quartermain, to sneak a 12,000 year old Artefact out of Nazi Germany by emptying lead into anything that moves.

title: Deadzone Haunt
description: Deadzone Haunt is a wave-based First-Person Zombie Shooter. Customize your loadout, upgrade weapons, and use perks & power-ups to dominate the demons. Experience smooth movement, satisfying gunplay, and a new approach to weapon camo customization.

title: Velhodium Isle
description: Velhodium Isle is a pixel-art boomer shooter in which you fight monsters in themed locations. Use weapons and magic to get through crowds of monsters and close the source of apocalyptic terrors. Disable shields, close the anomaly, and survive the brutal slaughter!

title: Yamedomo
description:
You suddenly, really suddenly,
realized last night that you were in love with him.

But he and you are just friends(?).
Wouldn't confessing to him make things awkward between them?
Wouldn't he pretend it never happened? You think like that.
And you find that very sad.... So you decided to mess everything up.

That's right, you decided to become a Yandere overnight!

title: Samurai Pizza Cats: Blast from the Past!
description:
That’s right folks! After more then 30 years the Samurai Pizza Cats finally return! The Big Cheese has an evil Scheme up his sleeve and it’s up to you, the player to stop him from taking over Little Tokyo!

The show first aired in Japan on February 1, 1990. Kyatto Ninden Teyandee is a science-fiction, action-comedy animated show set in Edoropolis, a city inhabited by anthropomorphic robotic animals. The series gained international recognition in the early 1990s when it was localized as Samurai Pizza Cats and broadcast worldwide and has maintained a dedicated fanbase to this day.

The new game, Samurai Pizza Cats: Blast from the Past!, is being developed by Dutch studio BLAST ZERO (creative team behind Jitsu Squad) and will be globally distributed by Red Dunes Games from the United Arab Emirates. Designed as a 2D action RPG, the game allows players to seamlessly switch between members of the Pizza Cats, utilizing their unique abilities to solve puzzles and engage in thrilling battles within the world of Little Tokyo.

title: Night of the Stars
description: Every 888 years in Faust, it's the Night of the Stars! You've been chosen by your community to reach out for the 3 Half-Gods and stop the ever-expanding Void from swallowing every life form. Your salvation lies in the joint power of the Half-Gods. But will they even want to collaborate with you?

title: The Stranger From the Bus Stop
description: A visual novel inspired of dating sim style and psychological/horror games tropes.

title: Bomb Around
description:
... and find out!
Physics based rage game inspired by jump king and other foddian games. Play as unique characters trying to reach as high as possible. Use interesting upgrades to reach new heights and discover the difficulty ahead. Compete on the leaderboards with speedrun, daily seed, or just casual play.

title: Wizard's Warp
description: Always wanted to learn how to teleport? Try not to get stuck in a wall! Wizard's Warp, a platformer that challenges those who are not afraid of hard challenges. Get to the top to save your favorite cat! But if you fall down, be ready for a rough landing.

title: Megafist
description: Megafist is a Punch'em up action roguelite, where you'll fight progressively stronger waves of Corporate Devils by powering up your Fist.

title: Serpent Wine
description: A fantasy yuri visual novel about the travelers Selindae and Lynolell's hunt for a cryptid. A short stand-alone story set after the events of Prisoner of the Mist, created for the Trans Joy Jam 2025.

title: Tape Us Out
description: Tape Us Out is an asymmetric, online co-op puzzle game. Players are sucked into a VHS tape and must face challenges of logic, coordination, and communication within the universe of old movies to find their way back to reality.

title: Prototype Mint B
description:
You have just received a file containing an AI fresh out of the digital oven and ready for its final phase of testing.

The company you work for is awaiting your judgement on whether this little pile of data should continue on to the next step.

Under 1000 words, with 2 choices
Mentions of mental health. Nothing really triggering(I think), just a dude.

title: A Tale In The Garden
description: A Tale in the Garden is a relaxing gardening simulator where you follow Filomena's journey. As she nurtures her garden for a contest, she eagerly awaits the arrival of her granddaughter Frida.

title: Smol Gods
description: A deity-drafting card game where you build a team of tiny gods, then battle another team by playing off your gods' powers and synergies.

title: The Confinement
description: The Confinement is a first-person precision platformer. Run, dodge and dash! You are trapped in Confinement, a simulation created by AmokAI. Use your sharp reflexes to overcome obstacles, escape and prove that you are the best at parkour through various levels!

title: Avenir Tower
description: Avenir Tower is a platforming game where you attempt to reach the top of a giant structure known as the Avenir Tower.

title: Thin Threads
description: Thin Threads is a first-person psychological horror game about a family's desperate struggle to survive poverty. Step into the shoes of each family member, witnessing their story unfold from different perspectives, immersing you in a truly haunting and disturbing experience.

title: Dare to Lucid Dream
description: For the first time in years, Sonny meets a person he knows inside of his lucid dreams and, to his surprise, Sonny discovers that what he says and does in his dreams directly affects the people he dreamed about.

title: Dinofurie
description: Dinofurie is a thrilling multiplayer battle royale where dinosaurs clash in intense survival battles. Choose from a diverse roster of prehistoric creatures, each with unique abilities and playstyles, and fight for dominance in a vast, dynamic world.

title: Ohanabatake no Flore
description: The story is about Flore, Parfait and Rinette who are 11 years old and like growing flowers. Grow over 50 different varieties of flowers with them!

title: Heartful Memories: Little Witch Parfait 2
description:
The protagonist, Perky, has only his name to remember, but nothing else in his memory to confirm his true identity. He is found unconscious by Parfait Sucreal near the Crabell Waterfall outside Florelmos. When Parfait allows him to recover in her house and informs him about Florelmos, as well as herself, she takes Perky to the wise witch to see if she knew anything about Perky.

Unfortunately, the wise witch says she is not able to claim his identity but that he owns 500000 gold in return for keeping her keeping his sword for him. Until he collects the money by 6 months, the wise witch tells Parfait to allow Perky to stay in the Black Cat Market.

title: Anima Fighters
description: Fight to escape from the dimensional prison: choose one of the six warriors and prepare for battle.

title: Voidface
description: Face off in a challenging bullet-hell arena shooter to try and clear bite-sized boss rush challenges. Learn to dodge their attacks, cast spells to gain an upper hand, and kill everything that gets in your way.

title: Emptiness Sire
description: Emptiness Sire is a turn-based puzzle adventure set in a world reborn in medieval times after a catastrophic meteor shower. Explore the ruins of humanity, face deadly cosmic horror creatures, and uncover secrets as you guide three heroes on a quest to survive the divine punishment.

title: Parfait Fan Box
description: A fandisc for the Parfait saga.

title: Shoujo Mahou Gaku Little Witch Romanesque Bangai Hen "Sayonara, Mauresumo"
description: Short, stand-alone side-story available for free from Littlewitch's website.

title: Crystal Fortress
description: Defend the Crystal Fortress and its people from invading forces in this blend of Turn-Based Tactical RPGs and Tower Defense. Summon the infantry, call out the archers, deploy turrets. Use all the available tools to keep the enemies at bay!

title: Sinsations 2: Modern Gods
description:
In Sinsations 2: Modern Gods you take the role of returning Deadly Sin of Lust, Kosuke, or the Deadly Sin of Lust, Maverick. You're tasked by Lucifer to help clean up the cities of the world by getting rid of Modern Gods that have started appearing.

Because the world is being influenced by these Modern Gods and Lucifer's Deadly Sins are having less and less influence themselves, Lucifer is commanding all Deadly Sins to get rid of any Modern Gods they come across... By any means necessary.

title: Foddia
description:
Foddia is a 2D-Platformer inspired by Getting Over It. There are difficult challenges to overcome and mysteries to uncover at every turn. Swing on ropes, make long jumps across chasms, and climb your way to the top of the Foddian Mountain.

You came here for a reason.
Was it to climb this mountain that won't stop towering over you?
Was it to search for secrets in the depths unknown?
Was it to become the fastest hiker the world has ever seen?

The only certainty is that if you leave now...
You may never know why you came in the first place.

title: Adopt A Boyfriend
description:
Riley has grown tired of time-wasters and first dates with no chemistry.

Wanting to feel loved again, they hastily turn to ARA, the Agency for Romancing Animalfolk, hoping the agency can give them hope in the world of romance.

Excitement builds for the day when their new chance at love will arrive, when not one, but two hot animal boys show up on their doorstep!

will you pursue the friendship and adoration that comes with the people-pleasing bunny Aramis? Or push through the stoic exterior of cute kitten Kujo to find his heart of gold underneath?

title: Her Love, Like Poison
description: A dark lesbian horror/romance story so toxic it's emitting spores. Ethel, a shy university student, ventures into the wintry woods late one night, where she meets an enchanting raven-haired femme fatale - but all is not as it seems.

title: Good Morgan Eve
description: A short RPG Maker horror game where you play as Morgan, an odd girl navigating a typical day where she has to deal with an obsessive stalker and an even more obsessive girlfriend.

title: Black Light Kills
description: Welcome to the darkness of the town; here, you walk a fine line between reality and dreams, questioning your sanity. Black Light Kills takes you deep into Aiden’s mind, where nightmares begin as reality fades.

title: Kaal Yoddha
description: Kaal Yoddha is an action-adventure game steeped in the mythic heritage of ancient India. Step into the role of Prince Avyaan, a skilled warrior driven by curiosity and valor, as he answers a mysterious plea for help from a remote island besieged by a terrifying curse.

title: Abyss Chaser
description: Hunt demons as a biker rebel angel in this action-packed rogue-like dungeon crawler. Ride through Forsaken Lands and chase your enemies to the Depths of Hell using blades, guns, spells and support of otherworldly patrons.

title: Demon Hunters
description: Demon Hunters is a 2D RPG with roguelike elements where you explore dungeons, fight hordes of enemies and epic bosses. Upgrade weapons, collect artifacts and close the demonic portal!

title: Mystery of Gevaudan
description: Based on French legends, the horror game Mystery of Gévaudan invites you to immerse yourself in a magical adventure. Armed with your phone's camera, solve puzzles and survive by avoiding (or killing) creepy monsters to uncover a dark mystery.

title: P World
description: P World is a Pachinko-Action FPS game. Collect pinballs and shoot them into a gigantic pachinko machine to unleash the power. Drive into cyber world and fire your souls to survive against endless waves of DIGITAL GHOST .

title: Zenomatrix
description: ZENOMATRIX is the first ever game to seamlessly combine puzzle-solving and horror, navigate a surreal realm inspired by early 90's CGI experiments as you engage in first-person conundrums against creatures that only move to attack when not directly observed.

title: El Salar
description: A 2D zelda-like adventure game inspired by Bolivian folklore.

title: Mythic Mire
description: A surreal RPG-adventure set in a world between dreams and nightmares. Explore strange environments with your trusty digital Pixie companions.

title: No Escape from Madness
description: No Escape from Madness is a thrilling shooting adventure game that blends Lovecraftian elements with extraction gameplay. You will guide the self-sacrificing infantry operators into the Sector where The Elder One is poised to descend.

title: Hostile Dreams 2
description: An extremely challenging psycho-horror platformer with unique ragdoll controls – made of my dreams.

title: Lullaby of Lost Soul
description: Lullaby of Lost Soul is an atmospheric horror game with anime-style graphics, built on Unreal Engine 5. Explore the eerie Academy, uncover its secrets, and face the ghost of a deceased girl. Solve puzzles, evade traps, and unravel the mystical story to break an ancient curse.

title: Fogrest: The Whisper of Harbingers
description: Fogrest is a 2D pixel adventure game. A fog has descended on the land, monstrous creatures are waiting to attack. Make your way through dark forests and deserted towns to find answers.

title: Apartment Dream
description:
Apartment Dream is a game about exploring memories through art.

Follow MONA on her somber-hued adventure as she seeks to complete the magical picture book left behind by her deceased mother. As you explore the building she lives in and meet all of its unique residents, you'll realize this truly is your Apartment Dream.

title: High Flyer
description: Soar to new heights in High Flyer, an endless runner game where agility & quick reflexes are key. Navigate vibrant aerial worlds, dodge obstacles, and collect power-ups. Unlock unique characters, compete in race-themed challenges, and climb global leaderboards. Experience endless fun and excitement!

title: Screaming Head
description: You are a head and you have two feet, four wives, one house and a retirement fund. Unfortunately, your body is a jealous type. One day it attacks you and takes... everything! Well go ahead and scream your way through an eclectic gallery of various body parts to get your darlings back. AAAAAAAAAAAAA!

title: TModLoader: Metroid Mod
description:
The Metroid Mod is, quite simply, a mod for Terraria that adds content based on the Metroid franchise.

It adds:
-A variety of armor sets
-Multiple new weapons
-Accessories
-1 new mount
-1 new grapple hook with swinging capabilities
-New materials/items/etc.
-Many of these items introduce new mechanics
-New NPCs
-New Mobs
-7 new bosses, 6 of which have almost completely custom AI
-And much more planned for future updates!

title: Funko Fusion: Kim Pine
description: Bring the hype with Kim Pine from Scott Pilgrim vs. The World! Add this DLC item to your library to add Kim Pine as a playable character.

title: Guilty Gear Xrd: Rev 2 - Character Colors Axl Low
Picayune Dreams: Contamination
description: Picayune Dreams: Contamination is a major content update for the base game. The update introduces new weapons, bosses and alternative suits with different gameplay modifiers.

title: The Running Toaster
description: Run like a Toaster! Collect slices of Bread and speed up by shooting Toast at the Vegetables!

title: Shadows Bounce Once
description:
The most exciting puzzle & stealth action game is here for you!
Control Ninja and assassinate all the white enemies.

title: Wine Factory Simulator
description: Grow, Harvest, Create – The Art of Winemaking Awaits!

title: So Much Stuff 4: Bits and Bobs - Collector's Edition
description: Uncover an abundance of new stuff in this exciting sequel!

title: 15 in 1 Family Games Mega Collection
description: One bundle, endless fun!
