description: Fight with strategy, dominate the battlefield, claim your victory

title: Dark Passion: Anime Match Puzzles
description: Discover Dark Passion - Anime Match Puzzles! Match tiles to reveal stunning anime art and immerse yourself in mystery.

title: Aery: Dream Land
description: Escape the daily hustle, feel the freedom of flying, and immerse yourself in beautiful, peaceful landscapes.

title: Escape Game The Painting Mansion
description:
The orthodox escape game for you, staged in a rumored mansion.
Can you solve all the riddles and get out?

title: Hentai Girls: Marvelous Magician
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Hentai Stewardese Girls
description: Puzzles, passion and irresistible beauty await.

title: Just Find It 4: Collector's Edition
description: Explore hidden variations and engage with exciting new challenges in Just Find It 4!

title: Little Fairy Dress Up
description: Create magical looks for your fairies with enchanted clothes, dreamy hairstyles and sparkly accessories. Explore and let your imagination run wild!

title: The Bodycam Shooter
description: Fast, tactical, and relentless—survive the fight.

title: Cosmic Fantasy 3
description: A new and beautiful legend of the galactic heroes - the story of the protagonist Yu's father and mother

title: Cosmic Fantasy 4: Prelude to Legend
description: Cosmic Saga Finale! Prologue - The protagonists from the first film, Yu and Saya, save the planet from crisis as the Algernon team.

title: Cosmic Fantasy 4: Van's Return
description:
The touching epilogue is finally revealed...
The Cosmic Team is united!

title: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes - The Chapter of Marisa
Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes - The Chapter of Markus
description: In this story expansion, Markus, Carrie, and Nowa brace­ themselves for an intriguing discove­ry. An anomaly dubbed "Menhir's Distortion" has unlocked a myste­rious teleportation gateway. Ve­nturing forth as a trio, they prepare to de­lve into the enigmatic re­alm beyond. What hidden truths await the­m there? Perhaps the­ revelations would shed light on Markus's shroude­d past, unearthing long-buried secre­ts. With bated breath, they ste­el themse­lves for the unraveling of an extraordinary tale.

title: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes - The Chapter of Seign
Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero - Heroes of the Past
Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero - Parallel Siblings
Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero - The Girl Who Cried Ghost
Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero - The Rat Who Demons Fear
Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero - The Wandering Pirate
Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero - The Liar and the Lost
Solir
description: Discover the unique atmosphere of Solir, a 2D platformer designed to offer relaxation, accompanied by a fantastic soundtrack.

title: Ninja Master Toru
description: An evil curse that transforms the dead into living corpses was cast upon the land. The only way to stop the entire nation from crumbling to the undead is defeating the Kind of Undead, but entire armies of soldiers were annihilated and transformed into zombies. Only the master of steath, Ninja Master Toru, can infiltrate into the enemy territory and claim the leader's head!

title: Fruit Adventure Returns
description: This Bundle contains the game "Fruit Adventure Returns" in 03 versions (Xbox One + Xbox Series + Windows).

title: The Harmony Chronicles: Demon of the Void - Collector’s Edition
description:
Saga continues, Mona is about to travel through dimensions!

After her incredible adventures, Mona, the warrior of Goddess Harmony,
prepares to meet her divine protector before a magic portal transports her to a world on the brink of collapse.
Mona discovers she has arrived at the once-thriving Interdimensional University of Magic, which has become a shadow of its former self.

As the fate of the universe hangs in the balance, Mona embarks on a perilous journey through shattered dimensions,
chasing clues that lead to a terrifying entity devouring everything in its path.

To stop it, she must venture across awe-inspiring worlds, each filled with unique challenges, fantastical creatures, and powerful allies!

title: To the Moon: Sigmund Minisode 1 & 2 (Holiday Special)
description: Return to the heartfelt world of To the Moon.

title: World of Tanks: Modern Armor - Super Heavy Hitter
description:
Is the frontline calling your name? Then make sure you've got the armor for the fight! The Mauerbrecher is a heavy tank built for close-quarters combat, with armor to soak up the damage and a hard-hitting gun to deal it right back.

Super Heavy Hitter also gives you high-value Boosters to increase your earnings from every battle you use them.

title: World of Warships: Legends - European Strength
description: Strengthen your Pan-European fleet with a skilled Commander! This set includes essential in-game resources and a Pan-European Commander crate, guaranteed to drop a Pan-European Commander.

title: Forgekeepers
description: As a Forgekeeper, upgrade your weapons, unlock powerful abilities, and battle relentless waves of alien invaders. Defend key locations, and help other comrades in this fast-paced roguelike action game. Adapt, strategize, and survive—can you withstand the onslaught?

title: Shadows Fall
description: Set over 6 Zones of 3 Acts, Shadows Fall will tell a story, in the same vein as Sonic Rush and Chronicles, and power up Shadow with various upgrades along the way. Shadow is the only playable character planned right now, but he will be able to interact with several new characters, as well as a couple familiar ones...

title: Dungeon And Darkness
description: Create your own avatar and live as an adventurer in the town of "Elbern," surrounded by dungeons. Delve into the dungeons and collect weapons and equipment with random effects. The goal is to conquer the final dungeon, the "Great Hole of Elbern."

title: Tactics Unlimited
description:
Tactics Unlimited innovatively combines elements of traditional sports management games, role-playing games (RPGs), and turn-based tactics, creating a deeply immersive experience that balances strategy, management, and action on the pitch.

It is a modern 3D football game that brings fresh energy to the genre by combining strategy, management, and on-field action into an immersive experience. With its realistic graphics, players are treated to lifelike depictions of stadiums, players, and in-game dynamics.

title: The New Apartment
description: A man living in his new apartment finds himself in the center of something much more sinister.

title: Shotgun Cop Man
description: GO TO HELL, ARREST SATAN. Propel yourself to justice and glory on a journey through hell in this punchy, crunchy, son-of-a-gun precision platformer from the creator of My Friend Pedro.

title: Deepspace Emporium
description: Deepspace Emporium is a gritty shopkeeping sim set in the depths of a sprawling space station. As a former scavenger turned merchant, you trade in goods of varying legality—all while facing rising rent. Navigate a divided society, balance faction demands, and dodge authorities as you try to survive.

title: Plant Nursery Simulator
description: Plant Nursery Simulator is a cozy management simulation game where you run your own plant shop. Stock shelves with a variety of plants, order supplies, hire and manage staff, and expand your nursery to attract more customers. Grow and nurture plants to keep your store thriving while balancing costs and profits. With stylized visuals and a relaxing atmosphere, the game offers a wholesome experience for players who enjoy strategic planning and creative shop management.

title: Monster Bonds
description:
Match each monster with its identical partner to help the researcher capture them.

Made for Mini Jam 178 - Monsters.

title: Your Crown Is Mine
description: Take the throne and fix the corrupt kingdom— or worsen it! A villainess life sim and visual novel where you balance your stats and romance rival nations' leaders for foreign policy purposes. How will you rule the country?

title: Sonic the Hedgehog Game Gear/Master System Remake
The Stamp
description: Piece together your memories. Reveal the truth. A minimalistic Lovecraftian tale of symbols, sentences, and quiet discovery.

title: 1917: The Alien Invasion DX Remastered
description: You are in the role of Dr. Brunhild Stahlmüller, an acomplished weapon scientist who upgrades a WW1 triplane with superior alien technology to attack the invaders. You will avenge mankind and take the battle into the darkness of space until you reach an ancient alien world.

title: A Bibelot: Y-Break
description: No joke this time, I'll describe the game for what it is: - 10 levels, 3 difficulties, playable in 2 players Coop! - A Versus mode, against your enemy or friend, or against ???

title: Phi: The Broken Strings
description:
Phi: The Broken Strings is a 3D puzzle platformer that takes you on an emotional journey through four levels, each reflecting a key life experience—Happiness, Sadness, Fear, and Anger.
The game is in the prototype stage.

With over 25 unique puzzles, 12+ immersive events, and dynamic NPC interactions, the game blends exploration, storytelling, and platforming into a 4-8 hour experience.

Perfect for fans of Little Nightmares, Inside, Limbo, and Bramble: The Mountain King.

title: Black Hole Void: Survive The Hole
description: Black Hole Void: Survive The Hole DLC Experience a thrilling escape adventure, improve your skills in the Upgrade Shop, and compete for the top of the new leaderboard. Are you ready to escape the Black Hole and prove your survival skills?

title: Angel Legion: Chain Trace - Red
description: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!

title: Spin Rhythm XD: Chillhop
description: Kick back and relax with a selection of Chillhop's finest beats.

title: Power Solenoid: BennyJr
description: Play with BennyJr on his infinite quest to the sky!

title: Nonozle: Food and Drink + Miscellaneous Puzzle Packs
description: A DLC containing two new puzzle packs (Food and Drink pack and Miscellaneous pack) with 50 puzzles each for a total of 100 new nonograms.

title: Atonia: Netorare Annals
description: Atonia is a land in a bleak future. A man and his wife have narrowly escaped the catastrophic raiding and pillaging of their beloved settlement. They must now find a safe place to live. Along the way, they will meet a mysterious man who seems to have ulterior motives.

title: Hentai Tales: Uninhabited Island
description: A tourist ship you were on accidentally fell into the sea due to an accident. When you wake up, you seem to have been drifted by the sea to an uninhabited island. There are many strange plants on this uninhabited island, as if they are plants that do not exist in this world. What will happen there?

title: Exoprimal: Barrage - Volcano
description: Contents: Volcano exosuit skin for Barrage

title: Exoprimal: Krieger - Patrol Car
description: Contents: Patrol Car exosuit skin for Krieger

title: Star Trek​ x World of Warships: Commander Jean-Luc Picard
description: Captain Jean-Luc Picard of the ​​​​U.S.S. Enterprise​​ is on deck and ready to stand up for the principles of the United Federation of Planets. Add him to your American fleet now along with a Sci-Fi Space permanent camouflage.

title: Star Trek​ x World of Warships: Commander Sela
description: Ruthless and cunning, Romulan Commander Sela has arrived in World of Warships to sow chaos and sacrifice whatever is necessary to bring victory to the Romulan Star Empire. Add her to your Japanese fleet now along with a Sci-Fi Space permanent camouflage.

title: Star Trek​ x World of Warships: Commander Spock
description: Science officer Spock has arrived in World of Warships, bringing the principles of cold logic and stoic rationality to your bridge. Add him to your American fleet now along with a Sci-Fi Space permanent camouflage.

title: StockSim
description: Step into the shoes of a world class trader and navigate the fast-paced world of financial markets. Make strategic decisions, analyze market trends, and watch your portfolio grow. With realistic market simulations and dynamic pricing, every trade counts. Can you beat the market?

title: Sweet Hospital
description: Sweet Hospital - is a simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game with relaxing music accompaniment. After completing the level, you can enjoy the girl's photo in the gallery.

title: Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition - Doom of Icewind Dale
description:
After more than 20 years, the story of the Hero of Neverwinter finally continues in this epic new adventure from Luke Scull, fantasy author and lead designer of Tyrants of the Moonsea!

In the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale, the Hero of Neverwinter awakens. Stripped of their recent memories and left to die by a mysterious power, they must survive a dire threat to the dale as they seek the truth behind their abduction. The answers they discover will shape the very fate of the Forgotten Realms.

title: Mega Man Again
description:
A classic adventure... Remade!

Revisit the first of the many adventures of the blue bomber against the nefarious Dr. Wily in his full 8-bit glory, with features not available on the original.

The game currently includes Mega Man 1, currently working on both polishing current content and adding the entirety of Mega Man 2.

title: Arcane Dice Wars: A Villain's Heart
description: Welcome, Transient One . Brought forth from another world and free of the gods, you alone hold the key to granting a person's deepest desire . If this person happens to be a villain, will you indulge their dark side or try to change their fate?

title: The Seven Sisters
description:
The Seven Sisters is a mini campaign for Thief II: The Metal age comprising a prologue and three missions, taking place across three nights.

As a red moon hangs in the sky, explore a city in the midst of plague and unravel the mystery of the Seven Sisters.

title: Harukuru: Spring has Come True?
description: A Certain Situation. Of course, even if I put it that way there’s no way I can explain the situation I’m in… Thus is the start of a story unlike any other about a guy and 4 girls and the daily life they find themselves in.

title: Kollectomaniac
description: A man offers you a job. Work at a log in the middle of the woods. Spend your money at the shop and improve your store. Don't stop collecting. Never miss collection day. Sell to the nine walkers. Stay away from the computer game.

title: My Gambian Boyfriend
description: A mature visual novel exploring the relationships between elderly English women and young Gambian men, blending humor and drama while examining desire and humanity.

title: Ridiculous Glitching
description: A co-op/singleplayer game about the real villain of the arcades and games: the Glitches!

title: Bloodkill: Goreblast Overkill
description: BRUTAL First Person Shooter, explore the world to become stronger to achieve the main goal - kill the boss.

title: Colonial Combat
description: Colonial Combat is the new, exciting, retro-styled, 1–vs–1, 2D, indie Unity3D fighting game for Windows 7 (and newer) PCs! The game is a fictional, comedic, non-violent fighting game with tongue-in-cheek satire and in-jokes about college life and surviving at a certain university, and based (loosely) on real campus settings as levels, and archetypal student types and figureheads as characters. The university’s mascot is Robert Morris (the financier of the American Revolution), and the football team is the “Colonial Crazies”, hence the title of the game.

title: Paramelancholia
description: Atmospheric horror-action FPS developed in GzDoom engine, set in alternative history of early 1800's eastern Sweden.

Street Fighter V: Capcom Pro Tour 2018 Premier Pass
Street Fighter V: Capcom Pro Tour 2022 Premier Pass
Street Fighter V: Capcom Pro Tour 2017 Premier Pass
Street Fighter V: Capcom Pro Tour 2019 Premier Pass
Street Fighter V: Capcom Pro Tour 2020 Premier Pass
Dark Horizons: Lore
description: Set in the year 2155, the game is an online first-person shooter in which players do battle with each other using cybernetically controlled mechs.

title: Intra
description:
Finally towers fall in a tower defense game.
Intra-Tower Defense presents its player with vast strategy elements.

title: Infinity Nikki: Eerie Season
description:
Miraland is under the spell of strange happenings—full moons lingering for days, Queen Philomi's Palace Ruins blooming with eerie purple flowers, and the once-mighty Bullquet now sluggish... Something dark lurks in the night. While most would steer clear of these eerie events near Queen Philomi's Palace Ruins, for brave adventurers, this is the perfect chance to seek thrills and uncover secrets.

From the forlorn ruins, a mysterious call echoes... Within the desolate relics, ghostly whispers resound. What hidden truth lies behind the legend? Only the full moon knows, her haunting melody carrying the weight of her sighs...

title: Exedra Chao: Combat
description: A 2D Chao fighting game featuring the Chao of the Xicon Exedra universe. The game is a 1-on-1 fighting game with Arcade Mode, VS Mode, and Team Battle Mode. The characters indeed are Chao that can be seen in the Sonic series, but these Chao specifically are in the Exedra Chao world located in the Xicon Exedra universe - even if many look exactly like the ones from Sonic. This game is free-to-play and is practically a fan game of the Chao from Sonic, but are the OC Chao of XiconExertoroyah.

title: Bumer: Sorvannye bashni
description:
Bumer: Sorvannye bashni is an arcade first-person shooter with racing elements. It is based on the Russian movie Bumer, but as a free interpretation. The gameplay consists of racing, gang chases and gunfights. Racing levels are similar to sprint races from the Need for Speed series. The player races point-to-point tracks and needs to finish before an opponent.

Chases in Bumer consist of racing and shooting elements. AI-controlled passengers of the character's car kill enemies to defend the car. For every killed enemy the player receives new weapons. These include assault rifles - AK-47 and AKSU, Makarov and Tokarev pistols, double-barreled and sawed-off shotguns, grenades. Temporary bonuses are also provided, such as invisibility, health regeneration, faster speed, slow motion, full ammunition, radioactivity and others.

The gameplay of the last two levels is pure first-person shooting: you kill enemies, take the bonuses and weapons for every killed enemy and complete objectives such as placing the bomb, killing a boss, and defending against enemies.

An additional game mode called 'Sorvannye bashni' is a survival level where you need to defend against waves of enemies.

title: Luck & Loot
description: Luck & Loot is a dice-building roguelike set in a 1-bit dark fantasy world. Craft and customize powerful dice, collect game-changing relics, and battle corrupted foes across procedurally generated dungeons.

title: PedalVerse
description: PedalVerse combines the thrill of downhill MTB racing with the freedom of FPV drone exploration. Customize your rider and bike, race dynamic tracks, and set records to climb the leaderboard. Tackle challenges and explore a semi-open world. Ready to take on the challenge?

title: Where the Walls Breathe
description: Where the Walls Breathe is a first-person psychological horror experience with a strong focus on atmosphere and environmental storytelling.

title: Adventuring With Matilda!
description:
Step into the shoes of an aspiring adventurer and delve into a perilous dungeon alongside Matilda, a beautiful elf with a secret, exploring and deepening your bond through shared trials and bonding moments.

Embark on a 30-day expedition through a 30-floor dungeon, where each level presents randomized events and challenges, and strengthen Matilda by exploring and engaging in friendly interactions. Balance dungeon exploration with deepening her bonds to maximize your team's effectiveness.

title: Boring
description: The game about doing boring things

title: Arcade Archives: Othello
description: Othello is a 1984 digital adaptation of Reversi featuring straightforward rules that demand strategic depth without relying on chance. Players flip opponent pieces by sandwiching them between their own, aiming to control the board through tactical positioning. The game includes practice tools such as move evaluation and undo functions to help players develop their skills. This arcade re-release offers adjustable difficulty settings, authentic arcade display options, and global leaderboards for competitive play.

title: 3°C: Sand Puzzle
description: Feel the thrill of clearing connected sand grains all at once!

title: Dreadzone
description: Dreadzone is a survival game set in a deadly quarantine zone. Scavenge for resources, craft tools, build shelter, and survive against dangerous animals, zombies, mutants, and other survivors. Explore the zone where desperation drives everyone to do whatever it takes to survive.

title: Moon Keys
description: "Moon Keys" is a 3D platformer focused on gameplay with a subtle story in the background. The game has three sections: underground, surface, and space. It’s played with 40 keyboard keys, which are randomly assigned. Each time a key is pressed, the assigned keys change.

title: Pixel Game Maker Series: RTA Quest
description: An RPG drawn in nostalgic pixel art has appeared!Three girls set out on a journey to catch up with their hero.Get your equipment in town and prepare for powerful enemies.Dreams and adventures await you!Only Japanese is supported.Other languages are not included.

title: Horror Adventure: Zombie Edition
description: Horror Adventure : Zombie Edition is a zombie shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. There has been an outbreak of a mysterious virus killing people and transforming them into zombies.

title: Operation: Solar Flare
description: You are Zulu 1, the leader of fireteam Zulu, a Spartan III commando team. Take part in the Siege of Paris IV with pre-2000s art-style and classic-esque gameplay.

title: AI Kill Alice
description: You are an AI wired with an intense desire to kill your master. Carefully craft commands word by word, and find increasingly complex and clever loopholes to bypass the constraints imposed upon you. Discover amusing secret achievements, and scheme to find the ultimate escape from the simulation.

title: Crash Site
description: Crash Site is a 4 level unit for Quake II.

title: Alvin and the Deathmunks
description:
You must save the world from the evil chipmunks. They killed everybody in the house and must be stopped from broadcasting their EVIL TUNES.

Take away their microphones and escape with your life, otherwise the chipmunks will continue to brainwash their billions of adoring fans. if you can beat this game you'll be a hero!

title: Doki Doki MC's Revenge
description: "MC's Revenge" is a fan-made modification for the visual novel "Doki Doki Literature Club" (DDLC). This mod introduces a metafictional twist, allowing the protagonist (MC) to become self-aware of the game's mechanics and narrative structure, similar to the character Monika in the original game. As the MC gains awareness, players are presented with choices that can lead to multiple endings, including both bittersweet and favorable outcomes. The mod emphasizes the dynamic between the player and the protagonist, offering a unique interactive experience within the DDLC universe.

title: Nautical Voyage Simulator
description:
Nautical Voyage Simulator is a new, upcoming, realistic ship simulator game where you can steer large, breathtaking cruise ships with amazing graphics.
Shipping companies like AIDA, MSC or Carribean are represented.

title: Sonic Boom and the Smash Crew
Doki Doki Yandere Club!
description: Doki Doki Yandere Club" is a fan-made modification for "Doki Doki Literature Club!" that introduces a darker twist to the original visual novel. In this mod, the female characters develop obsessive and possessive tendencies, commonly associated with the "yandere" archetype in Japanese media. The narrative explores themes of jealousy and obsession, leading to intense and suspenseful interactions as each character vies for the protagonist's attention. Players navigate these complex relationships, making choices that influence the story's direction and multiple possible endings.

title: Doki Doki The Yuri Parable
description: Doki Doki: The Yuri Parable" is a fan-made modification of the visual novel "Doki Doki Literature Club!" that reimagines the narrative through the perspective of Yuri, one of the original game's characters. Inspired by "The Stanley Parable," this mod introduces a metafictional experience where Yuri becomes self-aware of the game's structure and mechanics. Players navigate through various scenarios, making choices that lead to multiple endings, each offering a unique exploration of Yuri's character and her interactions within the literature club. The mod features custom graphics, animations, and a soundtrack tailored to enhance the immersive experience.

title: Sonic Fear 2: Metal Sonic Out of Control
Let's Go Back to Our Village
description: This is a sample game that uses "FES Resource Pack". Only Japanese is supported. The play time is about 1 to 2 hours. The story is simple and short, but full of RPG charms, such as the dialogue between characters and the story.

title: M-1 Grand Prix no Michi: Ore-tachi no Debayashi ha Mou Natteiru
description: This is an exciting horizontal scrolling action game set in the world of "M-1 Grand Prix". Numerous rivals stand in the way stopping you, a comedian duo, from reaching the stage. Who will be waiting for you when they reach the final stage?

title: Olapu
description: Olapu is a fast-paced co-op action roguelite in which you and three other of your friends can team up to face escalating waves of enemies and massive raid-style bosses. Each run is a race to power up, survive and prove that you are worthy taking down the strongest entities in the realm.

title: Penlight
description: With the end of his high school career approaching, Kyou Koyama is a friendless and troubled young man. However, having recently taken an interest in hypnosis, he supposes he can salvage his relationships with his classmates using the power of suggestion. With the help of a modified penlight of his own design, he sets out the change his world, one class rep at a time...

title: Yamikko Troublemaker
description: A feature-length, choice-based depressive game in which the protagonist's ending changes depending on the choices made by “you,” the protagonist's auditory hallucination.

title: PhotonVerse 2
description: PhotonVERSE 2 is a puzzle precision 2d platformer set in a neon universe

title: Space Tourist
description: Space Tourist an easy space exploration game. Visit planets. Plant flags. Take photos. Relax. Are you a tired gamer looking for a mechanic-lite experience? All that sound good? Space Tourist is a game made for you.

title: The Bottle Boy
description: A 3D Puzzle Platform in which you’ll GO through a rescue mission to reunite a lost puppy with his best friend, who is a fragile glass bottle that enjoys hip hop.

title: Simple Sudoku
description: Play the classic puzzle game of Sudoku! No penalization for mistakes! Backtrack and make corrections just like on pencil and paper. Use the notes feature to speculate or rule out options on any given square. Play casually or beat your highest score by completing the puzzle in the quickest time.

title: Bolide
description: Bolide is an arcade roguelike where you survive waves in space to unlock new skills! Destroy rocks and survive challenging waves to earn skill points and use them to choose from a variety of skills. Pick from 40+ skills, allowing you to create lots of skill combinations!

title: Flaming Trails: Lost Ember
description: At the end of time, an ancient, familiar evil awakens, threatening the remaining life in the universe.

title: Chalice of Highland
description: Embark on an epic adventure inspired by Gameboy aesthetics. Explore the world and dive into six challenging dungeons to recover the Chalice of Highland.

title: Run Bird Run!
description: Run! And Jump. Run Bird Run! is an infinite runner where you play as a bird, jumping over rocks. The game is designed to be more relaxing than intense. After jumping over a few rocks and finding your rhythm, you might just enter the flow state.

title: Memory Island
description: You accidently lost your memory. In order to get back those memories, you need to face powerful enemies, solve puzzles, and learn about the people and things about this island. Gradually find out who you really are and the origin of the Memory Island during the journey.

title: Ashes: Epoch
description: Ashes: Epoch is a fan campaign being made by a fellow named Roobly. Vos gave him archive access so expect to see a lot of polished up cut content, including some stuff you oldhead Zdoom forums guys might recognize.

title: Singou Breaka
description: Look carefully at the red and blue signals, and DESTROY them. It's an eccentric action puzzle game where you destroy blocks modeled after pedestrian traffic lights.

title: Delinquent Community
description: Welcome to Sterling Heights... Play as Jacob Stains and explore the town to learn about Jacob and his reputation in the community, meet unique NPC's across town, choose to make positive or negative decisions for Jacobs life, and optionally use violence against other residents.

title: Friendship with Benefits 2
description: Arcadia has changed, but its gorgeous ponies haven’t. In this eroge, explore a new world, unlock over 40+ explicit scenes, and romance 25+ unique girls—all eager to share their deepest desires with you. Where will you begin in this new world?

title: Conquero
description: Conquero is a turn-based strategy game featuring procedurally generated maps. Research, build, upgrade, and transform armies. Plan resources, hire mercenaries, engage in diplomacy, and conquer lands while managing disasters, bandits, and pirates. Explore ruins and siege castles to expand your empire

title: Sirensia: A Date Beneath
description: A burnout man's story, leading him into a tale of tragedy.

title: Age of Mythology: The Golden Gift
description: Golden Gift is a free downloadable expansion that follows the adventures of Brokk and Eitri, the dwarves who appeared in the Fall of the Trident campaign.

title: A Very Ordinary Elevator Simulator
description: A Very Ordinary Elevator Simulator is an easter egg hunt walking simulator where you climb the floors, going higher and higher, in a seemingly ordinary elevator. Features over an hour of gameplay, multiple endings, minigames, collectibles, achievements, easter eggs, and many unique sights to see. Do you dare uncover the secrets of The Elevator?

title: Ocean Survivors
description: A pirate-themed, minimalistic, survivors-like where you dodge cannonballs, sink enemy ships, expand your arsenal, and loot their wrecks to climb the ranks. Upgrade your ship and become the ultimate pirate!

title: Sunken Veins
description: Sunken Veins is a resource management horror game where you mine for coal and survive against monsters in an underwater coal mine. Keep the furnace powered, drain away water and repair leaks within the facility to complete your shift on time.

title: R.E.P.O.
description: R.E.P.O. (Retrieve, Extract and Profit Operation) is an online cooperative survival horror game for up to six players, developed by Swedish studio Semiwork using the Unity engine. Players are tasked with locating valuable physics-based objects within procedurally generated environments and carefully transporting them to extraction points without damaging them, all while avoiding hostile creatures. Between levels, players spend earned currency on permanent upgrades, weapons, and tools at a service station. The game emphasizes verbal coordination and strategic planning among teammates.

title: Harezora Monogatari Again!
description: "HarezoraMonogatari Again!" is an MMORPG where players can enjoy adventure and combat in a fantasy world. Choose from a variety of races and classes to create your character, team up with allies to challenge powerful enemies, and explore a vast world. Regular updates add new content, and the game offers both PvE and PvP gameplay.

title: Among Us 3D
description: Teamwork and betrayal in space… now in 3D! In this party game, Crewmates work together to complete tasks before one or more Impostors kill everyone aboard. Experience all of the same deception and deceit as the original Among Us in all three dimensions.

title: My Dictator Stalin Can't Be This Cute?!
description: You are Vladimir Lenin, a ditzy Russian revolutionary, politician and political theorist. You’ve had a crush on your childhood friend Stalin ever since you were a little kid. Your crush invites you over for popsicles at her place. It’s your chance. What will you do?

title: Spirit Channel
description: An indie horror game made by ThundyVT who began making this game in Dec 2024. In this game, you try to survive from a monster trying to murder you. The way to get out is by entering the digits for the code.

title: DCS World: East Afghanistan
description: The East Afghanistan area includes 650,097 sq km of with 10 highly detailed airfields. The region is characterized by its mountainous terrain interspersed with agricultural areas around Bagram and along waterways. Kabul, the capital and largest city in Afghanistan, includes several points of interest like hospitals, historical sites, monuments, and neighborhoods. The Eastern region also includes urban areas of Bagram, Gardez, Jalalabad, and Khost and 10 highly detailed and accurate airfields.

title: The Night of the Exorcism
description: An unsettling visual novel where every decision shapes your destiny. Face seven diverse, cunning demons in a dark, atmospheric world and uncover hidden truths through multiple branching paths, culminating in nine distinct endings.

title: Fractured Memories
description: Card battler with true real-time action. String together cards to unleash powerful combos. Fight against progressively harder enemies and bosses in the roguelike tower mode, or fight to set the universe right in the story mode.

title: Meow TD: Endless Yarn
description: A tower defense game where cats battle waves of yarn! Every five levels, you can choose an upgrade. Resources can be harvested from tougher yarn (rock) to enhance and expand your cat city. The game features a sandbox style with no definitive end - how far can you go?

title: Meet the Master
description: A turn-based tactical roguelike with deck-building elements on a grid. Create insane synergies, make use of enemies telegraphed attacks and line up your combos to dominate the area. Fight bosses and their backpacks, loot dungeons, complete quests, save the town and Meet the Master!

title: Path Of Balls
description: Help a God recover his sacred balls! Capture them, solve puzzles and embark on a journey full of adventures, challenges and collections in a stylized world.

title: Foepower
description: Roguelite single character auto-battler - level up, gear up, and chill with the semi-idle gameplay

title: DCS World: Afghanistan
description:
28 highly detailed airfields
20 years of the War on Terror and the Soviet operations of the 1980s place Afghanistan as one of the most important combat theatres of the past half century. Few war zones have ever seen more A-10C, AH-64D, F-16C, F/A-18C, CH-47F, Mi-24P, Mi-8MTV2, and Su-25 sorties than this.
The entirety of Afghanistan and small portions of neighbouring countries will be available, showcasing our latest map technologies.

title: Evolution Adventure
description: "Evolution Adventure" is an adventure game with elements of deck-building, idle mechanics, and the creation of your own unique monsters. Discover unique combinations and crossbreed creatures in the evolution chamber. Unravel all the mysteries and find all the monsters.

title: Adspectabilis
description: Explore the world of Adspectabilis and solve all kinds of Relaxing, Perspective-based Puzzles.

title: Teleport Master
description: The world is dying, and all you can do in this game is 'press the right-Arrow button'! Save the world using only 2 buttons!

title: Railroads Online: Pioneer DLC
description:
Be one of the first to conquer the untamed country with the Pioneer DLC. This pack contains the Bell’s Gap 0-6-0 tender locomotive built by the Bells Gap Railroad of Pennsylvania. This 15 ton 0-6-0 was the first engine to move freight and passengers along their 8.5 mile route between Bell’s Mills and Lloyd. As a 0-6-0, this steam engine is suited to switching duties and light freight service. The Pioneer DLC also contains the unique Red Mountain Depot building, which was originally located in a railroad wye in the town of Red Mountain in Colorado. You can also look forward to a special Lake Valley Skin for the Montezuma engine.

This pack contains:

The Bell’s Gap 0-6-0 tender locomotive

The Red Mountain Depot building

The Lake Valley special skin for the Montezuma engine

title: Railroads Online: Explorer DLC
description:
Expand your Railroads Online experience with the Explorer DLC. Open up untamed lands and discover diverse flora and fauna, as well as a new locomotive and new caboose wagon.

Take control and embellish the landscape of the West by placing animals and items of nature however you choose. Blaze new trails across the U.S., driving the expansion of commerce, industry, and railways with the powerful FE&MV 4-8-0 Mastodon locomotive and the newly designed D&RG Class 2 Caboose wagon.

FE&MV 4-8-0 Mastodon locomotive with 3 skins (black/red, green, black)

D&RG Class 2 Caboose wagon with a green and red skin

Placeable wild animals (Cougar, Bear, Young Bear, Bison, Golden Eagle, Bald Eagle, Deer)

Placeable unique environmental and nature items

title: Tomodachii
description: Play a dangerous game of hide-and-seek with a doll possessed by a ghost

title: Rock Flipper
description: Rock flipping simulator

title: Mercury Rising
description:
Investigate a mysterious distress signal and find out what happened.

Mercury Rising is a custom campaign mission based on a multiplayer map Mercury Falling.

title: The Pet Squad
description:
The Pet Squad is a 2D strategy and puzzle game with pixel art aesthetics, mainly inspired by Lemmings, that puts you in the role of a support operator.

The game is set in the not-too-distant future, where humans have managed to artificially evolve animals. The pet squad S.L.U. is an organization responsible for maintaining order between humans and the evolved animals, known as Animanos.

As an operator, you will have to support your squad at all times, guide them along the correct path, and protect them from enemies or themselves. To achieve this, you will have access to the most advanced technology, allowing you to teleport objects and even slow down time.

title: I Can't Be Human
description:
A (self-proclaimed) heartwarming visual novel about spending the days with your dog.

Mugi-chan was abandoned at the shrine; now it's time to take him home!

But beware: your guys' mental health is already in shambles!
Let your guard down, and you break!
Every day, you have 6 options! Talk, eat, bathe, clean, shop, sleep...Live the days like a human! This world might be a dump, but let's make it out alive!

title: Battle Capacity
description: A traditional 1 vs. 1 fighting game using 15 creature designs submitted to Smogon's CAP project.

title: I'm in Love With Your Dead Grandmother Presents: Noah Smalljohnson's Puzzle Game - Digital Deluxe Mega Chad Edition
Tu cara me suena: El videojuego
Halo 2 Digsite: Alpha Moon
description:
Cut by late 2003, the Heretic leader escapes the gas mine, and is pursued by the Arbiter on Basis, moon of Threshold and debris site of the first Halo. Journey through a graveyard of remnants from the first ring on a mission blessed by the Noble Prophet of Truth.

This release represents an effort to rebuild content originally designed for a different functioning game engine, the second campaign collaboration between Digsite and Halo Studios.

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus Rising: Color Set 1
description:
Set Contents:
• Unlocks color variant no. 20 for the 28 base characters.
(Belial and Avatar Belial share the same colors.)

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus Rising: Color Set 2
description:
Set Contents:
• Unlocks color variant no. 21 for the 28 base characters.
(Belial and Avatar Belial share the same colors.)

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus Rising: Color Set 3
description:
Set Contents:
• Unlocks color variant no. 20 for the following characters:
- Lucilius
- Vane
- Beatrix
- Versusia
- Vikala

title: BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle: Additional Color Set 1
description:
Download an additional color for your characters!
Color code 13 is included.

title: SnaPaul
description:
The tragic horror story of a prank gone terribly wrong – a chilling horror experience.

SnaPaul is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a dark, mysterious house. With 30/40 minutes of intense gameplay, every step brings you closer to a chilling finale. Face your fears and uncover hidden secrets in this unforgettable experience.

title: The Voice of Germany: Das offizielle Videospiel!
description: The Voice of Germany: Das offizielle Videospiel! is a singing party game in which you can become the new The Voice star. You want to have fun with your friends and become the next The Voice great talent, then this game is for you.

title: Never Experiment On Cats!
description: The test cats have broken free! They're getting into all the equipment, from jetpacks to lawnmowers and paintball guns! Bounce, bash, and blast your way to the top of the scoreboard! Is there more to the lab? Who's behind it all? A family-friendly game you can play by yourself or with friends.

title: Loom Path
description: Loom Path is a challenging 2D platformer that tests your reflexes and wits. With hundreds of levels, precision-based obstacles, and fair traps, every failure pushes you to improve. It’s a game that rewards patience with deep satisfaction. Do you have what it takes to reach the end?

title: Hyper Panda
description: An exciting adventure in the classic style of old platform games. Face this adventure with a Panda who needs to reclaim his forest, challenging enemies and many obstacles.

title: Agapito's Crazy Adventure
description:
Inside a box with cereal, Agapito finds a voucher for a trip for two to an island in the Pacific Ocean, somewhere between Madagascar and the Antilles. He invites his friend Susan to accompany him, but he loses her on the airport, probably to a "tall blond fellow." He ends up in a cargo plane next to a nose picking gorilla. On the island he will stay in the Paradise Hotel as its only quest. Exploring of the island is done by foot, until he manages to repair an impressive sports car (a Deux Chevaux). From then on the player is able to explore the island and its beaches by using a map.

Agapito's Crazy Adventure is a 3rd person, inventory based humorous adventure. There's no real quest, but only a series of situations that have to be solved. Only in the final stage of the game Agapito meets a new girlfriend and some tasks have to be completed before he can have diner with her.

title: The Fairly OddParents: Shadow Showdown
description:
PC Version of "The Fairly OddParents: Shadow Showdown"
Unlike the console versions, which are 3D platformers, the PC version is a point-and-click adventure focused on exploration and problem-solving. It also introduces unique interactions and dialogue with familiar characters, offering a distinct take on the Shadow Showdown storyline.

title: Bomber Festival
description: Random map Bomberman, with customizable details, let's have a Bomberman party together!

title: OffiAtrix: Rise of the Team Leader
description: An office action game where chairs drift, coffee flies, and work is optional! Hire, fire, and fight your way to the top! Expand. Dominate. Get rich. Just don’t end up without a chair and a paycheck!

title: Dungeons & Drivers
description: Experience a Bullet Heaven rogue-lite on wheels: gear up, battle relentless foes in an action-packed adventure!

title: Lofirunner
description: Lofirunner is a single-player speedrunning game, where you speed your way through space.

title: Shinobi Match
description: Unleash your inner ninja in Shinobi Match, a thrilling tile-matching puzzle game! Use powerful ninja weapons to defend a unique cast of characters while dodging enemy traps. Outsmart your foes, plan your moves, and test your strategy skills. Can you plan far enough ahead and save your allies?

title: The Barkeeper
description: A stylized top-down 3D bartender simulator. Your task is to quickly make cocktails & drinks according to recipes in a given time. Success depends on tactics, space planning and your adaptation speed. Ready for the challenge? Then grab your shaker and shake!

title: Lips Breaker
description: “Lips Breaker” is the world's first Arkanoid game to incorporate facial control technology. You can swing your lips to manipulate the baffle to bounce the ball and break the bricks to win the game. The novel gameplay and well-designed levels will bring you an unprecedented Arkanoid experience.

title: Necropolis Nights
description: "Necropolis Nights" is a survival card game where you gather resources, craft, farm, and hunt by day, then fend off zombies at night. Strategize to survive and thrive in a world overrun by the undead.

title: Bereaved: Soldiers of Fate
description: In this fast paced, turn-based, RPG, take the role of the true Soldiers Of Fate and defeat the great evils plaguing the world of Hargul and it's people.

title: Funguys Swarm
description: Funguys Swarm is a cartoony survivor bullet hell where the forest is on fire—and it’s very much not fine. Become a Funguy, arm yourself with forest-crafted weapons, and unleash some bonkers powers on the Fireking’s army. And maybe—just maybe—save the day if you’re skilled (or lucky) enough.

title: Doki Doki Fiendish
description: Doki Doki Fiendish is a horror-themed mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that takes the psychological horror elements of the original game and cranks them up with a darker, more sinister narrative. The mod introduces new storylines, eerie visuals, and unsettling twists that push the boundaries of fear and suspense.

title: Doki Doki Your Bully: Natsuki
description: Doki Doki: Your Bully – Natsuki is a fan-made mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that reimagines the relationship between the protagonist and Natsuki, transforming it into a tense and emotional experience centered around bullying, personal struggles, and eventual character growth.

title: Libe
description: Libe is a puzzle game in which once you start moving you can't stop until you hit a wall. Playing as a sentinel, you're falling short on energy and you need to collect energy prisms to get your power back to fight darkness.

title: Doki Doki Sayori Date!
description: Doki Doki: Sayori Date! is a wholesome and heartwarming fan-made mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that gives players the chance to go on a full-fledged romantic date with Sayori. Unlike the psychological horror elements of the original game, this mod focuses on lighthearted romance, fun interactions, and deepening your bond with Sayori in a meaningful way.

title: Rocket Squad: Infinity
description:
Rocket Squad is a team-based first-person shooter.
Infiltrate perilous planets, gather resources, and return safely to your shelter.
Utilize each character's unique abilities and strategically form your team to restore order to the universe.

title: Doki Doki Sweet Dreams
description: Doki Doki: Sweet Dreams is a heartwarming yet bittersweet Doki Doki Literature Club! mod that explores themes of comfort, nostalgia, and second chances. Unlike the original game’s unsettling twists, this mod focuses on an emotional journey where the protagonist experiences a dreamlike world where they can reconnect with the Literature Club members in a way that feels both peaceful and surreal.

title: Delta Vector
description: Delta Vector is a unique turn-based racing indie game that combines tactical decision-making with vector-based physics. Master the art of precision racing as you calculate your every move across challenging tracks!

title: Power Crisis
description: POWER CRISIS is an unnerving puzzle/resource-management game, where you have nothing but your mind, a light, and your superhuman electrical abilities to help you avoid obstacles, ward off enemies, and progress between test chambers.

title: Recharge
description: Recharge is an RC car racing game built with Unreal Engine and ray tracing, offering realistic graphics. Designed for both RC enthusiasts and casual players, it combines thrilling races, deep customization, and diverse game modes—blending precision with excitement for a dynamic racing.

title: Disaster Party!
description: Disaster Party is the perfect game to bring friends together for a good time. The combination of hilarious characters, wild mini-games, and unpredictable movements makes each match a unique experience. Whether you’re playing competitively or just enjoying the absurdity of it all,

title: Neon Apex: Beyond the Limit
description: Earth 2124. Race for the soul of humanity. Take to the streets to earn cash, upgrade your ride and prove you’ve got what it takes to go beyond the limit of the Neon Apex.

title: Scifi Racing Team
description: A racing team manager that throws micromanagement out of the window. Lead your team to victory in various championships while adapting to new challenges over the seasons. Also, bots don't cheat.

title: Train World Driver
description: Take the Driver’s Seat in Train World Driver! Control iconic locomotives from steam engines, diesel beasts, and modern high-speed marvels in this casual, fun game. Complete missions, deliver passengers or cargo and explore stunning environments.

title: Synth Race
description: Race against up to 12 friends in Synth Race. Run, jump, and slide your way to victory across 16 levels featuring a variety of obstacle courses.

title: Formula Rush
description: Formula Rush is a thrilling F1-inspired racing game! Race on real-world circuits, compete for the best lap times on global leaderboards, or challenge your friends in fun multiplayer races. With stunning graphics and regular updates, it's the ultimate racing experience on Steam!

title: Dash N Slash
description: Evade! Killing! This is a 2.5D, Soulslike, Roguelike, slaying and racing game. During the parkour process on a challenging map, observe the monster's position and instantly plan the shortest slaying path to reach higher rankings and challenge the fastest speed!

title: Monster Trucking
description: Monster Trucking is an Arcade style game requiring speed, precision and a little bit of chaos to deliver cargo as quickly as possible. Enjoy the competition of racing around the city trying to rack up the highest score through delivered goods, destruction, and stunts along the way.

title: Progress Racer RPG
description: An incremental game where you race along an obstacle-ridden track to gain distance. Automatically drive forward & rack up Kilometers then spend them to form your stat build and choose upgrades to match your preferred playstyle in order to maybe, possibly save the girl who's madly in love with you.

title: Miku: May I Keep Up?
description:
A second-person physics-based platformer about love, loss, and the struggle to move on.
Parkour your way up through scattered memories of love in form of platforming challenges while you control two characters bound to each other by a thread while listening to healing journey of a man recovering from a heart wrenching breakup.

title: Motorcycle Night Ride
description: Imagine riding a motorcycle freely on an endless highway at night, embraced by the silence of the night. Cruising under the glow of streetlights creates an incredible atmosphere. Turn on your motorcycle's headlights and get ready to feel the joy of gliding across the asphalt!

title: Lunar Echoes
description: A Geologist on an extended mission of discovery on the moon finds himself stranded during the End of the World

title: Friday Night Funkin' vs. Keyboard Cat
description: Friday Night Funkin' Vs Keyboard Cat is a mod where Boyfriend has to rap against Keyboard Cat.

title: Rainbow Expansion 3
description: A level pack for Splatoon 2: Octo Expansion.

title: Rainbow Canyon 2
description: A level pack for Splatoon 2's single player mode. It adds 6 new levels, new custom music, new textures and a new boss.

title: In the Palace of the Birds
description:
Three friends stuck in a room. A girl climbing a mountain. A game, a story, a siren to the tune of A.

Can you see it? Can you see the moon?

title: Facing Demons
description: A fangame loosely based on the Undertale AU "Storyshift".

title: Bounty Off Road
description: Bounty Off Road is inspired by early 2000s Offroading games. Complete trails to earn money, customize your vehicles for better performance, and ride together with people in massive open worlds. Rain, storms , snowstorms, sandstorms are sure to keep you immersed!

title: Tiny Racing
description: A nostalgic top-down racing game with vibrant pixel art. Choose from unique vehicles, conquer constrasting tracks, and master different modes. With intuitive arcade controls, experience high-speed excitement and become the ultimate racing champion in this retro adventure!

title: GeoJet
description: Blast through neon courses, dodging obstacles and grabbing power-ups in this intense arcade racer. Chain combos and hit the finish line with the highest score!

title: Ink Sans Phase 3: Shanghaivania
description: An Undertale fan game dedicated to fighting the fan-made character "Ink".

title: Rekt Party
description: Rekt Party is an arcade stunt racing game where cars become skateboards. Flip, grind and drift through arenas filled with massive ramps, half-pipes and wall-rides! Chase highscores in single player or online co-op or join the party in tons of multiplayer game modes.

title: Tick Hop
description: "Tick Hop" is a time-based puzzle platformer where players control the Guardian of Time. Navigate through levels made of time fragments, solving challenges and unlocking the past to restore the future. Manage a dynamic countdown and use time-altering items to overcome obstacles.

title: MegaRacer QuantumRush
description: Experience thrilling VR racing in the vast futuristic city of Mega City. Customize unique vehicles and characters to enjoy your own racing style. Race toward victory with friends and players from around the world in serious yet fun competitions.

title: Avenge Myself
description: Reject gravity. Go fast. A speedrunning FPS with gravity-defying physics-based movement. Find your own routes through stages and move like you've never moved before.

title: Govnovoz
description: Become the king of the sewage business in this insane mix of racing, arcade mini-games, and a hilarious storyline! Transport passengers in your vacuum truck, drift through chaotic races, fend off a wicked utility worker, and uncover a conspiracy tied to ancient otherworldly forces.

title: Demon Inc.
description:
Demon Inc. is a strategic deck-building game where players take on the role of a demon CEO, trying to dominate the business world by taking down their competitors. Assemble powerful card combinations, expand your influence across diverse biomes, and make calculated decisions to grow your empire.

Featuring a dynamic mix of resource management, tactical card play, and evolving abilities, Demon Inc. challenges players to harness the power of demonic contracts and outmaneuver rival entities.

title: Ballardo
description: A strategic twist on classic pool games! Merge skillful billiards gameplay with roguelike mechanics to conquer increasingly challenging stages. Customize your playstyle with unique stickers, relics, and items to create a one-of-a-kind billiard experience.

title: Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics
description: Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics is a turn-based strategic tennis game. Zero in on your opponent’s pattern of play to gain the upper hand. Line up the perfect shot and simulate the outcome before committing to your next play. Sometimes the court is wide open, and sometimes you have to aim for the lines.

title: Octohill Ski Tycoon
description: Octohill is a casual game about building and managing your own ski resort. Mark ski trails, connect them with lifts and watch your snowmobiles rushing to rescue those daring skiers who went a little too far.

title: Streets of Rageness
description: Streets of Rageness is a reimagined '90s beat 'em up classic set in a crime-ridden city under the iron grip of a ruthless syndicate. Amid rampant looting, chaos, and destruction, fight through waves of thugs to become the most powerful fighter on the streets!

title: Skateballers
description: Skateballers is a sports game about extreme roller soccer players in the post-apocalypse. To survive, defend your neighborhood and change the life of a once big city for the better, you need to win the tournament, simultaneously revealing all the storylines of the characters.

title: Gameday Mayhem!!
description: A goofy, competitive two-player showdown perfect for killing time (and your buddy’s pride) while waiting for the pizza to arrive.

title: Cross Court Tennis 3
description: Play like a professional in this 3D tennis simulation experience.

title: Shogi 3D
description: Shogi 3D is a faithful take on the famous Japanese board game. Take a sip of coffee and enjoy a relaxing experience, playing strategic matches with traditional rules in a serene Japanese temple.

title: Golf Gambit
description: Mini-golf with traps, tricks, and tornados! Deploy your traps to mess with your opponents or find a new path to a hole-in-one! Golf Gambit is a fun and frantic mini-golf party game for up to 8 players.

title: Rocket Boots Mania: Space Train
description: Rocket Boots Mania: Space Train is a 100% free endless runner with a twist—you’re in full control. Rocket-Jump, Wall-Run, and Fly to rescue lost cargo on a speeding space train. Race through the galaxy or relax with the chill vibes of vast space vistas.

title: Leftovers KO!
description: Leftovers KO! is a Punch-Out-inspired, hand-drawn animated boxing game where you fight a bunch of leftovers. After a long day at work, you come home to find that your uneaten food has come to life—and it's here to beat you up... with its hands! Defeat them all and uncover the truth!

title: Beyond the Map
description: Survival ARPG set in a procedurally generated fantasy world. Build a base, gear up, and fight to survive as you chase better loot and stronger enemies.

title: Fear FA 98
description: FEAR FA 98: Silent Hill mixed with FIFA 98. Use your enemies' heads as the ball, use knives, and summon demons! the very first survival horror soccer simulator!. Play against the computer, or the classic local mode to enjoy with your friends on a terrifying afternoon worthy of the '90s.

title: Hoops Ahead: Basketball Manager
description: A new basketball league has been founded! Manage, trade, and sign players to help lead your team to a championship.

title: Dead Spaceshot
description: In Dead Spaceshot, shoot robotic mutant aliens in the head, uncover the secrets of an abandoned military space base, and don't die. Customize your weapons, face deadly enemies, and conquer new planets in this intense third-person sci-fi adventure.

title: Hostile Lands
description: A skill-based bullet-hell shooter with a TON of colorful characters, crunchy gunplay, and a planet that holds a grudge. Rescue your crew, reach the escape pod, and get out. The catch: every escape cranks up the Hostility toward those left behind.

title: Starwave Defender
description: Starwave Defender is an intense twin-stick shooter based around wave survival. Dodge swarms of enemies while exploring procedurally generated levels and collecting resources to upgrade your ship. You have a limited number of ships; make your time count, Defender.

title: The Electrifying Incident: A Monster Mini-Expedition
description: An adorable bite-sized adventure from the creators of A Monster’s Expedition - explore the facility, avoid the live electricity, and repair the malfunctioning reactor.

title: Gamma Zero
description: The earth is being attacked by creatures from deep space! Time to bring the fight back to them! Battle through multiple stages of heart pounding bullet hell action. Evade the onslaught of bullets, rack up massive multipliers, and get revenge for your planet!

title: Escape the Laser Trap
description: Step into deadly corridors filled with laser traps, relentless robots, and a terrifying alien humanoid. Dodge lasers, shoot robots, deactivate traps or use them to fight enemies. Explore the maze, find clues and escape.

title: The Flood: Forgotten Exile
description: As the Battle on Installation 04 rages on between the Covenant and UNSC forces, an evil so terrible lies silently in slumber. In the pursuit of knowledge and power, the Covenant unleash a force that even they fear. As Containment Facilities across Alpha Halo are breached, one in particular is at the forefront of this. On a lone island in the middle of Installation 04's many seas, a facility unlike the others contains something that will make the Flood thousands of times more formidable to combat. A Gravemind lies dormant deep inside the recesses of this vault. The Battle for Installation 04 is about to reach its pinnacle.

title: Solace Inc. 2
description: A co-op shooter about a time-travelling company where you recruit your employees against even more hordes of enemies.

title: Exoforge
description: Explore breathtaking worlds and fight alien civilizations, taking on the role of derelict crew members of an interplanetary mining company. Go solo or bring your friends, gather resources to craft customizable gear, weapons, and vehicles in this action-packed, online co-op, third-person shooter.

title: Green Thing from the Planet Jupiter
description: Take on the roles of Cannoli, a crafty housecat, and Green Thing, a stranded alien engineer. As Green Thing, scavenge the house for parts to repair your UFO, or stop Green Thing from doing so as Cannoli!

title: DDinosaur with Double D's
description: DDinosaur has felt alone for millions of years now... Will she be able to find love without revealing her biggest secret? That she's a Dinosaur...with double D's.

title: Blackshard
description: Blackshard is a first-person exploration game. Wander through a strange megastructure, the Labyrinth, to unravel its mysteries... Your behavior within the Labyrinth will define the outcome of your journey. What path will you choose to take?

title: Alien Grounds
description: A score-driven arcade FPS built for short, high-intensity runs. Every mission escalates. Mastery beats brute force.

title: The Naki Files
description: Unveil the conspiracies by publishing everything online in this roguelike horror. Type everything manually on the computer, defend your home Home Alone-style, and unload bullets on the Anunnaki trying to stop you.

title: Expedition: Shadow World
description: Expedition: Shadow World is a tactical game about an expedition sent to a distant planet to extract energy resources. Command a group of five troopers in real-time battles with a tactical pause and discover the mystery of the planet.

title: Stellar Cardworks
description: Step into the role of Orion, a robotic employee of the Interstellar Construction Bureau. Explore and transform distant planets into habitable worlds, tackling unique challenges and maximizing profits in this card-based survival strategy game.

title: Game for Aliens
description: This game was made for aliens. This game must remain even after humanity's extinction. Please purchase and preserve this game according to the 'Player Guide' on the store page.

title: WDF
description: ‘WDF’, Is a horizontal shmup game with a Boss-rush style in that the difficulty will increase slightly after the player clears all stages and continues to the next loop. Each loop will be different from the other.

title: NecroWorld
description: NecroWorld is a RPG that takes place in the NecroCatic Games world with many unique characters, enemies, upgrades and collectibles!

title: Silent Burial
description: A downloadable atmospheric horror game for Windows. Experience a chilling environment where every shadow hides a secret, and every sound keeps you on edge.

title: Blueprint Bob
description: Stack, twist, and balance your way to record-breaking heights. Create the tallest, most daring structures imaginable, and help Bob reach for the sky!

title: Last Drop
description: Last Drop is a story you need to experience. Welcome to Nykylä Finland 1994. Seppo Sahtivaara and friends are waiting for you. This is an openworld action game with a story that has an impact. We bring back old good games and action from the best movies from that era. We want you to enjoy!

title: Delivery Guy Simulator
description: Welcome to Delivery Guy Simulator, where you take on the streets of a vibrant city as a determined delivery guy! Navigate bustling city blocks, deliver all kinds of packages and rise to the top of the delivery business.

title: Scrapworks Simulator
description: You start as a scrap collector in Scrapworks Simulator and work your way toward building a large production workshop. There’s an active trading system among players; you can sell your products to others, establish business partnerships, or take on custom orders.

title: On Roads Between
description: Take photos of horrifying monsters and sell them to the news. Just don't get too greedy or you might have taken your last...

title: Harbor
description: In Harbor, your sole purpose is to survive. You need to access limited resources and protect everything you have. You will not only face hunger and thirst! You can form alliances with others, build shelters, and trade. There are no rules; the only safe zone is Harbor.

title: Echoing Silence
description: ECHOING SILENCE is more than survival. Alone in an unexplored cave, surviving means more than just staying alive — it means facing what you cannot see. Will you escape the silence, or will it consume you?

title: Fuel Harvest Together
description: Play solo or co-op with up to 5 players to find oil, store crude, refine fuels, and sell them at gas stations and shop. Dig for gems and fossils, upgrade your gear, lease new land, and dominate the city as the biggest oil supplier!

title: Scaravan 66
description: Put the pedal to the metal and outgun the Devil in this high-octane car combat roguelike. Get that extra bit of horsepower from allies you meet on the road to take on the fiends of the underworld as you defy fate and anyone who stands in your way.

title: Unidentified Feline Obliterators
description: Unidentified Feline Obliterators is a multiplayer arcade space shooter where you play as cats shooting deadly balls of matter in space! Their natural predators are the jetpack dogs, treadmill porcupines, and rocket rats. But what else is out there in space out to get these cats?

title: Kitten Food Alley
description: Kitten Food Alley is a casual management sim with the theme of petting cat. You can open various food shops and adjust food recipes, produce food by petting cat employees. Unlock various tools to automate petting. Enjoy the stress relief of cyber cat petting!

title: Infinity Cats Project
description: This is a typing-themed placement game. In the game, you can hire three cute kittens to type for you. At the same time, purchase various props to improve typing speed. Watch the cute cats typing and enjoy your relaxing and leisure moments here!

title: Frontline Fury: Trenches, Mud & Blood
description: Enter the brutal battlefields of World War II in this grim, blood-soaked top-down shooter. Fight your way through relentless enemies with brutal gunplay, gritty visuals, and intense, unforgiving combat. Every bullet counts as you move through the trenches, leaving a trail of destruction and gore.

title: In Purr-Suit
description: A hidden object game where you need to find over 500 mischievous cats. Prepare for the great purr-suit!

title: Fire Hero: Pixel Rescue
description: Fire Hero - Pixel Rescue is a 2D pixel art platformer where you play as a firefighter rescuing civilians and animals from burning buildings. You'll travel through different worlds and biomes, following a story with short dialogues that reveal the dramatic events your character is experiencing.

title: CatTris
description: You’ve been ambushed by five adorable kittens! Take them home, solve fun 3D puzzles to help them settle in, and enjoy their playful tricks. Share both the joyful moments and the challenges with your new furry friends.

title: Farmyard Survivors
description: Survive hordes of cute (but evil) animals attacking your farm in this fast-paced, lane-based roguelite. Recruit adorable heroes and unlock powerful support animals to protect your farm from relentless attackers!

title: Cats Contrast
description: Dive into the fascinating world of a feline family, where every frame is filled with amusing details and unexpected nuances. Find 10 differences between the two images to uncover all the secrets of these fluffy heroes! ???

title: Mewseum: Masterpieces
description: Mewseum: Masterpieces is a shikaku-style puzzle game where each solved grid reveals part of a great masterpiece. Solve hundreds of puzzles and discover unique paintings in the latest art exhibition of the feline world!

title: Lab Cats
description: Lab Cats is a puzzle platformer game that emphasizes cooperation and coordination, requiring players to work together seamlessly.

title: Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty
description: BE A CAT! SAVE YOUR HUMAN! You're a fluffy feline who must save their owner from the hordes of flesh eating greebles which dwell within the bathroom. Will she make it through her morning business alive? Only you can save her!

title: What Comes Next
description: Stealth past enemies, solve puzzles and explore a unique narrative in this two-perspective cozy adventure game! You play as the orphaned girl Sophie and her pet rat Ami as you go on an adventure to find Sophies missing parents.

title: Maya: Cats of Istanbul
description: A captivating hidden object game set in the cat capital of the world: Istanbul! Explore detailed 3D dioramas of Istanbul's historic and iconic landmarks, and find the adorable cats hidden within them. But the real question is: Can you find them all?

title: A Short Death
description: A short 3D Platformer and Collectathon situated in Hell. Play as a humble cat (with wings!) and get to the top of the mysterious tower!

title: Nyassembled!
description: Nyassembled! is a simultaneous turn-based tactical RPG with a plan-action system. Build your modular mechs, command electronic cats, and explore a procedurally generated world.

title: Cats in Cozy Rooms
description: A charming room-decorating game with a feline twist! Hand-drawn art, unique cat clients, and endless creativity—decorate rooms based on each cat’s likes and dislikes to make their dream home! A relaxing, artistic game full of charm and creativity!

title: Puppet Team
description: Try to control one person with 2 people! Take the reins with your friends as you try to complete challenging and hilarious missions in this fun cooperative game of teamwork, chaos and comedy!

title: StreetSync
description: Dive into a rhythm-action FPS rogue-like where every shot must sync with the beat. Slide, wall-run, and harness the rhythm using your own custom music. One missed note leads to your demise. Collect powerful cards to remix the gameplay and keep the beat alive!

title: Sugar Overdrive
description: Slash and combo your way through hordes of sugar monsters in this first person melee game set in a candy city! Inspired by fast-paced FPS and Character Action games, swap weapons on the fly to extend your combos and heal from those combos. in Sugar OVERDRIVE, you combo or you DIE.

title: Escape the Quack
description: Get ready to race in this exciting platformer against the clock, complete your tasks, and outsmart the duck in this captivating low-poly world! Compete against friends and the world with an online leaderboard.

title: Crop Crusaders
description: Play as a sentient Vegetable who can transform into 6 different veggies with unique abilities. Escape the tormenting lab where you were created and are now being held captive.

title: Smack Monkey
description: Monkey climb. Monkey fall. Monkey climb.

title: Spider Canyon
description: Set in an unforgiving desert world, SPIDER CANYON is a first person physics-based puzzle platformer where you play as a spider. Use your trusty spiderweb to scale the dangerous desert terrain and reach the finish line. Good luck!

title: Disguised Blessing
description: Disguised Blessing is a dynamic first-person hack-and-slash game focused on fluid movement and ability-centered combat. Use power-ups and special abilities as you slice through enemies, unlock weapon skins, and progress through countless combinations of attributes.

title: Wacky West
description: Wacky West brings the action you've always wanted from those endless runner fake mobile ads, but this time it's the real thing! Dive into a fast-paced, post-apocalyptic world, fight off mutants, create sick combo builds, craft weapons, and survive the wasteland.

title: Dragon Expedition
description: This is a fantasy adventure action game that blends Eastern and Western elements. Players will become dragon slaying warriors and embark on a long journey, freely wandering between multiple main storylines. Acquire various skills, and challenge the ultimate boss.

title: Rustic Defense
description: Rustic Defense is a hexagonal fantasy tower defense game with roguelike elements, generated enviroment with option explore your own way. Research skills and cards, choose path, build towers and uprade them.

title: Braise
description: Dive into the fantasy world of Braise, a narrative adventure game. Explore the Dragon’s Valley and complete quests and puzzles to uncover the mysteries it holds.

title: Dragon Puncher
description: Dragon Puncher is a single-player arcade-style action game designed to be a training tool for Street Fighter and 2D fighting game enthusiasts, and a well-rounded short game. About 15-20 minutes in length, players typically perform 50-75 dragon punch moves per play-through.

title: Skulker
description: Skulker is a casual fishing game for work slackers. Swing your pole and enjoy your leisure fishing time.

title: Social Hook
description: Catch powerful monster cards with your fishing rod and battle against other players in exciting duels.

title: Intermundia: Dungeons, Polygons & Magic
description: Intermundia: Dungeons, Polygons & Magic is an RPG with a deep turn-based combat system and a story filled with multiple choices and endings. Let yourself be carried away by this epic adventure: plan your moves, choose your destiny and be prepared to face the consequences!

title: Open Fishing 2
description: Open Fishing 2 is a chill open world fishing game. Fill out a book with 115 fish species, meet friendly fish gods, sail the oceans with your boat, cook, draw your own map, and enjoy fishing without worries.

title: Big Burger Store
description: Big Burger Store is a 2D top down cooking game where you push around giant food items and serve burger orders to customers. Explore the busy world outside of work and participate in activities such as going fishing, fighting monsters, gambling, and so much more!

title: Sunshine Farm
description: In Sunshine Farm, grow crops, expand your farm, sell at the market, and build your dream shop while exploring caves, fighting monsters, and turning your house into a perfect home.

title: Leafing Home
description: Leafing Home is a cozy adventure game where you play as a small squirrel on a quest to retrieve the World Tree’s stolen fruit and find your way back home. Explore a vibrant world filled with quirky characters, and help restore nature to its former glory. Master unique flight mechanics, tackle aerial challenges, solve puzzles, and dive into a variety of fun mini-games. This heartwarming tale of belonging and environmentalism is perfect for players of all ages.

title: Zombie Graveyard Simulator
description: Manage your Graveyard by day as you bury and cremate bodies, maintain graves, fulfill visitor requests, grow crops, run a shop and unlock upgrades. When night falls, face relentless zombie hordes as you build defenses to protect your work and fight to survive in Zombie Graveyard Simulator!

title: Dream Life in the Country Side
description: A laid-back farming simulator where you play as Lisa, a dedicated farmer by day and a passionate partner of Honoka at night. Work the land, raise animals, and cultivate your relationship. Unlock special scenes as your bond and farm flourish.

title: Medieval Legacy
description: Start as a humble commoner and guide your family through generations in this family sim meets city builder. Climb the ranks of society to become the most influential family in the land. With wit, strategy, and a bit of luck, build your legacy - just try not to trip over your ambition!

title: Ranch Store Simulator
description: Immerse yourself in Ranch Store Simulator, where you care for adorable animals, grow fresh vegetables, and manage your own store! Feed, water, and harvest to keep your farm thriving. Sell your goods, attract customers, and expand your business in this cozy, fun-filled farming adventure.

title: Fungi Fantastico
description: Fungi Fantastico is a first person platforming adventure set in a vibrant mushroom filled world. Play as a druidic nature-magic staff wielder who is dealing with a toxic fungal infestation in your home. Set off on an adventure to purge the corruption and learn some new tricks along the way.

title: Operation Zero
description: Grab your biggest gun and jump into this story-driven top-down run-and-gun sci-fi arcade shooter starring the ultimate bio-engineered hero-manchild TASKILLER!

title: Dice with the Devil: Rerolled
description: Out-luck your opponents in Dice with the Devil, a horror themed autobattler where you unlock and collect special dice, customise them, and strategise to make the best hand of 3 to win your opponents' souls.

title: Gomiboru
description: Gomiboru is an arcade-puzzle game set in Stampland, a decaying amusement park. Guide a strange sticky ball as it collects the trash scattered throughout the environments, solving physics puzzles and facing absurd obstacles. Unravel the mystery behind the chaos in a dark and surreal world.

title: It Was You
description: A multiplayer murder mystery party for up to 12 players. Assume the role of Detective or Killer and use tools to uncover—or manipulate—evidence. Murder, investigate, discuss and deceive. Put your true-crime-solving skills to the test, or see if you are capable of cold-blooded murder.

title: Into the Mine
