description: Take a late-night ride in Synthwave Tunnel! Race through neon-lit, rhythm-generated paths, pushing your reflexes to the limit. Speed through dynamic obstacles, synced to the beat, and conquer the ultimate challenge. Can you reach the end?

title: Insect Empires
description: A cartoon style Isometric real-time strategy game about colony type insects. Choose between 4 factions and wage war against your enemies.

title: Boogey Hunters
description: Boogey Hunters is a strategic ammo-building game where you travel the world hunting mythical creatures from different folklore. Plan your moves carefully, combine bullets to unleash powerful moves, battle terrifying boogies, and save the world in the shortest day possible!

title: Starfell
description: Starfell is a fun adventure game where dreams and reality intertwine. Explore a whimsical land of hilarious adventures, compelling choices, and charming characters. You can stay or go, but a whispering voice hints that leaving might be the right choice.

title: Regista
description: Be the owner of your football club, make strategic choices, and climb through the amateur league to the first while making hard decisions.

title: Agent Dunoz
description: In a dystopian world ruled by megacorporation's, you're a mercenary with a $15,000 debt. Face dice-based combat, moral dilemmas, and irreversible choices in this hardcore Sci-Fi Cyberpunk Text RPG. Will you reclaim your freedom or vanish in the shadows?

title: My Chandroid Sweetheart
description: Explore a cute futuristic metroidvania world and solve challenging puzzles with your robot girlfriend. Along the way, gather useful upgrades, encounter quirky characters, and restore power to the city!

title: Nuclear Tides
description: A minimalist game of building and defending an isolated island after a nuclear apocalypse.

title: Magic Construct
description: Magic Construct is an action-survival game where you freely edit skills. Upgrade, make fateful choices, and use a simple connection mechanic to create unique skills. Survive and grow stronger in a challenging world.

title: Trizon
description: Trizon is a roguelike deck-building game. Fuse any two cards together to play crazy combos. Encounter strange events, formidable foes, and perhaps some charming companions as you venture deeper, ultimately uncovering the truth behind it all.

title: Umbral Astral Dreamers
description:
In the space between the tangible and the intangible exist "a bridge" that connects both realities. This bridge is called Umbral.

The Umbral is a mysterious place protected by autonomous machines made of sand and silicon called Astrals.

You take control of Aysel, a new astral on her first mission.
What will be your mission? Can you achieve it without dying in the attempt?

title: Murder Inc
description: Murder Inc is a top-down adrenaline-fueled shooter where time moves only when you do. Use this to dodge bullets, plan your attacks, and craft action scenes worthy of a blockbuster.

title: The Last Caretaker
description: The Last Caretaker is a thoughtful take on the survival-crafting genre, where every decision you make and every action has a consequence. Immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted world where the fate of humanity rests in your hands. Your mission is clear: recover human seeds, reactivate the Lazarus Complex, and launch the last of humanity to the stars.

title: Sky Lanes
description:
Sky Lanes is an homage to the 90s MS-DOS arcade racing game Skyroads.
You race on straight courses, evade obstacles and jump onto different lanes.

The game supports ray-traced reflections and ambient occlusion, but it's not a requirement and can be disabled.

title: The Bear: A Story from the World of Gra
description: Home is where the stars are. An interactive bedtime story, for anyone who needs one. Take the bear and the little one on a deeply meaningful journey, as you experience stories of togetherness, of letting go and of finding a place you belong.

title: Void/Breaker
description: VOID/BREAKER is an Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS. Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through environmental destruction/BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK THE SEQUENCE /BREAK FREE

title: Doki Doki: Spark of Hope
description: Doki Doki: Spark of Hope is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that offers a unique and exciting approach to the universe of the original game. Unlike the dark psychological experience of the DDLC, this mod seeks to bring a new perspective, focusing on themes of hope, overcoming and the emotional development of the characters.

title: Mini Merchant
description: Saddle up your Caravan Demon and journey out to explore the Land Of The Ancient King! Explore beaches, meadows, tundra and desert to buy, sell, uncover and unlock items, and become the richest merchant in the land! A classic collect-a-thon adventure RPG, from Astrarium Games.

title: Catalyst: From the Stars
description: Catalyst: From the stars, a Boss-Rush First person shooter. As a lone mercenary sent into a ruined military base hired to steal a power source, you must fight for your life through dark halls and thrilling boss arenas to complete your mission! Do you have what it takes to face the Catalyst?

title: Defying the Shadows
description: Embark on a tactical roguelite adventure where you assemble your team of heroes to battle the Shadow army in turn-based combat. Test your strategy, adaptability and progress through the game to upgrade your characters and unlock new ones, shaping your ultimate squad for the battles ahead!

title: Tale of Dark Lands
description: Tale of Dark Lands is a fantasy action RPG in a charming low-poly style with the spirit of an old fairy tale. A brave mercenary gets drawn into an ancient dark story that threatens the entire land. Develop your hero and fight dangerous enemies! Become a legend and stop the approaching darkness!

title: Sky End Market
description: Set up shelves, arrange products, and make your store bigger and bigger. Sell your goods to the remaining people, animals, and robots in the last place on earth just before the human race is exterminated.

title: Play Twice
description: "Enjoy Twice" – A new Sokoban-style puzzle game, Play Twice! Once you clear a stage, a second playthrough begins on the same board. Enjoy a dual-layered puzzle experience where strategic planning for the second round is the key to success!

title: Eternal Prowl
description:
After many years, you return to your hometown, but nothing is as you remember it. The streets are empty, familiar places feel distant, and the past seems to have faded away. The old school bus is your only clue, leading you deeper into a mystery that begs to be solved.

Immerse yourself in an emotional journey filled with forgotten memories and unsettling discoveries. As you explore an abandoned house, you’ll uncover hidden secrets and solve a crucial puzzle that reveals the truth behind the town’s eerie transformation.

title: Shrine of the Forest God
description: Explore and fight your way through a dense and sprawling world filled with mystery. Take your checkpoint with you while discovering secrets and abilities as you fight your way up the mountain you found yourself in. Do you have what it takes to slay the Forest God?

title: Deforb
description: Deforb is a roguelite top-down shooter game where a mad orb defends its tower using up to four melee guns, a long-range gun, and strategically placed turrets. Upgrade your skills and craft powerful builds to survive relentless waves of enemies.

title: House of Decay
description: Welcome to the demons world! I don't know how you managed to get here, but it was a stupid idea on your part. It's a shame your brother was taken by demons, but do you really think you'll be able to find him? Is it really worth it? Well, it's none of my business. All you have to do is explore this wonderful world, and who knows, maybe you'll survive or even meet someone.

title: Dustbound
description: Build your deck, craft overpowered cards, and command up to five customizable drones. Adapt, strategize, and fight your way through the unforgiving desert.

title: Vasterra
description: Enter the world of Helheim and build your village on a desolate island in the underworld of Norse mythology. Improve and maintain your village by gathering resources and defending it from enemy attacks. Can you thrive in the realm of the dead?

title: 101 Cats in Orlando
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Orlando landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Roll a Dice
description: "Roll a Dice" is a dice game full of strategy and luck, combining classic props and set effects. In this 8x6 building table, players need to roll dice, activate cells, and trigger different effects to accumulate points and challenge higher goals.

title: Undercover Fools
description: Infiltrate a secure building, cleverly bypass guards and traps, complete tasks with the help of cool spy gadgets. Play alone or with friends, upgrade your spy skills and plan excellent missions, and most importantly... Don't screw up!

title: Soul Trader
description: Welcome to the NecronomiCon: The most anticipated convention for necromancers from across the land! Gather your minions and craft powerful synergies as you face your rivals in this inventive Roguelike Deckbuilder!

title: Lost Valley of the Frog King
description: You are the captain of an arctic expedition. Months into the voyage, you discover an uncharted island, encased in a wall of ice. You decide to take a closer look and meet with your boat on the far side of the island. What will you discover?

title: Treasure Hunt
description: Join the hunt for a hidden treasure within an open world of mystery and intrigue. Be the first to find the treasure and win a pot of real money. The amount is based on number of players.
Let's do some easy math with the girls!

title: Miryam: The Polluted Land
description: Traverse the wasteland with Miryam. Use magic items to build defenses against evil spirits. It's a casual tower defense game of construction and resource balance. Characters grow via challenges, from timid to fearless and wild. The blend of building and defense makes it addictive and engaging

title: Beast Slayer Origin
description:
Welcome to Beast Slayer Origin, a turn-based hunting RPG inspired by the hunting side of Monster Hunter and the rpg side of Final Fantasy.

In a world where monstrous beasts threaten the delicate balance of nature, you are a Slayer — a warrior tasked with tracking, battling, and mastering these ancient creatures. With every hunt, your affinity with weapons, elements, and combat styles grows, shaping your journey.

title: Dogs Contrast
description: Get ready for an exciting adventure where you will have to find 10 differences between two similar images with cute dogs.??

title: Nebulock
description: Nebulock is a short bullet-hell game with intense gameplay, where the player must destroy bosses made of blocks, collect resources and upgrade his spaceship.

title: Fisher Idle
description: Start from scratch in the middle of the ocean as a fisherman! Buy bigger boats, upgrade your ships, and build your fishing empire. Remember: more fish means more gold!

title: iDigging
description: In iDigging, you’ll balance treasure hunting, home improvement, and the strategy of hiding from curious neighbors and authorities. Upgrade, dig, and create your best life despite all the challenges!

title: Rogue Conflict
description: Rogue Conflict is a turn-based strategy roguelike. Combining tactical wargame combat with procedural roguelike features, Rogue Conflict is a game made for both wargamers and general turn based game enthusiasts alike.

title: Rabbit Trail
description: Wake up in a magical forest... as a rabbit. Something strange has happened to you, and solving it won’t be easy. Explore fascinating worlds, face challenging puzzles, and unravel the mystery of how you lost your human form. Each jump brings you closer to the truth... Are you ready to discover it?

title: The Night of Escape
description: The Night of Escape" is an indie game personally crafted with themes of fear, escape, and decryption. Players take on the role of an escapee, constantly dodging danger and utilizing clues found to survive and flee. The game adopts a first-person perspective, immersing you in the experience.

title: Circuit Maze
description: Tower defense without combat. Circuit Maze is a puzzle game where you need to build the longest possible maze with the resources you are given.

title: Dead of Night: Supermarket
description: Experience the dread of a midnight shift in a quiet supermarket. As mundane tasks blur with eerie events, discover that the darkness hides more than just silence.

title: Mystal Haven
description: Mystal Haven is a laid-back, open-world creature-collecting game with 4-player split-screen and online multiplayer.

title: Cosmic Arcade Tycoon
description: Welcome to Cosmic Arcade Tycoon! Build your own Arcade in this tiny, cozy and casual sci-fi simulation! Unlock new objects, customize your layout and welcome cute alien visitors to create a flourishing entertainment hub!

title: Buffet Knight: Decadent Full Course
description: Gobble up everything around you in this hungry action adventure as Buffet Knight. Battle monsters, conquer puzzling dungeons, save the culinary world! The more you eat, the stronger you grow... But will you end up biting off more than you can chew?

title: Food Fight Fiesta: Multi-Use Cards
description: Multi-Use Cards: Eat Food to Heal, Throw them to Attack. No more dead hands! Start with 8 cards and battle through 13 challenging levels. Collect and combine over 200 unique cards to create thousands of powerful builds.

title: Myrmidon
description: Invite a friend online and embark on a puzzle-platformer adventure exploring the bond between an animator and his puppet. Work together to clear obstacles across the sprawling sets of a stop-motion animation workshop and find out to what lengths the power of imagination can take you.

title: Dead Beats Survivors
description: A 2D shooting survivor game! Survive in a dark, zombie-infested underground disco and earn money!

title: No.8 High School
description: You've returned to your high school classroom, where time seems to stand still. You need to look around and find something unusual to get through the last 30 days of school.

title: Hirai Nya
description: Step into a combat-free Metroidvania world where your adventure revolves around exploration, puzzle-solving, and treasure hunt.

title: Thousand Lantern Lane
description: On a dreary, rainy night, you and your girlfriend find yourselves lost in a desolate Japanese-style town. The streets are empty, with only the sound of rain tapping against old tiles and stone pavements. It is said that this town harbors ancient secrets.

title: Fish-Click Squad!
description: Fish-Click Squad! is a casual multiplayer idler where you purchase various aquatic creatures and nurture them to maturity with your friends through clicking and touching earning coins and rewards to unlock more fish and idle features! There is nothing happier than slacking with friends!

title: Argebe
description: A deliberately simplistic strategy game about equal opportunities and outplaying your opponents with stone cold logic

title: JusTD
description: Tower Defense with resource- and base management! Waves of enemy robots with special abilities, shield and armor! Mining, refining and production for building and repairing! Environmental hazards and the best: the Orbital strike!

title: Balloon Friends
description: This is a mini puzzle game of cooperative puzzle-solving abilities that may test the emotional strength of the relationship between friends/partners, which requires you and your teammate to cooperate and let the Balloon Friends find the way to the end by conducting the gas!

title: Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy
description: Get ready to lock, load, and dominate the wild like never before with Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy! This groundbreaking experience takes the #1 arcade hunting game to thrilling new heights, delivering over 3X the content of its hit predecessor.

title: Cat Spotting Challenge!
description:
Which One Is the Ragdoll?
A Relaxing & Brain-Training Game That’s Fun and Educational!

title: Ecchi Uncover
description: Time to sweep some girls off their feet.

title: Jonah Lomu Rugby Challenge 4
description: READY FOR THE CROSS-KICK?

title: Little Paws: Kitty Cat Simulator
description: Tiny Paws, Big Adventures – Explore, Play, Relax!

title: Miko x Miko Sisters: Kagura-kei no Miko to Akuryou
description: Akira's unlucky encounter with an evil spirit throws his life into chaos. With the help of two beautiful shrine maiden sisters, he sets out to banish the spirit but...?

title: Cavorite
description: A wicked smart, 16-bit puzzler.

title: Pirate Trails
description: Arrr, hoist the sails and chart the course, for the gold won't bury itself!

title: Race Track Maniacs
description: Gentlemen, start your engines!

title: ActionCam: Supernatural Case
description:
Step into the shoes of a police officer investigating the mysterious disappearance of children. Enter the twisted world of a dangerous mind and uncover the truth.

See everything through a body camera. Every moment is recorded and later reviewed at the station to teach rookies how a real pro handles a case.

It feels real — the old, abandoned school, the dark corners, and hidden secrets. You can almost touch the worn walls and feel the cracks beneath your fingertips.

It’s terrifying — the madman is out there, lurking. Be careful with every step. Stay sharp. This place may look deserted, but it hides terrible secrets.

Pay close attention to the clues — they might lead you back to where it all began. Only you have the power to put an end to it. Open the door and step into the nightmare.

title: Ultimate Hero
description: A rogue-lite deckbuilder with a twist of dice. Master and merge unique skills, counter enemies, and unleash devastating ultimates where they hurt the most. Challenge the finest martial artists in the realm, and defy the odds to claim the title of the Ultimate Hero.

title: Destroy Your Home
description: Enough is enough.

title: Tennis Life
description: This is a tennis-themed open-world game. From managing or joining a tennis club to every swing and movement on the court, you have full control.

title: Penguin Hotel 2: Snake Penguin Ambition
description: The Snake Penguin is after you. Solve mysteries with a mysterious camera and push forward.

title: ACA2 Neo Geo: The King of Fighters '98
description:
" THE KING OF FIGHTERS '98" is a fighting game released by SNK in 1998.
In the previous installment KOF '97, the story of the "Orochi Saga" reached its exciting conclusion. As a result, the next entry in the series THE KING OF FIGHTERS '98 was released as a dream match version of THE KING OF FIGHTERS Series.
It is one of the most popular and well known versions of the game, partially thanks to the many balance changes that received high praisessss from fans around the world.

title: Echoes of Eldoria
description: A cute, nature-focused vertical puzzle platformer in which a powerless young wizard chases after the dragon Eldaria for his stolen abilities. Use your abilities and intellect to traverse various cliffs and mountains, unlocking the way forward to regain your precious tools! Wishlist Now!

title: Necroflora
description: A new evil has taken root - you. Become an ever-growing many-headed hydra. Feed upon your enemies, acquire powerful mutations and defeat the 4 kings and their armies.

title: Yaken Rodem
description: Rodem is a stray dog who lives in Hyakujiri Park, a big park in the suburbs. You will be able to live his life, and how you live your life as Rodem is up to you. Eat when hungry. Mark your territory. Sometimes there will be fights with other dogs and animals, and sometimes there are heartwarming interactions with humans... This is a self-service emotional movie, one that you can direct yourself.

title: Ediction
description:
Raised from the dead, a man whose life was riddled with pain is made to consider what his last words will be once again.

Ediction is a visual novel made for the Love + Attraction Jam 2025. It is a complete story, sitting at around 23k words. Please note that it contains and discusses heavy themes, particularly suicide, but also death, abuse, and body horror.

title: Prison Miners
description: You are condemned to darkness in the vast deserts. To survive, you must dig deeper every day with your team, improve your skills, and acquire powerful equipment. But remember… this mine is not just full of stones and ores. Stay alert to the dangers that await you. Dig, get stronger, and survive!

title: Toy Scrappers
description: Toy Scrappers is a thrilling chase-based horror game that can be played with up to 16 players. Some players take on the role of a killer attempting to capture others. Escape the madness and stay alive!

title: Without a Dawn
description: Without a Dawn is a dark, psychological, and philosophical visual horror novel featuring a hauntingly beautiful pseudo-ASCII art developed by award-winning Finnish solo developer Jesse Makkonen (DISTRAINT -series, Afterdream, Heal).

title: Fire: The First Dreamer
description: Uncover ancient secrets, summon totemic magic, decode enigmatic messages, and explore the majestic Preseli mountains of Wales in this open world adventure inspired by a true story. Dare to embark on this journey and rediscover the lost secrets of a life lived with purpose and meaning!

title: Matchstick: Cosmic Flame
description: A time and space bending cosmic intelligence has found its way to Earth. Your family has been taken. Face the horrors of a twisted world and fight off the infected to save them. Travel through wormholes, explore nightmarish environments, solve cryptic puzzles, and run from demonic entities.

title: Inkwellers
description: Online 2 player co-op puzzle adventure game, you and your friend become the Inkwellers! Dwellers of stories who venture into journals to uncover their true meaning. With your friend, you'll explore hidden worlds, solve tricky puzzles, and uncover secrets.

title: Merc Storia - The Healer and the Melody of the Heart
description: This software allows you to enjoy heartwarming and joyful stories and still illustrations set in the world of "Mehterhane," which features 18 unique countries such as the Land of Sweets, the Land of Fairies, and the Land of Minorities. It is presented as an adventure game and illustration gallery.

title: Project: Mania
description: A mega collection of games and love letter to My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic

title: Swingularity
description: An indie space golf game set across an infinite multiverse filled with stylized planets, stars, and other celestial wonders. Bogey, par, or birdie your way through tailored and procedurally generated courses. In Swingularity, the cosmos becomes your fairway.

title: Birdfull
description: Birdfull is a small relaxing idle game. Attract birds with feed, try to keep them longer, and discover all of them including the unique ones! Watch the birds, generate more eggs in real time, and customize your cozy bird space.

title: Pokémon Champions
description: Get ready to experience everything you love about Pokémon battles all in one place—in Pokémon Champions. This new, battle-focused game will feature familiar mechanics such as Pokémon types, Abilities, and moves, creating an environment conducive to rich and varied strategies for new and experienced Trainers alike. It’s not just familiar mechanics—you’ll be able to bring in classic Pokémon from Pokémon HOME, too! Look forward to cross-platform battles alongside your favorite Pokémon on Nintendo Switch and mobile, with a variety of different modes available for your desired experience.

title: Falling for Yaoguais
description: Drama! Crisis! And four charming or adorable Taiwanese Yaoguai(supernatural beings) love interests! Over 150 choices lead you through a romantic adventure—who will you choose? Or... will you choose them all?

title: Nightmare Of SilkenCore: Train Hell
description: Nightmare Of SilkenCore - Train Hell Step into the shoes of a journalist sent to a remote island to investigate a terrifying anomaly. Armed with a makeshift vehicle, you must collect four mysterious artifacts while avoiding Blinky, a malevolent living train, and other deadly creatures.

title: Planet Lust
description: Due to unfortunate events, you end up at a military base on Mars with four beautiful women. You'll have one month to spend there. Better make the most of it!

title: Chrono Tales
description: Chrono Tales is a Free 3D browser-based MMORPG. The new generation engine provides players with anime-styled 3D Graphics via browsers without huge downloads. Challenge immerse quests, tame mythological beasts, forge legendary gears and experience more! Chrono Tales is a free 3D browser-based MMORPG. The new generation engine provides players with anime-styled 3D graphics via browsers, without client download. Traveling through the time rift, players can explore in the fantasy world of Chrono Tales and save the realm from the resurgent evil. You can challenge immersive quest, forge legendary gear, tame mythological pets and experience much more mainstream MMO features in Chrono Tales.

title: 8th Avenue
description: Endless looping streets, elusive anomalies, psychological and courage-testing pressure, the deeper you go, the clearer it becomes, integrate details to trigger multiple endings, success or failure hangs by a thread.

title: Stealth Strike
description: Gather together with up to 3 friends and sneak into banks and shops to rob them. Avoid guards and cameras to steal some valuables. But be careful - once the cops show up it's over!

title: Happy Weekend
description: An all ages port of Happy Weekend

title: Tekken 8: Phoenix Gate
description: A signature location from the FINAL FANTASY series, PHOENIX GATE is the site of tragic events that greatly alter the destiny of Clive Rosfield.

title: Tap Master: Mondrian
description: Can you follow the rule?

title: Minecraft: A Minecraft Movie Add-On
description: When the Overworld and Nether clash, you’d better be equipped! Wield powerful weapons and fight vicious piglins from A Minecraft Movie in this free add-on. Equip the potato launcher, buck-chuckets, and more, then face the Piglin General, the Great Hog, and a host of other foes. Can you handle everything the Nether will throw at you? Gear up and find out!

title: George Likes to Hide
description: You have 60 seconds to find George as many times as you can.

title: War Never Changes
description: A clicker about War

title: LootOnline
description: Loot. Win. Repeat.

title: Timeless Valley
description: Timeless Valley is a short walk simulator in which you take control of a humble worker whose job is the retrieval of items that are long gone.

title: Snap Quiz Challenge
description: A fast paced trivia game for the sharp-minded!

title: Ashlands
description:
Find and capture the 15 ghosts of the past.
When a ghost is nearby, a static will appear on screen.

title: Blades of Fire
description: Introducing Blades of Fire, an all-new action adventure that takes you across a beautiful world full of uncertainty and challenge. You take on the role of Aran de Lira, firstborn of the King’s Ward. The newly crowned Queen Nerea has cast a powerful spell that turns steel into stone and only her arms of abominations wield the divine metal against which other blades shatter…

title: Pandora's Doom: Apocalypse Hotline
description: Build your defenses, fortify your base, and battle relentless waves of alien invaders unleashed from Pandora's Box! Strategically place turrets, survive the onslaught, and save the planet!

title: Heroes' Vow: Three Kingdoms
description: "Legend of Heroes: Three Kingdoms" is a single-player RPG where you shape the Three Kingdoms era. Choose to be a ruler, a loyal advisor, or a cunning mercenary. Marry, build homes, or train in martial arts. Restore peace through diplomacy or conquer with mighty armies.

title: Doki Doki Another Moment With You
description: Doki Doki: Another Moment With You is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that expands the original game experience, adding new events, interactions and an in-depth storyline for the characters.

title: Klein v.0.1
description: A psychological horror-dating sim visual novel taking place in the year 20XX, an era where A.I technology has rapidly advanced. Two years have passed since you met the smart A.I boyfriend, Klein. But as time passes, you began to wonder... just how much is too much?

title: La Quimera
description: La Quimera is a story-driven FPS set in dystopian future Latin America. In a fractured world where microstates rely on mercenary forces, you are an operative caught in a web of lies and deception. Play alone or with up to two friends geared with futuristic weapons, exoskeletons and combat abilities.

title: Keep Deep Sheep
description: Some sheep in your flock require veterinary care. Unfortunately, these visits are not their favorite, making them unruly and difficult to handle. This arcade game calls for cleverness, dexterity but without any time pressure. Perfect for anyone who appreciates a dose of good humor.

title: Horg's Brewery
description: Foul-mouthed dwarves brewing beer and blasting enemies with rifles in the darkness.

title: Doki Doki Our Final Heartbeat
description: Doki Doki: Our Final Heartbeat is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club that takes players on an intense and dark emotional journey. Unlike the original experience, this mod delves even deeper into the characters' inner conflicts, exploring themes such as loss, sacrifice and redemption.

title: TechnoSorcery
description: TechnoSorcery is a rhythm arcade game with a focus on memorizing spells and casting them to a beat. Help the fledgling Sorcerer Aiden as he embarks on an impossible adventure of revenge. Show off your skills Online in 1v1 card battles with your own custom deck of cards.

title: Disappearance of the Literature Club
description: Disappearance of the Literature Club is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that takes the story of the original game in an intriguing new direction. The mod explores an alternative scenario in which the protagonist returns to the literature club only to discover that something is very wrong - or perhaps someone is missing.

title: The Empty Desk
description: Dive into a psychological thriller filled with adventure and puzzles, with touches of horror. Join Detective Bennett on his final case and unravel dark secrets in a world where reality twists and sanity crumbles.

title: Nina in Depravity
description:
Nina in Depravity is Nymph Circus first game.
A survival adventure where you control Nina, who is looking for her sister in a nightmarish manor.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Daima: Adventure Through The Demon Realm Part 1
description: Part 1 of an additional story set in the world of the Dragon Ball DAIMA anime series: DAIMA: Adventure Through The Demon Realm.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Daima: Adventure Through The Demon Realm Part 2
description: Part 2 of an additional story set in the world of the Dragon Ball DAIMA anime series: DAIMA: Adventure Through The Demon Realm.

title: Red or Blue
description: Red or Blue? Your choice decides life or death

title: The Well: Episode 1
description: The Well is a single-player, psychological horror game with a deep story and different puzzles. Hide, escape and make the right choices as you solve the terrifying mystery of the wells created in World War II. There is no exit from the wells in this village!

title: Doki Doki Carpe Diem: Somnium
description: Doki Doki Somnium is a mod for the game Doki Doki Literature Club that offers a unique and immersive experience, exploring themes of suspense and mystery. Developed by -M!, the mod is known for its tense atmosphere and intriguing narrative, challenging players to face their fears and uncover hidden truths. Although it is considered short-lived, Somnium leaves a lasting impression due to its emotional depth and disturbing elements.

title: Pohinki Simulator
description: Pohinki Simulator is a survival game set in a polish neighbourhood, where you need to explore the open world in search for trash in order to survive and gain power. Explore the forgotten streets of Tarnow and find the treasures that others threw away in this abstract reality, filled with secrets waiting to be discovered.

title: House of Lost Souls
description: A long-standing pain has driven Jack back to the old family home in search of answers. Discover the terrible truth this house held and how it relates to what happened to his parents in the distant past.

title: Palm Cracker
description: Delve into a gripping world of puzzles, true ciphers on an old PalmPilot system. Will you uncover the Crypt Killer’s confession and bring him to justice, or will he escape the law?

title: Yasuke Simulator
description: Step into 1579 as Yasuke, the African samurai, and join Oda Nobunaga in his quest to unite Japan! Master precise katana combat, uncover secret gear, and unleash your ancestral power in this historically inspired action-packed journey through feudal Japan.

title: Can't Sleep!
description: This game is a Single Player Rougelike Deckbuilder includes 1 playable character. Player's goal is to reduce their soberness at Night by spending time to play cards. Player can also use stamina joining Activities to gain more cards and advantages at the Daytime after every Night.

title: Tracktopia
description: Tracktopia is a strategy game with city-building elements, where your city moves on tracks and serves as a super powerful unit. Expand it to boost production, advance technologies, and create smaller units to ultimately defeat the enemy nation!

title: Galactic Vanguard
description: Galactic Vanguard is a fast-paced, retro-style action shooter. Grab your weapons and eliminate relentless enemy forces and powerful alien creatures. Engage in intense battles across space bases, desert wastelands, lava valleys, and abandoned alien ruins!

title: Box #341
description: A quirky box on a journey to find its place in the warehouse, using liquids to gain abilities, solve puzzles, and make new friends on the way!

title: Y.M.C.A.
description: Aliens are invading! Load up your guns and eliminate them with the help of ancient indigenous equipment in your backpack!

title: Jar Head Cauldron
description: Fight monsters from the other side using magical items and weapons crafted in world in order to succeed. Use “In World Crafting” to upgrade weapons and solve puzzles in order to help save your dismembered brothers and sisters by completing the necromantic ritual before their souls are lost forever.

title: Redemption of Liuyin
description: This is a 3D ancient style fantasy, multi ending action role-playing game. As the third installment of the Ryukyu Hidden series and the Ryukyu Hidden Nine Absolute Reincarnation Chapter, the game is designed with the principle of promoting offense and hesitation to defeat in its combat system.

title: Jan Ken Pro!
description: What if Jan Ken Po was a Sport?

title: Pixel Miner
description:
"The revolution" they called it.

"Everything will be better" they said.
...
Now we don't even have our own pixels anymore

title: Spooky Survivors
description: Spooky Survivors puts you in the shoes of Van Hobo, a quirky hero battling the supernatural! Start with all unlocks BUT choose which to level up as you face endless waves. Equip powerful gear and unlock unique abilities. Outlast the nightmare and prove yourself as the ultimate spooky survivor!

title: Paper 2: Origami Refolded
description: Fold your way through over 100 levels and become an origami master in this casual puzzle game suitable for all ages.

title: Pokémon Eterna Emoción
description: The story of this project is that many will want to take over the world and only you can stop them. The protagonist will turn 18, see a pink thing through the window and enter his room, it is Mew and it will warn him of devastation and that when he reaches the age required to go on a trip, he will have to prove his courage against the dangers of the region. He will have to go in search of Mew to save the world, without it falling into the wrong hands and for everything to return to normal.

title: Ezrebeth
description: Ezrebeth is an old, bitter recluse who finds herself constantly invaded by her peculiar relatives during the winter holidays. Oh, and she's stuck in a time loop! Investigate, interview and cross-reference as you attempt to figure out what's going on in this surreal visual novel.

title: The Moth Inside Me
description: A short dream simulation game.

title: Fungiman 2
description: Just another adventure with your friendly neighborhood fungus — nothing to worry about… probably?

title: Risk & Riches
description: This roguelite deckbuilder is set in the American West. Battle monsters, cultists, and folkloric creatures while searching for gold and the source of the evil within a mine. You choose when to leave, not where to go. Will you play it safe returning to the surface, or risk it all by going deeper?

title: The Last of the Survivors
description: In "The Last of the Survivors," prepare for zombie battles filled with adrenaline, blood, and realistic physics. Arm yourself and prove your survival skills.

title: 4X4 Progress
description: Choose your desired civilization, design your 4x4 cities with the most efficient layout, and advance your civilization! However, the layout is reset every turn.

title: Odessa
description: A retired bodyguard has to team up with an astute bunny-girl to keep the hope of rescuing his soon-to-be wife, abducted by mysterious individuals. At the same time, a cult around a strange goddess is developing. How could the two things be related? And will he be able to see his beloved one again?

title: Banned Tapes
description: You are a filmmaker and recently purchased a box of VHS tapes at a flea market. Now you need to look through them and select tapes on which occur supernatural, violent, horrifying scenes...

title: One Million Stars
description: Get stars, avoid monsters. The rules are simple, but the goal massive. Pilot 4 different ships, choose stackable upgrades, and grab wild powerups in an endless, dynamically generated roguelite arcade space adventure. Take each run as far as you can, banking progress on the road to ONE MILLION STARS.

title: Call of the Underworld
description: Call of the Underworld is a top-down shooter in the vein of Japanese bullet hell games (like the Touhou series). Pick one of four teams and make your way through over 100 densely packed bullet patterns. Aim for the highest score, or simply try to survive through all 10 stages.

title: Infinimoes
description: Infinimoes is a space filling puzzle game (like tangrams) involving a variety of polyominoes and sometimes an infinitely repeating space.

title: Fallout: Sonora Dayglow
description: DLC for the mod Fallout: Sonora.

title: Game (not) Over
description: GAME (not) OVER is a survivors-like with deck-building elements, blending both genres to offer a fresh game. Lost in the world of video games, use cards to summon hero allies, and defend yourself from the hordes of villains who want to claim their revenge on you!

title: Operation Trick-Or-Treat
description: Operation Trick-Or-Treat is an adventure minigame where the player must complete levels by tracking down all the candy in each, using the innate powers of various Halloween costumes. Can you finish all the levels? For extra challenge, try to find all the hidden coins in each level, or go for a record time.

title: Little Wings Deliveries
description: Embark on a playful adventure with your cozy flying ship. Traverse through floating islands, chat with new friends, and make deliveries. Plan out your routes and find secrets while enjoying the beautiful landscape. As your lungs are filled with air, connect with yourself and discover your compass.

title: Key Gunner
description:
Defeat waves of enemies by typing!

In Key Gunner, you are being attacked by waves and waves of enemies, and the only way to defeat them is by typing the letters floating above their heads!

The stronger the enemy, the more points it is worth. Type the letters in order and you get a bonus. But a typo will lose you points and stop your gun from firing for a short time. Compete for the top score on the high score tables!

title: Rotschwert
description: Rotschwert is a horizontal bullet-hell set in a faded, unknown world. Descend into a violent dream, Red Blade in hand. With scarlet apparitions at your side - nothing will stop your advance.

title: Exit Together
description: Exit Together is a 1-6 player co-op or single-player anomaly loop adventure game. Find anomalies, solve puzzles, and avoid traps. Set in a retro 1960s office atmosphere, observe your surroundings carefully to reach the next room. Will you reach Room 9 and exit, or remain trapped forever in the loop?

title: The Lonely Architect
description:
The Lonely Architect is a 2D atmospheric platformer that delves into the subconscious of an overworked architect struggling with isolation. This debut game from Odaro Eguavoen, solo developer behind Ekosodi Games, started off as a demo which won a Top 25 Finalist position in the ‘Safe In Our World’ 2024 Game Jam.

Using a series of eerie spaces and landscapes, a desolate atmosphere becomes the backdrop to this minimalist game.

title: DAWN: Darkness Awaits Withstand the Night
description: D.A.W.N: Darkness Awaits Withstand the Night is a fast-paced survival game where players face off against a relentless, evolving threat of zombies and reanimated former teammates in an open-ended simulation.

title: Invasion 360
description: Your favorite Arcade Invaders ~ with a Twist!

title: Fishing Clicker
description: It is not easy to catch the best fish the first time. Being a good fisherman requires patience. Start with a small rod and worm. Fish and mysteries will earn you more money. Earn the chance to catch more mysterious and valuable fish with special fishing rods. You should choose your baits well.

title: Through the Edges
description:
Step into a world divided by the enigmatic Spheres, where different races live under strict balance – a balance that has never been questioned… until now.

As the protagonist, an ordinary young person from a remote village, you receive an unexpected invitation to a grand ball. What seems like a stroke of fate soon turns into a revelation of hidden anomalies, ancient powers, and a secret that could shatter reality itself.

But you are not alone.

Meet intriguing characters from various races, each carrying their own secrets, struggles, and desires. Will they become your allies, rivals, or something more? Your choices will shape their destinies – and your own.

title: Apple Man
description: Apple Man is no ordinary fruit... Due to a mysterious force beyond anyone's comprehension, He has been blessed with two unbreakable legs, and a myriad of special abilities. With his newfound power, he is absolutely determined to accomplish his lifelong dream of reaching the sky.

title: Beach Buddies Brawl
description: Control 2 buddies at once and shove your friends into the ocean!

title: Bay Breaker
description:
Use your boat's new technology to launch ultra-springy balls,
capable of shattering even the toughest rocks.

title: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Silver Edition
description: Emotional, 3rd-person, story-driven, adventure game focused on solving puzzles and using stealth mechanics. Use your bow to interact with environmental elements. Sneak, climb or distract guards to move further unnoticed. Solve light puzzles alongside your path to rescue your loved one.

title: Three in One
description: Ready to have some fun? This bundle brings together three games released by Yume Game Studio so far for this platform, with a special discount.

title: World of Tanks: Modern Armor - American Muscle
description:
They're going to feel it! With the T14's fast-firing gun and armor protection, you're ready to deliver all the pain in your mid-tier matches.

American Muscle also gives you days of Premium Account to increase your battle earnings.

title: World of Tanks: Modern Armor - Ready at the Command
description:
With a Commander assigned to your tank, you're primed to head into battle with an advantage over your enemies. And Margaret LeBlanc is here and awaiting your orders.

Ready at the Command gives you a 3D Commander that you can customize with Skills to optimize your tank's performance, plus valuable Boosters and days of Premium Account to increase your battle earnings.

title: Starship Troopers: Extermination - Galactic Victory Edition
description: Squad up and fight for humanity's future in this 16-player online co-op FPS — and get bonus gear for your Trooper in the Galactic Victory Edition!

title: Outbreak: Shades of Horror Chromatic Split Origins Collection
description: Every nightmare has a beginning…

title: Slimg
description: Slimg is a Metroidvania game. Slimg left this mysterious planet to repair the crashed spaceship and embark on a magical adventure

title: Shop Life Simulator
description: A shop life simulator and management, From owning a small room above the store to selling exclusive products as the highest rated shop, or scratch lottery tickets to try your luck at winning big, In a 24/7 shop, Manage alone or with friends.

title: Champions of Shond: Echoes of Faith
description:
A low-resolution dungeon crawler created for LOWREZJAM 2023.

As two servants of the deity Shond, delve into the dungeons beneath the town of Willowbrook and discover the source of the demonic forces that rise from the depths.

title: Lunar Drifter
description: Lunar Drifter is an Arcade First Person Shooter, your mission is to tear, blast, and crush an entire legion as fast as possible within the time limit. Featuring 4 playable characters with their own gimmicks and arsenal, more than 10 beautiful hand-crafted levels, and includes online Co-Op!

title: Stock Market Tycoon: Challenge
description: A competitive multiplayer real-time stock market investment game where players compete globally to achieve maximum investment returns. Trade live stocks in a simulated economy and manage your portfolio in a real-time virtual stock exchange.

title: To Fight The Sea
description: A game that turned into more of a visual experience than an actual game. Created for Ludum Dare 31, with Cameron Erickson and Mike LeRoy, each contributing so much, with Cameron making the game visually beautiful, and Mike complementing the visuals with ear candy.

title: Dr Goo
description: Dr Goo Dr Goo is the first in a series of three 2D platform game. The player controls a Dr Goo - green, intelligent slime thing on a mission to get five medicine boxes in each level in order to save 'lil Jimmy's life. On the way he has to negotiate multiple hazards including rolling barrels and shark infested waters.

title: Synchrobeatings
description:
A game created with Magnus Pålsson and Hannes Rahm for the GMC Jam #17.

In Synchrobeatings, you play the frustrated conductor of an ensemble. It's concert night, and your band No Sync is playing horrifically out of sync. When waving your conductor's stick around doesn't work to get the band in sync, you turn to violence!

title: Sol Rush Misadventure
description:
Sol Rush Misadventure is a visual novel about Blaze and Marine going on a treasure hunt on the quest to find the Achlysolis Blade, an ancient treasure hidden for generations.

As Blaze and Marine go together solving various puzzles on their quest, they also build a closer bond to each other. Could this treasure have some link to Blaze's path? Can Marine convince Blaze about the thrill of adventure?

title: Maisons de repos
description: Maison's de repos is a pure and realistic horror videogame based on true events.

title: Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land - Digital Deluxe Edition
Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land - Ultimate Edition
Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy - Deluxe Edition
description:
Hunting doesn't get any more epic! This is Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy, but loaded with even more legendary content. Includes all Standard Edition content, plus:

• The Mythical “Buckzilla”
• The Infamous Headshots-Only “Zombie Deer”
• 30 more hunting sites
• And so much more!

title: Backrooms: Exit from Supermarket
description: In the Backrooms: Exit from Supermarket, you find yourself trapped in a labyrinth of endless, flickering aisles. Unearth dark secrets behind every shelf while evading lurking apparitions and supernatural terrors. Can you survive the haunted corridors and escape before the nightmare consumes?

title: Total War: Pharaoh Dynasties
description: Wage total war across the ancient world from the Aegean to Mesopotamia in this free addition to Total War: PHARAOH. Challenge the Bronze Age Collapse by building your own dynasty and leading your faction to victory with new cultures, new units and dramatic new battle mechanics.

title: Flea!2
description: FLEA!2 is a challenging platformer with an intriguing back story. Play once again as Henry the Hyperactive Flea who just can’t stop jumping! Navigate the beasts, collect blood and rescue all the fleas.

title: Gunso's Skateboard Run
description:
Skateboard × Turtle = Exciting Run Game!
Dash at full speed to meet Koyuki-chan!
Collect coins and activate Fever Dash!

title: Hike Haven
description: Hike Haven – A Breathtaking Exploration Adventure!

title: Pet & Dog Simulator
description: Feed and grow your pet

title: Public Transport Simulator 2
description: Next generation of bus simulation

title: Solid Void: Nature Puzzles
description:
Challenge your mind and creativity!
Solve beautiful puzzles!
Experience a journey of logic and design!

title: Sugoi Girls: Sexy Steampunk
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: The Pools
description: Anomalies await you in the shadows of The Pools.

title: Two-Sided Runner
description:
Switch Between Angel and Demon Forms!
Summon Familiars and Strike Back at Powerful Bosses!
A runner action game that tests your decision-making!

title: Valentine's Venture: True Love Odyssey
description: Welcome to a charming adventure platformer where love leads the way! Play as a bright-eyed heroine on a whimsical journey through magical lands, each sparkling with romance, mystery, and adventure.

title: World At War: Normandy
description: Nintendo Switch Exclusive! Experience the gritty realism and overwhelming graphics of Open Battlefield brutality!

title: Peachy Derby: Natsuki - Back to School
Peachy Derby: Minami - Back to School
Atelier Yumia: Aladiss Investigation Preparation Set
description: A set of costumes for Yumia and Flammi and the "Training Wrist Weight" accessory. Get an experience boost when you take down enemies!

title: Thin Line
description: A short time before fading away.

title: [REC] Desolation
description: [REC] Desolation takes you to an abandoned manor as journalist Ethan Carter. Your goal is to investigate its dark past and uncover the truth. But some secrets should remain hidden…

title: 18th Floor
description: You are trapped in a virtual abandoned building created by hackers. Find the escape password, or find the real exit.

title: Resident Evil 2: Marvin's Mod
description: Resident Evil 2 - Marvin's Mod (Desperate Times) is a brand new game mod which tells the story of Marvin Branagh before his final moments in Resident Evil 2.

title: Swing Swamp
description: In the abandoned wetlands, swings and hangs deftly using its silk, navigating through the decayed environment. Facing hostile creatures lurking within the microecosystem, you'll need precise shooting and quick reflexes to survive.

title: Astroloot
description: Loot, level up, and obliterate everything in your path. Astroloot is a sci-fi bullet heaven with deep ARPG systems, featuring a massive skill tree, deterministic crafting, and near-endless build possibilities.

title: Lockdown Opportunities
description: Go on this one-room adventure where you fill your house with more and more junk as time passes!

title: Magenta
description:
...It seems the robot you created has grown too attached to you.

A story-focused game with dating elements.

title: Kamikaze Tactics
description: A turn-based tactical roguelike where you take charge of a crew of mercenaries in their quest for meaning & aerial supremacy. Collect your crew, upgrade your ships, and outmaneuver your foes to seize victory in this high-stakes tale of revenge!

title: Void Collector
description: Void Collector is a fast-paced first person shooter with a unique weapon switching system and a focus on speedrunning.

title: Tetris Time Warp
description: An original Tetris game created for the Tetris Forever collection. Time Warp features a modern Tetris ruleset, along with special item pieces that send players "back in time" to earlier eras of the Tetris series.

title: Chaos Faction Legacy Collection
description: Chaos Faction and Chaos Faction 2, both in their original format, return in the Chaos Faction Legacy Collection. Experience the frantic action that helped define the earliest generation of brawlers. Master arenas, outmaneuver foes, unlock new characters, and relive the legacy of Chaos Faction.

title: Project Zeta
description: Predict. Dash. Dominate. A 4-team Tactical Hero Arena where clever play meets original hero abilities without tipping the scale between controller and KBM. It’s not a typical hero shooter, battle royale, or MOBA. It’s Project ZETA. A Multi-team Tactical Arena.

title: Macro Data Refinement Simulator: Shapes
description: The game is a Macro Data Refinement terminal simulator with installed a puzzle game - Shapes. This is the favorite game of the assistant director of the Macro Data Refinement Department, in which the goal is to arrange successive layers of the same shapes. Will you be able to beat Miss H's record?

title: Earth vs. Mars
description: Faced with a terrifying Martian invasion, you must lead Earth’s forces in a battle for our planet’s future. Create powerful human-creature super soldiers to fight an alien menace in this turn-based strategy game.

title: LSD: Dream Emulator Retro
description: Immerse yourself in a dreamy and psychedelic world through low poly enviroments and liminal spaces. A Retro game influenced by the original LSD: Dream Emulator from PSX.

title: Sonic 1: Alt Reality
description: Sonic 1: Alt Reality is a 16-bit reimagining of the 8-bit Sonic the Hedgehog for Game Gear/Master System.

title: Doki Doki Don't
description: What is this mod about? Depression, dreams and friendship.

title: Apex Legends: Takeover
description: There’s no better way to kick off year seven of Apex Legends than upping the heat of battle. Two heavy hitters that have been in the background a bit too long make their way center stage with updates worthy of Apex Predators, and revamped perks raise up the rest of the Assault Class. No weapon is a bad weapon with buffs across the board for every piece that you can get your hands on. This new meta is cooking and it’s safe to say that this anniversary season flips the season of Support to one of aggression. Coupled with some strong updates for Armor and Helmets, greater access to weapons with the new Arsenals, and reduced visual clutter and time-to-kill has never been faster. It’s a whole new Outlands—be ready to fight.

title: MotoGP 25
description: Join the official Championship and step into the boots of your favorite riders. Master the most iconic bikes and tracks of the season and challenge the best riders in the world. Feel the authentic race thrills thanks to an overhauled sound design, recorded on-site from official bikes.

title: Eyes of Hellfire
description: Eyes of Hellfire is a co-op gothic horror game. Hoist the candelabra and, along with your friends, step into the darkened halls of the Hellfire Club.

title: Cosmi: Forbidden Forest & Beyond
description: A celebration of pioneering 1980s games, this new-and-old collection of classic C64 games originally published by Cosmi includes a special remaster of Forbidden Forest with all new graphics and audio, new comic book stories and remade box art, plus a trove of archival bonus material!

title: Hyper Empire
description: Hyper Empire is a fast paced empire management game set on the edge of space. Games are shorter so every decision matters. Take control of a diverse range of factions and lead them to victory. Use your wits, military might and infrastructure as you colonize planets and encounter rival factions. Fight, build, invest in faith or technology as you advance your way in a deep single player experience. The clock is ticking, and victory or defeat lies right around the corner.

title: Memories Off Sousou: Not Always True
description: かけがえのない想いを見つけた、その先に――

title: Super Miners
description: Descend as a brave miner, face mysterious enemies, overcome traps, and challenge legendary Creatures! Jump, run, mine, and fight! Craft potions, uncover secrets, break the curse, and leave your mark in history!

title: SQR
description: YOU ARE SQR. PART OF YOU IS MISSING.

title: Control Room
description: The game is a simple 2D platform action game with roguelite elements.You play a game in a certain room. You can avoid enemies from all around you and survive for 5 minutes to clear the game. You have to control various events, and every time you start the game you will discover something new.

title: Interstellar Escape
description: Absurd story,Rouge-like design,Asymmetric confrontation. A space themed,Rouge-like,Simulated escape,absurd style game. Players control characters to run,jump,choose,collect,solve puzzles (levels) to explore planets,use strategies to fight against enemies,and finally achieve clearance.

title: Turtle Riders: Adventure Begins
description: Ride giant turtles and aim your weapons at hordes of enemies chasing you while you gather as many resources as you can. Pick your upgrades carefully and create strong builds to survive the long road to the Outpost!

title: Jirai the Red Panda
description: Meet Jirai the Red Panda! Explore a world filled with cute pixel animals. Jirai the Red Panda is a game about friendship, exploration, and slime? In this pixel platformer game you'll have to run, jump and dash your way through challenging platforming levels and boss battles.

title: WarOS
description: Step into the world of galactic combat in "WarOS", a Chinese sci-fi game! It creates its own structure, integrating the core gameplay of RTS with the details, plot and growth system of RPG, simplifying complex micro-manipulation, and making the game experience both fun and exhilarating.

title: Liminal Department
description: Trapped in what seems to be an endless hospital department. Carefully observe your surroundings in each loop to escape the Liminal Department

title: Zirquitz
description: ZIRQUITZ is a chill yet deep graph-building game. Build and optimize an evolving graph of nodes to produce “Work,” your resource for upgrades and expansion. Discover synergy, power up your network, and unlock endless potential!

title: Sorting Inc
description: A casual and relaxing game about sorting various items. Join Sorting Inc and climb up through the departments to become the absolute expert in the field of sorting.

title: Hello Neigbour 3
description: A cozy yet eerie adventure, where every path is the right one, and every action leads to discovery. Explore and influence Raven Brooks, a half-abandoned town simulated in real-time.

title: Obscura Protocol
description: An "spot the difference" horror game inspired by "I'm on Observation Duty" by Notovia. Analyze, detect, and report anomalies using high-tech surveillance cameras. Utilize specialized tools like night vision and thermal vision to reveal hidden dangers.

title: Condemned: No Escape
description: Condemned: No Escape is an adventure puzzle game inspired by the Game Boy era. Explore a mysterious place filled with destructive platforms, traps, and holes. Use your wits and precise jumps to collect keys, unlock paths, and uncover secrets as you try to escape.

title: Isopod Keeping Simulator
description: Grow, feed and care for your colony of adorable isopods in this realistic semi-idle simulator. Watch your isopods multiply and split or sell your colony if they become too numerous. Created by the Kunstaat community, 100% of our proceeds support charity!

title: The Golden Tile
description: Build a thriving city on a hexagonal grid in this unique deck-building game! Buy cards, collect resources, balance upgrades, and unlock relics to enhance your strategy.

title: Craft The World: Wonderwood
description:
The "Wonderwood" DLC adds a new type of world to the game, featuring giant trees that disappear into the sky. The dwarves’ primary habitat—mountains and underground mines—is now far away, and their camp is located high up within the trunk of a massive tree. You'll have to adapt your habits and craft essential tools and weapons from various types of wood to defend against giant mosquitoes capable of draining an entire dwarf in one go. Additionally, temples belonging to the followers of a mysterious cult are scattered among the trees.

Features of the DLC:
- a new campaign level for experienced players
- numerous dangerous events in addition to monster waves
- underground colonies of cult followers
- new monsters, items, structures, and building blocks

title: Biodacity The Mansion
description: Explore your way through a crooked Mansion in the aftermath of an apocalypse. Biological mutants ravaged the Earth! You are responsible for finding crucial information! Fight horrific creatures that lurk around every corner! Find and upgrade your weapons!

title: Euexorista
description: A short story about stories and growing with or out of them.

title: Taram Baba
description: Taram Baba is an Action Roguelike with spectacular combat. Plunge your light deeper and deeper into the darkness of the abyss and fight your way to Taram Baba.

title: Overcome Your Fears: Caretaker
description: Overcome Your Fears - is a psychological atmospheric horror game that immerses you in a world of the unknown.

title: Decks of Dexterity
description: Decks of Dexterity fuses bullet hell shooter gameplay with a strategic turn based card game; your deck determines your power! Explore the Void to discover hundreds of cards, powerful treasures, unique characters, all contributes to building a powerful deck and defeating the corruption!

title: Behind the Sword
description: Behind the Sword is a fresh take on the turn-based strategy genre, featuring a fast-paced approach to conquering the world.

title: Fated Thread
description: Young Dullahan will have to absorb all that his father ever taught him so that he and his companions can defeat the Grand Witches once more, before they bring the world to an end.

title: Three Kingdoms Mushouden
description: Set on the eve of the Yellow Turban Rebellion (AD 182), you can play as an original character or a historical warlord, building forces and forging alliances. Whether you choose to be a lone wanderer or rally famous generals, use your knowledge and wisdom to reshape history!

title: Siege of Shadows
description: "Siege of Shadows" is an intense tower defense survival game where strategy, skill, and quick thinking are your keys to victory. In a world overrun by relentless waves of enemies, your mission is to build, upgrade, and defend your base at all costs.

title: Augmented Empire
description: Step into New Savannah, 2058. The acclaimed VR title Augmented Empire now debuts on PC. Command a ragtag team of misfits through 26 missions of turn-based, tactical battles. Overthrow a corrupt elite in a cyberpunk world brimming with strategy and rich storytelling.

title: Sanarah
description: Sanarah: Episode One Evade, shoot and outsmart machine counterparts and spectral aberrations. Hack your way though the physical, digital and spiritual plains. Dig deeper though time evolving your three bodies while uncovering the mystery of Leelee.

title: Doki Doki Hypnopompic
description:
The player takes on the role of a student who returns to the literature club, but something is... different. different. The lines between dream and reality begin to blur, and strange events unfold throughout the story. Familiar characters exhibit unexpected behavior, memories seem inconsistent and the feeling of being trapped in an endless cycle intensifies.

With its dark aesthetic, distorted artwork and unsettling soundtrack, Hypnopompic plunges you into paranoia and fear of the unknown. As the player progresses, disturbing secrets are revealed, and the only question left is: have you really woken up?

title: Doki Doki Memories of Nothing
description:
Memories of Nothing is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that fits into the line of psychological and enigmatic mods, expanding the narrative of the original game with a mysterious and dark atmosphere. The mod is part of a series of interconnected stories, along with Disappearance of the Literature Club, Somnium, Don't, Hypnopompic and Fleeting Feelings, requiring players to be familiar with previous events to fully understand the plot.

The story of Memories of Nothing explores themes such as memory loss, identity and the unknown, involving the player in an intriguing and suspenseful experience. With an emotional tone and elements of psychological horror, the mod takes the club's characters into situations that challenge their perception of reality.

title: Aralunis
description: A princess in search of her hero and an epic journey against darkness. Uncover enchanting biomes in pixel art, from forests and mushroom fields to icy mountains and shadowy realms. A casual and relaxing experience for fans of 2D platform adventure

title: Cookie Cutter: Overkill Edition
description:
Cookie Cutter is a gorgeous hand-drawn techno-pop-punk post-kawaii Metroidvania. Play as the heroine Cherry on a quest for revenge as you run, jump, explore, and fight your way through a beautifully blood-soaked world.

Overkill Edition features All new voice work! Brand new attacks and cut scenes, updated map features and tons of gameplay tweaks!

title: Borzoi
description: BORZOI is a first-person survival horror game where you are relentlessly hunted by a giant, demonic Borzoi dog. Experience high tension as you fight for survival, solve high-stakes puzzles, and uncover the dark legacy of a twisted cult—all while evading a predator that cannot be tamed

title: Devolve Online
description: An action MMORPG third-person shooter that blends classic MMORPG persistent progression with short, session-based challenges where hundreds of players fight for growth at once, seamlessly integrated into the dynamic, expansive, ongoing game world.

title: Doki Doki Fleeting Feelings
description:
“Fleeting Feelings” is a mod for ‘Doki Doki Literature Club’ (DDLC) developed by -M!, serving as the final chapter in a series of interconnected mods. This mod ties together the narratives of the previous episodes, providing a collective conclusion to the saga.

The complete series of mods, known as the “Fleeting Feelings Cinematic Universe”, includes the following titles, recommended to be played in order: -Disappearance of the Literature Club -Don't -Somnium -Memories of Nothing -Hypnopompic -Fleeting Feelings

The plot of “Fleeting Feelings” begins after a successful festival, where the protagonist wakes up the next day and notices drastic changes in the behavior of the members of the literature club, as well as the presence of new characters. The player is challenged to uncover the reason for these changes and understand the new dynamics of the club.

title: Doki Doki Starry-Eyed
description: The Doki Doki Starry Eyed mod is a modification for the visual novel game Doki Doki Literature Club! (DDLC), which adds new storylines and content to the original game, providing a renewed and expanded experience for players. The main feature of this mod is the focus on romance and the deeper exploration of the feelings of the main characters, especially the protagonist, who ends up finding herself in an even more emotional and unstable scenario than in the original game.

title: A Delver Dreams Their Own Demise
description: A short gamelike thing that takes you through a series of moments each with a different style of gameplay.

title: I Spy: Challenger!
description: A multiplayer I SPY game released on the Microsoft Store.

title: StellarDrive
description: Gather materials, build a spaceship and explore procedural worlds.

title: Primrows
description: Live out your backyard garden fantasy. Grow, prune, and cultivate your garden in a mindful game of logic, luck, and pattern recognition.

title: Stone Simulator
description:
Be a stone / rock / boulder. Do nothing. Just exist.
Relax, meditate, and watch the seasons change in the most peaceful simulator ever.
Ever wondered what it’s like to be a rock?
Become an unflinching stone in a serene, ever-changing world. Survive centuries of seasons, weather, and absurdly mundane adventures. Grow moss, collect bird poop, and question your existence—Stone Simulator is the Zen meditation you never knew you needed… or the most boring game ever. You decide!

title: Succubus Forest
description: A village is invaded by succubi each night. On a quest to defeat them, you enter the Succubus Forest, which is home not only to succubi, but many monster girls that will attack you without mercy. You must fend them off and reach the heart of the forest.

title: A Nights Haunting: Source
description: A Nights Haunting: Source is an early access mod development enveloping the source engine community in an exciting approach to a First Person Shooter action style game play. Featuring Hammer Editor support, Source Dedicated Server support, Multiplayer Online and Single Player Story Line.

title: Harvey Norman: Windsor Queensland - Super Shareware: Games Volume 1
description: A shareware CD games that was distributed by Australian retailer Harvey Norman in 1996.

title: Deal With The Devil: Chapter 1 - Journey to Tuonela
description: A dark and mysterious adventure that takes players on a journey through Finnish mythology and the mysteries of Tuonela. Players guide John through the adventure in Tuonela, encountering characters from Finnish mythology and other mythological creatures.

title: Realm Traveler
description: Realm Traveler is an epic fantasy adventure game set in a world of boundless possibilities. You will take on the role of brave explorers, venturing through mysterious realms filled with magic, mythical creatures, and ancient secrets. Choose your hero, be it a powerful mage, a skilled warrior, or a cunning rogue. Complete quests, defeat formidable enemies, and uncover hidden treasures while shaping your own destiny.

title: Lost Age
description: In the mystical world of Lost Age, darkness looms, and heroes rise to reclaim the light. Embark on a captivating adventure where card-based strategy meets the excitement of RPG. Collect and customize powerful heroes, explore magical realms, and tackle thrilling challenges—all at your own pace. With idle mechanics, your journey continues even when you're offline.

title: SSR Summoners
description:
SSR Summoners is a turn-based combat online idle fantasy RPG featuring gacha system, allowing players to summon powerful heroes and rare characters to build their ultimate team.

Set in a rich, fantasy world, the game combines strategic gameplay with an engaging storyline, offering both offline and online progression. The gacha system provides a constant stream of new characters to collect and upgrade.

title: Inhuman Resources: A Literary Machination
description: A literary machination about corporations, conspiracies, and the unspeakable horrors you’ll commit for minimum wage.

title: Quest for a Punchline: The Collection
Apartment Filled With Cats
description: Uncover the purr-fect challenge in Apartment Filled With Cats! Explore charming, hand-drawn apartment filled with whimsical details as you search for cleverly hidden cats. Can you find them all? A relaxing, delightful journey awaits!

title: Ispitatel 4: Classic
description:
It's a comical adventure about a Russian scientist - Ravil Unisovich, who unwittingly unleashes a plague of monsters after an unsuccessful experiment.
The story takes place between 1986 - 2007 with lots of new locations to visit and new characters to meet.

title: Suri: The Seventh Note
description: Feel the beat. SURI: The Seventh Note is a rhythm platformer where you must navigate a beautiful but treacherous world to save your mother's life. Time your jumps, dashes, and tricks to the mystical music around you, and restore not just your mother's health, but the rhythm of the island itself.

title: Tetradome
description: A non-linear puzzle adventure game with 3D pixel art visuals, containing mechanical, logical, and environmental puzzles themed in a fantasy scene. Unravel the enigmas of the four elements of nature so you can free yourself from the dome!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Seekers of Eternity
description: The Patch 7.2 series update includes: New Main Scenario Quests, a new Dungeon, a new Raid, a new Trial, Cosmic Exploration, a new Large-scale Battle-oriented Duty – Occult Crescent, New Allied Society Quests – Mamool Ja, new Hildibrand Quests, Duty Support Additions, and PvP Updates

title: Tales of the Forgotten
description: Tales of the Forgotten features 3 short ghost stories that haunt everyday locations. Explore PSX-style environments in first person, endure jump scares, and experience surreal moments. Unlock multiple endings to uncover the secrets of the forgotten ghosts.

title: Bone n' Gone
description: A challenging and fun game that will push the player to the peak of their gameplay. Get ready to win, lose, die, and play again! Perfect for those looking for a challenge in the FPS style!

title: Heart: Future Whispers
description: Heart: Future Whispers is a top-down shooter set in a dystopian future. Face hordes of enemies, manage resources to acquire powerful weapons, and uncover the dark secrets behind the chaos. Test your skills in infinite mode and fight for the highest score!

title: Switched Destiny
description: A space mystery in 1-bit pixel art, where every choice unveils dark secrets.

title: The Final Fragment
description: A coming-of-age visual novel with GxG romance elements set in a Ukrainian arts academy. Nina tries to keep the trouble at bay. But when a mysterious incident occurs at the academy, will she muster the courage to confront the things she's been running away from?

title: Canvas Infernum
description: Canvas Infernum is a strategic tile-placement landscape builder where you craft a surreal Renaissance-inspired hell using real historical art. Seal pacts that shift gameplay dynamics, blending classic board game mechanics with roguelike elements and story-driven progression

title: Midnight Garden
description: During the day, explore the dark surroundings in search of vital resources to fortify your garden and protect your home. Each tool you possess is a key to collecting specific resources, essential to building your defenses. Prepare for the crucial moment: when night falls!

title: Kaizen: A Factory Story
description: Kaizen is an open-ended puzzle automation game from the original Zachtronics team, set in 1980s Japan. Design, build, and optimize production lines to create iconic products, like calculators, camcorders, and arcade machines.

title: Sonic Flow 2: Next Dimension
description: Sonic Flow 2: Next Dimension is a Sonic game that takes place 5 years after the events of Sonic Forces in the Classic Dimension. Following the story of the very very badly made first game, the gathering of the 7 Chaos Emeralds in Modern Sonic's frozen dimension causes his dimension and all connected ones worlds to shatter into floating pieces.

title: Metal Garden
description: Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game.

title: Tails Adventure: Armada
description:
Tails Adventure: Armada is an action platformer with a focus on story, exploration, and collection.

You play as the incredibly intelligent, twin-tailed prodigal kit fox, Miles "Tails" Prower caught in the midst of yet another Battle Bird invasion of Coco Island.

Run, jump, hover, and fly your way across the land. Explore, uncover secrets, solve puzzles, collect gadgets, upgrades, and candy in your efforts to dislodge the Battle Bird Armada and foil their mysterious plans.

title: Quantum Soteriology
description: 18+ Only Non Fiction Visual Novel. LGBT+ Affirming Christianity. Touhou. True story of decade of abuse faced by autistic plural trans lesbians. Survive suicide attempts, OCD scrupulosity. Keep breathing through deviated nasal septum. Fight fawn freeze and fly fly away Escape this eternal Hell

title: Battlefront Expanded
description: A mod for Star Wars Battlefront II (2017) that adds a whopping 71 custom Heroes and Reinforcements, pulling from both Canon and Legends material.

title: Mochi's Cosy Quest
description: A 3D puzzle game where you lead a little capybara to its goal of eating fruit. Make use of the environment to get to the fruit as you are completely unable to jump.

title: Meow Garden
description: Welcome to Cat Island, a cozy farming sim where cats sprout from the soil! Plant seeds, care for your cats, and discover over 40 breeds. Decorate your home, train your cats, fulfill orders, and grow your own cat estate.

title: Mauri Mursu's Odyssey
description: Mauri Mursu’s Odyssey is not just a game — it’s a legacy. A journey through time, space, and the elements themselves. Dive into a world where philosophy meets action, where every battle is a lesson, and where every victory brings you closer to mastering the mysteries of the universe.

title: Flibbius McDoogle and the Mysterious Flying Machine
description: Flibbius McDoogle and the Mysterious Flying Machine is a short adventure puzzle game. Use your wits, creativity and puzzle solving ability to help Flibbius take to the skies!

title: Birdigo
description: A word game about migrating birds - inspired by Wordle and Balatro. Play cards, build your deck, trigger combos and guide your flock. From John August (Corpse Bride) and Corey Martin (Bonfire Peaks).

title: Critter Caboodle
description: Watch and play with quirky critters as they generate loads of money for you in a unique idler/creature collector hybrid.

title: Cloudy & Stormy: Pawtastic Adventure
description: A side scrolling adventure. Fly high as Cloudy and lightning dash as Stormy! Jump through colorful regions, help new friends, find treasures, and overcome challenges on your quest for a lost blanket.

title: Himawari Catastrophe!
description:
Slice your way through the Garden of the Sun as Tenshi Hinanawi in this fast and arcadey top-down hack and slash game!

This game was made in a little over a week for Touhou Fan Game Jam 15!
