title: LingTian 2: Your Destined Prince
description: LingTian 2 is a gorgeous and exquisite otome visual novel game. You are ordinary girl experiencing a sweet royal romance with Prince LingTian of Fang Kingdom! The game features over 1,000 stunning scenes, full voice acting, a main storyline, and 10 interactive sections.

title: Cultivation of The Strong
description: The Self Cultivation of the Strong "is a combination of developing a world map, third person survival shooting, and Roguelike. To become a true powerhouse, one must pass the test of girls! The greatest hero of the empire, are you ready to take on the challenge?

title: Draconis 8
description: Draconis 8 is a trading card game that meets the balance and strategy of a tile-laying board game. Each pack includes a terrain card and a complete, balanced eight-card deck for one player — featuring one powerful dragon and seven champions ready for battle.

title: Trash Horror Collection 5
description: A collection of 7 trashy horror games!... this will definitely give you an 80s vibe!

title: Stream Star: Sensations
description: Stream Star: Sensations is an erotic experience, where you stream explicit content for chat donations. Upgrade your space, discover new positions through research, and manage enjoyment for an engaging stream experience.

title: Kuu
description: Trapped in the fading light of a broken moonhouse, you have 30 nights to balance scarce resources. Grow meager rations in the weak earthlight. Navigate the emotional sanity of a fragile sisterhood. Decode ancient documents in search of secrets. Your only choices will be impossible ones.

title: Medievaly: Battle Simulator
description: Feeling Medievaly? Travel to the most vibrant version of the Dark Ages yet to defend your kingdom from encroaching enemies! Devise creative strategies, manage resources, and enjoy a dynamic simulated medieval battlefield where every decision matters and the unexpected will always happen!

title: Helios Hotel: The Night Shift
description:
Rose has just moved to a small town ready to start a new life. Luckily, she quickly found a job as a receptionist at the Helios Hotel, the fancy new hotel in town. Her first day proves working at the Helios Hotel isn't quite what she was expecting.

Helios Hotel: The Night Shift is a story-driven choose-your-own-adventure style horror game inspired by paranormal and slasher films. Play as Rose and perform the functions of the hotel receptionist while uncovering strange occurrences that begin to unfold more and more each night. This is a short indie horror game broken down into four chapters.

title: Hand of Fate: Hordes
description: Hand of Fate: Hordes is a dark-fantasy bullet heaven auto-shooter powered by your strategic deckbuilding mastery. Survive the horde, forge your build, and unleash devastating attacks to escape a netherworld beyond the 13th Gate. Thrive in chaos!

title: World of Warships: Legends - A Tale of Bravery
description: Enhance your fleet with U.S. Tier IV Premium destroyer Hill, named after Edwin J. Hill, a hero of Pearl Harbor. You'll also receive an American Commander crate, Promotion Orders, camouflages, and more.

title: Ruff Day at the Office
description: Play as an adorable office dog who overhears his owner's needs and decides to help! Grab items in your mouth, type on computers, complete silly tasks with pure dog logic across every floor of the office building.

title: Entropy Architects
description: "With each layer's laws collapsing, every decision reforges the world!" Will you become a desperate gambler, or emerge as a calculating tactician? Every choice remolds your fate – and sometimes, you'll need a dash of luck to tip the scales. Forge your ultimate build and conquer the impossible!

title: Chou Mentei Sherlock-chan: Okiteyaburi no Misdirection
description: The famous detective Sarako Imai (Sherlock-chan) takes on a difficult case! Sherlock-chan and Watson-kun are on a comfort trip. Can they solve a murder case at a winter spa resort? A murder mystery with a challenge to the player.

title: Rain Kills
description: Smash crystals, dodge rain, make money, upgrade your equipment, keep going.

title: Capsule Fighting
description: This is a game in the rougelike genre. Where you'll control your character through challenging, dramatic battles. The game offers many character customization features such as character upgrades, weapon upgrades, equipment systems, support drone systems.

title: Cirno's Card Class
description: Victory or defeat depends on the placement of your cards, timing of usage, and combinations. Create your own tactics and unleash unpredictable plays!

title: Galaxy Odyssey
description: Embark on a Space Journey with Spacecraft. Control your spacecraft with six degrees of freedom as you explore the vastness of space. Activate Beacons to extend your signal range and refuel to keep moving forward. Beware of asteroids, debris, and lasers aimed at taking you down.

title: Synthetic Paradox
description: Synthetic Paradox is a sci-fi action rogue-lite mixed with tower defense elements. Fight never-ending waves of enemies and bosses, collect items and build up your defenses alone or in co-op for up to 4 players! Discover unique combinations of towers and items to help you protect your Core!

title: Filiy Eclipse
description: Filiy Eclipse is an exploration action RPG that explores a mysterious science fiction world.Explore the surface, underground and sky of the star to discover what happened aboard it.

title: Macho Harvest: Muscular Harvest Puzzle
description: A super chaotic puzzle game of macho x agriculture! ? Let's raise various kinds of machos that are born by sowing protein in the field with care and love and ship them!

title: 100 Cats Italy
description: Find 200 Cats hidden in Italy! Can you find them all?

title: World Hockey '88
description: Turn back the clock! Take a shot! Face-off against friends and family side-by-side or over the (inter)net in this modernized celebration of video games of hockey past!

title: Wanderling
description: Wanderling is a no-combat roguelike platformer about exploration. Die, retry, and mark your path deeper into a dungeon filled with traps and enemies. You get 8 tries to gain the upgrades and map knowledge needed to clear each dungeon.

title: MMKK
description: Use the earpick to remove earwax!

title: Newton Coin
description: Newton Coin This is a clicker game. In the game, you need to click on the Coin. You'll get a random Newton - themed gold coin every three hours. With effort and luck, you can continuously expand your gold coin collection!

title: A 20-year-old game is being remade with the newest engine RPG Maker Unite and distributed for free?: RPG Maker's heroes vs. the demon king
description: The game that was created 20 years ago with RPG MAKER 2000 has been remade in the latest RPG MAKER UNITE!(←the story setting, but it's true that RPG MAKER UNITE was made!) Let's enjoy this new RPG Maker experience, which fuses nostalgia and chaos!

title: Secret Cats: St. Patrick
description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Secret Cats - St. Patrick" a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

title: Deductopia Chapter 1: Bring Your Pet to School Day
description: Can you sort out this chaotic classroom? Six kids, six pets, six desks--but whose is whose? Drag the right names and pictures to the right desks to win!

title: Bad Midwife
description: You play as a pregnant woman kidnapped and trapped in an unknown place. Based on true events, survive a psychological horror journey where every step could cost your life, and your baby. Can you get the best final?

title: Obstacle Overdrive
description: Cruise through a world of colorful retro inspired toys in Obstacle Overdrive, a cozy off-roading toy car adventure! Navigate fun, challenging courses, tumultuous tumbles, and enjoy the charm of a miniature world where the obstacles are as playful as the ride itself.

title: Play Together: Hunter Cash's Hidden Safe
description: Here's a golden opportunity for you to accumulate more in-game currencies! Acquire Gems, Stars, and Theme Draw Tickets for an incredibly low price!

title: Sub-Verge
description: Conversation is a dangerous game. Manipulate a fractured band of renegade divers to reach the depths of this short narrative puzzle. Uncover alliances and expose betrayals — before something horrific from the dark abyss silences you all. Don’t let the conversation get too deep.

title: Beast Saga
description: Beast Saga is an open-world RPG set in a martial arts universe where you play as a young wolf tribe member named Lang Jiusi. Immerse yourself in a world of free exploration, gathering, crafting, life skills, martial arts cultivation, forming alliances and experiencing unique Jianghu adventures.

title: Supra Binyot Lande 2: Melpert's Quest for Booti
description: In this sequel to the 2019 Vinesauce fangame Supra Binyot Lande, Melpert must platform his way through 10 levels and battle bosses in order to find enough treasure to pay off the ransom to save his friend Gnorp. He will find upgrades to assist him, such as Monster cans or Dark Souls.

title: Creepy Shift: House For Sale
description: Handyman needed—ASAP! The investor’s coming in the morning, and the house still isn’t ready! Take on an extra shift where horror meets simulation. Tackle the chaos, uncover dark secrets, and finish everything before dawn.

title: Tropico 6: Return to Nature
description:
“Penultimo, where are you? – I can’t find my registration for that ‘Forest Bathing for Beginners’ course!” Something seems a bit off with El Presidente today… and you might be right if you suspect Sunny Flowers has got something to do with this!

El Prez is branching out: In Tropico 6 – Return to Nature you will reap the benefits of nature with the help of a mysterious new world wonder – the Biggdrasil – as well as blooming new buildings. Well, there we are – sounds much more like El Prez, right? From Forest Schools to Tree Houses and the Beekeeper you’ll cultivate the green side of dictatorship like never before!

Treehugger’s Paradise: In Tropico 6 – Return to Nature you build your way to a greener Tropico with 15 new buildings, including Forest Schools, Tree Houses and the iconic Biggdrasil – the island’s first homegrown world wonder and the first one you can customize.

‘El Árbol De Maravilla’: Play through a new scenario, designed to help you find your way to get the most out of nature’s abundance. The scenario map is also available for you to tinker around in sandbox mode.

Make Tropico Green Again: Flex your power with 3 new edicts like ‘Reforestation’, ‘Natural Reaction’ and ‘Tropical Paradise’ edicts – because you care.

No Greens, No Glory: Introducing the new ‘Nature’ value, a fresh, not to say organic, metric that works similar to the ‘Beauty’ value. Keep it high and revel in the ‘harvest’ from your new buildings.

Impress Sunny Flowers: Spruce up your style with your new Nature Suit and adorn your palace garden with one of 4 scenic Biggdrasil statues.

title: Card Draw
description: A relaxing roguelike deckbuilder where you construct equations with your cards. Craft your strategy, build your deck, draw cards and create equations to produce points. Climb the leaderboards with your high score in multiple different game modes, or simply click, relax and watch big numbers go up.

title: Cannibal Harvest
description: Short Horror Game

title: Mask of Dead II: Shadow Of Pelagius
description: Mask of Dead 2: Shadow of Pelagius is a JRPG with an active combat system. A lot of time has passed since the first Adamant War the reapers were able to recover from the damage they received and restore Purgatory, but not for long... Riom Ruri, the son of the High Reaper, has just finished training and has already received his first task - to scout the surrounding area with a small squad of other reapers. But everything does not go according to plan and Riom is forced to face the mistakes of his brothers in the past and save Purgatory from complete destruction.

title: Sanrio Characters Miracle Match: Magical Onigokko
description:
An action game where you play tag with cute characters in a magical world! Will you become a “Challenger” and escape? Or will you become a “Hunter” and catch the Challengers? Utilize each character’s magical skills wisely!

As you play, you will obtain “Jewels.” By collecting Jewels and spending them at the “Shop,” you will be able to make friends with new characters and obtain new costumes. Show off your fashion sense by dressing up your favorite character in a pretty dress or cool jacket!

title: VG Trivia Challenge
description:
Welcome to the Video Game Trivia Challenge. Here, you will answer over 75 questions and identify over 50 songs to gather (fake) money. Earn enough to receive passwords. The game is based on Who wants to be a Millionaire, and most pictures and sounds are from that show. Other songs are from various video games.
Good luck, and have fun.

title: Matolek the Goat's School
description: Another educational game with the friendly Koziolek Matolek in the lead role. This time the title character invites children to visit the school in Pacanów, where he and his friends go.

title: Girl Abducted
description: A quiet evening turns into a nightmare. Two sisters find themselves stalked by abductors. As they close in, the girls must outwit their pursuers to survive the night. With tense chases, comedic twists, and daring escapes, their bond will be tested in a high-stakes battle for freedom.

title: Crimson Tale
description:
Crimson Tale is a short first-person narrative puzzle game where Elizabeth takes one last action against the oppressing forces of the nobility. Avoid the sun, go back in time with blood magic and use your vampire abilities to find the golden guard, ending this tyrany once and for all.

You are Elizabeth, a vampire who returns to a decaying village where the nobility has fled and the guards control the people. With Christie’s death still fresh, Elizabeth uses her powers to travel to the past, discovering the hidden fates of those connected to the village’s downfall. While she uncovers the other's past lives to change the future, her determination sets out to avenge her love and bring an end to the last of the tyranny responsible for the remaining chaos.

title: Matolek the Goat the Inventor
description: A set of interesting, addictive games and educational games with the friendly Matolek the lead role. Our hero wants to get a mysterious recipe for six at school here.

title: Arctis
description: A turn-based survival strategy game where players must lead their group of characters through an arctic landscape while exploring and dodging or confronting threats. The map consists of a series of rotating concentric circles, so it is never static between turns.

title: Getting a Bottle of Water Simulator
description: The title is pretty self-explanatory. Get the bottle of water.

title: Ghost Master: Resurrection
description: Command an army of specters, unleash terror on the town of Gravenville, and solve puzzles to unlock mysteries in this strategic adventure game of resource management and supernatural mayhem.

title: Ambulance Life: A Paramedic Simulator - Bay Side Expansion
description: Welcome to Bay Side, a brand-new district filled with emergencies! Suit up, Paramedic, lives are in your hands!

title: Dead In Antares
description: Dead in Antares is a turn-based survival management game with RPG elements, set on an alien planet. Lead a crew of survivors sent on a mission to save humanity. Manage their needs, strengthen their teamwork, and explore this mysterious world to find a way back home.

title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss
description: A mining station in the Pacific abyss is no longer responding. As an investigator of the occult, unravel the mysteries of the deep. Test your wits and sanity in this thriller inspired by the master of Providence.

title: RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business
description: RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business is a new standalone adventure of RoboCop: Rogue City. OmniTower is their fortress, violence their language. Face elite mercenaries all the way to the top of the tower and enforce the law amidst the chaos!

title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
description: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

title: Styx: Blades of Greed
description: The master of stealth is back! Explore the dizzying heights of the Iserian Continent and cunningly eliminate your enemies. Thanks to your Quartz powers, you are freer than ever. Be creative: Never has it felt so good to be greedy.

title: Titty World
description:
A free "practice game" with characters from the webcomics "IT HURTS!!" and "PLEASE FORGIVE ME!!!"
Katie and Pasqualo have been sucked into a fantasy RPG. The goal of the game is: LOOK AT TITTIES?! Say WHAT?! Join the two girls (and maybe someone else too) as they reluctantly go through this game and try to get out! Believe it or not, despite the title, this isn't a pervy game. No actual boobs.

title: Color Dark Castle
description: Color Dark Castle is a remake of the first Dark Castle adding colored graphics, new 'Novice' difficulty setting, allowing to save the game, and a secret level.

title: Sonic Scramble
description: Sonic Scramble is a 2D Platform Fighter featuring the cast of the Sonic the Hedgehog series. Using mechanics familiar to other Platform Fighters as well as mechanics inspired by Traditional 2D Fighting Games like a meter, special cancels, and super moves, Sonic Scramble aims to be a Sonic Fighting Game like no other.

title: Surge Generations
description: Surge Generations is a complete overhaul of Shadow Generations with the goal of replacing everything Shadow-related with Surge, such as voice lines, cutscenes, animations, and more.

title: Astrobuilder
description: The world’s first dynamic world AI RPG. Play as any NPC in a galaxy that evolves in real time. Every quest, dialogue, and fate is generated on the fly — no reruns, just infinite stories shaped by your choices.

title: Gordon and the Light Within
description:
Gordon the Corgi adventures through a dark forest full of many dangers his own light the only guide to help recover from the darkness that seeks to consume his love. Can he find his way back? or will the darkness prevail? A platformer with tough challenges and many enemies to defeat. A classic retro style game and even though it can be challenging at times it is definitely a game for casual players looking for the feeling of old arcade type platformers.

Move around and explore the maze of levels as you expand your light source in the darkness. Having to squish enemy squirrels, birds, and cats. With big sub-bosses and bosses that provide a challenge in finding a way to overcome them. Collect items to increase your lives and see if you can get this highest score while avoiding being crushed or falling. Watch out for certain nature items that can slow your character, and manage your health, stamina and lives carefully to make it through the levels.

Simple 2d side scrolling platformer controls using Wasd, arrow keys. or controller. run and jump mechanics (using space bar) and bouncing off enemies heads to crush them while avoiding being crushed.

Chill audio design and hand-drawn backgrounds emphasizing the nature aspects of the forest into which Gordon the Corgi is exploring his way through.

title: Doki Doki Silver & Emerald
description: Doki Doki Silver & Emerald is a short mod for Doki Doki Literature Club, created by Tiny Waffle Studios. Released on February 10, 2024, the mod combines elements of comedy and drama. In the story, Monika and Kotonoha make a bet to see who can get the best grade in an exam in the next class. Kotonoha gets a bit annoyed, and events unfold from there. This mod also offers a closure to what Natsuki mentioned at the end of “Natsuki Rants About DDLC Mods and Community”.

title: Thysiastery
description: Thysiastery is a dungeon crawler RPG featuring traditional roguelike and turn-based gameplay. Command a party of bearers of the Brand, drawn into a vast Labyrinth. Recruit while exploring the Labyrinth in hope of finding a way out, and its secrets will be revealed as you delve deeper.

title: Sweet Dreams on Christmas Eve
description: Short christmas adventure where you bake cookies for Santa!

title: Lacey's Flash Games
description: These are the REAL girls’ games. In the mid 2000s, Charlie (Charchar887), discovers the Laceys's Flash Games and their disturbing secrets. Step into the virtual world to uncover the whereabouts of the missing website creator, Rocio Yani, and explore all the games and activities with Lacey!

title: Isha's Magic Book Decoding
description: Together with the wizard Isha, embark on a roguelike adventure to decipher the magic book and resolve the anomalies occurring in this land!

title: I Am Your Beast: Support Group Update
description: The new story expansion sees a new epilogue added to the end of the game where you’ll sit in as a part of the COI Support Group. Tall tales are swapped across nine levels, with ten new cutscenes and extreme situations for Harding to force his opponents through that you don't typically experience in the main game.

title: Monsterpatch
description: A Cozy Monster-Collecting RPG, A love letter to retro monster collecting games that blends unique farming and town building mechanics!

title: Harder
description: Harder is an action rogue-like game with combat heavily inspired by the hack and slash genre. Progress through a series of enemies and bosses to reach your one true goal. Dodge, dash, parry, and slash your way through angels and demons alike in this quest to kill GOD.

title: Sheepherds!
description: Sheepherds! is a cozy co-op party game where you and your sheepdog buddies guide colorful flocks through beautiful landscapes to sheer their wool. Take your time and have fun barking, running and discovering magical places together— or take on challenges to win even more treats!

title: Tapeçaria
description: A plunderludic experiment that plays with memory and nostalgia and the meaning of moving within and around videogames.

title: Lost Garden
description: Lost Garden is a virtual space that represents the lost nature, and invites users to renew their experience of partnership and appreciation for nature through creation. The game offers an opportunity to sculpt a breathing system composed of soil, water, and plants. This takes place in a process of development, discovery, and progress, alongside disconnection and relaxation.

title: Rise of Elements
description: Rise of Elements is a Match-3 style narrative puzzle game with classic RPG elements, where players will clash for victory. Compete in Argos’s Tournament of Champions to achieve elemental mastery and rid the world of Aetheron of the Void’s looming threat.

title: Floor 0
description: Immerse yourself in a psychological horror experience presented as unsettling found footage. You are trapped in an endless, dimly lit hallway, with nothing but a flashlight to help you. Starting on floor 10, you have one goal — reach floor 0 and escape.

title: Pac-Man SDL
description: Pac-Man Arrangement inspired fangame

title: Death In Your Dice
description: Can you outwit fate when your turn comes? From now on, all you care about is the game of dice and its consequences. Observe, investigate, act, defend yourself. Time is ticking away, but death will not wait.

title: Baba Is You: Baba Make Level
description: Baba Make Level adds an official level editor, the ability to share levels online with other players, a curated "Featured Levels" list, two new official levelpacks containing over 250 entirely new and unused/cut levels, new art, new music and new rules.

title: The Quest for Achievements
description: Dive into The Quest for Achievements, a charming pixel-art mini RPG where the thrill of the game meets the satisfaction of collecting. Prepare for an unprecedented achievement hunting experience, unlike any other RPG adventure!

title: All Abug!
description: Faced with the threat of a wave of toxic fumes, embark on an expedition to save yourself from certain death. Gobble up obstacles on your path to allow your caterpillar to move along and board survivors who also seek asylum!

title: Spirit Drop
description: Spirit Drop is a free stacker game with a focus on control and self-improvement for Windows and Linux. Developed by RayBlast Games since May 3rd, 2020, it features extensive single-player variety, various practice modes, as well as modular custom rulesets, which can be used in multiplayer.

title: Trials of The Illuminati: Animated Christmas Time Jigsaws
description: Get into the holiday spirit with Trials of the Illuminati: Animated Christmas Jigsaw Puzzles, a relaxing and engaging jigsaw puzzle game perfect for unwinding this Christmas season! Immerse yourself in the festive cheer with beautifully animated scenes and classic Christmas music as you piece together delightful holiday moments.

title: Trials of the Illuminati: Sea Creatures Jigsaws

description: Prepare for a hilarious and addictive experience with 69, a uniquely crafted casual fast-clicker game that will test your reflexes and tickle your funny bone. Each level completion is a testament to your skill, a small victory in a world of chaotic fun. Immerse yourself in a truly bizarre narrative drawn (very loosely!) from the true story of a rapper hilariously mistaken for colored candy. It's an experience you won't soon forget!

title: Amanita August
description: You run a tiny shop in the kingdom of Amanita, which has been attacked by an evil demon king and his army. So your job as a humble shopkeeper is to ensure that the chosen hero is well-prepared for her quest! Provide her with weapons, clothing, medical supplies, and maybe even friendship?

title: Doujin Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Doujin Jigsaw Puzzle, a unique jigsaw puzzle game featuring stunning Japanese-inspired art style illustrations. Challenge yourself to solve intricate puzzles and reveal beautiful images piece by piece.

title: Base Dominators
description:
An action-packed FPS war game, inspired by the classic ''Battlefield 1942''. Dominate the enemy bases to claim victory!

In Base Dominators, your mission is clear: dominate the enemy bases and lead your team to victory. This action-packed FPS war game allows you to choose from five distinct classes—Soldier, Sniper, Medic, Engineer, and Anti-Tank—each offering unique abilities and playstyles to suit your strategic approach. Command the battlefield by piloting tanks, cars, helicopters, and airplanes as you immerse yourself in chaotic, adrenaline-fueled warfare. With two dynamic levels—Forest and Desert—you’ll need to adapt to diverse terrains, figure out the best strategies, and collaborate with your teammates to outsmart your opponents. Whether you're coordinating attacks or holding the line, teamwork is the key to dominating enemy bases and claiming victory. If you're a fan of military FPS games, vehicle combat, or just looking for an exciting war game experience, I believe this little game delivers all the chaos and fun you'd expect.

title: Doki Doki Emerald Affection
description: Doki Doki: Emerald Affection is a modification of the game Doki Doki Literature Club! which focuses on the relationship between the protagonist (MC) and the club president, Monika. After a month in the club and with graduation approaching, the MC begins to question his feelings for Monika. With a complicated past and the desire to make her happy, he faces the dilemma of confessing his feelings or letting life's problems get in the way.

title: Doki Doki Happy Thoughts
description: Doki Doki: Happy Thoughts is a modification of the game Doki Doki Literature Club! that offers players a deep immersion into the mind of Sayori, one of the main characters. As she sits down to write her poem, she realizes that in order to be honest on paper, she needs to be honest with herself. As she delves into her happy thoughts, Sayori also faces the depths of her own despair, seeking to write true to her heart. This mod is visually captivating and viscerally written, promising to leave a lasting impression on players.

title: Dreams of Literature: Noir
description: Enter Sayori's mind and follow the dreams she has during the week of the DDLC. Can you guess which day this chapter takes place?

title: Doki Doki What If
description: Doki Doki: What If is a modification for the game Doki Doki Literature Club! that explores theories about the game's original story. The mod is currently in its introductory phase, offering a preview of what to expect in the full version. The mod's creator shared a demo version on Reddit, mentioning that this introduction serves to give players an idea of what's to come.

title: The Ultimate Clicker Master of the Universe
Doki Doki Switcheroo
description: Doki Doki Switcheroo is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that features a unique premise: the characters switch roles within the story. This means that Sayori, Monika, Yuri and Natsuki take on each other's personalities and roles, creating new dynamics and unexpected interactions.

title: An Idle Nightmare
description: This is an idle game that is also a psychological horror game. You were put on a mysterious case to investigate a series of cult-related disappearances. Will you be able to lift the veil on those murders? Or will you go beyond it?

title: The Last Tape
description: A hidden truth. For over 50 years, Lurmont has been hiding incredibly dark secrets from the public. During an investigation, tapes are discovered showing all the atrocities they have committed.

title: 28 Days Later: The Game
description: Fan recreation of danny boyle horror movie

title: Intravenous 2: IV1 Remaster
description: Described by its developer as "Intravenous 1 2.0", Intraveous 2: IV1 Remaster is a remaster of Intravenous (2021) using assets and features from Intravenous 2 (2024) released as downloadable content for the latter.

title: Stardust Skate
description: Skate through Stardust Valley in this endless runner, competing for the highest score and the coolest deck!

title: Heart Of Evil: Source
description: A port of Heart Of Evil to the Source engine with new features like aiming down iron sights.

title: Cave Up
description: In Cave Up you find yourself at the bottom of a deep cave. Your goal is climb up and find your way out. To do this you may draw shapes at the top of the screen, drop them down and then maneuver up to a hole in the ceiling. Along the way you'll encounter plenty of obstacles that will prevent you from climbing to the top in a straight line.

title: Moonring DX
description: Moonring DX gives players access to The Egg: a 100 floor megadungeon for players who are advanced enough to have explored most of Caldera but have not yet completed the game.

title: Cycene
description:
Cycene is an "earliest access" game, with hopes of becoming the most successful live service game of all time. At present time of writing, it does not have working servers. Features include: jumping, sprinting, stilts, and talking. It has one environment and one level. Every character is a seal with a toilet plunger.

More content is promised in the future, such as "Daily login bonuses and other menial tasks!", "Aggressive microtransactions!", and "TOO MUCH CONTENT".

title: Star Garden
description: Dive into an electrifying single-player story or take on thrilling multiplayer battles with up to four players locally or six online. Star Garden brings creature collection, exploration, and fast-paced action to life in stunning, dynamic worlds. Your interstellar adventure awaits!

title: Cannon Guys
description:
Build your own deck of weapons and outsmart the enemy in turn-based, one-on-one battles. Become the leader of three fighters, create a strategy and shoot! Enjoy epic landscape-destroying hits. Collect and upgrade weapon cards. Win battles and move to new arenas to unlock powerful new cards in your collection! Get chests from which you can get rare and legendary weapons and fighters! Climb the rankings in online battles or challenge a friend!
You have many options for how to destroy your enemies, and the arena changes from explosions. Create your own team of three unique fighters and choose the weapon you want to fight with. Weapons differ in their capabilities and mechanics, which makes the...

title: Face Love: Face Designer
description: ITS VALENTINES SEASON AND EVERYONE'S FACES GOT BLOWN OFF!

title: Angelic Agency: Soul Salvation Unit
description:
"Angelic Agency: Soul Salvation Unit" is a mystery adventure featuring a public security duo tackling supernatural cases.

Players take on the role of Tsujitsuma, a member of the "Angelic Agency" investigating "Ghosturbance Cases." The game progresses through three phases: (1) Conversation Part, (2) Deduction Part, and (3) Salvation Part.

Players navigate these phases to uncover the truth behind each incident.

title: Sentimental Garden
description:
Is this space I see now a phantom garden?
Is this space I see now a phantom garden?

This is a short game in which you simply walk around in a garden-like space.

title: No More Shopping
description: Go through the supermarket buying all the products on the list, but be careful! Your family is very forgetful so they won't stop calling you to ask for more products they didn't think of in the first place. What could be more stressful?

title: Universe Horizon
description: An idle incremental game where you decide to travel across the whole Universe. Embark on this journey in your little ship and get as far away as possible from Earth, gathering resources and upgrading your spaceship along the way.

title: Star Wars Arcade Remake: Racer
description: This is a remake of the first of three arcade star wars sega games!

title: Urban Explorers
description: An intriguing paranormal investigation roguelite where you must break into murky places in order to unravel the mysteries behind a town that was evacuated after a nuclear accident.

title: Seed of Nostalgia
description: Seed of Nostalgia is a beautiful pixel art JRPG which follows the tale of Atilla and a cast of intriguing characters on a quest to save their dying world. Explore a mystical land, unravel dark secrets, and confront ancient forces in a tale of magic, sacrifice, and unexpected revelations.

title: Deserto Divino
description: You're Quespin, a young Egyptian who suddenly dreams of something that could change your life forever — so you set off on a bold journey across Egypt’s endless deserts and ancient pyramids to chase it. Along the way, you'll face challenges, meet unforgettable people, and discover that this journey will transform your life in ways you never imagined.

title: Flugrettung: Die Simulation
description: Flugrettung: Die Simulation is a helicopter flight rescue simulation where players assume the role of an air rescue pilot leading a team of emergency doctors, paramedics, and dog handlers. Players navigate over 100 rescue missions including avalanches, car accidents, and industrial fires, making strategic decisions in time-critical situations. The game features realistic flight physics, 3D landscapes with map-based navigation, and detailed graphics designed to create an immersive rescue operation experience.

title: Alone in the Stars: Survivor
description: Fight through alien worlds, obliterating relentless foes, and forge your own path to unlimited power. In this third-person roguelite shooter, harness the power of deep customization. Adapt, experiment, and break the limits of power as you carve your legend across the stars.

title: Tales of Wind: Radiant Rebirth
description:
Start your adventure in Tales of Wind: Radiant Rebirth today – the epic action MMORPG loved by millions, now more vibrant than ever.

Tales of Wind: Radiant Rebirth is a vibrant and action-packed MMORPG that blends classic fantasy with innovative mechanics, designed to keep you hooked on mobile and PC. Get ready for a brand-new adventure with smoother gameplay, more customization, and an expanded world to explore!

Explore the world of La Place, a city blessed by the gods, now under the shadow of dark forces. Your power is needed to uncover the truth and restore the light.

title: Nolean: The Space Bartender
description: Play as a bartender traveling across the galaxy, serving unique drinks to clandestine clients while evading the watchful eyes of the Shioncala Empire. With your trusty ship, you'll navigate space, dodge patrols, hack enemy systems, and craft custom cocktails without leaving a trace.

title: Ministry of Order
description: You’ve been assigned to the Maternity Ward in a totalitarian 1920s state. Reunite newborns with their rightful parents using a simplified genetics puzzle - no mistakes allowed. Obey the regime, join a secret conspiracy, or forge your own path.

title: The Vampire's Bride: A Bride Who Gets Married to Vampdoll
description: A visual novel game featuring a pure love girls' love story bound by blood, with the concept of "Vampires x Military Uniforms x girls' love (yuri) ."

title: Overlooting
description: An inventory management roguelite game. Adapt your strategy to a skill tree that changes every run, combine pieces of equipment to form powerful synergies and create a game-changing build capable of defeating the bosses that will try to stop you.

title: Whale Singer: Rise of the Leviathan
description: Dive into a musical adventure where singing is the key to defeating an ominous creature destroying the oceans. Follow the song of your ancestors, explore breathtaking environments, forge new connections, and discover the magic in the depths of the sea... and the magic within.

title: Ankoku-jou
description: An adventure game with an epic story divided into 9 volumes. The setting is the world of Minelvaton, which is from another dimension. The story is about defeating the dark apostle Gru, who wants to become ruler, by destroying the legendary "Mirror of La Val" and creating a new world.

title: How Was Your Day?
description:
Caught in a strange time loop and with her beloved dog, Beans, missing, 13-year-old Diya discovers that building meaningful connections is key to solving the sinister mystery in this beautifully illustrated 80s-themed narrative adventure. Can Diya break free from the endless cycle and find Beans?

Video game enthusiast and moody 13-year-old Diya’s day starts out rough. It’s the late 80s, and on top of the usual teenage angst—school, bullies, cliques, and annoying adults—Diya’s just moved to a new country, has no friends, and her once-close relationship with her brother is souring. Ugh! But when the only light in her life, her beloved dog Beans, vanishes without a trace, and she finds herself trapped in a mysterious time loop, Diya’s day goes from bad to worse.

Groundhog Day meets Stranger Things in this narrative-driven, point-and-click adventure that brings a supernatural twist to an ordinary teen’s life. Journey through Diya's repeating day, where every interaction could hold the key to breaking the loop and unlocking the truth about Beans' disappearance.

title: Gravity Flip X
description: Immerse yourself in a pixel-art platformer with a gripping anime-style story! Each level unveils new challenges—dodging obstacles, intense shootouts, thrilling chases, and unexpected alliances. Discover the world step by step and experience a narrative full of twists and excitement!

title: Rawyokan
description: Rawyokan is a single player fighting game with focus on simplicity – one button allows the player to unleash a series of strikes to the opponent or parry incoming attacks when timed correctly. Fight your way through multiple opponents and challenge the grandmaster.

title: Sky Ahoy
description: In this steampunk RPG, adventure into a world of floating islands, pirates and robots. Craft and dismantle with a unique forging system and watch as the world changes around you based off your choices. Will you be a hero, a pirate or break the system and become a revolutionary?

title: Anomaly Living
description: Anomaly Living is a cooperative horror game for 1-2 players. Only you can help find Leia in this world filled with monsters and anomaly phenomena. Good luck!

title: The Ringing of Twilight
description: Navigate through various levels as you search for artifacts. But you must listen to your surroundings, for an invisible entity draws ever closer...

title: Morse Academy
description: Three operatives return to the ruins of their abandoned boarding school, chasing a cryptic fugitive. But as they traverse through the school, old wounds resurface, and fear turns them against each other.

title: Hole: Bottomless
description: "The universe looks at you." A short liminal and cosmic horror game about escaping from a bizarre subway station.

title: Paper Mall
description:
WHAT ARE YOU DOING IN THE MAZE !?
This is a small dungeon crawling style maze game made by the developer of Copper Odyssey.

In this game, you will be finding 3 Candy Plates that will be given to you by Loved Ones. That's it! It is a simple game as this was basically made in a 3 day timespan.

You will be playing as 3 Schoolgirls who have dressed themselves as The Sun, The Artist, and The Moon.

title: 1.96.9 All Update
description: The game is simple to play, with players using the mouse to search for hidden NPCs. The game allows players to save while playing, and there is no "game over" for players, making it easy to play. Some NPCs like to hide, so we recommend exploring the map thoroughly.

title: CodeRed 911
description: CODERED 911 is a Multiplayer, Open World PvP game. Players choose to be either a criminal or a cop. Create your own gang as an open world criminal or join the police force to bring justice to the streets. Choose your side!

title: Meyouw
description:
Play with Your Voice, Embark on an Adventure!

A fun and energetic game for kids who love to shout! My nephew is always shouting, so I wanted to create a game where he could channel his energy in a fun and engaging way. Maybe you’d like to test how well you can control your voice too!

This game was designed as a special keepsake for my nephew and will be released on his birthday!

How to Play?

Kitty Kitty Mode – Whisper or make a soft sound... That’s it! Our cat starts walking! But be careful—if you're too quiet, your cat might suddenly stop!
Meow Jump – Make a little more noise! Hoooop, our cat just jumped! But don’t overdo it, or you might fall into an unexpected trap!
Are the Doors Closed? – No problem! Raise your voice a bit more, be brave, and shout! Our cat will open the door! But be careful not to disturb the neighbors!

️ Bonus Tip: Use the mouse scroll wheel to zoom in and out. Maybe you'd like to take a closer look at those adorable little paws!

Are you ready to overcome obstacles using your voice? Grab your microphone and join this fantastic adventure!

If you enjoy the game, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist! That would be a huge motivation for me. Thank you in advance!

title: Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey
description: Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey is a roguelite turn-based strategy RPG. Wield magic and might against legendary foes from Greek mythology. Recruit a synergistic army and cultivate your hero to win Immortal Glory!

title: Death & Faeology
description: In a world where the fae-touched fall prey to a sinister killer, only a faeologist can uncover the truth. A dark academia murder mystery narrative game inspired by Strange Horticulture and the Ace Attorney series.

title: NetEscape
description: Once a thriving 90s MMO, NetEscape now stands as a time capsule, housing a dark secret beneath its bright, colorful surface. With the server shutdown looming at midnight, explore, gather clues, and uncover the mystery hidden within NetEscape before the game—and its secrets—are lost forever.

title: Nifty
description: A metafictional puzzle game created by Mr. Yes.

title: Tetris: The Grand Master 4 - Absolute Eye
description:
The action puzzle game Tetris the Grand Master first appeared in game arcades in August 1998, and became a beloved game for gamers as a Tetris game packed with addictive elements.

Then, Tetris the Absolute: The Grand Master 2 was released in 2000, and Tetris the Grand Master 3: Terror Instinct was released in 2005. The latest in the series, Tetris the Grand Master 4: Absolute Eye, ​​will be available on Steam for the first time in 20 years.

This time, Tetris the Grand Master 4: Absolute Eye offers players a deeper, more strategic Tetris experience, and the depth of the game will satisfy even experienced players. New modes have been added, and this game will test your skills to the limit, requiring precise strategy and fast play.

Of course, there are also modes that even beginners to Tetris can enjoy, and the game is so full of charm that you will find yourself retrying it over and over again.

The sound is handled by Shinji Hosoe, who is well known for the Tetris the Grand Master series. His music, full of tension and excitement, will increase the player’s concentration and make the game even more exciting.

title: Rentlord
description: A roguelike real estate game where you buy properties, manage your income, and overcome unique weekly challenges.

title: World Flag Master
description:
How Many Flags of the World Do You Know?
A Fun Brain-Training Game to Learn Flags While Playing

title: Tell Me Your Story Games Collection
description: Cook For Love, Amelia’s Garden, and titular Tell Me Your Story are here to accompany you during rainy days.

title: Tiny Lands & Not Not: A Brain Buster
description: Train your brain, spot the differences, and test your reflexes—solo or with friends!

title: Soccer Dash: Football Simulator
description: Control the ball, conquer the game!

title: Hentai Girls: Flight Crush
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Game & Console Supermarket: Business Simulator
description: Build, stock, and dominate the Gaming Market!

title: Forest Ranger Life Simulator
description: Step into nature’s shoes – a ranger’s journey begins!

title: Eggconsole Super Zenon Gamma 5 PC-8801mkIISR

The Many Readings of the Japanese Kanji “生”
Learn Them Through a Fun Quiz!

description: Speed, skill and whiskers - can you master the fishy rush?

description: A haunting tale of sin and redemption, bound by a twisted fate. Can three individuals uncover the tragic past hidden beneath the crimson-stained snow?

title: Atomicboy 2
description: Atomicboy 2 is an original game successor to a mod to Chirpy the Penguin

title: The Legend of the Vampire
description: Legend of the Vampire is an RPG style game with anime visualization. In the game, you have to play as one of the vampires or paladins who fights against vampires. You will be able to fight with friends and other players, get a pet, find a companion and propose to her. Choose a mage, archer, or swordsman character type and go in search of adventures and new friends.

title: BomberCin 2
description:
BomberCin 2 is a homage to the early Arcade and NES games, like Mario Bros., Wrecking Crew, Gyromite and Bomberman.
In this game, you play as Cin, a little chick with a protection helmet, and your job is to stop an infestation of nasty bugs using nothing but an endless supply of bombs!
Unlike most platformers out there, you are unable to jump, so you must climb up ladders and use your bombs as both a defense tool and a weapon to defeat upcoming baddies.

title: Box 'n' Robot
description: Box 'n ' Robot is an old school box pushing puzzle game with randomly generated levels. Walk around a ship filled with boxes, with the task of turning off all the lights.

title: CubbettyCube
description: Test your precision in this simple yet challenging platforming adventure!

title: K-pop Idols Dating: Anime Love for PinkOrbil T.
description: Conquer the Hearts of Future K-pop Stars in 30 Days!

title: Mine Clicker: Base Craft Building Game
description: Tap, Mine, Build—Create Your Ultimate Base!

title: Sakura Haven
description: "Sakura Haven – A Tranquil Journey Through a World of Blooming Beauty"

title: West Escape: Complete Edition
description: Outrun the law, blast aliens, and fight for love in the Wild West!

title: Rocket Penguin
description: Rocket Penguin is a unique 2D flying game that may seem simple but requires master-level skills to reach outer space.

title: Super Smash Bros. Crusade: Light Yagami
description: A custom character mod for Light Yagami from Death Note, complete with full moveset, for Super Smash Bros. Crusade.

title: An Idle Nightmare 2: Sabbath
description:
The knotting of the twigs. Gnarled Obzhynki. Erde's Congregation. In the woods, a spark is lit. The black masses rise anew. A raven's nest in bloom. The Sabbath has begun.
A few kilometers away from there, you enter the same shabby office building you have for the past year and a half, constrained to wither away your fickle little life on corporate work and cheap booze. The world is a contradiction, dull yet garish, numbing yet full of quiet panic. But it doesn't have to be.

title: Anomaly Zero: Twelve
description: Anomaly Zero:Twelve is a slow-paced horror game where your awareness and attention to details will prevail! You are trapped in this appartment! Scan your surroundings for anomalies, and try to escape!

title: Caverns of the Molten God
description: Caverns of the Molten God is an exploration platformer with gameplay inspired by Metroid and the classic arcade game Joust. Explore the caverns and uncover the secret of why you're here and what the Molten God has in store for you.

title: Pixel54
description: Pixel54 is a 2D platformer game that will take the player into a pixelated world full of adventures and challenges made of jumps and fights to overcome every enemy and obstacle. The game is based on 30 sequential levels (10 "worlds" of 3 levels each) and two different possible endings. In the game you have to collect all the ten colors (starting with a simple white you should reach red, green, blu, etc...) avoiding enemies, overtaking enigmas and fighting bosses. Collecting colors is mandatory to reach the next levels and to use some active elements inside the worlds (the player can switch between the colours so that the character will be able to use the element of that same color). The player is required to avoid traps and to be able to move around a world where everything may do harm or result in a game over. There's a shop system where you can buy powerups after having collect enough in-game coins. There are 5 levels of difficulty (from very easy to impossible), two languages (italian and english), an extra item you can buy in the shop after completing the game, original musics (made by the developer) and 3D prerendered sprites. A cheats system is provided. You can purchase the official guide (but it's italian only) to master the game and to learn the codes for the cheat system. A Windows computer is required in order to play but someone managed to run it on Linux. RTX20xx with at least 3 GB VRAM is reccomanded. You can download the game for free: it has been released on itch.io and no payment is required (you can donate though naming your own price).

title: Don't Forget to Smile
description:
Welcome to Don't Forget to Smile – the game that throws you into an adrenaline-fueled, anxiety-ridden trip through the darkest corners of modern life.

10+ weapons, 15+ augments, synergies and upgrades will help you break out of your day to day and fight back.

title: Taco Attack!
description: Catch ingredients to make tacos. But look out—catch the wrong ingredient and your taco will break! Use items to trip up your opponents or give yourself a boost. What are you waiting for?! Onion mark...get set...TACOOOOO!!

title: Tile Kingdom
description: "Tile Kingdom" is a strategic city-building game where you place your terrain into empty grids and expand your territory. You will earn reputation and become a real king.

title: The First Descendant: Season 2
description:
The First Descendant Releases Season 2 Episode 2 Update ‘Beyond The Void’

As Season 2's story expands, Descendants embark on missions in the newly introduced Sigma Sector—a once-unknown land concealed by the Void Storm. Following the destruction of the Iron Heart, the Descendants discover a crucial clue in this area while tracking Karel.

During their operations in Sigma Sector, Descendants uncover evidence of Vulgus' experiments on Arche holders. This episode also marks the significant reveal of Dia, the daughter of Gley, whose whereabouts had remained a mystery until now.

Additionally, the episode introduces Serena, one of the original Descendants who vanished 100 years ago. As Karel’s plans begin to unfold, a new enemy faction emerges—the Obliviant, a unit of Descendants who have fallen under Vulgus’ control.

With the introduction of Sigma Sector, new key characters (Dia and Serena), and the Obliviant, Episode 2 deepens the story of The First Descendant’s expanding universe.

title: Unblock
description:
Unblock is a little pseudo-isometric platformer about resilience and the power of never giving up.

Jump your way through colorful, handcrafted worlds that are as cute as they are challenging, and help Devon as he escapes the cubic realm to reclaim his ordinary life.

title: Taverna
description: Step into a bustling online tavern, filled with fantasy races and goofy roles, where your creativity flourishes through deep building customization in a highly interactive game world.

title: Stone Crawler Plus
description: A sequel to Stone Crawler, a young girl explores a strange floating city filled with monsters.

title: Rootbound
description: A physics-based action adventure about a plantling’s quest to save its home from a mysterious blight. Equipped with your sentient backpack, you venture into a broken world. Meet lost souls, solve ancient puzzles, fight dangerous monsters, and uncover the secrets of a long-forgotten civilization.

title: Kloinks!
description: A Claymation-like Standalone Game for GZDoom

title: We Bowling?!
description:
WeBowling?! is built from the ground up for Speedrunners. In this game you take control of a bowling ball of your choosing and make your way through the obstacles in the fastest amount of time.

Each of the 5 current levels (more to come) contains its own steam leaderboard so you have 5 chances to get the WR.

With force sensitivity options and ball selection, you have all the means necessary to tailor the game to your exact specifications!

Obstacles range from mini-golf esque obstacles like windmills and spinners to more mundane ones like.... a rock!

Do you have what it takes to bowl a strike?? Let's find out....

I only have one question for you....

We Bowling?!

title: MonsterEnd
description: As a survivor, although you successfully avoided the invasion of the apocalypse, after several years of life, your resources are about to run out. In order to survive, you have to leave the shelter and face enemies from all directions!

title: Backrooms: The Lost Circus
description: Backrooms: The Lost Circus is a Co-op horror game up to 4 players, where you and your friends will explore the game, try to pass the game level using your mind, wit, remembering the places where you were

title: Static Paradox
description: Your sight is limited in this first-person psychological horror game in the deep abyss. Use sound to your advantage, while you still have your mind in this experience of pure mind-numbing terror. Try to survive long enough to discover the terrible secrets... if you can...

title: Orchid Glitter
description: Orchid Glitter is late 2000s style 2d shmups. This isn't just a bullet-hell shooter where you dodge bullets. The game design also includes features like eliminating bullets with charge attacks, and earning points and resources by taking dangerous actions.

title: Half Dragon
description: Half Dragon is a open world first person RPG loosely inspired by the elder scrolls you can fight monsters, play sidequests, or talk to NPC's when the full game comes out (this game is in early stages of develepment so dont expect the game to be close to finished)

title: Little Mermaid Interactive Fairy Tale
description: Little Mermaid is an Adventure game, published by Midas Interactive Entertainment, which was released in Europe in 1999.

title: SwapFell: I Hate You.
description: A fan game loosely based off the Undertale AU "Swapfell".

title: Underfell Neutral Run
description: A fan game based on the Undertale AU "Underfell".

title: Voxelgram 2
description: A 3D nonograms game where solving puzzles feels like sculpting in three dimensions. Reveal voxel models as you complete each challenge. This edition adds puzzles in two colours and procedurally generated puzzles.

title: All Under Control
description:
"He looked weird the entire time."

What was meant to be a visit between two friends in São Paulo takes a turn to the macabre when one of them feels compelled to tell a dark story. Alex, a polar bear in his mid 20s, had moved to the city years ago with hopes for a peaceful future. He had another friend back then: a wolf with dangerous habits, who one day took a step too far...

"All Under Control" is a short furry horror VN inspired by the works of Stephen King, Junji Ito and Thomas Ligotti.

title: Vampires and Knights: Eclipse Survival & Magic Craft
description: Rise against vampires and emerge victorious in the kingdoms darkest battles.

title: Steampunch
description: Get ready for the electrifying journey of Steampunch, a casual and challenging 2D platformer! Overcome enemies, traps, and obstacles to reach the elevator that takes you to the next level.

title: Sand Legends
description: Save the princess, be the hero!

title: Remember Saint Patrick
description: Celebrate the special day with Remember St Patrick, a festive card-matching memory game perfect for all ages! Flip cards to reveal delightful St Patrick-themed icons like leprechauns, clovers, and rainbows, while testing your memory across increasing levels of fun and challenge. With cheerful visuals, cozy music, and endless holiday spirit, it’s the perfect way to make your gaming season merry and bright!

title: Paranormal Watcher
description:
Paranormal Watcher invites you into the eerie world of paranormal hunting from a safe distance but don’t let the safety of the screen fool you. As a remote paranormal investigator, you’re tasked with monitoring haunted locations through surveillance cameras. Your mission: detect and report every unsettling anomaly that creeps into view, from flickering lights to ghostly apparitions.

Paranormal activity you capture isn’t always obvious objects might move, shadows could shift, and figures may emerge from the darkness. Only your sharp eye and quick reflexes can catch the disturbances in real time and fix the scene by filing accurate anomaly reports. But beware: the ghosts might be watching you, too.

title: Pix Arts Masters Tennis
description: Realistic, true physics, local multiplayer, Tennis Game

title: Legends Aligned
description: Organize, Fit, Conquer!

title: Arcade Archives: vs. Mystery Tower
description:
"VS. MYSTERY TOWER" is an action puzzle game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1986.
The Mystery Tower is an ancient structure full of secrets that stretches up to the heavens. You play as an archaeologist, seeking its peak on an adventure.
Stack blocks to stand on as you make your way to the goal. Can you solve all the puzzles along your way to the top?!

title: Aero Cosmos
description: Soar through the void—master the skies beyond the stars.

title: WWE 2K25: Deadman Edition
description: Pre-order WWE 2K25 Deadman Edition for up to 7-Day Early Access and WWE 2K24 while you wait! Celebrate The Bloodline in Showcase. Compete online with up to 4 players in MyGM. Intergender wrestling, barricade diving, chain wrestling, Promos + more!

title: WWE 2K25: The Bloodline Edition
description: Pre-order WWE 2K25 The Bloodline Edition for up to 7-Day Early Access and WWE 2K24 while you wait! Epic exploration comes to WWE 2K25 on The Island. Celebrate The Bloodline in Showcase. Compete online in MyGM. Intergender wrestling, chain wrestling, Promos + more!

title: Dreamless Girl: Deluxe Edtion Plus
description:
Welcome to this game that combines visual novel and side-scrolling bullet hell shooter elements.

During the day, you will experience the protagonist's school life from her perspective. At night, you will become a secret operative, piloting the Dreambreaker through various dreamscapes. To find her missing sister, the protagonist, Mu Deng, dives into different dreams every night, searching for the clues her sister left behind. Along the way, she encounters various companions and gradually uncovers the secrets behind her sister's disappearance.

Deluxe Edition includes character skinpackage "Rose-hued Uniforms"&"Sweet Strike" , includes two skins each for characters Mu Deng, Plague Nun, and ZZ. These skins unlock automatically after completing specific levels.

title: The Crew: Motorfest - Year 2 Pass
description: Expand your adventure with exclusive new PvE gameplay and a total of 20 new vehicles. The Year 2 Pass includes: The Chase Squad Experience, with an exclusive playlist and new open world challenges. Hunt down all your rivals and unlock 7 exclusive Chase Squad vehicles. 13 new vehicles via monthly drops: 2 vehicles available at the launch of Year 2, and 1 new vehicle added every month.

title: War Robots: Frontiers - Lancelot Rising
description: Push beyond your limits with new battle supplies.

title: Railbreak: 90s Throwback Collection
description: Is a bundle of survival horror games from developer Dead Drop Studios.

title: Cats Games + Say Cheese! + Soko Games
description:
Challenge Your Mind – Incredible Puzzle Game Bundle!

Get ready to test your logic, creativity, and reasoning with exciting challenges! Solve complex puzzles, discover patterns, manipulate pieces, and find clever solutions to progress through each game.

With innovative mechanics and brain-teasing enigmas that encourage strategic thinking, this bundle is perfect for those who love challenges and the pure satisfaction of finding the right solution.

title: Crimson III
description:
The evil demon Crimson will not rest until humanity is destroyed. The powers of an ancient civilization made his resurrection more terrible than ever before: using robotic technology, he fused himself with a machine and became even stronger. Chosen heroes from different lands must meet each other and join forces to defeat Crimson once and for all.

Crimson III plays very similarly to its predecessor. It is a Japanese-style role-playing game with overhead navigation, first-person turn-based combat, randomly appearing enemies, and simple leveling up system. Like in the previous game, the player has to conclude initial chapters dedicated to each of the heroes before controlling them as a party on their main quest. Battles have an auto option, allowing the AI to take over the player-controlled party.

title: Rogue Candy
description: Welcome to the sweet and chaotic world of Rogue Candy! A 3D Action Rogue-Like FPS where the landscape is crafted from sugary treats and the inhabitants are living, jiggly candy creatures.

title: Death Stream
description: You wake up in a basement room, bound, with a camera staring you down. A deranged masked man entices his audience. You’ve been abducted by a lunatic who thrives on chaos and carnage. His goal? To force you into a twisted game of luck while the entire internet watches in real time.

title: Distant Lands: Earendel
description: Distant Lands: Earendel is a clicker about reality, memory and knowledge

title: Reave
description: A dark fantasy VR extraction game. Battle creatures and rival players in deadly raids. Loot, betray, and escape the depths — or die trying. Trust no one. Descend into REAVE.

title: Exoshock
description: Exoshock is a cooperative sci-fi PvE shooter that redefines VR combat with intense firefights, squad tactics, and dynamic battlefields.

title: The Beacon's End
description: You play as Samuel, a solitary lighthouse keeper on the remote Blackstone island. Tasked with a daily routine trying to forget his haunting past by maintaining the lighthouse beacon to protect passing ships, Samuel is unaware that underneath the island lurks something very sinister.

title: Enforcers Revolt
description: Enforcers Revolt is an exhilarating Player Vs Player online game, pitting teams of 10 against each other in intense battles, players are immersed in thrilling and strategic combat scenarios. For those looking to hone their skills or explore the game's intricacies, single-player modes against bots offer an opportunity to master maps and game mechanics. Join the rebellion and engage in epic clashes where teamwork, strategy, and skill determine the victors in this classic Arcade game Enforcers Revolt.

title: Katamari Damacy Rolling Live
description: Katamari Damacy Rolling LIVE — the Katamari franchise’s first original game in nearly eight years — launches exclusively on Apple Arcade. In this new adventure, players roll the Katamari as ordered by the King of All Cosmos, embracing the series’ iconic gameplay of “roll, stick, and grow.”

title: Omega Timeline: Poppy's Story - A ChristmAUs Carol
description: Following an unexpected Snowstorm hitting the Omega Timeline, Poppy and Cadence find themselves trapped in a part of the timeline's residential areas. As such, they must way to pass the time by speaking with the hundred or so people who find themselves in their same situation until people arrive to help.

title: Cartier 06
description: After a long day at work, all you want is to relax on the couch—but the night has other plans. Step into the shoes of a Romanian engineer in the mid-2000s and survive a harrowing night as something hunts you in the shadows.

title: Puffies.
description: A puzzle game that reimagines the classic jigsaw experience with a nostalgic twist of puffy stickers. Solve levels of varying difficulty by combining fun, hand-designed puffy stickers and building your collection along the way.

title: Space Invaders: Infinity Gene Evolve
description: Space Invaders: Infinity Gene Evolve is a sequel to the console versions of Space Invaders: Infinity Gene, currently available exclusively through Apple Arcade. The title adds a new set of stages to the main game, along with the mobile exclusive crossover ships from other Taito titles; new bosses; new Style Change and Burst mechanics; along with various gameplay adjustments.

title: Five Nights at Sonic's Side Story Act 1
Clean it Up!
description: Manage your cleaning store where you clean and polish every last smudge of dirt. Use the profits to upgrade your supplies and keep everything clean.

title: BlockFront
description: a WWII Total conversion FPS for MInecraft

title: Your Mother
description: "Your Mother" is a computer desktop companion. Experience the love and kindness from mothers.

title: Core Keeper: Bags & Blasts
description: That’s right, the new boss, sub-biome, pouches, explosives, and equipment are just the tip of the iceberg! Bags & Blasts is a major update, which means it’s just bursting with new additions. From even more inventory management features (quick-stack to nearby chests, anyone?) all the way to new decorations, enemies, and more. You’ll find new content across the entirety of the game, with plenty of community requested features – including more content for the Mage & Summoner classes – and lots of fun surprises along the way.

title: The Munchkin Army
description: The Munchkin Army (tentatively known as The Quest Part 2) was the second video game in the Skulduggery Pleasant series. It involved helping Mr. Bliss in defeating Dark Gods.

title: Sonic The Rise of The Death Egg
UFO
description:
UFO is a short stream-of-consciousness visual novel.

UFO is a boy's summer dream, a fragmented, brief, and surrealistic visual experience.

Teenager Plan, who is in middle school, is filled with confusion about the unknown. Like all children of this age, he is intrigued by the new and mysterious aspects of the world and humanity, while also harbouring fear.

In his dream, he encounters her, them, and it. The player takes on the role of Plan and experiences this summer dream together.

title: Inspector Schmidt: The Ebbing - Prologue
description: This is the prologue to Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing. In this detective RPG, the captain of a steamship collapses under mysterious circumstances during lunch. What happened? Question the passengers, discover and combine clues, and succeed in dice-based skill checks to solve the case.

title: Cozy Land
description: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!

title: World of Tanks Modern Armor - Tactical Expert
description:
If one gun allows you to launch a blistering assault, what can you do with three? Take command of the Orochi O-Ni and find out!

The Orochi O-Ni is a massive heavy tank for World War II mode that boasts multi-turret functionality. Switch among its three turrets to discover new tactics and unleash the full potential of its firepower.

Tactical Expert also gives you the Gunpei Takeda Commander, a formidable figure that you can customize with Skills to optimize your tank's performance.

title: World of Tanks Modern Armor - Supreme Beast
description:
When The Warlord Panther stalks the battlefield, all cower before its might! This Japanese medium tank intimidates enemies in World War II mode with its mobility and high potential damage output per minute. No prey can escape!

Supreme Beast also gives you valuable Boosters and days of Premium Account to increase your battle earnings.

title: Fight Legends: Mortal Fighting
description: Unleash your rage! Choose your class, weapons, and armor! Explore and fight!

title: Crystal Ball of Firmament
description: The spell book is missing! Help the magician to find it in this action platformer adventure. Use the crystal ball to change between the day and night to make your path, collect tokens and buy useful upgrades. Venture out 4 different biomes (mountain, woods, winter forest and city) with a total of 32 levels. Warping the day / night cycle changes ambiental obstacles and enemies behavior.

title: 100 Cats India
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in India! Can you find them all?

title: 100 Cats Philippines
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Philippines! Can you find them all?

title: 100 Singapore Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the ️Singapore, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Singapore themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍

title: 100 Sri Lanka Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the Sri Lanka, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Sri Lanka themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍

title: 100th Bug Brigade
description: 100th Bug Brigade is an accessible, story-rich, tactical, team-based roleplaying game featuring very cute bugs in a very uncute time.

title: 100 Zombie Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the ZOMBIE LAND, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 101 Cats in Antalya
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Antalya landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Cycle of Struggle: Ardengrad
description: Cycle of Struggle: Ardengrad - a visual novel about social struggle and the fates of people in a country on the brink of revolution. Four heroines, four ideologies, one choice: become a fighter or an observer, save Ardena or plunge it into chaos. Your decisions will shape the course of history.

title: Love Hospital
description: "Love Hospital" is a comedy romance simulation game where you can enjoy sweet relationships with beautiful nurses. Experience the fun and laughter-filled romance unfolding in the hospital!"

title: Dr.Mememe want to sleep
description: The genius Hakase “Mememe”, who wants to sleep all the time, invented “Kawaii Sheep”, which induces sleep with its mysterious healing properties. This is an exponentially kawaii sheep-carrying game in which Hakase puts the whole world to sleep.

title: There Is No Lore
description: Collect Cards, build Decks, alter with Trinkets, discover Synergies, win Locations, beat Bosses. All this and more await you in this roguelite deckbuilding auto-battler, but please remember - There Is No Lore, stop looking.

title: Survival and Rise: Being Alive
description: After a plane crash, you wake on a sunlit island with dinosaurs. Unarmed, you gather resources, build shelter, and upgrade gear. Discover it's an experimental island; the crash was orchestrated. Complete tasks, defeat AI, mutants, and rivals to escape.

title: Beneath Her Gaze
description: Single Route Visual Novel About a Bizarre Tall Woman. Discover all the mysteries behind her, and enjoy her company, if you can.

title: Suck It Up!
description: Suck It Up! Is an action-adventure where you take the role of an exterminator, tasked with clearing a city of its critter infestation. Dust off your vacuum cleaner and suck up the pests to save Cloud Town!

title: The Catastrophe
description: Set off into space on your personal spaceship and rescue all the lost catstronauts! Navigate through flying obstacles while managing fuel and health. Don’t forget to watch your ship’s weight — it affects your maneuverability. Enjoy a relaxing gameplay experience with pixel art and cozy cosmic vibes!

title: Fogreaver
description: Fogreaver is an intense survival-action game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. As a lone survivor, you must fight through relentless hordes, clearing each area to unlock new battlegrounds. Armed with powerful weapons, you’ll face increasingly difficult challenges.

title: Invasion Survivors
description: Invasion Survivors is a fast-paced bullet heaven and bullet hell arena shooter with roguelike elements. Explore a colorful and chaotic world where survival depends on your skills, quick reflexes, and every choice you make.

title: Brigands
description: Brigands is a “top-down hack and slash / beat 'em up adventure” game set in a medieval fantasy world. A local co-op game for casual gamers who like high intensity challenges for short periods of time. You can play from 1 to 4 players on a single computer.

title: Shadow of Backrooms
description: Explore a dark world full of liminal rooms, abandoned corridors and surreal places. You will feel lost in the backrooms, wandering aimlessly through endless corridors and hoping to find a way out. But beware: you are not alone. How long can you survive? Will you find the exit - or get lost forever?

title: Morphing
description: Morphing is a 2D adventure puzzle game where you possess the ability of morphing. This power allows you to transform and acquire the traits of certain objects or creatures. Use this unique skill to overcome challenges and explore the world.

title: VonGarland Castle: Beyond Blood
description: prepare yourself for side scrolling survival horror action. Ransom VonGarland must journey to Mayhem Island and the ruins of VonGarland Castle to find her brother and uncover the truth of what Plasmadine corporation is doing on the island

title: Tiny Sheriff
description: Tiny Sheriff is a 2D movement platformer where you use weapons as a means of transportation. Master your movement capabilities to take on increasingly daring challenges.

title: Mavors
description: A combination of Strategy and City Building, featuring modular units, organic growth, and true simultaneous movement. Territory expands into unclaimed tiles automatically while population grows exponentially. Units draw directly from population for manpower, their armament is entirely up to you.

title: Comic Store Simulator
description: Collect, sell or even display your favorite comic books! With over 100 to collect, along with various other forms of merchandise, run the store of your dreams as you order new products, employ helpful staff, stock shelves and bid on auctions in hopes to complete your comic book collection.

title: Shifting To The Backrooms
description: "Shifting To The Backrooms" is a mix of psychological horror and drama game where the protagonist, Will, grappling with family tragedies, discovers the method of "shifting" enabling him to escape to the dream liminal worlds. However, the dream turns into a nightmare from which Will cannot wake up.

title: 5 Nights at Bobr Kurwa
description: Beaver Lyolik ate too many mushrooms and became a KURWA! Only the chosen ones can survive these 5 nights!

title: Sélas
description: Sélas is a challenging puzzle-platformer where every jump counts. Explore a mysterious world, overcome obstacles, and uncover hidden secrets. Are you ready to unravel its mysteries?

title: Click Click Bomb
description: A Giant Bomb inspired clicker-incremental game with unlockables and gimmicks to discover. A casual experience, best enjoyed on a second screen at work. Features moreish Match 3-esque mechanics.

title: The Trail: Reign of Apocalypse
description: We were cut off from heaven hundreds of thousands of years ago. Since then, the corrupted soul of an evil god has wrought constant terror and destruction upon us. Will you be able to defy the prophecy and finally save the Overworld from its endless cycle of evil?

title: Hamstermind
description: Play as the legendary explorer Hamster Jones and explore a mysterious pyramid while solving the puzzles hidden within.

title: WayPoint
description: Turn-based multiplayer strategy for up to 4 players. Carve your path to the finish line or eliminate your opponents using devastating events. There are no good events in this world—only the hope that your opponent's situation is worse. Only cunning and strategy will lead you to victory!

title: Many Nights a Whisper
description: A short interactive essay on dreams, pressure, and expectations. Take part in an ancient ritual where one shot determines the fate of a generation.

title: Appulse
description: Discover pinball like never before with Appulse! The game is a roguelite shooter, where you protect a Galactic Federation ship! Upgrade your ball, your weapons and your ship to pushback waves of unwavering robots.

title: Hide In Dummy
description: "Hide in Dummy" is a multiplayer game where players hide among dummies or become the seeker. The seeker changes every 30 seconds, and the last player standing wins. Dummies spawn when players are caught, creating chaos. Use strategy to survive or outwit the seeker.

title: HappyKids
description: A casual game consisting of several mini-games.

title: The Way of Knight
