description: The Way of Knight is a chess-like puzzle game about the journey of Esroh the knight. You pilot the heroes through various enemies, boards, hazards, and stories.

title: Aether & Iron
description: Immerse yourself in this narrative RPG set in an alternate 1930s where anti-gravitational technology has taken cars, roads, and even New York City into the sky. Muster a crew, master tactical, turn-based combat, and unravel the dark secrets lurking beneath the floating metropolis.

title: Stopping Santa
description: Stopping Santa is a top-down arena shooter where you play a mercenary fighting against Santa’s legions. Short play sessions, simple controls, instant action, and a global leaderboard for the Top 10. Inspired by classic arcade games.

title: Loopbreaker
description: Loopbreaker is a class-based, third-person, action roguelike in which you can go it alone or team up with friends to battle back against the alien invasion by collecting powerful items and outpacing the onslaught.

title: Something Took Her
description: Within the rural town of Oakview, students are vanishing. One is Amy Morrison, a troubled friend of yours. People say she made a pact with something in the vents of the school. Unravel the mysteries surrounding the town's past, survive the supernatural trauma, and search for traces of your friend.

title: Make Capybara Happy
description: Jump platform to platform with cute capybara. This game much and much harder than it looks.

title: Below Benni's
description: While urban exploring a long-forgotten bakery, the floor collapses beneath you and traps you underground. Now, you must find a way out — as it seems something has been trapped down here all this time. And it knows you’re here.

title: Goofy Lil Guys
description: In this action real time local PvPvE game, players will collect a team of adorable creatures and harness their unique abilities in order to grow stronger before the final fight to the death. 2-4 local players can engage in this cute spin of split-screen battleroyale creature collection.

title: Rhythm Town: Music Visualizer
description: Rhythm Town is a cozy music-driven sandbox where your world moves to the beat. Upload your favorite tracks from your PC, place objects freely, and watch as everything sways, pulses, and comes to life with the rhythm. No challenges or pressure—just pure creativity and musical relaxation.

title: Super Spy Violet
description: Top Down-Synchronous-Stealth game where Agent Violet have to infiltrate Havvatopia City and prevent dimensional war

title: Warding Witches
description: Warding Witches offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging, amplified by an intuitive scoring system that weaves into gameplay seamlessly.

title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite
description: Face unpredictable dangers, fight perilous fires with your crew, and save lives in Firefighting Simulator: Ignite. Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter and play with up to 3 friends or with the help of your NPC controlled crew members.

title: Metal Coffin
description: War has been raging for decades with no signs of it stopping. Take your chance in bringing an end to it in this high focus strategy game. Manage your troops, your supplies and protect your flagship at all costs and you might just be able make it to the capital of the nation.

title: Fracture Point
description: After years in prison, you return to a dark megacity ruled by a ruthless corporation. The only way forward is up—through countless floors of a heavily guarded skyscraper—to reach the corporation's leader and take your revenge.

title: Waiting For You At The End of Time
description: The player is a student who, due to an accident, was plunged into a mystery of time. Can the player solve this mystery of time and space? When countless mysteries are solved, what will be the final outcome for the player and the person he loves?

title: Animas
description: Animas is a first-person psychological horror experience that plunges you into the dark secrets of the Blanco family. Explore a cursed house in the Venezuelan mountains, where time unravels to reveal decades of sectarian rituals and familial tragedies.

title: Save The Babies
description: Save The Babies is an action game that combines gunplay and platforming obstacles. A good agent's struggle to save babies kidnapped by bad guys. You are that good agent. If the bad guys want to play games, show them how to play games.

title: Sokowand
description: Sokowand is a top-down puzzle game which fuses sokoban-inspired puzzles with a magical floor that can be ripped out. Need to cross a gap? Use the floor next to you! Push boxes to open doors, manipulate signals, redirect laser by rotating mirrors and rewire entire floors full of electricity.

title: Playing House
description: Carry out the holiday mission of “Playing House”

title: Strangers Lurk
description: Play as Erica as a simple night of babysitting quickly turns into a deadly fight for survival. A masked prowler lurks in the shadows watching your every move and striking when you least expect!

title: The Balldragon
description: A short parody of everybody's favorite japanese cartoon.

title: Resurrection Core
description: Resurrection Core is a fast paced, vertically scrolling shooter game. Destroy enemies and fearsome bosses, collect power-ups and resurrect enemy cores to increase your fire power. Game honors the arcade classics, but also adds unique, modern touch to the game-play mechanics.

title: The Light of Celestia
description: The Light of Celestia is a story-driven action-adventure featuring intense combat and mystical exploration. Step into the role of Zoe, a destined protector bound to ancient magic, as she unravels the secrets of Eldoria. Confront dark forces, uncover lost truths, and embrace the light within.

title: Meow Time Machine: Munch
description: This is an immersive hidden object puzzle game that takes you through time and space to explore the tumultuous inner world of expressionist master Edvard Munch. From the shadows of childhood to the birth of "The Scream," from European travels to the tranquility of his later years.

title: A Game About Mowing Your Lawn
description: A simplistic game about mowing your lawn. Harvest grass, sell clippings, upgrade your gear, and experience the beauty and detail.

title: Speed Surge
description: Strap in and ignite your engines in Speed Surge, the adrenaline-pumping arcade racing game where every second counts! Dash through thrilling tracks as you race against time. Are you ready to become the ultimate speedster?

title: Mudbird
description: Mudbird is an adventure survival game about escaping a desolate archipelago. Hunt, garden, fish, and explore the mysterious islands.

title: Cake Up
description: Play as a cake courier who delivers an order to the king in the midst of a magical war! Dodge the magic projectiles, deliver the cake safely and try not to fall into the clutches of the evil cake robbers!

title: Duo Quest
description: Dive into a fantasy world where your bond is your greatest weapon! Team up with a friend to battle monsters by answering quirky and thought-provoking questions about each other, while building decks and exploring an ever-changing world. Can your relationship survive the ultimate test?

title: Ninja vs. Zombies 3
description: Fight Zombies, Monsters and a Nightmare with your Skills and Upgrades, use your Sword correctly and escape with Smoke Bombs, blast your way or smash Undead side by side with your Ninja Elite like never before. Action-packed meets Survival RogueElite Ninja Game.

title: Naroike
description: Naroike is a casual side-scrolling game that combines roguelite and hack-and-slash elements. Collect a wide variety of artifacts and use your skills to defeat enemies.

title: Heretic Red
description: In an isolated, snowy village, a detective monk must solve a series of bizarre murders. Collect evidence, unravel the truth, and expose killers. In this tight-knit community, every resident is a friend and a suspect. As the body count rises, you must use everything you have to stop the bloodshed.

title: Rogue Monster Theolodorus
description: An entry for 7DRL Challenge 2025. A traditional roguelike (turn-based, grid-based, permadeath, no metaprogression) meets a deckbuilder cardbattler with win16 visuals and chip audio.

title: Kingdom Loop
description: Kingdom Loop is a strategic roguelike autobattler focused on building your army and kingdom. Explore many tile combinations, items, and units in search of the perfect setup to beat the Ancient Kings!

title: Bunny Hurling
description: Hunt the bunnies, load the catapult and hurl them… The King demands.

title: Skully Bunnies
description:
Skully Bunnies is a fast paced, competitive, party card game. To win the game, a player must be the first to fuse 3 Skully Bunnies together. Strategy fused with luck of the draw creates intense gameplay. The fun factor to this game is not only unique, but highly contagious. Skully Bunnies mobile card game creates new fast paced action mixed like never before.

Skully Bunnies pits players against each other in a strategic battle to fuse 3 Skully Bunnies in order to win. Players share one deck and have every advantage and disadvantage the game offers, it's all based on luck of the draw and how you play your cards. Players will draw from the same deck using the same types of cards throughout the game: bunnies, skulls, fusion items, spells, spell-cancel and Skully Bunnies. As players draw cards from the deck and put cards into play they will be challenged by other players using spell cards. To win the game use everything at your disposal to fuse three Skully Bunnies based on the number of players. It doesn’t matter how you do it, you just gotta be the first one! Turns go clockwise around the table, and each turn is made up of four phases.

title: Ice on the Edge
description: ICE on the EDGE is a figure skating simulation game where you train athletes and lead them to victory. Plan training, master techniques, and refine routines for competitions. Face fierce rivals, push the limits, and carve your legacy on the ice. Guide your skater to the ultimate stage—On the Edge.

title: Desperate Place
description: Desperate Place is a strategic tower defense game where you play as a crew member who wakes up early on a damaged colonization starship. Stranded on an unknown planet, you must gather resources, repair the ship, and defend against alien monsters to survive and escape.

title: Wall World 2
description: The adventure in the mysterious world of the Wall continues! Pilot your robospider into its depths, uncover lost artifacts and technologies, upgrade your exosuit and spider, and battle the horrors lurking in the dark. Unravel the mysteries buried in the depths of the Wall!

title: Future Vibe Check
description: Future Vibe Check is a musical automation game where your factories don’t just produce goods—they make music. Summoned by Infinity, you must rebuild reality. The call of endless optimization will be sublimated into sound. Automate the Vibe. Defend the Vibe. Become the Vibe.

title: Ryder
description: A vibrant creature-collecting puzzle adventure. Play as over 60 creatures, each with unique traits, to solve more than 100 puzzles across four colorful regions. Explore a lively, low-poly world, complete your bestiary, and ascend the Sanguine Mountain to fulfill your destiny as a Ryder.

title: Bō: Path of the Teal Lotus - Tanuki Kabuki
Town of Zoz
description: Fight with flavor! As Ito, a young shaman chef adventurer, you'll hunt critters, gather magical ingredients and rebuild bonds by cooking for the townspeople. A shaman chef always aims to lend a helping hand, but the more Ito gets involved, the more he'll learn about the town and its ancient secrets.

title: Wild Blue Skies
description: Wild Blue Skies reimagines the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s. Join Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers as they soar through the skies on a mission to save the world in this action-packed, nostalgic journey!

title: Shtrek
description: Shtrek is a simple but challenging platformer where every move matters. You have 60 levels to beat and 60 lives to do it. No extra mechanics, no distractions - just precise jumps, fast resets, and pure platforming.

title: Another Box of Hotcorn
description: 50 more levels of popcorn-popping action! Pop the required amount of popcorn in each level before time runs out.

title: Bee Simulator: The Hive
description: Live the epic adventure of a tiny bee in a vast world! Collect pollen, race through jet streams, and protect your hive from wasps. Now even bigger with The Hive expansion - gather resources, build and customize your very own beehive!

title: The Throng
description: An online frog-based game where survival is not guaranteed, so be ready to hide, run, and laugh.

title: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour - Quad Lake Pass
description: The Quad Lake Pass grants access to the next 4 lake add-ons upon their release. Four fantastic venues, one great price! Requires Fishing Sim World core game, sold separately.

title: Family Bible Quest
description: Experience the wonders of the Bible in a whole new way! Dive into captivating stories alone or with the whole family. Enjoy mini-games such as charades, quizzes, word searches, singing, painting, memorization, and would-you-rather questions. Read, reflect, and have fun!

title: Project Carrot
description: Project Carrot is a distinctive and challenging 3D platformer, inspired by beloved titles from the 90s. Players will find themselves in a secret underground world full of challenges and delightful characters that pay homage to classic platformers while offering a fresh and exciting adventure.

title: War Room
description: War Room is a realistic strategy, taking you straight into the heat of the war in Afghanistan.

title: Firearms Master
description: Firearms Master is a horizontal scrolling shooting game. The story tells of the endless wars of the continent of Armas, you need to conquer this continent to end all wars.

title: Chaos Hero
description: Dive into bullet-hell auto-combat! Fight through hordes of monsters and experience the thrill of going from barely scraping by to tearing through everything!

title: Spellomancer
description: Spellomancer is a competitive, team-based action platformer that tests both your brains and brawn. Harvest enchanted letters from a bibliographic battlefield, fend off your opponents with an arsenal of wild weapons, and spell words to earn points.

title: Victim.exe
description: This executable, named "victim", was found in the deep corners of the internet. It contained a severely corrupted maze game. Though there are many, only one level of this game was able to be shared, as the other half-corrupted levels were not safe for viewing and caused multiple seizures to the people recovering them. Almost 20 audio files were also removed as most were too disturbing for listening, including a 32-minute-long file of several children screaming.

title: Fussball Manager 25
description: Mod for the FIFA Manager series by EA to get the Manager-Experience with updated squads and other new additions.

title: Velana Adventures: Chapter I
description: A short Tactical RPG adventure in the Velana world. A gaiden, or side story game, to the main War of Velana series.

title: Picross S Doraemon & F Characters Edition
description:
The Picross S series for Nintendo Switch welcomes characters from the world of Fujiko·F·Fujio!

From universally adored classics like Doraemon and Kiteretsu Encyclopedia to the more mature SF Short Stories, this collaboration features an incredible lineup of 28 works in total.

Solve Picross puzzles to bring iconic characters and memorable scenes to life as charming pixel art.

Enjoy solving puzzles solo or with friends and family, and immerse yourself in the nostalgia and fresh discoveries of Fujiko·F·Fujio’s timeless creations!

The game features four Picross modes familiar from the Picross S series: Picross, Mega Picross, Color Picross, and Clip Picross, as well as the Extra bonus content.

The number of puzzles is 150 each for Picross and Mega Picross and 5 for Clip Picross for a total of 200 piece puzzles of 40 each, 30 for Color Picross and 5 for Extra.

Picross is a picture crossword puzzle game where you follow hint number to complete a picture. With simple, easy-to-follow rules, it’s a game anyone can play!

title: Rhyolite
description: Rhyolite is a 1-4 player co-op action roguelike set on a steampunk locomotive being attacked by ghost trains. Defend, repair, and upgrade your train as you search the railway for a portal to the spirit world.

title: Animal Pattern
description: Explore the animal world in this fun, family-friendly game. Sit back and relax and exercise your memory by finding all animal pairs. Match all pairs to win across seven stages with all hand-drawn art featuring many unique animals.

title: Cozy Meadow
description: A Relaxing Adventure

title: Pixel Game Maker Series: Rocket Frog
description:
Charge... keep charging... and then jump!
Make inertia your friend and fly!
But not actually, as you might go too far and fall!

title: Pets and Friends
description: Create your cozy unique animal album with your creations.

title: Dead Rails
description: Dead Rails is an intense, cooperative, twin stick shooter. In a world where humanity has come to rely on rail roads and train stations for transportation of supply, players must work together to progress through the railroad, and get as far as possible through each train shelter.

title: Buddy Bug
description: In a microscopic insect world tucked away in a corner of the city, gather your friends, fight bravely, and use all sorts of innovative gadgets to carve out your own territory. In this cooperative, rogue-lite game, you will embark on an exciting and exhilarating journey.

title: Shuyun Huazhang
description: "Shuyun Huazhang" is an exploration game set in Sanxingdui's digital world. Players can explore scenes, interact with digital characters, enjoy films, with relics interaction and digital dress-up features. It supports VR, Windows and uses techs to add charm to Sanxingdui culture.

title: The Whispering Woods
description:
Detective Lukas Berger is investigating the sudden disappearance of several residents from a remote village. Clues are scarce until he receives a call from his colleague John: an abandoned house deep in the forest might hold the key. But as Lukas arrives, he quickly realizes that something is not right. Dark shadows, unexplainable noises, and an eerie presence await him.

Explore the mysterious house in this first-person horror game and face the unknown. Solve challenging puzzles and uncover the truth behind the disappearances – but beware: some secrets are better left undiscovered...

title: Card Gauntlet
description: Take on the Card Gauntlet! Pick one of 6 Specializations, each with its own set of unique skill cards to collect and build a totally unique deck. Fight monsters, roll the dice, and triumph!

title: Conductor Cat
description: Conductor Cat is an adventure game about rebuilding a broken world. Gather scrap, build machines, and restore a dying canyon as Griffin the cat. He's journeying home aboard his train, racing to see his father one last time.

title: Hex and Chill
description: A serene match-3 puzzle game designed for pure relaxation. Swap colorful hex tiles at your own pace with no timers or pressure—just soothing gameplay and tranquil music. Includes full source code for the curious. Your personal oasis of simple puzzles awaits.

title: Recital of the Heart
description: An adventure game with a focus on story and exploration. Experiment with wide range of weapons, abilities, and modifications as you delve deep into a world pure imagination. Solve conflict and mysteries with your partner Kand by your side. Heed his wise words, or throw caution (and him) to the wind!

title: Crabby Fishes
description: Can a bunch of crabs save the ocean? Dive into a dynamic, hand-drawn tower defense where quirky sea creatures battle alien zombie-like polluters. Build, upgrade, and unleash wild abilities in fast-paced, chaotic battles. Immerse yourself in a vibrant, colorful world as you fight to reclaim the reef!

title: Find Oann
description: Find Oann is an action-horror game that follows the story of the protagonist, Thomas, who must solve mysteries, arm himself, and fight against horrendous creatures to survive and find the mysterious Oann.

title: Dogenstein
description: "WOKE" NO MORE! Blast through waves of politically correct and "WOKED" lunatics in a hilariously violent story of liberation and revenge. The legendary DOGE fights back in an action-packed RETRO FPS. Say goodbye to political correctness!

title: Hivaneph: The Legend of Elles
description: Hivaneph: The Legend of Elles is an action-adventure game where every character holds a unique perspective, revealing a world that is distinct to their own eyes.

title: Deep In The Lab
description: Deep in the Lab is 2D '90 style survival horror game, with old style pre-rendered backgrounds, puzzles to solve, keys to collect, monster to avoid or defeat (your choice), poor resources, jumpscares, limited saves, FMV and a five floors lab to explore.

title: Factions
description: Join your faction, and fight for survival in this exciting third person shooter.

title: Apocalypse Approaches
description: Apocalypse Approaches is a fast-paced top-down roguelike where time is your health. Battle through procedurally generated dungeons and defeat enemies to regain lost time. Upgrade your kit with cogs, manipulate time, and survive as the clock constantly ticks down.

title: The Deep Creep
description: The Deep Creep is a dynamic stylized first-person shooter. Choose one of 3 unique game modes and defeat all enemies in this dungeon!

title: Crown of Chaos
description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the gloomy streets of the old city, where something sinister lurks around every corner, and your only salvation is your two trusty katanas. Fight creepy monsters, hone your fighting skills and try to survive as long as possible in this battle of endurance.

title: The Thread of Fate
description: Explore the territory of the factory, where everything went wrong after an unknown incident. But be prepared - you've been shrunk to tiny size, and now you must fight creepy mutants lurking in the shadows to survive.

title: Pandemic: Ground Zero
description: Dive into the world of fast-paced racing with six unique cars, where every tight turn can determine your fate.

title: Hexiv
description: Hexiv is a strategy deckbuilder about surviving on a lush but hostile planet. Use cards to build, explore and expand while battling a determined adversary to unlock the mysteries of this genre-blending roguelike!

title: Dungeon Ascent
description: Descend into the dark depths of a dungeon teeming with creepy creatures, where every moment is a fight for survival. Grab powerful weapons, improve your skills and fight to your last breath to survive as long as possible in this endless nightmare.

title: Bosquet
description: Une aventure narrative sur le thème de la maladie avec un gameplay du genre auto-battler. Explorez la forêt, affrontez des ennemis et rencontrez de nombreux compagnons aux personnalités uniques !

title: Natural Selection University
description: Survive 100 days at Natural Selection University and write a world-changing thesis in this challenging strategy simulation game! Balance time, resources, and sanity as you navigate harsh conditions, random disasters, and absurd campus events.

title: Puzzled Cube
description: Puzzled Cube challenges your mind with a gripping, hands-on puzzle experience. Feel the thrill of unraveling complex patterns, the rush of each perfect move, and the satisfaction of mastering the cube. Stay focused, think ahead, and enjoy the journey!

title: Cart Capers
description: Cart Capers is a fast-paced arcade racing game where players push, steer, and stunt their way through dynamic challenges using shopping carts. Race against rivals, pull off tricks, and compete in chaotic multiplayer modes or take on a fun-filled single-player adventure

title: Unusual Farm Operations
description: You are an alien in a UFO, and you are tasked with abducting farm animals and collecting their samples.

title: Bootsies
description: Bootsies is a 1D fighting game focused on fundamentals and reading the opponent. Characters have minimal movesets but make use of a unique space-betting system to increase their risk and reward. Bootsies' main modes include a singleplayer roguelite campaign and local/online multiplayer with rollback netcode.

title: Master of Piece
description: Recruit mercenaries, combine their traits, and forge endless synergies. Venture through the mysterious medieval realm, facing powerful foes and mighty bosses. Simple turn-based rules hide deep strategic depth—build your ultimate team, master the pieces, and uncover the secrets of the Dragon Orb.

title: A Paranormal Story
description: A Paranormal Story is an investigation and suspense game where you must try to understand the past and secrets of the cell phone owner, through old messages, notes and mysterious apps through a fake smartphone interface.

title: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced
description:
This release contains the 3 classic side-scrolling 2D action games "Azure Striker Gunvolt" (2014), "Azure Striker Gunvolt 2" (2016), and "Azure Striker Gunvolt 3" (2022), including all available DLC.

Enjoy not just the action, but deep story that plays out without interrupting gameplay in "Live Novel" dialog that plays during missions. With full voiceover (Japanese only in Gunvolt 1 and 2) and a total of 37 vocal tracks sung by the "Muses", you'll be immersed in the near-future dystopian world.

In addition, the series director has renewed all three titles, polishing the action gameplay and updating the music. Previously separately available items such as voice drama CDs are now included in-game in Library Mode, making for the most complete "final version" of the trilogy.

title: Sea of Dreams Survivors
description:
Welcome aboard the Sea of Dreams, can you survive to this nightmare ?

Fend against vast enemy forces, with hundreds of nightmarish foes swarming the screen at any given time.

In this action-packed rogue-lite, you play as one of the survivors trapped aboard the Sea of Dreams.

Slay, adapt, and grow stronger with every wave of enemies—then slay even more!

Upgrade your abilities, and unlock unique perks to adapt to the escalating chaos.

Set in the terrifying universe of Sea of Dreams, this standalone spin-off delivers relentless action in a world steeped in dread and mystery. Will you endure the horrors of The Other World and find your way back, or will you become another lost soul aboard the Sea of Dreams?

The nightmare begins. Will you survive?

title: Spartan Survivors
description: Fight hordes of Covenant & Flood in this new game mixing Roguelike, Halo & Bullet Heaven for hundreds hours of mindless fun!

title: Len'en Monochrome World
description: Len'en Monochrome World is the upcoming fifth game of the Len'en Project, still in development. Thus far, only Tsubakura Enraku is known to be in the game. It is stated that this is a "2D Action" game, making it possibly the first Len'en game (in order of games announced) to not be a shoot 'em up.

title: Pwanet Pwotector
description:
A game created with Nathan Ranney, Max Cordeiro and Mike LeRoy for Ludum Dare #34.

Use your space ship's mighty space gun to blast away incoming asteroids, and evil aliens! But be careful! You do not want to shoot the happy Stardust that wants to come land on your planet! The Stardust makes your population grow! Pull the Stardust in as fast as possible and get the high score!

title: BattleCry: Age of Myths
description: You are one of the commanders in training, under the new emperor's rules. Command your army and fight against oncoming enemies in the battlefield. Add different types of soldiers and try new formations to win the battles!

title: Room 54: Horde Survival
description: Survive at Hordes of Creatures in this 'Spin-Off' modality of our Main Title - Room 54. Gear up , unlock new weapons / abilities and fight!

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Fallen Banners
description:
Gather your party for two challenging new PvE dungeon experiences: Lep Seclusa and Exiled Redoubt. Unlock new achievements and earn new rewards including item sets, collectibles, and more as you fight to preserve what little peace remains in the war-torn region of Cyrodiil.

Lep Seclusa

The Moth Priests of Lep Seclusa are besieged, and the cunning Orpheon the Tactician is set on seizing the power of the Elder Scroll they safeguard. You must help Sister Chana defend the sanctuary against an army of deserters, protect its people and secrets, and confront Orpheon before he can use the power of the scroll to forever change the face of Cyrodiil.

Exiled Redoubt

Soldiers of the Alliance War, regardless of their faction, are vanishing, and all trails lead to the Imperial fortress known as the Exiled Redoubt. Team up with the Battlemage Lucilla, infiltrate this mysterious stronghold, and put a stop to the schemes of a once noble Imperial house before its chaos can spread beyond its stone walls and throughout Tamriel.

title: Demigoddess!
description: Demigoddess! is a unique game that focuses on the essentials of turn-based strategy games. It is designed so that each gameplay can be won or lost in 1 hour. The random map generation system makes different situation each time. You can control over 450 types of soldiers and monsters of 20 factions.

title: Deep Fringe
description: Deep Fringe is deep tactical combat game set in a biopunk wasteland. Lead powerful factions in turn-based battles, leveraging the strategic use of an interactive environment. Modify or destroy terrain to achieve tactical supremacy. Craft legendary chapters with the level editor.

title: Runes of Mystery
description: The Demon Lord. His cold-blooded minions roam the magical world, spreading fear and destruction. Draw them out of their hiding places, strip them of their power and restore peace.

title: Oni Fight
description: Mahiro, who bought the new VR game “TS Fight,” decides to play with friends with a rule where the winner gets to ask the loser to do one thing…

title: Masyanya Under The Yellow Press
description:
The game is a typical quest from Alawar. It was released on October 22, 2008.

The game features an interface that includes a bar with collectible items, an inventory, a task list, a score multiplier gauge, a Masyanya icon, and a hint button. If you click incorrectly for too long, the multiplier will reset, and Masyanya will get sad.

Collectible items can sometimes automatically combine. The game also includes close-up views and mini-games displayed in separate windows.

title: Casebook: Episode 0 - The Missing Urn
description: A short freeware game that acts as a demo for and prequel to the Casebook trilogy. Help detective James Burton and his aunt locate the urn that contains the ashes of her late husband.

title: Nightmare Halls
description: A psychological horror game where you work through puzzles and walk through the halls of a mansion you are stuck in.

title: PowerWash Simulator 2
description: PowerWash Simulator is back, bubbling with fresh locations, soap-erior equipment and splashy features. Effortlessly transform soiled surroundings into clean, serene scenes, solo or with pals. Satisfaction is a spray away!

title: Oppai Puzzle
description: Unwind and challenge yourself with Oppai Puzzle, a classic digital jigsaw puzzle experience designed for ultimate relaxation and captivating gameplay. Enjoy the timeless fun of jigsaw puzzles reimagined for the digital age!

title: Cat Puzzle
description: Rescue as many cats as you can within the time limit! Combine puzzle and roguelike elements to achieve the highest score possible.

title: Bloons Junior
description: Play 50 all-new challenging levels, and a new special balloon type! Some of these levels are very hard, and should keep most of you busy for a while!

title: Anno 2070: The Distrust Series Package
description: The financial boom and growing consumer behavior taking place in the Tycoon cities have drastically changed consumer habits within the population. This pack brings you 10 extra ornamental buildings that will embellish your city centers: Security Fence Section, Security Fence Corner, Safety Fence Gate, Covered City Center, Searchlight, Carousel Display, Shopping Mall Entrance, Shopping Mall Corridor, Shopping Mall Corner, and Shopping Mall Intersection.

title: Anno 2070: The Crisis Response Package
description: Master two exclusive Tycoon missions to win back lost investors and attract new followers.

title: Shockwave Triggers
description: SHOCKWAVE TRIGGERS is an arcade high resolution pixel art shmup/shoot'em up, in which you use the power of Shockwaves and a good timing to get the most bonus from your destroyed enemies. It's simple: shoot, dodge, wait and SHOCKWAVE!

title: Capybara: The Story of Sisyphus - Extra Content
description: This DLC expands your options and provides new items to use in your playthrough!

title: Kuso Game Girl Wateri
description:
Kusoge Girl Wattery is a unique and humorous collection-style exploration game that compiles about 30 mini "kusoge", roughly 20 previously released by the author and 10 new ones created specifically for this title.

At the beginning, only a few games are accessible. By playing through them and earning trophies, more games and areas gradually unlock. The trophies vary in type and difficulty, adding a layer of progression and strategy to the otherwise chaotic and comedic presentation.

title: Lysward
description: Lysward is a single-player survival game set in a vast and unforgiving desert in the fantastical world of Umbra. Explore, craft, team up with your companion, and leverage the Amri magic to endure the heat.

title: Chrono Cross
description:
CHRONO CROSS is an RPG that transcends time and space, unfolding across two interlinked parallel worlds.
With over 40 party members to meet, people and dimensions will intertwine in this epic drama about the planet itself.
Utilising an innovative turn-based style battle system, CHRONO CROSS is a unique RPG that follows the protagonist “Serge” as he crosses time on his quest to save himself dying in a parallel universe.

New Features in the Remastered Edition
・3D models converted to HD
・Refined character illustrations
・Higher-quality background music
・Switch enemy encounters on or off
・Background filter feature
・Battle enhancement features to make combat easier
・Auto-battle function
・Switch between imitation pixel font and HD font
・Change screen resolution

title: Radical Dreamers: Le Trésor Interdit
description:
"RADICAL DREAMERS - Le Trésor Interdit -" was released in 1996 as a standalone game, and has not been easily accesible for play in recent years. Players can experience the story that went on to become the basis for CHRONO CROSS in an audio novel format. Here, an alternate story of the RADICAL DREAMERS, a group of three thieves - Serge, Kid and Magil - unfolds in a parallel world.

*You can switch between the new and old versions of the 3D models and illustrations.
*The 3D models, illustrations, font and background filter cannot be toggled separately. They will all be switched together.

title: Wizard Cats
description: Craft limitless spells! Destroy hordes of enemies and duel other master wizards!

title: Love’s Sweet Garnish 2
description: This is the continuation of CANVAS+GARDEN’s doujin title Koi ni, Kanmi o Soete, featuring after stories for Rira and Rishie and main routes for Ciel and Koron.

title: Pool 2
description: Gather your friends and get ready for a chaotic twist on pool! No more waiting for your turn, each player controls a cue ball, and shots are taken in real-time! Play up to 4 players on wacky pool tables in this physics-based party game!

title: Git Up!
description: A platformer where you need to jump between, and balance on, loose platforms in order to reach the time portal and continue your journey through time. Unlock new locations and pixelart characters as you go. Keep your balance, but if you fall down, just Git Up!

title: DB2: Disco Boogie of the Dead Beats
description: A 2D competitive shooting game that can be played by up to four players! In addition to shooting, there are many other elements that will load your cognition, such as hitting notes and well-timed QTEs. Earn more chips than anyone else in the space-time warped underground disco.

title: Free Chess: Lewis Set
description: Play a game of Free Chess with this iconic Lewis Chess set!

title: Hlína
description: Immerse yourself in the depressing and atmospheric city of Hlína, where, as a young boy named Oliver, you face the harsh realities of life. Work in a factory, care for your mother, play mini-games, and uncover a deep story in this hand-crafted city.

title: Radioactivity
description: Radioactivity is a co-op survival horror. You are a Liquidator! Together or alone, help your state clean up post-apocalyptic radioactive wilderness. Plan each deployment, fight radiation spread and the creatures that it produces. Together, make WEA flourish once more!

title: The Pale Piper
description: Uncover the truth behind your death and your sibling’s in a story-driven precision platformer inspired by the Pied Piper myth. Navigate a decaying, interconnected world where movement is your only defense. No combat, only precision, consequence, and secrets hidden in the dark.

title: Frustration Nation
description: Prepare to be frustrated... or not. Who knows.

title: Toward The Ice
description: Toward The Ice is a classic first-person party-based dungeon crawler RPG with grid-based movement and turn-based combat. Venture into the frozen north and help a fair princess rescue her idiot brother from Troll kidnappers.

title: Marble Allstars
description: Marble Allstars is a classic online 3D platformer marble game featuring 60 levels and a large collection of nostalgic marbles to collect!

title: So Much Stuff 5: Mix-Knacks - Collector's Edition
description:
Explore beautifully crafted levels, clear diverse scenes, and relish in a multitude of engaging mini-games.
Collect charming trinkets to adorn a fresh room in "So Much Stuff 5: Mix-Knacks."
Get ready for another delightful sorting adventure!

Collector's Edition brings:
- interesting sorting puzzles!
- 8 more chapters of fun!
- visit your collection room!

title: ATYI
description: Move your arms, move your legs!

title: Something Strange has Come Over God's Country Tonight
description:
a short surreal horror game about repressed queerness,
made for the rainbow jam 2023.

title: Île d'Or
description: A maritime trading game built on three pillars: Trade, Expeditions and Battle. Earn silver to grow your crew, build mighty ships from expedition materials, and win your battles. Balance the three as you like. Rival factions vie for these waters; your story choices decide who becomes ally or enemy.

title: Bunny Roulette
description: Russian roulette horror with 2-4 players, new card ability system allowing for unique strategy and gameplay.

title: Kwiks
description: Draw rectangles to expose the background area.

title: Futanari Coffee Shop
description: An erotic management simulation game about managing a coffee shop.

title: Into the Forest: Out of Your Mind
description:
Created for Ludum Dare #49 with Max Cordeiro.

Be careful, weary traveler, for this forest is known for playing tricks on the mind.

The further into the forest you venture, the more likelihood there is of you seeing a different type of enemy than the one you're fighting. If so, use your bestiary and identification techniques to narrow down which of the forest's beasts you're battling.

title: Sweet Home 2: Look and Find - Collector's Edition
description: Grab a warm blanket and get comfortable for more object-seeking!

title: Eggconsole Gulkave MSX
description: A side-scrolling shooting game with a unique power-up system. Instantly assess the numbers on the items and power up skillfully!

title: Book Supermarket: Library Manager Simulator
description: Build, manage, and grow the ultimate bookstore!

title: Island Rescue
description: Rescue the stranded in this addictive puzzler

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Muui-do
description: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!

title: Lila and the Secret Flower Jungle
description: In this visual novel you will meet Lila, a young explorer, and Max, her loyal monkey friend, who embark on a great adventure guided by a mysterious map.

title: Picture the Difference!
description:
Spot the Difference with Cute Illustrations!
A Brain-Training IQ Game to Sharpen Your Reflexes

title: Quick, Quack!
description: Quack Quack Quack Quack!

title: Station Platform 42
description: Horror action ADV in which you fight evil spirits on a station platform!

title: Sugoi Girls: Sassy Spy
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: The Exorcist: Gravebound Horror
description: Can you survive the wrath of the vengeful spirit?

title: Time Travel: Escape Room Game
description: Your help is essential in this time travel machine game!

title: Urban Car Driver Simulator: City Explorer Challenge
description: Drive, explore, conquer – the city is yours!

title: Love Colors & Calm Colors
description: Two relaxing art experiences in one bundle! Color, create, and have fun—solo or with friends!

title: 6 in 1 Racing Games Collection
description: Six Ways to race, No Speed Limits, No Regrets

title: Bridge Race & Stacky Dash
description: Get ready for a thrilling duo of fast-paced, brick-stacking action with Bridge Race and Stacky Dash!

title: The Purging
description:
The Purge was created under 48 hours for the Ludum Dare #22 compo.

Its complete, has 9 levels, 6 enemies and a boss.

title: Chronocracy
description: Build a unique civilization in a flat world! Explore, extract resources, expand, and battle enemies. Use your time management skills to fend off attacks and face a mysterious threat. Are you ready to create a world that can survive?

title: Digimon World
description: A port of digimon world for pc exclusive to Korea

title: Lunacid: Tears of the Moon
description: Lunacid: Tears of the Moon is a First Person Dungeon Crawler made with the Sword of Moonlight - King’s Field making tool from 2000. Explore various dungeons for powerful weapons and spells to forestall the previsioned end of the world.

title: Threaded Dungeons
description:
A world threaded in death. Can you cultivate a party of four that defies all odds? Make every action count in tactical turn-based combat. Choose your allegiances carefully. Scour dungeons in search of loot and secrets. Resist or acquiesce to tempting whispers in the darkness.

Threaded Dungeons is a turn-based, party-based dungeon crawling RPG.

title: Touhou Tenshiin: Celestial Examination Hall
description: A fan-made 3D fighting game set in the Touhou Project universe! Unease once again shrouds Gensokyo, as terrifying rumors intertwine with the rising craze of 'Celestial Cultivation'!? End this chaos with dazzling combos and tactical mastery！

title: Fuuraiki 5
description: The 5th game in the series this time takes place in Mie prefecture.

title: Curse Warrior
description:
Curse Warrior is a dungeon crawler RPG where you explore and conquer the underground labyrinth “Eclipse,” filled with curses.

In the dungeon, your party members may become cursed through various actions.

Since curses alter the abilities and actions of your party members, players must constantly monitor the state of their party and make crucial decisions on how to proceed. Build stronger characters while managing and adjusting the effects of curses to successfully clear the dungeon.

title: Disgaea Mayhem
description:
Disgaea Mayhem is a brand-new 3D action RPG from an all-star team consisting of director Shunsuke Minowa, character designer Takehito Harada, and composer Tenpei Sato.

In this game, players will be able to experience the exhilaration of defeating enemies with overwhelming power that defies convention—unleashing flashy techniques with simple controls, completionist elements like leveling characters up to 9,999 and “reincarnating” them to grow even stronger, and developing overpowered stats that let them deal over a billion damage.

title: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster
description: This game tells a story of heart-to-heart connections and salvation surrounding Mono, a girl who visits the medical facility “Ishokan” in hopes of saving her older sister, who has been afflicted by the terrifying “Shinigami Disease”; Melhendia, a goat-like creature who seeks to exploit her; and the girls who the disease have transformed into strange creatures.

title: Sono Hi no Kemono ni ha
description:
Ritsuki, his younger sister Runa and childhood friend Mayu attend a school that is popular for its drama activities, with many of its graduates going on to become famous actors and scenario writers. Shortly after the entrance ceremony, they were invited by their classmate Inori to join the drama club. Ritsuki was eager to aim for the school’s primaries for the national competition, but first year students were forbidden from participating in the contest. They wouldn’t accept the fact that they were excluded just because they didn’t have much experience. If only they were given the opportunity to demonstrate their acting abilities…

Rumour has it that there is a ghost that haunts the theater. It is said that it will grant any wish so long as it is related to drama.

title: A Tiny Space Adventure
description: **A Tiny Space Adventure** follows a brother and his dog, Jupiter, on an exciting journey through space to rescue his sister. With fun puzzles, quirky characters, and unique aliens, this adventure offers a delightful experience for players of all ages.

title: Fire Magician: Arcana
description: "Fire Magician" is a third-person action shooter game where the player controls a cute magician named Arcana, battling poker enemies. By stacking energy, the player can use cool wind and fire abilities to defeat the Poker King, Suoha, reclaim the Wheel of Fortune, and save their plundered homeland!

title: They Built a Railgun!?
description: A short kinetic novel about a girl finding out her friends built a railgun.

title: Radiolength
description: A short adventure game about a young girl leaving her hometown.

title: Ship, Inc.
description: Run a wholesome shipping business! Ship, Inc. is a cozy wholesome job simulator where you are a packaging employee in a cargo shipment company. Follow the shipment orders, choose package size, and prepare parcels. Upgrade your office, deliver orders safely and quickly!

title: Nothing Exists Outside of This House
description: Your friend Marie needs you. Find Marie.

title: Good Morning Marie
description: Your friend Marie needs you. Find Marie.

title: Genshin Impact: Day of the Flame's Return
description:
Version 5.5 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New characters: Varesa and Iansan
• New Tribal Chronicles quest for the Collective of the Plenty
• New areas: Atocpan and Ancient Sacred Mountain
• New main event: Tournament of Glory in Bloom
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

title: Type 'n' Fish
description: Welcome to Type 'n' Fish, a cozy indie game where your typing skills become your fishing rod. Cast your line into tranquil waters and type your way to catching a variety of unique fish, each with its own educational description.

title: Absym
description: Absym is a unique souls-like that challenges you to survive between two dimensions: the decaying Nihilor and the corrupted Absymalith. Fight, explore, and use Rift Dancing to shift between worlds in real time. Every choice draws you closer to redemption... or corruption.

title: Lilia: The Fallen Flower in the Prison City
description: In the trade city of Marigold, a spirited woman, Lilia, sets off on her grand adventure. However, while exploring the dungeon, she runs into a potential ally, Sheryl. Can these two opposing personalities work together to survive the dungeon?

title: Lansbury's SneakOut
description: Help Lansbury navigate eerie underground tunnels and avoid capture by roaming ancient warriors.

title: Myst 30th Anniversary Collection
description: To celebrate the 30th Anniversary of Myst, Cyan offered a historical anthology of the complete series up until its 30th anniversary. With this bundle, players get the original 7 Myst games together, in addition to the latest remake of Myst.

title: Sonic and Seanic: The Dark Brotherhood Saga
Sight Of The Victim: Passenger 23
description: A regular night shift turns into a chilling fight for survival. Explore a bustling rest stop, uncover dark secrets, and face the haunting legacy of a tragic accident in PASSENGER 23.

title: Moonbrella
description: A 2D Metroidvania with deep movement and no jump button. Upgrade your umbrella to explore an abandoned planet and ascend to the moon.

title: Dicey Bugs
description: A roguelite dice‑building creature collector where you control both sides of the fight by choosing one action at a time. Capture bugs, unlock new dice, and customize every run.

title: Brominion
description: Brominion is an interactive overlay strategy game for live broadcasters on Twitch. Through the chat, viewers can farm resources to build an army, hunt monsters and even duel other viewers!

title: Tanki Classic
description: Tanki Classic is the free-to-play MMO-shooter with real-time PvP-battles. Throw yourself into furious tank battles shoulder to shoulder with other living players and master your skills!

title: Stella: Into the Shadow
description: When Stella's friend disappears, her life transforms into a detective mystery. Working at a nightclub, forging new connections, and uncovering the city's secrets will force her to reevaluate everything: from those around her to her very self.

title: Bushside Rangers
description: Unravel the twisted secrets of the "Bushside Rangers Nature Park" as Vera, a young girl forced to use her wits as she's pursued by the tainted memories of the park's long lost innocence.

title: Mistaken
description: The world is lost to eldritch mist. No heroes, no grand purpose—only survival. Build, fight, and carve your path through treacherous lands where the remnants of humanity and horrors beyond reason now roam. Survive… or be Mistaken.

title: OmOneko
description: “A story about cat girls … with bite.” Nekos have evolved in the shadows of human society. Beautiful. Mysterious. Chaotic. And now, three of them live with you. Will you be able to get past the stigma and grow closer to them? OmOneko is a tale of cat and mouse... and rats.

title: My Woods
description: A girl enters nature to wonder about her problems, and meets with another girl. This girl is strage... Odd. Why is she here?

title: 7 Days of Summer: Lost Alpha
description:
"7 Days of Summer: Lost Alpha (7DS: LA)" is a modification for "Everlasting Summer," offering an alternative take on both the story and the universe of the original game. It features a new original storyline, numerous new illustrations, and a reimagined musical accompaniment.
At first glance, the story repeats itself: the bus, the camp, the girls... And yet, the minor differences gradually accumulate to grow into an entirely new story. A major role in this is played by our protagonist (or rather, protagonists): he differs from the usual Semyon, which is why his story is different. Meanwhile, rumors are spreading throughout the camp that our hero is not quite an ordinary pioneer...

title: The Last Memory of a Burning Thought
description: Find what you need to find in this "Deskvania" style game!

title: Decaying Wires
description:
"...Today was a good day. And I hope tomorrow will be too."
You just downloaded a cute looking visual novel, you will definitely have a good time! And, after all, what can go wrong?

Experience a lot of fun and cheerful moments with Mitsuko and Shizuka!

"Can you hear it too now?
It always drills my brain."

The game contains original art, soundtrack and takes 15-20 minutes to complete

And remember, wires always look for a new owner.

title: Hello Sunshine
description: A survival mystery set in the ruins of a corporate empire. Walk in the shadow of a giant robot during the sweltering days; stay close to keep warm during the cold nights. Scavenge, craft, upgrade — and piece together the broken puzzle of a world ruled by machines that refuse to shut down.

title: Luigi: Insanity
description:
It all began on that one day... And Luigi will never forget what he experienced.

Luigi - Insanity is a Luigi’s Mansion horror fan game.

title: My Little Puppy
description: "There is a saying that when you depart from this world, the dog who went ahead will warmly welcome you." While spending time in dog heaven, Bong-gu the Welsh Corgi suddenly catches his dad's scent. Now, he embarks on a journey to meet his dad. Will Bong-gu be able to see his dad again?

title: Everlasting Tower
description:
Escape a fiery death by climbing this tower for as long as you can.

A simple randomly-generated vertical platformer with a retro feel. See for how long you can endure the everlasting tower.

Has 4 difficulty levels and local high-scores.

title: Dice a Million
description: Have you ever tried rolling 1,000,000 points on some dice? No? Well, now at least you can try.

title: It Is Coming
description: It Is Coming is a first-person low-poly collectathon inspired by Garry's Mod PNG killer NPCs. You play as the next poor lad to get abducted and brought to Planet Camebox. You'll go through maps while collecting Orbs and avoiding contact with whichever anomaly is hunting you down. Look out for the random events, they can help and harm you. Collecting more orbs unlocks more anomalies to choose from, and getting high ranks unlocks more maps.

title: Shuuchaku Gakuen
description: The only quality that can be measured is whether or not they possess the qualities of morbid love. As they spend their time at the school, what was once a peaceful life turns into a blood-soaked, corpse-riddled, blood-soaked day....

title: Netabare ga Hageshisugiru RPG: Saigo no Teki no Shoutai ha Yuusha no Chichi
description: Netabare ga Hageshisugiru RPG is a Japanese RPG released in 2023. The game features spoilers throughout the story.

title: Netabare ga Hageshisugiru RPG 2: Shinyuu no Shin no Sugata ha Daimaou
description: Netabare ga Hageshisugiru RPG 2 is a Japanese RPG released in 2024. The game features spoilers throughout the story.

title: Undertale: Remembering the Genocides
description: Undertale: Remembering the GENOCIDES is an Undertale (joke) fangame (and yet another generic sans fangame) that took place of 69,000 genocide routes. Sans remembers you're genocides and decided to stop you early at Snowdin. Fight him to WIN.

title: Cruellete
description: Fight to death with Casino-Themed bosses with a spin(Pun intended)!

title: Get Away From The Cube
description: Get away from the cube before it touches you.

title: The Maid
description: The Maid is a first-person psychological horror and mystery game that focuses on creating fear and tension in the player.

title: Duke Nukem Forever Collection
description:
Items included in this package:
- Duke Nukem Forever
- Duke Nukem Forever: Hail to the Icons Parody Pack
- Duke Nukem Forever: The Doctor Who Cloned Me

title: Xi
description: "Xi" is a horror puzzle game set in the context of modern Chinese folklore. The story takes place in an long-abandoned mountain mansion. This immersive escape room experience feels a bit too real, with eerie and strange elements everywhere—an empty banquet, an endless corridor.

title: Phase Zero
description: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Two survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and escape the town in this classic survival horror. Can you make it till dawn?

title: Fear of Hot Water Ghost
description: "Watch out! The terrifying sexy water ghost is here!" A survival horror action-adventure where you escape from a nightmarish city that has suddenly gone mad.

title: Void Martyrs
description: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit. Scavenge amongst drifting space cathedrals, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

title: A Long Long Night
description: Bart is throwing the biggest party in Springfield! Drive around town like it's the 80's! Enjoy the Synthwave and get the party started!

title: Yamame Climb
description: A short and tricky platformer about scaling structures by climbing webs starring Yamame Kurodani from Touhou Project. Made for the Touhou Project Fan Game Jam 15

title: OneTale
description: UNDERTALE but you play as Niko from Oneshot!

title: Deltarune: Chapter 1 - Noelle Edition
description: A Deltarune chapter 1 mod that adds Noelle to the party. It (probably) has no bugs, new story and snowgrave route! If you wanted to play something like "what if Noelle were in chapter 1", I think this is definitely what you are searching.

title: Put the Fries in the Bag
description: Customers come in, ask for food, you serve it to them, they leave, repeat.

title: Pec-Men
description:
PEC-Men is a free 3D action game with unique and humorous ideas. Players control the macho character “Brother Kenta ” and aim for the goal by climbing over obstacles by twitching the left and right pectoralis major muscles.
It features a simple yet stylish game design, and the unique experience of moving the pectoral muscles with just a left or right mouse click is addictive.
With an estimated play time of around 60 minutes, this game is perfect for casual players or play-by-play videos. "PEC-MEN" is a novel concept of manipulating the pectoral muscles and a somewhat surreal world view that is worth a try if you like free games!

title: The Dark Delivers
description: Welcome to Postal Sector 7. As the Night Shift Package Inspector, your job is simple: assess parcels and reject anything not up to code. Stay alert for anomalous dangers and survive long enough to meet your quota by 6AM.

title: Crypto Fantasy: The Scrolls of Kouga
description: CRYPTOFANTASY -The Scrolls of Kouga" is a 2D Dot Royal Road JRPGA boy is reborn in another world after an incident!He wakes up in a world where "ninjas" are active.

title: Forget-Me-Not of the Tetragon
description: Will you take the first step to reclaim your memories? Even if it means involving everyone...

title: Escape Game Sleepless
description: A popular escape game with lots of cute animals. Even if you are not good at solving puzzles, this is an escape game that you can enjoy casually.

title: Anxieties
description: Every day, you trawl the internet for ghost stories and horror tales. After the usual routine, something feels off...?

title: Boku no Soushiki ni Youkoso: Happy Rebirthday
Smash Cars
description: Set on a beautiful resort island, the fast-paced, bumper car gameplay transforms the relaxing setting into a frenzied raceway.

title: Team Fortress 2: Gold Rush
description: TF2: Gold Rush is a mod that restores and carefully enhances the experience TF2 offered in its early years. Expect a truly vintage flavor of the game, with fewer hats and weapons—but more polish, and a stronger visual direction.

title: U.N.P.O.C. Vessel of Opportunity
description: Opportunity is near. Follow clues, solve the puzzles, and stay persistent in the chase of a new way of life. Explore, survive, and thrive in this open world adventure story.

title: Lock On
description: Lock On is a roulette game developed by Hypa Soft for PC-8000/PC-8800.

title: What Happened on the Moon?
description: What happened on the Moon? is a short horror game where you control an AI Moon Rover on a mission to investigate mysterious activity on the lunar surface...

title: My Mario Game
description: Surrealistic Mario game based on janky indie fangames from the 2000s.

title: Sayaka's Addiction
description: There are many ways to go about the game and progress the story. Money can be earned in many different ways and through a variety of minigames. Want to work earnestly at a part-time job? Go for it! Want to work as a waitress? That's also an option!

title: Moero Downhill Night 2
description: A generation has passed since the glory days of racing in Downhill Night, and the once heart-pounding races have faded into nostalgic legend. But a new epic tale is about to begin, with a need for speed, topped with sex and romance. In Moero Downhill Night 2, the cast of girls is great, and where the trills of sex increase as the accelerator hits the floor. Help the girls win their races, and you'll be rewarded once you get back to the pit. The sequel to Moero Downhill Night 1, with even more gorgeous girls, super racing CGs, and intense, uncensored sexual scenes.

title: Gambonanza
description: Gambonanza is a mind-bending roguelike where every move counts. Unlock over 100 innovative Gambits and harness powerful synergy with your chess pieces to transform your board into a festival of explosive combos and tactical twists!

title: El Akelarre de Lola
description: A platform video game starring Spanish singer and dancer Lola Indigo

title: Eldritch Survivors
description: Uncover the secrets behind the protagonists' fate, trapped in an endless cycle of death. Eldritch Survivor is a survival-like game that maximizes both the narrative and the excitement of each dungeon encounter. Immerse yourself in a 99% pure Lovecraftian world and confront the terror of the unknown.

title: Flocky the Cat
description: A traitor in your village kills your father and kidnaps your sister. You are a young cat who must save his sister and other clans of cats.

title: Girls Power: The Fantastic World Of Dreams
description: The girls of the magical world went to look for the ruthless thief who stole the mystical object from their museum. Which they protected traveling between worlds until finding out in which dimension the thief was, and there the thief put many traps in the different worlds where they chased her.

title: Sword & Siege: Crusades Book I
description: Fight through the 1st and 2nd Crusades and the conflicts between them in Crusades: Book I, a tactical medieval wargame of sieges, field battles, and frontier warfare. Command Crusader armies or Islamic alliances across 74 scenarios and two branching campaigns.

title: GravMetal
description: The last GravMetal has been born, now he knows one thing... SURVIVAL

title: Gisselle's Adventure
description: A serious video game about social anxiety, narrated from the perspective of Gisselle, a young student who, after years of homeschooling, must face the real world and her own fears. Through a blend of visual novel elements, RPG, and platforming, the player will accompany Gisselle in her struggle to overcome her social phobia in a story that fuses the everyday with the surreal.

title: Ice Cream Float
description: Join AISU THE PENGUIN on her quest to eat as many tasty frozen treats as possible while also enjoying a healthy pescatarian diet of salmon along the way. Bop enemies, dodge obstacles, and get to the end.

title: Hello Worlds!
description: Hello Worlds! is a puzzle platformer which will bend your minds! Experience what it truly means to be beside yourselves.

title: Pumpkin Remover
description: Remove the rotten pumpkins in this spooky Red Remover expansion pack. Features all new levels and a new look especially for Halloween :)

title: Fallout: Vault 666
description:
"War. War never changes. And neither does-

THE DOOM DWELLER- you were chosen by THE OVERSEER to enter VAULT 666 and locate THE WATER CHIP. If you fail, your home, your friends, and your PET BUNNY will perish.

Traveling the Wasteland, your investigations lead you to a CAVE ENTRANCE. But what's this? No vault dwellers in sight, but more mutants than you can shake a boomstick at! It stinks like rotten meat!

So, pump that POWER FIST, rev that RIPPER, and unload your 10MM, right into the face of HELL! Welcome to VAULT 666!

Death in the Vault is about to change!"

title: Nebula Ball 3D
description: It's 2250. Aliens and humans pack together in the Nebula Arena for the craziest sport in the galaxy: Bowling! From the dude that’s making Brooke Vs. World Doom comes an absolutely insane bowling game. Each game of bowling is played in a unique level with 10 different lanes, each one trickier than the last. Unlock crazy bowling balls by gaining experience points, which you can earn by scoring high and completing mini objectives that can differ per level.

title: Quest: The Adventure for the 6 Stones
ChuSingura 46+1 Wacchi to Onii-chan no Love Love Nagaya Seikatsu
description: Shinpachirou failed to stop the raid of the forty-seven ronin and returned to Naoto on the verge of death. Her injuries healed as they spent a quiet life together. As spring arrived, Suguha asked if she would like to live in Edo, to which she readily agreed. However, they were not samurai but rather ronin, and without money, they have no jobs. Still, they believed that they’ll be able to figure things out when they got there.They found a place in a cheap longhouse and she explained to him the various lifestyles and customs of the Edo period, much of which was a still a commonplace in the present age. Their loving cohabitation true story begins now.

title: Halo Infinite: Operation Blue Team
description:
Welcome to Blue Team, Spartans.

This legendary Spartan-II team has a prodigious combat record spanning well over two hundred military operations against all kinds of foes—from the colonial insurrection to the Covenant, and the many threats that have arisen in recent years.

While John-117, Fred-104, Kelly-087, and Linda-058 have typically been the primary members of Blue Team, the roster has evolved over time—and now it is time for you to join them.

Operation: Blue Team is live from March 11 to April 8

title: Halo Infinite Operation: Frontlines
description:
Touchdown, hit it marines! The 2025 Spring Update for Halo Infinite begins with Operation: Frontlines.

Get your gauntleted hands on the Fuel Rod SPNKr, a new weapon for Halo Infinite based on an old Covenant favorite—now repurposed by the Banished.

Fashion your Spartan with the finest flair in the brand-new Operation Pass, a vastly expanded offering for the first Operation of each major Update that now brings 50 tiers of customization rewards. Give the enemy team back their bomb as the classic Assault mode returns, and that’s just the tip of the iceberg...

title: Rocket League: Season 18
description:
Get ready for the soccar celebration of the decade, just not this decade. Buckle up and blast off to the near future in Rocket League Season 18 starting March 14 at 9 AM PT.
⁠
⁠In Season 18, drift into the all-new Futura Garden Arena and experience the next generation of competition. But even at the dawn of a new age, style is everything — and few things say timeless like a mean lean muscle machine.

title: New World: The Ideal World
description: This world is crazy. This is the story of a cute ASCII art character living in a harsh world. A simple command-based RPG. ASCII Art charactor is from 2chan, but knowledge of 2chan is not required. Only Japanese is supported.

title: Halo Infinite: Operation - Brute Force
description: Operation: Brute Force was a limited-time event in Halo Infinite. It introduced the Chimera armor core inspired by the Jiralhanae (Brutes), alongside a 20-tier free Operation Pass containing armor pieces, coatings, and cosmetics. The event featured themed shop bundles and added new customization items focused on Brute aesthetics. No major gameplay changes or new modes were tied specifically to the operation, but it continued the seasonal content cadence of the game.

title: Nurse Boy 0
description:
Nurse Boy 0 is a short visual novel, made to celebrate Valentine's day. Play as Mc, who really wants to date a Nurse Boy (Medsestra) he just met.

Game contains lots of swearings and degeneracy,
And is not suited for younger audiences.
Please proceed with caution and don't take it close to heart.

title: Pixel P.I.
description:
Pixel P.I. is a detective game that allows you to ask questions by typing in order to unlock answers from witnesses or suspects.

It follows Pixel, a hacker detective who lost her recent memories and is going over past police cases trying to find any clue about her missing past.

title: Monster Girl and the Mysterious Adventure: Remastered Edition
description: A refined remaster of the game originally released in March 2020, featuring enhanced graphics and improved systems. All graphics, including characters, dungeons, items, and UI, have been completely revamped.

title: Scenes from the Heart
description: In this heartwarming Visual Novel, you will aid two of your new classmates while also getting to know them better. Explore the world of improv theater, tease the group's Tsundere, learn about their backstory, and work together to create your own Visual Novel.

title: Danganronpa Minus
description: A Korean Danganronpa fangame

title: Ghost Blast
description: Ghost Blast is a game where you explore giant stages to find secrets and collectables! Blast off springs, through enemies and even through walls. The more you find before you finish, the higher your RANK!

title: Payday 3: Trifecta Lootbag
description:
Trifecta Lootbag includes:
Venomous Verdigris Mask
Cotton Stripes Gloves
Obsidian Glitz Suit

title: Charmolypi
description: After a young and mysterious girl named Castranom arrives at a small hut near a lake occupied by recluse Afeil, the two begin a friendship and find solace in each other. As Castranom learns to fish at the lake, watch as the two grow closer and their own past come to light in a short little fishing game.

title: Amanda's Magic Book 10: Veil of the Phantom
You Alone Can Defeat Evil
description: You Alone Can Defeat Evil is a gripping and challenging 2D top-down action-adventure game.

title: Starium
description: A choice-filled Open World RPG where you navigate the story through conversation, combat, or stealth.

title: Inago Rage
description:
Inago Rage is a first-person shooter set in small arenas. The game starts on 1st January 1999 and it is set on Ganymede, Jupiter's largest moon. Through comic-book like sequences with manipulated photographs between levels it is shown that the arenas are simulations designed by humans. There are 50 levels in total and most of them consist of multiple platforms linked together. The player's character can freely move around, jump and shoot. It is also possible to use rocket boots for a short amount of time to cross gaps. The goal of most of the levels is to shoot a certain amount of enemies or collect a number of jewels before time expires. Many small enemies spawn at once and form swarms. There are 31 different types of enemies in total. There are power-ups that provide bonuses such as triplefire, rapidfire, splinter, slow time, boost, guardian, shield, health, neutron bomb, attractor, and lunar quake. Later levels often have a vertical design with many platforms stacked on top of each other. You respawn after falling down, with a small time penalty. The game includes a level editor to build custom levels that can be shared with other players.

The game is now provided free with a purchase of Drunken Robot Pornography which was inspired by Inago Rage.

title: The Dragon Odyssey
description:
Embark on a grand adventure in a land steeped in legend and magic. Join forces with other players to reclaim your rightful place among the heroes of old!

Experience top-tier AAA gaming right at your fingertips. Dive into a world of dragons and legends with just a tap. Whether you play for minutes or hours, The Dragon Odyssey offers an unforgettable adventure.

Go solo or team up with friends to defeat colossal foes! Battle swarms of enemies or engage in epic player-vs-player clashes to prove your valor! Explore a vast and enchanting world!

title: Evocreo II
description:
Join millions of players in this pocket monster game sequel
Embark on an epic adventure in EvoCreo 2, the ultimate monster-catching RPG set in the captivating world of Shoru. Immerse yourself in a land teeming with mythical creatures called Creo. For thousands of years, these collectible monsters have roamed the lands, their origins and evolution shrouded in mystery. Do you have what it takes to unravel the secrets of the Creo and become a legendary Evoking Master Trainer?

title: Blobbs Remastered
description: Blobbs: Remastered combines simple but addictive gameplay, colourful and cartoony visuals, witty humour and ever so satisfying popping sounds. Ping, pop, zap, freeze and even explode your way through real time puzzles, attempting to create spectacular chain reactions in order to clear the screen in as few clicks as possible.

title: Hentai Energy: Halloween
description:
Hentai energy: Halloween is a casual comic book puzzle game.
It tells the story of a young witch who performed a magical ritual.

title: Half-Life: Extended
description:
Half-Life: Extended is a project dedicated to improving upon many aspects of the original game by achieving consistency between all the expansions, restoring unused content as well as adding new one and reimagining many aspects of the original maps.

Half-Life Extended: Day One is composed of the same chapters as the original Half-Life’s demo under the same name (minus Inbound). In this release you will see:

- Hazard Course
- Anomalous Materials
- Unforeseen Consequences
- Office Complex
- We’ve Got Hostiles

It is known that our mod changes many things that affect how the game plays. However, only 3 out of 5 chapters in the demo contain proper combat, so we’ve made a decision not to immediately overload the game with all the new stuff we’ve prepared.

Instead, Day One will serve as the entryway to Extended’s proper gameplay, gradually introducing you to updated weapons and vanilla enemies’ (and allies’) new stats, abilities and weapons.

title: Letterlike
description: Letterlike is a roguelike word game that's all about collecting items, upgrading words, and upgrading letter tiles to make the strongest synergies and reach the highest scores!

title: Shi Shi Te Na O: Even in Death
description: Shi Shi Te Na O: Even in Death is stealth horror action game that requires trial and error. It tells the story of a young girl who wakes up in a strange and unsettling world, where eerie creatures known as "Ochibito" roam.

title: Ghost Sector
description: Ghost Sector is a survival horror game where you play as M-07, a prototype machine trapped in a cybernetic facility during lockdown. Outwit the automated defenses, search for answers to your origin uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and upgrade your abilities while preserving your finite energy.

title: Hare Nochi Munasawagi
description: The story of Harenochi Munasawagi does not start in a very original way: the protagonist is a high-school boy named Kazuhiko, who is - surprise! - permanently horny, displaying his "affections" at any given opportunity to anyone young and female, including even his childhood friend Chihiro. But while the focus on the story is on Kazuhiko and his quest for physical intimacy (which often results in girls getting angry and beating him up), there are other rather disturbing elements that come into play later - in particular, bunny-like demons who share Kazuhiko's passion for the opposite sex...

title: Missile Command: Delta
description: Missiles are incoming. The stakes are high. Only you can stop the destruction. Manage your pool of defenses strategically to survive rounds of incoming missiles in this high-pressure, tactical turn-based game. Will you be able to unravel the mystery in time?

title: I, Robot
description: Jeff Minter is back with another unique take on a 1980s Atari arcade game: I, Robot. Reimagined in Minter’s signature assault of colors, shapes and sounds, this new take on the eclectic arcade title is built from the ground up with new challenges, new twists, and a whole lot of llamas.

title: Nemiza's Verdict
description: Nemiza's Verdict is a cooperative roguelite dungeon crawler where your soul takes over various monstrosities. Hunt down Nemiza and challenge their verdict in the twisted labyrinth of Lovence by evolving your monstrous abilities and remember skills from your past life.

title: The Séance of Blake Manor
description: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

title: Football Striker 2025
description:
From the creative minds behind Jumping Food Games comes the sequel to the most exciting soccer puzzle game of the year: Football Striker 2025!
Dive into the world of soccer with this sequel and experience 20 new football-related levels that will challenge your gray matter.

Over 20 tricky levels are waiting for you!

Get Football Striker 2025 now and become a legend on the virtual pitch!

title: Sportal
description: Retro fps where you use sport equipment - baseball bats, hockey sticks, golf clubs, bowling balls and pigskins to launch projectiles into monsters straight from classic creature features. Collect upgrades, find gear and hit fastballs to get back home in this stylish action game set in 50’s America.

title: Look Mum No Computer
description: Music meets mayhem in this twin-stick shooter action-RPG! Craft synthesizer modules to gain new weapons and experiment with the original music of Look Mum No Computer. Meet quirky NPCs, complete quests and battle huge bosses.

title: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine
description: Team up with a friend to reach a lost submarine and prevent the outbreak of war. Work together on two devices to solve increasingly challenging puzzles, where each of you has your own unique role to play.

title: Restore, Reflect, Retry
description:
This is a haunted game about a haunted game. You've played this game before. You may not remember, but the game does.

Open the door. Enter the maze. Ignore the ghosts.

title: Hentai: Memory Leak
description: A causal memory training puzzle with a nice reward at the end of each level.

title: Castlebound
description: Lead a band of heroes in a walking castle to battle endless hordes of enemies in this unique action-packed roguelike!

title: Fresh Tracks
description: Jump, dodge, and fight to the rhythm of the gods in this thrilling music-action game on skis. Take on obstacles and menacing enemies as you ski further into the darkness that has befallen the snow-covered land of Norwyn.

title: Integrifix
description: Catch a falling Core with at least one Shard and heal a broken mind, while you transfer through the abstract memories of your patient. The backgrounds and sounds help you to discover the best moment to send the Shard at the Core. Try gathering Bonuses, and nourish the Integrity Percentage for the Perfect Ending!

title: NumWorlds
