description: A cozy, brain-teasing puzzle adventure. Chain numbers through the sunken city of Atlantis and the age of dinosaurs. 200+ handcrafted levels and an endless mode to get lost in, all at your own pace.

title: Wor Games
description:
Play either single player (with CPU team mate) or 2 player co-op.

This game is inspired by the 1981 Midway arcade game Wizard of Wor and the fantastic 1984 version for the commodore 64.

I have fond memories of playing this game with my dad in the 1980s. He's now 85 at the time of release!

This is for you, dad xxx

title: Halo Infinite: Operation - Snowbound
description: Operation: Snowbound brought a winter wonderland to Halo Infinite with revived classic maps, fresh festive modes like 1v1 Showdown and Snowball Fight, a rewarding Pass (free and premium), plus tons of holiday cosmetics to unlock or purchase.

title: Halo Infinite: Operation - Great Journey
description: Operation: Great Journey launched as part of Halo Infinite’s 2024 Winter Update to coincide with the 20th anniversary of Halo 2. The update includes a new weapon, sandbox balance changes, a playlist featuring Halo 2-inspired gameplay and classic maps, a new Operation Pass, and updates to Forge.

title: Halo Infinite: Operation - Champions
description: Operation: Champions was a limited-time event in Halo Infinite. It focused on gladiator-style customization for Spartans and introduced a 20-tier free Operation Pass featuring the Athlon armor core, originally seen in Halo 5: Guardians. The pass included armor pieces, coatings, and other cosmetics centered on an arena combat theme. Additional themed bundles were available in the shop.

title: Halo Infinte: Operation - Anvil
description:
Welcome to Anvil, Spartan. Let’s get you acquainted with your new Operation.

Anvil Station is home to a multispecies partnership between the UNSC and their alien allies from the Arbiter’s Swords of Sanghelios. While wounds from the Covenant War are still fresh for many, there are also emerging generations of both species for whom the war will be but a memory.

On Anvil Station, humans and Sangheili work together to test experimental prototypes, including new Spartan armor variants.

A new 20-tier Operation Pass, an exciting new Big Team Battle mode, a refresh of The Exchange, and more await!

title: Goblin Slayer
description: Enter the world of Goblin Slayer, where you'll battle waves of goblins across an open map filled with levels to conquer. Collect power-up as you progress, stacking them to become incredibly powerful as you clear each wave. Take on bigger challenges and face ever-growing hordes in this fast-paced, action-packed adventure!

title: Hypermarket Simulator
description: Take charge of your own hypermarket in this addictive business simulation game! Manage inventory, automate tasks, and design the perfect store to keep customers coming back for more. Expand your store, sign exclusive licensing deals, and transform your small shop into the ultimate shopping destination.

title: Ace Strategy Mecha Nova
description: Command powerful mechs in "ACE Strategy: Mecha Nova," a tactical roguelike where you recruit elite allies, stack drones, and deploy strategic abilities across procedural battlefields. Master unit positioning, collect game-changing upgrades, and adapt your tactics for total battlefield dominance

title: Wanted 3D: Dead or Alive
description: Grab your bandolier and saddle up for Wanted 3D, a GZDoom-powered Spaghetti Western FPS! It's time to settle the score with your former gang and reclaim what is rightfully yours. Are you ready for the wildest showdown the Wild West has to offer?

title: Travel Junction
description: Hero fails to find a job in a major tour company. Eventually, he gets a job in a very small tour company on the verge of bankruptcy only containing four people with him. Their last hope is barely known southern island that no big tourist company holds. Hero and company president's daughter go there as guides alongside a tourist group of six women.

title: The Primrose Theater
description: A short love letter to 2013 Unity horror games. Inspired by games like The Theater and Kuro Oni.

title: Crimson Frontier
description: Crimson Frontier is a top-down shooter with RPG elements set in a cyberpunk universe. Battle powerful megacorporations, upgrade your character with augmentations, and uncover the truth in a dystopian world.

title: Foldy's OS Quest
description: Foldy’s OS Quest invites players into a colorful computerized world for an action-packed 3D platforming adventure like no other! Run, jump, zip, surf and stomp your way through the magical world of personal computing, and take down the virus before it can break through the Firewall!

title: Hero's Hand
description: Embark on the ultimate Poker-Based Roguelike RPG Adventure! Hero’s Hand packs a strategic punch! Become the Knight of Spades & save the land of Cardunia! The game features hand drawn animation, humorous fantasy monsters, & addictive turn-based poker combat that keeps you coming back for more!

title: Concrete Spaces
description: Spatial expectations built up and torn down, spoken word inspired pacing, and an ode to bilinguality. Thank you. Concrete Spaces.

title: Decontamination
description: You work in a decontamination organization. Travel to different zones and clear them of infection. In these zones, you will need to complete tasks such as cleaning up toxic lakes, collecting minerals, or even saving the creatures in these places.

title: Enigma Da Parda
description: Here begins the story of the Buddhist from Rio Grande do Norte who only wanted the luck of a peaceful love.

title: UNB
description:
Uh oh! Your tryin to HANG OUT WITH YOUR FRIEND ALIEN, but HIS UGLY and STUPID CYC is trying to KILL you! He's an STICKFIGUTRE, the only way to get to his GLASSES? The power of FL STUDIO...

PRESENTED BY THE RIZZ RESIDENCE CREW

title: Shoot For The Stars
description: A foddian style game but you are a gun!

title: Supermarket CEO Simulator
description:
Supermarket CEO Simulator – Build your retail empire and become the market leader!
Take charge of your own business and turn a small store into a thriving supermarket chain! In Supermarket CEO Simulator, you have full control over every aspect of supermarket management – from stocking shelves and hiring staff to marketing and expanding your business. The competition is fierce, and customers have high expectations – do you have what it takes to become a retail mogul?

title: Zombie Strike Force
description: The undead have taken over—gear up, survive, and fight back!

title: Chernobyl: Escape from Pripyat
description: Embark on a harrowing journey into the heart of darkness with Escape From Pripyat, a narrative-driven shooter that plunges you into a realm where fear and survival intertwine. You assume the role of a fearless investigative reporter, part of a specialized unit dispatched to document the unfolding horrors within the desolate ruins of Pripyat.

title: Digging a Hole 2025
description: The earth holds secrets—will you find them?

title: Super Slime Boy
description:
A fast-paced precision platformer where every jump counts!
Restore colour to a world drained of life by conquering 56 challenging levels!

title: Card Shop Game Store: TCG Simulator
description: Welcome to CARD SHOP GAME STORE - TCG SIMULATOR, a unique trading card shop simulator where you can build a successful business by selling collectible cards! Buy rare packs, open boosters, negotiate with customers, and develop your store into a paradise for collectors and trading card game enthusiasts.

title: Golden Racing
description: Golden Racing is a fast-paced arcade racing game where speed and precision are the keys to victory. Take control of powerful sports cars and race through thrilling tracks filled with sharp turns and challenging obstacles, with one goal in mind: reach the finish line before time runs out. Every second counts in this adrenaline-fueled challenge, where only the most skilled drivers can claim the glory and become champions of Golden Racing.

title: Stellar Docks: Deep Space
description: Logic without limits, puzzles beyond the stars!

title: Cazzarion: Builder
description: Build a tower by dropping blocks one by one! Aim accurately and stack the blocks squarely on each other and form the tallest skyscraper!

title: Miside Reality
description: Fall in, fade out—where does the real world end?

title: The Lost Dino: Survival Expedition
description: The jungle hides more than predators.

title: Chained Up Together
description: The chain binds you… but can it save you?

title: Sparkling Bug
description: Senkichu(Sparkling Bug) is an exploration game taking place underwater and the goal is to collect every item and song to unlock the ending.

title: Renai Karichaimashita: Koikari - Love For Hire: Limited Edition
description:
Because of his family's unique circumstances, the only thing Yuki put his faith in was that "Money will make my little sister happy." To this end, he regularly worked a part-time job until late at night.

His goals were to graduate as soon as possible and get a full-time job. But, one day as he was leaving for work, his little sister told him, "If Yuki isn't going to college then I won't either." He knew he couldn't put such a burden upon his little sister.

So, in order to gather the necessary sum of money to enter university, Yuki signed up for a "human employment rental" website. It seemed extremely suspicious, but desperate times call for desperate measures.

He starts his new job...and for some reason, a girl in his class asks him to be her pretend boyfriend. Then he's hired to pretend to be a woman's lover, another girl's friend, and even the older brother to a pair of twins!

The details of his fake relationships with these girls begin as soon as he takes their money!

This edition includes:
- B2 tapestry
- Theme song CD
- Acyrlic key chain

title: Bulbo's Belief System
description:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told—learning allows him to see, move, and interact, but forgetting is just as important.

Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity to walk across gaps, and manage conflicting beliefs to solve mind-bending challenges. Experiment with what Bulbo knows (or doesn't) to navigate a world where perception shapes reality.

Can you control what Bulbo learns and unlearns to reach the goal?

title: Rios de Lluvia
description: Rivers of Rain is a puzzle platform game where you play as Antonia and her grandfather, switching between both of them to solve different puzzles to complete their journey from the mountains to the sea.

title: Yandere Okami vs. Bouryoku Akazukin
description:
A short comedic game developed by Yuya Nako

Little Red Riding Hood decides to defeat monsters to get gifts for her grandmother. But things don't go so well...?

title: Super Ultra Usagi Rush!!
description:
This is a horror/puzzle game by Oyumeno
The main character is Suiri, a lonely girl.

One night, after having a nightmare, she starts looking for her mother, but she wasn't anywhere and Suiri gets attacked by a mysterious monster that suddenly appeared in her house.

After running for her life, she finds a hidden staircase...

title: Phantom Thief Angels: Twin Angel - Labyrinth of Time and World: Re:light
description:
Sammy-supervised PSP classic "Phantom Thief Twin Angel - Labyrinth of Time and World" gets HD remaster!

The remaster features full HD visuals, remastered sound effects, multilingual support, and other optimizations for a modern visual novel experience.

Kiichi Kanoh, the director and writer of the original PSP game, returns as executive producer.

title: Mink
description: A pixel art platformer where you solve puzzles and cross big gaps by "meowing" to create your own platforms.

title: Arcade Archives: Juno First
description:
"Juno FIRST" is a shooter released by KONAMI in 1983.
Operate your own aircraft to defeat countless approaching enemy UFOs and conquer the WAVE.
In an emergency, you can use warp to evade enemy attacks.

title: Sonic Brick
description: Sonic Brick is an early Sonic fan game made in Kilk & Play by Johan Leion in 1997.

title: Chitin
description:
Very short horror game made for a bug themed jam

Wanted to explore a lot of things but alas, jams are finite. I put most points on atmosphere, as my main goal for this was to try and evoke what I felt going through the rot part of Dark Souls 3 snow DLC.

title: Sort of Justice: Chapter 1
description: Sort of Justice is an immersive adult visual novel set in the dark side of society. As you plot your revenge against your backstabber, you will encounter many personalities, discover relationships and uncover buried secrets.

title: I Am Your Beast: Cold Sweat Update
description: Our final content update, Cold Sweat, is out now! This update brings new story-free levels that up the challenge and extend the weird. It also features a remix of TYRANTS BETTER RUN by Mega Ran, so yeah, we’re pretty excited about this one!

title: Poop Killer: Flush or Die
description: Bob and Case just wanted a quiet night… but fate (and a clogged toilet) had other plans. When a clueless friend ignores an important warning and decides to take a dump in a broken toilet, the nightmare begins.

title: Hollowglass
description: Try to survive in the desert for at least a few more moments and let neither thirst, nor jackals, nor death stop you...

title: Shizuoka Curse
description: Shizuoka Curse is the story of a desperate young Japanese vlogger, who goes to an abandoned school in the woods in hopes of recording footage that would make him internet famous but it all goes wrong...

title: Raiders of the Apocalypse
description: Explore dangerous bunkers packed with mutants, scavenge vital loot, and race against dwindling oxygen. Upgrade your shelter, craft gear, and risk it all for bigger rewards. Solo or co-op, see how deep you dare go!

title: Evil World Hopsca
description: This is a third-person horror escape game. It's weird. You face a million dangers in the mall. Run away from monsters and beware of all kinds of traps. Collect supplies, weapons and items to fight monsters, and medicines to restore various states. Solve puzzles and escape.

title: Baby's Nightmare Circus VR: Remake
description: Baby's Nightmare Circus VR: Remake is a re-imagining of the original Baby's Nightmare Circus, optimized for virtual reality. This version features new 3D graphics and real-time rendering for an immersive and unsettling experience. It also offers a non-VR mode for PC, which includes support for 4K resolution, ray-tracing, and various ultrawide aspect ratios. The game's environments have been fully rebuilt in 3D while retaining the aesthetic of the original, and the gameplay has been adapted for VR.

title: Yeonkyung
description: The game is a 3D first-person horror game and features Korean and Japanese soldiers and is played in a place called Yeongyeong, the palace of the Goryeo Dynasty. (Please understand that the game size is high for quality reasons.)

title: Shadow of The Forgotten
description: In a long-abandoned mansion of Dr. Victor Grimm, players find themselves trapped after a sudden collapse of the mansion's entrance. As they explore the sprawling, decaying building, they uncover secrets, and disturbing relics of Dr. Grimm's experiments.

title: Dead Silence: Echoes of the Damned
description: An atmospheric horror game with an open world and cinematic scenes. Explore the dark forest, search for items, read notes, perform rituals, and uncover a terrifying story. A first-person experience filled with jumpscares and intense tension.

title: Razorback
description: Razorback is a futuristic racing game inspired by Trackmania, featuring high-speed ship piloting with unique vertical engine mechanic and dynamic challenges. Compete in creative time-attack races for adrenaline-fueled fun!

title: Coin Push RPG
description: Coin Push RPG is a unique blend of Semi-Idle RPG and coin-pusher gameplay! Recruit legendary heroes, equip them with powerful gear, upgrade your town, construct buildings, and unlock stunning backgrounds as you expand your influence. Build a diverse and unstoppable team with your own unique style.

title: Magitech Requiem
description: Equip various magitech, perks, and weaponry to fight against hordes of creatures beckoned to remind humanity of their hubris. Fight either alone or alongside up to two friends, and employ advanced tactics to defy the forces of fate.

title: Mahjong Realms
description: Dive into a world of mystical, alien realms in this unique take on mahjong solitaire. Unlock new themes as you advance and design your own layouts to share with the community.

title: Emberfly
description: Emberfly is a horror game set in Korea. One day, you wake up at school. The outside is dark, and no one seems to be around. Relying on the flashlight in your hand, you must find a way to escape from this dream that feels real but isn't.

title: SlideNGlide
description: A challenging action-platformer where players navigate diverse biomes filled with unique enemies, tough platforming challenges, and intense boss fights. With tight controls and punishing difficulty, the game rewards precision, mastery, and exploration.

title: Milky Way Idle
description: A multiplayer idle RPG where automation replaces grinding. Level up skills, gather resources, craft powerful items, and battle monsters—all while AFK. Trade in the marketplace, join a guild, team up for party combat, and socialize in chat as you progress effortlessly.

title: FF: U on PC - Final Fantasy: Unlimited - Labyrinth: Kuroki Dream Memory
description: FF:U on PC is a visual novel based on the Final Fantasy: Unlimited anime. Choose from several dialogue options as you progress the story; the ending changes depending on your choices. The game also features card-based gameplay during moments of combat.

title: Teller's Duty
description: Teller’s Duty is a simulation game where players take on the role of a bank teller in a dystopian world. They must process transactions, verify documents, and detect fraud while navigating complex moral dilemmas that shape the story. Featuring a vintage paper-inspired aesthetic and a choice-driven narrative, the game challenges players to balance their duties with ethical decisions that impact their future

title: Banshee (Fazbear's Pizzeria Tycoon!)
description: Banshee is a fangame based on FNAF 6, manage a restaurant, repurpose old animatronics, find secrets and keep track of the place during the night!

title: Tidal Hopper
description: Tidal Hopper is an arcade game in which you play as a penguin jumping out of the water while keeping track of your oxygen meter and avoiding enemies.

title: MySims Kingdom
description: MySims Kingdom sets you on an adventure to help King Roland and his subjects revitalize the Kingdom. Throughout the quest, you will join up with friends, discover fascinating lands, take on challenges, and build amazing contraptions. Almost everything is customizable, allowing every creation within your world to have a signature look.

title: Bug Cleaners
description: Are you ready to stop the bug invasion? Fight off the invaders either solo or cooperatively with your team using extraordinary tools! Enjoy fun moments in chaotic missions — bug hunting has never been this exciting!

title: Skarab
description: Arise warrior, your kingdom has need of you. Wield ancient weaponry and harness arcane powers in your quest to liberate Egypt, rescue her royal highness, and exile Anubis to the afterlife.

title: Seven Kingdoms: The Princess Problem
description:
Every seven years the seven kingdoms send their best and brightest young people to be their delegates at the Vail Isle Summit, a tradition where seven weeks are spent together to form friendships, alliances and marriages. This year, however, things are different. Since the Great Peace, never have alliances been so close to collapse. The seven nations on the razor's edge of war. What happens at this summit could very well determine the fate of the known world.

You are one of the delegates.

title: Tavern Talk: Tempest Tantrum
description:
Welcome back, Innkeep!
Have you been wondering about what happened after you saved the world? How’s life in Asteria now that the dust has settled?

One and a half years after the events of Tavern Talk, young detective Melina finds a mysterious mechanism and breaks it, accidentally unleashing the chaotic spirit trapped inside. Melina and her friends must now race to fix the ancient apparatus, recapture the spirit, and stop a Primordial storm from causing devastating damage.

title: Find Love or Die Trying: Til Death Do Us Part
description: The afterstory to Find Love or Die Trying is here! Continue your romance with your chosen partner in the world beyond the killer dating show. Will your love survive, when the world turns against you?

title: Mobenium 2D
description:
A top-down tank game about surviving enemy waves.

First proper game by Eggs & Chickens, made for a school project.

title: Gran Turismo 4 Spec II
description:
Spec II is a mod which expands upon the core Gran Turismo 4 experience, bringing a variety of fixes and improvements to the game. As the name may suggest, Spec II primarily aims to improve on the game in ways that feel Polyphony Digital themselves would, while also adding a few modernised features and challenge run-friendly options.

Spec II is based on the NTSC version of Gran Turismo 4 Online Public Beta and is distributed as an xDelta patch requiring this version.

title: Sovereign Syndicate: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Sovereign Syndicate: Digital Deluxe Edition is a bundle that includes the base game and several digital bonuses. Included Content:

- Sovereign Syndicate (Base Game)
- Digital Artbook
- Original Soundtrack

title: Zomboard
description: Zomboard is a post-apocalyptic colony sim and base defense game. Start with a few survivors, build your settlement, and fortify defenses to survive overwhelming zombie hordes.

title: MoonSpire
description: A short 2D puzzle platformer with a rage element inspired by Nintendo's Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Seasons platforming sections.

title: Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2025
description: Lead your college basketball team in Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2025. Recruit stars, coach for success, and make key decisions that will lead your team to the tournament. Navigate recruiting, the transfer portal and NIL options to build a winner. The ultimate coaching simulation game!

title: Dawn: Instagram Model
description: A short story of an Instagram model.

title: Doki Doki No Happiness
description: Doki Doki No Happiness is a mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that seeks to expand the game's original story, offering an alternative approach where psychological horror gives way to a lighter, more emotional experience. Unlike the dark plot of the base game, this mod introduces a storyline in which the characters can find true happiness, allowing the player to explore new paths and more positive endings.

title: Bliss Valley
description: While running errands, you'll meet three cute furry characters that you can potentially date, romance, and eventually seduce. This game contains explicit sexual content.

title: Treeverse
description:
Treeverse is a top down open world classless MMORPG.

Start in the city of Lorwick, meet friends, party up, kill monsters, gather resources, craft your monster shards, collect blue prints… and conquer all the different worlds!

title: Ryan's Apparition Wandering Restaurant
description: You've just been hired, congratulations! Turns out being a nocturnal security guard is a popular job position among mascot-themed kid restaurants.

title: Something To Write About: Unbroken - Book One
description: Unbroken brings you into the world of a young professional athlete and former soldier, navigating your life,friendships, relationships and your complicated past. The choices you make will not only impact yourself, but everybody around you, choose wisely.

title: Microsoft Bubble
description: Aim the Bubble launcher to match 3 or more of the same bubble color. Release the launcher and send your bubble to pop the matching bunch off the board!

title: Crunchies Munchies
description: Eat as much food as possible. Hitting each other or hitting a saw will cause you to barf it out.

title: Doki Doki Literature Club: The Festival
description:
Doki Doki Literature Club: The Festival is an expansive mod that reimagines the original story of Doki Doki Literature Club! by focusing on the long-awaited School Festival.

Unlike the base game, where the event never actually takes place, in this mod the protagonist and the Literature Club members-Sayori, Natsuki, Yuri and Moniki-prepare for the festival in more depth, with new interactions, dialogues and exclusive events. The player's choices play a crucial role in how the festival unfolds, and can lead to different outcomes, from touching and romantic moments to shocking revelations.

title: Welcome to: Doki Doki Literature Club, Player!
description:
Welcome to Doki Doki Literature Club, Player! is a unique mod that breaks the fourth wall even further and transforms the original Doki Doki Literature Club! experience into something even more immersive and interactive.

In this mod, you're not just a player controlling the protagonist-you're recognized as an individual within the game universe itself. The members of the Literature Club, Sayori, Natsuki, Yuri and Monika, interact directly with you, reacting to your choices in unexpected ways and even questioning your presence in their world.

title: Grand Fantasy Heroes
description: An epic Fantasy RPG where you will level up heroes, go on adventures, and progress in power until you can take on the Demon King.

title: Pierrot’s Pilgrimage
description: Hello! Do you want to play something easy but different? This game is like a walk in a strange park. But also you can speak with people in this park. Don't worry, they are behind the screen, they are not real! They can't hurt you. They cannot fall in love with you. Very nice and chill experience.

title: Unravel Trigger: Prelude to War
description:
An append to Unravel Trigger, with 3 new stories taking place before and after the war for Millicent, Natore and Estelle.
The after-war episode also serves as a prequel to Unravel Trigger: Cold War.

title: Unravel Trigger: Cold War
description: The sequel to Unravel Trigger: Prelude to War.

title: Hyperkidmorph2mr.gunner
description:
Free-mouse lasso Gunner lock on fast-paced first-person-shooter fixed-camera gunny game

Experience being a total loser for free

title: Pluralys
description:
Pluralys is a solo narrative RPG set in an alternate world to our blue planet.
You can explore almost every place in the game, talk to everyone, and immerse yourself in a rich story full of mystery.
You’ve been contacted by someone, but who are they, and what do they want? You’ll have to find out.
This place is certainly hiding a lot of things...

title: Detective: The Test
description: Test your detective instincts across three challenging cases. No hints, no help—just you, your intuition, and your ability to piece together the truth. Can you solve the mystery?

title: Astroidle
description: Ready for some chill time in space? Astrodle has you covered. Watch the numbers soar as you upgrade your ship and travel the stars. Oh, and you might just become a god.

title: Pigeon Hater
description: our friends decided to play a prank on you for your birthday by giving you a whole box of dildos. Should you just throw this "gift" in the trash or seek revenge on those annoying pigeons? The decision is all yours!

title: Subway Driver Dream Emulator
description: Subway Driver Dream Emulator is an experiment on translating feelings that its developer had when they were a child taking the subway train, in Paris's suburbs, where they grew up.

title: Ascendaria
description: Climb as high as possible through diverse and fascinating worlds. Overcome unique challenges, discover hidden secrets, and collect upgrades and bonuses. But beware, a single mistake can send you tumbling down. Dive into the adventure and see how high you can climb!

title: Millennium Runners
description: The ultimate anti-gravity racing experience. Millennium Runners is an homage to classic arcade racing games. Speed through futuristic cities and planets in adrenaline-fueled competitions. Along the way, you'll discover hidden easter eggs and pick up an arsenal of power-ups — from rockets to mines and more — designed either to propel you to victory or to hinder your rivals. Choose your team, conquer the Millennium Cup, and race your way into legend!

title: Glory On Pluto
description: Bring prestige back to Earth by building your engines and finding Glory on Pluto in this offbeat and unique deckbuilding rougelike.

title: Easy Street: A Shopping Adventure
description:
Easy Street is an educational shopping game.
The player controls a small child who must travel Easy Street, to go to the local stores to buy the items on their shopping list. The player must choose which store is appropriate to buy the items on the top of the screen, entering the store, and choosing the correct item. On more difficult levels, the player must choose how much to pay for the item. To complicate matters, the player will get approached by Knuckles the Gorilla, and if he is able to hop onto the player's wagon, the player will not be able to enter any more stores, and must restart their shopping trip. When the player has gathered all required items, they can return home with their shopping complete.

title: Killing Floor III: Deluxe Edition
description:
It's 2091. Megacorporation Horzine has produced the ultimate army: an obedient horde of bioengineered monstrosities called "Zeds." Now, only the rebel group Nightfall stands between these infernal creations and the future of humanity

The Digital Deluxe Edition contains:
- “Shadow Agent” Specialist Skin Set
- “Shadow Agent” Weapon Skin Set
- Nightfall Supply Pass
- 1000 Creds

title: Hardball + Hardball 2
description: ATARI PRESENTS is a series of titles geared toward the preservation of cult classics, forgotten favorites, and titles that would otherwise be lost to time. In the spirit of that, each ATARI PRESENTS title is presented unchanged from its original version other than providing the means to play them on modern hardware. Even the store description below is the very same language used to describe the title at the time of its release. Please enjoy!

title: CroquettesClicker
description: An incremental game about kibble and cats! Collect, upgrade, and manage your kibble to reach unimaginable heights. Will you become the ultimate kibble master?

title: Death From Above: Complete Edition
description:
The Complete Edition contains:
Death From Above
Death From Above Soundtrack
Aerorozvidka Supporter Skin Pack
Fellas & Defenders Supporter Skin Pack

title: Lost Rift
description: Lost Rift is a First Person Survival Shooter Adventure that blends base-building PVE co-op with high-stakes PvPvE extraction gameplay set on a mysterious archipelago that can be explored solo or in teams of up to 5 players.

title: I Hate this Place
description: A craft-based, isometric survival horror game with twisted monsters and warped reality. Scavenge and build to survive terrifying days and nights while using stealth and noise to fight enemies that stalk by sound. All styled with bold comic art and an '80s horror vibe.

title: Revenge of the Savage Planet: Cosmic Hoarder Edition
description: Revenge of the Savage Planet is an upbeat, satirical action adventure Sci-Fi. Jump, shoot and collect your way across vibrant alien worlds, uncovering new gear and upgrades, while discovering various hidden secrets.

title: Shelf Heroes
description: Blast rogue toys with wacky weapons in this fast-paced Roguelite FPS! Mix & match toy parts to assemble your Shelf Hero, discover powerful perk combos, and explore a giant House. Play solo or with friends in 3-player co-op!

title: Fractured Perception
description: Discover a mystery, understand the danger you are living in, and find the true culprit of a series of disturbing crimes that have occurred around you.

title: Romestead
description: Rome has fallen! Rebuild civilization in this action-adventure survival game for 1-8 players. Fight, build towns and earn favor with the Roman gods! ...or just farm your crops.

title: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord - War Sails
description: Sail the high seas, lead mighty fleets, and forge your legacy in War Sails. Bringing naval warfare to Bannerlord for the first time, War Sails lets players command powerful ships, engage in thrilling sea battles, and master maritime conquest.

title: Frosthaven
description: From the creative mind of Isaac Childres, the highly acclaimed board game moves to the digital realm in the video game adaptation of FROSTHAVEN! The dark fantasy tactical RPG features deep mechanics and challenging yet satisfying gameplay both in Single Player and Co-Op Online Multiplayer.

title: Killing Floor III: Elite Nightfall Edition
description:
It's 2091. Megacorporation Horzine has produced the ultimate army: an obedient horde of bioengineered monstrosities called "Zeds." Now, only the rebel group Nightfall stands between these infernal creations and the future of humanity.

The Elite Nightfall Edition contains:
- “Shadow Agent” Specialist Skin Set
- “Shadow Agent” Weapon Skin Set
- Year 1 Premium Nightfall Supply Pass Access (4 Supply Passes)
- 3000 Creds

title: Raev: Kingdom on the Distant Shores
description: Build an empire, founding its villages and cities. Every kingdom started with a single bonfire, and RAEV allows you to create your own thriving civilization across a sprawling continent. Craft interwoven cityscapes, inspire your people, and build a kingdom to forge your path to greatness.

title: High Above
description: High Above is a small rooftop-building game about finding peace in the skies. Design and grow your perfect rooftop retreat, from vibrant Cuban courtyards to modern urban hideaways. Watch the world come to life around you, at your own pace, in your own little oasis.

title: LAN Party Adventures
description: Okay, Pedro is AWOL, and you have to get this LAN Party set up at the Game Store for the session later. Connect cables, install software, and solve puzzles all while you and the gang uncover the mystery of your missing friend.

title: Arcas Champions
description: Apes with Fruit Guns! Train and collect ape champions, equip weapons and glide into epic online battles in a unique third person ability shooter. Combine totem abilities with friends and dominate the jungle planet in thrilling game modes whilst climbing the leaderboards for glory.

title: Cat-Ptured
description: A fast-paced, 'hyper-stylized' 3D platformer featuring a cute, low poly, PSX aesthetic. You'll control Tia, a reckless kid with an oversized hammer (and an even bigger heart), as they traverse dangerous alien planets in order to stop the planet eating menaces known as Nyomers!

title: Infinity Nikki: Revelry Season
description:
Behind every mask lies a wilder fantasy. Under the spotlight, wishes burn brighter than the sun!

Dance! Let the rhythm of joy guide your feet. Step onto the world's stage and witness this fantastic party.

title: Trident's Tale
description: Uncover the secrets of the Storm Trident and rule the seas - Your legend awaits in Trident's Tale!

title: Crashawk
description: A tight, retro-style 2D platformer inspired by the Game Boy and Super Game Boy accessories. Use the unique crashing mechanic to ricochet off walls and make your way through the singleplayer campaign or bound off the ground to demolish your friends in the new multiplayer battle mode!

title: Earth Mechanica
description: A 3D RPG/Platformer about an alien invasion brought about by a partnership with a world famous inventor and the leader of an alien race. You play as a group of kids & robots who are trying to find out how this happened and setting it right.

title: Dark Mass
description: Dark Mass is a fully underwater horror game. Explore the ruins of a sunken manor and flee from a curse trapped within for centuries. Your choices will decide if you escape or join the lost souls of the abyss.

title: Galactic Blasters D: Future Darkness
description: A horizontal space shooter game that is the 4th Galactic Blasters game.

title: Green Crab Grab
description: An arcade-like clicker game where you catch invasive crabs.

title: Haffy DX
description:
Traverse four varied stages of strange, wacky enemies, fast-paced bullet dodging action and ultra-threatening bosses. Experience hand-drawn* cinematics between each level to keep you waiting for what's next. Feeling overwhelmed? Your starship can change into 3 different forms, each with their own killer arsenal. And if that's not enough, you can just BOMB 'EM!

The one thing standing between the Sagitaria-IV and the enemy is YOU. Get on your pilot goggles, prepare for space combat you won't soon forget.

title: Creeping Clark
description: "Creeping Clark" is a linear indie horror game that pulls players into Sophie Clark's unsettling experience in a remote forest house. With a playtime of ~60 minutes (Demo: ~25 minutes), follow Sophie as she navigates a series of disturbing events that blur the line between anxiety and reality.

title: Le Trésor d'ali Gator
description: Legend tells of a pirate called Ali Gator whose treasure lies in a castle. You have gone to the castle to search for the treasure. It’s a simple exploration game where you wander around a maze of only 49 rooms, but there are many traps to catch you out. The game is quite a departure for Lankhor, who specialised in text adventures on the CPC – and they should have stuck to what they knew best. It’s written by Claude Le Moullec, who also wrote dozens of listings for French magazines, and in fact, it was originally intended to be a listing as well.

title: Ano Subarashii Bento wo 2-do 3-do
description: This bento-shop simulator has players take over a failing bento shop with the goal of dominating the local town corner. Players can make their own custom bento via drag-and-drop from the available ingredients, choose how to stock their store, or snoop around opponents' stores to get a feel for their strategy. While normally played against the computer, a local multiplayer mode supports up to four players.

title: Cyber Arms Val-Kaizer
description: In 21st century humanity started other planets colonization. Along with "bioloader" research to create a strengthened outer protective skin was underway. The lead researcher was afraid of military use of bioloader and set an explosion in the laboratory. His sister was found on the place of explosion miraculously saved.

title: Burya v Stakane: Honky na Marshrutkakh
description:
The operational situation in the vast expanses of the Far Northern Galaxy has become much more complicated. Persons of unknown nationality are operating everywhere. The production of illegal alcohol has been established on secret planets on a galactic scale.

In the game Storm in a Teacup: Minibus Racing, two seasoned employees of the Krishna Operatives sect are sent to carry out a complex of operational-search activities.

To restore order in the region, the operatives will have to solve many problems: free Princess Zadolballa, assemble a proton torpedo, and stop the illegal production of robotics.

And in the meantime, find the Chosen One, whose appearance was predicted by the Oracle, rescue the great and secret Ch., steal a starship - in a word, demonstrate operational ingenuity.

And our heroes will be helped by talented racers: rapper Nikolai Beldyev, the beautiful Zhuzhu, the young and very promising Enikey Skovorodker and others.

title: Kadetstvo: Novaya Istoriya
description: The game will have a new meeting with the heroes of the popular TV series: the charming bully Makarov, the handsome intellectual Sukhomlin, the kind Perepechko, ensign Kantemirov, General Matveyev and other old acquaintances.

title: Ordinary World the Video Game
description: This game was drawn on the Nintendo 3DS app, Flipnote. After another heartbreak Syd decides to move away from her small town to the Big City. Help her as you earn coins around Small Town by playing mini games (at the Bar, Club, and Gas Station), and by getting to know everyone in town on your Tasks list, Save coins into your piggy bank for comic book cut scenes until you've reached your final goal: a train ticket which you decide to Leave or Stay.

title: Aleprok
description: A cooperative survival and strategy game where you explore diverse environments, build and defend your clan town, upgrade weapons and skills, and master magic to survive relentless enemy attacks.

title: Cara Mia
description: An odd short adventure inspired by Space Funeral.

title: A Little Perspective
description: A Little Perspective is an abstract, perspective-based puzzle game where perception and reality are one and the same.

title: Malum Incarnatum
description:
With the sin of the flesh every man is born, thus
does each soul yearn for love.
But should love be won but once and then lost,
even the soul of a righteous heart may succumb to sin.

Descend into human hell and unravel a life torn apart by the desire to love and be loved. Even if this longing for love only leads to evil growing inside one man's heart.

Features a surreal horror experience like none other!
Inspired by late 90s PSX-games and even includes Full Motion Videos.

Solve a hidden mystery to unlock a different outcome.
Play with a Controller (Xbox 360/One/Series/DualSense/DualShock 4) and Headphones for the best experience!
Abandon all hope, ye who enter!

title: Carne Vescens
description:
Trapped in her own apartment, a mother finds herself unable to keep her insatiable baby fed.
So she decides to feed her baby the only bit of food she has left: HERSELF.

title: Clash of Adventurers
description:
Clash of Adventurers is an Open World MMORPG developed by Devsland Soft, a studio incorporated to bring this project alive.

The first Saga of Clash of Adventurers: 'Arrival of the Adventurers' is being developed using Unreal Engine 5 as Free To Play for PC Windows O.S.

Elemental forces attempt to take over the lands of Lumeria, you will take part as an Adventurer to restore the order and prevent the wild creatures from erasing the Human Race. As an adventurer you will be able to explore freely the lands of Lumeria and forge your own destiny, the only boundaries are your skills and abilities to survive in the wild. Collaboration and coordination are key values, playing the role of an Attacker, Defender or Support you will have to join other Adventurers to complete Quests, unlock Achievements, defeat the fantastic creatures unleashed in Lumeria, and perhaps engage in battle against other Adventurers, much just like yourself, are shaping their own fate.

title: The Last Bunker
description: A "60-Seconds" like scav-survival game. Collect food and water, trade, and defend your bunker. How long can you survive?

title: Pokémon Old World Dawn
description:
In Celestia, the floating city, Eve's ordinary school life is suddenly disrupted when she encounters Net, an enigmatic being who leads her on a journey of discovery and adventure. A prehistoric monster, previously imprisoned, has been unleashed and is wreaking havoc on the universe with the destructive power of the Void. With the world on the edge of destruction, Eve finds herself having to go on a journey of searching for the truth, fighting against strong opponents, and learning how to bring an end to the Void before it destroys everything.

This completed fangame clocks in at 40 hours of playtime, from a fresh-new Void type to challenging boss fights with creative mechanics and an abundance of challenges—from crafting and mini-games to side gyms and regional Pokémon evolutions. Throughout your journey, you'll encounter eccentric characters, ride across regions, and gain achievements, all while shaping Eve's story and discovering what it truly means to find one's self.

title: An Angel Dances In The Sparks of a Bonfire
description:
left and right to move

space to restart

controllers supported

title: Verdant Idea
description:
Minecraft 1.20.1 Modpack.

The world as you know is gone. Your task is to bring it back to life!

Inspired by Regrowth, Verdant Idea is a unique experience in which you start in a vast, empty world and eventually build a thriving civilization using magic and technology.

While this modpack takes inspiration from Regrowth, treat it as a spiritual successor - there are many exiting changes and additions!

title: Magnitude: Gamma
description:
Radiation is accelerating the rogue electron incursion.

The core must remain protected in order to prevent a nuclear disaster.

title: Speeder Ship
description: Speeder Ship is an exhilarating endless runner game set in tunnels where players must navigate obstacles, collect points, and seize special items that grant temporary invincibility, double scores, or time slowdowns. As player accumulate points, the pace quickens, intensifying the challenge. Dodge obstacles, gather points, and push your reflexes to the limit in this adrenaline-fueled adventure!

title: Crowd Fighters
description: Call out the heroes and defend your fortress!

title: Firefighting Heroes: Truck 911 Simulator
description: Gear up and answer the call with "Firefighting Heroes: Truck 911 Simulator." Step into the role of a dedicated firefighter in this thrilling simulation, where you'll tackle fires across over 30 diverse areas inspired by real American locations. Experience the urgency of emergency response as you drive fire trucks, wield authentic firefighting tools, and save lives in a variety of challenging scenarios.

title: Heist Simulator: Urban Thief Shadows
description: Step into the thrilling world of "Heist Simulator: Urban Thief Shadows," where your dreams of masterful heists come to life. As a skilled thief, you'll navigate a series of daring robberies, from simple snatches to elaborate capers. Plan your operations meticulously, equip yourself with advanced tools, and upgrade your skills to become the ultimate heist artist.

title: Quiz & Learn: Food & Drink
description: A relaxing multiple-choice quiz about food and drink that includes photo rounds with interesting facts

title: Ghost Shooter
description: A shooting game in which the player defends the city while defeating ghosts summoned by rituals with a gun that can purify them. The player becomes a girl (Ghost Shooter) with a gun that can purify ghosts, and fights to the death against ghosts and monsters that are approaching the city.

title: Top Driver
description: The ultimate challenge of speed and skill

title: Arcade Archives: Senkyu
description:
Aim for the winning SENKYU KING!!

"SENKYU" is a puzzle game released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1995.
The game is played by connecting four or more balls of the same color and erasing them to create a chain of four or more balls of the same color, aiming for a high score.
In addition to the SKILL TESTER MODE where you can judge your own skill, you can also participate in the SENKYU tournament and aim for the victory in the NORMAL MODE, as well as engage in 2-player versus battles.

title: Monster Popper
description: Step into a world full of fast-paced action and mischievous monsters! Monster Popper is a dynamic action platformer where you play as a young hero armed with a powerful energy blaster. Your mission is to eliminate waves of crazy, bouncing creatures and defeat giant bosses that threaten the magical kingdom.

title: Fish With Names
description: A surreal fishing experience.

title: Nightmare SuperHighway
description: A surreal exploration game about being alone in a bright, colorful city.

title: Trials of Innocence
description: Trials of Innocence is an indie courtroom detective game. Step into the shoes of the main character, rookie lawyer Luna Ray, and navigate her journey through the legal world. Unravel a shocking conspiracy that changes the fate of many, including herself, and confront her inner choices.

title: Maccha's World
description:
You find yourself cut off from your family in desperate need of a new liver to save your life. With 100,000 gold coins needed, you enter "The Pit", a cave full of money, monsters and alcohol. Can you make it out in one piece?

Maccha's World is a short but very challenging NES-styled game inspired by the likes of Spelunky and Kero Blaster.

title: Doki Doki Easter Hunt!
description: Do you want to go on a cute easter hunt? Do you want to go on a cute easter hunt with the dokis? This is just the mod for you: Doki Doki Easter Hunt! A short but fun mod with a twist ending.So what does it entail, you ask?Play and find out! ;)

title: Doki Heika Banzai!
description: "This is the project I've worked on for the last couple weeks. It's a comedy set in WW2 Imperial Japan and it's pretty short!I can't really reveal much of the plot without giving away too much, but I can tell you that the protagonist and the four girls are going to war in this one and whacky adventures are ensured! The mod is a bit NSFW."

title: Doki Doki New Eyes
description: At first, I only thought it would be temporary.However, soon, things started getting weirder and weirder. Whenever he was around, my heart would beat faster, and I wouldn't control my body anymore. There's nothing wrong with that Right? Doki Doki! New Eyes is a fan game that lets you play through Act 1 & 2 of the original DDLC game Through Yuri's point of view. What you see isn't necessarily what's real. Sometimes, you need to change your perspective a little You need to look at the world with new eyes.

title: Doki Doki Meme Club 2: Rise of The Dark Memes
description: The adventure of the Meme Club continues. But this time, they're danker than ever. If you've gotten sick of the endless assault of Natsuki-routes and Save Them All stories, then Meme Club 2 is the mod for you.Editor's note: This mod contains intentionally offensive content for comedic purposes. E.g.: sexual assault, violence, politics, etc.

title: Doki Doki Undone Fate
description: When Monika retains her memories of the previous playthrough, events go down differently than in the base game. How differently? Well, the inclusion of a whole new week to play through for starters! But be warned: Just because Monika is no longer messing with the game's code doesn't mean there are no more tragedies that can go down in the Literature Club... Can you Undo the tragic Fate this game is pushing for and ensure a happy ending?Editor's note: The beginning of this mod is mostly the same as Act 1 of DDLC, albeit with minor changes.

title: Chat Champions
description: Chat Champions is an interactive pixel battle simulator built for live streaming on Twitch.

title: Minecraft: Spring to Life
description: The Spring to Life drop is an update to Minecraft: Bedrock Edition which brings more reasons to explore! Befriend new mob variants, marvel at glittering firefly bushes, seek out ambient sounds, and delight in an Overworld full of life.

title: Only Sliding
description: A puzzle game with one mechanic (sliding).

title: Minecraft: Chase the Skies
description: The Chase the Skies drop is an update to Minecraft: Bedrock Edition which brings a new flying mount, opening up the skies for exploring, crafting, and (hopefully) surviving! Discover the skies with the new happy ghast, plan a group trip with the Player Locator bar guide and ride mobs, craft your leads and saddles and prepare for the breathtaking views with Vibrant Visuals.

title: Kush Quest
description:
In a world where ingesting cannabis gives a small percentage of the population super human abilities, an Evil King outlaws the plant as part of his plans for World Domination. The World's last hope is Lucky Jay and the Blaze Knights, a Brotherhood of heroes sworn to use their cannabis inspired abilities for good.

Enjoy this retro RPG inspired video game dedicated to the cannabis community. Take on enemies in a battle system inspired by early Final Fantasy and Pokemon. Purchase and Equip new gear including smoking paraphernalia. Unlock new abilities and summons through exciting side quests. Even manage your own grow operations.

Indulge yourself in a carefully plotted story full of twists and turns or keep yourself busy earning money to decorate your house. The possibilities are endless in Kush Quest.

title: Injustice 2: Infinite Transforms
description: Allows you to Transform Gear without using Source Crystals.

title: Wuthering Waves: Tangled Truth in Inverted Tower
description:
Version 2.2 of Wuthering Waves, including:
• New characters: Cantarella and Rover (Aero)
• New areas: Avinoleum and Beohr Waters
• New story quests
• New echoes, events and more!

title: Rogue Zodiacs
description: A content-rich, turn-based roguelike with truly endless replay value achieved by having countless varieties because all contents are unique. 250+ unique abilities, 200+ unique relics, 16+ locations, 40+ hazards, 90+ unique enemies, and the 12 Zodiacs guarantee each of your runs will be different.

title: Just Monika: A Doki Doki Literature Club Song
description: This mod is a playable version of the music video "Just Monika" by Random Encounters. Meaning it plays like a normal mod but also has musical elements embedded in it. It was recently overhauled to have a new extended story and brand new features, such as updated sprites and backgrounds, grammatical error fixes, and much much more. [25th June 2020]

title: Doki Doki Love and Literature
description: After being persuaded by his childhood friend Sayori, a boy named Kazuma (our protagonist) grudgingly joins the Doki Doki Literature Club. Soon, he finds himself falling in love with a certain pink-haired, manga-loving baker.

title: Doki Doki Just Us
description: After the school festival two new members joined the literature club. One is shy and the other is playful on the outside, but what are they truly like? Will they get along well with the other girls? Will our protagonist find true love during all the calamity? Find out now!But remember... this mod adapts to the choices you make. Choose Wisley...

title: Doki Doki College Club 2
description:
Doki Doki College Club 2 is a sequel to the original Doki Doki College Club, both of which are intended as parody mods. While the first leaned slightly more into the original game's format, both mods use satire and absurdist humor. The humor may not appeal to everyone, and some references are intentionally obscure.

It’s recommended to play the first mod before starting this one, as it provides context for the characters and story. If you enjoyed the first, this sequel builds on it with more content and polish. Development of this mod was more ambitious, with significantly more time spent on writing and design—estimated at around 200 hours.

title: Go Home Club
description: Ah, the Literature Club! A place for books, poems, manga, and memes... wait what? Monika won't be happy with that last one...

title: Doki Doki Literature Club! Take Two!
description: A sequel mod that expands on the story of the original game. After a brief chat in the void, Monika and Sayori decide to give their world one last chance. Now armed with the knowledge that all the club members are sentient, a better result is all they can hope for. Sayori also retains her self-awareness, so Monika is a little less alone this time.The demo contains all of Act 5. It begins on the day of the festival, introduces two new characters, and proceeds from there with routes for everyone. It's structure is similar to Act 1 of the first game, but very little of the original is reused (unless you don't listen to Monika at the start, ahaha).The first playthrough is roughly two hours long. Skipping repeated scenes leaves each route at an hour or so each. Although this demo consists of Act 5 in its entirety, there is still a lot more to look forward to. Act 6 shifts the game into a linear story with plenty of intrigue and unexpected twists. The next release will be the full version, but it may take a long time to develop.

title: Doki Doki The New Literature Club
description: A grand idea inspired this mod: what about a full-blown sequel to DDLC?The story takes place after the good ending of DDLC, with a self-aware Sayori thanking you for all you did (while Monika floats out in limbo after her deletion). Set two months after this event, our protagonist returns to the literature club after having drifted away from it to find a larger group of 7, now. He finds all three of the girls (Natsuki, Yuri, and of course, Sayori) in the club cute, and this sways him to join. Now, he must help the club get ready for the upcoming Winter Festival, all while trying to impress the girl of his fancy.This game will expand a lot of the features of DDLC. There is still poem writing, still drama between the club members, and still all the loveable quirks in the dialogue. However, this game will be much larger. Act 1 has 5 ways to end (though this trickles into only 3 distinct ways to play through Act 2). There are four new male characters, each with distinct personalities and ties to the Doki girls we know and love. It tackles how Sayori might deal with her self-awareness, in light of her depression, and also asks what the club would be like if it were larger. I won't delve too much further into detail, I'll let that be left for later.

There he met the doll Stigma, who looked just like his sister. This was a world where one must kill to stay alive. He would dirty his hand with blood to find and rescue her.
