description:
In 2004, Serenity Scott was a sophomore at Mercer University, studying anthropology and computational science. Investigators say she engaged in frequent online conversations with an unidentified individual that went by the pseudonym "hoot83", whose identity has never been verified.

Serenity Scott was last seen on October 22nd, 2004. To this day, her whereabouts are unknown. No evidence suggests there was foul play.

Night Owls is a ~20 min unsettling narrative that marks the 20-year anniversary of the disappearance of a 20-year-old woman.

title: The Haunting Of Stabbey Road
description: Discover the dark secrets of a once renowned recording studio.

title: Scirocco Thugs
description: Roundhouse Kicks, Six shooters and rusty Lead Pipes become your vehicles for revenge against the Don.... Grab some scrap and engage in brutal, breakneck melee combat in this FPS Beat 'Em Up!

title: Canidae
description: On Halloween, a gang of teenagers in animal masks head out to set off fireworks and drink with their friends. Unfortunately, nothing ever goes right for you. As the night grows darker and pranks turn to violence, your friends start to change. Will you?

title: BrainRot
description: A party pvp game based on brainrot trends.

title: Faire Trade
description: Ready to take on the management of a fantasy shop? Faire Trade allows you to do just that! From farming, to crafting, to selling, to hiring, to expanding, to pricing, to decorating to….. Well, the world's your oyster! Stay curious, adapt, and let your blossoming shop shine!

title: Stormbinders
description: Stormbinders is a turn-based strategy game with a unique fantasy setting. Classic tactical gameplay meets a new level of strategic depth in a battle for survival against chaotic magic storms.

title: Knuckle Jet
description: What's this? An off-the-wall, riveting jetpunk nose-breaking ricochet action platformer, lovingly crafted by the oddballs behind the Teslagrad series?

title: The Dark West
description: The Dark West is a grim ARPG reimagining the genre with deep player agency, innovative systems, and and a fresh take on player progression. We're crafting an experience that blends cutting-edge gameplay within an engaging and immersive world.

title: Cyber Rats
description: Cyber Rats is a brutal Rogue-Lite Survival Horror game. Escape a sadistic AI's death maze, or be torn apart trying!

title: Hallow Maze
description: Hallow Maze is an epic action adventure through an intricate world submerged in war. Explore twisting caves, enormous palaces, battle unhuman horrors and help those in need, in a gothic hand painted 2.5D artstyle.

title: Melted Time
description: Candle, your path is full of puzzles. Can you handle it? Hurry, your time is already melting away.

title: DotAge: Folkways
description: Village elder, help us! Meet new Pipfolks, lure them into your village, solve the problems they will cause, and play with new elders with unique mechanics!

title: Indigo Horizon
description: A brief, single-stage shooting game with minimalistic visuals and rewarding scoring mechanics.

title: Serial Cleaner: Blood & Confetti
description: The work of a good cleaner is never done! Bob is back, forced to track down The Fest-Evil killer across three crime-ridden celebrations - Chinese New Year, Día de los Muertos, and Mardi Gras. Sneak, sweep, and survive in this stylish 2D stealth-action DLC. Tread carefully… the dead are watching.

title: Shoot Yourself With a Rifle
description: Shoot yourself with a rifle.

title: The Lingering: Last Customer
description: Devi, a 27-year-old young woman, books a late-night massage at Ahola Spa & Reflexology—the only spa that is still open.. What should have been a relaxing escape turns into a lingering nightmare…

title: Dino Genesis
description: Dino Genesis is an action FPS that navigates you through the forgotten island, ISLA GENESIS. You will have to defend yourself from genetically created Dinosaurs, Arachnids and Insects while discovering the dark secrets of the island.

title: HypurrX
description: HypurrX is a gritty sci-fi arcade style cute-em-up. Say whaaat?Pilot your cat companion through a brutal onslaught of enemy waves and epic boss battles. Challenge the global leaderboards in this single player bullet hell trench runner.

title: Indiepocalypse #61
description: Issue #61 of a monthly indie game anthology collecting games from 10 developers.

title: Christmas Horror Land
description: A boy wakes up during Christmas eve and goes to get some milk out of the fridge. But their curiosity gets the better of them and decide to go have a look around and see something they wished they'd never seen... Join me on my journey of creating my first released game Christmas Horror Land a spine chilling horror game by us at Hungry Entertainment! Christmas Horror Land will have a new version every Christmas so stay for future Updates.

title: The Ballad of Bellum
description: Take a magical adventure in a world with beautiful tilt-shift effects. Explore dungeons, win powerful items, and defeat bosses! But why? This delightful world isn't as simple as it looks.

title: Elusive
description: Elusive is about a young raider, Zoe, following her father's explorer footsteps, encouraged to discover the treasures of the giants' world, despite the dangers she may encounter.

title: Separium: 12th Elevator
description: You are the Administrator of Separium. Complete AI Purry's mission to assess anomalies in the elevator and reach the Administrator's Office on the 12th floor.

title: Doomed Detective Game
description: Doomed Detective Game is a game in which you will play the role of a detective who has arrived in the city of Redrock to figure out a very mysterious crime. Your task is to explore the city, find clues, talk to the residents of the city and find the killer! P.S: Every city resident is an AI...

title: Astral Codec
description: A fan-made expansion exploring the origin of The Interloper.

title: Tiles in Time
description: Enter this challenge in which you must paint all the tiles before reaching the last one in the shortest time possible. Visit different worlds and face different puzzles which will test all your skills.

title: Drehmal: Apotheosis
description: Drehmal: APOTHEOSIS is a massive, one of a kind Minecraft survival/adventure map with a heavy emphasis on exploration. Originally released in 2020 by Keeko & Rift as Drehmal: PRIMORDIAL, the APOTHEOSIS update has been in development for more than 3 years with support from a team of more than 15 incredibly talented developers. APOTHEOSIS transforms Drehmal into a fully realized experience. The update introduces a complete main story and plot alongside tons of vanilla-friendly gameplay mechanics to make Drehmal a highly ambitious, one-of-a-kind Minecraft experience.

title: Plants vs Zombies: Neighborhood Defense
description: Plants vs Zombies Neighborhood Defense is a PVZ fangame with high difficulty and new content!

title: Night is Coming: Wrath of the Woods
description: Survival strategy game set in a world inspired by Slavic mythology and the nature of Eastern Europe. Build your settlement, protect its dwellers, and help them prepare for the coming Darkness.

title: Eternal Guardian Rubine: The First Fight
description: ETERNAL GUARDIAN RUBINE -The First Fight- is a hair trigger 3D run-and-gun-and-sting inspired by many action games from the 90s, but mainly Sin & Punishment, Alien Soldier, Cannon Spike, and Radiant Silvergun. You as the bio-mechanical superweapon Rubine must use your entire arsenal to blast through various overstimulating levels across multiple small scenarios while racking up the biggest high score you can.

title: Azure Hue
description: A young woman finds a blue gem, and starts to experience strange things. How could something so beautiful bring about such awful visions? There's got to be a more reasonable explanation. I mean... "bad luck charms" don't really exist... right?

title: Amphora Hell
description:
"My masterpiece..."
The Kilnmaster strokes his unkempt red beard as he observes the fruit of his labor.
The first 'legged amphora', an idea so profound and arresting that he is sure to become the most respected potter in the realm within days.

But suddenly, his eyes narrow;
"There's a dent, an imperfection! This work is nothing but junk. I'll shatter ya, you lousy pot!"
The terrified amphora swiftly dashes out of the strike's way.
Enraged, The Kilnmaster sends his autonomous mallets after it.
"No evidence of my failure must remain. Prepare to be scrapped!

Can you survive for the entire duration of my goofy ass fl studio beat and escape?
Run, little amphora!

title: Happy Hike
description: Take a Relaxing Walk Through Beautiful Trails

title: Psychiatric Prison Romance: Serial Killer Anime Boys Dating Sim
description: 12 boys, 30 days, one prison… and every decision could be your last.

title: Warriors Waifus Mahjong
description: Battle against fierce warrior waifus in thrilling Mahjong combat. Quick thinking and strategic skill will earn you victory... and rewards that only the boldest can claim as these proud warriors reveal themselves to you.

title: The Great Emu War of 1932
description: The Great Emu War Of 1932 is a fast paced top-down shooter based on the famous failed emu cull in outback Western Australia.

title: Warlordocracy: Chapter 3
description:
Investigate the machinations of the slave-trading Izar Empire, and the silver magnate Sullius Berindal, on the jungle island of Moonshade.

Import your party and reputations from the previous chapter or create a new character from scratch.

title: Star Mission: Remote Sectors
description: In 2224, as a spaceship commander, you’re tasked with investigating a mysterious gravity anomaly on a distant planet. Dive into a story-driven sci-fi adventure, harness cosmic energy, and upgrade your skills to overcome evolving dangers in an uncharted world.

title: Utakata no Uchronia: Trail
description: A fandisc for Illusion of Itehari, which includes sequel stories and alternative scenarios depicting the aftermath of the original game, as well as new routes for Hiiragi and Tsuwabuki.

title: Life Dash
description: Life Dash is a playful life simulator where you strategically manage your time, career, and money, racing friends to achieve happiness, wealth, and success in a colorful cartoon world filled with mini-quests and surprises!

title: Define
description: As the game progresses, the speed at which the fruits fall will increase, making the game more challenging. Players need to react quickly and accurately determine the landing points of the fruits in order to achieve higher scores.

title: Ammo Garden
description: A twin-stick, bullet-hell, roguelite where you Grow and Defend the last Farm in a Post-Apocalyptic Wasteland. Farm Crops, Upgrade Weapons and Kill every Creature that tries to invade your Farm!

title: Don't Shoot First!
description: Face off in Don't Shoot First, a Wild West duel where timing is everything. Draw too soon, you lose. Wait too long… it’s over. Do you have the nerves to hold back and the reflexes to strike at the perfect moment?

title: Tokyo Drive
description: Tokyo Drive is a racing game that uses the location data of actual roads and buildings in Tokyo, Japan (Tokyo's 23 wards).

title: GrigoriNightDragon
description: GrigoriNightDragon is a captivating RPG set in Elyria's fantasy realm. Discover quests, adventures, and formidable dragons guarding castles. Multiple endings ensure endless replayability and a multitude of challanges awit you on your journey!

title: The Untold Legends: Baba Yaga
description: The first in a series of exploration/horror games giving a new twist on old legends. Follow the clues and stay on the trail or navigate the open world and choose your own path, but beware, the actions you take may alter your ending. Unveil the story while evading the clutches of Baba Yaga.

title: Priest With a Gun
description: A late-night vending machine run is cut short when a demonic outbreak occurs in the park. Little do the demons know, Father Garcia is never unarmed.

title: SIMP: Super Infection Massive Pathology
description: SIMP is an exciting microscopic roguelite shooter. Guide Gaylord to rescue his fiancée Zoe from the creatures of the immune system, using an arsenal of organic weapons and unique abilities.

title: Game of Gods
description: Create your own religion and battle for domination of Earth's souls. Collect souls to upgrade your religion and battle other religions to control more territory and expand. Evolve your religion to higher states and dominate earth's souls to create your own utopia here on planet earth!

title: Eldercraft: Mountaineers
description: Eldercraft: Mountaineers is an RPG about crafting, surviving and exploring. Forge your routes and pathways up the mountain to reach valuable treasures. These will help you forge more pathways that will lead you to the summit.

title: Underworld Explorers
description: Journey into the unknown with Underworld Explorers, a bite-sized roguelike with card and dice mechanics where you will fight powerful monsters, level up your heroes, find artifacts and explore deeper until you confront the Underworld Lord!

title: Ominoflux
description: Clear lines, crush enemies, and save the realm of Ominoflux. Master the chaos and build your power in a roguelite adventure with multiple game modes. Ominoflux will surely make you think, and maybe even smile too.

title: Shiny Sisters
description:
The cross-dressing protagonists met each other at an informal social gathering attended by the ojou-sama schools.
While not knowing that they are all guys, they felt a strange affinity with each other.
This development was amusing to Yuuki’s master Ran, so she plotted to make them into an idol group and have them perform at an upcoming event in town.
After some initial confusion about the sudden idea, they all ended up agreeing due to varying reasons.
Will they be able to become idols while keeping their true gender a secret!?

title: DreadHaven: The Last Colony
description: Dreadhaven: The Last Colony is a minimalist turn-based city-building strategy game set in a hostile, post-apocalyptic world overrun by the undead. Your mission is to expand, fortify, and withstand relentless waves of the undead.

title: Funky Maker
description:
Download, play, and create your own music levels easily, comfortably, and quickly.

Dive into the catalog filled with community-made levels and try to achieve the highest scores, or jump into the editor to create your own levels and upload them to the catalog for everyone to try.

Master the rhythm by hitting the arrows with precision to the beat of the music, aim for the top spots on the leaderboards, or become one with the editor and show your creations to the world!

title: All that Glitters
description: All That Glitters is a narrative first person game of about one hour, only available in french as of now. Search a polluted river looking for treasures, discuss with your hallucinations, and find the weapon allowing you to defend yourself against the curse of the Idiot.

title: Skibidi Revenge
description: Vampire-like game about toilets and cameras.

title: Disc Station 98 #2
description: This edition also includes Toushin Toshi (+18) and a demo for Gokichi-kun Series: Igo Nyuumon Doujou.

title: Stellaris: Shadows of the Shroud
description:
Shadows of the Shroud is an expansion for Stellaris, released as a part of the Season 09 Expansion Pass in 2025.

The psionic plane holds untold power—but at what cost? Shadows of the Shroud is a complete overhaul of the Psionic Ascension path, introducing new moral dilemmas, patron allegiances, and the ever-present temptation of ultimate destruction.

title: The Doors That Led to Nowhere
description: "Wake up lost in a void of darkness. With no other option, press onward through cryptic dimensional doors, wielding a mysterious blade created by the fallen entities that came long before you in this heart-pounding First Person RPG."

title: Neo Static
description: A simple 2D platformer about keeping your speed as much as possible. Use your parries to hit off walls and foes to traverse each stage's obstacles with style! Get familiar with each stage to shrink your time lower and lower 'till you reach the highest rank you can!

title: O-Bot The Robot
description: Destroy Evil Robots! Collect Gears! Don't get destroyed!

title: Den' Rozhdeniya 2
description:
Teddybear Finni needs your help with planning his birthday party. Collect items, presents, and fruits and invite your friends!

This game was developed to teach russian kids the English language.

title: Piko Fox!
description: A game where you must get all your presents back! The creature stole them and to get them back you'll need to platform your way through various worlds and stop various foes!

title: Seaside Fireflies
description: A seagull meets a girl on the beach who's having a heck of a time gathering fireflies along the seashore. Undeterred, our hero offers to help her collect every firefly on the beach!

title: Uppercute
description: Uppercute is a 3D action platformer where, with the help of your sister and the use of your runner skills, you’ll dive into people's minds, face challenging opponents and retrieve valuable information to solve the mystery of your brother's disappearance.

title: Amazing Animals Activity Center
description: Explore the woundrous world of animals in ten fun-packed activities

title: Primal Chronicles
description: Primal chronicles is a prehistoric tribe management roguelike. In real-time, you have to order your tribes men to gather, hunt and craft. Every game is a unique journey across multiple lands filled with spirits. You will either lead your tribe to salvation or doom them all.

title: Fault: Broken Promises
description:
“Fault” is a classic RPG with turn-based combat and a wide roster of NPCs to interact with. You can expect an engaging, dialogue-driven story with multiple endings.

You play as Albel, an aspiring newcomer at the academy of magic and swordsmanship.
Gameplay consists of going to the dungeon, fighting monsters and collecting loot before returning to the academy at night. You will be returned from the dungeon if you run out of stamina or get defeated.

title: State Your Business
description: Play the role of white house security officer, check visitors for discrephancies by inspecting documents, interviewing, frisking and searching vehicles. Take care of dignitaries. Earn salary, upgrade skills and materials, level up your security rank to keep the president and the white house safe.

title: My Final Cursed Days - Cursed Transformation Version
description: This DLC version of My Final Cursed Days is the original version of the game, complete with all of its adult content, including transformation hijinks, additional character customization areas, and all other 18+ content not included in the general audience version of the game!

title: Mecha
description: Mecha is a 3D puzzle platformer that follows Coni’s journey to find and fix her errant creations. Along the way, she learns the importance of accepting the challenges she faces and finding greater purpose.

title: Is There a Way?
description: Is there a way? - is a visual novel in which you will immerse yourself in the times of the USSR. You will have to reveal the details of your own story, find accomplices and solve the mysteries of the psychiatric hospital «Turov».

title: Tower Tactics: Astral Siege
description: The second expansion for Tower Tactics: Liberation! Includes a new game mode: Siege, 7 new decks, 50 new cards, 50+ new trinkets, 4 new enemies, 24 new maps and more!

title: Last Box Standing May Go On
description: A puzzle game about cannibalistic box creatures. Yeah.

title: Sky Jumping
description: Sky Jumping is a challenging first-person platformer.Complete all the challenges, get to the top and leave your message for future conquerors.

title: Algos United: Live!
description: Algos United: Live! is a unique community experience where streamers guide armies of their viewers in the fight for territory in the world of Algos, inspired by community-focused games like Stream Raiders, Kukoro, and Jackbox, and taking the concept even further with stronger community bonds, deeper gameplay, and more ways for everyone to participate meaningfully.

title: So Much Stuff 5: Mix-Knacks
description: Explore beautifully crafted levels, clear diverse scenes, and relish in a multitude of engaging mini-games. Collect charming trinkets to adorn a fresh room in "So Much Stuff 5: Mix-Knacks."

title: Colonisator
description: Play as a ship captain, at the head of your shipping company, in a fictional 17th century full of colors and dangers! Colonisator is a game combining turn-based strategy, management, simulation and real time naval combat !

title: Kiko's Apple Adventure
description: A Sokoban game about a curious bear who loves tasty apples. Explore islands, move the finish line, and outsmart your enemies.

title: Joy Life 4
description: Joy Life 4 is a card flipping game that tests memory. In the game, you need to flip the cards to find two cards with the same picture to eliminate them. If the cards are not consistent, the cards will not change. If they are the same picture, they will be eliminated.

title: It’s A Game Changer
description: t's A Game Changer is a fast-paced, single-player microgame roguelike inspired by WarioWare. Cycle through diverse 2D and 3D microgames like dodging the rain and fishing. Choose upgrades, face rapid-fire challenges, and enjoy endless replayability. Created by a passionate indie developer.

title: I'm Pregnant at 16
description: A story-driven game about Lida, a 16-year-old girl facing an unexpected pregnancy. Make decisions, navigate relationships, and deal with the consequences of your choices in a story blending drama, humor, and absurdity.

title: Eternal Vampire
description: In this 2D action game, you control a vampire with melee and magic abilities. Defeat enemies and earn XP, get new swords and spells. Explore random dungeons, fight bosses and reach new enemies using teleport points.

title: Fantasy Clicker
description: Fantasy Clicker is an idle clicker game with some RPG elements. Battle different monsters in fantasy inspired levels, gather gold/resources to upgrade your heroes and buildings. Farm experience to level up.

title: NIPA
description: NIPA is a Dungeon Crawler with puzzles where you can't shoot. You control Ney, a being from a pacifist race who must climb the White Tower to redeem himself and save his people.

title: Exploding Kittens 2
description: Download Exploding Kittens 2 and live your best and most chaotic kitty life! Take a deep whiff of burning furballs, draw a card and pray for victory (and look stylish all the while, thanks to oodles of customisation options for your own adorable avatar).

title: Platformer Paradise
description: Avoid Obstacles to complete levels, use anything to your advantage, hiding behind walls, glass, even staying out of the view of Cannons will suffice towards your survival.

title: Night Blood W: Cutthroat Wolf
description: "Nightblood W: Cutthroat Wolf" is a cyberpunk action role-playing game. You will play the role of an ambitious gang cadre. Your goal is to challenge and eliminate the rebellious Frey Gang alone, prove your strength, and eventually reach the top of the gang to control the entire city.

title: GrimWhimsy
description: In GrimWhimsy, you and your friends are convicted criminals thrown into the dark corridors of a forgotten laboratory. Survive, trick the monsters, and laugh together when things go wrong. Can you escape this hell? Find out for yourself!

title: Speak of my sin
description: Speak of My Sin is a word reasoning game - players are supposed to find the truth of the cases, restore the story in a number of interrelated cases and finally detect the identification of “me”, speaking out “my” sin.

title: Jenga Cat
description: Cat on Jenga tower - land it softly! Click Jenga pieces to collapse tower with cat on top - gently to the ground! Remove pieces with greater height difference from cat for higher scores. Clear target score to safely land the cat and win!

title: Striker!
description: Striker! is a retro-inspired football-golf game set across 40+ levels. Control your team of Strikers and shoot your ball over a wide range of different courses and mechanics.

title: Beyond The Tales
description: A turn-based RPG about some friends that want to discover the meaning of their existence, but if they do, the world will end. This game will break the story to enter to a surreal aftergame experience.

title: Flora Corner
description: Flora Corner is a cozy idle game about growing houseplants and decorating your living space.

title: SaveKunkun
description: Dive into horror-comedy with SaveKunkun. Play as an IKUN fan stuck in a time loop, remembering each reset. When a prank injures your friend, prevent their fall using over 100 methods. Explore time's mysteries, uncover friend's intentions, and save them.

title: Strider-X
description: Strider-X - Multiplayer First Person Competitive TDM Shooter featuring massive, high quality maps, and immersive gameplay crafted to attract all gamers. Proudly being built based on our communities feedback and input.

title: ScrapDown
description: Scrap Down is action shooter arena in the style of a 2D shooter set in a space theme. It offers casual and fast-paced shooting mechanics that are easy to understand. It enhances the fun by allowing players to prank each other with in-game items.

title: Kanna School
description: Welcome to Kanna Academy, a highly entertaining and innovative side-scrolling tower defense game!

title: Deck of Defense
description: Deck of Defense is a deck-building, tower defense game where you place cards to defend your base. Craft a unique deck, upgrade your abilities, unlock game-breaking defense strategies, and see if your Deck of Defense can stand the test of time.

title: Taxi Goldmania
description: Become a taxi driver in this 3D arcade race-runner. You will have to transport passengers, following traffic rules, driving the car, avoiding collisions, delivering passengers on time, and collecting coins.

title: Pirates Slayer
description: Pirates Slayer is an exciting 3D action-roguelike game where each level represents a new adventure! You will have to battle sinister skeletons, collect gold coins, and use them to unlock unique characters and powerful weapons.

title: Spaceport Assault
description: You are all alone on a hostile spaceport. Try to find the best weapons hidden on the map, because you will have to fight back. There are more and more enemies. They're chasing you. Hurry up.

title: Do You Have a Moment to Talk About Our Lord and Savior?
description: A Short Rogue-like Deckbuilder! As a missionary, you’re forced into a cardgame by a wicked man. He promises if you beat level 13, he'll set you free. Draw as many cards as you like, but if you pull the same color twice, all your cards burn! Obtain SPECIAL CARDS. Build Your Deck. Reach Level 13!

title: Primal Slideee
description: Does this game seem easy and simple to you? It will require both your skill and luck.

title: Kamilia
description:
Kamilia is an emotional, story-driven detective mystery where your choices shape the outcome.

Step into the shoes of a gifted painter, pulled into an unsolved mystery. An investigation that soon turns into something far deeper — an intimate, heartfelt search for truth.

Explore a beautifully crafted narrative blending mystery, emotion, and visual storytelling into a unique, choice-driven experience.

title: The Pilgrim's Progress
description: Join us in "The Pilgrim's Progress," an epic journey inspired by John Bunyan's classic. Follow Christian's path to the Celestial City, exploring stunning environments, solving puzzles, engaging in strategic battles, and experiencing themes of faith, redemption, and perseverance. Support our vision!

title: GunBang
description: GunBang is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you face off hordes of enemies and bosses. Choose from a variety of weapons, traits and items to create unique builds and survive until observers are satisfied!

title: Wilderness: Survival
description: Wilderness: Survival is a single or multiplayer survival game. It is a pirate-like game where you can hunt, mine,fightning ,farming,gun crafting,fishing, fight skeletons and evolve. Duel with your friends etc. You can do. The game is still under development, please give constructive criticism.

title: Defense of the Sodomites
description: An exciting tower defense game where you have to defend your people from the invasion of enemy forces. Your task is to build and upgrade cannons to fend off waves of attacking enemies.

title: Capers vs Pirates
description: Capers vs Pirates is an exciting 3D tower defense game where players take on the role of cunning capers defending their treasures from raids by greedy pirates. In this game, you will need to set up the perfect defense as the game is challenging. Use your strategic thinking!

title: Nuke Bomberman
description: In this exciting game, you will find yourself in a maze where every step could be your last. Your task is to navigate through the twisty corridors, using bombs to blast through walls and monsters.

title: Miraculous Fall
description: Miraculous Fall is an exciting 3D Adventure game where players face the consequences of a catastrophic event that has altered the laws of physics. Your task is to carefully descend on various objects to safely return to the ground.

title: Recovering Stolen
description: Recovering Stolen is an intellectual game where your task is to organize various goods in the three-dimensional space of the store. Use your logic skills and spatial thinking to optimally place the items.

title: Air Hares
description: Join the intrepid bunny pilot, Captain Rabbo, and her crew of fluffy flyers as they fight to turn the barren Winrose Warren into a blossoming landscape! Become an Air Hare in a unique take on bullet hells, restoring farmland one seed at a time, against the nefarious Gale Gang goons!

title: Shadow Puppet
description: A short horror game about wandering through vaguely familiar memories while something endlessly follows you. It moves when you do, and you need to get out before it catches up.

title: Castaway Soul
description: Adapt and survive against an ever increasing menace! Castaway Soul is a casual Isometric 3D rogue-lite game, with elements of mystery and bullet-heaven like action that combines wave-to-wave upgrades with meta-progression builds.

title: Laserstorm
description: Welcome to Laserstorm, the wild, free-for-all, shooter where you can unleash chaos as your favorite critter, decked out in your choice of stylish hats! Join up to 3 other friends in a frenzy of lasers and excitement, where only the savviest animals survive.

title: Chibi Reboot
description: Guide Chibi through a total of 16 different levels with increasing difficulty. Collect various items and face your opponents. Keep an eye on your heart display, and don’t let Chibi end up in the junkyard. 8-bit background music.

title: Mounted War
description: Mounted War is a third-person shooter where players ride horses, shoot, and command armies. Deep strategy and action: using military units like archers and cavalry for victory through medieval battles and trade.

title: Over Clock
description: "Over Clock" is an innovative adventure game that combines puzzles and exploration. Players place blocks and delve deep underground aiming for the 100th line. Experience different terrains in each stage, collect materials to develop new skills. Strategy and speed are the keys to success.

title: Artificial Fashionista: Summer Collection
description: A set of 35+ new Summer-themed items for Foris to wear!

title: Galactic Inferno
description: Sci-Fi RPG: Engage in epic battles, upgrade your hero, and conquer the galaxy!

title: Ashwood Conspiracy
description: Ashwood Conspiracy is a story-rich point-and-click adventure game. Follow in your late uncle's footsteps to uncover the mystery behind the most devastating event in Ashwood's history. Find, collect, and combine items to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. Will you dare to finish what he started?

title: Revolver roulette
description: Revolver roulette is a game that tests players' courage and luck. In the game, a revolver will be used to simulate the scene of Russian roulette. Players need to load bullets, use items to increase their chances of winning, and finally shoot to defeat the opponent and receive their prize money.

title: Invention 5
description: 3D first-person shooter with Scrollshooter elements. Complete levels, kill zombies and fight bosses to defeat the main villain - Casey.

title: Danger and Deadlier
description: Danger and Deadlier is a hardcore medieval fantasy dungeon adventure game. Join intense 6v6v6 battles with different classes. Dungeon-style exploration lets you find valuable treasures. What are you waiting for? Join this gold rush now!"

title: Weaponry (Experimental)
description: A fast-paced 1v1 randomized FPS game.

title: Flip Coin
description: Experience the journey of flipping a coin to reach your destination.

title: Pixel Flip
description: Embark on endless stages of card matching fun. Dive into a vibrant world, collect all the "Pixels", strategize your moves and level up your character. Can you become the ultimate Pixel Collector?

title: Battle Street
description: To fight alone or side by side with your friend,one-on-one for fun. Defend yourself Tuesday with special powers and attack.

title: Stellaris: BioGenesis
description:
BioGenesis is an expansion for Stellaris, released as a part of the Season 09 Expansion Pass in 2025.

Step into the role of a master geneticist, sculpting the galaxy to your design with living ships, engineered ecosystems, and enhanced species. Forge new paths with unparalleled bioengineering tools to create a civilization that thrives on adaptability and evolution – or exploit these tools to dominate the stars.

title: The Adventures of Penny & Lou
description: Step into the paws of two brave shar-pei sisters on a daring mission through Stray City. This captivating 2D platformer whisks you away on an adventure with Penny and Lou as they strive to rescue their cherished toys and lend a helping paw to stray puppies in need.

title: Death Report
description: This is a horror game that will take you into a world full of suspense, thrills, and psychological challenges, testing your courage and wisdom, uncovering secrets that have been sealed by time. -Pure manual map, without using automatically generated maps -Pure manual system, easy to adjust

title: Burning Sky
description: Fight and survive a desolate half-destroyed planet cracker, teeming with mutated wildlife and robotic enemies. Will you make it out alive?

title: Histo-Time
description: Help your favorite historical characters from different eras and places face challenging levels and obstacles, including epic boss battles. Who is behind all this confusion? Find out in this sharp game what they are capable of doing to save the world.

title: SpinGhost
description: In this score-based game, control a runner on a rotating ring. Dodge obstacles by switching edges with a click or space bar. Face gimmicks and increasing speed over time. The spinning camera adds complexity. Quick decisions lead to high scores.

title: Escape the Arcana
description: Lost in an enchanted forest, face the Major Arcana in a roguelike deckbuilder journey. Relax, make card combos, navigate shifting paths, and enjoy the groovy jazz. Experiment with different builds and strategies to defeat all 22 Major Arcana and escape.

title: Fire & Brimstone
description: Fire & Brimstone is a traditional roguelike with a randomized skilltree. You play as Jess, a lonely imp come to explore the depths of a temple lost in the guts of a volcano, in search of a powerful artfact that may let them have friends.

title: Garden of the Sea
description: A chilled-out life sim where you play, craft, and explore across magical islands. Build a house, grow a garden, nurture animals, adventure across the surrounding ocean, and make yourself at home!

title: Tour de France 2025
description: The official game takes on a new dimension with new graphics for increased immersion. Take on the roads of the Tour de France 2025, sprint, climb, and try to win the mythical Yellow Jersey.

title: Velvet's Veil
description: An adult narrative game combining meaningful choices and real-time action, set in an intriguing contemporary nighttime setting.

title: Takenoko: Tilt Five AR
description: Gardeners in imperial Japan have been tasked to see who is worthy of caring for the sacred panda. Cultivate your plots, grow bamboo, and complete objectives in this holographic adaption of the award-winning board game now available for Tilt Five!

title: Re-Exit
description: Re-Exit, a psychological horror, spot the anomaly game that challenges your perception and attention to detail. Trapped in a temporal loop, your mission is to observe your surroundings carefully and report any anomalies.

title: The Hypnic Chain
description:
The Hypnic Chain is a “dream emulator” based on imagery, situations, and environments that have been known to haunt the developer's dreams.

Inspired by LSD: Dream Emulator, its successor Yume Nikki, and the extended family of RPG Maker horror.

title: Wildgate
description: Wildgate is a PVP multiplayer shooter that blends tactical ship-to-ship combat with fast-paced first-person action. Evade deadly environmental hazards, search for powerful weapons and ship upgrades, and be the first crew to escape with the Artifact... or the last crew left flying.

title: The Unlit Sun
description: The Unlit Sun is a psychological horror game played from a first-person perspective, delving into the boundaries between consciousness and the unknown. Trapped in a distorted world shaped by a mysterious entity named Nyctarion, Ethan struggles to escape a dark reality forged by buried secrets and enigmatic symbolism. In an atmosphere filled with tension and looming danger, every decision draws the protagonist closer to—or further from—his fate. Uncover a deep and unsettling story where light and darkness are two sides of the same power.

title: Sunken Engine
description: Sunken Engine is a Lovecraftian Ship Repair Simulator. Restore the old shipyard you inherited from your father. Every arriving ship carries a dark mystery waiting to be uncovered. While keeping your customers happy, you must also deal with the strange and eerie events happening on the island.

title: GeoGuessr: Steam Edition
description: Explore the world with GeoGuessr Steam Edition! Compete against others, climb divisions, and prove your geography skills. Travel to stunning locations, analyze clues, and make your best guess.

title: Shelley Duvall's Tales of Digby the Dog
description: Meet Digby, the one-pound dog, and his friends, in three animated, interactive stories and 7 fun-filled games. Includes wacky sound studio, animated surprises hidden within every screen, and 5 sing-along tunes

title: Yurei Hunt
description: Yurei Hunt is a multiplayer hide & seek prop hunt game where deception is key. Play as a Yurei, possessing objects & using abilities, or as a Hunter, relying on instincts & proximity voice chat to track them. With a world full of tricks, surprises & eerie tension, every match is a battle of wits.

title: Nice Pro?
description: Have you ever dreamt of a better version of Nice Pro? Younger, more beautiful, more perfect.

title: Banana Ragdoll
description: Banana Ragdoll is a game where you can be amogus and look at Bananas! You can destroy tall towers with realistic physics! There are 3 levels available to you and many character physical property settings.

title: Zombiefield
description: New Zombiefield contractors! Your mission is to open portals to attract tougher zombies and evacuate before the missile strike. Work together with your manager to reduce risks and get paid for completing your contract

title: Smartplant
description: The agricultural megacorporation Emmer Technologies is intent on controlling the world-wide food supply with their novel UtopiaBot technology. Play as Dr. Teagan Wixx who must confront Emmer and their controversial food revolution as she also struggles with a complex and very personal mystery.

title: Danganronpa V4 Rocky Restarts
description: Danganronpa V4 Rocky Restarts is a now cancelled cancelled Danganronpa fangame. The game had a prologue, one fully released chapter, and half of a second chapter prior to its cancellation.

title: Jungle Jumperz
description: Let's Jumpz!

title: Dachs Hunter
description: Dachs Hunter is a survivors-like top-down roguelite game where you play as a dachshund wizard battling through hordes of elemental monsters. Discover and collect unique spells, master all elements, and strategize your way to survival.

title: Myriad Death
description:
High Difficulty Pixel Roguelike Action Raspberry Mash will feature Hololive English -Myth-'s Mori Calliope!!

"MYRIAD DEATH" is a fan-made action and shooting game in which hololive English -Myth- member "Mori Calliope" and her master "Death-sensei" reclaim the stolen underworld.

Defeat the enemies that stand in your way using various weapons that drop randomly from treasure chests in the dungeon!

title: Velistra: Failed State
description: Assume the presidency of Velistra, a nation teetering on collapse. Every choice reshapes destiny amid ruthless factions, moral dilemmas, and global pressures. A careful balance must be struck in both economics and politics. How will you lead?

title: Our War: Firepower Suppression
description: A grand and intense flying shooting game with powerful firepower output to suppress enemies and enjoy the fun of combat.

title: Echoes of the Divine Tree
description: "Fight with faith!" This is a traditional-style yuri-themed card RPG. Build your deck, unearth relics, forge equipment, strive to become stronger, defeat various oddities, and change the fate of the divine tree's offspring, Hecate.

title: Death Delivery
description: Death Delivery is satisfying, fast-paced First Person Shooter with stylized slow motion,music, action and old-school trial-and-error difficulty.

title: Six-Ear Macaque: Awakening
description: Six- Ear Macaque: Awakening is a casual role-playing game based on the Chinese classic novel Journey to the West. The protagonist is one of the Six- Ear Macaque, is one of the "mixed four monkeys", ability and Sun Wukong equal. In the game, you will explore the legendary path of your destiny.

title: Rocket Delivery: Space Wok
description: A backpack building run-and-gun game! Fill your backpack with guns, blast away space bugs, and deliver noodles to hungry customers!

title: Dead Pixel
description: How sharp are your eyes? Can you see it? Is it even there? If you've never seen a dead pixel now is your chance.

title: Run-Sprint-Parkour!
description: An action-adventure sports 3D platform survival game. Qualify to join thrilling running competitions, and unleash your unstoppable potential. Put on an unforgettable show and rise to riches—go from zero to hero!

title: Little Red Riding Hood: Endless Zoom Tale
description: Little Red Riding Hood goes through the forest to see her grandmother, but a wolf is stalking her... What will happen?

title: My Name is Mayo: Remayo
description: In My Name is Mayo: Remayo, the real-life tapping, clicking adventure of a Mayo Jar returns!

title: 1-Bit Dungeon
description: 1-Bit Dungeon is a fast-paced 2D action platformer that tests your swordsmanship in a brutal retro-inspired adventure. With crisp 1-bit pixel art and modern design, it offers intense combat, tight controls, and a rewarding challenge.

title: Tropicali
description:
Babes, money and power. What else could you want in tropical paradise?

Welcome to Tropicali! Where all your dreams can come true at the expense of everyone else!

Tropicali is a light management sim with visual novel narrative where you, son of a mexican politic turned entrepeneur, inherit his resort on the exhotic island of Tropicali.
Manage your workers, buy land and flirt with the girls as you uncover their secrets and those of Tropicali itself.

title: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Assassin's Creed Shadows Digital Deluxe Edition includes the base game and the Deluxe Pack.

Experience an epic action-adventure story set in feudal Japan! Become a lethal shinobi assassin and powerful legendary samurai as you explore a beautiful open world in a time of chaos. Master complementary playstyles, create your shinobi league, customize your hideout, and usher in a new era for Japan.

title: Murim Survival
description: Murim Survival is a survival roguelite where you battle relentless enemies within a time limit. Explore a world on the brink of collapse, master martial arts, collect powerful equipment, and unlock unique traits to become a true hero of the Murim. The fate of this world is in your hands.

title: Bleach: Rebirth of Souls - Deluxe Edition
description: Awaken the blade within you and reverse your fate in BLEACH Rebirth of Souls! Engage in thrilling battles with powerful sword abilities and characters from this legendary anime franchise.

title: 2urvive + 3xtinction
description: Two perfect games for all lovers of brutal top down shooters.

title: Bleach: Rebirth of Souls - Ultimate Edition
description: Awaken the blade within you and reverse your fate in BLEACH Rebirth of Souls! Engage in thrilling battles with powerful sword abilities and characters from this legendary anime franchise.

title: Boomerforge
description: Grimdur Stoneheart is an ex-adventurer dwarf, now the manager of the greatest forge on Bramblegate. Stories about a new mine full of ore started to circulate on the city and Grimdur himself decided to explore the mine, using only his trusty bombs to clear the path. Can the dwarf find the legendary ore to create the Ultime Weapon?

title: Boxes Wizard
description: Boxes Wizard is a platform and puzzle game with 36 challenging levels. You control a wizard with the unique ability to swap with boxes scattered throughout the stage.

title: Dinobreak: Couch Co-Op Collection
description: Is a bundle of survival horror games from developer Dead Drop Studios.

title: Outbreak: Shades of Horror Chromatic Split Lost Lives Collection
description: Is a bundle of survival horror games from developer Dead Drop Studios.

title: Al Sira
description: "Al Sira" is a narrative-driven puzzle game that lets you uncover the life, teachings, and actions of Muhammad, the Prophet of Islam. Solve mysteries, explore key historical events, and piece together his remarkable legacy in this immersive and thought-provoking journey.

title: Raccoon is Hungry
description: Racoon is Hungry is the second installment of the "Is Hungry" series. Follow the adventures of a gluttonous racoon searching for food, but in the city the food is not as easy to pass by on the ground. To find food the racoon must search inside dumpsters for edibles food, such as apples, slices of piza, hamburguers, grapes and so on. But watch out, as food is not the only thing that is possible to find on a dumpster! What kind of surprise awaits the curious racoon?

title: Azumanga Donjara Daiou DX
description: A version of the board game Donjara/Ponjan featuring characters and art from Azumanga Daioh. Inspired by the PlayStation game Azumanga Donjara Daiou.

title: Sea of Thieves: X Edition
description: Dive into Sea of Thieves with this special edition of the smash-hit pirate adventure, which includes the base version of the game along with a comprehensive collection of ship sets inspired by Xbox and beloved Xbox titles, plus a varied assortment of cosmetics, currency and access to digital bonus media.

title: Spot Challenge Vol. 3
description: Spot Challenge is a game series inspired by 'Find the Differences,' where you compare two images and spot over 340 differences across 35 levels. Play solo or with friends and family—test your attention to detail in this fun challenge!

title: Firefighter Frankie
description: Help Firefighter Frankie, the brave Golden Retriever, save the town! Drive your firetruck, upgrade your tools, and fight fires . Find clues to solve the mystery and uncover who is causing the trouble. Relax and explore at your own pace in a colorful low-poly world.

title: Pantheon Rift
description: Get ready for a thrilling party-style battle arena where your only weapon is a sword. Take down other players while avoiding environmental chaos and destruction. The fast-paced matches and unpredictable environment require quick thinking, adaptability, and strategy.

title: TurtleRun
description: Slow and steady? Not this turtle! Leap, dodge, shoot, and parry your way back through this mysterious land to reunite with your beloved home.This fast-paced platformer is packed with tricky platforming levels, engaging mini-games, intense boss fights, and a determined turtle on a mission.

title: My Furry Protogen 3
description: The choice has been made, and now there is no turning back - they must find and stop him. The final chapter in the adventure of our heroes.

title: Chupacabra Hunt
description: Chupacabra Hunt is a Chupacabra hunting horror game, a vampiric creature that is feeding on the blood of animals in the region. Track the creature by following its footprints and listening to its screams, prepare your weapon and kill it.

title: Warno: Nemesis #1 - Air Assault
description: Victory from above as you take command of two brand-new divisions in Nemesis: Air Assault. The famous American U.S. 101st Airborne Division (Air Assault) and the hardy Afghanistan War veterans of the Soviet 56th Separate Air Assault Brigade feature several new units, models, and unique vehicles.

title: Madame Fifi's Bakery
description: Play as the adorable cat baker, Madame Fifi, and craft the townsfolks' favorite sweet treats in this cozy baking game! Fulfill the orders of the vibrant animal village and complete the customers requests of scrumptious baked goods with satisfying gameplay!
